items.title: Chinese Ink Warrior on Horseback
items.titleZh: A dramatic vertical Chinese ink wash painting in monochrome black, charcoal, and soft gray on off-white rice paper, in the style of expressive shan shui brush art and heroic historical wuxia illustration. On the right side, a lone armored general sits upright on a dark warhorse atop a rocky cliff, viewed from behind and slightly in profile, looking out over a vast army below. The warrior wears layered black lamellar armor, a flowing windblown cloak, and a topknot with long trailing ribbons; he holds a straight sword angled downward beside the horse. The horse is muscular and glossy black, standing firmly near the cliff edge with its tail and mane subtly swept by the wind. Below and across the lower half of the scene, a dense battlefield mass of soldiers appears as misty silhouettes with upright spears and several battle flags, partially obscured by fog. In the distance, steep mountain peaks emerge through drifting mist on the upper right, with 7 small birds flying across the pale sky near the center. On the left side, include 2 large vertical columns of bold black Chinese calligraphy in wild cursive brush strokes: the main quote reading “一身转战三千里，一剑曾当百万师”, with a smaller vertical signature “王维” below, plus a small red seal stamp. Emphasize strong negative space, textured ink bleeding, splattered brush edges, atmospheric haze, epic solitude, martial grandeur, and a solemn, contemplative mood.

items.title: Chinese Ink Swordsman and Calligraphy
items.titleZh: A dramatic vertical Chinese ink-wash painting on aged rice paper, minimalist monochrome with soft warm parchment tones, showing a lone ancient swordsman standing on the edge of a steep dark cliff at the right side of the composition, seen mostly from behind in three-quarter back view. He wears flowing historical robes and a long wind-whipped cloak, with long dark hair tied in a topknot and loose strands streaming sideways in the wind, and he holds a straight sword lowered in his right hand. Below and to the left stretches a vast misty landscape with 1 distant walled frontier city, faint watchtowers and rooftops, a winding river or plain, and layered mountain silhouettes fading into haze. Use expressive black brushwork, splattered ink textures, dry-brush edges, atmospheric empty space, and a powerful contrast between the dense dark figure and cliff and the pale open background. Add 2 large vertical columns of bold black calligraphy on the left half, reading “愿将腰下剑” and “直为斩楼兰。”, plus 1 smaller vertical inscription to the far left reading “塞下曲六首 李白”, and include 2 small red seal stamps, one near the small inscription and one near the upper right corner. The mood is heroic, lonely, contemplative, and defiant, like a Tang-dynasty poet-warrior poster rendered as traditional sumi-e.

items.titleZh: A vertical traditional Chinese ink-wash painting on aged off-white rice paper, minimalist monochrome palette with soft gray washes and deep black brushwork. The composition combines large expressive Chinese calligraphy on the left and center with a misty shanshui landscape on the right. Write the quote in bold hand-brushed characters: “照人如照水，切玉如切泥。” arranged in 2 vertical columns, with 4 large characters in the left column and 4 large characters plus punctuation in the center-right column, each character painted with energetic dry-brush and wet-brush variation, visible tapering strokes, splashes, and ink texture. Add 2 red seal stamps: one small oval seal near the upper left beside the calligraphy, and one square seal near the lower left corner. On the right half, paint towering craggy cliffs with sparse pine trees, drifting fog, and 2 thin waterfalls descending into a calm river. In the lower right foreground, show 2 ancient Chinese scholars in flowing hanfu robes and topknots, seated across a flat stone table on river rocks, leaning over a board game or manuscript in quiet discussion; their forms should be small relative to the landscape. Include still water reflections, distant low islets, and layered atmospheric mist. Overall feeling: contemplative, literati painting, poetic solitude, elegant scholarly mood, Song-dynasty-inspired ink illustration with masterful calligraphy.

Beside her is 1 floating Magnezone-like robot creature, metallic silver and blue-gray with a domed body, 1 central red eye, 1 smaller side eye, a yellow antenna on top, and 2 horseshoe magnets as arms with red and blue tips. items.title: Cyberpunk Fallen Angel Samurai
items.titleZh: A hyper-detailed symmetrically composed anime-inspired cyberpunk illustration on a flat, saturated {argument name="background color" default="crimson red"} background. Centered in the frame, a solitary androgynous warrior sits slouched on a dark wooden chair, legs apart, hands relaxed between the knees, projecting calm menace and fallen-divinity energy. The face is intentionally obscured and unreadable, framed by an elaborate black samurai-style horned helmet with 2 curved horns and dense mechanical ornamentation. The figure has 2 large white feathered wings spread outward from the back. Behind and around the seated body, the composition splits into two contrasting organic-tech masses: on the left side, a chaotic storm of 1 dense tangle of teal and dark blue cables, wires, plugs, circuit fragments, and techno-organic tendrils; on the right side, 1 explosive bloom of pink cherry blossoms, petals, curling branches, and ribbon-like floral swirls. Place 1 upright katana behind the figure on the right side, angled slightly inward, with a black handle and visible guard. Dress the character in a mixed streetwear and armored outfit: a split-tone jacket with the left half in dark cyan-black circuitry patterns and the right half in pale pink floral patterns, black fitted pants with asymmetrical detailing, mismatched striped socks in cyan and pink, and chunky high-top sneakers with oversized soles, one predominantly cyan-black and the other predominantly pink-white, both covered in graphic paneling and straps. The hands should look partly mechanical or armored, with long sharp fingers. Flood the image with tiny decorative fragments, petals, paint-like flecks, and micro-details so the entire scene feels intricately hand-inked. Use a high-contrast palette dominated by {argument name="accent color 1" default="teal blue"}, {argument name="accent color 2" default="pink"}, black, and white against the red field. Render in an ultra-detailed manga-meets-graffiti style with crisp linework, dense textures, poster-like frontal framing, and a balanced fusion of angelic, demonic, floral, and cybernetic motifs.
items.promptZh: 一幅超详细、对称、受动漫启发的赛博朋克插图，位于平坦、饱和的{argument name="background color" default="crimson red"}背景上。画面中央，一位孤独的雌雄同体的战士无精打采地坐在一张深色木椅上，双腿分开，双手放松在膝盖之间，投射出平静的威胁和堕落的神性能量。脸部被刻意遮挡且难以辨认，周围是精致的黑色武士风格有角头盔，头盔上有两个弯曲的角和密集的机械装饰。该人物有两个巨大的白色羽毛翅膀，从背部向外展开。在坐着的身体后面和周围，构图分成两个对比鲜明的有机技术体：在左侧，由一团浓密的青色和深蓝色电缆、电线、插头、电路碎片和技术有机卷须组成的混乱风暴；在左边，是由一团浓密的青色和深蓝色电缆、电线、插头、电路碎片和技术有机卷须组成的混乱风暴；在左边，是由一团浓密的青色和深蓝色电缆、电线、插头、电路碎片和技术有机卷须组成的混乱风暴。右侧是一朵绽放的粉红色樱花、花瓣、卷曲的树枝和丝带状的花朵漩涡。将 1 个直立的武士刀放在右侧人物后面，稍微向内倾斜，带有黑色手柄和可见的防护装置。为角色穿上混合街头服饰和装甲服装：一件左半身为深青黑色电路图案、右半身为浅粉色花卉图案的分色夹克、带有不对称细节的黑色合身裤、不匹配的青色和粉色条纹袜子，以及带有超大鞋底的厚底高帮运动鞋，一只主要是青黑色，另一只主要是粉白色，两者都覆盖有图案镶板和带子。双手看起来应该是机械的或装甲的，手指又长又锋利。用微小的装饰碎片、花瓣、油漆般的斑点和微观细节充斥图像，使整个场景感觉错综复杂的手绘。使用以 {argument name="accent color 1" default="teal blue"}、{argument name="accent color 2" default="pink"}、黑色和白色为主的高对比度调色板，与红色字段相对应。以超详细的漫画与涂鸦风格进行渲染，具有清晰的线条、密集的纹理、海报般的正面框架，以及天使、恶魔、花卉和控制论图案的平衡融合。

items.title: Protein Powder Splash Hero Shot
items.titleZh: Create a hyper-realistic commercial product splash shot of a large white plastic whey protein tub labeled {argument name="brand name" default="PUREZZA"} and {argument name="product name" default="WHEYPRO"}, floating slightly above a glass filled with thick chocolate protein shake. The tub is centered, angled slightly to the right, with a clean glossy surface and a bold blue, white, and black label design. The label should prominently read “100% WPC PROTEIN MILK” and include small nutrition callouts such as “82G PROTEIN,” “2G SUGAR/SERVING,” “119% RDI OF VC,” “100% CHOLINE,” a circular “GMP” badge, a black strip reading “WHEY MILK PROTEIN CONCENTRATE,” another strip reading “LOW SUGAR / LOW FAT / RICH NATURAL,” and a flavor tag reading {argument name="flavor text" default="BLACK COOKIES FLAVOUR"}. Surround the tub with an explosive upward and outward splash of glossy chocolate liquid, with dramatic arcs, droplets, and suspended motion frozen in midair. Include exactly 5 whole chocolate sandwich cookies flying around the product and multiple broken cookie chunks and crumbs scattered throughout the scene, with one partially visible cookie near the lower right and another near the upper left. The glass at the bottom should be only partially visible, transparent, and overflowing from the impact of the splash. Use a high-contrast studio background with a dark deep blue gradient on the left fading to bright white on the right, cinematic rim lighting, crisp reflections, ultra-sharp focus on the tub, and detailed texture in the liquid and cookie crumbs. The overall look should be premium sports nutrition advertising, dynamic, energetic, and suitable for a hero image on a modern ecommerce fitness website.

items.title: Oil Pastel Anime Catgirl
items.titleZh: A cute anime catgirl crouching low in a playful pose, drawn as a hand-made oil pastel illustration on textured off-white paper. She has long straight {argument name="hair color" default="deep purple with lighter lavender ends"} hair, large pointed orange cat ears on top of her head, and a striped orange-and-black cat tail curving in from the right side. Her outfit is a tiger-inspired bodysuit in vivid {argument name="outfit color" default="bright orange"} with bold black accents: long fitted sleeves, a dark black chest and torso panel, orange legs, orange gloves, and a soft pale pink patch on the hip and upper thigh area. She is squatting with one knee raised, one hand touching the ground in front of her, and the other hand lifted in a salute near her forehead, facing the viewer with a mischievous, energetic feel. Render the whole image in rough crayon-like oil pastel strokes with visible grain, uneven sketchy black outlines, scribbled color fill, and childlike analog texture. Use a warm pastel palette with orange as the dominant color, purple hair, soft pink scribbled background shading, and a purple-blue scribbled shadow beneath her. Keep the composition as a single centered full-body character on paper, whimsical, charming, slightly messy, and irresistibly cute, like an expressive pastel doodle illustration.

items.titleZh: A soft, cute oil pastel portrait illustration of a young woman sitting indoors, drawn in a handmade crayon-like style with visible waxy strokes, rough sketch lines, and lightly textured paper. She is shown from about the thighs up in a slightly forward-leaning seated pose, one elbow resting on her knee and one hand supporting her cheek, creating a casual candid feeling. Give her {argument name="hair color" default="medium chestnut brown"} shoulder-length hair with a center part and softly flipped ends, with loose strands framing the face. Dress her in a chunky ribbed knit sweater in {argument name="sweater color" default="muted gray"}, paired with a high-waisted skirt in {argument name="skirt color" default="warm beige"}. Add 2 pieces of jewelry: one dangling earring visible on the right side and one delicate necklace with a small pendant. Add 1 small crossbody bag with a thin strap running diagonally across the torso and the pouch resting near the waist. Use a warm neutral palette of cream, beige, gray, brown, and soft charcoal, with gentle ochre highlights. Keep the facial features minimal and softly suggested in the same pastel style, with a sweet, cozy, very cute mood. The layout is vertical, with a dense information panel on the left and the main figures dominating the center and right. At the top left, large serif English title text reads "LEVERAGE INFINITY" under smaller Japanese text "スタンド名:". Below it, a left-column profile card contains 6 visible info lines with Japanese labels and values: "スタンド使い名:" with the value "1-sphere", "性別: 不詳", "見た目:" followed by a short Japanese description, "年齢: 不詳", "身長: 96cm", and "職業: 市場の条省・養分". Beneath that, add a framed ability box titled "スタンド能力" containing several lines of Japanese body text and a bold English catchphrase at the bottom reading exactly: "Choose... TO THE MOOOOON!! Or face the MARGIN CAAAAALL!!". At the lower left, add a framed radar chart section titled "スタンドパラメータ" with 5 labeled stats around the graph: "破壊力 B", "持続力 C", "成長性 A", "スピード C", and "人念力 B"; fill the radar graph with a translucent pink polygon. The main illustration shows 2 stacked figures: a humanoid Stand above and a pig-like user below. The Stand is tall, metallic, and menacing, with a mushroom-cap helmet head in glossy red with white spots, circular gold-and-pink ear-like side discs, a segmented chrome-and-brass body, muscular but sleek mechanical arms, and a pink pig-snout emblem on the chest. Its face area is obscured by a rectangular censor blur. It reaches one articulated hand toward the viewer in an aggressive foreshortened pose. Around the Stand’s upper body, place 3 large stylized sound-effect glyphs reading "ゴゴゴ" in purple and black. On the far right, add a jagged speech or impact shape with 4 stacked lines of bold Japanese text reading "レヴァ", "レヴァ", "レヴァ", "レヴァ!!". Behind both figures, erupting pink-purple aura flames and floating rock fragments create intense supernatural energy. The lower figure is a short, squat, pig-bodied character standing wide-legged, with pink skin, small hoof-like feet, a yellow-green neckerchief, and a huge mushroom cap hat in red with white spots and a thick yellow underside rim; the torso area is obscured by a large rectangular censor blur. The pig points outward with one hand and holds a woven basket in the other hand containing 3 visible items: 1 blue heart-shaped object and 2 small round produce-like objects. Keep the composition theatrical and bizarre, combining grotesque humor, market-speculation parody, and high-impact manga poster aesthetics.

items.titleZh: A dynamic anime-style full-body illustration of a futuristic angelic android girl floating in outer space above Earth, shown in a dramatic diagonal action pose as if gliding or diving forward. She has short tousled {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair with soft layered bangs, a slim feminine build, and a partially obscured face turned to the right. Her body is a mix of human and machine: 2 visible metallic robotic arms and 2 visible robotic legs with articulated black joints and polished silver armor plating. She wears a white ceremonial dress uniform with a fitted bodice, puffed short sleeves, gold trim, a flared skirt, and delicate white lace underskirt details. The chest and both sleeves each feature a luminous blue gem emblem with ornate gold eye-like decoration, for a total of 3 blue jewel insignias. Add a high collar with small gold star accents and a silver waist belt. She has 2 large mechanical feathered wings extending upward and outward from her back, each wing made of layered white feather-like panels attached to metallic segmented frames. Her left arm reaches back with open mechanical fingers while her legs are bent in mid-flight, one knee raised and the other leg extended downward. The background is deep black space filled with fine stars, with the curved horizon of Earth occupying the lower left and bottom edge, glowing with a bright blue atmospheric rim and visible white cloud patterns over the planet surface. Use cinematic rim lighting, glossy reflections on metal parts, crisp clean anime linework, highly detailed fabric folds, elegant sci-fi fantasy design, and a sense of weightless motion.

The vehicle is a sleek white delta-wing orbiter with 2 vertical tail fins, 2 large rear engines, a pointed nose, dark cockpit windows, subtle panel lines, light weathering, and small black technical markings. The fuselage bears the text {argument name="ship name" default="STARSTREAK"}. A blazing reentry plasma sheath wraps around the nose, belly, wing edges, and upper rear body, forming a long turbulent orange-white fire trail that fills much of the upper background. The shuttle remains clearly visible inside the incandescent shock layer, with bright rim lighting and scorched warm reflections on the hull. Below, the curved Earth occupies the lower part of the frame with a thin blue atmospheric limb, cloud systems, ocean, and a visible spiral storm. Above is deep black-blue space with faint stars. items.title: Flaming Angel in Black Void
items.titleZh: A dramatic fantasy illustration of a single female angelic figure made entirely of fire, floating against a pure black background. The body is semi-transparent and sculpted from glowing orange, amber, and white-hot flame, with brighter highlights at the head, chest, knee, and pointed lower leg. She has 2 large feathered wings formed from flame trails, arcing upward behind her back, and long flowing hair that sweeps forward in a blazing halo around her head. Her pose is dynamic and balletic: torso arched, left arm extended outward, one leg bent, the other stretched downward into a tapering flame point, as if descending or diving through the air. The figure wears the suggestion of a short dress or skirt shape also formed from fire. Surround the body with turbulent smoke-like flame ribbons and motion streaks, especially trailing behind the wings and around the lower half, creating a sense of speed and supernatural energy. High contrast, luminous edges, ethereal anatomy, no ground, no props, no text, centered vertical composition, cinematic fantasy fire spirit aesthetic.

items.title: Romantic Cottage Window Garden Scene
items.titleZh: A dreamy romantic illustration of a young woman leaning out of an open cottage window, perfectly emphasizing the contrast between the sunny flower garden outside and the cozy room inside. She rests both elbows on the white-painted windowsill and cups her face in her hands, centered in the composition, with her face hidden by her pose and hair. She has very long wavy light brown hair with small white flowers tucked into it, and wears a soft vintage cream-beige floral dress with puffed sleeves and delicate lace trim. The window is a white wooden double casement window opened outward on both sides, framed by sheer lace curtains that billow gently inward and outward. The exterior wall is white painted brick or plaster, covered with climbing vines and many small white blossoms around the top and sides of the window. In the foreground outside, show a lush spring garden with an exact mix of 5 flower groups: pale pink tulips, cream-white tulips, small white daisies with yellow centers, soft lavender flower spikes, and layered pale pink garden roses or peonies, with a short white picket fence peeking up along the bottom edge. Through the window, clearly show the interior as a separate indoor space: a warm, softly lit shabby-chic room with muted beige tones, framed botanical prints on the wall, a wooden cabinet or shelf with vases and flowers, and a small delicate chandelier hanging in the background. Use gentle morning sunlight, soft shadows of vines across the wall and sill, airy pastel colors, highly detailed painterly anime-inspired realism, ethereal floral fantasy mood, serene and nostalgic atmosphere, vertical composition.

items.titleZh: A 360-degree equirectangular anime-style VR bedroom scene viewed from a first-person perspective on a bed, with a young adult woman leaning very close toward the viewer in the center of the frame. She has {argument name="hair color" default="medium brown"} hair in a smooth bob with side-swept bangs, small earrings, and wears a fitted {argument name="shirt color" default="slate blue"} button-up blouse with the top buttons open and matching dark blue pants. Her pose is intimate and immersive: kneeling and straddling over the viewer on a rumpled white bed, one arm extended forward toward the camera and the other bracing on the mattress, as if reaching out inside a VR experience. The room is a warm, softly lit modern bedroom with beige walls and recessed ceiling lights, a dark wooden door on the left, a TV on a low dresser, a second dresser with framed photos, a centered window with sheer white curtains and darker gray drapes, two bedside tables with glowing lamps, one tall potted plant near the window, and one dark wooden bookshelf on the right. items.title: Fashion Editorial with Cartoons
items.titleZh:
Full-body fashion editorial of a confident {argument name="subject" default="young woman"} sitting casually on a concrete ledge, relaxed pose with one leg slightly extended and arms resting naturally, direct gaze into the camera. She has long flowing hair moving gently in the wind, natural glowing skin, and subtle modern makeup. She is wearing a {argument name="jacket style" default="light blue oversized denim jacket"} layered over a clean white t-shirt, neutral-toned fitted shorts, bright colorful socks, and trendy sneakers.
Behind her, {argument name="characters" default="Tom and Jerry"} appear as playful cartoon characters integrated into the scene — slightly oversized, interacting with each other and the environment (Tom peeking from behind the ledge, Jerry standing on it or running playfully), positioned naturally in the background as if part of the world. Their style remains true to classic animation with bold outlines and expressive motion.
Beside her, a bold cartoon dragon illustration with thick outlines and vibrant neon blue, green, and yellow colors, playful yet powerful, subtly wrapping around the composition and interacting with the model’s pose.
Scene is set in a bright urban outdoor environment with a clear blue sky, strong natural sunlight, crisp shadows, and high contrast lighting. Add subtle wind motion in clothing and hair.
Mixed-media aesthetic blending high-end photorealism with graphic illustration elements — include hand-drawn doodles, arrows, motion lines, sparkles, and dynamic graphic overlays around the subject and characters.
Ultra-detailed, HDR, sharp focus, cinematic composition, fashion magazine quality, 8K resolution.
items.promptZh:
一位自信的{argument name="subject" default="young Woman"}的全身时尚社论，随意地坐在混凝土壁架上，摆出轻松的姿势，单腿稍微伸展，手臂自然休息，目光直视镜头。她有一头飘逸的长发，在风中轻轻飘动，皮肤自然光泽，妆容精致现代。她穿着一件{argument name="jacket style" default="light blue oversized denim Jack"}，内搭干净的白色 T 恤、中性色调合身短裤、色彩鲜艳的袜子和时尚运动鞋。
在她身后，{argument name="characters" default="Tom and Jerry"} 看起来像俏皮的卡通人物，融入了场景中 — 尺寸稍大，彼此之间以及环境互动（汤姆从壁架后面偷看，杰瑞站在上面或顽皮地奔跑），自然地位于背景中，仿佛是世界的一部分。他们的风格仍然忠于经典动画，具有大胆的轮廓和富有表现力的动作。
在她旁边，有一个大胆的卡通龙插图，具有粗大的轮廓和充满活力的霓虹蓝、绿色和黄色，俏皮而有力，巧妙地包裹着构图，并与模特的姿势互动。
场景设置在明亮的城市室外环境中，拥有清澈的蓝天、强烈的自然阳光、清晰的阴影和高对比度的灯光。在衣服和头发上添加微妙的风动。
混合媒体美学将高端写实主义与图形插图元素融为一体——包括手绘涂鸦、箭头、运动线、闪光以及围绕主题和角色的动态图形叠加。
超细致、HDR、锐焦、电影构图、时尚杂志品质、8K 分辨率。

She has long slightly messy dark hair with soft bangs, wearing a {argument name="clothing" default="black leather jacket"}. She turns her head toward the camera with a calm, slightly intense expression. The scene is lit with contrasting {argument name="lighting colors" default="red and blue neon lighting"} casting dramatic highlights on her face and hair. Background filled with soft bokeh from streetlights, cars, and neon signs, creating a {argument name="setting style" default="Tokyo cyberpunk vibe"}. movement sheet for a solo {argument name="subject" default="female rapper dancer"} doing dance moves    
Monochrome grayscale illustration, 3D-rendered character, clean instructional reference sheet, white background, comic-style cell grid layout, technical diagram aesthetic.    
[LAYOUT] 4×4 grid layout with a total of 16 panels. Each panel is separated by thin black border lines. Cells are numbered from 1 to 16, with consistent panel sizes.  
[CHARACTER]  image1 (the same two characters appear consistently in all panels)  
[PANEL STRUCTURE – per cell]  Top-left: bold number badge + English title text  Center: full-body character pose illustration  Bottom-left: English description text (3–4 lines)  Overlay: directional arrows indicating movement  
[ARROWS / MOTION INDICATORS] Curved arrows, straight arrows, and circular rotation indicators placed around the character to show motion flow and direction.  
[RENDERING STYLE] Highly detailed 3D sculpted style, soft studio lighting, subtle shadows, no color, grayscale shading, clean linework, game concept art quality.  
[NEGATIVE] No background scenery, no color tones, no additional characters, no complex background.

独奏舞蹈动作的动作表{argument name="subject" default="female rapper dancer"}

items.title: Back-to-Back Dark Bishounen Portrait
items.titleZh: A dramatic, painterly anime-style illustration of two androgynous young men standing back-to-back in a dark, romantic historical-fantasy composition. The left figure is taller and shown from mid-thigh up, with very long, messy black hair cascading over the shoulders and chest, a partially open white shirt, a fitted black vest, a brown leather belt, and an ornate black military-inspired coat draped over one shoulder with gold embroidery, gold buttons, a large gold epaulet, fur trim at the collar, and a round red-and-cream rosette detail near the shoulder. His pose is relaxed and theatrical, with one hand lifted into his hair and his head tipped slightly back. The right figure is slightly shorter, shown from the waist up and turned away in profile, with short tousled black hair, a white high-collared shirt, a black vest, dark gloves, and crossed arms, giving a cool, reserved presence. Both characters have pale skin and a moody bishounen aesthetic. The background features a huge glowing red sun or moon centered behind them, with a textured gold-leaf and black grunge backdrop, deep crimson drapery or haze near the lower left, scattered glowing red petals or embers drifting through the air, and red flowering branches on the right side. Use rich crimson, black, antique gold, and ivory tones, cinematic rim lighting, layered textures, intricate costume rendering, elegant brushwork, and an emotional, nostalgic, high-detail finish.
items.promptZh: 一幅戏剧性的、绘画式的动漫风格插图，描绘了两个雌雄同体的年轻人背靠背站立在黑暗、浪漫的历史奇幻作品中。左边的人物身材更高，从大腿中部开始，长而凌乱的黑发披散在肩膀和胸部，半敞开的白衬衫，合身的黑色背心，棕色皮带，一件华丽的黑色军装风外套披在肩上，上面有金色刺绣，金色纽扣，金色大肩章，领子有毛皮装饰，肩膀附近有圆形的红色和奶油色玫瑰花饰细节。他的姿势轻松而戏剧化，一只手伸进头发里，头稍微向后倾斜。右图身材稍矮，腰部以上侧转侧脸，黑色凌乱短发，白色高领衬衫，黑色背心，深色手套，双臂交叉，冷峻内敛。两个角色都有苍白的皮肤和喜怒无常的美少年审美。背景以巨大的发光红色太阳或月亮为中心，在它们身后，有纹理的金叶和黑色垃圾背景，左下角附近有深红色的窗帘或薄雾，散落的发光红色花瓣或余烬在空中飘荡，右侧是红色的开花树枝。使用浓郁的深红色、黑色、古金色和象牙色色调、电影般的边缘照明、分层纹理、复杂的服装渲染、优雅的笔触以及情感、怀旧、高细节的完成效果。

items.title: Dual-Themed Anime Boys in Crystal Boxes
items.titleZh: A highly detailed fantasy anime illustration of two young men reclining inside separate transparent crystal-like display boxes suspended side by side in a dark, theatrical space, split into contrasting themes. The left box has a warm olive-green and gold palette and contains a calm, elegant young man with short light blond hair, pale skin, a black dress shirt, a loosened gold striped tie, cream trousers, and black shoes, lying in a relaxed pose while holding a small flower near his face. Around him are exactly 10 visible decorative elements: 1 brown paper bag filled with leafy green plants, 1 metal mug, 1 lemon, 1 small zebra figurine, 1 open book, 1 sunflower, trailing green vines, many floating soap bubbles, etched white floral drawings on the glass, and greenery covering the floor of the box. The right box has a dramatic crimson red and black palette and contains a mischievous, confident young man with tousled medium brown hair, pale skin, a black outfit with red accents and layered accessories, lounging with one knee raised while biting or holding a red rose. Around him are exactly 10 visible decorative elements: 1 bone-like white skeletal ornament, 1 faceted red gemstone, 1 faceted pale gemstone, 1 hanging card or tag on a chain, 1 red book, 1 wrapped piece of meat or food on a tray, 1 small lion figurine, 1 red snack bag, claw-like scratch marks beneath the box, and sparkling red crystal shards. The background is split vertically into a starry cosmic seam between the two boxes, with draped curtains, strings of triangular bunting, faint paw-print motifs on the red side, and exactly 4 balloons total: 2 on the left in white and olive green, 2 on the right in red and black. Make the composition ornate, glossy, and cinematic, with dramatic reflections on the glass, rich highlights, floating particles, luxurious textures, intricate props, and a nostalgic storybook mood. Render in polished modern anime key art style, ultra-detailed, elegant, dreamlike, and emotionally evocative.

items.titleZh: A moody dark fantasy anime illustration of a wounded young man with {argument name="hair color" default="ash blond"} short tousled hair, sitting slumped on the floor against a cracked white plaster wall. His face is mostly turned away and partially obscured in shadow, giving him a mysterious, exhausted presence. He wears a loose black kimono robe hanging open at the chest, exposing a lean muscular torso, with a deep red sash at the waist. A long strand of dark crimson prayer beads hangs around his neck, with more beads tangled in one hand and spilled across the floor. Beside him rests an ornate black ceremonial staff with circular rings and a spear-like finial, leaning diagonally against his shoulder. The wall behind him is streaked with dramatic dark red blood smears and drips near the upper right, suggesting a recent battle. On the floor in the foreground are scattered prayer beads, broken metallic ornaments, several paper talismans or ofuda slips with black calligraphy, and a single red flower. Warm late-afternoon light cuts across the scene from the left, creating strong highlights and deep shadows over the robe folds, hand, chest, and wall texture. Painterly brushwork, highly detailed fabric and skin rendering, melancholic atmosphere, elegant gothic composition, vertical portrait framing, cinematic anime key visual style.

The character has {argument name="hair color" default="deep crimson red"} hair, long and layered with loose messy strands, plus one very long thick braid draped over the front of the body and decorated with turquoise beads and tassels. They wear a dark metallic half-mask covering the lower face, multiple ear piercings with red and silver ornaments, and a confident, dangerous expression. One hand rests behind the neck holding a katana across the shoulders; the sword has a black hilt with red accents and a reflective blade. The background is a decorative Japanese-inspired painting with a large glowing red-orange sun disk behind the head, red plum blossoms, smoky cloud-like swirls, parchment-textured beige and charcoal tones, and scattered gold leaf splashes. items.title: Minimalist Literary Cover for The Vegetarian
items.titleZh: A minimalist literary book cover for {argument name="book title" default="素食者"}, designed in an elegant East Asian art-book style with muted dark forest green and warm off-white as the only main colors. The composition is vertical and highly refined, with a split layout: the left two-thirds are textured off-white paper, while the right third is a deep green field divided by a rough organic torn-paper edge running vertically from top to bottom. On the lower center-right, place a grayscale side-profile portrait of an East Asian woman facing right, her head slightly tilted upward, eyes closed or nearly closed, with black hair tied in a low bun. Her figure should feel quiet, fragile, and contemplative. The upper part of her head is visually replaced by a torn white paper shape that merges into the page, creating a surreal collage effect. From inside the opening around her head and neck, thin wild plant stems with tiny leaves and buds grow upward diagonally, as if vegetation is emerging from her body. Add subtle paper grain, print texture, and soft tonal fading for a poetic, fine-press look. Set the main Chinese title vertically in very large dark green serif-style characters on the far left: {argument name="title text" default="素食者"}. Near the upper middle-left, add vertically arranged author and translator credits in Chinese, small and elegant: "[韩] 韩江 著" and "胡椒筒｜译". In the upper right on the dark green area, add small Korean and English text in a delicate serif font: {argument name="korean title" default="채식주의자"}, "The Vegetarian", and {argument name="author name" default="Han Kang"}. On the mid-to-lower right, add a short vertical Chinese quote in small type: {argument name="quote" default="我的身体里 有一片荒芜的森林 它枯萎了 我不想吃的东西"}. At the bottom right, place the publisher and year in small Chinese text: "四川文艺出版社" and "2022". Include one small solid dark green dot on the left side below the title as a graphic accent. The overall mood is restrained, melancholic, intelligent, and literary, like an award-winning modern novel cover.

The composition is divided by large flowing curtain-like abstract shapes that create dramatic negative space and diagonal wedges of light. On the right side, show an elderly butler-like man seen from behind, standing upright in a formal black tailcoat or tuxedo jacket, white shirt cuffs visible, hands clasped behind his back, facing a tall softly glowing window with sheer curtains. His posture is reserved, dignified, and solitary. On the lower portion, within a triangular beam of light, place a dim still life on a table: exactly 3 objects, a wine glass, a teapot, and a plate, all partially obscured in shadow. The image should feel like an award-winning contemporary literary fiction cover: quiet, melancholic, restrained, cinematic, with paper grain texture, soft vignette, subtle painterly shading, and highly intentional asymmetrical layout. Keep the typography integrated into the design, with generous negative space and no bright colors.

items.title: Dark Creative Overload at Night
items.titleZh: A moody cinematic digital illustration of a tired young creator sitting alone at a cluttered desk in a dark room at night, seen in three-quarter side view, leaning forward with one elbow on the desk and one hand covering part of the face in an exhausted, overwhelmed pose. The face is intentionally obscured in shadow. The person wears dark casual clothes and a lanyard badge, suggesting a student, designer, or medical worker. The room feels realistic and slightly messy, with a desk lamp, papers, sketchbooks, mugs, stationery, and stacked books. On the left wall, include 2 illuminated X-ray films and a round wall clock, plus shelves and pinned notes in deep shadow. In front of the person is a glowing widescreen monitor showing an AI image generation or creative editing interface with a city-at-sunset artwork in the main preview and a row of thumbnail variations beneath it, modern dark UI, one purple action button. The monitor is the main light source, casting warm orange and cool blue highlights across the desk. Around the monitor and pouring out into the air, depict a vast surreal explosion of imagination and digital creativity: a swirling galaxy-like vortex with stars, nebula colors, spark particles, light trails, and cosmic dust in purple, blue, pink, and gold. Embed many floating dreamlike elements inside the swirl: a fantasy castle on a floating island with a tree, planets and moons, an astronaut, a film clapperboard, a video camera, musical notes, glowing silhouettes of people, a futuristic city skyline, a hot-air balloon, a car, birds, jellyfish-like luminous creatures, and multiple cats, including 1 giant sleeping orange tabby cat in the upper right and 1 cat in a space helmet near the lower right. The magical imagery should feel like thoughts escaping from the computer, beautiful but slightly dark and overwhelming, as if creativity, obsession, and emotional intensity are filling the room. Include a skeletal anatomy hand model standing beside the monitor on the right side of the desk, reinforcing an art-studio or study setting. Use dramatic low-key lighting, high contrast, intricate detail, volumetric glow, cinematic depth, and a balance of realism and fantastical surrealism. The overall mood is melancholic, imaginative, and darkly inspiring, visualizing the feeling of being consumed by ideas generated through {argument name="creative tool" default="AI image generation"}.

items.title: Anime Key Visual Composition
items.titleZh:
Create a TV anime key visual using the attached characters.
4:5 size.
Faithfully reproduce the character's hairstyles and the logo.

1. A woman with an ogre mask (legendary blacksmith) in the background with a mysterious large close-up of her face.
2. A man with a troubled expression holding the sword from the 7th image (slightly smaller as a sub-character).
3. A girl in green clothes holding the plushie from the 6th image, looking up at the sky with a startled face from a front position (protagonist).
4. A woman in a kimono looking on from a distance with a worried expression (supporting character).
5. A girl with a ponytail also looking on with a worried expression (supporting character).

Use the logo effectively.

items.title: Anime Summer Soda Ad Poster
items.titleZh: A bright, high-energy anime-style summer advertisement poster for a sparkling soft drink, set at the seaside under a vivid cobalt-blue sky with towering white cumulus clouds and a blazing sun near the top center creating lens flare and radiant beams. Feature exactly 3 Japanese high school girls in matching summer sailor uniforms: short-sleeved white blouses with navy ribbon bows and dark navy pleated skirts. All three have dark, windblown shoulder-length to long hair and youthful, lively poses. In the left foreground, show one girl from a dramatic low angle thrusting a large plastic soda bottle toward the viewer so it dominates the composition; her hand and the bottle are oversized by perspective. In the middle, show a second girl seated low near the water, one knee raised, drinking from a smaller bottle. On the right, show a third girl standing in profile or three-quarter view, also sipping from a bottle while her hair and skirt stream in the sea breeze. Make the ocean water intensely turquoise and sunlit, with energetic splashes framing the bottom left and bottom right edges, scattered droplets and sparkling highlights across the scene. Add a few small white seabirds in the distant sky. The overall mood is refreshing, nostalgic, youthful, and cinematic, like a premium Japanese beverage commercial key visual. The bottle label should be clean and minimalist white with modern sans-serif typography reading {argument name="brand name" default="ASCII SPARK"}, with smaller flavor text {argument name="flavor text" default="Yuzu White Peach Soda"} and a subtle 500 mL marking. Place the brand logo in the upper left in thin uppercase letters, and add a handwritten-style Japanese tagline in white at the lower left reading {argument name="tagline text" default="夏がくれる、はじけるひととき。"}. Use crisp cel-shaded anime rendering mixed with painterly light effects, ultra-detailed water droplets on the bottle, condensation, transparent plastic, glittering carbonation bubbles, and dramatic foreshortening.

items.title: Xinjiang Road Trip Scrapbook Spread
items.titleZh: A warm, handcrafted travel scrapbook spread photographed from directly above on a wooden tabletop, showing an open two-page journal with thick deckled paper edges and layered fabric tabs peeking out from the sides. The style is a realistic mixed-media travel diary with watercolor map art, handwritten Chinese titles, taped instant photos, doodles, and soft natural light. On the upper left page, write the date "2024.09.20." in small handwriting and a large black brush-style Chinese title reading {argument name="title text" default="新疆公路旅行手帐"}. Arrange 5 Polaroid-style instant photos across the spread, each slightly tilted and attached with beige or patterned washi tape: 1 photo at upper left showing two travelers by a blue alpine lake labeled "天山天池"; 1 tall photo near upper center-left showing three people on a green grassland labeled "那拉提草原"; 1 photo at lower left showing a couple by a deep blue lake labeled "赛里木湖"; 1 photo at upper center-right showing two travelers on a long empty road under a bright blue sky labeled "沙漠公路"; 1 photo at lower center showing two figures standing on dunes at sunset labeled "日落沙丘". Add small handwritten bilingual place annotations near the left-page photos: "天山天池 (Tianshan Tianchi)", "赛拉木草原 (Sayram Lake)", "沙漠公路 (Desert Highway)", and "日落沙丘 (Sunset Dunes)" in a casual notebook style. On the right page, paint a loose watercolor map of Xinjiang in beige, pale green, and blue, with a bold winding blue road route crossing the region and exactly 10 red location pins placed along the route. Include map doodles: a small mountain icon cluster near the top, a river and several blue lakes, a tiny compass in the upper right, 2 camel drawings, 2 yurt drawings, and thin gray roads branching around the main blue route. Along the bottom of the right page, place 3 more taped Polaroid photos: 1 at lower left showing people in colorful ethnic clothing labeled "大巴扎"; 1 at lower middle showing hands holding grilled meat skewers labeled "烤肉串"; 1 at lower right showing a couple inside a yurt labeled "蒙古包自拍". Scatter small hand-drawn doodles throughout both pages, including a sun, a tiny car, 2 horse drawings, 4 fish icons, a crescent moon, several stars, small arrows, flames near the food photo and along the lower map area, and tiny decorative swirls. Keep all text in Chinese where shown, with a lively hand-journal aesthetic, realistic paper texture, slight shadows under every photo, and an overall cozy memory-book feeling of a Xinjiang road trip.

items.title: Empowerment Sports Campaign Poster
items.titleZh: Create a high-end global sportswear campaign poster on a clean light gray studio background with a full-body female athlete crouching in the foreground, photographed in a fashion-advertising style. She is a young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} shoulder-length slightly tousled hair, wearing a fitted white short-sleeve athletic t-shirt with a small black puma logo on the chest, black leggings, a light gray sweatshirt tied around her waist, and gray running shoes with subtle white branding. Her pose is low and powerful, one knee raised, one hand resting on the lifted knee and the other hanging loosely, facing camera with confident energy. Behind and around her, fill most of the composition with oversized black hand-painted brush lettering in an expressive activist style. The text must read exactly: "WE ARE THE VOICE OF" above, then the huge central word "STRENGTH," then beneath it "UNITY," and "AND CHANGE." Add a bold handwritten hashtag "#OWNYOURPOWER" near the middle-right. In the lower-right corner place the black Puma leaping cat logo above the wordmark "PUMA" and the tagline "FOREVER. FASTER." At the very bottom add 3 small footer text blocks: left "PUMA.COM", center "FOREVER. FASTER. TOGETHER. A GLOBAL MOVEMENT FOR EQUALITY, EMPOWERMENT AND CHANGE.", right "JOIN THE MOVEMENT. #OWNYOURPOWER". Composition should feel like a contemporary empowerment campaign, blending sports fashion editorial photography with protest-style brush typography, minimal palette of white, black, and gray, crisp studio lighting, premium ad layout, vertical poster format.

items.title: Cyberpunk Fashion Campaign Poster
items.titleZh:
Ultra-realistic luxury fashion campaign poster featuring a young male model with textured wavy hair, sharp jawline, and minimal beard, wearing slim futuristic visor glasses. He stands in a composed yet powerful pose, slightly turned, eyes locked with the camera.

Outfit: oversized matte-finish charcoal techwear trench coat with layered panels, magnetic closures, and subtle reflective piping. Inner layer includes a high-neck tactical knit and structured cargo trousers, creating a futuristic urban silhouette.

Branding elements: subtle co-branded identity of {argument name="brands" default="Acronym × Adidas Originals"} placed minimally on coat sleeve and top corner of composition. Add small futuristic patches, barcodes, and geometric tech symbols for a clean cyber aesthetic.

Composition: medium shot, slightly low angle for dominance, coat flowing and occupying most of the frame with strong structure and depth. Model positioned slightly off-center.

Background: dark gradient concrete wall with neon cyan and white holographic-style typography behind the subject, slightly defocused for depth.

Lighting: cinematic high-contrast lighting with cool cyan and teal tones, combined with a sharp white rim light outlining the coat edges. Subtle reflections enhance the fabric’s technical texture. HDR, ultra-sharp focus, premium editorial finish.

Typography layout:
• Top right: co-branded logos
• Left vertical block: technical product specs text
• Right side: minimal tagline “{argument name="tagline" default="Engineered for the unseen"}”
• Bottom: “{argument name="label" default="Urban Tech Capsule"}” label

Style: futuristic streetwear campaign, cyberpunk editorial, ultra-detailed, 8k resolution, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, clean yet bold composition, modern UI-inspired overlays
items.promptZh:
超现实的奢华时尚活动海报，年轻男模特留着有纹理的波浪发、锐利的下巴轮廓和极少的胡须，戴着纤薄的未来派遮阳眼镜。他以一种冷静而有力的姿势站立，微微转动身体，眼睛紧盯着镜头。

服装：超大哑光木炭科技风风衣，配有分层镶片、磁扣和精致的反光滚边。内层包括高领战术针织衫和结构工装裤，营造出未来派的都市轮廓。

品牌元素：{argument name="brands" default="Acronym × Adidas Originals"} 微妙的联合品牌标识最少地放置在外套袖子和构图的顶角上。添加未来派的小补丁、条形码和几何科技符号，打造干净的网络美感。

构图：中景，略低的角度形成主导，外套流动并占据画面的大部分，结构和深度很强。模型位置稍微偏离中心。

背景：深色渐变混凝土墙，主体后面带有霓虹青色和白色全息式字体，稍微散焦深度。

灯光：电影般的高对比度灯光，带有冷青色和青色色调，与勾勒出外套边缘的锐利白色边缘光相结合。微妙的反射增强了面料的技术质感。 HDR、超清晰对焦、优质编辑效果。

版式布局：
• 右上：联名徽标
• 左侧垂直块：技术产品规格文本
• 右侧：最小标语“{argument name="tagline" default="Engineered for the unseen"}”
• 底部：“{argument name="label" default="Urban Tech Capsule"}”标签

风格：未来街头服饰运动、赛博朋克社论、超详细、8k 分辨率、浅景深、柔和的胶片颗粒、干净而大胆的构图、现代 UI 风格的叠加层

items.title: Moonlit Yuri Wedding Poster
items.titleZh: A romantic fantasy wedding illustration of two women standing arm in arm in a moonlit palace balcony at night, highly detailed anime style with luminous painterly rendering, elegant and dreamy. The taller woman on the left has {argument name="left character hair color" default="light brown"} shoulder-length softly layered hair and wears a regal ivory-white tailored wedding suit with gold embroidery, a high-collared ruffled shirt, cream vest, cravat, chain accessories, and a long ceremonial coat whose inner lining is deep violet with floral patterns; a purple flower corsage is pinned to her chest. The woman on the right has {argument name="right character hair color" default="black"} long wavy hair and wears an ornate bridal gown in ivory with gold lace embroidery, sheer lace sleeves, a fitted bodice, a very long translucent veil, and rich crimson inner panels and accents peeking from the skirt; she wears red gemstone jewelry and floral hair ornaments in white and red. She holds a large bouquet of red, burgundy, and white flowers with greenery and trailing red ribbons while gently linking arms with her partner. Set them before gothic arched windows, hanging crystal ornaments, glowing lanterns, purple flowers, a distant city skyline, a star-filled sky, and a bright full moon. Add decorative vertical Japanese title text integrated into the composition: on the left, {argument name="left title text" default="紫苑の護り"} with smaller vertical ruby text beside it; on the right, {argument name="right title text" default="紅雪の献心"} with smaller vertical ruby text beside it. Include crescent moon and snowflake-like decorative motifs framing the titles. Use a tall poster composition, full-body view, luxurious fabrics, sparkling highlights, soft bokeh, and an overall palette of ivory, gold, violet, crimson, and midnight blue.

items.title: Romantic Yuri Wedding Chapel Portrait
items.titleZh: A luminous, ultra-detailed anime-style wedding portrait of two brides in a romantic white chapel filled with soft ivory light, sheer curtains, carved arches, pale floral arrangements, and sparkling bokeh. The composition is vertical and elegant, showing the pair from about thigh-up to full dress detail, standing close together in an intimate yuri moment. The taller bride on the left has {argument name="hair color" default="warm chestnut brown"} long wavy hair cascading over her shoulders and back, wearing a refined white bridal pantsuit with a fitted tailcoat, gold buttons, a cream vest, a silk cravat, subtle floral embroidery along the coat tails, and a white rose boutonniere with pale blue accents. She is visibly emotional, gently wiping tears with a handkerchief, her other hand resting near her chest, giving the feeling of being moved by the ceremony. The shorter bride on the right has {argument name="second bride hair color" default="long black hair"}, very long and glossy, and wears an ornate off-shoulder wedding gown in white with icy blue undertones, translucent lace sleeves, intricate beadwork, floral embroidery, layered ruffles, and a long veil decorated with tiny flowers and crystal-like details. A silver floral hair ornament with dangling pieces decorates the side of her head. She looks up at her partner tenderly while holding a cascading bouquet of white roses, blue flowers, and trailing greenery. Emphasize the contrast between the tailored princely suit and the delicate fairy-tale gown, with luxurious fabric textures, lace transparency, fine embroidery, soft glowing highlights, drifting sparkles, and a dreamy, emotional atmosphere. Make the scene feel like {argument name="relationship theme" default="an original yuri wedding between an older office lady-style bride and a younger nurse-style bride"}, painted in polished, high-end romantic illustration style, ethereal, graceful, and heartfelt.
items.promptZh: 一幅明亮、超详细的动漫风格婚礼肖像，描绘了两位新娘在浪漫的白色教堂中的情景，教堂里充满了柔和的象牙色灯光、透明的窗帘、雕刻的拱门、苍白的插花和闪闪发光的散景。构图垂直而优雅，展示了两人从大腿到整个裙子的细节，在亲密的尤里时刻紧密地站在一起。左边身材较高的新娘，一头{argument name="hair color" default="warmchestnut Brown"}长卷发披散在肩部和背部，身穿精致的白色新娘长裤套装，搭配合身燕尾服、金色纽扣、奶油色背心、丝绸领结，衣尾饰有精致的花卉刺绣，胸花上饰有淡蓝色点缀的白玫瑰胸花。她表情明显激动，用手帕轻轻擦拭眼泪，另一只手放在胸前，给人一种被仪式感动的感觉。右边的矮个子新娘有{argument name="第二位新娘发色" default="长黑发"}，非常长且有光泽，穿着华丽的露肩婚纱，白色带有冰蓝色底色，半透明蕾丝袖，复杂的珠饰，花卉刺绣，分层荷叶边，长头纱装饰着小花和水晶般的细节。她头部的一侧装饰着银色的花朵发饰，上面有悬垂的碎片。她温柔地抬头看着她的伴侣，手里拿着一束白玫瑰、蓝色的花朵和绿色的植物。强调剪裁精良的王子套装与精致童话礼服的对比，奢华的面料质感、透明的蕾丝、精致的刺绣、柔和的光泽亮点、飘逸的火花，营造出梦幻、感性的氛围。使场景感觉像{argument name="relationship theme" default="一场年长办公室女士风格新娘和年轻护士风格新娘之间的原创百合婚礼"}，采用精致、高端浪漫的插画风格绘制，空灵、优雅、真挚。

items.titleZh: A richly detailed anime-style illustration of a late-night Call of Cthulhu tabletop RPG session in a dim antique study lit by warm oil lamps and candles. Three young women sit around a wooden table crowded with game materials. On the left, a girl in a military-style cap and camouflage jacket with long dark braided hair writes notes on a character sheet with a pen, looking stressed and slightly overwhelmed. In the center, a girl with very long pale lavender hair in twin buns and flowing lengths wears an elegant dark green dress with gold trim and white lace cuffs, smiling mischievously while holding up a large hardcover book titled "Talk of Cthulhu" with a dramatic occult monster cover; above her is handwritten Japanese text reading "これで全員 一時的狂気ね" with a small heart. On the right, an orange-haired girl in a white lab coat with a stethoscope and ID badge reads a paper nervously, with handwritten Japanese text above her that says "SAN値が ピンチ！" with energetic accent lines. The tabletop is packed with exactly 10 polyhedral dice scattered across the center, assorted papers, 3 visible character sheets or note pages, 4 large map sheets, 2 mugs with dark emblems, 1 glass of iced cola, 1 plate of cookies, 1 bag of potato chips labeled in Japanese, 1 small standing sign reading "発狂中", 1 black ink bottle, 1 white feather quill, 2 closed occult hardcovers stacked at the lower right, and 1 large open illustrated monster book on the right. The room behind them has tall bookshelves full of old books, framed occult artwork including a tentacled creature image, a large aged wall map with pinned markings and strings, candles, wood furniture, and a moody Victorian occult-library atmosphere. Composition is a wide cinematic group shot from slightly above table height, highly rendered, warm brown and amber lighting, intricate textures, expressive anime faces and hair, playful horror-comedy tone, premium light novel or visual novel key art quality.

Make the photos feel like authentic couple memories shot on a phone: close mirror selfie together, dark blurry selfie, indoor peace-sign selfie, night street selfie, motion-blur closeup, outdoor daytime shot under a tree, indoor shoulder-leaning shot, another blurry affectionate shot, seated restaurant shot with glasses on the table, warm night bokeh shot, rooftop or balcony mirror selfie with city lights, nighttime urban walking shot, cozy leaning-together shot, shoulder-around pose, close side-by-side portrait, and another intimate close crop. Mix indoor home scenes, nighttime city scenes, one daytime outdoor scene, and one restaurant setting. Use imperfect framing, slight blur, flash, grain, and spontaneous candid composition so it feels like a real person's saved couple photo dump, not a polished campaign.

He has short {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair with a slightly textured top, visible ears, and light stubble beard along the jaw and chin. items.title: Open Manga Spread of Skirt Battle
items.titleZh: A photorealistic overhead view of an open Japanese manga magazine held in two human hands at the lower left and lower right corners, shown as a dramatic two-page black-and-white comic spread on slightly warm paper with visible page curvature, center gutter distortion, ink texture, screentone shading, and dense speed lines. The magazine fills almost the entire frame on a neutral tabletop. The spread depicts a fictional over-the-top battle sports manga about {argument name="sport name" default="スカートバウト"}, with exaggerated action, intense expressions, and absurdly serious tournament storytelling. In the center across both pages, show 2 main full-body schoolgirl fighters in a chaotic combat scene: on the left page center a long-haired teenage girl in a dark school blazer, ribbon tie, pleated skirt, and loafers spins powerfully with both arms raised overhead, her hair and skirt flaring in a circular arc; on the right page center a second teenage girl in a sailor-style school uniform is upside down in a handstand-like impact pose, one leg thrust high into the air, skirt exploding outward with violent motion lines, as if she has been thrown or is counterattacking. Make the composition packed with explosive radial lines, debris-like ink flecks, dramatic foreshortening, and giant bold Japanese sound-effect typography crossing the gutter. The spread should read like a mainstream shonen battle manga but focused on skirts and rotational motion rather than weapons. Include exactly 8 side panels around the central action: 4 stacked along the far left page and 4 along the far right page. On the left side, panel 1 shows a girl standing under a waterfall in ascetic training, panel 2 shows inverted handstand practice in shallow water, panel 3 shows intense physical training on the ground, panel 4 shows 2 girls in a close emotional conversation. On the right side, panel 1 shows a composed rival girl in portrait close-up, panel 2 shows a roaring audience in stadium stands, panel 3 shows a small comedic rules diagram explaining the sport with 2 simplified girls and a skirt icon, panel 4 shows a shocked face close-up reaction. Render all text as authentic Japanese manga lettering and captions, including vertical title calligraphy, side narration boxes, crowd chants, rule panel labels, and large impact kanji; use the visible phrases as inspiration but do not prioritize perfect legibility. Add one oversized vertical title on the left page reading {argument name="attack name left" default="白鳥の湖"} and one huge central impact phrase on the right page reading {argument name="attack name right" default="倒立回転逆襲"}. Preserve the feeling of a fake magazine feature or serialized manga chapter discovered in print, with believable halftone dots, slightly worn page edges, high contrast black ink, and a humorous yet sincerely epic tone.

On the left side, panel 1 shows a girl standing under a waterfall in ascetic training, panel 2 shows inverted handstand practice in shallow water, panel 3 shows intense physical training on the ground, panel 4 shows 2 girls in a close emotional conversation. items.title: Concept to Form Design Process
items.titleZh:
Subject: [e.g., {argument name="subject" default="Tennis Serve"}] 
Please present the transformation process of this theme from concept to form, as well as the completed design as the final result, in an A4 vertical visual image. Two-part structure (top and bottom). 
The top section is a five-step visualization flowchart of the essence of the theme: Source of Inspiration → Trajectory & Energy → Abstracted Lines & Structure → Three-dimensional Form → Final Design. Build it according to this flow. Fine sketches, line drawings, design blueprints, small arrows, short English labels, and a layout with elegant negative space. 
The title is "MOTION TO FORM." 
The bottom image displays the final 'hero visual' image formed from the process above. The category is not fixed; the AI chooses the most suitable design object based on the theme. It can be any form, such as a product, object, furniture, accessory, packaging, vessel, lamp, gadget, accessory, artwork, etc. 
Generate a fictional brand name, slogan, and short copy to create creative content suitable for advertising or design release visual effects. 
The overall presentation has a high level of completion, merging concept boards, brand advertisements, and design development materials. A sense of beauty composed of minimalism, poetry, intelligence, and negative space. The color palette is based on neutral tones, paired with 1-2 accent colors derived from the theme. 
Accurately depict material feel, light, shadow, structural beauty, and texture representation. High resolution, commercial-grade visual quality.

Create a full-body fashion-style photo of a young woman standing slightly right of center in a wide, confident stance, legs apart, arms relaxed at her sides, facing forward. Her face is intentionally blurred for anonymity. She has long straight split-dyed hair, one half {argument name="hair color" default="pastel pink"} and the other half {argument name="second hair color" default="pastel blue"}, falling past her chest. She wears a white oversized T-shirt with the black chest print {argument name="shirt text" default="OKIHIRO AI Creative"}, a light pink pleated mini skirt, and chunky white sneakers. Use clean studio lighting with soft shadows under her feet. Fill the left half of the poster with huge distressed black Japanese typography in an energetic diagonal layout reading {argument name="main headline" default="センスない奴は画像とテキストを極めろ"}, with oversized characters stacked and overlapping for maximum impact. Add 2 broad paint-brush swashes behind the lower headline area: 1 pink brush stroke sweeping from the lower left toward center and 1 blue brush stroke sweeping from center-right toward the far right. In the upper right, place a compact vertical block of small black Japanese copy in 4 lines reading: 「AI動画の自動化に 溺れるな。 静止した一枚と、 研ぎ澄まされた言葉が、 最も強い武器になる。」 arranged like a manifesto note. In the lower right, add a small angled English text block in uppercase reading {argument name="tagline text" default="MASTER TEXT & IMAGE. SHAPE PERCEPTION. CONTROL THE OUTCOME."}. In the lower left corner, add a small brand signature reading "OKIHIRO AI CREATIVE MANIFESTO". The overall composition should feel like a modern creative manifesto poster, mixing fashion editorial photography, Japanese street advertising, bold typography, and minimalist graphic design.

items.title: Three Android Idol Girls on Concert Stage
items.titleZh: A full-body anime illustration of 3 humanoid AI assistant idol girls standing side by side on a glossy futuristic concert stage, shown in a straight-on front view with their full figures visible from head to shoes. They are designed as the same base android model with subtle personality differences expressed mainly through costume design, pose, and color balance rather than body type. All 3 have short silver-gray bob hair with soft waves, large over-ear mechanical headphones, pale skin, youthful idol styling, and sleek visible robotic limbs with glossy red-and-black plating and heart-shaped accent motifs. The setting is a large indoor live venue with steel truss rigging overhead, bright white and pink-purple stage spotlights, giant LED screens in the background, and reflective black stage flooring with glowing grid lines and mirror-like reflections. The overall mood is polished, cute, futuristic, and high-end, with dramatic concert lighting and crisp detailed rendering. The left girl wears a mostly black idol outfit with red accents: a cropped translucent black jacket over a short black dress or romper with a flared skirt, black armored thigh-high mechanical legs, chunky black platform boots, red gloves, and small heart details throughout; she stands with knees slightly inward and both hands pressed to her cheeks in a shy, affectionate pose, with a sweet blushing expression. The center girl wears a balanced red-and-white idol outfit: a white sleeveless top with red heart accents, a layered burgundy-red frilled mini skirt, fully exposed red-and-black robotic arms and legs, and red platform shoes; she stands in a neutral straight upright pose with one hand raised lightly near her face, presenting the clearest full-body view of the android construction. The right girl wears a mostly red idol dress with black lace-like detailing, a black waist belt, a flared skirt with white frilled underskirt, red-and-black knee armor, and red platform shoes; she stands elegantly with one arm bent near her chest and the other arm extended outward, as if introducing the audience. Keep the trio evenly spaced across the frame. items.title: Photorealistic beauty campaign portrait prompt
items.titleZh:
Photorealistic close-up beauty campaign portrait of a stunning young Western woman with long, voluminous curly dark hair, defined cheekbones, thick expressive eyebrows, and flawless luminous skin. Her features are sharp yet feminine, with a confident, slightly rebellious expression.

She wears a premium black and {argument name="color scheme" default="hot-pink"} baseball cap featuring bold, glowing {argument name="accent color" default="hot-pink"} 3D lettering “{argument name="name" default="SHARON"}” on the front, designed like a high-end streetwear brand logo. Trendy translucent pink-tinted round glasses sit perfectly on her face. A beige band-aid is placed on the bridge of her nose and another on her left cheek, adding a stylized edgy aesthetic. A lit cigarette rests between her slightly parted lips, revealing perfect white teeth.

Highly detailed miniature anime-style figurines (cute detective-inspired girl character: short brown bob haircut, oversized sparkling blue eyes, round glasses, bright red overalls, white shirt, yellow gloves) interact playfully across the composition: one sitting on the brim of the cap, one climbing her ear, one pulling her lower lip, one tucked inside her shirt collar, and one posed on her shoulder. A bold, oversized cyan pencil is tucked under the cap strap, acting as a striking graphic element.

Wardrobe styling: luxury streetwear aesthetic — black structured jacket layered over a crisp white-and-pink striped collared shirt, finished with a neatly tied pink scarf.

Color palette: deep blacks, vibrant hot-pink highlights, electric cyan accents, and warm yellow pops for contrast.

Lighting: high-end studio lighting with soft frontal illumination and dramatic rim lighting for depth and separation. Clean white seamless background.

Composition: ultra-sharp focus, editorial framing, luxury fashion advertisement style, cinematic depth, hyper-realistic textures (visible skin pores, detailed fabric weave, individual hair strands), 8K resolution, extremely intricate detailing.

Mood: bold, playful, high-fashion, Gen-Z luxury streetwear campaign, blending realism with surreal miniature storytelling.
items.promptZh:
逼真的美容广告特写肖像，描绘了一位令人惊叹的年轻西方女性，她有着长而浓密的深色卷发、轮廓分明的颧骨、浓密而富有表现力的眉毛和完美无瑕的发光皮肤。她的五官棱角分明，又不失女人味，表情自信，略带叛逆。

她戴着一顶高级黑色的{argument name="color scheme" default="hot-pink"}棒球帽，正面饰有大胆发光的{argument name="accent color" default="hot-pink"} 3D 字样“{argument name="name" default="SHARON"}”，设计得像高端街头服饰品牌徽标。时尚的半透明粉色圆形眼镜完美地戴在她的脸上。她的鼻梁上贴着米色创可贴，左脸颊上贴着一张米色创可贴，增添了一种风格化的前卫美感。她微微张开的双唇间叼着一根点燃的香烟，露出洁白的牙齿。

高度细致的微型动漫风格雕像（可爱的侦探风格女孩角色：棕色短发、超大的闪亮蓝眼睛、圆形眼镜、鲜红色工作服、白衬衫、黄色手套）在整个构图中有趣地互动：一个坐在帽檐上，一个爬上她的耳朵，一个拉着她的下唇，一个塞在她的衬衫领子里，一个摆在她的肩膀上。一支大胆的超大青色铅笔塞在帽带下方，充当引人注目的图形元素。

衣橱造型：奢华街头服饰美学——黑色结构夹克搭配清爽的白粉色条纹领衬衫，最后搭配一条系得整齐的粉色围巾。

调色板：深黑色、充满活力的粉红色高光、电青色和暖黄色形成对比。

照明：高端工作室照明，具有柔和的正面照明和戏剧性的边缘照明，以实现深度和分离。干净的白色无缝背景。

构图：超清晰焦点、社论取景、奢华时尚广告风格、电影深度、超现实纹理（可见的皮肤毛孔、细致的织物编织、单独的发丝）、8K 分辨率、极其复杂的细节。

基调：大胆、俏皮、时尚、Z 世代奢华街头服饰宣传活动，将现实主义与超现实的微型故事讲述融为一体。

Highlight the 4 right-side outlets with a green outline group and individual green outlines, and place 4 numbered green labels on the right: "1 Servidor 1", "2 Servidor 2", "3 Servidor 3", "4 Switch (mover aquí)". On the left, highlight the currently used upper-left outlet with an orange outline and add an orange callout box reading "Switch: mover de aquí", plus a curved arrow from that outlet to the bottom outlet of the right-side green group. Also outline the 3 lower-left outlets in light gray and add 3 gray labels on the left aligned to them: "Solo protección (sin batería)", "No crítico", and "Libre / periféricos". At the bottom, add a large yellow warning box with a caution icon and this text: "Ojo: 3 servidores + 1 switch pueden sobrecargar un Back-UPS ES 700. Si pita o se apaga al probarlo, necesitas un SAI más potente." Clean infographic style, readable bold typography, neat rounded rectangles, high contrast, and practical IT-diagram presentation.

items.title: Luxury Concept Poster Design
items.titleZh:
What you will generate is not a regular illustration, but a high-end concept poster that expresses the meaning and symbolism of the person and name "{argument name="person name" default="ELON MUSK"}" as a visual metaphor.

Place the giant letters "{argument name="person name" default="ELON MUSK"}" as the main protagonist of the entire screen. The letters should be thick, powerful sans-serif characters with an overwhelming presence. The background should be {argument name="background color" default="deep black"}, and the characters a slightly yellowish off-white, with paper texture, graininess, and light scuffs like vintage silkscreen printing or old posters.

At the bottom center, place a monochrome portrait of a man reminiscent of Elon Musk. It should have an atmosphere similar to the person himself, with an expression looking up at the future. The face should not be too realistic, but expressed with strong shadows in a print/poster style.

In the upper right, include a composition where a rocket is launching diagonally upward. Use {argument name="accent color" default="red"} as an accent color for the rocket's exhaust flames and smoke, and have it pass through the giant letters as if cutting through them. This visualizes the meaning of "breaking through to the future," "breaking through existing frameworks," and "large-scale challenges."

Make the overall design a minimalist and powerful graphic poster. Do not add too many elements; compose it only with the text, the person, the rocket, and the red smoke. The composition should be bold and designed to leave an impression at a glance, even from a distance.

In the lower left, add small auxiliary text like "VISION / SCALE / MOTION," and in the lower right, "BUILD THE FUTURE." You may discreetly place small symbols associated with Tesla or X if necessary, but the main focus remains the symbolism of the name "ELON MUSK" and the person.

Unify the colors around three main colors: black, off-white, and red. Create a concept poster with a strong visual memory that conveys luxury, futurism, ambition, solitude, a sense of scale, and the energy of destruction and creation.
items.prompt:
あなたが生成するのは、普通のイラストではなく、「{argument name="人物名" default="ELON MUSK"}」という人物・名前が持つ意味や象徴性を、視覚的なメタファーとして表現した高級コンセプトポスターです。

巨大な文字「{argument name="人物名" default="ELON MUSK"}」を画面全体の主役として配置してください。文字は太く、力強く、圧倒的な存在感を持つサンセリフ体。背景は{argument name="背景色" default="深い黒"}、文字は少し黄味がかったオフホワイトで、ヴィンテージのシルクスクリーン印刷や古いポスターのような紙質感、粒子感、軽い擦れを加えてください。

画面中央下には、イーロン・マスクを想起させる男性のモノクロポートレートを配置してください。本人に似た雰囲気で、未来を見上げるような表情。顔は写実的すぎず、版画・ポスター調の強い陰影で表現してください。

右上には、ロケットが斜め上に打ち上がっていく構図を入れてください。ロケットの噴射炎と煙は{argument name="アクセントカラー" default="赤"}をアクセントカラーにし、巨大な文字の一部を切り裂くように通過させてください。これにより「未来へ突き抜ける」「既存の枠を突破する」「スケールの大きな挑戦」という意味を視覚化します。

全体は極簡で力強いグラフィックポスターにしてください。要素を増やしすぎず、文字、人物、ロケット、赤い噴煙だけで構成します。構図は大胆で、遠くから見ても一目で印象に残るデザインにしてください。

左下に小さく「VISION / SCALE / MOTION」、右下に「BUILD THE FUTURE.」のような短い補助テキストを入れてください。必要に応じてTeslaやXを連想させる小さな記号を控えめに配置してもよいですが、主役はあくまで「ELON MUSK」という文字と人物の象徴性です。

色数は黒、オフホワイト、赤の3色を中心に統一してください。高級感、未来感、野心、孤独、スケール感、破壊と創造のエネルギーが伝わる、強い視覚記憶を持つコンセプトポスターにしてください。

items.title: 1960s Art-House Film Poster
items.titleZh:
Create a vertical poster composition on aged cream paper with a handmade analog feel. Use rough ripped paper edges, layered magazine cutouts, photocopy grain, halftone texture, ink bleed, and slightly imperfect screen-print registration. Keep the subject as the main black-and-white photographic portrait, placed prominently in the center or upper center.

Surround the subject with graphic blocks of deep red, cobalt blue, warm yellow, black, and ivory. Add supporting collage fragments such as a rainy European street, film-strip borders, newspaper clippings, urban silhouettes, and cinematic details, arranged like a handmade 1960s art-house movie poster.

Use bold condensed typography with a strong visual hierarchy. Add large headline text: “{argument name="main title" default="[MAIN TITLE]"}”. Add smaller subtitle text: “{argument name="subtitle" default="[SUBTITLE]"}”. Add bottom text: “{argument name="event details" default="[BRAND NAME / EVENT NAME / COMING SOON / DATE]"}”. If needed, include a small top line reading “[TAGLINE]”.

The final result should feel cinematic, intellectual, rebellious, and editorial — like a lost 1960s European film poster with a strong point of view. Keep it raw, tactile, printed, imperfect, and handmade. Avoid a glossy modern finish.
items.promptZh:
在老化的奶油色纸上创建具有手工模拟感觉的垂直海报构图。使用粗糙的撕裂纸边缘、分层的杂志剪纸、复印颗粒、半色调纹理、渗墨和稍微不完美的丝网印刷套准。将拍摄对象作为主要的黑白摄影肖像，突出地放置在中心或上部中心。

用深红色、钴蓝色、暖黄色、黑色和象牙色的图形块围绕主题。添加辅助拼贴片段，例如雨天的欧洲街道、胶片边框、剪报、城市剪影和电影细节，排列得像手工制作的 20 世纪 60 年代艺术电影海报一样。

使用具有强烈视觉层次结构的大胆压缩版式。添加大标题文本：“{argument name="main title" default="[MAIN TITLE]"}”。添加较小的副标题文本：“{argument name="subtitle" default="[SUBTITLE]"}”。添加底部文本：“{参数名称=“活动详细信息”默认=“[品牌名称/活动名称/即将推出/日期]”}”。如果需要，请在顶行添加一小行“[TAGLINE]”。

Her face is completely obscured by a large rectangular mosaic censor blur. Behind and to her right, show a sleek humanoid stand entity made of glossy pale lavender liquid with splashing droplets around its head and shoulders, narrow eyes, smooth organic armor-like anatomy, and 3 round purple orb details down the chest and abdomen. Add 2 large stylized purple Japanese sound effects in a hand-drawn manga font: one near the top reading "ゴゴゴ…" and one near the lower body reading "ゴゴゴゴ……". On the far right, place a vertical Japanese exclamation in black text: "オラオララッ！汗の一滴まで見逃されェ！". Below that, include a boxed radar chart titled "スタンド能力パラメーター" with 6 labeled stats around the graph: "破壊力 B", "スピード A", "射程距離 C", "成長性 B", "精密動作性 A", and durability at the remaining axis, with a purple filled polygon. items.titleZh: A full-page manga-style parody character profile illustration on an aged off-white paper background, designed like a JoJo-inspired stand user sheet with bold ink lines, cross-hatching, dramatic posing, and stylized Japanese text. The central figure is an anthropomorphic duck mascot athlete standing in a confident forward stride, pointing directly at the viewer with one gloved hand and clenching the other fist. He has a large round pale-yellow duck head with a bright orange beak, huge glossy black eyes, and a fierce determined expression with furrowed brows. His body is human-like and athletic, wearing a dark green sleeveless soccer jersey over a white undershirt, white shorts, black shoes with teal laces, and yellow-and-black horizontal striped knee-high socks. Around his neck hangs a lanyard with an ID badge showing a small portrait icon of the duck mascot and the text “No.001”. The jersey has 4 visible sponsor-style patches and labels: “農協牛乳”, “今野硝子工業”, “相模福祉村”, and a small crest marked “SC'S”. Behind him stands his humanoid Stand, a tall muscular armored figure with a metallic olive-gold body, a heart-shaped chest emblem, narrow intimidating eyes, and a raised fist, surrounded by jagged purple spiritual flames. Add 4 large purple manga sound effect texts around the figures, each reading “ゴゴ…”, with one near the upper left of the Stand and 3 stacked vertically along the left side of the mascot. On the left side of the page, include a profile text column with 6 horizontal rule-separated lines of Japanese text: “スタンド使い名: ガミティ”, “性別: 男”, “見た目: ダチョウのマスコット”, “年齢: 不明”, “身長: 175cm”, and “職業: マスコット / PR活動”. On the right side, place a large spiky speech bubble filled with bold vertical Japanese text: “オラオラオラオラオラ！ 前に出るぞ！絶対に負けねェーッ！ 相模原・共に行こうぜェーッ！”. Below that, add a lower-right information block with a heading “スタンド名:『オオサガミ・オオオォ！』” and a smaller subtitle “(SC相模原チャント「オオサガミオオオォー！」より)”, followed by a paragraph headed “スタンド能力:” describing an emotional amplification power in dense Japanese body text. In the lower left corner, include a purple-filled radar chart with 6 axes labeled in Japanese: “破壊力 B”, “スピード B”, “射程距離 D”, “成長性 C”, “精密動作性 C”, and “持続力 C”. Composition should feel like a dramatic manga magazine character introduction page, with the mascot in front, the Stand looming behind, strong foreshortening, dynamic comic-book energy, and a humorous contrast between a cute sports mascot and an overwhelmingly serious supernatural battle presentation.

items.title: Cinematic Typography Poster
items.titleZh: A minimalist cinematic poster on a tall vertical canvas with an off-white textured paper background and a dark matte stage platform at the bottom, dominated by giant condensed black sans-serif letters spelling {argument name="main title" default="SAM ALTMAN"} across nearly the full height of the composition, with the first word stacked above and overlapping the second. Replace one central vertical letterform with a glowing open doorway, outlined in warm orange-red light, revealing a bright sunrise sky and a distant cityscape beyond. On the stage, place 1 lone adult man seen from behind in three-quarter profile, walking toward the doorway, wearing a dark crewneck sweater, dark pants, and light sneakers, with realistic proportions and subtle dramatic rim lighting. To the upper right of the typography, add 3 small lines of spaced uppercase text reading {argument name="tagline line 1" default="AI."}, {argument name="tagline line 2" default="POWER."}, and {argument name="tagline line 3" default="POSSIBILITY."}. In the lower left corner, add 1 small orange credit line reading {argument name="credit text" default="OPENAI CEO"}. Use strong scale contrast, lots of negative space, editorial magazine-cover styling, clean modern layout, muted neutral tones with one warm orange accent, realistic lighting, subtle film grain, and a sophisticated futuristic mood.
items.promptZh: 一张极简主义的电影海报，位于高大的垂直画布上，背景为灰白色纹理纸，底部有一个深色哑光舞台平台，主要是巨大的浓缩黑色无衬线字母，拼写为{argument name =“main title”default =“SAM ALTMAN”}，几乎覆盖了构图的整个高度，第一个单词堆叠在上面并与第二个单词重叠。用发光的开放式门口取代中央垂直的字体，用温暖的橙红色灯光勾勒出轮廓，露出明亮的日出天空和远处的城市景观。在舞台上，放置一名孤独的成年男子，从后面看，呈四分之三侧面，朝门口走去，穿着深色圆领毛衣、深色裤子和浅色运动鞋，比例逼真，边缘灯光微妙而戏剧性。在版式的右上角，添加 3 行小行间隔大写文本：{argument name="tagline line 1" default="AI."}、{argument name="tagline line 2" default="POWER."} 和 {argument name="tagline line 3" default="POSSIBILITY."}。在左下角，添加 1 个小的橙色信用额度，内容为 {argument name="credit text" default="OPENAI CEO"}。使用强烈的比例对比、大量的负空间、社论杂志封面造型、干净的现代布局、带有温暖橙色口音的柔和中性色调、逼真的灯光、微妙的胶片颗粒和精致的未来主义情绪。
