items.title: Old Shanghai Fusion Poster
items.titleZh: A vertical cultural travel poster on warm off-white textured paper, designed like a handcrafted 3D shadow-box collage that forms the silhouette of the Chinese character for Shanghai. Use a refined old-meets-new Shanghai theme with miniature architecture, street scenes, props, food, and typography, photographed straight-on with soft studio lighting and delicate drop shadows. The composition should feel elegant, editorial, nostalgic, and premium, with muted cream, brass gold, teal green, brick red, jade, and weathered wood tones. At the upper left, build the top section of the character from 1 modern glass skyscraper, 1 tall historic high-rise with a golden crown, 1 domed neoclassical waterfront building, 1 clock-tower civic building, 2 smaller background towers, 2 red vintage Shanghai trams, and 1 rickshaw. Beneath that, create a canal-town section with 2 tall red Oriental Pearl Tower spheres-and-columns motifs, 2 qipao dresses displayed vertically, 4 old shikumen and lane houses, 1 curved waterfront canal, 4 wooden boats on the water, and 2 gramophones placed at the far left and right edges. Across the center, place a large diagonal metallic-gold embossed title reading {argument name="headline text" default="SHANGHAI COLLECTION"} in bold retro 3D lettering. To the right of the upper composition, add hand-lettered vintage script text reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="OLD SHANGHAI FUSION"}. On the lower left, add serif text reading {argument name="tagline text" default="DESIGN POSTER"}. The lower half should form the rest of the character using traditional Chinese architectural miniatures and market objects: 1 large classical Chinese roofed building complex, 4 vertical neon-style shop signs with Chinese characters, 2 square decorative plaques, 1 small green ceramic ewer, 2 shallow food trays, 1 rectangular tray of 6 soup dumplings, 1 long tray with 3 white tanghulu-like skewered sweets, 2 round mooncakes, and 1 small sauce dish, 1 rectangular display shelf containing 4 steamed buns, 1 bowl of noodles, 2 golden pastries, 1 plate of white flower-shaped sweets, 1 small doll figurine, and 2 painted opera masks, plus 2 hanging newspapers at the lower right. Keep the background spacious and minimal, with the collage and text arranged diagonally for a sophisticated poster layout. Make the whole image look like a meticulously assembled handmade paper-and-wood diorama, combining Art Deco Shanghai glamour, Republican-era nostalgia, Jiangnan water-town charm, and traditional Chinese market culture.
items.promptZh: 垂直的文化旅行海报，采用温暖的灰白色纹理纸，设计像手工制作的 3D 影子拼贴画，形成上海汉字的轮廓。使用精致的新旧结合的上海主题，包括微型建筑、街景、道具、食物和版式，使用柔和的工作室灯光和精致的阴影直接拍摄。构图应该给人优雅、编辑、怀旧和优质的感觉，采用柔和的奶油色、黄铜金、水鸭绿、砖红色、翡翠色和风化木色调。在左上角，用 1 座现代玻璃摩天大楼、1 座带有金色王冠的历史高层建筑、1 座圆顶新古典主义海滨建筑、1 座钟楼市政建筑、2 座较小的背景塔、2 辆红色老式上海电车和 1 辆人力车来构建角色的顶部。在其下方，创建一个运河小镇部分，其中有2个高大的红色东方明珠塔球体和柱子图案，2件垂直展示的旗袍，4座古老的石库门和巷屋，1条弯曲的滨水运河，4艘水面上的木船，以及放置在最左边和最右边的2台留声机。在中心位置放置一个大型对角金属金色浮雕标题，上面写有粗体复古 3D 字体的{argument name="headline text" default="SHANGHAI COLLECTION"}。在上部构图的右侧，添加手写复古脚本文本：{argument name="subtitle text" default="OLD SHANGHAI FUSION"}。在左下角，添加衬线文本：{argument name="tagline text" default="DESIGN POSTER"}。下半部分应使用中国传统建筑模型和市场物品来形成其余的人物：1个大型古典中式屋顶建筑群，4个带有汉字的垂直霓虹灯式招牌，2个方形装饰牌，1个绿色陶瓷小壶，2个浅食盘，1个长方形托盘，装6个汤饺，1个长托盘，有3个白色糖葫芦状串糖，2个圆形月饼，1个小酱盘，1个长方形展示架上有4个包子、1碗面条、2个金黄糕点、1盘白色花形糖果、1个小娃娃、2个彩绘脸谱，右下方还有2张挂报纸。保持背景宽敞且简约，拼贴画和文字对角排列，形成精致的海报布局。使整个形象像一个精心组装的手工纸木立体模型，将上海的装饰艺术魅力、民国时代的怀旧气息、江南水乡的魅力和中国传统的市井文化融为一体。

items.title: Beijing Cultural Heritage Poster
items.titleZh: A refined vertical cultural exhibition poster on a warm ivory textured paper background, designed with abundant negative space and an elegant museum-catalog aesthetic. The centerpiece is one monumental piece of Chinese calligraphy formed as sculptural 3D architectural typography, reading {argument name="main Chinese character" default="北京"} as two large interconnected characters built entirely from miniature Beijing heritage landmarks and traditional decorative elements. The strokes are constructed like carved lacquer and wood architectural fragments in rich vermilion red, aged gold, jade green, turquoise blue, stone gray, and ivory, with exquisite relief detail, soft shadows, and a handcrafted collectible feel. Across the calligraphy, integrate iconic Beijing imagery: palace roofs with glazed tiles, temple pavilions, stairways, carved balustrades, watchtowers, a winding section of the Great Wall, ornamental clouds, guardian lion sculptures, small old trees, golden ginkgo branches and leaves, hanging red lanterns, a Beijing opera mask, a skewer of glossy candied hawthorn, the Temple of Heaven, and a plated roast duck tucked into one lower stroke. Make the composition feel like a cultural miniature world embedded inside each brushstroke, with realistic depth, crisp surface detail, and subtle museum lighting from the upper left. Add sparse typography around the main artwork in a sophisticated editorial layout: at upper left, a tiny emblem and the words "BEIJING CHINA", beneath it "2024" and "CITY CULTURE SERIES" in small thin serif capitals; at upper right, a vertical Chinese title reading "北京 一座城的壮阔史诗" with several smaller vertical lines of Chinese copy and a red seal stamp; at lower left, large elegant serif text reading {argument name="city name in English" default="BEIJING"} and beneath it {argument name="subtitle" default="ETERNAL GLORY"}, followed by smaller text "EXHIBITION POSTER", "NO.2024-001", and tiny heritage-themed footer copy; at lower right, tiny small-cap text reading {argument name="tagline" default="TIMELESS HERITAGE"} and "CULTURAL LEGACY OF A THOUSAND YEARS". Keep the overall style luxurious, poetic, highly detailed, and premium, blending Chinese traditional culture, architectural miniature art, and contemporary poster design.

items.title: Detailed Biographical Infographic Poster
items.titleZh: Please create an infographic about {argument name="subject name" default="[Name]"} with very rich and deep visual effects. It shouldn't just list information: I need you to dig deep into their life, major achievements, key career milestones, philosophical thoughts, and their unique impact on technology and design. Avoid a rigid block-by-block layout; use diagrams, annotations, and lead lines to organically combine this information. Visual style: Go for a bold, strong, and highly graphical illustration style. Specifically, it should look like this: the central focus is a highly realistic, photo-like portrait of the person. Surrounding this core are elements like timelines, analytical charts, classic products, famous quotes, and concise text. Composition: Keep the background clean. Use layered composition to perfectly mix the realistic portrait with strong graphical elements (like various shapes, icons, large color blocks). The entire image should look full of content, textured, and very professional.
items.prompt: 请帮我制作一张关于{argument name="人物姓名" default="[人物姓名]"}的信息图，视觉效果要非常丰富且有深度。不仅是罗列信息：我需要你深入挖掘他的生平、主要成就、职场关键节点、哲学思想，以及他对科技和设计的独特影响。不要用那种死板的一块一块的布局，要用图解、注释和引线标注把这些信息有机地结合在一起。画面风格：走那种大胆有力、图形感很强的插画路线。具体看起来是这样的：中心焦点是一张细节极其逼真、像照片一样的人物肖像。以此为核心，周围环绕着像时间轴、分析图表、经典产品、名言警句和短小精悍的文字。构图技巧：背景保持干净。运用分层构图，把逼真的人物肖像和强烈的图形元素（比如各种形状、图标、大色块）完美混搭在一起。整个画面要显得内容满满、有质感，看起来非常专业。

items.title: Ancient Chinese RPG Brothel Street UI
items.titleZh: A cinematic third-person in-game screenshot from a realistic ancient Chinese open-world RPG set at night in a luxurious pleasure district. The camera is positioned behind a tall male protagonist with long black hair tied half-up, wearing a dark embroidered hanfu-style robe, standing in the middle of a wet stone street and facing the entrance of an ornate brothel pavilion. The central building is richly detailed with carved wooden columns, glowing red lanterns, gold calligraphy plaques, and warm amber interior lighting spilling onto the street. A large horizontal signboard above the entrance reads “春院”. On the two front columns are vertical calligraphy couplets. Around the doorway and street are exactly 16 visible NPCs: 1 player character in the foreground seen from behind, 7 courtesans in flowing translucent silk hanfu dresses posed near the entrance and seated on stools, 6 pedestrians and guests scattered on the right side street and bridge area, and 2 seated figures inside the entrance area. In the foreground, a cute teen/young adult anime girl with {argument name="hair color" default="light chestnut brown"} shoulder-length wavy hair, side-swept bangs, and two colorful hairpins smiles directly at the viewer and winks with one eye. She is posed in dynamic perspective, reaching one hand toward the camera as if inviting the viewer to join her. She wears a yellow hooded windbreaker, a white T-shirt printed with colorful bicycle lettering, dark blue shorts, black thigh-high stockings, and a light blue backpack. Beside her is a mint-green compact folding bicycle labeled "FOLDY," shown unfolded and parked on the promenade with visible small wheels, frame hinge, handlebars, saddle, pedals, and kickstand, emphasizing portability and urban leisure cycling. Use a glossy, high-saturation anime poster aesthetic with clean linework, soft facial rendering, energetic lighting, and playful graphic decoration.

At the upper right, place a yellow burst badge with a tiny flag icon containing the text "フォールディングバイク サイクリングイベント 開催！". Add a white speech bubble near the girl’s face with pink outline and handwritten-feel Japanese text: "ねえ、キミ！ 折りたたみは どこへでも行けるよ♪ 一緒に 行こっ！". Near the bicycle, include a small angled sticker with text "コンパクトにたためて 持ち運びラクラク♪". Near the lower center-left, add a section label "イベントの楽しみポイント♪" followed by exactly 4 round icon features in pastel circles: 1) a pink bicycle icon with text "折りたたみで 持ち運び自由！" 2) a blue camera icon with text "フォトスポットで 思い出を残そう！" 3) a yellow drink icon with text "カフェタイムで ほっとひと息♪" 4) a purple gift icon with text "オリジナルグッズ プレゼント！".

On the lower right, add a rounded white information card with green accents titled "FOLDING BIKE サイクリングイベント" and large pink date text "6.15(日)". Inside the card, present exactly 4 event detail rows with colored circular icons: 1) calendar row: "開催日 2025. ※雨天時は6.22(日)に順延" 2) location row: "集合所 みなとみらい 臨港パーク" with smaller note "(神奈川県横浜市)" 3) course row: "コース みなとみらい〜湾沿いの気持ちいいルートを走ります" with smaller note "(約20km、初心者安心！)" 4) fee row: "参加費 3,000円" with smaller note "(保険・記念品付き) ※レンタルバイクあり（要予約）". At the bottom of this card, add a pink strip reading "初心者歓迎！ひとり参加も大歓迎！". Along the very bottom of the poster, create a wide pink banner with large Japanese copy "さあ、次の休日は一緒に走ろう！" and smaller text on the left "お申し込み・詳細は公式サイトへ！". In the center-bottom place a search-bar style box containing {argument name="search text" default="フォールディングライド 2025"}. To its right, add a black-and-white QR code and a pink label reading "エントリーはこちらから！". In the bottom-right corner, include a small inset photo-style illustration of two cyclists riding together with a handwritten note "たのしいかも♡". Maintain a lively, magazine-quality event poster composition with exactly 1 main character, 1 folding bike, 1 large event info card, 1 speech bubble, 1 yellow burst badge, 1 angled portability sticker, 4 feature icons, 1 QR code, and 1 inset image.

items.title: Dance Choreography Instruction Sheet
items.titleZh:
Dance Sequence Instruction Sheet
[VISUAL STYLE]
A composition featuring a highly detailed 3D-rendered female dancer. Designed like a professional choreography guide with a technical, diagram-inspired layout. Clean white background, soft studio lighting, and strong contrast to highlight body movement and posture.
[GRID LAYOUT]
Structured 4×4 panel grid (16 frames total), evenly spaced with thin black divider lines. Each panel is identical in size and clearly numbered from 1 to 16 to show a continuous dance progression.
[CHARACTER]
Use {argument name="reference" default="image1"} as the base character. The same female dancer appears consistently across all panels with accurate likeness and proportions.
[WARDROBE]
The dancer wears a stylish, performance-ready outfit: a {argument name="clothing" default="well-fitted top paired with a short, flowy skirt"}. The look should feel modern and visually appealing while still practical for dance movement. Fabric should subtly respond to motion (slight flow and folds), even in grayscale.
[PANEL STRUCTURE – EACH FRAME]
Top-left: Step number + short dance move title (e.g., “Step 5 – Spin Transition”)
Center: Full-body pose capturing a precise moment in the choreography
Bottom-left: 3–4 lines of concise instruction describing the move
Overlay: Motion arrows and directional guides illustrating how the dancer transitions
[MOTION INDICATORS]
Incorporate curved arrows for fluid motion, straight arrows for directional steps, and circular indicators for spins or turns. Emphasize rhythm, weight shifts, and body isolation.
[RENDER QUALITY]
High-detail sculpted 3D style with smooth grayscale shading, subtle shadows, and clean linework. Maintain a polished, concept-art level finish with clarity in every pose.
[RESTRICTIONS]
No color, no background scenery, no extra characters, no visual clutter, only the dancer and instructional elements..
items.promptZh:
舞蹈顺序说明书
[视觉风格]
一幅以高度细致的 3D 渲染女舞者为特色的作品。设计就像专业的编舞指南，具有技术性、图表启发的布局。干净的白色背景，柔和的工作室灯光，强烈的对比凸显身体动作和姿势。
[网格布局]
结构化 4×4 面板网格（总共 16 个框架），均匀间隔有细黑色分隔线。每个面板尺寸相同，并清晰编号从 1 到 16，以显示连续的舞蹈进程。
[人物]
使用 {argument name="reference" default="image1"} 作为基本字符。同一个女舞者在所有面板上一致出现，具有准确的相似度和比例。
[衣柜]
舞者穿着时尚、适合表演的服装：{argument name="clothing" default="合身的上衣搭配飘逸短裙"}。外观应该具有现代感和视觉吸引力，同时仍然适合舞蹈动作。即使是灰度，织物也应该对运动做出微妙的反应（轻微的流动和折叠）。
[面板结构 – 每个框架]
左上：步骤编号 + 短舞动作标题（例如“步骤 5 – 旋转过渡”）
中：全身姿势捕捉舞蹈中的精确瞬间
左下：3-4 行描述动作的简洁说明
叠加：运动箭头和方向指南说明舞者如何过渡
[运动指示器]
结合用于流体运动的弯曲箭头、用于定向步骤的直箭头以及用于旋转或转向的圆形指示器。强调节奏、重心转移和身体孤立。
[渲染质量]
高细节雕刻 3D 风格，具有平滑的灰度阴影、微妙的阴影和干净的线条。每个姿势都保持清晰、清晰的概念艺术水平。
[限制]
没有颜色，没有背景风景，没有多余的角色，没有视觉混乱，只有舞者和教学元素。

[GRID LAYOUT]
Structured 4×4 panel grid (16 frames total), evenly spaced with thin black divider lines. Each panel is identical in size and clearly numbered from 1 to 16 to show a continuous dance progression.
[CHARACTER]
Use {argument name="reference" default="image1"} as the base character. The same female dancer appears consistently across all panels with accurate likeness and proportions.
[WARDROBE]
The dancer wears a stylish, performance-ready outfit: a {argument name="clothing" default="well-fitted top paired with a short, flowy skirt"}. The look should feel modern and visually appealing while still practical for dance movement. Fabric should subtly respond to motion (slight flow and folds), even in grayscale.
[PANEL STRUCTURE – EACH FRAME]
Top-left: Step number + short dance move title (e.g., “Step 5 – Spin Transition”)
Center: Full-body pose capturing a precise moment in the choreography
Bottom-left: 3–4 lines of concise instruction describing the move
Overlay: Motion arrows and directional guides illustrating how the dancer transitions
[MOTION INDICATORS]
Incorporate curved arrows for fluid motion, straight arrows for directional steps, and circular indicators for spins or turns. Emphasize rhythm, weight shifts, and body isolation.
[RENDER QUALITY]
High-detail sculpted 3D style with smooth grayscale shading, subtle shadows, and clean linework. Maintain a polished, concept-art level finish with clarity in every pose.
[RESTRICTIONS]
No color, no background scenery, no extra characters, no visual clutter, only the dancer and instructional elements..

items.titleZh:
A dynamic, vertical advertising poster for {argument name="product" default="Nike Joggers"} featuring {argument name="celebrity" default="Sydney Sweeney"} in a mid-air jump pose. Sydney Sweeney is smiling brightly with her blonde hair flowing dynamically, wearing a vibrant, color-blocked outfit: an {argument name="outfit colors" default="orange and purple"} patterned windbreaker over a blue hoodie with a yellow and pink "NIKE" logo. She wears black athletic leggings with mesh panels and a large, padded, multi-colored (orange, purple, green, blue) leg sleeve on her left leg that matches the jacket. Her footwear is prominent: a massive, highly detailed, chunky Nike M2K Tekno sneaker in white with bold orange, blue, and black accents in the foreground, with a smaller, matching sneaker on her other foot. Her right hand is raised with bracelets.
The background is a high-key, stylized light blue gradient, with abstract architectural lines and motion streaks of a city, and a huge, translucent, light blue stylized "NIKE" logo overlapping. The top has text: "JUMP HIGHER. REACH FURTHER." in white with a Nike swoosh. The bottom features large, bold text: "puma”JOGGERS" followed by "POWER. PERFORMANCE. STYLE." The bottom contains more text and logos: "JUST DO IT." and two small Nike swooshes. The entire image has a high-energy, motion-blur-effect aesthetic with graphic textures and a clean, commercial design.

items.title: Surreal Violet Sports Ad Poster
items.titleZh: A high-end surreal sports advertising poster in a 3:4 vertical composition featuring an athletic woman frozen mid-jump against a deep moody charcoal-to-violet gradient background. She is centered slightly to the right, with her body stretched dynamically as if sprinting through the air, left arm extended back, right arm bent forward, one leg kicked forward and the other trailing behind. She has {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"} hair in a messy bun with loose wisps, and wears an off-white oversized Nike crewneck sweatshirt, loose violet-gray marbled athletic pants, and clean white Nike sneakers with a subtle violet glow along the soles. Her face is obscured by a soft rectangular blur block, creating an anonymous editorial fashion look. Behind and around her, dramatic electric violet smoke and energy clouds erupt and swirl, wrapping around her torso, legs, and feet, with luminous vapor trails and a storm-like aura that intensifies the motion. Place 1 white Nike swoosh logo in the top-left corner. Integrate 3 huge metallic silver 3D words across the lower middle of the poster reading {argument name="slogan text" default="JUST DO IT"}, split into the visible word blocks “JUST”, “DO”, and “IT”, partially overlapping the athlete’s body and cutting across the composition like bold campaign typography. The overall look is glossy, cinematic, premium, and energetic, with dramatic rim lighting, strong contrast, soft atmospheric haze, fashion-ad realism, and a viral AI-generated sports campaign aesthetic for {argument name="brand name" default="Nike"}.

items.title: Cyberpunk Rainy Street Robot Repair
items.titleZh: A cinematic cyberpunk street scene at night in heavy rain, ultra-detailed and photorealistic. In the foreground, a young East Asian woman mechanic with messy dark hair tied in a loose bun sits at a wet metal worktable, leaning forward with intense concentration as she repairs a small spherical quadruped robot. Her face is obscured by a centered square censor blur. She wears a transparent plastic rain poncho over dark clothing, the glossy folds catching neon reflections. In one hand she holds a precision screwdriver and with the other she adjusts exposed wiring and circuitry inside the robot’s open shell. The robot is compact and worn, about the size of a small dog, with a white and gray rounded body, a blue camera-like lens for one eye, visible internal electronics, scratches, grime, and four articulated mechanical legs planted on the table. Scatter the tabletop with exact repair clutter: 2 screwdrivers, 2 batteries, 1 circuit board, 1 small camera or lens module, loose screws, wires, and a half-filled glass of amber liquid. Surround them with a dense neon-lit East Asian alley market full of rain-slick pavement, steam from food stalls, and pedestrians carrying umbrellas. Include at least 8 visible illuminated signs layered into the background, including a large red sign reading {argument name="main neon sign" default="修理"}, an orange sign reading "OPEN", a bright sign reading "24H", a vertical sign reading "ホテル", and additional mixed Chinese, Japanese, and Korean-style shop signs. Show several background figures in dark rainwear and translucent ponchos, some faces softly blurred by depth of field. Use moody blue-and-orange lighting, glossy reflections, mist, volumetric rain, shallow depth of field, dramatic bokeh, anamorphic highlights, high texture detail, gritty realism, and the feeling of a lone street technician fixing advanced hardware in a bustling futuristic city.

items.title: French New Wave Torn Poster Collage
items.titleZh: A vintage 1960s French New Wave cinema poster collage on aged beige paper, designed like a torn-paper art-house one-sheet with analog grain, distressed print texture, rough ripped edges, ink wear, halftone imperfections, and slight misregistration. Center the composition around a large black-and-white portrait of a woman with messy dark hair, hand raised to her face, holding a cigarette, cropped from the chest up, with her face obscured by a rectangular blur block. Use a layered collage layout with exactly 8 major paper elements: 1) a top-left black text block reading "LES FILMS DU CARREFOUR présentent" above the large stacked name "ANNA KARINA" and smaller text "dans un film de JEAN-LUC GODARD"; 2) a red torn quote panel on the left reading "Il faut essayer d’être jeune comme on peut. - GODARD"; 3) a blue torn panel in the upper right with a black label reading "PRIX JEAN VIGO 1962"; 4) a narrow torn newspaper clipping on the upper right reading "l’amour est plus fort que la mort"; 5) a yellow torn panel on the mid-right showing a black silhouette of a man in a hat facing a woman, beside a vertical black filmstrip border with white sprocket holes; 6) a bottom-left black-and-white Paris street photo with wet pavement, a lamppost, pedestrians, and a visible sign reading "HOTEL DU NORD"; 7) a small bottom-left review text block reading '"LE FILM QUI A CHANGÉ LE CINÉMA" - CAHIERS DU CINÉMA'; 8) a bottom-right cropped black-and-white portrait of a man in a suit with his face obscured by a rectangular blur block, partially covered by a red torn paper shape. Across the lower middle, place the huge torn-paper title in bold condensed uppercase: "À BOUT DE" in black and "SOUFFLE" in red, slightly angled and spanning most of the width. Under the title, add a blue torn strip with white uppercase text "UNE HISTOIRE D’AMOUR ET DE LIBERTÉ". At the bottom center, add "COMING SOON" in black uppercase and below it "LES FILMS DU CARREFOUR". Limit the palette to faded cream, black, deep ultramarine blue, muted poster red, and mustard yellow. The overall mood is rebellious, romantic, and cinematic, like an iconic French New Wave poster made from ripped magazines, street photography, and bold typography.

items.title: French New Wave Protest Film Poster
items.titleZh: Create a vintage French New Wave political cinema poster as a torn-paper collage, vertical one-sheet composition, aged and distressed like a weathered 1968 street poster pasted on a wall. Use a limited palette of cream paper, faded black, deep red, mustard yellow, and muted cobalt blue, with heavy analog film grain, halftone print texture, ink bleed, fold creases, scratches, rough paper fibers, ripped edges, glue stains, and slightly misregistered letterpress typography. In the center, place a large black-and-white portrait of a brooding young man in a dark coat, seen in three-quarter profile, cropped from chest up, with curly dark hair and his face partially obscured by a rectangular censor-like paper block, giving the image a mysterious art-house feel. Surround the portrait with torn collage fragments: at upper left, a red paper panel with a black silhouette of a running protester; beneath it, a narrow off-white text strip reading “PARIS, MAI 68” and smaller French copy “LES MURS ONT DES OREILLES, L’AVENIR AUSSI.”; along the far left edge, a vertical black film-strip border with “36 KODAK TRI-X PAN FILM” in white; at lower left, a mustard-yellow torn panel with a cropped dark silhouette portrait; at upper right, a blue torn panel containing the quote “UN FILM COUP DE POING ET DE POÉSIE.” with “— CAHIERS DU CINÉMA” below; directly below that, a tall black-and-white photo fragment of a lone figure walking down a wet Paris street at night under lampposts; near the middle-right, a small torn newsprint block with the French slogan “LA BEAUTÉ EST DANS LA RUE” above a crowd scene; at lower right, a red torn panel with a black silhouette of a domed Paris landmark. Across the very top, centered in narrow black capitals, add the tagline “NOT EVERY REVOLUTION IS TELEVISED.” Near the lower middle, in small black condensed type, add “A FILM BY {argument name="director name" default="JEAN-PIERRE LEMAIRE"}”. Make the main title dominate the lower half in huge condensed red uppercase letters over torn cream paper: “{argument name="French title" default="L’HOMME QUI RÊVAIT"}”. Directly underneath, in smaller blue condensed capitals, add the English subtitle “{argument name="English subtitle" default="THE MAN WHO DREAMED"}”. At the bottom center, place a black strip with large white condensed capitals reading “COMING SOON”, and below it smaller text “ÉTÉ 1968”. In the bottom left corner, include a Cannes-style laurel mark with “SÉLECTION OFFICIELLE FESTIVAL DE CANNES 1968”. In the bottom right corner, add tiny production credits in French, including “UNE PRODUCTION LES FILMS DU SOLEIL DISTRIBUTION”. Keep the whole design asymmetrical, raw, rebellious, and elegant, evoking Godard, Truffaut, May 1968 protest graphics, and handmade French art-house poster collage.
items.promptZh: 创建一张老式的法国新浪潮政治电影海报，采用撕纸拼贴画、垂直单页构图，陈旧且破旧，就像一张贴在墙上的 1968 年风化街头海报。使用有限的奶油色纸、褪色黑色、深红色、芥末黄和柔和的钴蓝色调色板，并带有厚重的模拟胶片颗粒、半色调打印纹理、墨水渗色、折叠折痕、划痕、粗糙的纸纤维、撕裂的边缘、胶水污渍和轻微套准不准的凸版印刷。在中心，放置了一幅巨大的黑白肖像，画的是一位穿着深色外套、沉思的年轻人，四分之三的侧面轮廓，从胸部向上剪裁，有一头卷曲的深色头发，他的脸部分被矩形检查器状的纸块遮住，给图像带来了一种神秘的艺术之家的感觉。肖像周围布满了撕碎的拼贴碎片：左上角是一个红色纸面板，上面有一个奔跑的抗议者的黑色剪影；其下方是一条狭窄的灰白色文字条，上面写着“PARIS, MAI 68”和较小的法文文字“LES MURS ONT DES OREILLES, L’AVENIR AUSSI。”；沿着最左边缘，有一个垂直的黑色胶片条边框，上面写着白色的“36 KODAK TRI-X PAN FILM”；左下角是一块芥末黄色的撕破的面板，上面有一张剪裁过的深色剪影肖像；右上角是一块蓝色撕破的面板，上面写着“UN FILM COUP DE POING ET DE POÉSIE”。下面有“—电影手册”；正下方是一张高大的黑白照片片段，照片上是一个孤独的身影在夜间在潮湿的巴黎街道上的灯柱下行走；靠近中右翼的地方，人群场景上方有一个撕破的小新闻纸块，上面写着法语口号“LA BEAUTÉ EST DANS LA RUE”；右下角是一块红色撕裂的面板，上面有巴黎圆顶地标的黑色轮廓。在最顶部，以狭窄的黑色大写字母为中心，添加标语“并非所有革命都会电视转播”。靠近中下部分，以黑色小字体添加“A FILM BY {argument name="director name" default="JEAN-PIERRE LEMAIRE"}”。使主标题在撕破的奶油色纸上以巨大的压缩红色大写字母占据下半部分：“{argument name =“French title”default =“L'HOMME QUI RÊVAIT”}”。在正下方，用较小的蓝色压缩大写字母添加英文副标题“{argument name="English subtitle" default="THE MAN WHO DREAMED"}”。在底部中心放置一条黑色条带，上面写有大号白色浓缩大写字母“COMING SOON”，下方是较小的文字“ÉTÉ 1968”。在左下角，包括一个戛纳风格的桂冠标记，上面写着“SÉLECTION OFFICIELLE FESTIVAL DE CANNES 1968”。在右下角，用法语添加微小的制作人员名单，包括“UNE PRODUCTION LES FILMS DU SOLEIL DISTRIBUTION”。保持整个设计不对称、原始、叛逆和优雅，让人想起戈达尔、特吕弗、1968 年 5 月的抗议图形和手工制作的法国艺术海报拼贴画。

items.title: Japanese Children's Day Photo Card
items.titleZh: A soft, airy studio photograph on a warm off-white background with a minimalist Japanese greeting-card aesthetic. Show a small child, about toddler to preschool age, running joyfully toward the camera from left-center, with one arm raised high holding a tall pole with 2 carp streamers attached: 1 large blue koinobori on top and 1 smaller red koinobori below. The child wears a simple handmade samurai helmet folded from paper, a loose long-sleeve ivory shirt, light beige pants with rolled cuffs, and white sneakers. Keep the face unobtrusive and generic, with the focus on motion, innocence, and seasonal atmosphere. Surround the child with delicate hand-drawn doodle illustrations in thin gray pencil-like lines and faint pastel accents: 2 puffy clouds, 1 flying bird, 1 small origami crane near the text, 4 drifting leaves, 2 curved wind-line clusters, 1 small house, 2 tall trees, 2 purple iris flowers with grass at the bottom left, and sparse grass marks along the ground. On the right side, add elegant Japanese handwritten text reading {argument name="headline text" default="こどもの日"}, beneath it smaller Japanese text {argument name="subtext" default="すこやかな\n成長を願って。"}, and below that the English subtitle {argument name="english subtitle" default="Children's Day"} in a light handwritten script. Use a clean editorial layout with abundant negative space, natural soft lighting, muted cream and beige tones, subtle pastel blue and red accents, gentle shadows, and a calm premium lifestyle-photography look suitable for a seasonal holiday card or social media post.

items.title: Minimal Japanese Cooking Class Hero Image
items.titleZh: A soft, airy promotional hero image for a {argument name="class theme" default="Japanese home cooking class"} on a warm off-white background, styled like a minimalist lifestyle flyer. On the left half, show 2 people: an adult woman and a young girl cooking together at a white kitchen counter, both with calm, natural poses and gentle body language. The woman stands slightly behind and to the left of the child, leaning in supportively while helping guide the girl's hands as she slices a cucumber on a wooden cutting board with a kitchen knife. Their faces are intentionally obscured with soft rectangular blur blocks. The woman has dark brown hair tied in a low ponytail and wears a loose white blouse with a natural linen apron. The girl has dark hair in a high bun and wears a light short-sleeve top with a matching beige linen apron. On the counter, include a clear glass mixing bowl with salad, a folded striped kitchen towel, a wooden bowl of vegetables on the far left, a small wooden tray or plate with colorful vegetables in front, and a small potted green herb plant near the center-right edge of the cooking area. Visible produce should include sliced cucumber on the board and whole vegetables such as tomatoes, leafy greens, mushrooms, lemons or yellow citrus, and green peppers or cucumbers, arranged in a fresh, wholesome way. On the right half, leave generous negative space and place elegant Japanese headline text in a refined serif style: {argument name="headline text" default="お料理教室開講"}. Beneath it, add 2 lines of smaller Japanese body text: {argument name="subtext" default="はじめてさんも、もっと楽しみたい方も。 一緒に『おいしい』を作りましょう。"}. Surround the composition with 7 delicate hand-drawn dark gray doodle elements: 1 small leafy sprig on the far left, 1 hanging line at the upper left with 5 kitchen tools suspended from it (a frying pan, a spatula, a ladle, a peeler or slim utensil, and an oven mitt), 1 cluster of 2 floating leaves in the upper right, 1 small cooking pot icon on the right, 1 whisking bowl icon with tiny hearts near the lower middle-right, and 1 long single-line flourish sweeping across the lower right. Use soft natural daylight, muted beige and cream tones, shallow depth of field, clean editorial photography, gentle shadows, and a calm family-friendly premium aesthetic suitable for a cooking class landing page or poster.

The group consists of 2 men and 1 woman, all casually dressed in muted colors; the person on the left wears a dark navy sweater, the woman in the center-right wears an off-white knit top, and the person on the far right wears a light gray hoodie in side profile. Their faces are softly obscured and not detailed. Place 2 open silver laptops on the table, 2 ceramic mugs, 2 notebooks, 1 smartphone, and 1 pen visible near the right person’s hand. Compose the people on the right half of the image, with a large pale sage-green organic blob shape behind them as a graphic backdrop. items.title: Celestial Blue Anime Girl Floating
items.titleZh: A full-body anime illustration of a dreamy celestial girl floating diagonally across a pure white background, viewed from above as if weightless in open air. She has very long, flowing {argument name="hair color" default="deep navy blue"} hair spreading in elegant ribbons around her body, with glossy highlights, loose strands, and star-shaped hair ornaments near one side of her head. Her face is softly obscured and de-emphasized, while the composition focuses on her delicate pose, costume, and swirling magical atmosphere. She wears a highly detailed white and blue sailor-inspired fantasy dress with translucent layered sleeves, frilled ruffles, sparkling lace, sheer fabric panels, and a large star-like crystal brooch at the chest. The outfit includes 5 clearly visible clothing elements: a short frilled dress, a sailor collar and neck ribbon, semi-transparent detached sleeves or draped chiffon layers, 1 white thigh-high stocking on one leg, and 1 dark blue starry thigh-high stocking on the other leg with a matching garter band. She is barefoot, with both feet visible. Her pose is graceful and drifting: one arm reaches upward with an open hand, the other hand rests near her chest, one leg extended and the other slightly bent. Surround her with a luminous constellation motif in cool blue tones, including exactly 6 prominent five-pointed star ornaments scattered around her, multiple tiny star sparkles, circular watercolor-like swirls, floating bubbles, and ornate crescent-ring filigree arcs framing parts of the image. Make the palette icy blue, cobalt, indigo, and white, with shimmering glitter textures, soft translucent overlays, crisp line art, and a light ethereal glow. The overall mood is magical, elegant, celestial, and serene, like a star maiden suspended in a winter night sky interpreted on a clean white canvas.

items.title: Chibi Angel in Fantasy Forest
items.titleZh: {argument name="art style" default="High-quality Japanese anime style"}, fantasy world. A {argument name="character" default="tiny 'chibi angel' (Figure 1) with white wings"} is flying gracefully through a {argument name="setting" default="mysterious forest"}. The chibi angel is cute and stylized, with soft glowing wings that emit a gentle light. The forest is mystical, dotted with giant trees, twisted trunks, floating light particles, and bioluminescent plants and mushrooms. A light mist drifts through the space, creating a deep, mysterious atmosphere. Sunlight filtering through the trees mixes with magical light to produce a dreamlike world. The camera uses a dynamic composition, chasing the chibi angel to depict it gliding through the air. Expressing motion blur for a sense of speed, wind currents, and the trajectory of flapping wings. Lighting is soft and fantastic, with a color palette based on green, blue, and gold. Light particles and volume lights fill the space. Ultra-high definition, cinematic, deep composition, aerial perspective, excellent artwork. No text, no logos, do not make it overly realistic (maintain anime expression).

items.title: Premium Earbuds Ad Poster
items.titleZh: Create a high-end futuristic product advertisement poster for {argument name="product name" default="Apple Pods Pro 3"}, styled like a premium tech magazine cover. Vertical composition, clean soft gray studio background with subtle rainbow prism lens flares around the edges. A fashionable young person is centered in the background, face obscured by a simple rectangular blur block, wearing a bright neon-lime knit beanie, wavy shoulder-length pink hair, and a black-and-white zebra striped top. One white wireless earbud is visible in their ear. In the extreme foreground, their hand is extended toward the camera holding an open glossy white charging case, shot with dramatic shallow depth of field and forced perspective so the case dominates the frame. Inside the open case, exactly 2 white earbuds are visible. Add 4 larger floating earbuds around the composition: 2 on the left side and 2 on the right side, softly blurred as if suspended in space. Place huge bold white sans-serif headline text across the top reading {argument name="headline text" default="AIRPODS"}. On the upper right, add smaller stacked white sans-serif product text reading {argument name="product label" default="Apple Pods Pro 3"}. On the left middle, add a white feature callout in stacked text: {argument name="left feature text" default="Premium sound and noise cancellation"}. On the right side, add 2 large numeric feature blocks in white: one reading "30" with smaller text "hours of battery life." beneath it, and one reading "1" with smaller text "year warranty." beneath it. Sleek commercial lighting, glossy reflections on the case, crisp product detail, modern fashion-tech aesthetic, polished Apple-inspired ad design, photorealistic, premium editorial finish.

items.title: Retro AI Creative Brand Poster
items.titleZh: Create a retro cinematic personal-brand poster in a distressed 1970s propaganda-meets-film-advertising style, landscape orientation, with a thick worn black border and heavy paper grain, ink bleed, halftone texture, scuffed edges, and aged print imperfections. Use a bold limited palette of deep black, warm cream, saturated poster red, and mustard yellow. The composition is a single unified poster with a large cropped portrait of {argument name="character name" default="HOSSEIN"} on the left half, shown from chest up, wearing dark sunglasses, a dark shirt, a chain necklace, and a mustard yellow jacket, with short dark hair styled up; the face is intentionally obscured by a centered rectangular block in muted taupe-gray, creating an editorial anonymized look. On the far left, place a vertical black panel containing 2 stacked “AI” blocks and 1 subtitle: top block reads “AI”, beneath it the subtitle reads “CREATIVE AGENT”, lower down another large “AI” sits over a gold circuit-board graphic. Across the center-right, place the main diagonal cream title band with huge black condensed lettering for the name {argument name="main name text" default="HOSSEIN"} and an oversized red “AI” at the far right of the band. Beneath the large name, add a small stretched subtitle line reading “AI CINEMATOGRAPHER · ADVERTIVE FOR BRAND”. In the top-right corner, add a 3-line stacked headline reading {argument name="top right headline" default="AI CINEMATOGRAPHER ADVERTIVE FOR BRAND"} in bold cream text on red. On the red field below the title band, include exactly 4 stacked black label boxes with cream text: “CINEMATOGRAPHER”, “AI CREATOR”, “VISUAL ARTIST”, and “BRAND ADVISOR”. Near the right side, add a handwritten white script note with exactly 3 lines: “Visual Storyteller”, “Brand Builder”, and “AI Explore”. In the lower area, arrange exactly 6 creative-tech objects: 1 circular orange graphic icon, 1 white audio waveform/equalizer graphic, 1 black film clapperboard labeled with “AI”, 1 open silver laptop, 1 pair of black headphones, and 1 large professional cinema camera body with visible “RED” marking; also include the edge of a music keyboard/controller at the bottom right. In the bottom-right corner, place a small dark terminal-style text block with tiny white monospace lines suggesting AI-generated visuals and analytics. Keep the whole design bold, gritty, and highly graphic, like a premium personal branding poster for an AI creative director and visual storyteller.
items.promptZh: 以 1970 年代宣传与电影广告相结合的仿旧风格、横向制作复古电影个人品牌海报，具有厚重的磨损黑色边框和厚重的纸纹、墨水渗色、半色调纹理、磨损的边缘和老化的印刷缺陷。使用深黑色、暖奶油色、饱和的海报红和芥末黄等大胆的有限调色板。构图是一张统一的海报，左半部分是一张大幅裁剪的{argument name="character name" default="HOSSEIN"}肖像，从胸部向上显示，戴着深色墨镜，穿着深色衬衫、项链和芥末黄色夹克，深色短发盘起；脸部被有意地用柔和的灰褐色矩形块遮挡，营造出编辑匿名的外观。在最左边，放置一个垂直的黑色面板，其中包含 2 个堆叠的“AI”块和 1 个字幕：顶部块写着“AI”，其下方的副标题写着“CREATIVE AGENT”，下方另一个大“AI”位于金色电路板图形上方。在中间偏右的位置，放置主对角线奶油色标题带，并在带子的最右侧放置一个巨大的黑色压缩字体{argument name =“main name text”default =“HOSSEIN”}，并在带子的最右侧放置一个超大的红色“AI”。在大名字下面，添加一个小的拉长副标题行，写着“AI CINEMATOGRAPHER·ADVERTIVE FOR BRAND”。在右上角，添加一个 3 行堆叠标题，内容为红色粗体奶油色文本：{argument name="top right title" default="AI CINEMATOGRAPHER ADVERTIVE FOR BRAND"}。在标题带下方的红色字段中，恰好包含 4 个带有奶油色文本的堆叠黑色标签框：“电影摄影师”、“AI 创造者”、“视觉艺术家”和“品牌顾问”。在右侧附近，添加一个手写的白色脚本注释，其中只有 3 行：“Visual Storyteller”、“Brand Builder”和“AI Explore”。在下部区域，正好排列了6个创意科技物品：1个圆形橙色图形图标、1个白色音频波形/均衡器图形、1个标有“AI”的黑色电影拍板、1台打开的银色笔记本电脑、1副黑色耳机、1个带有可见“RED”标记的大型专业电影摄影机机身；还包括右下角音乐键盘/控制器的边缘。在右下角，放置一个小的深色终端样式文本块，其中带有微小的白色等宽线，建议人工智能生成的视觉效果和分析。保持整个设计大胆、坚韧和高度图形化，就像人工智能创意总监和视觉故事讲述者的优质个人品牌海报一样。

items.title: Luxury Miniature Dubai City Model
items.titleZh: A hyper-detailed cinematic isometric miniature city model of {argument name="landmark tower" default="Burj Khalifa"} rising dramatically from the center of a square architectural master-plan board, presented like a luxury urban planning maquette on a black background. The composition shows one dominant ultra-tall silver skyscraper in the exact center, surrounded by a dense ring of modern high-rise towers, illuminated roads, bridges, and glowing warm city lights. Curving turquoise-blue water features and artificial lakes wrap around the central district in multiple connected pools and canals, with one large circular fountain-like feature near the tower base and several small island shapes visible in the water. In the lower right quadrant, include a large low-rise complex with rounded geometric roofs and subtle green-lit sections, connected by multilane roads and looping interchanges. The entire city sits on one square beige map board engraved with faint street grids and planning lines, with the board edges clearly visible and slightly raised. Viewpoint is a high three-quarter isometric angle, centered and symmetrical, with the tower extending far upward into negative space. Lighting is dramatic and luxurious: warm golden edge lights on buildings and roads, cool reflections in the water, crisp metallic highlights on the central tower, and a deep black void surrounding the model. Style should feel like a photorealistic architectural visualization mixed with a premium collectible scale model, extremely intricate, sharp, polished, and elegant.

items.title: Gothic Android Warrior Cathedral Key Art
items.titleZh: A cinematic dark fantasy anime illustration in a ruined gothic cathedral, vertical composition. Show a lone female android-like warrior from behind, centered slightly low in frame, kneeling or sitting back on her heels on a reflective stone floor. She has extremely long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="silver white"} hair spreading across the floor and air, a sleek black blindfold visor covering her eyes, and a black high-cut gothic combat dress with elegant straps, long black opera gloves, and thigh-high black boots. Her physique is slim and graceful. She holds 1 large ornate sword upright in front of her, with both hands resting on the hilt, the blade planted on the ground like a memorial. The sword has a dark blade and a decorative gold ring-like guard near the handle. The atmosphere is solemn, tragic, and reverent. Place 3 tall pointed arched windows in the background, glowing with cold white backlight through haze and dust. Include 4 stone angel statues total: 2 larger angels in the left background and 2 in the right background, partially obscured by fog and darkness. Fill the air with drifting ash, snow-like particles, black debris fragments, and a few faint orange embers near the floor. Use dramatic volumetric light rays, soft bloom, smoky mist, high contrast, and a desaturated palette of charcoal gray, silver, blue-gray, and black. The scene should feel like a memorial after a battle, highly detailed, ultra-polished, melancholic, ethereal, and game key art inspired by {argument name="franchise title" default="NieR:Automata"}. Add 1 vertical Japanese title inscription near the lower left reading {argument name="vertical text" default="儚き夢と共にあれ"}, with 1 small vertical English subtitle beside it reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="NieR:Automata"}.

items.title: High-Fashion Editorial Portrait Prompt
items.titleZh:
A high-fashion editorial portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="woman"} in a {argument name="setting" default="minimalist studio setting"}. She is leaning slightly forward and tilting her head, creating a dynamic, asymmetrical composition. Her expression is neutral and confident, with a slightly intense gaze directed toward the camera.

She wears a structured, oversized {argument name="clothing" default="gray blazer"} with a subtle textured pattern over a soft white dress. Around her neck is a sheer black scarf that drapes loosely and flows downward, adding contrast and movement. Her hands are partially tucked into the blazer, with sheer black gloves visible.

Her hair is styled in a slightly messy, effortless updo with loose strands framing her face. She wears bold, modern silver earrings. Her makeup is natural and dewy, with softly defined eyes and neutral lips.

The lighting is soft and diffused, creating gentle shadows and a clean, editorial feel. The background is minimal, featuring smooth, light gray tones with subtle curved shapes that add depth without distraction.

The color palette is muted and sophisticated: gray, white, and black dominate the scene. The overall mood is elegant, contemporary, and slightly moody, resembling a luxury fashion magazine shoot. Style keywords: fashion editorial, minimalist, soft lighting, neutral tones, modern elegance, high detail, shallow depth of field, studio photography, cinematic composition.
items.promptZh:
一张{argument name="subject" default="woman"}在{argument name="setting" default="简约工作室环境"}中的时尚社论肖像。她微微前倾并倾斜头部，营造出动态、不对称的构图。她的表情中立而自信，目光略带强烈地看着镜头。

她穿着一件挺括的大廓形{argument name="clothing" default="gray blazer"}，上面搭配柔软的白色连衣裙，上面有精致的纹理图案。她脖子上围着一条透明的黑色围巾，宽松地垂下来，垂下来，增添了对比和动感。她的双手部分地塞进了西装外套中，露出了透明的黑色手套。

她的头发略微凌乱，随意地盘成高髻，松散的发丝勾勒出她的脸型。她戴着大胆、现代的银耳环。她的妆容自然水润，眼睛轮廓柔和，嘴唇中性。

灯光柔和且扩散，营造出柔和的阴影和干净、编辑的感觉。背景极简，采用平滑的浅灰色色调和微妙的弯曲形状，增加深度而不分散注意力。

调色板柔和而精致：灰色、白色和黑色占据主导地位。整体氛围优雅、现代，略显喜怒无常，就像一场奢华时尚杂志的拍摄。风格关键词：时尚社论、简约、柔和的灯光、中性色调、现代优雅、高细节、浅景深、工作室摄影、电影构图。

items.title: Alishan One-Day Travel Poster
items.titleZh: Create a vintage illustrated travel poster in traditional Chinese for {argument name="destination name" default="阿里山國家風景區"}, designed as a one-day itinerary infographic with a split vertical layout. The left panel is a parchment-textured itinerary card in warm beige with ornate gold Art Nouveau borders and dark brown typography, and the right panel is a dramatic painted fantasy-realism map scene of a mountain journey at sunrise and sunset tones. At the top of the left panel, large headline text reads {argument name="headline text" default="阿里山國家風景區一日遊"}. items.title: Luxury Minimalist Footwear Ad
items.titleZh: A hyper realistic luxury editorial advertisement for Nike, executed with a restrained, high-fashion aesthetic. A male leg is suspended mid-air at a precise 45-degree angle toward the camera, styled with immaculate white athletic crew socks featuring a subtle, tonal Nike logo. The composition is clean and intentional, with generous negative space. The sneaker occupies the lower half of the frame, positioned slightly off-center for a balanced editorial layout. The footwear is a premium Nike low-top silhouette with glacier teal suede overlays and off-white tumbled leather panels. The iridescent chrome Swoosh reflects soft, diffused studio lighting, creating a refined, mirror-like highlight without harsh glare. Shot with a shallow depth of field: the sneaker remains perfectly sharp, while the leg transitions into a soft, elegant blur. Background & Atmosphere: A deep matte charcoal background with a subtle gradient falloff. No visible graffiti or noise—only a faint, almost imperceptible texture to avoid flatness. A soft vignette gently draws focus toward the sneaker. Lighting: Soft, controlled, diffused lighting from camera-left. Low contrast compared to sports ads, but with precise highlight control. Gentle specular highlight on chrome Swoosh. Soft glow on white leather. Minimal shadow harshness. Studio-quality, fashion editorial lighting. Typography & Layout (Luxury Minimalism). Top center (very small, spaced serif): “PRECISION · FORM · MOTION”. Center-right headline (elegant hierarchy): “FORM” (ultra-bold, clean sans-serif), “IN MOTION” (thin, high tracking). Microtext (extremely subtle, small scale): “Engineered simplicity. Refined movement.” Graphic Style: No bright accent colors. No arrows or aggressive elements. No clutter. No zine-style overlays. Pure, editorial restraint. Bottom-left Lockup: “LESS, BUT BETTER.” (bold, minimal sans-serif). Subline (small, refined): “Every detail serves a purpose.” Branding: Upper right: Nike wordmark and Swoosh in soft white or light gray. Small, understated—never overpowering Finish. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography. Luxury fashion campaign aesthetic. Ultra-clean composition. 4K resolution. Vertical 3:4 aspect ratio. Optimized for premium digital campaigns and editorial placements
items.promptZh: 耐克的超现实奢华社论广告，以内敛、高级时尚的美学风格呈现。一条男性腿以与镜头成 45 度角的方式悬挂在半空中，脚上穿着完美的白色运动袜，上面印有微妙的同色调 Nike 标志。构图干净、有意，有大量的负空间。运动鞋占据了框架的下半部分，位置稍微偏离中心，以实现平衡的编辑布局。该鞋款采用优质 Nike 低帮廓形，配有冰川蓝麂皮覆盖层和灰白色滚花皮革镶片。虹彩镀铬 Swoosh 反射柔和、漫射的演播室灯光，营造出精致、镜面般的亮点，而不会产生刺眼的眩光。采用浅景深拍摄：运动鞋保持完美锐利，而腿部则过渡为柔和、优雅的模糊效果。背景和氛围：深哑光木炭背景，具有微妙的渐变衰减。没有可见的涂鸦或噪音，只有微弱的、几乎难以察觉的纹理，以避免平坦。柔和的小插图将焦点轻轻地吸引到运动鞋上。照明：来自相机左侧的柔和、受控、漫射照明。与体育广告相比对比度较低，但具有精确的高光控制。镀铬 Swoosh 上有柔和的镜面高光。白色皮革上发出柔和的光芒。最小的阴影粗糙度。工作室品质的时尚编辑照明。版式和布局（奢华极简主义）。顶部中心（非常小，间隔衬线）：“精确·形式·运动”。中右标题（优雅的层次结构）：“FORM”（超粗体、干净的无衬线）、“IN MOTION”（细长、高跟踪）。缩微文字（极其微妙，小尺寸）：“设计简单。精致的动作。”图形风格：没有明亮的强调色。没有箭头或攻击性元素。没有混乱。没有杂志风格的覆盖。纯粹的编辑克制。左下角锁定：“更少，但更好。” （粗体、最小无衬线）。副线（小而精致）：“每个细节都有其目的。”品牌：右上：Nike 字标和 Swoosh 为柔和的白色或浅灰色。小巧、低调——永远不会压倒Finish。逼真的高端商业摄影。奢华时尚运动美学。超洁净的成分。 4K分辨率。垂直长宽比为 3:4。针对优质数字营销活动和编辑展示位置进行了优化

monochromatic grayscale illustration, 3D rendered character, clean instructional reference sheet, 
white background, comic-style cell grid layout, technical diagram aesthetic

numbered cells from 1 to 16, consistent panel size

{argument name="character" default="young female dancer, athletic build, ponytail hairstyle, crop top and baggy pants, sneakers"}, same character in all panels

top-left: bold number badge + {argument name="title" default="Korean title text"}
center: full-body character pose illustration
bottom-left: {argument name="description" default="Korean description text (3-4 lines)"}
overlay: directional arrows indicating movement direction

[ARROWS / MOTION INDICATORS]
curved arrows, straight arrows, circular rotation indicators, 
placed around the character to show movement flow and direction

[RENDERING STYLE]
high detail 3D sculpt style, soft studio lighting, subtle shadows, 
no color, grayscale shading, clean linework, game concept art quality

[NEGATIVE]
no background scenery, no color tones, no extra characters, 
no cluttered backgrounds

Emphasize her exposed midriff, slim athletic build, glossy fabric rendering, delicate gold edging, and layered idol costume details. items.title: Anthro Idol Group Concert Poster
items.titleZh:
A polished anime idol concert key visual on a glowing stage staircase, featuring exactly 5 anthropomorphic performers posed in a dynamic diagonal formation under dramatic purple-blue concert lighting and sparkling spotlights. The scene is viewed from a slightly low, wide-angle perspective to emphasize depth and stage presence, with neon-lit steps leading upward and metal truss structures framing the background. At center back is a large illuminated crest with a pawprint inside a geometric star emblem, flanked by laurel motifs, suggesting an idol group logo. The floor and stair edges glow with violet and blue rim light, and tiny glitter particles plus a few gold confetti pieces float through the air. The mood is energetic, triumphant, and glamorous, like a promotional poster for a live performance.

The 5 performers are all kemonomimi or furry idol characters in coordinated fantasy-stage costumes with belts, chains, layered fabrics, fingerless gloves, and tailored accessories, each color-themed individually while sharing a unified group design language. From left to right: a gray wolf boy in a deep blue outfit, closest to camera, smiling confidently and reaching one paw forward toward the viewer; an orange fox boy in black, white, and orange, stepping forward with a playful grin and one hand extended; a gray-and-white wolf boy in black, white, and green, standing slightly behind center and pointing upward/outward; a white rabbit girl in black, white, and pink, with tall bunny ears, fluffy tail, short skirt layers, and one arm raised high in an idol pose; and a brown bear boy in navy and gold, turned mostly away in a cool over-the-shoulder stance with one arm extended sideways. All characters should have expressive anime faces, fluffy fur rendering, detailed tails and paws, and high-end polished illustration quality.

Give each outfit a distinct accent color: blue for the left wolf, orange for the fox, green for the center wolf, pink for the rabbit, and gold for the bear. Costumes should mix idol fashion with fantasy military stagewear: fitted jackets or vests, asymmetrical panels, short trousers or layered skirts, harness straps, metallic trims, hanging chains, decorative cords, and patterned fabric inserts. The characters should look like a cohesive idol unit named {argument name="group name" default="Pawlight"}. Use {argument name="stage lighting color" default="purple and blue"} as the dominant lighting palette, with bright white spotlights from above and subtle lens glow. Place {argument name="emblem design" default="a pawprint inside a star crest with laurel branches"} on the back screen. The overall style should be {argument name="art style" default="high-detail anime idol promotional illustration"}, and the atmosphere should feel like {argument name="performance mood" default="a climactic live show finale"}.

在发光的舞台楼梯上呈现精美的动漫偶像音乐会主视觉，在戏剧性的紫蓝色音乐会灯光和闪闪发光的聚光灯下，恰好有 5 名拟人化表演者以动态对角线姿势摆出姿势。该场景是从略低的广角视角观看的，以强调深度和舞台存在感，霓虹灯照亮的台阶通向上方，金属桁架结构构成了背景。背面中央是一个巨大的发光徽章，几何星徽内有爪印，两侧是月桂树图案，暗示着偶像团体的标志。地板和楼梯边缘闪烁着紫色和蓝色的边缘光，微小的闪光颗粒和一些金色的五彩纸屑漂浮在空气中。气氛充满活力，得意洋洋，魅力四射，就像现场表演的宣传海报一样。

5 名表演者都是 kemonomimi 或毛茸茸的偶像角色，穿着协调的奇幻舞台服装，配有腰带、链条、分层面料、无指手套和定制配饰，每个人都有单独的颜色主题，同时共享统一的团体设计语言。从左到右：一个身穿深蓝色服装的灰太狼男孩，距离镜头最近，自信地微笑着，向前伸出一只爪子朝向观众；一个身穿黑、白、橙三色衣服的橙色狐狸男孩向前走来，脸上挂着俏皮的笑容，伸出了一只手；一个灰白相间的狼童，身着黑、白、绿，站在中心稍靠后的位置，手指向上/向外；黑、白、粉红的白兔女郎，兔耳朵高高的，尾巴毛茸茸的，短裙层层叠叠，一只手臂高高举起，摆出偶像的姿势；还有一个穿着海军蓝和金色衣服的棕熊男孩，以一种冷静的过肩姿势，一只手臂侧向一侧，几乎转过身去。所有角色都应具有富有表现力的动漫面孔、蓬松的皮毛渲染、细致的尾巴和爪子以及高端抛光的插图质量。

为每件衣服赋予独特的强调色：蓝色代表左边的狼，橙色代表狐狸，绿色代表中间的狼，粉色代表兔子，金色代表熊。服装应将偶像时尚与幻想军事舞台服装相结合：合身的夹克或背心、不对称镶片、短裤或分层裙子、吊带、金属饰边、挂链、装饰绳和图案织物嵌片。这些角色应该看起来像一个有凝聚力的偶像单位，名为 {argument name="group name" default="Pawlight"}。使用 {argument name="stage lighting color" default="purple and blue"} 作为主要灯光调色板，上面有明亮的白色聚光灯和微妙的镜头发光。将 {argument name="emblem design" default="a pawprint inside a star crest with laurel trees"} 放在背面屏幕上。整体风格应该是{argument name="art style" default="高细节动漫偶像宣传插画"}，气氛应该是{argument name="performance Mood" default="a climatic live show Finale"}。

The woman on the left has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair tied in a high ponytail with loose bangs, and wears a fluffy brown fleece jacket, dark pants, and a red lanyard with an ID card. She sits in a low camping chair and leans forward, using chopsticks over a small bowl or food container in her hands. The woman on the right has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} shoulder-length hair and wears a muted purple hoodie layered under a black puffer vest, light gray sweatpants, and dark shoes. She sits in another low camping chair, resting her cheek on one hand in a relaxed, sleepy pose. Keep both faces obscured by a soft rectangular blur block, as if anonymized in a posted photo. Around them, include exactly 4 red beverage cans visible in the scene: 2 on the wooden table planks near the center, 1 cropped in the lower right foreground, and 1 farther back near the right side. Build a low U-shaped arrangement of 3 wooden bench planks surrounding the heater. Add small camping details: 1 olive duffel bag on the left ground, 1 plastic storage box with supplies behind the left woman, 1 white plastic shopping bag on top of the box, 1 small bowl on the table, 1 colorful snack package on the right-side plank, 1 soft brown cloth on the far left floor, and 1 black metal rack frame standing at the back right. items.title: Urban Alley Mural Artist
items.titleZh:
A cinematic, ultra-realistic night scene of a {argument name="artist" default="young male street artist"} painting a large-scale {argument name="mural subject" default="mural of a woman’s face"} in a {argument name="setting" default="narrow urban alley"}. The camera angle is slightly low, creating a dramatic, powerful perspective. The artist has medium-length, slightly messy dark hair and light stubble or a short beard, giving him a rugged, creative look.

He wears a loose white t-shirt and casual jeans, slightly oversized, with a relaxed streetwear vibe. His posture is focused and engaged as he stands close to the wall, actively spray-painting.

He is creating a massive, hyper-realistic mural of a woman’s face on a textured brick wall. The mural is incredibly detailed—smooth skin tones, realistic lighting, expressive eyes, and glossy lips—appearing almost like a photograph. Fine mist from the spray paint is visible in the air, catching light and adding motion and atmosphere.

The setting is a narrow urban alley at night, surrounded by tall buildings. The environment is gritty and textured—aged brick walls, paint splashes, subtle grime, and urban wear. Neon signs and distant streetlights cast vibrant reflections in teal, magenta, and blue tones, creating a cinematic, slightly cyberpunk mood.

Lighting is dramatic and layered: cool ambient light fills the alley, while warmer neon highlights create contrast. A subtle rim light outlines the artist’s silhouette, separating him from the dark background. The mural is partially illuminated, acting as a strong focal point.

Atmosphere includes light fog or mist, enhancing depth and making the lighting glow softly. The scene feels immersive, quiet, and artistically intense.

Depth of field is moderately shallow: the artist and mural are in sharp focus, while the background fades into soft blur with bokeh highlights.

Style: hyper-realistic, cinematic photography, street art aesthetic, ultra-detailed textures, high dynamic range, subtle film grain.

Camera details: 35mm or 50mm lens, f/1.8–f/2.8 aperture, low-light photography, slight low-angle shot, natural perspective.

Composition: vertical frame (4:5 or 9:16), subject slightly off-center, mural dominating the frame for strong visual storytelling.

items.promptZh:
电影般的超现实夜景，{argument name="artist" default="年轻男性街头艺术家"}在{argument name="setting" default="狭窄的城市小巷"}中绘制大型{argument name="mural subject" default="女人脸壁画"}。摄像机角度略低，创造出戏剧性、有力的视角。这位艺术家有一头中等长度、略显凌乱的深色头发和浅色胡茬或短胡须，使他看起来粗犷而富有创意。

他穿着宽松的白色T恤和休闲牛仔裤，略显宽松，有一种轻松的街头风格。当他靠近墙壁站着时，他的姿势是专注而专注的，积极地进行喷漆。

他正在一块有纹理的砖墙上创作一幅巨大的、超现实的女性脸部壁画。这幅壁画极其细致——平滑的肤色、逼真的灯光、富有表情的眼睛和光泽的嘴唇——看起来几乎就像一张照片。喷漆产生的细雾在空气中清晰可见，捕捉光线并增添动感和氛围。

背景是夜晚的一条狭窄的城市小巷，周围都是高楼大厦。环境充满坚韧和质感——陈旧的砖墙、油漆飞溅、微妙的污垢和城市磨损。霓虹灯标志和远处的路灯以青色、洋红色和蓝色色调投射出充满活力的反射，营造出一种电影般的、略带赛博朋克的氛围。

灯光引人注目且层次分明：冷色的环境光充满了小巷，而温暖的霓虹灯则营造出对比。微妙的边缘光勾勒出艺术家的轮廓，将他与黑暗的背景分开。壁画部分被照亮，成为一个强烈的焦点。

氛围包括轻雾或薄雾，增强深度并使灯光柔和地发光。场景让人感觉身临其境、安静且具有强烈的艺术气息。

景深适度浅：艺术家和壁画清晰对焦，而背景则淡入柔和的模糊状态，并带有散景高光。

风格：超写实、电影摄影、街头艺术美学、超细致纹理、高动态范围、微妙的胶片颗粒。

相机细节：35mm或50mm镜头，f/1.8–f/2.8光圈，弱光摄影，轻微低角度拍摄，自然透视。

构图：垂直框架（4:5 或 9:16），主题稍微偏离中心，壁画主导框架，以提供强烈的视觉叙事效果。

items.title: Japanese Horror Game Street Reflection
items.titleZh: A cinematic Japanese psychological horror game screenshot at night, shown from a third-person over-the-shoulder perspective behind a young man wearing a dark hooded jacket, standing under a convenience store awning and staring into a large front window. In the glass, instead of a normal reflection, there is a terrifying humanoid figure with an unnaturally elongated oval head, long straight black hair hanging down both sides, a pale expressionless face, and a dark coat, standing directly opposite him. Beyond the reflection is a wet urban street in Japan with glossy rain-soaked asphalt, sparse pedestrians holding umbrellas, dim storefronts, vending machines, parking signs, and tall buildings bending inward in a surreal warped perspective toward a dark swirling vortex in the sky at the end of the street. The convenience store window ledge displays exactly 5 visible magazine covers lined up side by side and exactly 8 instant food items or cup noodles stacked on the lower right. Add subtle in-game UI text in Japanese: exactly 2 objective lines in the upper left, and exactly 2 small action prompts in the lower left. Include readable Japanese street posters and shop signs, such as a large red staff recruitment sign on the upper right and a yellow points campaign sign on the lower right. items.title: Futuristic Animation Trade Magazine Cover
items.titleZh: Create a futuristic professional magazine cover for the animation industry, portrait orientation, high-end editorial design, cinematic and polished. The masthead dominates the upper left in huge bold white sans-serif letters split across two lines: {argument name="magazine title" default="FRAME RATE"}. Above it, a small yellow all-caps tagline reads: THE INDUSTRY TRADE MAGAZINE FOR ANIMATION PROFESSIONALS. Below the masthead, a smaller white subtitle reads: THE BUSINESS, TECHNOLOGY & ART OF ANIMATION. In the upper right, place issue text in stacked bold type: VOL. 23 in yellow and SUMMER 2026 in white. The cover image shows a stylized humanoid female-coded robot or digital mannequin in a dynamic running pose, facing right, shown full body, with one leg lifted behind and one arm extended. Her body is semi-transparent dark mesh with glowing orange internal joints, spine, and limb mechanisms, accented by blue and purple neon tracing lines and circular motion rings around wrists, ankles, hips, and feet. She has messy tied-up blue hair and a smooth simplified face with minimal features, like a CG character prototype. Set her in a dark animation studio interior with blurred monitors, desks, and concept art pinned in the background, lit with low moody ambient light so the neon figure becomes the focal point. Add reflective flooring beneath her with concentric holographic rings under both feet in green, yellow, and orange. On the left side, arrange editorial cover lines in a clean magazine layout. A small yellow label says COVER STORY. Below it, a large bold white stacked headline reads: {argument name="cover headline" default="PIPELINES THAT LEARN. STORIES THAT MOVE."}. Beneath that, a yellow subhead reads: HOW AI IS TRANSFORMING EVERY STAGE OF ANIMATION PRODUCTION. In the lower left, include 3 secondary article listings, each with a short yellow rule above it: 1) INBETWEENING 2.0, with small white teaser text: Inside the new generation of AI Inbetweening models changing the industry standard., and page number p. 24 in yellow. 2) CONSISTENCY AT SCALE, with small white teaser text: Maintaining character performance with AI-assisted interpolation., and page number p. 38 in yellow. 3) ARTIST ORCHARD, NOT REPLACEMENT, with small white teaser text: How top studios integrate AI tools while keeping artists in the loop., and page number p. 52 in yellow. Near the lower right, add a black circular badge outlined in yellow containing yellow and white text: WORKFLOW SPOTLIGHT on top, DreamFrame Studios on building a proprietary AI animation stack beneath, and p. 60 at the bottom in yellow. In the bottom right corner, place a white barcode box with pricing above it reading: US $12.99   EUR €14.99, plus small issue code numbers. Add reflective flooring beneath her with concentric holographic rings under both feet in green, yellow, and orange. On the left side, arrange editorial cover lines in a clean magazine layout. Beneath that, a yellow subhead reads: HOW AI IS TRANSFORMING EVERY STAGE OF ANIMATION PRODUCTION. Near the lower right, add a black circular badge outlined in yellow containing yellow and white text: WORKFLOW SPOTLIGHT on top, DreamFrame Studios on building a proprietary AI animation stack beneath, and p. 60 at the bottom in yellow. In the bottom right corner, place a white barcode box with pricing above it reading: US $12.99   EUR €14.99, plus small issue code numbers. items.titleZh: Using the provided reference image, transform the top-down RPG town map into a polished anime-style event illustration from a human eye-level perspective. Convert the 2 small sprite characters by the well into 2 full-size fantasy characters in the foreground: a silver-haired mage in a purple robe holding a staff, and a blonde elf in green-and-brown adventurer clothing, both leaning over and looking into the well. Add a cinematic JRPG feel with soft daylight, detailed painterly rendering, clean line art, and gentle depth of field. items.title: Shadow Assassin in Ruined Temple
items.titleZh: A cinematic dark-fantasy action scene inspired by {argument name="inspiration" default="Assassin's Creed"}, showing a single hooded assassin-like warrior suspended mid-leap inside a ruined ancient temple. The figure is centered, faceless in deep shadow beneath a tightly wrapped hood, wearing layered charcoal and black robes with ornate embossed patterns on the chest, shoulders, sleeves, and bracers, a wrapped waist sash, loose flowing trousers, and wind-whipped fabric tails. One arm is raised overhead gripping a curved blade, while the other arm extends outward for balance in a dynamic airborne attack pose. From the sweeping weapon and the fighter's movement, a massive ribbon of black smoke and shadow curls in a dramatic arc from the lower left foreground up around the character, like living darkness or ink in motion. items.title: Absurd Tabloid Panther Newspaper Front Page
items.titleZh:
A realistic, slightly humorous tabloid newspaper front page photographed from above on a wooden table, designed to look like a printed broadsheet with subtle paper texture, fold marks, and mild lens distortion. The masthead at top left reads “The Daily Metro”, the date line near the top center reads “Friday, April 22, 2005”, and the top-right section marker reads “CITY NEWS | 05”. A red banner near the upper left says “EXCLUSIVE STORY”. The dominant oversized black headline spans multiple lines: “Zoo Panther Caught Living Double Life – As a Charming Bar Hopping Casanova!” Below it, a large subheadline reads: ““Marquise” the Panther Escapes Zoo at Night, Spends Eveningsvlenlars, Becomes Heartthrob Among Lonely Women”. The page layout should mimic a sensational tabloid with 1 huge headline area, 1 large main photo on the upper right, 1 small inset photo under the main text on the left, 3 narrow text columns with dense newspaper copy in the center-left, 1 pull-quote box in the middle, 1 lower-left secondary story block with a panther portrait, 3 small bottom photo thumbnails in a row, and 1 right-side sidebar box titled “What’s Next For Mamquiss?”. Keep most body text tiny and partly nonsensical or pseudo-legible like AI-generated newspaper filler, but preserve the major visible headlines exactly.

The main photo on the upper right shows the back view of a glamorous blonde woman in a silky champagne-colored dress standing at a bar beside a large black panther upright on a stool or standing with forepaws elevated near the counter. The bar background contains many liquor bottles and glassware on shelves, warmly lit. The woman’s face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blur/block. The panther is sleek, glossy, and realistically rendered. The inset photo under the headline at left shows the black panther near a zoo exit or pathway sign at night. The lower-left portrait shows a close-up of the panther’s face. The 3 bottom thumbnails show nightlife scenes: the panther moving through a bar interior, the panther seated near two women at a small round table, and the panther lounging in dim warm light.

Use an early-2000s tabloid aesthetic, high-contrast black headline typography, off-white newsprint, red accent rules, narrow columns, and slightly messy authentic newspaper composition. The overall tone is deadpan absurdist journalism, realistic enough to glance as a real newspaper, with the page filling most of the frame and photographed in natural indoor light.
items.promptZh:
一张写实、略带幽默的小报头版，从上方在木桌上拍摄，设计看起来像印刷大报，具有微妙的纸张纹理、折叠痕迹和轻微的镜头畸变。左上角的报头写着“The Daily Metro”，靠近顶部中心的日期线写着“Friday, April 22, 2005”，右上角的部分标记写着“CITY NEWS | 05”。左上角附近的红色横幅上写着“独家故事”。占主导地位的超大黑色标题跨越多行：“动物园黑豹过着双重生活——作为一个迷人的酒吧跳卡萨诺瓦！”其下方有一个大副标题：“黑豹“侯爵夫人”夜间逃离动物园，共度夜晚，成为孤独女性中的万人迷”。页面布局应模仿耸人听闻的小报，其中有 1 个巨大的标题区域，右上角有 1 张大的主照片，左侧主文本下方有 1 个小插图照片，中间左侧有 3 个狭窄的文本列，其中有密集的报纸副本，中间有 1 个引文框，1 个左下带有黑豹肖像的次要故事块，3 个连续的小底部照片缩略图，以及 1 个标题为“下一步是什么”的右侧边栏框曼奎斯？保持大部分正文文字很小，部分无意义或伪清晰，就像人工智能生成的报纸填充物一样，但要准确保留主要的可见标题。

右上角的主照片显示了一位迷人的金发女郎的后视图，她穿着丝绸般的香槟色连衣裙，站在酒吧里，旁边是一只直立在凳子上的大黑豹，或者站在柜台附近，前爪举高。酒吧背景架子上摆着许多酒瓶和玻璃器皿，灯光温暖。女人的脸故意被矩形模糊/块遮挡。黑豹造型时尚、有光泽、渲染逼真。左侧标题下的插图显示夜间动物园出口或道路标志附近的黑豹。左下肖像显示了黑豹脸部的特写。底部的 3 个缩略图显示了夜生活场景：黑豹在酒吧内部移动，黑豹坐在小圆桌旁边的两个女人旁边，黑豹懒洋洋地躺在昏暗的温暖灯光下。

使用 2000 年代初期的小报美学、高对比度黑色标题排版、灰白色新闻纸、红色重音规则、狭窄的栏目和略显凌乱的正宗报纸构图。整体基调是冷漠荒诞的新闻主义，足够逼真，看起来就像一份真正的报纸，页面占据了大部分画面，并在室内自然光下拍摄。

items.title: Gothic Magical Swordswoman
items.titleZh: A hyper-detailed anime fantasy action illustration of a fierce young woman lunging toward the viewer with a glowing magical sword, shown in an extreme foreshortened low-angle perspective where the blade dominates the foreground and points straight at the camera. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long pastel pink"} hair streaming dramatically behind her in many windblown strands, bright {argument name="eye color" default="turquoise blue"} eyes, and a focused, determined expression. She wears an elaborate black gothic-lolita battle dress with layered ruffles, lace trim, corset shaping, detached lace sleeves or gloves, thigh garter details, and dark armored boots. Her outfit is accented with exactly 3 vivid blue roses: 2 in a black lace headpiece and 1 at the center of her chest. The sword is ornate and elegant, with a silver filigree guard and a luminous blue blade filled with glowing rune-like patterns. Surround her with multiple overlapping circular magic sigils, arcane rings, starfield particles, sparkling shards, and cosmic light trails in a {argument name="background palette" default="violet, indigo, and electric blue"} celestial backdrop. Add crystalline prism fragments and glittering highlights across the scene, with intense bloom, high contrast, intricate lace and fabric detail, and a polished premium gacha-game key visual look. The composition should feel dynamic, cinematic, and magical, as if {argument name="character name" default="a gothic magical swordswoman"} is mid-strike in an astral dimension.

items.title: Epic Fantasy Double-Exposure Poster
items.titleZh: A vertically oriented epic fantasy poster in the style of a prestige television series one-sheet, designed like a Chinese theatrical promotional poster for {argument name="franchise title" default="Game of Thrones"}. The composition is a dramatic double-exposure silhouette of a woman in left-facing side profile occupying most of the frame, her braided hair forming the crown and upper contour of the silhouette. Inside and around the silhouette, blend a vast dark medieval fantasy world with storm clouds, smoke, mountains, castles, dragons, armies, and fire. At the top inside the head area, place 1 grand stone city or castle complex glowing with pale golden light beneath turbulent clouds, and 3 dragons in the sky: 1 large dragon flying prominently on the upper right and 2 smaller distant dragons near the top edge. In the midsection, show 2 fur-cloaked heroic figures standing close together in a bleak winter atmosphere, one centered and one slightly left, with a looming iron-throne-like structure behind them. In the lower right interior, include 1 icy blue-eyed undead king emerging from darkness. Across the lower half, transition from cold mist and coastal water on the left into burning ruins and orange fire on the right, with 1 medium dragon flying near the center-lower area above the battlefield. Scatter tiny marching soldiers and riders along ridgelines and paths to imply war across the landscape. Use a muted palette of ash white, charcoal black, slate blue, steel gray, sepia, and ember orange, with cinematic high contrast, volumetric fog, painterly photo-collage realism, and intricate textured detail. Leave negative space around the silhouette on a warm off-white paper-like background. Add vertical Chinese slogan text along the upper left margin reading {argument name="vertical slogan" default="风暴降临前 传奇永不终结"}. Add a small English logo area on the left reading {argument name="series logo" default="GAME OF THRONES"}. Place a large Chinese title near the lower left reading {argument name="main title" default="冰与火之歌"}, with the English subtitle "A SONG OF ICE AND FIRE" beneath it. Add small credit text below for the novel author George R. R. Martin. Along the bottom, display 5 house sigils in a horizontal row with bilingual labels: Stark, Lannister, Targaryen, Baratheon, Tarly. Beneath them, add the tagline {argument name="bottom tagline" default="THE SEVEN KINGDOMS, ONE THRONE."}. Premium, moody, majestic, collectible poster design.

items.title: Anime X Battle Poster
items.titleZh:
Create a dramatic anime-style social media battle poster inspired by X/Twitter, split vertically down the center into two opposing halves with a glowing lightning-like divide and a huge luminous VS at the bottom center. The composition is a tall smartphone-optimized promotional key visual with dense layered UI cards, speech bubbles, tweet screenshots, reaction counters, and explosive energy effects. At the top center, place a large X logo with the title text "BATTLE" and the Japanese subtitle "Xでレスバ中". The left side is a cool purple and black theme, the right side is a hot red and white theme, with sparks, streaks, embers, and motion lines flying across both sides.

Show 2 anime schoolgirl characters facing off. On the left, a calm, composed girl representing logical rebuttal: long dark black-to-purple gradient hair, straight bangs, pale skin, slim build, black sailor-style school uniform with purple neck ribbon, pleated skirt, black knee socks, loafers, holding a smartphone in one hand and touching her glasses or temple with the other. Her face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blur mosaic over the central face area. Her stance is reserved and still. Surround her with purple glowing tweet cards and speech bubbles. Her display name and handle should appear repeatedly as "雲居モヤ @kumoi_moya". Include exactly 3 large quoted statement boxes on her side with these Japanese texts: "それ、前提が雑だよね。", "感情だけでは通らないよ。", and "論点、そこじゃない。". Also include exactly 5 smaller purple UI/comment elements on her side: 1) a small comment bubble reading "それな 千代先輩、強すぎ…", 2) a small comment bubble reading "論理的で草 完全に正論パンチ", 3) a like card reading "いいね! 12.8K", 4) a repost card reading "リポスト 9,341", and 5) a dark trend card reading "おすすめトレンド #モヤVSエナ 42,857件のポスト". Add a central dark smartphone tweet panel tilted slightly, showing her tweet with profile icon, name, handle, the text "それ、前提が雑だよね。", and counters "312", "1,204", and "8,745".

On the right, show an aggressive, fiery girl representing emotional counterattack and confidence: vivid red hair in a high messy side bun with long loose hair, bright teal eyes, fair skin, energetic expression, open shouting mouth, pointing directly toward the opponent with one hand while the other hand rests on her hip. She wears a white blouse, black jumper-style dress or vest dress, oversized red bow tie, white loose socks scrunched around the ankles, and black loafers. Surround her with red glowing tweet cards and notification-style UI. Her display name and handle should appear repeatedly as "緋空エナ @hisora_ena". Include exactly 3 large quoted statement boxes on her side with these Japanese texts: "ちゃんと読んでから言ってる!?", "正論ぶってるだけでしょ!", and "逃げてないで答えて!". Also include exactly 6 smaller red UI/comment elements on her side: 1) a top notification badge card reading "通知 99+", 2) a small comment bubble reading "エナちゃん つよすぎるww", 3) a small comment bubble reading "言いたいこと全部言ってくれる!", 4) a like card reading "いいね! 18.7K", 5) a like card reading "いいね! 23.6K", and 6) a repost card reading "リポスト 11.2K". Add a red tweet panel near the center showing her tweet with profile icon, name, handle, the text "ちゃんと読んでから言ってる!?", and counters "278", "1,652", and "10.9K".

In the lower middle area, place exactly 3 central dark interface cards bridging both sides: 1) a quote-post card labeled "引用ポスト" showing both users and the exchange "論点、そこじゃない。" and "正論ぶってるだけでしょ!", 2) a reply count card reading "返信 1,876件", and 3) a bottom navigation bar styled like the X mobile app with home, search, notifications, messages icons and a blue button labeled "ポスト". The overall aesthetic should be glossy, high-contrast, highly rendered anime illustration with neon edge lighting, intense backlighting, dynamic perspective, layered translucency, and a chaotic viral-internet argument atmosphere. Use crisp Japanese UI typography, dramatic red-vs-purple color contrast, and polished promotional-poster quality.

items.titleZh: A hyperrealistic premium denim advertisement shot in a dark, moody editorial style. A male figure wearing raw selvedge denim jeans is captured mid-stride against a near-black charcoal background, body angled diagonally at a bold 45-degree perspective toward the camera. The jeans feature a slim tapered silhouette with deep indigo wash, subtle thigh and knee fading, reinforced copper rivets catching ambient light, and clean off-white contrast stitching, dominating the lower two-thirds of the frame. The composition uses shallow depth of field with sharp focus on the denim texture and soft blur on the upper torso. The background is layered with subtle urban texture — faint graffiti strokes in electric yellow and muted olive, barely visible through a heavy dark vignette. Multiple rows of ultra-small all-caps typographic text orbit the figure at different angles reading phrases like "{argument name="slogan one" default="RAW. REAL. RELENTLESS."}" and "{argument name="slogan two" default="WEAR WHAT YOU'VE BEEN THROUGH"}" — some running vertically, some at 30-degree angles, creating a chaotic yet intentional graphic zine energy. At the upper right, a bold brand wordmark appears in clean white against the dark background. At the top center, a thin horizontal navigation-style text bar reads "AUTHENTIC FIT · LIVED-IN LUXURY · BUILT TO LAST" in spaced all-caps serif font. A large commanding headline is placed center-right — "{argument name="main headline" default="OWN"}" in massive ultra-bold white letters followed by "THE MOMENT" in lighter weight creating dramatic type hierarchy. Small yellow plus (+) symbols and diagonal arrows (↗) are scattered throughout as accent details. Bottom left features a bold slogan lockup: "DEFINE YOUR DENIM" in large bold sans-serif white text with a thin subline reading "An unapologetic reminder that style is a statement. Every crease tells a story." The overall lighting is dramatic and directional — a single cold key light from the left causing copper rivets to shimmer and deep indigo denim to glow with subtle sheen against the darkness. Close macro detail visible on the fabric weave texture near the knee fade. Photorealistic. Commercial photography quality. High contrast. 4K resolution. 3:4 vertical format optimized for social media.
