items.titleZh: A wide cinematic anime key visual of a bustling modern Tokyo-like district transformed into a multicultural fantasy metropolis under a bright blue midday sky with fluffy clouds. The scene is viewed from street level along a broad pedestrian avenue leading toward a large red torii gate at the center distance, with stone steps, crowds of people, dense commercial buildings, and a Japanese castle rising on a green hill behind the city blocks. A very tall broadcasting tower resembling Tokyo Skytree stands slightly right of center in the background. Fill the sky with exactly 8 airborne fantasy and sci-fi elements: 2 large dragons in flight, 2 winged humanoid angels, 1 huge flying saucer, and 3 smaller UFOs scattered farther away. The city should feel like a coexistence society where humans and fantasy races live together naturally. Add many colorful digital billboards and vertical signs on buildings, including Japanese text and fantasy character advertisements; the largest curved screen on the left should display the text “Shinpi Sekai 神秘世界 ようこそ,” and a lower billboard should reference a multicultural society of different races. In the foreground, place exactly 6 prominent characters across the street scene: on the far left, a tall elf schoolgirl with long brown hair, pointed ears, a white blouse, ribbon tie, and plaid skirt; left-center, a humanoid crocodile or lizard man in casual urban clothes with a jacket and pendant; near him, a small child with animal-like ears wearing a red backpack and scarf; center-left, a white-haired young man with white feathered wings in a light jacket; center-right, a silver-haired cat-eared schoolgirl in a light jacket and dark pleated skirt; right-center, a black-haired teenage boy in a black hoodie with a backpack; and on the far right, a blonde elf schoolgirl with pointed ears, white short-sleeve shirt, tie, and brown plaid skirt. In the midground and background, add a crowd of pedestrians including a few more fantasy species. Also include exactly 3 additional perched or elevated fantasy figures on the right side architecture: 1 dark-clad black-winged girl standing on a ledge, 1 small blonde fairy-like winged girl floating near a rooftop, and 1 tiny golden winged creature near the street. Style: polished high-detail anime illustration, light novel promotional art, sharp linework, vibrant colors, clean atmospheric perspective, crisp sunlight, soft shadows, highly detailed urban signage, a sense of wonder, coexistence, and worldbuilding.

The background is layered with subtle urban texture - faint graffiti strokes in electric yellow and muted olive, barely visible through a heavy dark vignette. Multiple rows of ultra-small all-caps typographic text orbit the sneaker at different angles, reading phrases like "{argument name="slogan" default="THE ONLY LIMITS ARE THE ONES YOU SET FOR YOURSELF"}" - evoking motion, speed, and energy. items.title: Anime Tunnel Driving Cockpit Scene
items.titleZh: A cinematic anime-style interior car scene viewed from the back seat over the shoulder of {argument name="driver description" default="a young woman with shoulder-length black hair"} driving through a dim urban tunnel at night. She grips a classic three-spoke steering wheel with both hands, left hand around 10 o’clock and right hand around 3 o’clock, wearing a wristwatch on one wrist and a thin bracelet on the other, with a loose light-colored shirt and rolled sleeves. The dashboard is a vintage sports car cockpit with 4 visible round analog gauges glowing warm orange-red, a retro radio console, metallic trim, and a manual gear shifter in the lower right foreground. Outside the windshield, show dense tunnel traffic with multiple cars ahead, red brake lights, harsh overhead tunnel lights receding into the distance, and rough concrete walls streaked with speed lines. Composition is wide and immersive, emphasizing the driver’s hands, steering wheel, and instrument cluster, with the driver’s face seen in partial side profile on the left edge. Render in gritty manga-inspired linework with heavy ink hatching, dark shadows, muted blue-gray and black tones, and warm highlights from the dashboard and tunnel lights. Mood is tense, focused, nocturnal, and stylish, like a dramatic street-racing or thriller anime frame.

items.titleZh: A minimalist luxury fashion advertisement poster for {argument name="brand name" default="GUCCI"}, editorial studio photography on a soft warm beige background with a clean high-end magazine layout. Show a stylish woman from about mid-thigh up in a three-quarter side profile facing right, with a short sleek black bob haircut, a single visible gold hoop earring, and her face intentionally obscured by a large vertical blurred rectangular block centered over the face. She wears a camel wool overcoat layered over a black turtleneck sweater and carries a classic designer shoulder bag tucked under her arm. The bag is beige canvas with a repeating monogram pattern, black leather trim and strap, and a prominent interlocking gold hardware emblem on the flap. Her pose is poised and refined, one hand lightly holding the coat and the other supporting the bag, conveying quiet luxury. Use soft diffused lighting, muted neutral tones, sharp fashion-editorial styling, premium texture detail in the wool coat, leather, canvas, and metallic hardware. On the left side of the composition, place the large serif wordmark {argument name="brand name" default="GUCCI"} in black with a small luxury-style emblem directly beneath it, a thin vertical divider line below, then the stacked tagline {argument name="tagline" default="TIMELESS ELEGANCE"} in small uppercase sans serif, and near the bottom left the season text {argument name="season text" default="FALL WINTER 2024"}. On the right edge, add oversized cropped abstract numeral-like graphic forms in a pale taupe tone as a background design element. Keep the overall composition clean, balanced, and sophisticated, like a luxury campaign poster or magazine cover.

items.titleZh: A gritty, realistic fitness lifestyle portrait of {argument name="subject" default="a male athlete"} leaning back against the ropes of an old-school boxing ring inside a worn vintage gym. He wears an oversized heather-grey pullover hoodie with the hood up, visible drawstrings hanging down, soft cotton texture, natural folds, and a front kangaroo pocket; black satin-like athletic boxing shorts with white trim and curved white piping near the hem; and white hand wraps on both hands, slightly frayed and loosely wound. His posture is relaxed but strong: both arms draped outward and resting on the ring ropes at left and right, shoulders open, torso square to camera, hands hanging naturally over the ropes. Hair is dark brown, short-to-medium length, slightly messy and visible under the hood at the forehead. The physique is natural and athletic with realistic proportions and understated muscle definition. The boxing ring shows exactly 3 visible rope colors: a red rope in the upper background, a pale grey-white rope crossing behind the hands and waist, and a dark blue rope across the lower foreground. Background is softly blurred with distressed beige walls, scattered vintage gym posters and banners, industrial wear, and dim training-space atmosphere. Lighting is soft natural indoor light mixed with ambient gym light, creating gentle shadows and a moody cinematic tone. Photorealistic texture, subdued earthy colors, shallow depth of field, high detail in fabric, wraps, skin, and ring ropes, editorial sports portrait style.

The person is located in the right third of the frame, with blurred foreground obstruction on the left, like a moment caught by chance from a street crowd or the edge of a car window. Bus stop signs, advertising lightboxes, lamp posts, and umbrella edges form clear vertical and diagonal lines to guide the eye. The ground has rain reflections, and distant car lights and neon are blurred into soft spots. items.title: Chaotic Fourth Crusade Parody Poster
items.titleZh: A chaotic fictional Japanese movie poster themed around world history, designed like a glossy blockbuster comedy-action epic about the Fourth Crusade getting completely lost and attacking Constantinople instead of reaching Jerusalem. The composition is dense, loud, and satirical, with a dramatic historical battlefield collage under a bright blue sky, flames, smoke, medieval ships, domes, city walls, and crusader armies. In the center foreground, a full-body medieval crusader in a dirty white tunic with a large red cross points directly toward the viewer, surrounded by four other medieval figures in ornate robes, hoods, helmets, and merchant-like clothing; their faces are obscured by soft rectangular blurs, making the poster look like a parody cast reveal. Across the top, huge hot-pink Japanese brush lettering reads {argument name="headline text" default="方向性、完全に迷子。"}, with smaller black Japanese tagline text above and below it. A torn vertical caption on the left side in bold yellow Japanese text explains that they meant to head for Jerusalem but somehow crush the Byzantine Empire. Two large parchment banners cross the upper middle area: one says that the original destination was Jerusalem, and the larger center banner declares in bold red Japanese text that the destination is Jerusalem, followed by smaller black text saying that was supposed to be the plan. On the upper right, a pinned parchment itinerary board contains a 5-step comedic route list with icons and arrows: departure, no money, bowing to Venice, lightly attacking Zara, then Constantinople, ending with a red line implying they somehow arrived there. Around the characters are exactly 8 speech balloons and callout labels: one saying “Eh, huh?”, one saying “No money…”, one saying “By order, let’s go.”, one saying “Slight detour.”, one saying “I failed, lol.”, one saying “Zara? We passed there!”, one label for a “contract” with a note that it is kind of expensive, and one pointing to Venice as a sponsor-like label. Additional wooden or parchment location signs label exactly 3 places: Zara, Venice, and Constantinople, with Japanese side notes identifying them as Christian or Byzantine cities. The lower half becomes darker and more catastrophic, showing a burning Byzantine-style city with a large domed church resembling Hagia Sophia, naval combat, collapsing architecture, orange firelight, and black smoke. At the bottom center, enormous distressed Japanese title typography in yellow and white announces the film as the Fourth Crusade and says Constantinople burns due to getting lost, with gritty texture, heavy drop shadows, and explosive blockbuster poster styling. On the right side of the title area, a red stamped burst says in Japanese that it begins around 1204. Along the very bottom is a narrow cast strip with exactly 6 small cast thumbnails labeled in Japanese, plus tiny fake credits running across the footer. In the bottom right corner, place a bright pink starburst badge with yellow and white Japanese text reading {argument name="badge text" default="史実です。信じられないけど。"}. Overall style: absurd historical parody, cinematic key art, Japanese theatrical poster, high detail, photobashed realism mixed with exaggerated graphic design, weathered paper textures, bold manga-like captions, comedic educational tone, epic war-movie energy.

She is mid-action, drinking from a chilled {argument name="beverage" default="Pepsi"} can, with visible condensation droplets emphasizing the heat and refreshment contrast. She has wireless earbuds in her ears, immersed in her own vibe.

Her face must closely match the provided reference image — accurate facial structure, skin tone, hairstyle, and expression — polished, natural, and visually appealing.

She is wearing a coordinated {argument name="outfit color" default="red"} outfit: a stylish crop top (half sleeves, ending above the belly) paired with a short skirt that extends to just above the knees. The outfit is modern, clean, and fashion-forward. She also wears a matching cap, adding a sporty street-style aesthetic.

The {argument name="beverage" default="Pepsi"} can is detailed with a crisp logo, metallic reflections, and condensation. Her interaction with it feels natural and candid, like a moment captured during a walk.

Composition is dynamic and lifestyle-oriented, with slight motion (hair movement, walking posture). Background softly blurred for depth, keeping focus on the subject.

Color grading: warm, summery tones balanced with the bold {argument name="outfit color" default="red"} outfit and cool blue of the {argument name="beverage" default="Pepsi"} branding for contrast.

Full moon in the center-top sky, purple nebula clouds, embers, ash, magical sparks, and a ruined gothic castle city on the right background. In the foreground, count 3 female elf warriors standing in a heroic triangular formation, all wearing ornate metallic armor with glossy magenta, silver, and violet tones. Center character: blonde elf princess-warrior, short to medium hair, small crown or jeweled tiara, white fur mantle over shoulders, polished silver armor exposing midriff, black gloves, confident battle stance, wielding a gigantic double-bladed ceremonial axe with intricate filigree, turquoise crystal core, and engraved silver-blue blades. Left character: taller elf archer-warrior with long light brown hair, pointed ears, elaborate rose-magenta armor, large curved fantasy sword in her right hand, and a quiver of pink-fletched arrows on her back. Right character: long dark magenta-haired elf swordswoman with floral hair ornaments, violet-magenta armor, black cape, holding a slender sword angled downward. The image should feel like premium box art for an original game titled {argument name="game title" default="ECLIPSE SAGA"}. items.title: Fantasy RPG Game Cover with Three Knight Women
items.titleZh: A dramatic Japanese fantasy action RPG PlayStation 5 game cover poster in a dark ornate high-fantasy style, vertically composed like premium key art. Show three armored warrior women standing heroically in the foreground against a glowing night battlefield and a towering gothic fantasy castle city in the distance, with fireworks, embers, magical light trails, and a star-filled purple-blue sky. The central figure is a blonde elf-like knight with pointed ears, a fur-trimmed collar, silver and gold armor, and a powerful stance, holding an enormous double-headed ceremonial battle axe angled across the lower half of the image; the axe is highly detailed with filigree silver metalwork, turquoise-blue crystal inlays, and an intricate engraved circular blade. On the left stands a second female knight with long dark crimson hair, metallic breastplate armor in steel and burgundy tones, and a sword held downward; behind her looms 1 giant black raven or crow with one glowing blue eye. On the right stands a third female knight with long light brown hair covering her eyes, pointed ears, and glossy magenta-pink armor with revealing fantasy plate design; a quiver of arrows is visible behind her shoulder. Include 2 red flying bird-like creatures or phoenixes in the upper right sky. The mood is epic, intense, and slightly gothic, with dense sparks, glowing particles, rim lighting, and lavish metallic reflections. Add an ornate thin gold border framing the entire cover. At the top left, place a small circular emblem and the text "O-prompt Laboratory". Along the right side, add vertical Japanese tagline text: "絆と力に、運命を斬り拓け". At the bottom center, place the game title in large embossed gold serif letters: "{argument name="game title" default="ELYSION"}", with a subtitle beneath in smaller serif capitals: "{argument name="subtitle" default="REBIRTH"}". Below that, add the Japanese subtitle text "エリシオン・リバース". At the bottom left, include a realistic Japanese age rating badge reading "CERO C" with small text "15才以上対象". Along the bottom, add the Japanese tagline "美しき騎士たちの、終わりなき戦いが今、始まる。" and beneath it the English line "THE ETERNAL BATTLE OF THE KNIGHTS BEGINS NOW.". Make it look like polished AAA console box art for a nonexistent fantasy game, ultra-detailed, cinematic, richly textured, high contrast, with the composition dominated by the three women and the oversized axe.

items.title: Traditional Japanese Buddhist Statue
items.titleZh: A {argument name="type of Buddhist statue" default="standing statue of Senju Kannon Bodhisattva"} reminiscent of ancient Japanese Buddhist sculpture. It features a serene and majestic atmosphere similar to the masterpieces housed in the {argument name="collection" default="Tokyo National Museum"}. A full-body frontal view with a slender and elegant physique, a soft and compassionate expression, half-closed eyes, and a gentle smile. It includes an exquisite crown, flowing celestial robes, and delicate jewelry. A large number of arms are arranged in an orderly radial pattern behind the back to strongly emphasize the symbolism of the Thousand-Armed Kannon. The hands may be based on 42 arms in accordance with actual sculptural traditions. It stands on a lotus pedestal with a halo behind. The material is primarily {argument name="material" default="wood carving"}, depicting historical textures such as lacquer, peeling gold leaf, weathered colors from aging, traces of original color, cracks, wear, and a sense of temple heritage. The overall design evokes Japanese Buddhist sculptures of the Heian to Kamakura periods, characterized by dignity, nobility, and religious solemnity. Like a professional photograph of a museum collection, the background is dark and subdued, highlighting the three-dimensionality and texture of the statue. Museum-grade, cultural asset-grade, ultra-high definition.
items.prompt: 日本の古仏彫刻を思わせる、{argument name="仏像の種類" default="千手観音菩薩立像"}。{argument name="所蔵元" default="東京国立博物館"}に所蔵されている名品仏像のような、静謐で荘厳な雰囲気。正面向きの全身像、細身で端正な体躯、やわらかく慈悲深い表情、半眼、穏やかな微笑。頭上に精緻な宝冠、流麗な天衣、繊細な装身具。背後には放射状に広がる多数の腕を整然と配置し、千手観音の象徴性を強く示す。手は実際の仏像表現に即して42臂を基調としてもよい。台座は蓮華座、背後に光背。材質は{argument name="材質" default="木彫"}を基調に、漆箔、金箔の剥落、経年による古色、わずかな彩色の残存、ひび、摩耗、寺院伝来の歴史ある質感を表現。全体は平安〜鎌倉期の日本仏像彫刻を思わせる、端正で高貴、宗教性あふれる、宗教的荘厳さに満ちた造形。美術館で撮影された収蔵品写真のように、背景は暗めで落ち着き、像の立体感と質感が際立つ。博物館級、文化財級、超高精細。

items.title: Anime McDonald's Recommendation Poster
items.titleZh: A vibrant Japanese fast-food promotional anime poster in a vertical layout, themed around McDonald's recommendations. The background is a bold red and white graphic design with golden sparkles, sweeping shapes, and energetic ad-style composition. In the upper left corner, show the McDonald's golden arches logo inside a red square. On the left half, feature a stylish anime girl with fox or wolf ears and a fluffy tail, shown from mid-thigh up, wearing a modern dark navy and black streetwear outfit with blue accents: cropped top exposing the midriff, layered jacket, belt, straps, and small decorative pins. Her hair is {argument name="hair color" default="dark purple"}, medium-length and tousled. Her face is intentionally obscured by a soft blurred rectangular censor block. She holds a large sesame-seed burger in her left hand and gestures invitingly with her right hand toward the food items. Across the top right, include large Japanese headline text reading 彩葉のおすすめ！マクドナルド, with a smaller black banner beneath it reading 食べたくなる定番メニューをチェック！. Arrange 4 numbered menu callouts in rounded white speech-bubble labels with red and yellow accents: item 1 is ビッグマック next to a Big Mac image near the center-right; item 2 is マックフライポテト next to a tall red fries carton on the right; item 3 is チキンマックナゲット next to an open nugget box containing exactly 6 chicken nuggets and a cup of red dipping sauce near the lower center-right; item 4 is てりやきマックバーガー next to a glossy teriyaki burger near the lower left-center. Also place a white McDonald's drink cup with ice and dark soda in the bottom left. On the right side, include 2 small informational badges stacked vertically: one badge with a sun and moon icon and Japanese text 朝は朝マック、夜は夜マックも楽しめる！, and one badge with a smartphone icon and Japanese text アプリでモバイルオーダーも便利！. At the very bottom, add a large bold Japanese slogan in white and yellow on a red banner: 今日はマックに行きたくなる！. Add tiny disclaimer text along the lower edge. The illustration style is polished, colorful anime key visual art mixed with commercial food photography rendering for the burgers, fries, nuggets, and drink; highly appetizing, glossy lighting, clean outlines, dynamic ad composition, and a cheerful promotional mood.

items.title: Anime KFC Princess Promo Poster
items.titleZh: A vibrant Japanese fast-food promotional poster in glossy anime advertising style, themed around KFC and a magical princess mascot. The composition is vertical and packed but still a single unified ad scene. At center-right, a cheerful young anime woman inspired by Princess Kaguya poses energetically toward the viewer with one hand reaching forward and the other arm lifted. She has long flowing golden-blonde hair, large sparkling amber-red eyes, a bright open smile, and ornate hair accessories including red floral ornaments, dangling beads, green ribbons, and a small gold crescent-moon crown. She wears a festive kimono-inspired outfit in coral red, soft pink, cream, and olive green with layered sleeves, floral patterns, decorative cords, bows, tassels, and a wide obi with a flower knot. Her hair and sleeves sweep dramatically as if caught in a lively breeze. In the lower left foreground, show 1 large KFC bucket overflowing with 4 pieces of crispy fried chicken, rendered extra crunchy, golden, juicy, and appetizing. Along the bottom foreground, include 3 side items: 1 chicken burger with sesame bun and lettuce, 1 small carton of fries, and 1 biscuit or pie-like pastry topped with glossy syrup. Use the KFC logo in the top right and on the bucket and fries carton, with the Colonel face partially censored by a rectangular blur on the bucket. Surround the scene with celebratory red-and-gold graphics, sparkles, brushstroke flourishes, and festive Japanese New Year-like motifs. Add large bold Japanese headline text at the upper left reading ケンタッキーの魅力 in thick red characters with white and gold outline. Add 2 white brushstroke callout bubbles on the left with red text: サクッと香ばしい！ and ジューシーで大満足！. Add a red flower-shaped badge on the right reading 今日のごほうびに. Add a red bottom banner with white text listing オリジナルチキン / バーガー / ビスケット. Extremely polished commercial illustration, high saturation, warm lighting, clean line art, glossy food rendering, energetic composition, premium poster finish.

items.title: Anime MOS Burger Promo Poster
items.titleZh:
A polished Japanese fast-food promotional poster in a bright anime-advertisement style, combining a fantasy princess character with clean product photography and cheerful branding. The composition is landscape and split visually: on the left, a full-body anime girl inspired by a moon-princess or bamboo-princess aesthetic stands in a welcoming pose with one hand extended toward the viewer and the other hand near her face. She has very long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white with pastel pink and lavender gradients"} hair, large expressive eyes, and an elegant floral-and-ribbon hair ornament in dark blue, gold, pink, and turquoise. Her outfit is a luxurious modernized kimono dress in white, teal, navy, and pink with translucent sleeves, floral patterns, layered obi bows, tassels, and gold ornaments, with a magical sparkling atmosphere around her. Behind her is a dreamy teal-and-cream background with soft circles, starry sparkles, faint floral motifs, sweeping decorative lines, and a subtle silhouette of a Japanese pagoda.

On the right is a neat food-ad layout for {argument name="brand name" default="MOS BURGER"}, with the red MOS BURGER logo at the top left corner and again at the bottom right. At the top center-right, place a green ribbon banner with the Japanese text "モスバーガー特集". Below it, add a large elegant handwritten-style Japanese headline: "行きたくなる、できたてのおいしさ。" with the middle phrase "できたて" emphasized in vivid pink-red while the rest is black. Under that, add a smaller subheadline in Japanese: "ヤチヨ風の幻想感 × モスのごほうびバーガー". 

Feature exactly 4 food items arranged horizontally across the middle-right, each rendered as appetizing semi-photorealistic product shots with soft shadows and crisp detail. Item 1: a classic burger with bun, thick meat patty, sauce, mayonnaise, and a large tomato slice, with a red circular badge reading "定番人気" and the label "モスバーガー" plus small Japanese descriptive text beneath. Item 2: a teriyaki burger with lettuce and glossy sauce, with a green circular badge reading "和風人気" and the label "テリヤキバーガー" plus small Japanese descriptive text beneath. Item 3: a white paper carton of onion rings with a yellow circular badge reading "サイドも最高" and the label "オニポテ" plus small Japanese descriptive text beneath. Item 4: a pink milkshake in a clear cup with straw, with a blue circular badge reading "ひんやり甘い" and the label "モスシェイク" plus small Japanese descriptive text beneath. 

Below the products, add a rounded rectangular recommendation box with a teal border and a teal ribbon title reading "おすすめポイント". Inside, include exactly 4 bullet points in Japanese with pink flower-like bullets, describing made-to-order freshness, the appeal of the classic meat sauce and tomato burger, the Japanese-style popularity of teriyaki burger, and that onion rings and shake are also must-try items. To the right inside the same lower area, include a smaller rounded box with line-art icons of cutlery, a drink, and a burger, plus Japanese copy that reads "モスのこだわり" and "おいしさは、まごころから。" followed by smaller explanatory Japanese text.

Across the bottom, place a large curved banner with a teal gradient and white center glow containing the Japanese slogan "今日はモスに寄り道しよう。" with "モス" highlighted in bold red. Near the lower right, add a small orange-red circular callout with Japanese text similar to "あなたのお気に入りがきっと見つかる!". Use a crisp commercial poster layout, vivid teal, aqua, white, pink, and gold accents, glossy food rendering, decorative sparkles, and a premium collaboration feel between anime fantasy illustration and modern restaurant advertising.

items.title: Japanese AI Product Landing Page Hero
items.titleZh:
Create a polished Japanese landing page hero image for a fictional premium consumer tech product brand called {argument name="brand name" default="DOKUMI"}. The page should look like a modern beauty-tech and food-safety product website, in a soft warm beige and ivory palette with elegant editorial styling, lots of whitespace, and subtle luxury cosmetics branding. Use a wide desktop web layout screenshot with a top navigation bar, a large left-aligned headline block, and a right-side lifestyle product photo composition.

The top header contains 8 visible navigation elements in a single row: the brand logo text "DOKUMI" at far left, then "ABOUT", "PRODUCT", "FEATURE", "INGREDIENT", "VOICE", "Q&A", then a small user account icon, and a rounded red call-to-action button labeled "今すぐ購入する" at the far right. Beneath the button area on the upper right, add a vertical red ribbon badge with white Japanese text reading exactly 4 stacked text groups: "発売記念", "限定", "20%", "OFF", plus small "CAMPAIGN" text below.

The hero section is split into two main columns. On the left, place a very large Japanese headline in elegant Mincho-style serif typography over three lines: "一口目は、", then "AIが先に。" with dramatic scale and generous spacing. Below it, add a smaller two-line Japanese subheading describing AI-based detection of food toxins, foreign substances, and allergens before eating, in a refined gray tone. Under that, place 2 horizontal CTA buttons: a filled red rounded button labeled "今すぐ始める" with a right arrow, and a white outlined rounded button labeled "詳しく見る" with a right arrow.

Below the buttons, add a row of 3 rounded white feature cards with thin borders and simple black line icons. The 3 cards are: 1) shield icon with title "AI画像解析" and a smaller subtitle about detecting toxins with high precision, 2) clock icon with title "3秒判定" and a smaller subtitle about instant results just by holding it up, 3) smartphone icon with title "スマホ連携" and a smaller subtitle about automatic history saving in the app.

At the bottom of the hero, add a row of 3 statistic cards with rounded corners and thin borders. The 3 cards read: 1) "累計販売台数※1" with large number "23,500" and smaller "台突破", 2) "満足度※2" with large number "94.3%", 3) "リピート率※2" with large number "81.2%". To the right of these cards, place 2 small footnote lines in Japanese: "※1 2026年4月時点 自社調べ" and "※2 2026年3月調査 N=180".

On the right side, create a soft, glamorous lifestyle photo scene. Show a stylish young woman with shoulder-length softly curled brown hair, fair skin, and a large red polka-dot bow headband. She wears an off-shoulder white ruffled blouse and rests her face lightly on one hand at a glossy tabletop. Her face is obscured by a centered rectangular skin-tone privacy block. In front of her on the table sits a sleek white handheld scanner device with a rounded vertical body and a small dark lens opening near the top rim accented in red. Next to the device is a realistic glossy red apple. Near the device, overlay a dark blue circular callout badge with white Japanese text reading "毒性チェック" and "わずか3秒", with a small plus sign beneath.

Use soft natural window light from the left, faint diagonal light streaks on the background wall, gentle shadows, realistic product rendering, and a premium e-commerce LP aesthetic. The composition should feel clean, aspirational, and slightly playful, like a startup landing page for an unusual AI gadget. Include all visible Japanese text exactly where specified.

items.title: Brutal Red-Kimono Manga Fight Page
items.titleZh: A gritty black-and-white manga action page with selective red color on the heroine’s clothing, arranged as 6 comic panels with dynamic diagonal borders on a white page. The central and largest panel shows a fierce young woman with long straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair and blunt bangs, wearing a short red kimono-style robe with a wide golden obi sash, barefoot, delivering a high vertical kick into a burly man’s face; her face is obscured by a soft square blur, and the impact explodes with ink splatter and debris. In the top-left panel, the same woman crouches low in a feral fighting stance on cracked ground, one hand touching the earth, hair streaming outward, robe open enough to show powerful legs. A narrow close-up panel shows only her intense eyes under straight bangs, cold and focused. In the bottom-left panel, she drives a straight punch into an attacker with a dramatic burst effect at the point of contact. In the bottom-center panel, she performs a rising kick or sweeping upward strike against another large male opponent, with speed lines and hair flowing. In the bottom-right panel, shown from behind, she stands calmly amid defeated men lying on the ground with smoke or dust rising around them, her long hair cascading down her back and the red robe hanging loosely. items.titleZh: A hand-painted vintage Chinese tourist food map poster in watercolor and ink wash style, shown from a bird’s-eye view over a misty mountainous county landscape. The composition is a stylized illustrated map of {argument name="place name" default="缙云"}, with pale rice-paper texture, soft beige background, green-gray mountains, winding rivers, country roads, old towns, scenic rocks, bamboo leaves, and pink flowers framing the corners. Large artistic Chinese calligraphy title at the upper left reads {argument name="headline text" default="缙云 山野美食暴走地图"}, with a small subtitle ribbon below reading “黄帝缙云·人间仙都”. Add a poetic text block on the left in Chinese: “山水缙云，仙都奇境 百味乡野，烟火人间 跟着美食，遇见缙云 一城山水，一口乡愁”. In the center is the main county town labeled “缙云县城”, surrounded by illustrated routes connecting scenic destinations and local dishes. Include exactly 12 numbered food stops, each with a realistic painted bowl or plate of food placed on the map near its location, with orange circular numbers and Chinese labels plus a short one-line description. The 12 stops are: 1 “河阳土爽面” with description “山野本味，宾客烟火”; 2 “笕川笋干菜” with description “时令山珍，晒干留香”; 3 “缙云烧饼” with description “炭炉焦香，卷云招牌”; 4 “敲肉羹” with description “鲜香软糯，地道乡味”; 5 “岩下炖汤” with description “石材慢炖，暖身养胃”; 6 “溪鱼鲜” with description “山水河鲜，鲜掉眉毛”; 7 “壶镇扁食/落菜” with description “古法胶味，越吃越香”; 8 “葛根豆腐” with description “山野清润，解腻爽口”; 9 “山粉饺” with description “皮薄馅足，山野风味”; 10 “苦槠豆腐” with description “山林珍味，自然本鲜”; 11 “农家焐年糕” with description “糯香浓郁，儿时味道”; 12 “老街米糕” with description “清甜米香，古法手工”. Mark exactly 8 place labels on the map: “新建镇”, “壶镇镇”, “大洋镇”, “仙都景区”, “河阳古民居”, “岩宕书房”, “蛟龙大峡谷”, and “缙云县城”. Paint recognizable scenic clusters with white-walled black-roofed traditional houses, steep karst peaks, bridges, and terraced terrain. Add a small legend box at the lower right with exactly 5 items labeled “山脉”, “河流”, “主要道路”, “乡镇”, and “景点地标”, plus a sixth food icon label “美食推荐”. Include a decorative compass rose nearby. Overall mood is elegant, artisanal, nostalgic, and premium, like a cultural tourism poster combining local cuisine guide and scenic map illustration, with highly polished composition and refined Chinese branding.

items.titleZh: A highly detailed anime illustration of a fashionable young woman on an elegant daytime outing in a European-style flower street, shown in a full-body to three-quarter standing pose. Her accessories include 1 black choker with a white flower ornament, 1 black armband on the upper arm, 2 white frilled wrist cuffs, 2 black garter straps, 2 sheer black thigh-high stockings with lace tops, and she carries 1 small black handbag. Her expression should feel delicate, elegant, and slightly shy, with one hand lifting a lock of hair and the other holding the bag. items.titleZh: 1. Design a modern tech-style poster for an "AI Agent tool launch," vertical 4:5 aspect ratio, with a clear and eye-catching main title and a subtitle explaining product value. Use a black, white, and gray color palette with fluorescent green accents. Include abstract networks, code windows, and agent nodes. The overall look should resemble a high-end SaaS launch poster, and text must be accurate and readable. 2. Generate a cover image suitable for an X/Twitter long-form post titled "2026 AI Tool Trends," horizontal 16:9 aspect ratio, with a clean and sophisticated style. Include the title and 3 keywords: Agent / Workflow / Automation. The background should be a combination of desktop workflows, browsers, terminals, and data panels, with a layout like a tech media header. 3. Generate an advertisement for a Web3 wallet security tool. The center of the image shows a phone displaying the wallet interface, surrounded by on-chain addresses, risk alerts, shield icons, and transaction path visualizations. The style should be professional and trustworthy, with the Chinese title: "Making every on-chain operation safer." 4. Create a Chinese infographic titled "The 5 Layers of AI Agent Capabilities," including: understanding tasks, calling tools, reading data, executing operations, and reviewing/optimizing. Show this in a clear hierarchical structure, each layer with a small icon, white background, and tech-blue accents. 5. Generate a one-page 4-panel comic strip about a creator going from manually searching for info, writing copy, and making images to completing the workflow automatically with an AI Agent. The style should be lighthearted and humorous, with consistent characters and short, clear Chinese dialogue. The last panel should highlight "double the efficiency." 6. items.titleZh: A high-end studio advertising poster for {argument name="brand name" default="crocs"}, in a monochrome pastel blue and white color palette, with a glossy reflective floor and a soft sky-blue backdrop. The background is dominated by the word {argument name="headline text" default="CROCS"} in gigantic bold white condensed sans-serif letters spanning nearly the full height of the image. In the top-right corner, add small white text reading "Designed with ChatGPT". Feature 3 adult women with shoulder-length wavy light brown to dark blonde hair, all wearing loose oversized white long-sleeve tops and flowing white wide-leg pants, styled as minimalist fashion models with relaxed neutral expressions. Their faces are intentionally obscured or blurred. One model reclines against an enormous upright white clog shoe on the left side, one model sits casually on top of a giant white clog on the upper right, and one model lounges on the floor at the lower right, leaning back on one arm while seated partly on a glossy blue sphere. Include 2 oversized white clog shoes as hero props: one standing vertically on the left showing the sole and side profile, and one angled on blue crystalline blocks at center-right showing the upper and toe box. Both clogs are classic foam slip-on style with perforation holes, chunky tread, heel straps, and circular logo rivets. The center-right clog is decorated with exactly 8 visible charms pinned to the upper: a blue-green iridescent round charm, a white daisy with yellow center, a black-and-white round emblem near the strap, a small "CROCS" word charm, a dark flower, a peace-hand sign, an orange smiley face, a white cloud, and an orange flower. Scatter exactly 7 glossy floating or grounded blue spheres of varying sizes around the set: one large sphere behind the left model, one medium sphere floating near center, one medium sphere at bottom left foreground, one medium sphere used as a seat under the lower-right model, one small sphere near the upper left, and 2 additional blue spheres integrated into the composition. Add translucent sculptural gel-like forms at the far left and far right edges, plus angular blue crystal-like rocks beneath the right shoe. At the bottom center, place white promotional copy in a clean sans-serif font: {argument name="tagline line 1" default="Made for comfort, worn for confidence."} on the first line and {argument name="tagline line 2" default="Because life feels better when your feet stop complaining."} on the second line. Beneath that, show 4 minimalist feature icons with labels in white: "ICONIC COMFORT", "LIGHTWEIGHT", "EASY TO CLEAN", and "UNIQUELY YOU". Place the {argument name="logo text" default="crocs"} logo in bold lowercase white at the bottom center with a small trademark symbol. The overall style should feel like a premium surreal fashion campaign, clean editorial lighting, soft shadows, glossy textures, airy composition, and modern lifestyle product advertising.

items.title: Klimt-Style Character Art
items.titleZh:
A vertical work (9:16) in the style of Gustav Klimt's Vienna Secession.

In the center, {argument name="character" default="Mona"} ({argument name="outfit" default="gold magical girl costume"}, brown short bob, banana-shaped tiara) is closing her eyes in a self-contained pose as if embracing.

Elements unique to Klimt:
- Replace all decorative patterns on clothing and background with gold geometric patterns using banana shapes as motifs
- Glowing gold decorations with a texture like real gold leaf
- Only the face and hands are realistic, everything else is a flat decorative pattern
- The background is a mosaic of black and gold swirls and banana shapes
- Dense collection of vortices, spirals, rectangles, and floral geometry
- Painterly texture, the feel of an oil canvas

In the lower right, a plaque-style text reading "{argument name="plaque text" default="MONA BANANA, 2026, Oil and Gold Leaf on Canvas"}."
A dignified piece indistinguishable from a real Klimt work.
items.prompt:
グスタフ・クリムト（Gustav Klimt）のウィーン分離派スタイルの縦型作品（9:16）。

中央に{argument name="キャラクター" default="萌奈"}（{argument name="衣装" default="ゴールド魔法少女衣装"}、茶色ショートボブ、バナナ型ティアラ）が抱擁するような自己完結したポーズで目を閉じている。

クリムト特有の要素：
- 衣装と背景の装飾パターンをすべてバナナの形をモチーフにした金の幾何学紋様で置き換える
- 本物の金箔を貼ったような輝く質感のゴールド装飾
- 顔と手だけが写実的で、それ以外はすべて平面的な装飾パターン
- 背景は黒×金の渦巻きとバナナ形のモザイク
- 渦・螺旋・矩形・花の幾何学が密集
- 絵画的なテクスチャ、油彩キャンバスの質感

右下に"{argument name="銘板テキスト" default="MONA BANANA, 2026, Oil and Gold Leaf on Canvas"}"の銘板風テキスト。
本物のクリムト作品と見紛う格調。

items.title: Pixel Art Bolirana Night Scene
items.titleZh: A moody retro pixel art scene inside a Colombian neighborhood bar at night, shown in portrait orientation from a first-person perspective. In the foreground, a human hand at the bottom center holds a small shiny metal bolirana ball between the thumb and fingers, aimed toward a full bolirana lane machine in the middle of the room. The machine is custom themed with The Simpsons and Duff Beer branding: a red and yellow wooden lane with a large circular scoring hole at the front edge, several smaller scoring holes arranged near the backboard, three upright metal pins or bumpers, a backboard logo that says "Duff," and the text "THE SIMPSONS" near the lower front. The top marquee of the machine says "Tomate tu" and has a built-in digital score screen showing exactly 3 player labels: "JUGADOR 1", "JUGADOR 0", and "JUGADOR 2" with colorful pixelated score graphics. To the left on the brick wall, include a large illuminated beer sign with the eagle logo and the text "AGUILA CERVEZA." On the right side, a young man in a dark hoodie and jeans stands in profile beside the machine, one hand in his pocket and the other pointing at the scoreboard, his face intentionally obscured or blurred. In the lower right foreground, place a small wooden table holding exactly 2 bottles: a tall bottle labeled "AGUARDIENTE AMARILLO MANZANARES" and a brown beer bottle labeled "AGUILA." items.title: Anime Theatrical Movie Poster
items.titleZh: A stunning anime theatrical movie poster in portrait format. Studio Ghibli meets Makoto Shinkai visual language. A teenage girl in a tattered white shrine maiden robe stands on the wing of a crumbling giant stone deity — an ancient colossus covered in moss and glowing golden kanji script, slowly falling through a sea of clouds. Her long black hair streams upward against gravity. She reaches one hand toward the sky where a vast celestial rift tears open the heavens — beyond it, an inverted ocean floats above the clouds, ancient wooden cities hanging upside down from its surface, lanterns drifting like stars. The sky transitions from deep twilight blue at the bottom to a luminous peach and rose gold at the top. Volumetric god rays pierce through cloud layers. Cherry blossom petals and torn paper talismans spiral everywhere. Her expression is calm determination. Art style: hand-drawn 2D animation, ultra-detailed background painting, expressive linework, rich cel shading. Palette: deep indigo, peach, rose gold, warm amber, soft white. Title in large elegant {argument name="language" default="Japanese kanji"} at the bottom with English subtitle beneath in a clean modern font. Tagline in small white italic text above the title. Mood: mythological, spiritual, bittersweet wonder. Theatrical release quality, Toho Films.

items.title: Hindi Poem Poster with Parashurama
items.titleZh: A vertically oriented literary poster in a muted sepia, ash, and parchment palette with dramatic gold kintsugi-style cracks running diagonally across the entire composition. The background is a soft textured paper and watercolor wash with smoky clouds, worn stains, and faint marbling. In the upper left, place a large faded monochrome portrait bust of an older Indian man in traditional formal attire, partially emerging from the mist like a historical figure or poet, softly blended into the background. In the upper right, set a small Hindi title line {argument name="headline text" default="परशुराम की प्रतीक्षा"} with a smaller author credit below it, elegant and understated. Beneath that, place one large centered Hindi quote in refined serif-style Devanagari, framed by oversized quotation marks, using the exact text {argument name="main quote" default="जब नाश मनुज पर छाता है, पहले विवेक मर जाता है।"}. In the lower half, create a heroic mythic Indian warrior standing on jagged black rocks, facing slightly left, with a powerful windswept stance. He has a bare muscular torso, long wild dark hair blown upward, and a tattered deep red drape wrapped across his body and trailing dramatically to the right in torn ribbons. He holds 1 large battle axe in his left hand, the blade angled downward, suggesting Parashurama. Surround him with dust, smoke, tiny debris, and painterly splashes. Add 2 vertical blocks of smaller Hindi poem text, one on the lower left and one on the lower right of the warrior, balanced like a printed poetry poster. Keep the poem text dense and readable but secondary to the central quote and figure. items.title: Japanese Space Conference Poster
items.titleZh: A polished Japanese event poster in a dramatic, aspirational sci-fi tourism style for {argument name="event year" default="2026"}, vertical layout, rich deep-blue space background blending into a bright daytime cityscape. At the top, outer space with a detailed Earth seen from orbit at upper left, a radiant sun flare at the planet’s edge, dense stars and faint nebulae across the sky. Large bold central Japanese headline text in white with subtle gold accents and a strong drop shadow: 「宇宙科学技術 連合講演会 {argument name="event year" default="2026"}」, with a smaller slogan above reading 「宇宙の未来を、ともに拓く。」. Surrounding the title, exactly 4 space elements: 1 lunar lander descending at left, 1 small satellite with blue solar panels near center-left, 1 larger satellite at upper right, and 1 white rocket launching vertically on the right with bright exhaust and billowing smoke. Add elegant golden orbital swoosh lines circling around the title and spacecraft. Below the title, place a gold badge reading 「宇科連」 and several centered lines of smaller Japanese descriptive text about Japan’s largest academic event for space science and technology, involving space science, JAXA space policy, space development startups, and comprehensive discussions on Japan’s space development strategy. The lower half transitions to a realistic panoramic view of Utsunomiya, Japan, with mountains in the distance and Mount Fuji-like snowy peak visible on the horizon, modern mid-rise city buildings, and a wide tram corridor. Feature a sleek modern yellow-and-black light rail tram prominently in the lower right foreground, angled toward the viewer, glossy reflective windows, destination sign reading 「宇都宮駅東口」, with overhead lines absent for a clean futuristic feel. Near the right midground behind the tram, include a large white satellite dish antenna facility. At the lower left, show a plated serving of exactly 6 golden-brown gyoza dumplings on a white dish with a small soy sauce dipping bowl in front; add a curved red Japanese label on the plate rim reading 「宇都宮餃子」. items.titleZh: Create a high-energy Japanese futuristic anime magazine cover in portrait orientation, designed like a glossy feature issue packed edge to edge with neon cyberpunk graphics. The composition is split into 5 sharp diagonal polygon panels outlined in black, each panel containing a different anime character portrait. At the top, place an oversized bold Japanese masthead reading {argument name="masthead text" default="次元交差"} in huge distressed white lettering with pink paint splatter and motion-streak accents, spanning almost the full width. Above it, add a small Japanese subtitle line in white. In the top right corner, design a magazine issue block with the words "FEATURE", a very large outlined "01", "VOL.", "MEMMODE", "2024 SPRING", and small Japanese text "創刊号" stacked in a clean editorial layout. The background should be dense with electric magenta, hot pink, cyan, blue, and black abstract streaks, halftone dots, glitch textures, floating plus signs, diagonal slashes, and light flares, giving a loud next-generation visual-culture feel. Show exactly 5 characters: 1) upper left panel, a handsome androgynous anime boy with messy layered silver hair, pale skin, black clothing with straps, zippers, layered necklaces, and a cool dark streetwear look; 2) upper right panel, a cute anime girl with light lavender-pink hair in twin braids, large magenta-violet eyes, a black cap labeled {argument name="cap text" default="MEMMODE"}, black X-shaped hairpins, and a black-purple outfit; 3) center panel, the main featured chibi-faced character with short white hair tipped with cyan and pink, one bright blue eye and one pink eye, wearing a glossy black cap and futuristic black outfit, looking directly at the viewer; 4) lower left panel, a serious anime boy with black hair and a bold white forelock, golden amber eyes, earrings, black hoodie and jacket layers, and blue neon rim lighting; 5) lower right panel, a softer feminine character with wavy blond hair under a dark cap, wearing a choker and holding a silver microphone near the chest, styled in pink-purple lighting. Make all characters highly polished, crisp, and vibrant, with large expressive eyes, sharp cel-shaded rendering, glossy highlights, and layered urban-tech fashion details. Add multiple editorial text blocks around the cover: on the left side a feature callout with Japanese text including "特集", a large stacked headline reading "交差する 5つの意志。", and two smaller Japanese lines below; a vertical side label reading "DIMENSION CROSS" and "MAIN"; a lower-left pickup box with "PICK UP", several Japanese lines, and 3 English hashtag lines such as "#IDENTITY #CONNECT #FUTURE", "#NEON #WILL #RESONANCE"; a bold page fraction "1/5 PAGE" at the bottom left; a bottom right focus box with "FOCUS" and small Japanese text; and a bottom-center Japanese tagline {argument name="bottom tagline" default="新たな物語の、はじまり。"}. items.title: Bold Potato Chips Advertising Poster
items.titleZh: Create a bold, high-impact commercial poster for a bag of potato chips in a bright warm orange-to-golden-yellow gradient background, with a dynamic snack-advertising layout and crisp studio lighting. The composition features one large open bag of chips in the lower right corner, tilted upward, overflowing with ridged golden potato chips, while exactly 9 clearly visible chips float around the upper and middle right area in midair with many small crumbs and seasoning flecks suspended for energy and motion. Use oversized distressed display typography stacked vertically on the left side reading exactly: “CRISPY.” on the top in dark reddish brown, “CRUNCHY.” in very large white letters, and “IRRESISTIBLE.” in saturated red-orange. Beneath that, place a dark brown brushstroke banner with handwritten cream script reading “Snack Happy!”. In the lower left corner, add one circular badge in red-orange with rough edges containing the text “MADE WITH REAL POTATOES” and smaller text “NO ARTIFICIAL FLAVORS”, plus 2 small potatoes illustrated at the bottom of the badge. Along the bottom edge, include exactly 3 simple white icon-and-text feature callouts separated evenly: “REAL POTATOES”, “NO ARTIFICIAL FLAVORS”, and “MADE FOR SNACK LOVERS”. The chip bag should be glossy metallic yellow with a large black irregular label shape on the front; inside it place the product name in big distressed white letters “{argument name="brand name" default="ZESTY"}” and below it a red banner with white text “{argument name="product type" default="POTATO CHIPS"}”, then smaller black text near the bottom right reading “{argument name="tagline text" default="BOLD FLAVOR. PERFECT CRUNCH."}”. Add a small rounded brand label in the upper left corner with the text “{argument name="headline brand" default="Pollo AI"}” and “GPT Image 2” beneath it. Emphasize appetizing texture, crunchy edges, realistic salt and seasoning specks, strong contrast, subtle grunge texture on the typography, and a polished modern supermarket-poster aesthetic ready for print or social promotion.

items.titleZh: Create a hyper-dynamic commercial poster for a {argument name="product name" default="X-SUGAR"} energy drink, in a high-contrast neon sports-advertising style. Use a vertical poster layout with a dark electric-blue and black background, dramatic lighting, rain droplets, motion streaks, lightning, and liquid splash effects. The centerpiece is one oversized aluminum can tilted diagonally to the right, floating above a glowing splash impact. The can is matte black with water condensation, a metallic silver rim, a bright lime-green pull tab, and a huge jagged X logo in lime green and electric blue across the front. On the can, include the text "EXTREME ENERGY" near the top rim, the main brand name "{argument name="product name" default="X-SUGAR"}", the subtitle "ENERGY DRINK", the flavor line "{argument name="flavor text" default="CITRUS BLAST"}", the phrase "NATURALLY FLAVORED", and the size "16 FL OZ (473 mL)". Behind and around the can, show explosive blue and neon-green liquid splashes, electric arcs, glowing particles, and speed energy trails. In the top left, place a small brand mark reading "Pollo AI" with "GPT Image 2" beneath it. Across the upper left to center, add a huge brush-lettered headline in layered colors: "{argument name="headline text" default="UNLEASH YOUR ENERGY"}", with "UNLEASH" in acid lime, "YOUR" in white, and "ENERGY" in vivid electric blue, all in rough painted typography. Under the headline, add the slogan "POWER. FOCUS. DOMINATE." with the three words colored lime, blue, and orange. In the top right, place an angled lime-green sticker with black text reading "NEW EXTREME FORMULA". On the left side, add one slanted dark feature panel with the heading "FUEL YOUR EVERY MOVE" and exactly 3 feature bullets with icons: 1) a yellow lightning bolt icon with "EXPLOSIVE ENERGY", 2) a blue target icon with "SHARP FOCUS", 3) an orange running figure icon with "MAXIMUM PERFORMANCE". On the right side, add exactly 3 standalone circular icon callouts stacked vertically: 1) yellow lightning icon with "MORE ENERGY MORE YOU", 2) blue brain icon with "MENTAL CLARITY ALL DAY", 3) orange flexed arm icon with "BUILT FOR CHAMPIONS". At the bottom left, include a silhouetted male runner sprinting forward with green, blue, and orange speed trails behind him. Along the bottom edge, show a futuristic city skyline with glowing windows reflected on a wet street surface. Add a bright lime brushstroke banner at the bottom with the text "RISE ABOVE. STAY UNSTOPPABLE." Overall mood: aggressive, exhilarating, powerful, premium fitness marketing, ultra-polished product poster, precise text rendering, crisp print-ready composition.
items.promptZh: 为{argument name="product name" default="X-SUGAR"}能量饮料制作一张超动态的商业海报，采用高对比度霓虹灯运动广告风格。使用具有深电蓝色和黑色背景、戏剧性灯光、雨滴、运动条纹、闪电和液体飞溅效果的垂直海报布局。中心装饰是一个向右对角倾斜的超大铝罐，漂浮在发光的飞溅冲击上方。罐子呈哑光黑色，带有水凝结，金属银色边缘，明亮的石灰绿色拉环，正面有一个巨大的锯齿状 X 标志，采用石灰绿和电蓝色。在罐头上，包括顶部边缘附近的文字“EXTREME ENERGY”、主要品牌名称“{argument name="product name" default="X-SUGAR"}”、副标题“ENERGY DRINK”、风味线“{argument name="flavor text" default="CITRUS BLAST"}”、短语“NATURALLY FLAVORED”和尺寸“16 FL OZ (473 mL)”。在罐子的后面和周围，展示了爆炸性的蓝色和霓虹绿色液体飞溅、电弧、发光粒子和速度能量痕迹。在左上角放置一个小品牌标记，上面写着“Pollo AI”，其下方带有“GPT Image 2”。从左上角到中间，添加一个巨大的分层颜色的毛笔标题：“{argument name=”headline text”default=”UNLEASH YOUR ENERGY”}”，其中“UNLEASH”为酸性石灰，“YOUR”为白色，“ENERGY”为生动的电蓝色，所有字体均采用粗糙的彩绘字体。在标题下添加口号“力量、聚焦、统治”。上面写着石灰、蓝色和橙色这三个词。在右上角，放置一个有角度的石灰绿色贴纸，上面写着黑色文字“NEW EXTREME FORMULA”。在左侧，添加一个倾斜的深色功能面板，标题为“为您的每一步加油”，并且恰好有 3 个带有图标的功能项目符号：1) 带有“爆炸能量”的黄色闪电图标，2) 带有“锐利聚焦”的蓝色目标图标，3) 带有“最大性能”的橙色跑步人物图标。在右侧，添加 3 个垂直堆叠的独立圆形图标标注：1) 带有“MORE ENERGY MORE YOU”的黄色闪电图标，2) 带有“全天思维清晰”的蓝色大脑图标，3) 带有“BUILT FOR CHAMPIONS”的橙色弯曲手臂图标。左下角有一位男性跑步者的剪影，他向前冲刺，身后有绿色、蓝色和橙色的速度轨迹。沿着底部边缘，展示了未来的城市天际线，发光的窗户反射在潮湿的街道表面上。在底部添加明亮的石灰笔触横幅，上面写着“崛起。保持不可阻挡。”整体情绪：进取、令人兴奋、强大、优质的健身营销、超精致的产品海报、精确的文本渲染、清晰的可打印构图。

items.title: Moody Vintage Bedroom at Night
items.titleZh: A moody cinematic photograph of a small old-fashioned bedroom at night, viewed from bedside height. In the left foreground, a worn wooden bed with a dark headboard is covered by a faded patchwork quilt, with exactly 2 stacked floral pillows near the head of the bed. The walls are stained, cracked, and aged plaster in warm ochre tones, giving the room a lived-in, slightly neglected feeling. On the upper left wall hangs 1 framed vintage street-scene print, and near the center wall hangs 1 dark shoulder bag from a hook. Beside the bed is a small wooden nightstand lit by 1 warm glowing table lamp with a round shade, casting soft amber light and deep shadows across the room. On the tabletop sit exactly 5 visible objects: 1 red cylindrical tin, 1 small boxy container, 1 shallow cup or ashtray, 1 small round alarm clock, and the lamp itself. Beneath the nightstand is an open shelf with clutter. On the right side, a tall old window with dark wooden panes shows a deep blue nighttime exterior with a few distant blurry lights; the curtain is thin, worn, and partly drawn. On the windowsill are exactly 3 visible objects: 1 tall ceramic bottle, 1 dark glass bottle, and 1 vintage silver-and-black radio cassette player. At the lower right is 1 small stool or low table draped with newspapers, with more papers stacked underneath. The lighting should be low-key, tungsten warm indoors against cool blue night outside, with heavy film grain, soft focus, rich shadows, nostalgic realism, subtle dust, and the atmosphere of a quiet, lonely apartment from the late 1970s or 1980s.

items.title: Vintage Chinese General Store Interior
items.titleZh: A nostalgic cinematic photograph of a small old-fashioned Chinese general store interior, shot from customer eye level with a slightly wide framing. Warm sepia and amber tones, soft window light from the left, subtle film grain, faint vignette, and a slightly hazy vintage look. Behind a long dark wooden-and-glass display counter stands 1 shopkeeper, a woman with a short black bob haircut wearing a plain white short-sleeve blouse, shown in side profile while working with her hands at the counter. The store feels authentic, modest, and lived-in, like the late 1970s to 1990s. On the right side, a black vintage sewing machine sits on an upper shelf with a handwritten price sign in Chinese beside it reading “768元”. Behind it are shelves packed with small colorful product boxes and tins. On the wall hang 1 large vertical handwritten price list in Chinese calligraphy and 2 old paper calendars or posters. The foreground glass cases display many old packaged goods: stacks of colorful tins and jars, several rectangular illustrated tins, 2 enamel wash basins with floral patterns, and multiple pairs of plain white canvas shoes arranged side by side on the bottom shelf. The left side of the frame shows bright wooden-framed windows and more countertop clutter, creating strong contrast between sunlight and the dim interior. Emphasize realistic documentary photography, richly textured wood, aged surfaces, retro packaging design, quiet everyday atmosphere, and a composition that leads the eye from the woman at center-left to the sewing machine and shelves at upper right.

items.title: Candid Bedroom Lounge Photo
items.titleZh: A candid, softly lit lifestyle photograph of a young woman lounging on a white bed in a minimal bedroom, shot vertically with a slightly wide lens from near her knees so her legs and oversized top dominate the foreground. She is lying on her back diagonally across the bed, wearing an oversized dark navy or black sweatshirt and very short light blue denim cutoff shorts with frayed hems, with bare legs visible in the foreground. Her arms are raised above and around her head in a relaxed, sleepy pose, one wrist bent loosely, and her face is mostly obscured by her arms and angle, giving an unposed, intimate feeling. Place the bed against a pale gray wall, with rumpled white bedding and large white pillows. On the left side near a window with sheer curtains, include a freestanding clothing rack holding exactly 8 visible hangers with neutral-toned clothes in black, white, beige, and gray, plus one blue garment draped over the top bar. On the right side behind the bed, include exactly 7 upright books lined on a narrow surface against the wall. items.title: Cyber DJ Beneath a Red Monolith
items.titleZh: A moody vertical concert-stage illustration in a dark futuristic painterly anime style, showing a lone electronic musician or DJ performing on a small platform. The performer stands centered behind a folding table, wearing an oversized black hoodie, loose dark pants, and heavy dark shoes, with a glossy black robotic helmet featuring one bright circular blue lens in the middle of the face. One arm is raised dramatically upward toward a massive floating red square panel hanging above the stage, while the other arm rests near the table. The background is filled with thick red and black smoke clouds, creating a dramatic backlit atmosphere with deep crimson glow and heavy shadows. On the table are 5 visible gear elements: an open dark laptop in the center, a white boxy speaker or computer unit on the left, a pair of headphones on the right, a small audio device near the white unit, and a glowing red drink can at the far right edge. Around the stage are 6 additional visible elements: a microphone stand to the left of the performer, a keyboard or piano edge entering from the far left, 2 stacked equipment boxes or amps under and beside the table, a patterned oriental-style rug covering the platform floor, and multiple loose black cables snaking across the stage. Show only the visible parts of him clearly: short dense tightly curled gray hair with silver highlights, both ears visible, a slender aged neck, and the upper torso in a charcoal gray blazer over an open-collar off-white dress shirt with no tie. Compose the image in a vertical portrait crop from mid-chest upward. Place him on a realistic New York City rooftop with exact visible details including 1 weathered HVAC unit on the left foreground, 1 cylindrical rooftop water tower on the right midground, 2 prominent Art Deco skyscrapers in the background resembling the Empire State Building on the left and the Chrysler Building on the right, plus low brick buildings, rooftop pipes, vents, railings, and soft atmospheric haze. Characters should be based on internet research of actual historical figures, with their features emphasized to look like characters in a period drama. To avoid rejection by video generation services, do not include sexual expressions, violence, or elements similar to existing works. The image quality should be a realistic photo from a 1980s live-action Japanese film. Conceive a storyboard and generate 8 landscape images (16:9 aspect ratio) for each shot from Start frame to End frame for Seedance 2.0. n=8. Be bold and comedic, using close-ups effectively. 1980s Japanese cinema look, shot on 35mm motion picture film. Photochemical texture, organic grain, subtle halation, soft highlight roll-off, slightly lifted blacks, realistic contrast, no digital sharpness, no HDR. Use a 35mm cinema camera with vintage spherical prime lenses. Inside the card, place a cute minimalist gaming logo: on the left, a stylized handheld game console icon drawn as a rounded rectangular device stacked over 2 visible offset layers like pages or cards, with a small ribbon bookmark hanging from the bottom edge. The console body is coral red with cream screen details, thin dark brown outlines, and tiny dark brown controller symbols: 1 cross-shaped D-pad on the left, 4 small circular buttons on the right, plus 4 tiny decorative dots in the center forming a smiling playful face impression. To the right of the icon, place the lowercase brand wordmark {argument name="brand name" default="gamelist"} in thick rounded geometric sans-serif letters, colored coral red to match the icon. Keep the spacing balanced so the icon and text read as one cohesive modern startup logo. Use a soft, friendly, vector-only aesthetic with no gradients, no photorealism, no texture, and high SVG-friendly simplicity. The palette should be limited to 4 colors: {argument name="primary color" default="coral red"}, cream, dark brown, and warm light beige. Show 4 small vertical thumbnail variations aligned along the right side of the dark interface, each showing the same logo on slightly different light neutral backgrounds. Add subtle UI framing only: a circular gray Edit button at bottom left of the large preview card, a circular gray share/upload button at bottom right of the card, and small monochrome action icons below the card on the dark background. Overall composition should look like a screenshot of an AI image generation result showcasing an app logo concept.

items.title: Vintage Roaring Tiger Japanese Poster
items.titleZh: Create a bold vintage Japanese-inspired poster on a square canvas with a fierce front-facing tiger head as the single central subject, perfectly symmetrical and filling most of the frame. The tiger is roaring with its mouth wide open, showing long curved ivory fangs, smaller lower teeth, a vivid pink tongue, a dark throat, a pink nose, intense yellow eyes, and dramatic black stripes over saturated orange fur with white cheek and neck fur. Add ornamental swirling stripe patterns on the forehead to give the face a stylized mythic look. Use a gritty retro screenprint or risograph texture with visible grain, worn ink, slightly distressed edges, and a limited palette of burnt orange, black, cream, white, muted pink, and small accents of yellow. The background should be a flat textured orange-red field. In the top right, include 1 small technical diagram panel showing a side-view tiger skeleton in thin cream line art with compact vertical Japanese annotation text beneath and beside it, like a pseudo-scientific label block. In the bottom left, include 3 vertically stacked icon boxes with thin cream borders: the first contains a heart icon with the label 心, the second contains crossed bones with the label 力, and the third contains three claw marks with the label 本能. Across the bottom center, place 2 very large cream-colored Japanese kanji characters with heavy black drop shadows and a rough hand-cut block print feel: 猛獣. Keep the overall composition aggressive, iconic, poster-like, centered, and highly graphic, blending traditional Japanese poster aesthetics, tattoo flash energy, and vintage animal anatomy chart styling.

items.title: Pink Surreal Wall Street Fashion Scene
items.titleZh: A surreal fashion editorial photograph on a city street modeled after Wall Street, shot from a slightly elevated front-facing angle in a tall vertical composition. The entire environment is nearly monochrome white and pale gray, with only selective pink accents standing out vividly. In the foreground, a faceless {argument name="person" default="adult man"} stands in the middle of a crosswalk wearing a crisp white suit, white shirt, {argument name="tie color" default="pink"} tie, and glossy {argument name="shoe color" default="pink"} dress shoes, holding 1 pink balloon in his right hand and 1 pink briefcase in his left hand. To his left, 1 surreal pink giraffe emerges vertically from a round manhole in the street, wearing a white top hat and a white collar with a pink tie, smiling playfully. Behind him in the center-left lane stands 1 pink alpaca or llama dressed in a white suit with a pink tie, and perched on its head is 1 small white cat wearing a tiny pink accessory, posed upright and looking forward. The street is lined with tall classical stone buildings, repeated columns, storefront windows, rows of identical potted shrubs, and multiple pale luxury cars and taxis receding into the distance. Include visible Wall Street-style street signs near the upper left corner. The road surface, cars, buildings, and sky should all be bleached white-gray for a dreamlike high-key look, while the pink elements remain saturated: the giraffe, the alpaca, the balloon, the briefcase, the tie, and the shoes. Style: whimsical surrealism, luxury editorial photography, immaculate symmetry, soft overcast light, clean cinematic realism, uncanny yet elegant atmosphere, ultra-detailed textures, shallow facial detail on the human with the face intentionally obscured or blurred.
items.promptZh: 一张超现实的时尚社论照片，拍摄于模仿华尔街的城市街道上，采用高垂直构图，从稍微抬高的正面角度拍摄。整个环境几乎是单色的白色和浅灰色，只有选择性的粉红色调脱颖而出。前景中，一个不露面的{argument name="person" default="adult man"}站在人行横道中央，穿着清爽的白色西装、白衬衫、{argument name="tie color" default="pink"}领带和光面的{argument name="shoe color" default="pink"}正装鞋，右手拿着 1 个粉色气球，左手拿着 1 个粉色公文包。在他的左边，一只超现实的粉色长颈鹿从街上的一个圆形沙井里垂直出现，戴着白色高顶帽子，穿着白色领带，打着粉色领带，俏皮地微笑着。在他身后的中左车道上，站着一只粉红色的羊驼或美洲驼，穿着白色的西装，系着粉红色的领带，头上栖息着一只戴着小粉红色配饰的小白猫，笔直地向前看。街道两旁是高大的古典石砌建筑，重复的柱子，店面的橱窗，一排排一模一样的盆栽灌木，多辆苍白的豪华轿车和出租车驶向远方。在左上角附近包括可见的华尔街风格的街道标志。路面、汽车、建筑物和天空都应该漂白成白灰色，以获得梦幻般的高调外观，而粉红色元素保持饱和：长颈鹿、羊驼、气球、公文包、领带和鞋子。风格：异想天开的超现实主义，豪华的社论摄影，完美的对称，柔和的阴光，干净的电影现实主义，神秘而优雅的氛围，超详细的纹理，人脸的浅面部细节，故意遮挡或模糊。

items.titleZh: Create a hyper-realistic {argument name="poster type" default="fashion poster"} for “{argument name="brand" default="SPLASH"}” featuring the same girl from the reference image (keep her face 100% identical). She is sitting confidently on a glossy, liquid-style 3D {argument name="brand" default="SPLASH"} logo with water splash effects. One leg relaxed, one bent, strong editorial pose. items.title: Netflix-Style Vibe Coder Poster
items.titleZh: A cinematic parody streaming-poster in vertical 2:3 format, styled like a dark Netflix original teaser poster for a humorous AI programming drama. At the very top, small white text reads {argument name="top banner text" default="A NETFLIX ORIGINAL"}. Centered and dominating the composition, huge glowing sci-fi sans serif title text in icy white with a faint lavender-blue neon bloom reads {argument name="title text" default="VIBE CODER"}, stacked on two lines. Below it, smaller white text says "STARRING" and beneath that a pink cast name in bold all caps reads {argument name="cast name" default="HUNKINS"}. The scene shows a dim moody programmer bedroom or office at night lit by monitors and purple-blue neon. In the center foreground, a plush teddy-bear-like mascot with white fuzzy paws sits slouched in a black desk chair wearing a black hoodie, face mostly hidden in shadow for a mysterious comedic look. On the hoodie chest, 4 lines of small off-white text read exactly: "// SHIP IT", "// VIBE CHECK", "// NO BUGS", "// JUST VIBES". In front of the character is an open laptop covered with 4 visible stickers: "vibe > spec", "DON'T THINK JUST PROMPT", a smiley face sticker, and "Claude 3.5", plus an abstract AI-style logo sticker. Behind the laptop are 2 widescreen monitors displaying dense code on dark themes. The background includes 2 wall notes/signs on the left: a sticky note reading "IDEAS > PLANS" and, on the right, a whiteboard with 3 stacked handwritten lines reading "BUILD FAST", "BREAK THINGS", "ASK AI", and a fourth line "REPEAT" beneath, plus a hand-drawn smiley. Next to the whiteboard is a pink-purple neon </> code icon sign. On the desk at lower right sits a matte black drink can with pink text reading "FOCUS (optional)" and a cardboard pizza box edge labeled "ITERATE LATER". Use rich shadows, soft practical light, purple and cyan rim light, subtle monitor glow, shallow depth of field, high contrast, glossy premium poster finish, and a slightly absurd, self-aware startup-comedy tone. At the bottom, centered white tagline text reads {argument name="tagline text" default="HE’S NOT A PROGRAMMER. HE’S A VIBE CODER."}, with the word "VIBE" highlighted in pink. Below that, a release line in white and red reads {argument name="release line" default="ONLY ON NETFLIX | COMING SOON"}, with "NETFLIX" in bold red. Make it look like a polished official teaser one-sheet for a fictional streaming series.

items.title: Mobster Cats Playing Poker
items.titleZh: A cinematic, ultra-detailed noir-style scene of 7 anthropomorphic domestic cats gathered around a round green felt poker table in a dim, smoky backroom bar. The central cat is the boss: a serious tabby wearing a dark pinstripe suit, white shirt, tie, black fedora, and black sunglasses, calmly smoking a thick cigar with dramatic smoke curling upward into the overhead lamp. Around him sit 6 other cats, each holding playing cards and dressed like underworld gamblers: on the far left a gray tabby in a textured flat cap and round dark sunglasses; next a ginger cat in a dark fedora, chunky gold chain, and dark glasses; to the right of center a fluffy gray cat in a brown fedora; further right a white-and-tabby cat in a dark New York Yankees baseball cap and pendant necklace; in the near right foreground a striped cat in a fedora and sunglasses seen in profile; all styled as mobsters. The table is crowded with exact poker details: 7 cats total, each with cards in paw, multiple stacks of red, blue, white, and black poker chips, scattered US dollar bills, a short whiskey glass in the front right, and 5 community cards face up in the middle. Use warm amber overhead lighting from a single large hanging lamp, deep shadows, richly textured fur, realistic whiskers, reflective sunglasses, and dense atmospheric cigar smoke. Background should be a dark wood-paneled gambling den with framed vintage posters and signs including a large poker poster on the left and an "ALL IN OR FOLD" sign on the right, plus bottles on shelves. Composition is eye-level and slightly wide-angle, centered on the smoking cat, with a gritty, luxurious gangster mood, photorealistic, dramatic depth, high contrast, and filmic color grading.

She wears a retro-futuristic armored bodysuit with glossy materials: a silver and black skin-tight jumpsuit, bulky red shoulder armor, red forearm guards, a red belt with a large rounded hip pouch, red knee-high armored boots, and white gloves. Her chest armor is metallic silver with red trim and a single circular blue orb on the right side of the chest, with small vent-like details and a mechanical collar ring around the neck connected to two short gray cables resting on the shoulders. She holds a matching red, white, blue, and black full-face helmet in her left hand at thigh level. Her hair is {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"}, medium length, slightly messy, tied back loosely with strands falling around the face. The character’s face is intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur. items.title: Dancing Couple on Cliffside House
items.titleZh: A dramatic vertical cinematic photograph of a weathered wooden house jutting out from the edge of a steep cliff, with a small balcony suspended over empty space. The house is old and dilapidated, made of gray, sun-bleached planks with warped boards, broken or dark window openings, and fragile angled wooden supports underneath the balcony. Dense green vines and foliage climb the cliff and partially frame the upper left side of the image, while the rock face drops sharply downward through most of the composition. On the balcony stand exactly 2 people: a formally dressed couple posed as if ballroom dancing. The man wears a dark suit or tuxedo and faces the woman with one arm raised in dance position; the woman wears a flowing {argument name="dress color" default="deep red"} evening gown, her hair styled up, and she mirrors his pose. The balcony railing is thin and rustic, emphasizing the dangerous height and precarious setting. The sky is pale blue-gray and overcast, with faint hazy mountains visible in the far lower right background. Use a realistic photographic style, moody natural light, high detail in the aged wood and cliff textures, a sense of vertigo and surreal elegance, and a composition that places the house in the upper left and the couple near the upper right edge of the structure.

items.title: Occult Cyber-Gothic Collage Poster
items.titleZh: A dark occult cyber-gothic collage poster in vertical format, dense and layered like a ritualistic noir album cover, with a distressed black, sepia, bronze, and deep crimson palette. Combine analog decay, glitch textures, scanned paper, technical schematics, surveillance graphics, sacred geometry, and fragmented photomontage into one unified composition. On the right side, feature a large aged human skull in profile, highly detailed, weathered, and partially overlaid with circles, target marks, sigils, thin grid lines, and red diagram annotations. Near the upper center, place a mysterious woman with long dark hair and pale skin, wearing a low-cut black garment, posed sensually with one hand raised near her face; behind her head, add a large dim red halo ring. On the left upper quadrant, include the draped back or shoulder of a pale classical-statue-like figure, ghostly and fragmentary. In the lower middle-right, place a dark-skinned ritual figure or priestess wearing layered beads, necklaces, and ceremonial adornment, partially obscured by texture and collage interference. In the lower right, show one worn cloth doll or voodoo-style rag figure hanging or suspended, with visible seams and outstretched limbs. In the bottom center, depict a rainy night street scene with 1 lone trench-coated figure walking away under dim lights and 1 car parked or idling on the wet road, reflections glowing red on the pavement. In the lower left, add a faceted black pyramid or crystal-like geometric form emerging from darkness. Scatter exactly 7 visible Latin text blocks throughout the design, styled as aged serif typography and cryptic inscriptions: "IN SOMNIIS VERITAS; IN DESIDERIIS, PERDITIO.", "ANIMA SINE FINE VAGAT, IN UMBRIS SUI IPSIUS INVENTA.", "PASSIO EST CLAVISTRA", "EGO SUM QUI NUNQUAM FUI.", "III FRAGMENTUM INFINITUM.", "COR AMAT; MENS DUBITAT; ANIMA LACERATUR.", and "IN VINO VERITAS IN SANGUINE REDEMPTIO". Add small UI-like microtext, barcode fragments, tiny charts, occult emblems, crosshair symbols, and illegible data panels across the entire image. The composition should feel oppressive, esoteric, cinematic, and surreal, with heavy texture, layered transparency, subtle red accents, chiaroscuro lighting, and a premium dark-art poster finish.
items.promptZh: 垂直格式的黑暗神秘网络哥特式拼贴海报，密集且分层，就像仪式性的黑色专辑封面一样，采用仿旧的黑色、棕褐色、青铜色和深红色调色板。将模拟衰减、故障纹理、扫描纸张、技术原理图、监视图形、神圣几何学和碎片蒙太奇组合成一个统一的构图。右侧是一个大型老年人类头骨的轮廓，非常详细，风化，部分覆盖有圆圈、目标标记、印记、细网格线和红色图表注释。在上中心附近，有一个神秘的女人，有着长长的黑发和苍白的皮肤，穿着一件低胸的黑色衣服，一只手举到脸附近，摆出性感的姿势；在她的头后面，添加一个大的暗红色光环。在左上象限，包括一个苍白的古典雕像般的人物的后背或肩膀，幽灵般且支离破碎。在右下方，放置一个深色皮肤的仪式人物或女祭司，戴着分层的珠子、项链和仪式装饰品，部分被纹理和拼贴干扰遮盖。右下角展示了一个破旧的布娃娃或巫毒风格的布娃娃，悬挂或悬挂着，有明显的接缝和伸展的四肢。底部中央描绘了雨夜的街景，1 个穿着风衣的孤独人物在昏暗的灯光下走开，1 辆汽车停在或闲置在潮湿的道路上，人行道上的倒影发出红色的光。在左下角，添加一个多面的黑色金字塔或从黑暗中出现的水晶状几何形状。在整个设计中散布 7 个可见的拉丁文本块，风格为古老的衬线排版和神秘的铭文：“IN SOMNIIS VERITAS; IN DESIDERIIS, PERDITIO.”、“ANIMA SINE FINE VAGAT, IN UMBRIS SUI IPSIUS INVENTA.”、“PASSIO EST CLAVISTRA”、“EGO SUM QUI NUNQUAM FUI.”、“III FRAGMENTUM” Infinitum。”、“COR AMAT；MENS Dubitat；ANIMA LACERATUR。”和“IN VINO VERITAS IN SANGUINE REDEMPTIO”。在整个图像中添加类似于 UI 的小型缩微文本、条形码片段、微小图表、神秘标志、十字准线符号和难以辨认的数据面板。构图应该给人压抑、深奥、电影般和超现实的感觉，具有厚重的质感、分层的透明度、微妙的红色调、明暗对比照明和优质的黑暗艺术海报效果。
