items.titleZh: A dramatic black-and-white ink-wash wartime illustration in a vertical composition, combining realistic World War II imagery with abstract splattered brushwork on a mostly white background. Show 4 soldiers total advancing from the left toward the center and distance: 1 large foreground soldier seen from behind on a rocky ledge, wearing a steel helmet, heavy pack, and carrying a rifle with bayonet, plus 3 smaller soldiers in a staggered line behind him moving toward the right. In the sky, show 5 warplanes flying overhead through thick smoke. On the right side, place a steep rocky island or coastal cliff with a ruined fortress or castle on top, with smoke rising around it. Below, depict a rough sea crashing against dark rocks and a narrow shoreline with tiny landing figures near the water. Use explosive black ink splashes, soot clouds, scratches, drips, and painterly debris to merge the soldiers, cliffs, and surf into one expressive composition. High contrast monochrome, misty atmosphere, desaturated grayscale only, cinematic and haunting, with lots of negative space and a fine-art concept-art feel.

items.titleZh: A cinematic fantasy poster in the style of an epic medieval throne-room drama, showing a modern woman seated confidently on a dark iron sword throne. She is centered in a full-body portrait, sitting with one leg crossed over the other and both arms resting casually on the throne arms, projecting relaxed queenly confidence. She has long, wavy {argument name="hair color" default="blonde"} hair falling over her shoulders, and wears contemporary casual clothing instead of period costume: a fitted long-sleeve {argument name="top color" default="deep burgundy"} shirt, dark blue skinny jeans, and black ankle boots. The throne is massive, jagged, and forged from overlapping weathered swords, filling most of the background. The setting is a dim, moody royal hall with warm firelight, soft glowing candles, faint sparks or embers in the air, and two vertical banners in the distant background bearing a red three-headed dragon-style sigil. Use dramatic, high-contrast lighting, rich dark metallic textures, warm orange highlights, and a polished premium fantasy-poster look. Add faint handwritten-style text near the upper left arc of the throne reading {argument name="name text" default="LAREENA STARKER"}. At the bottom, add large ornate metallic-gold title typography in a fantasy serif style reading {argument name="main title" default="BABE"} on the first line, smaller centered "OF" below it, and {argument name="subtitle" default="THRONES"} in very large letters across the bottom, with the O stylized as a circular emblem with vertical bars. Vertical poster composition, symmetrical framing, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, regal but playful modern parody of an iconic fantasy throne poster.

items.title: Ethereal Buddhist Pure Land scene
items.titleZh:
The Western Paradise (also known as the Western Pure Land, Sukhavati) is the Buddha-land of Amitabha (Infinite Life Buddha). Its core characteristic is the absence of all suffering and the experience of only joy, in stark contrast to our 'enduring' (Saha) world. Located in the west of our world, ten trillion Buddha-lands away (Amitabha Sutra).

Main Buddha: Amitabha Buddha (Infinite Light, Infinite Life), who constantly preaches the Dharma; flanked by Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva and Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva, collectively known as the 'Three Sages of the West'.

Land Environment: Adorned with Seven Treasures, flawless.
Ground: Gold as the ground, flat, soft, bright, and clean, without mountains, rivers, ravines, thorns, or stones.
Seven Treasure Ponds and Eight Merit Waters: Seven treasure ponds everywhere (gold, silver, lapis lazuli, crystal, tridacna, red pearl, agate). The water possesses eight merits: sweet, cold, soft, light, clear, fragrant, thirst-quenching, and heart-nourishing. Golden sand at the bottom, seven-treasure pathways, and lotuses in the pond as large as wheels, emitting blue, yellow, red, and white light.
Architecture: Seven-treasure pavilions, palaces, and lecture halls, floating in the air, changing size at will, transparent and bright, countless times better than the heavenly realms.
Precious Trees and Heavenly Music: Seven rows of trees, seven rows of railings, seven rows of nets, all made of four treasures. The wind blows through the trees and nets, producing subtle Dharma sounds like hundreds of thousands of instruments playing together, naturally leading listeners to mindfulness of Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha.
Climate and Heavenly Rain: No heat or cold, no wind or rain, always mild and comfortable; Mandarava flowers rain down from the sky six times a day and night, fragrant and colorful.
Marvelous Birds: White cranes, peacocks, parrots, Kalavinkas, etc., all manifested by the Buddha to produce harmonious sounds proclaiming the Dharma.

Sentient Beings: No suffering, only joy, infinite lifespan.
Rebirth: Beings are born from lotus flowers in the seven treasure ponds, not from parents, free from the suffering of birth, aging, sickness, and death.
Appearance: Purple-gold bodies, majestic and solemn, similar to Amitabha Buddha; possessing five supernatural powers: heavenly eye, heavenly ear, telepathy, past-life recall, and spiritual travel, free and unobstructed.
Lifespan: Immeasurable kalpas, nearly eternal, without early death or aging.
Nature: All are superior good people, free from greed, anger, ignorance, jealousy, or conflict; compassionate, equal, wise, and pure, constantly hearing the Dharma.
Life: Clothing and food manifest naturally without labor; in the morning, one can visit ten trillion Buddha-lands to offer to Buddhas and return by mealtime.

Time and Space: Infinite and Eternal.
Time: No day or night, no months or years, eternal happiness; the world does not undergo the changes of formation, existence, decay, and void.
Space: Vast and boundless, never crowded even with beings from all ten directions; a single grain of dust can contain three thousand great worlds.
items.prompt:
西方极乐世界（又称西方净土、安乐国），是阿弥陀佛（无量寿佛）的佛土，核心特点是无有众苦、但受诸乐，与我们这个 “堪忍”（婆婆）世界形成鲜明对比。
在我们世界的西方，距离十万亿佛土之遥（《阿弥陀经》）。

佛主：教主阿弥陀佛（无量光、无量寿），常住说法；左右胁侍为观世音菩萨、大势至菩萨，合称 “西方三圣”。

国土环境：七宝庄严，完美无瑕
大地：黄金为地，平坦柔软、光明洁净，无山川沟壑、荆棘土石。
七宝池与八功德水：
遍地七宝池（金、银、琉璃、玻璃、砗磲、赤珠、玛瑙）。
池水具八功德：甘、冷、软、轻、清、香、饮时、饮已，能除烦恼、润身悦心。
池底金沙，阶道七宝，池中莲花大如车轮，青、黄、赤、白，各放光明。
建筑：七宝楼阁、宫殿、讲堂，浮空而起、随心大小，光明通透，胜过天界无数倍。
宝树与天乐：
七重行树、七重栏楯、七重罗网，皆四宝所成。
风吹宝树罗网，出微妙法音，如百千乐同时俱作，闻者自然生念佛、念法、念僧之心。
气候与天雨：无寒暑、无风雨，永远温和舒适；昼夜六时，天雨曼陀罗花，缤纷铺落，香气芬芳。
奇禽：白鹤、孔雀、鹦鹉、迦陵频伽等，皆佛变化所作，出和雅音，宣说佛法，令众生常生善念。

众生：无苦唯乐，寿命无量
往生方式：众生由七宝池莲花化生，非父母胎生，无生老病死之苦。
身形：紫磨金色身，相好庄严，与阿弥陀佛相似；具天眼、天耳、他心、宿命、神足五通，自在无碍。
寿命：无量无边阿僧祇劫，几乎永恒，无夭折衰老。
心性：皆是诸上善人，无贪嗔痴、无嫉妒争斗，人人慈悲平等、智慧清净，常闻佛法、不退菩提。
生活：衣食自然化现，不需劳作；清晨可赴他方十万亿佛土供养诸佛，食时即返，自在无碍。

时间与空间：无限永恒
时间：无昼夜、无年月，永恒安乐，世界无 “成住坏空” 之变。
空间：广大无边，十方众生尽往亦不拥挤；一微尘可纳三千大千世界，事事无碍。

items.title: Corporate Cash Private Jet Satire
items.titleZh: A photorealistic satirical airport tarmac scene in daylight, shot vertically, showing a sleek white private jet parked with its door open and stairs visible on the left. On the side of the jet, large clean corporate lettering reads “Google | ANTHROPIC”. In the foreground, 2 adult male executives in dark navy business suits embrace in a celebratory hug, centered slightly left. The man facing camera-left has curly dark hair and wears a charcoal suit; the other man, with short dark hair and a white dress shirt under a navy suit, holds a thick fan of U.S. $100 bills in one hand while hugging. Their expressions should feel triumphant and conspiratorial. In the midground and right side, 2 additional adult men in dark suits push 2 metal airport luggage carts overflowing with tightly bundled stacks of cash. The left cart has a black front panel labeled “Google” in multicolor corporate-style lettering, and the right cart has a black front panel labeled “Deep Pockets Division” in white sans-serif text. Count exactly 2 carts and show both piled high with money bricks wrapped in bank bands. The private jet extends across most of the background, with oval windows, a visible rear engine on the right, and a partly cloudy blue sky above. The ground is wet and reflective, adding glossy reflections under the people and carts. Editorial photojournalism style, ultra-realistic lighting, sharp focus, subtle depth of field, luxury wealth satire, corporate power imagery, high-detail textures on suits, aircraft metal, and cash bundles.

The samurai wears traditional armor and a horned kabuto helmet, holding two swords at his sides, facing uphill toward the fire. Keep the figure small compared to the landscape to emphasize scale and isolation. Use extremely low-key lighting, strong backlighting from the flames, deep blacks, heavy smoke, drifting embers, and a moody high-contrast palette of black, ember red, and fiery orange. The image should feel like an epic historical Japanese war film, wide composition, minimalist framing, dramatic negative space, realistic texture, and intense atmospheric smoke.

items.titleZh: A highly detailed cinematic portrait of an anthropomorphic {argument name="dog breed" default="pug"} and a chimpanzee sitting across from each other playing chess in a dim, old-world Victorian study. The dog is on the left, shown from the waist up, wearing a brown tweed suit jacket, white shirt, and bow tie, with a single round monocle and chain over one eye, resting one paw near the chessboard and gazing thoughtfully at the pieces. The chimpanzee is on the right, also dressed in a heavy brown tweed jacket over a shirt, leaning forward with one hand against its chin in a classic thinking pose, intensely focused on the board. Between them is an ornate carved wooden chess table with a full chess set mid-game, with exactly 32 pieces visible: 16 light wooden pieces on the left side and 16 dark wooden pieces on the right side, arranged in a believable strategic position rather than a starting layout. The room is rich with dark polished wood, leather armchairs, a warm amber table lamp on the far left, bookshelves in the background, a framed classical portrait painting centered behind them, and a small mantel clock beneath the painting. Use warm tungsten lighting, shallow depth of field, moody shadows, ultra-realistic fur and skin textures, fine wrinkles, reflective glass on the monocle, and a serious intellectual atmosphere with subtle humor. Symmetrical composition, eye-level camera, photorealistic, sharp focus on both faces and the chessboard, luxurious period details, dark brown and sepia color palette.

The girl should resemble {argument name="character design" default="a Rei Ayanami-inspired pilot"}, with short icy blue hair, very pale skin, and a skintight white suit with black side panels, subtle gray seam lines, and 4 colored circular chest details in red, green, blue, and dark metallic tones. Set the scene in a devastated industrial bay with collapsed metal beams, broken concrete, smoke, steam, dangling cables, wet reflective flooring, and bright orange sparks erupting from shattered machinery on both sides. On the left wall, include a large worn NERV-style mural with a red leaf logo and the text {argument name="wall slogan" default="GOD'S IN HIS HEAVEN. ALL'S RIGHT WITH THE WORLD."}. Use cinematic low-angle composition, strong depth, photorealistic materials, hard rim lighting from above, cool steel-blue shadows, warm spark highlights, volumetric haze, ultra-detailed textures, high contrast, ominous atmosphere, and premium movie-poster polish. Make it feel like {argument name="franchise mood" default="a dark live-action Evangelion poster"}, hyper-detailed, realistic, intense, and iconic.

Keep the same beagle and the same potted houseplant from the reference as the main subjects, but redraw them as finely inked and lightly hand-colored specimen illustrations on an aged off-white page. Preserve the dog's seated pose, collar and tag, and the plant's pot and overall structure. Add a formal infographic layout with 8 labeled figure areas total: 1 large central full-body beagle study, 1 large right-side plant study, 4 left-column inset studies labeled “Fig. 1. Head (Frontal View)”, “Fig. 2. Head (Profile View)”, “Fig. 3. Collar & Tag”, and “Fig. 4. Forepaw (Anterior View)”, 3 bottom comparative detail studies labeled “Eye”, “Nose”, and “Leaf (Detail)”, plus 1 bottom-right notes panel. Add delicate dotted annotation callouts around the main dog and plant identifying features such as eyes, ears, nose, chest, legs, paws, coat, leaves, stem, and roots. Include the page title “THE BEAGLE & THE HOUSEPLANT” at the top, the subtitle “Observations on a Domestic Companion and Its Environment”, corner plate markings “PL. I.” and “Tab. 1.”, a central caption “Fig. 5. The Beagle (Canis lupus familiaris) Adult. Seated Position.”, a plant caption “Fig. 6. Houseplant in Pot (Dracaena sp.)”, a bottom section title “Fig. 7. Comparative Study: Details”, and a notes box containing 5 lines: “Location: Indoor”, “Observations: Peaceful coexistence between companion animal and potted plant.”, “Date: May 17, 2024”, “Observer: Naturalist’s Journal”, and “Plate I.” Use clean engraved linework, restrained watercolor washes, subtle paper texture, decorative border corners, and a symmetrical museum-plate composition.

items.title: Dark Electro Album Cover
items.titleZh: Square Japanese dark electro pop album cover, cinematic and ethereal, set at night in a rainy empty urban alley with wet reflective pavement and deep blue-black shadows. Center a ghostly elegant woman standing directly in front of a glowing vending machine filled with visible drink cans, the machine casting icy blue-white light around her while small red indicator lights glow on the right side. She has extremely long flowing silver-lavender hair, pale skin, and an enigmatic faceless or obscured-face treatment with the face hidden in shadow or a smooth blurred void. She wears an off-shoulder translucent {argument name="dress style" default="shimmering gray tulle gown"} with delicate sparkle texture, sheer draped sleeves, and ornate crystal jewelry at the neck and chest. Her pose is solemn and prayer-like, one hand raised holding a coin near her lips, the other hand gently clasping her wrist. Add 2 glowing red stigmata-like cross marks, one on the wrist and one on the hand, emitting subtle light. The mood is melancholic, mystical, futuristic, sacred, and slightly gothic. Use a high-contrast palette of cold neon blue, silver, black, and crimson accents, with mist, drizzle, soft bloom, fine film grain, and dramatic backlighting from the vending machine. Integrate ornate vintage border decorations in all 4 corners and a thin frame line around the cover. At the top center, place the artist name {argument name="artist name" default="AYANO YUKIMURA"} in elegant serif capitals with a smaller Japanese line beneath: {argument name="artist name in Japanese" default="アヤノ ユキムラ"}. Along the left side, create a vertical black panel with 3 text areas: the artist name at the top, a long vertical Japanese quote in white in the middle, and at the bottom the stacked genre text {argument name="genre text" default="JAPANESE DARK ELECTRO POP ALBUM"}. Across the bottom center, place the album title {argument name="album title" default="VENDING MACHINE STIGMATA"} in very large luminous cracked silver serif typography spanning 2 lines, with subtle star-like sparkles and ornamental flourishes. Premium fantasy-photoreal key art, ultra-detailed, polished CD jacket design.
items.promptZh: 方形的日本黑暗电子流行专辑封面，电影般的空灵，背景设定在夜晚的雨天空荡荡的城市小巷，潮湿的反光路面和深蓝黑色的阴影。一位幽灵般优雅的女士正站在一台发光的自动售货机前，售货机里装满了可见的饮料罐，机器在她周围投射冰冷的蓝白光，而右侧的小红色指示灯则发光。她有一头飘逸的银色淡紫色长发，苍白的皮肤，神秘的无脸或模糊脸部处理，脸部隐藏在阴影或光滑模糊的虚空中。她身着一件露肩半透明{argument name="dress style" default="shimmering grey tulle dress"}，质地精致，带有透明垂坠袖子，颈部和胸部饰有华丽的水晶珠宝。她的姿势庄严而祈祷，一只手举起，将一枚硬币放在嘴唇附近，另一只手轻轻地扣住手腕。添加2个发光的红色圣痕状十字标记，一个在手腕上，一个在手上，散发出微妙的光芒。情绪是忧郁的、神秘的、未来的、神圣的、略带哥特式的。使用冷霓虹蓝、银色、黑色和深红色调的高对比度调色板，搭配薄雾、细雨、柔和的花朵、精细的胶片颗粒和自动售货机的戏剧性背光。在所有 4 个角上融入华丽的复古边框装饰，并在封面周围采用细框线。在顶部中心，将艺术家姓名 {argument name="artist name" default="AYANO YUKIMURA"} 置于优雅的衬线大写字母中，下方有一条较小的日文线条：{argument name="artist name in Japanese" default="アヤノ ユキムラ"}。沿着左侧创建一个具有 3 个文本区域的垂直黑色面板：顶部是艺术家姓名，中间是白色的长垂直日语引言，底部是堆叠的流派文本 {argument name="genre text" default="JAPANESE DARK ELECTRO POP ALBUM"}。在底部中心，将专辑标题 {argument name="album title" default="VENDING MACHINE STIGMATA"} 放置在跨越 2 行的非常大的发光裂纹银色衬线字体中，带有微妙的星星般的闪光和装饰性的华丽。优质奇幻真实的关键艺术，超详细、抛光的 CD 封面设计。

items.titleZh: A minimalist flat vector illustration on a light gray background showing a stylized pelican riding a bicycle, composed from simple geometric SVG-like shapes with thick dark charcoal outlines and sparse details. The bicycle is shown in side view with 2 large wheels, each with a circular rim and a simple cross of 4 spokes, a black frame, seat, crank, and handlebars, resting on a single thin horizontal ground line near the bottom. The pelican is abstract and slightly awkward, built from clean outlined shapes: a white circular-oval body positioned over the bike, 2 narrow orange-yellow leg shapes hanging down toward the pedals, a white neck and head extending forward, 1 small black eye, a long triangular orange-yellow upper beak, and 1 large pale pink lower pouch. Add a separate white wing shape angled upward above the body. Keep the composition intentionally simple and a little imperfect, as if it were an SVG demo drawing generated from code in a code editor screenshot, but render only the artwork itself with no interface, no text, no shadows, and no extra scenery.

items.title: Kawaii Street Fashion Duo Portrait
items.titleZh: A candid street-fashion portrait of two cute anime-inspired girls standing close together in front of a colorful urban graffiti wall on a city sidewalk in Japan, photographed at eye level with a shallow depth of field and soft overcast daylight. Both have smooth pale skin and short blunt bob haircuts with straight ends, their bangs covering part of the forehead, and their faces intentionally simplified or blurred for an anonymous doll-like look. The girl on the left has {argument name="hair color" default="silver gray"} hair, wears a black knit beanie with a rectangular patch logo reading "Nightfall", a black leather jacket over a white graphic T-shirt with a dark distressed illustration and purple accent graphic, layered silver chain necklaces including a heart pendant, a black choker, and a black backpack strap over one shoulder. The girl on the right has icy light blue hair, wears a black knit beanie with a white scribble-style logo, an oversized black hoodie with bold hot-pink Japanese graffiti lettering across the chest, a silver chain necklace, and black backpack straps on both shoulders. They lean in slightly toward each other in a relaxed, stylish pose, with one hand lightly touching the hoodie shoulder area. The background is a vivid mural wall in pink, blue, and purple tones, plus a sticker-covered utility pole on the right edge with visible layered street stickers including "SMILE", "AQUARIUS", and a red "HELLO my name is" sticker covered in tags. Emphasize Japanese street style, alternative fashion, kawaii cool mood, realistic fabric textures, crisp clothing detail, subtle cinematic color grading, and a trendy Harajuku snapshot aesthetic.

items.title: Restaurant POV Change Comparison
items.titleZh: A side-by-side comparison graphic on a black background demonstrating a camera-angle change in the same restaurant scene. At the top, large white sans-serif text reads: "Show me the POV from someone standing behind the bar looking out over this crowded restaurant. Change NOTHING in the scene other than the pov". Below, place 2 stacked rectangular photos centered vertically: the top image labeled "Source" in large white text on the left, and the bottom image labeled "Output" in large white text on the left. The top photo shows a warmly lit, upscale, crowded restaurant interior seen from the dining room side, facing a tall back bar filled with many illuminated liquor bottles on wall-to-wall shelves, with bartenders and guests in front, amber lighting, globe pendant lights, wood ceiling, beige columns, and tightly packed seated diners in the foreground. The bottom photo shows the exact same restaurant, same crowd density, same warm lighting, same decor, same bar shelving, same globe pendant lights, and same overall composition elements, but now from the point of view of someone standing behind the bar and looking outward across the crowded restaurant; the foreground includes the bar counter with glassware, metal bar tools, bottles, and a point-of-sale screen visible at the lower left, while guests and staff fill the middle ground and the dining room extends into the background. Preserve the sense that only the camera position changed between the 2 images, with no other scene alterations.

items.title: Isometric Micro-World Cross-Section Archive
items.titleZh:
Please create a high-completion, high-information-density visual map of an 'Isometric Micro-World Archive' suitable for serialized publishing based on the [Theme].

This is not a regular room illustration or a simple architectural drawing, but a thematic space overview combining 'isometric perspective + architectural cross-section structure + multi-layer functional space + high-density thematic props + miniature model feel + game scene concept art feel.' The image should look like an opened miniature world, a business simulation game scene, a dollhouse model, or a world-building concept map, allowing viewers to understand the overall structure at a glance while repeatedly observing the small details within.

[Basic Settings]
Theme: [Theme, e.g., Insect Research Institute / Future Survival Base / Magic Potion Workshop / AI Automation Company / Plant Factory / Children's Learning Center / Space Supply Station]
Space Name / Brand Name: [Brand name or space name, can be empty]
Worldview Direction: [Reality / Sci-Fi / Fairy Tale / Magic / Post-Apocalyptic / Museum / Laboratory / Business Simulation / Campus / Natural Ecology]
Building Type: [Cottage / Base / Factory / Lab / Shop / Museum / Underground Space / Spaceship / Multi-layer Studio]
Core Function: [What this space is mainly used for, e.g., research, production, display, life, training, trading, learning, maintenance, planting]
Main Color: [Main color, e.g., light blue, mint green, cream yellow, pink, orange-green, purple-blue, white-blue tech color]
Auxiliary Color: [Auxiliary color, can be empty]
Accent Color: [Accent color, can be empty]
Aspect Ratio: [1:1 / 3:4 / 4:5 / 9:16]
Information Density: [Medium-high / High / Ultra-high]
Overall Vibe: [Healing, cute, precise, childlike, popular science, futuristic, retro, refreshing, sense of exploration]

If some fields are not filled, please automatically derive them reasonably based on the [Theme]; do not leave the screen blank. All content must be generated uniformly around the theme, avoiding irrelevant elements.

[Visual Structure]
Adopt a clear isometric perspective / axonometric view, where the main subject is an opened multi-layer thematic building or functional base. Viewers can simultaneously see the front, side, top, and internal space of the building. The entire building is located at the center of the screen, occupying most of the area, with the background environment moderately faded to highlight the subject.

The interior of the building needs to be divided into multiple functional areas, each with a clear purpose, rather than randomly piled decorations. It can include:
1. Main work area / Core operation area
2. Display area / Collection area / Specimen area
3. Research area / Lab area / Control area
4. Storage area / Shelving area / Supply area
5. Living area / Rest area / Small residential area
6. Energy area / Machine area / Piping area
7. Planting area / Cultivation area / Ecological area
8. Entrance area / Transport area / Maintenance area
9. Spatial connection structures like stairs, platforms, corridors, railings, ladders, etc.

Clear spatial relationships must be formed between various areas through stairs, corridors, platforms, pipes, bridges, or cables, making the image look like a real, functioning miniature system.

[Props and Details]
Generate a large number of relevant props based on the [Theme] and distribute them in different functional areas. Props need to be specific, identifiable, and thematically related, not just vague decorations. Each small object should be as clear and readable as a game asset, with a feel of being clickable, interactive, and collectable.

Types of props can include:
- Thematic equipment: machines, instruments, tools, consoles, containers, screens, workbenches
- Lifestyle objects: tables/chairs, bookshelves, beds, cups, boxes, cabinets, lamps
- Display objects: specimens, models, posters, signboards, glass cabinets, display racks
- Connection structures: pipes, wires, ladders, stairs, conveyor belts, slide rails, platforms
- Ecological elements: plants, water tanks, incubators, soil, branches, rocks, specimens
- Character elements: small number of characters, animals, robots, or thematic creatures to provide a sense of scale and story

The number of props should be rich but orderly. All props should serve the space's function and the thematic worldview.

[Style Requirements]
The overall style is clear, cute, precise hand-drawn cartoon isometric illustration. Lines are clean, edges are slightly rounded, colors are bright and soft, with an overall relaxed, healing, and exploratory feel. The image should have the feel of a business simulation game, a children's science picture book, a miniature model, or a concept art page.

Avoid over-realism, strong dark lighting/shadows, heavy oil painting feel, and complex noise. The focus is on being clear, exquisite, layered, and highly readable.

[Color and Lighting]
Use high brightness, low-to-medium saturation soft color schemes. The main color is unified, auxiliary colors are used to distinguish different spaces, and accent colors are used to highlight key equipment and small props. Line art colors should not use dead black; instead, use soft outlines like dark gray, blue-gray, or brown-gray.

Keep lighting and shadows lightweight; strong realistic projections are not needed. Build layers through color blocks, structures, lines, and local highlights. The background should use light colors and low-contrast processing to make the main building stand out more.

[Composition and Reading Path]
The main subject is centered or slightly upper-centered, with the building in a multi-layer cross-section structure. The visual reading path should start from the overall building outline, enter the functional areas of each floor, and finally observe the detailed props. The gaze can be guided by elements such as stairs, platforms, corridors, pipelines, and tracks.

The overall image should be full but not crowded, rich but not messy. Every room, platform, and corner should have content, yet still maintain clear spatial boundaries.

[Background Environment]
The background can include a weakened external environment according to the theme, such as a forest, city, street, underground rock layer, experimental park, seabed, space, campus, factory exterior, etc. The background should not compete with the subject; light colors, low opacity, and low contrast are recommended to achieve a 'subject clear, background receding' effect.

[Final Effect]
The final image should look like a complete thematic space concept map, with both the structural feel of an architectural cross-section and the detail of a game scene asset map, combined with the cute exploration feel of a miniature dollhouse. It should be suitable for serialized visual creation, IP worldview display, game scene settings, brand space concept maps, science content covers, or Little Red Book/Pinterest style visual posts.

Ensure the image has:
1. Clear isometric perspective
2. Clear architectural cross-section structure
3. Complete multi-layer functional areas
4. Rich props and thematic unity
5. Soft and bright colors
6. Clean and clear line art
7. Weakened background, prominent subject
8. High information density but not messy
9. A sense of an explorable, operable, and observable miniature world.
items.prompt:
请根据【主题】创作一张高完成度、高信息密度、适合系列化发布的「微缩世界剖面馆 / Isometric Micro-World Archive」视觉图。

这不是普通房间插画，也不是单纯的建筑图，而是一张结合“等距轴测视角 + 建筑剖面结构 + 多层功能空间 + 高密度主题道具 + 微缩模型感 + 游戏场景设定集感”的主题空间总览图。画面需要像一个被剖开的微缩世界、经营模拟游戏场景、玩具屋模型或世界观设定图，让观者可以一眼看懂整体结构，又能反复观察其中的小细节。

【基础设定】
主题：【主题，例如昆虫研究所 / 未来生存基地 / 魔法药剂工坊 / AI自动化公司 / 植物工厂 / 儿童学习中心 / 太空补给站】
空间名称 / 品牌名：【品牌名或空间名称，可为空】
世界观方向：【现实 / 科幻 / 童话 / 魔法 / 末日 / 博物馆 / 实验室 / 经营模拟 / 校园 / 自然生态】
建筑类型：【小屋 / 基地 / 工厂 / 实验室 / 商店 / 博物馆 / 地下空间 / 飞船 / 多层工作室】
核心功能：【这个空间主要用来做什么，例如研究、生产、展示、生活、训练、交易、学习、维修、种植】
主色调：【主色调，例如浅蓝、薄荷绿、奶油黄、粉色、橙绿、紫蓝、白蓝科技色】
辅助色：【辅助色，可为空】
点缀色：【点缀色，可为空】
画幅比例：【1:1 / 3:4 / 4:5 / 9:16】
信息密度：【中高密度 / 高密度 / 超高密度】
整体气质：【治愈、可爱、精密、童趣、科普、未来感、复古、清爽、探索感】

如果某些字段没有填写，请根据【主题】自动合理推导，不要让画面留空。所有内容都要围绕主题统一生成，避免加入无关元素。

【画面结构】
采用清晰的等距轴测视角 / isometric view / axonometric view，主体是一个被剖开的多层主题建筑或功能基地。观者可以同时看到建筑的正面、侧面、顶面和内部空间。整体建筑位于画面中心，占据画面主要面积，背景环境适度淡化，用来衬托主体。

建筑内部需要分成多个功能区域，每个区域都要有明确用途，而不是随机堆放装饰。可以包含：
1. 主工作区 / 核心操作区
2. 展示区 / 收藏区 / 标本区
3. 研究区 / 实验区 / 控制区
4. 储藏区 / 货架区 / 物资区
5. 生活区 / 休息区 / 小型居住区
6. 能源区 / 机器区 / 管道区
7. 种植区 / 培养区 / 生态区
8. 入口区 / 运输区 / 维修区
9. 楼梯、平台、走廊、栏杆、梯子等空间连接结构

各个区域之间要通过楼梯、走廊、平台、管道、桥架或电缆形成清晰的空间关系，让画面像一个真实可以运转的小型系统。

【道具与细节】
根据【主题】生成大量相关道具，并让它们分布在不同功能区中。道具需要具体、可识别、有主题关联，不能只是泛泛的装饰。每个小物件都应像游戏资产一样清晰可读，具有可点击、可互动、可收集的感觉。

道具类型可以包括：
- 主题设备：机器、仪器、工具、控制台、容器、屏幕、工作台
- 生活物件：桌椅、书架、床铺、杯子、箱子、柜子、灯具
- 展示物件：标本、模型、海报、说明牌、玻璃柜、陈列架
- 连接结构：管道、电线、梯子、楼梯、输送带、滑轨、平台
- 生态元素：植物、水箱、培养箱、土壤、树枝、岩石、标本
- 角色元素：少量小人物、小动物、机器人或主题生物，用来提供尺度感和故事感

道具数量要丰富，但要保持秩序。所有道具都应服务于空间功能和主题世界观。

【风格要求】
整体风格为清晰、可爱、精密的手绘卡通等距插画。线条干净，边缘略圆润，色彩明亮柔和，整体具有轻松、治愈、探索感。画面应有经营模拟游戏、儿童科普绘本、微缩模型、设定集页面的感觉。

避免过度写实，避免强烈暗黑光影，避免厚重油画感，避免复杂噪点。重点是清楚、精致、有层次、可读性强。

【颜色与光影】
使用高明度、低到中等饱和度的柔和配色。主色调统一，辅助色用于区分不同空间，点缀色用于突出关键设备和小道具。线稿颜色不要使用死黑，可使用深灰、蓝灰、棕灰等柔和描边。

光影保持轻量，不需要强烈真实投影。通过色块、结构、线条和局部高亮来建立层次。背景使用浅色、低对比度处理，使主体建筑更加突出。

【构图与阅读路径】
画面主体居中或略微偏上，建筑呈多层剖面结构。视觉阅读路径应从整体建筑轮廓开始，再进入各楼层功能区，最后观察细节道具。可以通过楼梯、平台、走廊、管线、轨道等元素引导视线。

整体画面要饱满但不拥挤，丰富但不混乱。每个房间、平台和角落都应该有内容，但仍然保持清晰的空间边界。

【背景环境】
背景可以根据主题加入弱化的外部环境，例如森林、城市、街道、地下岩层、实验园区、海底、太空、校园、工厂外墙等。背景不要抢主体，建议使用淡色、低透明度、低对比度处理，形成“主体清晰、背景退后”的效果。

【最终效果】
最终画面应像一张完整的主题空间设定图，既有建筑剖面图的结构感，又有游戏场景资产图的细节感，还带有微缩玩具屋的可爱探索感。它应该适合用于系列化视觉创作、IP世界观展示、游戏场景设定、品牌空间概念图、科普内容封面或小红书/Pinterest风格视觉发布。

请确保画面：
1. 等距轴测视角明确
2. 建筑剖面结构清楚
3. 多层功能区完整
4. 道具丰富且主题统一
5. 色彩柔和明亮
6. 线稿清晰干净
7. 背景弱化、主体突出
8. 信息密度高但不混乱
9. 具有可探索、可运营、可反复观察的微缩世界感

On the left and center, place a luminous circular hub labeled “AI” in bright blue, with 3 directional glowing energy arrows branching outward to competing platforms: “Google” on the left in a blue electric region, “Claude” on the upper right in a gold electric region, and “OpenAI” at the bottom center in a magenta-purple electric region. Add a subtle world-map or territory-battle visualization effect under each brand region, like illuminated digital land masses or influence zones. On the right side, show a young Japanese-looking woman from waist up, facing forward, wearing a long straight split-color wig with pastel pink on one side and pastel blue on the other, a plain white T-shirt with the printed text “OKIHIRO AI Creative”, and a light pink skirt. She raises one index finger beside her face in a presenter pose. Her face is fully obscured by a large soft-edged rectangular blur block. Across the top, add huge distressed white Japanese headline text: {argument name="headline text" default="AI戦国時代"}. Beneath it, add a second line in bold gold Japanese text: {argument name="subheadline text" default="性能だけの話じゃない"}. Across the bottom, place a wide black banner with massive bold gold Japanese text: {argument name="bottom text" default="空気を取った側が勝つ"}. Make the typography oversized, gritty, and attention-grabbing, with slight glow and drop shadow. items.title: Futuristic Floating City at Sunset
items.titleZh: A vast cinematic sci-fi city floating above a sea of glowing clouds at sunset, viewed from a high aerial perspective. The scene shows an advanced utopian megacity made of many slender futuristic skyscrapers and elevated platforms rising out of the clouds, with 2 prominent central dome structures, 1 large circular landing platform in the lower right foreground, 1 massive spacecraft in the lower left foreground flying toward the city with bright blue engine trails, and numerous smaller flying vehicles scattered across the sky. The architecture is sleek, metallic, and ultra-detailed, with tall needle-like towers, layered skybridges, suspended districts, and illuminated windows. Warm golden sunlight pours in from the left near the horizon, casting orange, peach, and pink highlights across the clouds, while the buildings reflect cool steel blues and subtle neon accents. Include dramatic volumetric clouds below and between the structures, atmospheric haze for depth, a grand sense of scale, and a polished concept-art look. Composition should feel epic and panoramic, with the tallest tower near the center-right, additional spires receding into the distance, and a dark vertical megastructure framing the far right edge. Add a clean white "Pollo.ai" logo in the top-right corner. Hyper-detailed, cinematic lighting, futuristic worldbuilding, high contrast, sharp focus, premium science-fiction key art.
items.promptZh: 从高空视角观看日落时分，一座巨大的电影科幻城市漂浮在发光的云海之上。场景展示了一座先进的乌托邦巨型城市，由许多细长的未来派摩天大楼和从云端升起的高架平台组成，有2个突出的中央穹顶结构，右下前景有1个大型圆形着陆平台，左下前景中有1个巨大的航天器飞向城市，带有亮蓝色的发动机尾迹，天空中散布着许多小型飞行器。该建筑时尚、金属、细节丰富，有高大的针状塔楼、分层的天桥、悬浮的区域和照明的窗户。温暖的金色阳光从靠近地平线的左侧倾泻而下，在云层上投射出橙色、桃色和粉色的亮点，而建筑物则反射出冷酷的钢蓝色和微妙的霓虹灯装饰。包括结构下方和结构之间的戏剧性体积云、深度大气雾霾、宏大的规模感以及精美的概念艺术外观。构图应该给人一种史诗般的全景感，最高的塔楼位于中右方附近，额外的尖塔逐渐向远处延伸，而黑暗的垂直巨型结构则构成了最右边缘。在右上角添加干净的白色“Pollo.ai”徽标。超详细的电影灯光、未来世界建筑、高对比度、锐利的焦点、优质的科幻关键艺术。

items.title: Filmmaking Eras Typographic Grid
items.titleZh:
Create a clean 2x2 grid on a pure white studio background featuring 4 large 3D typographic sculptures, each a single character built entirely from filmmaking equipment from a different era. The four glyphs are exactly 4 characters: top-left letter A, top-right number 5, bottom-left letter X, bottom-right number 9. Each character should be front-facing, centered in its quadrant, legible but formed from a dense pile of realistic cinema tools and on-set props, with believable occlusion, weight, and construction logic. Use high-end Cinema 4D product visualization, subtle ambient occlusion, soft three-point studio lighting with a softbox overhead, crisp shadows, realistic materials, and isolated composition.

Top-left: the letter A made from early cinema and silent-era equipment, assembled from vintage wooden tripods, hand-cranked film cameras, brass lenses, reels, megaphones, bell-shaped horns, matte black metal parts, leather straps, and aged wood. Surface qualities should include worn varnished wood, black crackle paint, brass tarnish, scuffed metal, and dusty antique patina. The silhouette should feel chaotic but readable, with tripod legs and old camera bodies defining the A shape.

Top-right: the number 5 made from mid-century analog filmmaking gear, assembled from classic film cameras, magazine reels, metal canisters, brown leather cases, audio accessories, silver fabric packs, director chairs, cylindrical lenses, grips, and vintage production bags. Materials should emphasize brushed aluminum, leather, canvas, rubber, and weathered industrial finishes. The 5 should be chunky and balanced, with stacked props tightly packed into the glyph.

Bottom-left: the letter X made from late 20th century video and broadcast equipment, assembled from shoulder-mount camcorders, portable recorders, battery packs, coiled cables, cassette-like modules, control panels, worn blue and gray plastic housings, and rugged field electronics. Include visible wiring and taped components. Materials should feel utilitarian and slightly battered, with dark plastic, anodized metal, stickers, rubber grips, and yellow accent details. The crossing diagonals of the X must be clear and substantial.

Bottom-right: the number 9 made from contemporary digital cinema and virtual production gear, assembled from modern cinema cameras, compact monitors, LED light panels, drones, gimbals, matte boxes, black modular accessories, and a vivid green chroma screen wrap forming part of the numeral. Include sleek vents, carbon fiber textures, matte black metal, polished glass, and bright green screen fabric as the dominant accent color. The 9 should feel the most modern and refined, with modular precision and clean industrial design.

Keep the background plain and uncluttered, no extra text, no floating objects, no flat typography, no 2D rendering. The sculptures should look like physical objects at realistic scale, highly detailed, photorealistic, and suitable as a graphic design asset.
items.promptZh:
在纯白色工作室背景上创建一个干净的 2x2 网格，其中包含 4 个大型 3D 印刷雕塑，每个雕塑都是完全由不同时代的电影制作设备构建的单个角色。这四个字形恰好是 4 个字符：左上角的字母 A、右上角的数字 5、左下角的字母 X、右下角的数字 9。每个字符都应该朝前，位于其象限的中心，清晰易读，但由密集的现实电影工具和现场道具组成，具有可信的遮挡、重量和构造逻辑。使用高端 Cinema 4D 产品可视化、微妙的环境光遮挡、带有头顶柔光箱的柔和三点工作室照明、清晰的阴影、逼真的材质和独立的构图。

左上：由早期电影和默片时代设备制成的字母 A，由老式木制三脚架、手摇胶片相机、黄铜镜头、卷轴、扩音器、钟形喇叭、哑光黑色金属部件、皮带和陈旧木材组装而成。表面质量应包括磨损的清漆木材、黑色裂纹漆、黄铜失去光泽、磨损的金属和布满灰尘的古董铜锈。剪影应该感觉混乱但可读，三脚架腿和旧相机机身定义了 A 形。

右上：5号由中世纪模拟电影制作设备制成，由经典胶片相机、杂志卷轴、金属罐、棕色皮套、音响配件、银色织物包、导演椅、柱面镜头、手柄和复古制作包组装而成。材料应强调拉丝铝、皮革、帆布、橡胶和风化工业饰面。 5 应该是厚实且平衡的，堆叠的道具紧密地封装在字形中。

左下：由 20 世纪末视频和广播设备制成的字母 X，由肩扛式摄像机、便携式录像机、电池组、卷绕电缆、盒式模块、控制面板、磨损的蓝色和灰色塑料外壳以及坚固耐用的现场电子设备组装而成。包括可见的接线和胶带组件。材料应该感觉实用且略有磨损，包括深色塑料、阳极氧化金属、贴纸、橡胶握把和黄色强调细节。 X 的交叉对角线必须清晰且实质性。

右下：数字 9 由当代数字电影和虚拟制作设备制成，由现代电影摄影机、紧凑型监视器、LED 灯板、无人机、万向节、遮光盒、黑色模块化配件以及构成数字一部分的生动绿色色度屏幕包裹组装而成。包括时尚的通风口、碳纤维纹理、哑光黑色金属、抛光玻璃和亮绿色屏幕织物作为主要强调色。 9应该是最现代、最精致的，具有模块化精度和简洁的工业设计。

保持背景简洁、无多余文本、无浮动对象、无平面排版、无 2D 渲染。雕塑应该看起来像真实比例的物理物体，高度详细，逼真，并且适合作为图形设计资产。

items.titleZh: Create a clean 2x2 grid of four front-facing 3D typographic sculptures on a light gray seamless studio background, separated by thin white dividers. Each quadrant features a single giant letter built entirely from dense, realistic filmmaking equipment and on-set props from a different cinematic era, with the letterform chaotic but clearly legible. Use high-end Cinema 4D product-render aesthetics, ambient occlusion, realistic scale relationships, intricate kit-bashing, subtle wear, metallic reflections, and three-point studio lighting with a soft overhead source. Top-left: the letter S, representing early silent-era or proto-cinema filmmaking, constructed from antique brass-and-wood cameras, exposed gears, film reels, projector parts, bellows, tripod wood legs, and vintage optical housings; warm bronze and copper tones; include 3 extra props at the base: a black megaphone labeled "DIRECTOR", a clapboard, and a short stack of film canisters; one projector-like lens at the upper right glows brightly. Top-right: the letter C, representing classical Hollywood film production, built from black metal film cameras, studio lenses, magazines, matte boxes, dolly components, control boxes, and analog set hardware; mostly black, steel, and gunmetal with subtle brass accents; include 4 extra props integrated around the base and inner right side: a clapperboard, a boxy side module, a film magazine marked "35", and a small cylindrical canister; a large forward-facing lamp or lens glows at the upper right. Bottom-left: the letter N, representing modern analog or late-20th-century cinema, assembled from Arriflex-style cameras, long cine zoom lenses, support rigs, rails, cables, a slate, and a field recorder; predominantly matte black with silver hardware and a few red accent rings; include 3 clearly visible base elements: a clapperboard section, a labeled director strip, and a rectangular audio recorder/control unit at the bottom. Bottom-right: the letter D, representing digital and virtual production, built from RED-style digital cinema cameras, monitors, battery packs, wireless transmitters, drones, LED panels, green-screen fabric inserts, and modular rig components; black technical bodies with vivid green accents and screen graphics; include 4 notable integrated device types: drone arms/propellers at the top, a rectangular LED light panel, multiple monitors, and a large camera lens at the lower left. Keep all objects grounded and physically connected, no floating pieces, no flat typography, no handwriting, no paper look, no messy background. Ultra-detailed, sharp, 8k, polished graphic design asset for a poster or visual comparison of filmmaking eras.
items.promptZh: 在浅灰色无缝工作室背景上创建一个由四个正面 3D 印刷雕塑组成的干净 2x2 网格，并由白色细隔板隔开。每个象限都有一个巨大的字母，完全由来自不同电影时代的密集、逼真的电影制作设备和现场道具制成，字母形式混乱但清晰易读。使用高端 Cinema 4D 产品渲染美学、环境光遮蔽、真实比例关系、复杂的套件攻击、细微磨损、金属反射以及带有柔和头顶光源的三点工作室照明。左上：字母S，代表早期默片时代或原始电影电影制作，由古董黄铜和木头相机、外露齿轮、胶片卷轴、投影仪部件、波纹管、三脚架木腿和老式光学外壳构成；温暖的青铜色和古铜色；底座上包括 3 个额外道具：一个标有“导演”的黑色扩音器、一块隔板和一小叠胶片罐；右上角的一个类似投影仪的镜头发出明亮的光。右上：字母C，代表经典的好莱坞电影制作，由黑色金属胶片摄影机、演播室镜头、杂志、遮光盒、摄影车组件、控制盒和模拟布景硬件制成；大部分为黑色、钢色和炮铜色，带有微妙的黄铜装饰；包括 4 个额外的道具，集成在底座和右侧内部：一个场记板、一个四四方方的侧面模块、一个标有“35”的电影杂志和一个小圆柱形罐；一个大的前向灯或透镜在右上角发光。左下：字母 N，代表现代模拟或 20 世纪末电影，由 Arriflex 式摄像机、长电影变焦镜头、支撑装置、导轨、电缆、石板和现场录音机组装而成；以哑光黑色为主，搭配银色硬件和一些红色装饰环；包括 3 个清晰可见的基本元素：场记板部分、带标签的导演条和底部的矩形录音机/控制单元。右下：字母 D，代表数字和虚拟制作，由 RED 风格的数字电影摄影机、监视器、电池组、无线发射器、无人机、LED 面板、绿幕织物插入物和模块化装备组件构建而成；黑色技术机身，带有生动的绿色点缀和屏幕图形；包括 4 种值得注意的集成设备类型：顶部的无人机臂/螺旋桨、矩形 LED 灯板、多个监视器和左下角的大型相机镜头。保持所有对象接地并物理连接，没有浮动碎片，没有平面排版，没有手写，没有纸张外观，没有凌乱的背景。超详细、锐利、8k、精美的图形设计资源，用于海报或电影制作时代的视觉比较。

items.title: Moonlit Tiger and Rose Fantasy Poster
items.titleZh: A dreamy, cinematic fantasy illustration in vertical poster format, showing {argument name="celebrity model" default="Liu Yifei"} in side profile walking barefoot across a perfectly still midnight-blue lake under a luminous full moon and a richly detailed star-filled sky with the Milky Way stretching diagonally behind her. She is a graceful East Asian woman with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a shimmering silver sleeveless evening gown with a flowing skirt and a thigh slit, the fabric sparkling like stardust. Her expression is calm and introspective, and she faces to the right as one foot touches the water, creating delicate glowing ripples. Two small dark islands sit low on the horizon, one on each side, emphasizing the vast open water and sky. A glowing vine of soft white roses and petals wraps around her body in an elegant S-curve, beginning behind her upper back, spiraling around her waist and legs, and continuing downward into the reflection. Beneath the water, instead of a normal reflection, create a large luminous line-art tiger formed from fine white neon-like contours, upside down relative to the woman above, with its body curled dynamically and its head near a large glowing white rose at the lower right; the tiger should feel majestic, lean, and ethereal rather than aggressive. The overall palette is cool blue, silver, and white, with gentle moonlight, soft bloom, mirror-like reflections, magical realism, ultra-clean composition, high detail, romantic fantasy mood. Add elegant cursive text centered near the bottom that reads {argument name="quote" default="In me the tiger sniffs the rose."}, plus one small four-point star icon near the lower right corner. Make it refined, poetic, and visually symbolic of inner strength and tenderness.
items.promptZh: 一幅梦幻般的电影奇幻插图，采用垂直海报格式，展示了{argument name="celebrity model" default="刘亦菲"}的侧面轮廓，在明亮的满月和细节丰富的布满星星的天空下赤脚走过完全静止的午夜蓝色湖水，银河系在她身后对角延伸。她是一位优雅的东亚女性，一头齐肩的黑发，穿着闪闪发光的银色无袖晚礼服，裙摆飘逸，大腿开衩，布料闪闪发光，如星尘。她的表情平静而内省，她面朝右侧，一只脚接触水面，泛起精致的发光波纹。两个黑色的小岛坐落在地平线的低处，每一侧各有一个，强调了广阔的水域和天空。柔软的白玫瑰和花瓣组成的发光藤蔓以优雅的 S 形曲线缠绕在她的身体上，从她的上背部后面开始，盘旋在她的腰部和腿部，一直向下延伸到倒影中。在水下，不是正常的倒影，而是由精美的白色霓虹灯般轮廓形成的大型发光线条艺术老虎，相对于上面的女人上下颠倒，它的身体动态地卷曲，它的头靠近右下方的一朵巨大的发光白玫瑰；老虎应该给人一种威严、精瘦、空灵的感觉，而不是咄咄逼人的感觉。整体色调为冷色调的蓝、银、白，柔和的月色，柔和的晕染，镜面般的倒影，魔幻现实主义，超干净的构图，高细节，浪漫的幻想意境。在底部附近添加优雅的草书文本，内容为 {argument name="quote" default="In me the Tiger sniffs the Rose."}，并在右下角附近添加一个小四点星形图标。使其精致、富有诗意，在视觉上象征内在的力量和温柔。

items.title: Manga Cover With Bass Girl and Designer Boy
items.titleZh: A vibrant Japanese comic-style cover illustration with two anime characters standing side by side against a split pink-and-blue pop graphic background filled with stars, dots, music notes, hearts, spark lines, and playful doodles. At the top, place a huge bold Japanese title in thick black and brown kanji with white outline and pink shadow reading 夜坂さんと茶藤くん, arranged in an energetic layered composition inside a fluffy cloud-like title shape. The left half of the background is pink and the right half is light blue, with a diagonal dividing rhythm and decorative manga-cover accents. Show exactly 2 characters from about mid-thigh up. On the left is a rebellious teenage girl with a straight black bob haircut and blunt bangs, pale skin, punk-rock fashion, and a slightly annoyed withdrawn pose with one hand near her mouth. She wears an oversized black zip hoodie over a red-and-black horizontal striped shirt, a red plaid pleated skirt, fishnet stockings, and a black heart-shaped choker. She holds a black electric bass guitar vertically across her body, with visible tuning pegs, strings, pickups, and chrome hardware. On the right is a cheerful teenage boy with messy light brown hair, fair skin, and a friendly expressive pose. He wears a white button-up shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbows, a fitted black vest with a small emblem on the chest, and black slacks. He holds a stylus pen near his face in one hand and a dark drawing tablet tucked in the other arm. Add exactly 2 vertical Japanese speech balloons: on the left, うるさいのはキライ。 in a pink outlined balloon; on the right, そのセンスもっとみんなに届けたいです… in a blue outlined balloon. Include small floating icons between and around them: exactly 2 black music notes, 2 pink hearts, 2 blue stars, and a few curved arrows and spark marks suggesting lively chemistry. The overall style is polished modern manga cover art, clean linework, glossy shading, expressive character design, bright pastel pop palette, high detail, commercial light novel or comic serialization cover aesthetic.

items.title: Vintage Little Prince Space Postcard
items.titleZh: Create a vintage illustrated postcard designed as a whimsical collaboration between {argument name="franchise name" default="The Little Prince"} and {argument name="space company name" default="SPACEX"}, shown as the front and back of the postcard side by side on one canvas. Use warm aged paper with slightly worn edges, subtle grain, faint stains, and a nostalgic mid-century print feel. The left half is the postcard image: a deep midnight blue starry sky with small golden stars and a tiny ringed planet, a large white rocket standing upright on a launch pad with bright exhaust at liftoff, and a small blond child in a green outfit with a long golden scarf sitting on a rocky hill beside an orange fox, both seen from behind and looking toward the rocket. Add elegant hand-lettered quote text in the sky that reads {argument name="quote" default="To the stars, what matters is invisible."}, with smaller serif and script attribution beneath: "ANTOINE DE SAINT-EXUPÉRY" and "The Little Prince". Along the bottom of the left panel, include 2 brand names: "The Little Prince" in blue script on the left and "SPACEX" in bold blue futuristic capitals on the right, separated by a small gold star and a thin divider line. Beneath that, add the slogan in spaced small caps: {argument name="tagline" default="EXPLORING WORLDS. CARING FOR WHAT MATTERS."}. The right half is the postcard back on the same aged paper, with a centered heading "POST CARD" near the top and a small gold star ornament below it. Add a circular postmark near the upper center-right with 4 visible text parts arranged inside the stamp: "PLANET EARTH", "MAY 23", "2024", and "BEYOND". In the top-right corner, place a blue postage stamp with perforated edges showing the Little Prince standing on a tiny planet under stars, with 4 readable text elements: "1943", "Le Petit Prince", "SPACE", and a small star symbol. The right side should have 2 writing columns divided by a vertical line. In the left writing area, place a handwritten-style message beginning with "Dear friend," followed by this text in neat cursive line breaks: "One day, we'll leave Earth not to escape it, but to understand it better. The universe is vast, but kindness is our compass. Let's take care of our home, as we reach for the stars." Then sign it on 3 lines: "The Little Prince", "and", "SPACEX". In the right address area, write "To you," on the first line, then "Somewhere wonderful" and "In the Universe" on the next lines with horizontal guide lines. Add small gold star doodles and, at the bottom-right corner, a simple line drawing of a tiny round planet with little flowers sprouting from it. Keep the palette limited to cream, navy, soft gold, muted green, warm orange, and blue-gray, with crisp but painterly illustration, accurate decorative typography, and a magical, hopeful, literary-meets-space-exploration tone.
items.promptZh: 创建一张复古插图明信片，设计为 {argument name="franchise name" default="The Little Prince"} 和 {argument name="space company name" default="SPACEX"} 之间异想天开的合作，将明信片的正面和背面并排显示在一张画布上。使用边缘稍有磨损、有细微纹理、淡淡污渍和怀旧中世纪印刷感觉的温暖老化纸张。左半部分是明信片的图像：深蓝色的星空，点缀着金色的小星星和一颗小小的环形行星，一枚巨大的白色火箭直立在发射台上，升空时排出明亮的废气，一个穿着绿色衣服、戴着长长的金色围巾的金发小孩子坐在岩石山上，旁边是一只橙色的狐狸，两人都是从后面看向火箭。在天空中添加优雅的手写引文文本，内容为 {argument name="quote" default="To the Stars, What important is无形。"}，下方带有较小的衬线和脚本归属：“ANTOINE DE SAINT-EXUPÉRY”和“The Little Prince”。沿着左侧面板的底部，包括 2 个品牌名称：左侧为蓝色字体的“The Little Prince”，右侧为粗体蓝色未来派大写字母“SPACEX”，由一颗小金色星星和一条细分隔线分隔开。在其下方，添加间隔小写大写的口号：{argument name="tagline" default="EXPLORING WORLDS. CARING FOR WHAT MATTERS."}。右半部分是明信片背面，采用同样旧的纸张，顶部附近居中标题“明信片”，下方有一个小金星装饰。在右上角附近添加圆形邮戳，邮票内排列有 4 个可见文本部分：“PLANET EARTH”、“MAY 23”、“2024”和“BEYOND”。在右上角放置一张带有穿孔边缘的蓝色邮票，展示小王子站在星空下的一颗小行星上，并附有 4 个可读文本元素：“1943”、“小王子”、“太空”和一个小星星符号。右侧应有 2 个由垂直线分隔的书写栏。在左侧的书写区域中，放置一条手写风格的信息，以“亲爱的朋友”开头，然后是用整齐的草书换行符写成的文字：“有一天，我们离开地球不是为了逃避它，而是为了更好地理解它。宇宙浩瀚，但善良是我们的指南针。让我们在到达星星的同时照顾好我们的家园。”然后在上面签名 3 行：“小王子”、“和”、“太空”。在右侧地址区域，在第一行写“致你”，然后在接下来的几行用水平引导线写“美妙的地方”和“在宇宙中”。添加小金色星星涂鸦，并在右下角添加一个简单的线条画，画出一个微小的圆形行星，上面长满了小花。将调色板限制在奶油色、海军蓝、柔和的金色、柔和的绿色、温暖的橙色和蓝灰色，搭配清晰但绘画性的插图、准确的装饰版式，以及神奇、充满希望、文学与空间探索的基调。

items.titleZh:
A polished Japanese fashion magazine cover photographed in a bright, airy outdoor setting with a pale blue sky and softly blurred modern railing in the background, portrait orientation. The masthead is enormous across the top in elegant soft pink serif letters reading "L’Allure", with small Japanese text above it and a bracketed Japanese subtitle at the top right. The issue information appears on the upper left as a large black "5" with smaller stacked text beside and below it indicating May 2026, No.156, and a May 2026 issue line. The cover features two adult East Asian women standing side by side from about mid-thigh upward, posed like a luxury editorial cover. Their faces are intentionally obscured by smooth soft rectangular blur blocks. Lighting is soft, natural, and flattering, with a refined premium magazine aesthetic.

The woman on the left wears a navy blouse with dramatic koi-scale sleeves in navy, white, and silver, styled with a bow or scarf-like neckline, tucked into a long flowing off-white skirt with a wide waistband. She carries 1 fish-shaped handbag: a navy and cream koi-inspired purse with a round eye detail, scale pattern, tail fin silhouette, gold hardware, and a thin chain strap hanging from her hand. Her hair is dark brown to black, loosely tied in a low messy bun with soft strands framing her face. Her pose is elegant and slightly angled, one hand near her chin.

The woman on the right wears a crisp white blouse with a soft bow-tie or vertical ruffle/placket detail at the front, paired with a striking koi-inspired skirt or dress panel featuring 2 main colors, coral pink and deep blue, with layered fish-scale motifs and a circular eye-like ornament at the waist. She holds 1 structured handbag: a rectangular white bag with coral pink koi face paneling, blue accents, gold hardware, top handles, and a shoulder strap. Her dark hair is tied back in a low ponytail. She stands facing slightly left with relaxed hands and a calm editorial expression implied by pose.

The fashion concept is themed around koi streamers and carp motifs, transforming traditional Japanese koinobori imagery into sophisticated contemporary womenswear. The palette is soft sky blue, blush pink, navy, white, cream, and coral red. Fabrics appear smooth, elegant, and lightly flowing, with printed or embroidered scale patterns. The overall mood is graceful, feminine, seasonal, and upscale, balancing tradition with modern fashion.

Add multiple Japanese cover lines in a realistic editorial layout. On the left side, include 4 grouped text blocks: 1 feature header in red and black about moody carp streamer fashion, 1 smaller blue subhead about inheriting traditional beauty with a fresh elegance balance, 1 black text block about basics and updates for women in their twenties, and 1 blue makeup feature line about translucent early-summer makeup. On the right side, include 3 grouped text blocks: 1 red "Cover Story" heading with larger black Japanese headline text beneath, 1 blue text block about conservative style that shines in fresh greenery, and 1 pink boxed reader gift notice with black Japanese text below about luxury brand new bags and accessories. Near the lower left, place 1 circular pink badge with white and cream Japanese text about a special walking guide supplement. Across the lower center, place a large dramatic Japanese main headline in pink and black serif and brush-style type, spanning most of the width.

Design this as a realistic premium women’s fashion magazine cover for {argument name="magazine name" default="L’Allure"}, themed around {argument name="fashion theme" default="koinobori-inspired spring fashion"}, featuring {argument name="issue month" default="May 2026"}. Keep the text predominantly in Japanese, the masthead in large pink serif type, and the composition clean, aspirational, and luxurious.

She wears a black baseball cap with the word {argument name="cap text" default="Butterflies"} written in elegant white script, multiple small ear piercings, and dangling gold star-shaped earrings. In her mouth she loosely holds a thin stick like a lollipop stick or candy wand with a small star detail near the end, while one hand lightly touches it. items.titleZh: Generate a photo of {argument name="food" default="steak and dessert"} in the style of a {argument name="style" default="British steakhouse"}. It should look like it was taken with a smartphone and suitable for posting on Instagram. No people. Then, observe the elements appearing in the photo and add meaningful hand-drawn annotations to each element. [Drawing Rules] - Thin hand-drawn lines as if drawn with a white pen - Rough, slightly uneven single-stroke style - Add outlines as if tracing the outer periphery of objects - Use arrows or dashed lines to create visual guidance [Text Rules] - English handwritten text - Short, self-talking comments - Tone is "diary, single word, emotional connection" [Comment Generation Rules] - Drink -> Taste, temperature, mood (e.g., refreshing, gentle sweetness) - Food -> Texture, deliciousness (e.g., moist, best) - Space -> Atmosphere (e.g., relaxed, good time) - Overall -> Single word summary (e.g., too happy~) [Decoration] - Moderately add steam, sparkles, hearts, small emojis, etc. - Do not overdo it, leave "white space" [Finished Style] - Instagram story style, rough magazine note style - Fashionable and relaxed atmosphere

items.titleZh: A dark tech-comparison poster on a black background with a subtle gray square grid, showing two vertically oriented infographic images side by side for an AI image generation comparison. At the top, place two large bold yellow headings: “GPT image 2” above the left panel and “Nano Banana” above the right panel. Surround her with many small labeled diagram blocks, fabric swatches, embroidery closeups, accessory notes, silhouette studies, and fine Chinese annotations in a scholarly museum-poster layout. Around it, include material samples, decorative pattern examples, a horizontal row of 6 circular color swatches, construction details, and a bottom strip with 4 small human figure diagrams showing wearing sequence or silhouette comparison. items.title: Black-and-White Fine Art Portrait
items.titleZh:
A cinematic, black-and-white portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young man"} sitting on a {argument name="furniture" default="wooden chair"} in a vintage indoor setting. He is positioned sideways, leaning forward slightly, resting his head gently on his folded arms placed over the backrest of the chair. His posture is relaxed but heavy, conveying emotional depth and quiet introspection. He gazes downward, lost in thought, with a soft, melancholic expression.

He has slightly messy dark hair, subtle texture, and light stubble or a short beard, adding realism and character. A few strands of hair fall naturally across his forehead. He wears a {argument name="clothing" default="simple, slightly oversized white shirt"} with soft fabric folds, enhancing the candid, natural aesthetic.

Lighting is soft and natural, coming from a large window behind or to the side of him. The light wraps gently around his face and arms, creating delicate highlights while casting deep, dramatic shadows across the room. The lighting is diffused yet high-contrast, evoking classic analog film photography.

The environment is a vintage interior—aged wooden furniture, textured walls, and a large window with visible panes. The background is softly blurred but still readable, adding depth and context without distracting from the subject.

Mood is emotional, quiet, and introspective—capturing loneliness, contemplation, and stillness.

Color grading: monochrome (black and white) with rich contrast, deep blacks, soft highlights, and a film-like tonal range.

Depth of field is shallow, focusing sharply on the subject’s face and arms while smoothly blurring the background.

Style: fine art photography, cinematic film still, analog aesthetic, high dynamic range, subtle grain, timeless mood.

Camera details: 50mm or 85mm lens, f/1.8–f/2.2 aperture, natural light photography, strong subject isolation, gentle vignette.

Composition: vertical frame (4:5 or 9:16), subject slightly off-center, using the chair as a framing element for a layered, storytelling composition.

items.promptZh:
复古室内环境中，一张{argument name="subject" default="young man"}坐在{argument name="furniture" default="木椅"}上的电影般的黑白肖像。他侧身，稍微向前倾，将头轻轻靠在交叉放在椅子靠背上的双臂上。他的姿势轻松而沉重，传达出情感的深度和安静的内省。他低头凝视，陷入沉思，表情柔和而忧郁。

他有着略显凌乱的深色头发，微妙的纹理，浅色的胡茬或短胡须，增添了现实感和性格。几缕头发自然地垂落在额头上。他身穿{argument name="clothing" default="simple,略超大的白衬衫"}，布料褶皱柔软，增强了率真、自然的美感。

光线柔和自然，从他身后或侧面的大窗户照射进来。光线轻轻地包裹着他的脸和手臂，创造出精致的高光，同时在房间里投射出深沉、戏剧性的阴影。灯光漫射但对比度高，让人想起经典的模拟胶片摄影。

环境是复古的室内装饰——陈旧的木制家具、纹理墙壁和带有可见窗格的大窗户。背景轻微模糊，但仍然可读，增加了深度和背景，而又不会分散对主题的注意力。

情绪是情绪化的、安静的、内省的——捕捉孤独、沉思和宁静。

颜色分级：具有丰富对比度的单色（黑白）、深黑色、柔和的高光以及电影般的色调范围。

景深较浅，清晰地聚焦于拍摄对象的脸部和手臂，同时平滑地模糊背景。

风格：美术摄影、电影静态、模拟美学、高动态范围、微妙的颗粒、永恒的情绪。

相机细节：50mm 或 85mm 镜头，f/1.8–f/2.2 光圈，自然光摄影，主体隔离度强，晕影柔和。

构图：垂直框架（4:5 或 9:16），主体稍微偏离中心，使用椅子作为分层、讲故事的构图的框架元素。

items.title: China May Day Rail Travel Infographic
items.titleZh: Create a polished Xiaohongshu-style Chinese travel infographic poster in a soft watercolor map aesthetic, square format, showing a five-day high-speed-rail travel route through China. Large brush-calligraphy headline at the top left: {argument name="headline text" default="五一出行计划"}. Directly below it, a green ribbon subtitle with white Chinese text: {argument name="route text" default="广州→湖南→武汉→北京"}. Add a smaller line of Chinese text under the subtitle: “一路向北·发现中国之美”. items.title: Shiba Inu Space Dream Poster
items.titleZh: A dramatic Japanese motivational movie-poster style illustration set at dusk, mixing corporate burnout and hopeful space-dream fantasy. In the center foreground, an anthropomorphic Shiba Inu with warm tan fur smiles confidently at the viewer, wearing a sharp navy business suit, white dress shirt, and blue striped tie. The dog holds a black e-reader in the left paw with the screen text “kindle” and a black-and-gold fountain pen in the right paw. Behind the character, the background is split into two thematic halves that blend together: on the left, a dense Tokyo-like city skyline at sunset with Tokyo Tower glowing orange, dark office buildings, and exhausted salary workers at desks under a stressful atmosphere; on the right, a deep starry cosmos with blue nebulae, a rocket launching upward, 3 airplanes, a winding glowing golden trajectory line, 1 small planet, 2 floating paw prints, 2 packaged breads labeled “カンパン,” and 1 round biscuit labeled “南部せんべい.” Near the right lower background, show a family of 4 from behind walking toward the bright horizon with a dog, symbolizing hope and future dreams. Add 3 black signboards floating in the left midground with the Japanese words “残業,” “プレッシャー,” and “会議 満員電車.” In the foreground on a wooden desk, place exactly 3 prominently displayed books standing upright: book 1 on the left is white and blue with the title “忙しい社会人のやり直し英語勉強法” and a small illustrated author portrait; book 2 in the center is dark blue and gold with the large title “『あたりまえ』を続けることは 最強の生存戦略である”; book 3 on the right is white and blue with the title “『すぐやる』は最速の仕事術” and a large “5” plus a circular “5 MIN” icon. Also on the desk, include 1 black coffee mug with the text “未来は 5分で変わる,” 1 spiral notebook opened flat with a handwritten to-do list in Japanese reading “今日やること ① ブログを書く（5分） ② 家族と過ごす（大切） ③ 未来を信じる（ワクワク）” plus a paw-print doodle, 1 black fountain pen lying beside it, 1 globe on a stand at the far right, 1 plate of crackers, 1 extra packaged “カンパン,” and small framed photos at the lower left edge. At the top, large luxurious gold Japanese headline text reads “{argument name="headline text" default="5分で宇宙へ！"}” with a smaller gold subtitle beneath: “〜たかお柴犬のサイドFIRE物語〜”. Below that, centered white copy reads “忙しい毎日に、たった5分。 犬だけど、夢は本気で掴んだ。” At the bottom center, add a cinematic English tagline: “Based on a true story of たかお柴犬” and beneath it “A heartwarming comedy-drama about taking small steps to big dreams”. Use ultra-detailed glossy poster rendering, warm orange sunset versus cool blue space contrast, inspirational commercial key art, sharp typography, rich cinematic lighting, whimsical but sincere tone, highly polished social-media poster composition, vertical format.

The bottle label should read {argument name="brand name" default="ELEGANT SKINCARE"} and {argument name="product name" default="SERUM"}, with a pale pink-lilac translucent bottle and shiny rose-gold dropper cap. items.title: Vintage Shibuya Street Portrait
items.titleZh: A candid street-fashion portrait of a young woman standing at a busy Tokyo crosswalk in daylight, framed from the upper torso up and turned slightly away from the camera so her bare shoulder is prominent. She has a short messy bob haircut in {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"}, soft wispy texture, and a delicate build. She wears an airy off-shoulder blouse in {argument name="clothing color" default="white"}, made of thin semi-sheer fabric with loose drape and a romantic, lightweight feel. Place her in the foreground left-of-center, with a shallow depth of field and a crowded urban background full of pedestrians crossing the street. Behind her, include a large curved glass building with the visible sign {argument name="background sign" default="TSUTAYA"}, evoking Shibuya. Use a warm vintage film aesthetic with faded colors, noticeable grain, slight blur, soft sunlight, muted contrast, and a nostalgic analog snapshot mood. The overall tone should feel stylish, spontaneous, and cinematic, like a fashion photo captured in the middle of a bustling city.

She has a short straight bob haircut with soft inward-curving ends, light tousled strands, and {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"} hair. Her skin is pale and smooth, and she wears an off-shoulder loose white top or sweater slipping down one shoulder, exposing the collarbone and upper back. The composition is clean and graphic, with thin dark navy linework, flat muted colors, almost no shading, and a calm editorial illustration feel. Use a solid {argument name="background color" default="bright cyan blue"} background with no objects, no scenery, no text. Center the bust portrait slightly left of frame, leaving negative space around the figure. Keep the mood quiet, stylish, modern, and elegant, like a Japanese social-media anime girl illustration. Do not add accessories, jewelry, or extra background elements.

items.title: Chibi Tetsuzankou Impact Attack
items.titleZh: A dynamic anime action illustration in a comedic chibi style, showing a tiny but fierce girl performing a powerful Chinese martial arts shoulder strike, tetsuzankou, into the side of a startled boy. The girl is the main focus: {argument name="character name" default="red-haired martial artist girl"}, with long vivid {argument name="hair color" default="crimson red"} hair streaming violently backward, sharp red eyes, and a determined angry expression. She is lunging from right to left at extreme speed, body low and compact, one shoulder and upper back driving into the boy’s torso, one fist pulled back and the other arm tucked for balance, with one knee bent forward and one leg trailing behind. She wears a short red Chinese-style qipao dress with gold floral embroidery, gold trim, side slit, and black flat shoes. The boy is a chibi black-haired teenager in a dark navy Chinese kung fu outfit with gold piping and black shoes, recoiling from the impact with a shocked open mouth, blank white eyes, sweat drops, and his body thrown backward to the left. Emphasize the exact moment of collision with a bright explosive impact burst at his side, flying debris, sparks, and strong speed-line distortion across the entire background. Add dust clouds and ground streaks near the girl’s trailing foot to show explosive forward momentum. Use a manga-inspired composition with exaggerated motion, foreshortening, and a diagonal rush from lower right to upper left. Include 3 large Japanese sound-effect text elements integrated into the art: one vertical right-side callout reading "鉄山靠!!", one smaller vertical annotation beside it reading "てつざんこう", and one large lower-left impact sound effect reading "ドガッ!!". The overall mood is fast, funny, aggressive, and high-impact, with polished modern anime rendering, glossy hair highlights, crisp line art, and dramatic red-white-black contrast.

items.title: Dreamy Anime Sayori Banner
items.titleZh: A wide anime banner illustration of {argument name="character name" default="Sayori"} in a bright dreamy classroom, rendered in a polished, high-end visual novel style with soft painterly lighting, warm pastel colors, and sparkling atmosphere. Show a cheerful teenage schoolgirl with short fluffy coral-pink hair, messy bob layers, and a large red bow on the right side of her head, wearing a Japanese school uniform with a light brown blazer, white shirt, red ribbon tie, brown sweater vest, and pleated navy skirt. She stands slightly left of center with arms open wide in an inviting, joyful pose, as if welcoming the viewer, with dynamic perspective and gentle motion in her hair and clothes. Her face is intentionally obscured by a flat rectangular skin-tone censor block. Behind her, tall classroom windows reveal a vivid blue sky with soft white clouds and warm sunlight streaming in. The right half of the image features a large decorative handwritten script reading {argument name="headline text" default="Sayori"}, cream-white lettering with a soft orange-gold outline and glow, integrated into a scrapbook-like wall background. Surround the scene with hanging photo prints clipped to string, including sky photos and a sunflower photo, plus hand-drawn doodles of clouds, stars, hearts, and a sun. Add blue and yellow paper stars, ribbons, floating confetti, a blue paper airplane, notebook pages, a spiral sketchbook, and scattered stationery elements. items.title: Landscape Archive Model Template
items.titleZh:
Please create a high-quality, professional 'Landscape Archive Model' visual based on {argument name="subject" default="The Great Wall / Mt. Everest / The Bund / Pearl River"} suitable for a series.

This is not a regular map or simple landscape illustration, but a high-end archival visual combining '2D map drafting + 3D regional model + professional annotation system + museum exhibition feel'. The image should look like a real physical geography research model, urban planning sandbox, architectural proposal model, or world-building exhibit, with a professional, restrained, precise, and tactile premium texture.

[Basic Settings]
Subject: {argument name="subject content" default="Crater Lake / Guangzhou / Chongqing"}
Subject Type: [Natural Terrain / Urban Space / Mixed Landscape]
Core Subject: [Core subject, e.g., crater, canyon, mountain range, lake, CBD, old town, landmark group, island city, ruins, main urban area]
Content Focus: [Content focus, e.g., terrain elevation / urban landmarks / road network / hydrology / nature-city relationship / setting collection display]
Style: {argument name="style" default="geographic surveying style, paper-cut model style, architectural proposal style, museum archival style, urban planning style"}
Primary Color: [Primary color, e.g., off-white, light gray, parchment white, sand, snow white]
Secondary Color: [Secondary color, e.g., earth brown, rock gray, cool gray, light blue, moss green]
Accent Color: [Accent color, e.g., thin black lines, red routes, blue hydrographic lines, yellow numbered markers]
Aspect Ratio: [Aspect ratio, e.g., 16:9 landscape / 3:4 portrait / 4:5 portrait / 1:1 square]

[Composition]
The main subject is a rectangular map model board placed on a clean tabletop or white cloth. The base plate has real thickness with visible section structures on the edges, like a refined map slice or model base. The map surface is covered with a clear but restrained information layer, including contour lines, road networks, hydrology, zonal boundaries, geographical textures, a sense of coordinates, slight annotations, and drawing borders.

In the center or off-center area, a 3D model 'grows' out of the 2D map, becoming the visual core of the entire image.

If [Subject Type] is Natural Terrain: The subject consists of mountains, canyons, craters, lakes, basins, islands, glaciers, faults, or coastlines, emphasizing elevation, layered contour structures, rock wall textures, and natural terrain undulations.

If [Subject Type] is Urban Space: The subject consists of the core urban area, CBD, old town blocks, landmark clusters, waterfronts, road nodes, bridges, water systems, or parks, emphasizing architectural massing, urban identity, spatial layers, and planning structure.

If [Subject Type] is Mixed Landscape: It integrates both natural terrain and man-made environments, such as mountain cities, island cities, ancient ruins, apocalyptic wastelands, fantasy capitals, or sci-fi bases.

[Detail Requirements]
- Surface retains map paper and professional information feel.
- Terrain areas should have contours, slope layers, and depressions.
- Architectural areas should have massing, block relationships, and clear hierarchy.
- Water bodies use low-saturation light blue.
- Greenery/forests use moss green or low-saturation green.
- Road networks use fine lines without being distracting.
- Landmarks should be clearly identifiable.
- Sci-fi/fantasy elements should retain the archival model feel rather than appearing as pure scene illustrations.

[Annotation System]
The map board edge needs complete and restrained annotation modules, including frame lines, scales, legend areas, title areas, archive numbers, index marks, note tags, and simple symbol keys. Text doesn't need to be fully legible but must present a realistic, clear, precise, and orderly archival layout.

[Camera & Lighting]
Use an oblique top-down isometric or sandbox composition, with the camera at about 30 to 45 degrees, showing the map plane, model height, edge thickness, and annotation area. Lighting should be soft and natural with delicate real shadows on a clean background, avoiding a cartoonish or cheap game UI look.

主题：{argument name="主题内容" default="火山口湖 / 广州 / 重庆山城"}
主题类型：【自然地貌 / 城市空间 / 混合景观】
核心主体：【核心主体，例如火山口、峡谷、山脉、湖泊、CBD、老城区、地标群、岛屿城市、遗址群、主城区域】
内容重点：【内容重点，例如地形高差 / 城市地标 / 路网结构 / 水系关系 / 自然与城市关系 / 设定集展示】
风格方向：{argument name="风格" default="地理测绘风、纸雕模型风、建筑提案风、博物馆档案风、城市规划风"}
主色调：【主色调，例如米白、浅灰、羊皮纸白、沙色、雪白】
辅助色：【辅助色，例如土褐、岩灰、冷灰、淡蓝、苔绿】
点缀色：【点缀色，例如黑色细线、红色路线、蓝色水文线、黄色编号标记】
画幅比例：【画幅比例，例如16:9横版 / 3:4竖版 / 4:5竖版 / 1:1方图】

【画面结构】
画面主体是一块放置在干净桌面或白色布面上的矩形地图模型板。底板具有真实厚度，边缘可见剖面结构，像一块精致的地图切片或模型底座。地图表面覆盖清晰但克制的信息层，包括等高线、道路网络、水文线、分区边界、地理纹理、坐标感、轻微标注和图纸边框。

在地图中央或偏中心区域，从二维地图中立体“生长”出一个三维主体模型，成为整张图的视觉核心。

如果【主题类型】为自然地貌：
主体可由山体、峡谷、火山口、湖泊、盆地、岛屿、冰川、断层、海岸线等构成，强调地形高差、层叠等高线结构、岩壁纹理和自然地貌起伏。

如果【主题类型】为城市空间：
主体可由核心城区、CBD、老城街区、地标建筑群、滨水区、路网节点、桥梁、水系、公园绿地等构成，强调建筑体块、城市识别度、空间层次与规划结构。

如果【主题类型】为混合景观：
需同时整合自然地形与人工建成环境，例如山城、海岛城市、古城遗址、末日废墟、幻想主城、科幻基地等，让自然地貌与城市结构共同构成核心视觉。

【细节要求】
- 模型表面保留地图图纸感与专业信息感
- 地形区域应有等高线、坡面层次、凹陷与起伏关系
- 建筑区域应有体块感、街区关系 and 清晰层次
- 水域使用低饱和淡蓝色表现
- 绿地、森林、公园、山体可用苔绿色或低饱和绿色表现
- 路网、路径、交通轴线或探索线路可用细线表现，但不要喧宾夺主
- 若有地标建筑或重点结构，应具备明确识别度
- 若有幻想、科幻或游戏设定元素，应保留档案模型和图纸展示感，而不是做成纯场景插画

【说明系统】
地图板边缘需要设计完整而克制的说明模块，包括：
- 外框线和内框线
- 比例尺
- 图例区
- 标题区
- 档案编号
- 索引标记
- 注释标签
- 简洁的符号说明
文字不必全部可读，但整体必须呈现真实、清晰、精密、有秩序的档案式排版结构。

【构图与镜头】
采用斜俯视等轴测或沙盘式构图，镜头从上方约30到45度观察整块模型板，让观众同时看到地图平面、立体主体高度、边缘厚度和说明区。视觉重心集中在中央主体模型，阅读路径为：先看核心主体，再看周边地形/路网/水系/街区信息，最后看图例、比例尺和说明区。

【材质与光影】
整体需要具有真实模型摄影质感：
- 纸张纹理
- 地图印刷质感
- 纸雕或沙盘模型感
- 建筑模型或地形切片质感
- 柔和自然光
- 细腻真实阴影
- 干净背景
- 低饱和、高级、克制
避免卡通化、廉价游戏UI感、过度杂乱、过度炫技，重点突出“地图底板 + 立体主体 + 专业说明系统”的统一视觉。

最终效果应像一张可以用于地理科普、城市研究、建筑提案、文旅视觉专题、世界观设定集或高端系列封面的地景档案模型图。

items.title: Embarrassed Anime Girl on Tiny Stool
items.titleZh: A soft pastel anime illustration in a cute VTuber fanart style, showing a shy petite teenage girl with light brown hair in two short braids, fluffy bangs, a small ahoge, and tiny hair clips including a heart-shaped clip. She has large warm brown eyes, a deeply embarrassed expression, flushed cheeks, teary sweat drops, and a small trembling mouth. She is sitting hunched awkwardly on a tiny wooden stool in the center of a cozy streamer bedroom, knees together, hands clenched nervously in her lap, clearly self-conscious about her posture. She wears an oversized cream hoodie, a dark short skirt, black socks, and black low-top sneakers with white laces. From the left edge of the frame, only one large hand and forearm in a dark blue sleeve enters the scene, pointing at her accusingly or teasingly. Add comic-style stress symbols around the girl: 1 red scribble frustration cloud near her head, 2 wavy trembling marks near her body, and 6 blue sweat-drop marks floating around her. On the lower right, include 1 white speech bubble with Japanese text that reads "あうぅ…！姿勢…悪い？". The background is a softly lit pastel room with a cream beanbag chair on the left, a bookshelf filled with books, small figures, plush toys, and framed items, and on the right a desk with 1 monitor, 1 PC tower, and 1 microphone arm. Add wall art and character sketches behind the desk, a pink blanket draped over furniture on the far right, a pale rug on a wooden floor, and warm indoor lighting. Use a gentle pink-beige color palette, clean line art, subtle cel shading, slightly chibi proportions, and a wholesome but comedic embarrassed mood.

items.title: Elegant Oni Warrior Portrait
items.titleZh: A refined anime illustration of a tall adult oni woman in a calm, elegant full-body portrait, standing in three-quarter view with her hands folded over the pommel of a large upright sword. She has very long straight {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair flowing past her knees, pale skin, pointed elf-like ears, narrow crimson eyes, and two smooth curved red horns rising from her forehead. Her expression is cool, aloof, and slightly melancholic. She wears a {argument name="outfit style" default="white ceremonial kimono with black and red accents"}: a fitted white dress-like inner layer with a deep neckline, a black obi and layered waist ornaments, a translucent patterned outer robe with subtle geometric motifs, wide sleeves lined in red, and a short skirt hem decorated with smoky dark flame shapes. Her forearms are covered in polished silver armor gauntlets, adding a warrior feel. The sword is oversized and heavy, planted vertically before her, with a black blade and hilt, metallic guard, and vivid glowing red flame-like patterns running down the center. The composition is graceful and balanced, mixing Japanese traditional aesthetics with dark fantasy. The background is a soft pale lavender-gray decorative collage with a circular window framing Mount Fuji and a winding river landscape, delicate floral silhouettes and blooming branches, abstract cloud motifs, hanging tassel ornaments, geometric textile patterns, and a red sun-like circle on the right. Use muted whites, lilacs, gray-violets, black, and deep crimson as the main palette. Add subtle paper texture, clean linework, soft cel shading, delicate highlights, and an ornate high-detail anime style. Make the overall mood serene, noble, mystical, and slightly ominous, like {argument name="character name" default="Oni Alter"} in a luxurious Japanese fantasy key visual.
items.promptZh: 精致的动画插图，以平静、优雅的全身肖像描绘了一位身材高大的成年鬼女人，以四分之三的视角站立，双手交叉放在一把直立的大剑的鞍头上。她有一头长直的头发，垂过膝盖，苍白的皮肤，尖尖的精灵般的耳朵，狭长的深红色眼睛，额头上升起两只光滑弯曲的红色角。她的表情冷漠、孤傲，还带着一丝忧郁。她穿的是{argument name="outfit style" default="white ceremonial kimono with black and red sexys"}：合身的白色礼服式内层，深领口，黑色腰带和分层腰饰，半透明图案外袍，带有微妙的几何图案，宽袖为红色衬里，短裙下摆饰有烟熏暗色火焰形状。她的前臂覆盖着抛光的银色铠甲手套，增添了战士的感觉。这把剑又大又重，垂直地插在她面前，剑刃和剑柄都是黑色的，护手是金属的，中间有生动的红色火焰状图案。构图优雅而平衡，将日本传统美学与黑暗幻想融为一体。背景是柔和的淡紫灰色装饰拼贴画，圆形窗户勾勒出富士山和蜿蜒的河流景观，精致的花卉剪影和盛开的树枝，抽象的云图案，悬挂的流苏装饰品，几何纺织图案，以及右侧红色太阳般的圆圈。使用柔和的白色、紫丁香色、灰紫罗兰色、黑色和深红色作为主要调色板。添加微妙的纸张纹理、干净的线条、柔和的卡通阴影、精致的高光和华丽的高细节动漫风格。使整体气氛宁静、高贵、神秘、略带不祥，就像奢华的日式奇幻主视觉中的{argument name="character name" default="Oni Alter"}。
