items.title: Neumorphic Glass UI Kit Board
items.titleZh: A clean neumorphic UI component showcase on a soft light gray background, arranged as a balanced design board of 18 separate interface elements with subtle shadows, frosted translucent white plastic surfaces, rounded corners, and glossy glass-like depth. Use a premium minimal product-design aesthetic with white-on-white layering, soft ambient occlusion, delicate inner shadows, and a restrained accent palette of deep teal green and vivid orange. Include 18 distinct components: 1 large circular rotary knob in the upper left with a dark teal glossy center, fine radial tick marks, and a small orange position indicator; 1 small circular directional control pad with a teal center button and four tiny arrow icons around it; 1 circular play button with a teal triangle icon and a short orange progress arc on the rim; 1 horizontal pill toggle switch at the top right with a teal knob positioned to the right; 1 rounded square heart button with a simple teal outline heart; 1 small circular indicator button with a single orange dot in the center; 1 pill-shaped plus-minus control with a teal minus on the left and teal plus on the right separated by a vertical divider; 1 long horizontal volume slider with a teal speaker icon on the left, fine slider ticks, a teal track, a teal knob near the right side, and a faint waveform icon on the far right; 1 circular percentage dial showing 60% with radial ticks and a few orange highlight marks near the upper right; 1 rounded square bell notification button with a teal outline bell icon; 1 compact music player card with a small square album image of misty evergreen trees on the left, the title {argument name="track title" default="Forest Drive"}, the subtitle {argument name="track subtitle" default="Ambient Journey"}, a thin progress bar, and a circular play button on the right; 4 small circular utility icon buttons in one row showing sliders/settings, search, share, and ellipsis; 1 large circular compass with cardinal letters N, E, S, W plus diagonal labels, a teal-and-orange needle, and metallic center; 1 tall vertical slider on the right with a teal track, teal knob around the middle, small side dots, an orange accent near the bottom, and a tiny speaker icon below; 1 bottom navigation bar in a long rounded pill containing 4 icons separated by subtle dividers: home, bar chart, compass, and user profile, with the home tab active in teal; items.titleZh: A clean neumorphic mobile dashboard UI mockup shown straight-on, centered on a soft light gray background, inside a white rounded smartphone frame with subtle embossed shadows and glossy soft highlights. The interface uses a minimalist white-on-white design with teal green and warm orange accent colors. At the very top of the phone, include a small circular menu button on the left, a centered speaker slit and front camera dot, and status icons on the right showing Wi‑Fi, signal, 100%, and battery. The main layout contains 12 distinct UI modules: 1 large time card at upper left showing “AM”, “10:24”, and “Friday, May 24” with three tiny pagination dots beneath; 1 weather card at upper right showing a soft 3D partly cloudy sun icon, “24°”, “Partly Cloudy”, and “New York”; 4 small circular action buttons in one row under the time card, showing a grid icon, heart, bell, and gear, with the grid button filled in dark teal; 1 slim horizontal slider card to the right of those buttons with a droplet icon, “40%”, and a teal progress bar; 1 large circular volume control occupying the left middle area, with a thick beveled silver knob, a surrounding tick-mark ring split into teal on the left and orange on the right, a short orange indicator line near the upper right, tiny speaker icons on both sides, and a pill label reading “VOLUME”; 1 music player card on the right middle with square album art in dark teal waves, the title “Ocean Drive”, subtitle “Miami Nights”, a thin orange playback progress line with times “1:45” and “3:48”, and three circular transport controls for previous, play, and next, with the play button filled teal; 3 small rounded buttons in a row beneath the music player, showing an equalizer icon filled teal, a broadcast icon, and sliders icon; 1 compass card at lower left with small circular buttons in the top corners, heading text “320° NW” above, and a detailed analog compass with N, E, S, W letters and a teal-and-orange needle pointing northwest; 1 equalizer card at lower right with four vertical sliders, scale markings “+12”, “0”, “-12”, and bottom frequency labels “60”, “250”, “1K”, “4K”, “16K”, using orange slider stems and white knobs; and 5 bottom dock controls: an orange circular power button, a small Bluetooth button, a central pill waveform panel, a crescent moon button, and a sun brightness button. Use soft ambient shadows, gentle inner embossing, rounded corners, precise spacing, and a premium futuristic smart-home or control-center aesthetic inspired by high-end dribbble neumorphism, ultra-detailed, crisp vector UI, realistic depth, polished product presentation.
items.promptZh: 一个干净的拟态移动仪表板 UI 模型直接显示，以柔和的浅灰色背景为中心，位于白色圆形智能手机框架内，具有微妙的浮雕阴影和光滑的柔和高光。界面采用简约的白底白字设计，搭配青绿色和暖橙色强调色。在手机的最顶部，左侧有一个小圆形菜单按钮、居中的扬声器狭缝和前置摄像头点，右侧的状态图标显示 Wi-Fi、信号、100% 和电池。主布局包含 12 个不同的 UI 模块：左上角有 1 个大时间卡，显示“AM”、“10:24”和“Friday, May 24”，下面有三个小分页点；右上角有一张天气卡，显示柔和的 3D 晴间多云太阳图标、“24°”、“晴间多云”和“纽约”；时间卡下方排成一排 4 个小圆形操作按钮，显示网格图标、心形、铃铛和齿轮，网格按钮填充为深青色；这些按钮右侧有 1 个细长的水平滑块卡，带有水滴图标“40%”和青色进度条； 1 个大型圆形音量控制，占据左侧中间区域，带有一个厚斜面银色旋钮，周围的刻度环分为左侧青色和右侧橙色，右上角附近有一条短橙色指示线，两侧有微小的扬声器图标，以及一个写有“音量”的药丸标签；右侧中间有 1 个音乐播放器卡，带有深青色波浪的方形专辑封面、标题“Ocean Drive”、副标题“Miami Nights”、带有时间“1:45”和“3:48”的细橙色播放进度线，以及三个用于上一首、播放和下一首的圆形传输控件，播放按钮填充青色；音乐播放器下方排成一排的 3 个小圆形按钮，显示青色的均衡器图标、广播图标和滑块图标；左下角有 1 个指南针卡，顶角有小圆形按钮，上方有标题文字“320° NW”，以及带有 N、E、S、W 字母的详细模拟指南针以及指向西北的青色和橙色指针；右下角有1个均衡器卡，有四个垂直滑块，刻度标记“+12”、“0”、“-12”，底部频率标签“60”、“250”、“1K”、“4K”、“16K”，使用橙色滑块杆和白色旋钮；和 5 个底部底座控件：一个橙色圆形电源按钮、一个小蓝牙按钮、一个中央药丸波形面板、一个新月按钮和一个太阳亮度按钮。使用柔和的环境阴影、柔和的内部浮雕、圆角、精确的间距以及受高端运球同态性启发的高级未来派智能家居或控制中心美学、超详细、清晰的矢量 UI、逼真的深度、精美的产品演示。

items.titleZh: Create a premium neumorphic smart-home and media control UI kit on a clean light gray background, arranged as a balanced dashboard-style composition of floating rounded cards and circular controls with soft extruded shadows, subtle inner highlights, frosted white surfaces, and elegant teal-and-orange accents. The overall style is minimalist, futuristic, tactile, and highly polished, like a high-end mobile interface concept. Include exactly 18 discrete UI modules and icons: 1 large circular volume knob card in the upper left with a glossy deep teal center, dotted perimeter, plus and minus symbols, and the text “VOLUME 67%”; items.titleZh:
A high-fashion surrealist advertising poster for {argument name="brand" default="Crocs"}. The scene is set in a minimalist, monochrome {argument name="background color" default="light blue"} studio with a semi-reflective floor. 
The central focus is an oversized, giant white Croc clog positioned on its heel at a diagonal angle, serving as a backrest. A fashion model with long dark hair, dressed in a {argument name="clothing" default="clean, all-white coordinated sweatshirt and wide-leg trousers"}, leans her entire back against the giant shoe in a relaxed, leaning posture. She is facing right in profile, looking ahead with a serene expression, and wearing standard-sized white Crocs.
In the background, the word "CROCS" is written in massive, bold, white condensed sans-serif typography, partially occluded by the giant shoe and the model to create a sense of depth. At the  top right, "Designed with ChatGPT" 
At the bottom center, a white sans-serif tagline reads: "Made for comfort, worn for confidence. Because life feels better when your feet stop complaining." The lighting is soft, cool, and even, casting gentle shadows and a soft reflection of the subjects on the glossy blue floor. The overall aesthetic is clean, modern, and high-concept.

Make the aspect ratio 3:4

items.title: Industrial Design Presentation Sheet
items.titleZh:
Core Subject: [{argument name="reference" default="use the uploaded image"}, keep the details, typography and structure locked 100%]

Layout & Composition: A {argument name="presentation type" default="professional industrial design presentation sheet"}. The image should be organized into a clean grid system.

Top Row: A 3x3 layout showing top-down flat lay views and close-up macro details of materials.

Middle Section: Three hero shots of the product standing upright in different color ways (Matte Black, Arctic White, and accented variants). The products should be slightly tilted to show depth and form.

Bottom Section: A dynamic "floating" composition featuring two products overlapping at opposing angles to showcase the front and side profiles simultaneously.

Environment & Lighting: Set against a minimalist, neutral studio gray background. Soft top-down lighting with realistic contact shadows. High-end product photography aesthetic.

Style & Finish: Matte textures, clean silhouettes, and sharp edges. Leave designated blank areas on the product surfaces for "Placeholder Branding" and "Graphic Mockups." 4k resolution, Unreal Engine 5 render style, hyper-realistic, clean aesthetic.

items.titleZh: A clean presentation grid of 20 modern mobile app logo concepts for nutrition, calorie tracking, healthy eating, food recognition, and AI wellness tools, shown on a vivid electric-blue background with soft studio lighting and subtle shadows. Arrange the icons in 4 rows by 5 columns, evenly spaced, each as a glossy rounded-square app tile with premium iOS-style depth, smooth gradients, glassy highlights, and crisp 3D-rendered detail. The color palette should center on saturated blues, cyan, teal, white, lime green, and small accents of orange and yellow. Include exactly 20 distinct icon designs: 1) a meal bowl with avocado, grains, broccoli, and cherry tomatoes framed by a camera scan bracket, 2) a white fork beside four horizontal nutrition bars in green, yellow, red, and blue on a dark navy tile, 3) a camera lens with a small bowl of vegetables in front, 4) a circular blue badge with the text {argument name="headline text" default="kcal"} and a green leaf overlapping the lower edge, 5) a teal-blue icon with the text {argument name="brand text" default="Ai"} above a white bowl and two sparkles, 6) a glossy green apple with circuit traces and nodes suggesting food-tech AI, 7) a halved avocado centered inside a glowing scan frame, 8) a metallic spoon with a blue lightning bolt symbol and curved tracking lines, 9) a circular segmented nutrition meter in green, orange, and red around salmon and broccoli, 10) a divided plate containing grilled chicken, broccoli, rice, blueberries, and a small ascending analytics bar chart, 11) a camera lens on a white tile with a green leaf attached, 12) a glowing green apple inside a scan bracket with a sparkle, 13) a luminous circular activity ring in blue, green, yellow, and orange on a dark tile, 14) a blue shield with a white fork in the center, 15) a yogurt or oatmeal bowl topped with strawberries, blueberries, and granola inside a scan bracket, 16) a dark navy calorie icon with the text {argument name="calorie text" default="kcal"}, a curved glow, one sparkle, and a tiny bar chart, 17) a mint-green square with a white circuit-tree or branching chip motif, 18) a plated healthy meal with grilled chicken, avocado, tomatoes, and greens inside a scan bracket, 19) a dark bowl of blueberries and white yogurt or cream with a bright electric lightning bolt overlay, 20) a pastel aqua 3D cube icon featuring a fork-and-plate symbol on one face and a green leaf on another. Make the overall style highly polished, slightly futuristic, commercially viable for App Store branding, with consistent visual language across all 20 icons, no extra text beyond the visible short labels, and a premium AI-generated product-design aesthetic.

He wears a cream tunic with a black world-tree emblem on the chest, long black undersleeves, dark pants, brown boots with wide cuffs, a brown belt with a rectangular buckle, and a large rust-red hooded cloak draped over both shoulders and flowing around the body. items.title: Blue Couture Group Portrait
items.titleZh: A luxurious studio fashion portrait of {argument name="group size" default="four"} elegant young women posed closely together in a dramatic royal-blue fantasy setting, all wearing coordinated deep sapphire and midnight-navy couture evening gowns with glittering beadwork, floral appliqué, sequins, lace sleeves, sheer mesh details, and voluminous layered skirts. The scene is monochromatic blue with a cool, moody, high-end editorial color grade. Arrange the women in a tight triangular composition: two standing or elevated in the back and two seated in front on draped fabric, with varied graceful poses, one woman raising an arm above her head, one leaning slightly, one seated upright, and one resting her chin on her hand. Their dresses should each be distinct but harmonized, featuring ornate crystal embellishments, embroidered flowers, and fitted bodices. Add matching sapphire jewelry including dangling earrings, gemstone necklaces, and floral hair accessories. Use long flowing hair in mixed dark black and soft light brown tones, styled smooth and glamorous. Surround them with opulent set dressing: 2 classical urn vases filled with blue roses, 1 fluted stone column in the background, heavy shimmering velvet curtains, and abundant draped satin fabric pooling around them. Lighting should be soft and diffused with subtle highlights on satin and jewels, creating a regal, mysterious, romantic atmosphere. Shoot as a vertical fashion editorial portrait, waist-up to full seated composition, highly detailed fabric textures, polished luxury beauty campaign aesthetic, no visible text.

items.title: Glass Reality Weaver in Cosmic Hall
items.titleZh: A monumental cosmic fantasy scene in ultra-detailed cinematic digital art: a giant seated humanoid figure made of transparent glass and liquid crystal occupies the left-center of the composition, its body filled with luminous internal filaments, refractive highlights, and delicate swirling patterns under the surface. The figure is posed like a divine artisan or reality-weaver, with 2 raised hands stretching and pinching an enormous veil of glowing golden threads across the right side of the image. The face is smooth and indistinct, almost mannequin-like, with no readable expression, emphasizing the sculptural body and the play of light through translucent skin. The woven sheet of light acts like a living tapestry or membrane, and inside it appears an entire fantastical world: 1 elevated bridge, 1 radiant futuristic city with slender towers and domes, multiple terraces, glowing architecture, and 3 prominent clusters of dark green trees growing on floating or elevated landforms. The environment around the giant is a vast celestial hall with ornate archways and branching, feather-like filigree structures made of gold light, opening into a deep midnight-blue, star-filled sky. The floor is black polished mirror stone with strong reflections of the figure, the golden threads, and the architecture. In the foreground, place 5 reflective metallic or glass spheres of varying size resting on the floor, catching the surrounding gold and blue light. Emphasize dramatic refraction through the glass body, shimmering caustics, intricate threadlike light trails, and rich reflections on the glossy ground. items.promptZh: 超详细的电影数字艺术中的一个巨大的宇宙奇幻场景：一个由透明玻璃和液晶制成的巨大坐姿人形人物占据了构图的左侧中心，其身体充满了发光的内部细丝、折射高光和表面下精致的漩涡图案。这个人物的姿势就像一位神圣的工匠或现实编织者，两只举起的手伸展并捏住图像右侧的巨大的发光金线面纱。脸部光滑而模糊，几乎像人体模型，没有任何可读的表情，强调雕塑般的身体和光线透过半透明皮肤的作用。编织的光片就像一张活生生的挂毯或薄膜，在它的内部呈现出一个完整的奇幻世界：一座高架桥、一座拥有细长塔楼和圆顶的光芒四射的未来城市、多个露台、发光的建筑，以及生长在漂浮或高架地貌上的 3 个突出的深绿色树木丛。巨人周围的环境是一个巨大的天体大厅，里面有华丽的拱门和由金光制成的分支、羽毛状的金丝结构，通向深邃的午夜蓝色、布满星星的天空。地板是黑色抛光镜面石，人物、金线和建筑都有强烈的反射。在前景中，将 5 个不同大小的反光金属或玻璃球放在地板上，捕捉周围的金色和蓝色光线。强调通过玻璃体的戏剧性折射、闪烁的焦散、复杂的线状光迹以及光滑地面上的丰富反射。调色板：深海军蓝、黑色、银蓝色和亮金色。情绪：令人敬畏、神秘、神圣、富有远见。高度复杂的巴洛克科幻奇幻美学、广角构图、史诗般的规模、锐利的细节、体积发光、超现实主义。

items.titleZh: A nostalgic watercolor anime poster on textured off-white paper, composed as a vertical double-exposure illustration inspired by late-1990s adventure anime. The main silhouette is the left-side profile of a young boy wearing large swim goggles pushed up on his head, his face turned to the right, with the silhouette filled by a dreamlike montage of memories and fantasy scenes. Inside the upper center of the silhouette, show 8 children from behind standing together on a ridge and looking toward a glowing, distant crystalline tower beneath a circular celestial portal in a cloudy blue-violet sky; include 7 small creature companions among them. On the upper right inside the silhouette, place a large dragon-like monster emerging from the clouds. Near the center, add a glowing round handheld digital device with a small screen, radiating light. In the middle-lower area, depict 2 iconic small dinosaur-like creatures sitting above an old shrine approach, one purple horned creature and one small yellow reptilian creature. In the lower area, show a mossy torii gate, overgrown stone steps, utility poles, and a small rural train on the right, all wrapped in mist and foliage. At the very bottom, include the 8 children again as tiny silhouettes walking away together along a path, reinforcing the theme of friendship and remembrance. Use soft ink-and-watercolor washes, muted blues, indigo, lavender, sepia, and warm golden highlights, with splattered pigment edges and painterly cloud textures. items.title: Gritty Evangelion Poster
items.titleZh: A dramatic vintage anime poster in the style of a gritty sci-fi mecha key visual, featuring three teenage pilots standing back-to-back in the foreground and a towering purple biomechanical robot looming directly behind them. The center pilot is a slim teenage boy in a dark navy and black plug suit with white shoulder panels and a glowing red circular core on the chest, standing front-facing with a serious expression. On the left is a pale teenage girl with short icy blue bob-cut hair and a white futuristic bodysuit, turned slightly away in profile. On the right is a teenage girl with long auburn hair flowing to the side, wearing a vivid red plug suit, looking outward with determination. Behind all three, the giant mecha head dominates the composition, centered and symmetrical, with a single horn, glowing orange eyes, angular armor, and massive shoulder structures rising like black wings. The background is outer space with 2 visible celestial bodies: 1 huge cratered moon directly behind the mecha’s head and 1 smaller planet at the right side. The bottom of the poster shows a ruined futuristic cityscape with broken buildings, rubble, sparks, and debris. At the very bottom center, include 2 tiny human silhouettes running forward through destruction, framed by pink energy streaks arcing left and right. Use a dark indigo, black, purple, rust red, and ash gray palette with heavy film grain, distressed ink texture, weathered paper wear, paint splatter, scratched print damage, and a rough screen-printed poster finish. Compose it as a full theatrical one-sheet with dense typography integrated into the edges: large vertical English title text on the left reading "NEON GENESIS EVANGELION", smaller vertical red text beside it reading "HIRANO OF EVANGELION", a red NERV insignia and the word "NERV" near the lower left, a boxed label at bottom left reading "TOKYO-3" and "JAPAN", a red warning box at the upper right reading "ANGEL ATTACK" with Japanese characters beneath, and multiple vertical Japanese taglines along the left and right borders. Cinematic, moody, apocalyptic, highly detailed, iconic 1990s anime poster design with premium modern illustration quality.
items.promptZh: 一张戏剧性的复古动漫海报，采用坚韧的科幻机甲主视觉风格，三名青少年飞行员背靠背站在前景中，一个高耸的紫色生物力学机器人隐约出现在他们身后。中间的飞行员是一名身材苗条的十几岁男孩，身穿深海军蓝和黑色插头套装，肩部镶有白色，胸前有一个发光的红色圆形核心，面朝前方站立，表情严肃。左边是一个面色苍白的少女，留着冰蓝色的鲍勃短发，穿着白色的未来派紧身衣，侧面稍微转过身。右边是一名赤褐色长发披散在侧的少女，穿着鲜艳的红色塞子套装，目光坚定地看着外面。在这三个人的身后，巨大的机甲头部占据了构图的主导地位，居中且对称，有一个角，发光的橙色眼睛，棱角分明的装甲，以及像黑色翅膀一样升起的巨大肩部结构。背景是外太空，有 2 个可见的天体：机甲头部正后方有 1 个巨大的陨石坑月亮，右侧有 1 个较小的行星。海报的底部展示了一个被毁坏的未来城市景观，其中有破碎的建筑物、瓦砾、火花和碎片。在最底部的中心，有两个微小的人类轮廓在毁灭中向前奔跑，周围是左右弧形的粉红色能量条纹。使用深靛蓝、黑色、紫色、铁锈红和灰灰色调色板，具有厚重的胶片颗粒、仿旧的墨水纹理、风化的纸张磨损、油漆飞溅、划痕的印刷损坏和粗糙的丝网印刷海报表面。将其组成完整的戏剧单页，边缘集成密集的排版：左侧较大的垂直英文标题文字为“NEON GENESIS EVANGELION”，旁边较小的垂直红色文字为“HIRANO OF EVANGELION”，红色 NERV 徽章和左下角附近的“NERV”一词，左下角的盒装标签为“TOKYO-3”和“JAPAN”，右上角的红色警告框为“ANGEL”攻击”下方有日语字符，左右边框上有多个垂直的日语标语。电影般的、喜怒无常的、世界末日般的、高度详细的、标志性的 20 世纪 90 年代动漫海报设计，具有优质的现代插图质量。

items.titleZh: A dark, gritty Chinese crime-thriller movie poster in a vertical one-sheet layout, with a moody neo-noir aesthetic and heavy cinematic contrast. The composition centers on a half-length portrait of a menacing middle-aged East Asian man with wavy black hair, wearing a dark textured overcoat over a black shirt, his face mostly swallowed by shadow, shown from chest up and slightly off-center to the right. His hands are visible in the lower-right area, calmly holding a string of dark wooden prayer beads, suggesting power, danger, and ritual. The background is a dim urban alley or old city street at night, layered with grunge textures, wet pavement reflections, decayed walls, and faint architectural silhouettes. In the lower center, place 1 small back-facing seated figure in a chair under a harsh spotlight, surrounded by 9 standing human silhouettes in the darkness, creating a tense interrogation or underworld confrontation scene. Use an almost monochrome palette of black, charcoal, and dirty gray, with deep blood-red accents and distressed white typography. On the left side, add 1 huge vertical column of expressive red Chinese brush-calligraphy title text, painted with rough splashes and dry-brush texture, dominating nearly the full height of the poster. Along the far left edge, add 2 vertical lines of smaller Chinese text in white and red: "我叫高启强，" and "风浪越大，鱼越贵". On the right side, add 1 vertical cast credit line in white Chinese text with a red circular separator: "张颂文 饰 高启强". In the lower-right quadrant, add 1 bold white brushstroke Chinese subtitle/title mark reading "狂飙", with the small English subtitle "THE KNOCKOUT" in red serif capitals beneath it. Add tiny faint Chinese release or tagline text along the bottom edge. The overall feeling should be oppressive, violent, prestigious, and highly designed, like a premium streaming-platform crime drama key art poster, with layered depth, dramatic shadows, textured smoke and grime, and realistic photographic detail.

items.title: Bursting Soap Bubble Macro Photo
items.titleZh: A high-speed macro photograph of a soap bubble bursting in a sunlit garden, framed horizontally. On the far left edge, show the side profile of a young child with visible cheek, nose, lips, and part of one closed or half-closed eye, gently blowing toward the bubble. Place 1 large soap bubble near the center-left of the frame. The left half of the bubble remains intact as a smooth, glossy, iridescent sphere with vivid rainbow colors and strong reflective highlights, including a bright sun glint near the upper area and reflections of trees and garden scenery on the surface. The right half of the bubble is exploding outward into countless tiny droplets, mist, and thin web-like liquid filaments, frozen sharply in mid-air and spreading to the right side of the image. Emphasize the dramatic transition line between the intact sphere and the shattered spray. Use bright direct sunlight, very high shutter speed, crisp macro detail, high contrast, saturated color, dark green leafy background rendered as soft bokeh, and a Kodak Ektar 100 film look. Photorealistic, ultra-detailed, dynamic motion frozen in time, shallow depth of field.

items.title: Medieval Shot Reverse Shot
items.titleZh: A cinematic medieval shot-reverse-shot pair presented as a gritty historical film still in an ultrawide 21:9 aspect ratio, overcast natural light, muted earth tones, damp autumn atmosphere, realistic muddy textures, shallow depth of field, and strong foreground shoulder framing. Set the scene on a rutted muddy country road running through a rural valley with rough wooden wattle fences on both sides, low rolling hills covered with sparse trees in the distance, open fields, and a small pale stone farmhouse or chapel on the far right hillside. The two characters face each other on the road. One is a weary medieval peasant man in a dirty brown tunic and cap, average build, carrying a wood-handled axe resting on his shoulder with a leather strap across his chest. The other is a knight or armed traveler in dark weathered chainmail and a worn hooded surcoat, standing still with a guarded posture. Create this as a grammar-of-cinema countershot demonstration: first frame shows the {argument name="foreground character" default="peasant man with axe"} from behind in the right foreground, his shoulder and back occupying the near right side of the frame, while the {argument name="background character" default="knight in chainmail"} stands full figure in the left midground facing camera on the muddy road; second frame reverses the angle and shows the knight’s shoulder and hooded back blurred in the left foreground while the peasant stands in the right midground holding the axe on his shoulder. Keep both shots consistent in location, weather, costume continuity, lens feel, and character spacing, with subdued dramatic realism and a tense conversational standoff.

items.title: Royal Blue Couture Group Portrait
items.titleZh: A luxurious editorial fashion portrait of 4 elegant young women posed together in a dark royal-blue baroque interior, styled like a haute couture group photoshoot. The scene is monochromatic in deep sapphire, midnight blue, and silver tones, with heavy velvet drapery, floral arrangements, a classical column, and ornate metallic vessels in the background. All 4 women wear distinct navy and cobalt evening gowns with elaborate embellishment: crystal beading, sequins, embroidered floral appliqué, layered tulle, satin, and sheer lace. The top-left woman has very long black hair and wears a dramatic long-sleeved sheer lace gown with floral embroidery and a fitted corset-like bodice, raising one arm above her head in a regal pose. The top-right woman has long wavy light brown or blonde hair and wears a sleeveless spaghetti-strap satin gown with blue flower appliqués at the bust and waist, seated upright with a poised expression. The bottom-left woman has long straight black hair and wears a structured satin dress with thin straps, jeweled floral ornaments across the bodice and skirt, and a voluminous gathered skirt. The bottom-right woman has long dark hair and wears an off-shoulder sheer glittering gown with translucent embroidered sleeves, leaning forward slightly with one hand near her chin in a soft, contemplative pose. All 4 wear coordinated sapphire gemstone jewelry including earrings, necklaces, and decorative hair accessories. Composition is a tightly framed vertical portrait with layered seated poses, rich fabric pooling across the foreground, soft diffused studio lighting, high detail, glamorous luxury campaign styling, moody shadows, polished skin, and a refined opulent atmosphere.

items.title: Fantasy Elf Ranger Trading Card
items.titleZh: A highly detailed fantasy trading card in a premium collectible card game style, vertical layout with an ornate antique gold frame, dark emerald-green enamel panels, and intricate vine-and-leaf embellishments. The card title at the top reads {argument name="character name" default="AELION"} in large elegant serif capitals, with the subtitle "ELF OF THE GREENWOOD" beneath it. In the central illustration, depict a realistic high-fantasy elf ranger standing in a sun-dappled forest. He has long {argument name="hair color" default="golden blond"} hair, pointed ears, and wears layered dark green leather-and-metal armor with engraved details, a hooded cloak, belts, bracers, and woodland-themed ornamentation. He carries an ornate recurved bow in one hand and a quiver of arrows on his back, posed alertly as if tracking prey through the trees. The forest background is lush, atmospheric, and cinematic, with shafts of warm light filtering through branches and leaves. The overall palette is green, bronze, gold, and earthy brown, with a moody heroic tone and realistic painterly rendering. On the upper left, include a circular faction crest showing 3 gold leaves. On the upper right, include a small shield emblem with a white tree icon. Along the left edge, place exactly 4 vertically stacked stat icons in circular medallions with large numbers beside them: a sword with 3, a shield with 2, a heart with 3, and a boot with 2. At the bottom left, add a large green gem-like badge with the number 4. At the bottom right, add a circular class or weapon icon showing a bow-and-arrow symbol. In a parchment text box across the lower third, include exactly 2 ability entries with decorative leaf bullets and serif typography. The first ability name is "WOODLAND PRECISION" followed by the rules text: "When Aelion attacks, he deals +1 damage if the target is at 2 or more spaces away." The second ability name is "NATURE’S STEP" followed by the rules text: "Once per turn, Aelion may move up to 2 additional spaces through forest terrain." Centered below the abilities, add an italic flavor quote: {argument name="quote" default="The wind in the leaves is my guide, and the forest my silence."} At the very bottom, on a dark green nameplate, write the type line "ALLY • ELF • RANGER". Use crisp, legible text, polished card-game UI design, balanced margins, and a finished professional TCG product look similar to a premium fantasy strategy card.
items.promptZh: 一款高度详细的奇幻集换式卡牌，采用优质收藏卡牌游戏风格，垂直布局，华丽的古董金色框架，深翠绿色珐琅面板，以及复杂的藤蔓和叶子装饰。顶部的卡片标题为 {argument name="character name" default="AELION"}，采用大号优雅的衬线大写字母，副标题为“ELF OF THE GREENWOOD”。在中央插图中，描绘了一位现实的奇幻精灵游侠站在阳光斑驳的森林中。他有一头长{argument name="hair color" default="golden blond"}头发，尖耳朵，穿着带有雕刻细节的分层深绿色皮革和金属盔甲、连帽斗篷、腰带、护腕和林地主题的装饰。他一手拿着一把华丽的反曲弓，背上背着一袋箭，摆出警惕的姿势，仿佛在树林中追踪猎物。森林背景郁郁葱葱，大气，电影般，温暖的光线穿过树枝和树叶。整体色调为绿色、古铜色、金色、土棕色，具有喜怒无常的英雄色调和写实的绘画渲染。左上角有一个圆形派系徽章，上面有 3 个金叶。右上角有一个带有白色树图标的小盾牌标志。沿着左边缘，将 4 个垂直堆叠的统计图标放置在圆形奖章中，旁边有大量数字：一把带有 3 的剑，带有 2 的盾牌，带有 3 的心，带有 2 的靴子。在左下角，添加一个带有数字 4 的大型绿色宝石状徽章。在右下角，添加一个显示弓箭符号的圆形类别或武器图标。在下三分之一的羊皮纸文本框中，包含 2 个带有装饰性叶项目符号和衬线字体的能力条目。第一个能力名称是“WOODLAND PRECISION”，后面是规则文本：“当 Aelion 攻击时，如果目标距离 2 个或更多空间，他会造成 +1 伤害。”第二个能力名称是“自然的脚步”，后面是规则文本：“每回合一次，艾利昂可以通过森林地形移动最多 2 个额外的空间。”在能力下方居中，添加斜体风格引用：{argument name="quote" default="树叶中的风是我的向导，森林是我的沉默。"} 在最底部的深绿色铭牌上，写下类型行“ALLY • ELF • RANGER”。使用清晰易读的文本、精美的卡牌游戏 UI 设计、平衡的利润以及看起来类似于高级奇幻策略卡牌的专业 TCG 产品。

items.title: Dark Fantasy Orc Warchief TCG Card
items.titleZh: Create a single high-detail fantasy trading card in a dark Warhammer-inspired style, full portrait orientation, with an ornate aged metal-and-red leather frame, distressed gold trim, and readable printed card text. The card title at the top reads {argument name="character name" default="GROKTHAR"} in large serif capitals, with the subtitle "Orc Warchief" centered below it. The main artwork shows a massive green-skinned orc war chief charging forward through a fiery battlefield, wearing brutal blackened spiked armor with skull motifs, leather straps, tusks, and blood-red war paint, one arm thrust forward as if commanding the attack and the other gripping a huge jagged battle axe. His physique is extremely muscular, with a savage snarling expression, long dark hair tied back, and a war-torn red-black color palette. The background is filled with smoke, embers, banners, silhouettes of warriors, and orange firelight. In the top left corner place a circular skull faction emblem. In the top right corner place a red vertical banner tab with a black tribal insignia. Along the left edge, stack exactly 4 circular stat icons in separate panels with values: sword attack 4, shield defense 3, heart health 5, boot movement 2. At the bottom, include a large parchment-colored text box with exactly 2 named abilities and 1 flavor quote. Ability 1 title: {argument name="ability one" default="BRUTAL STRIKE"}, with body text: "When Grokthar attacks, he deals +2 damage." Ability 2 title: {argument name="ability two" default="RALLY THE HORDE"}, with body text: "Once per turn, when another friendly Orc enters the battlefield, Grokthar gains +1 attack until end of turn." Beneath them, add the italic flavor quote: {argument name="flavor quote" default="Strength is law. Blood is proof. The weak serve. The strong rule."} In the bottom left corner place a red gem-like cost badge with the number 5. In the bottom right corner place a round crossed-weapons icon. Along the bottom type line, center exactly 3 class words separated by dots: "Ally • Orc • Warrior". Make the card look like a professionally printed collectible card game piece with crisp typography, balanced layout, dramatic fantasy illustration, rich texture, and authentic tabletop TCG design.

The card has an elaborate dark navy and antique gold frame with filigree corners, embossed metallic trim, and a painterly realistic illustration in the center. At the top center, large serif title text reads {argument name="character name" default="VARIAN THE AZUREMAGE"}, with a smaller subtitle beneath reading {argument name="class line" default="HUMAN WIZARD"}. In the top left corner, place a circular blue mana-like emblem containing a white swirling arcane symbol. In the top right corner, place a small heraldic banner panel with 2 gold icons stacked vertically: an arcane starburst above an open book. Along the left edge, create a vertical stat column with exactly 4 icon-and-number rows on dark blue plaques: a sword icon with the number 2, a shield icon with the number 1, a red heart icon with the number 3, and a boot icon with the number 2. The central artwork shows a male human wizard in a cathedral-like magical interior filled with blue light and faint candles, wearing layered royal-blue robes and cloak with intricate gold embroidery, gilded armor accents, leather belts, pouches, scroll cases, and jeweled ornaments. He has dark wavy medium-length hair and a dramatic heroic pose, gripping an ornate staff in his left hand; the staff is black-gold with branching prongs and a glowing blue crystal near the top. His right arm is extended outward, conjuring a luminous spiral galaxy of blue arcane energy, star-like particles, and trailing magical ribbons that swirl around his hand. The mood is majestic, mystical, and cinematic, with intense sapphire highlights, deep shadows, painterly detail, and premium fantasy card-game illustration quality. At the bottom, add a parchment-colored rules text box with ornate corners and 2 abilities, each preceded by a blue arcane symbol bullet. The first ability title is bold serif text: ARCANE BOLT, followed by the rules text: When Varian attacks, he deals 2 damage to any target. The second ability title is bold serif text: MANA SURGE, followed by the rules text: Once per turn, you may pay 1 mana (with a blue water-drop mana icon) to draw a card. Beneath the abilities, add an italic flavor quote in blue-gray text: “Knowledge is the truest power. In the lower right corner, place a circular gold-framed open book icon. Along the bottom border, centered in gold serif text on a blue strip, write: {argument name="type line" default="ALLY • HUMAN • WIZARD"}. items.title: 1990s Spanish Family Kitchen Lunch
items.titleZh: A candid documentary-style photograph of a {argument name="country" default="Spain"} family having lunch in a modest 1990s home kitchen, shot vertically with warm natural light and realistic lived-in detail. Four people sit around a small square table: an adult man in the left foreground seen mostly from the back and side, a middle-aged woman centered on the far side of the table serving food with a spoon, a teenage boy on the right side of the table, and a young girl in the right foreground with a ponytail, seen from behind in three-quarter view. The mood is intimate, ordinary, nostalgic, and unmistakably real, like a family snapshot rather than a staged commercial image. The table is covered with a blue-and-white plaid tablecloth and set with a rustic home-cooked meal: 1 black pan of stew or braised meat in the center, 1 wooden bowl filled with several pieces of bread, 2 small glass carafes containing dark red wine, multiple plates with food, cutlery, drinking glasses, and torn pieces of bread. The kitchen background should feel authentic and slightly worn: cream walls, a band of small patterned ceramic tiles across the middle of the wall, an open window on the left letting in soft daylight, 1 small potted plant on the windowsill, 1 wooden wall shelf holding jars and kitchen containers, 1 vintage wall calendar reading {argument name="month on calendar" default="AGOSTO"}, and dark wooden furniture on the right. Use soft film-like grain, muted colors, slight haze, gentle contrast, and natural imperfections typical of a 1990s analog photo. Composition should feel casually observed from a standing height near the table, with partial occlusion by the father and daughter in the foreground, no polished styling, no stock-photo cleanliness, just everyday family life in {argument name="decade" default="the 1990s"}.

items.title: Scientific Neuron Anatomy Poster
items.titleZh: Create a highly detailed scientific anatomical poster of a {argument name="subject" default="neuron"} on a clean warm off-white paper background, presented as a museum-quality hybrid of 3D pencil drawing and ultra-realistic biological illustration. The composition centers on one large neuron in three-quarter view, with an oversized spherical purple nucleus inside a textured cell body, many branching dendrites spreading outward like winter tree branches, and a long axon extending diagonally down to the right. The axon is partially cut away to reveal its internal structure and is wrapped in segmented blue-gray myelin sheaths with visible gaps at the nodes of Ranvier. At the far end, the axon branches into exactly 15 thin terminal fibers, each ending in a rounded synaptic bulb with pale peach and pink tips. The main central figure should look sculptural, organic, and slightly glossy, with intricate membrane textures, subtle beige, ivory, silver, brown, and violet coloration, and extremely fine linework for the distal branches. Surround the centerpiece with 6 labeled educational inset sections arranged like a textbook infographic: top left a title block reading {argument name="title text" default="NEURON (NERVE CELL)"} with a short explanatory paragraph and a numbered structure list containing exactly 10 items; upper right a smaller monochrome full-neuron sketch labeled {argument name="style note" default="3D PENCIL DRAWING"}; lower left a cell body soma detail diagram with labels pointing to internal organelles; bottom left a myelin sheath cross-section cylinder diagram; lower center a square grayscale microscopic view panel with 4 labels; right center an electrical signal section with a small action potential graph showing membrane potential versus time; lower right a synapse close-up drawing with receptor and neurotransmitter labeling. Include fine serif typography, delicate leader lines, small circled numbers on the main neuron, and the feel of an elegant old scientific plate mixed with modern biomedical visualization. Keep the layout airy and balanced, with the central neuron dominating most of the canvas, landscape orientation, extremely high resolution, crisp educational poster design, and a refined neutral aesthetic.

items.title: Teddy Bear Mona Lisa Hybrid
items.titleZh: A surreal oil painting in the style of Leonardo da Vinci's Mona Lisa, reimagined as a teddy-bear hybrid portrait. The subject sits in the same half-length frontal pose with folded hands, wearing the dark Renaissance dress and soft draped shawl of the original painting, against the classic hazy landscape with winding water, distant mountains, and muted atmospheric perspective. The figure has 2 round fluffy teddy bear ears on top of the head and 2 plush furry paws folded at the bottom, with a warm beige teddy-bear fur chest replacing the visible skin of the neckline and hands. Long dark brown hair falls smoothly over both shoulders. The face area is intentionally left as a flat featureless brown rectangular block, creating an uncanny censored or unfinished effect. Use cracked varnish texture, aged museum-painting patina, smoky sfumato transitions, low-saturation brown and olive tones, soft golden lighting, centered composition, highly detailed fur texture blended into classical portrait brushwork, whimsical yet eerie fine-art parody.
items.promptZh: 这是一幅莱昂纳多·达·芬奇《蒙娜丽莎》风格的超现实油画，被重新想象为泰迪熊混合肖像。画中人物以同样的半身正面姿势，双手合十，穿着原画中文艺复兴时期的深色连衣裙，披着柔软的披肩，映衬着蜿蜒的流水、远山和柔和的大气透视的经典朦胧风景。该人物头顶有 2 个毛茸茸的泰迪熊圆形耳朵，底部有 2 个折叠的毛绒毛茸茸的爪子，温暖的米色泰迪熊毛皮胸部取代了领口和双手的可见皮肤。深棕色的长发顺滑地披散在双肩上。脸部区域被故意留下为平坦的、无特征的棕色矩形块，创造出一种不可思议的审查或未完成的效果。使用裂纹的清漆纹理、古老的博物馆绘画铜绿、烟熏晕染过渡、低饱和度的棕色和橄榄色调、柔和的金色灯光、居中构图、高度细致的毛皮纹理融入古典肖像画笔法，异想天开但令人毛骨悚然的美术模仿。

items.title: Teddy Bear with a Pearl Earring
items.titleZh: A classical oil painting in the style of a 17th-century Dutch master, closely inspired by Vermeer’s composition, showing a teddy bear posed as the subject of a formal portrait. The bear is shown in three-quarter view from the shoulders up against a deep black background, turning its head slightly toward the viewer. It has soft golden-brown plush fur, one rounded fuzzy ear clearly visible and the other partially visible beneath a large blue-and-gold turban wrapped around its head, with a long fabric tail draping down the right side. The bear wears a single oversized pearl earring hanging from the visible ear area, echoing the iconic “girl with a pearl earring” look. The clothing includes 2 visible garments: a warm golden-brown robe or coat and a small white collar at the neckline. Use dramatic chiaroscuro lighting from the left, rich painterly texture, subtle canvas grain, realistic fabric folds, gentle highlights on the pearl, and a museum-quality old master atmosphere. Keep the composition simple, centered, and elegant, with the teddy bear’s face rendered as a plush toy version of a noble portrait subject, blending cute toy texture with fine-art realism.
items.promptZh: 这是一幅 17 世纪荷兰大师风格的古典油画，其构图灵感源自维米尔 (Vermeer) 的构图，以一只泰迪熊为正式肖像的主题。熊的四分之三视图显示在深黑色背景下，从肩膀向上，它的头稍微转向观众。它有着柔软的金棕色毛绒皮毛，一只圆形的毛茸茸的耳朵清晰可见，另一只耳朵在包裹着头部的蓝色和金色大头巾下部分可见，一条长长的织物尾巴垂在右侧。这只小熊的耳朵上挂着一只超大的珍珠耳环，呼应了标志性的“戴珍珠耳环的女孩”造型。服装包括两件可见服装：一件温暖的金棕色长袍或外套，以及领口的白色小领子。使用左侧戏剧性的明暗对比灯光、丰富的绘画质感、微妙的画布纹理、逼真的织物褶皱、珍珠上柔和的高光以及博物馆品质的老大师氛围。构图简洁、居中、优雅，泰迪熊的脸被渲染成毛绒玩具版的高贵肖像主题，将可爱的玩具质感与美术写实融为一体。

items.title: Teddy Bear Creation Fresco
items.titleZh: A whimsical high-detail oil-painting parody of Michelangelo’s Creation of Adam, but all human figures are replaced by teddy bears. On the left, a single plush teddy bear sits reclined on a rocky slope, posed like Adam, with soft golden-brown curly fur, round ears, shiny black eyes, a small dark nose, and a slightly open mouth. Its left arm supports its body while its right arm stretches outward, index paw extended toward the other bear. On the right, a larger central teddy bear posed like God emerges from a deep reddish-burgundy swirling mantle, wearing a flowing white draped robe, leaning forward with one outstretched arm and pointed paw reaching toward the left bear, almost touching fingertips. Surrounding the robed bear inside the mantle are 8 additional smaller teddy bears clustered tightly together, peeking from different angles like attendant figures. The composition exactly echoes the iconic near-touching hands scene, with the gap between fingertips centered. Use a cracked fresco wall background in warm beige tones, muted Renaissance palette, soft directional light, realistic fabric folds, detailed plush texture, subtle shadows, and a museum-quality painted surface. Blend classical Renaissance fresco aesthetics with charming surreal humor, keeping the scene elegant rather than cartoonish.

items.prompt: A whimsical high-detail oil-painting parody of Michelangelo’s Creation of Adam, but all human figures are replaced by teddy bears. On the left, a single plush teddy bear sits reclined on a rocky slope, posed like Adam, with soft golden-brown curly fur, round ears, shiny black eyes, a small dark nose, and a slightly open mouth. Its left arm supports its body while its right arm stretches outward, index paw extended toward the other bear. On the right, a larger central teddy bear posed like God emerges from a deep reddish-burgundy swirling mantle, wearing a flowing white draped robe, leaning forward with one outstretched arm and pointed paw reaching toward the left bear, almost touching fingertips. Surrounding the robed bear inside the mantle are 8 additional smaller teddy bears clustered tightly together, peeking from different angles like attendant figures. The composition exactly echoes the iconic near-touching hands scene, with the gap between fingertips centered. items.title: Teddy Bear Last Supper
items.titleZh: A whimsical yet reverent Renaissance-style parody of The Last Supper, with exactly 13 anthropomorphic teddy bears seated along one side of a long banquet table in a grand classical dining hall. The central bear is the clear focal point, posed like Jesus, facing forward with a calm, solemn expression, wearing a muted red robe with a deep blue drape. The other 12 teddy bears cluster in animated conversational groups to the left and right, each with slightly different fur tones from honey brown to cream, all with soft plush texture, rounded ears, black bead-like eyes, and expressive paws raised in discussion. Dress the surrounding bears in painterly biblical robes in earthy reds, dusty blues, ochres, and greens. Recreate the composition closely to Leonardo da Vinci’s Last Supper: symmetrical perspective, coffered wooden ceiling, three rear windows with soft blue mountain landscape visible outside, dark wall tapestries on both side walls, and a long white tablecloth hanging over trestle supports. On the table, include scattered small bread rolls, plates, bowls, and multiple small glasses of dark red wine spaced across the full length. Use warm museum-like lighting, aged fresco tones, soft shadows, detailed oil-paint texture, and a highly polished old-master look, balancing humor with genuine artistic beauty. No modern objects, no text, no extra characters, straight-on wide composition, full table visible.
items.promptZh: 这是对《最后的晚餐》的一种异想天开而又虔诚的文艺复兴风格模仿，在一座宏伟的古典餐厅中，13只拟人化的泰迪熊坐在长长的宴会桌的一侧。中央的熊是明显的焦点，它的姿势像耶稣，面朝前方，表情平静、庄严，穿着一件带有深蓝色垂褶的柔和红色长袍。另外 12 只泰迪熊则聚集在左右两侧，每只泰迪熊的皮毛色调都略有不同，从蜜棕色到奶油色，都具有柔软的毛绒质地、圆圆的耳朵、黑色珠子般的眼睛和富有表现力的爪子。给周围的熊穿上带有泥土红色、灰蓝色、赭色和绿色的绘画圣经长袍。再现了与列奥纳多·达·芬奇的《最后的晚餐》非常接近的构图：对称的透视、格子木制天花板、三扇后窗，可以看到外面柔和的蓝色山景、两侧墙壁上的深色壁挂毯、以及悬挂在栈桥支撑上的白色长桌布。桌子上放着散落的小面包卷、盘子、碗，以及多个小玻璃杯，里面盛满了整个桌子。使用温暖的博物馆般的灯光、古老的壁画色调、柔和的阴影、细致的油画纹理和高度抛光的古典大师外观，平衡幽默与真正的艺术美。没有现代物体，没有文字，没有多余的字符，直接宽构图，完整的表格可见。

items.titleZh: A stylized cinematic poster for a creative coding event, designed like a Disney-Pixar-inspired animated movie one-sheet. Vertical composition, warm cozy interior at night with a large loft window on the left showing a city skyline at sunset, exposed brick walls, and a neon-lit creative studio atmosphere. At the top center, big glossy dimensional typography reads "Disney•PIXAR" above the main title "The AI Web Design Sprint" in huge bold white 3D letters. Directly underneath, smaller bright text reads "BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD." In the center foreground, 2 adult men sit side by side at a wooden table with a laptop between them, casual startup-founder vibe, one in a dark hoodie and one in a light sweatshirt and baseball cap, both facing camera in a friendly promotional pose. Their faces should be generic and unobtrusive, with the emphasis on the event-poster composition rather than portrait realism. The laptop lid has 3 visible stickers: a purple code-brackets sticker, a black sticker with a white burst symbol, and a rectangular slogan sticker reading "BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD." Around the scene, include 4 whimsical animated mascot elements: a small hovering robot drone lamp in the upper left with glowing blue eyes and a cone of warm light shining downward; a smiling cartoon sun icon in the upper right; a tiny red pixel character floating nearby; and a glowing blue cat-like digital mascot standing on the table in front of the laptop. On the right side, a vertical monitor displays a dark coding interface with readable text including "// Welcome back, Julian!", "Opus 4.6", "Minimal Playground", "Agency 976", "Cyberpunk Cafe", "Surfers (late set)", and a checklist titled "Sprint Plan" with 4 items: "DISCOVER", "IDEATE", "BUILD", "SHIP". On the left side, a hand-lettered paper signboard contains 4 notices pinned together: "4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE", "DOORS 7PM", "SHOW 8PM", and "$10 ADV / $12 DOS". In the lower left foreground, a white coffee mug reads "THE SOUTH SIDE DIY 218 W. 31ST ST. CHICAGO, IL" with a small skull icon. In the lower right foreground, a terracotta plant pot with green leaves reads "CREATIVE COLLISION". At the bottom center, large bold text reads "APRIL 27–30" and below it "LIVE. ONLY ON THE WEB." Add a tiny line of faux credits along the bottom edge in classic movie-poster style, referencing names like Julian Lopez and Harvey Specter, projects such as Minimal Playground, Agency 976, Cyberpunk Cafe, and Surfers, and a playful production credit. Use dramatic warm-orange and cool-blue lighting, polished animated-film rendering, soft depth of field, glossy surfaces, rich contrast, highly detailed poster design, charming tech startup energy, and a premium event-advertisement finish.

items.title: Swiss Poster for AI Web Design Sprint
items.titleZh: Create a bold Swiss-modernist event poster for a live AI and web design sprint, portrait orientation, with a warm off-white paper background, stark black typography, and vivid red accent blocks. The composition is asymmetrical and editorial, with a strong grid and generous negative space. In the top left, place a small red uppercase line of text reading {argument name="date text" default="LIVE APRIL 27–30"}, followed by a thin horizontal black rule stretching toward the right. Below it, set an oversized stacked headline in ultra-bold black sans serif, left aligned, reading {argument name="headline text" default="The AI Web Design Sprint"}, broken across 4 lines with dramatic scale so the words dominate the left half of the poster. In the upper right quadrant, add 1 large solid red rectangle as a graphic block. Beneath that red block, place a compact black uppercase subhead in 3 lines: {argument name="tagline text" default="4 DAYS. REAL PROJECTS. SHIP TOGETHER."}. In the lower middle, include 2 cropped grayscale portrait photos of men from the chest up, side by side, documentary style, slightly overlapping the typography area; the left man has dark slicked-back hair and a short beard, the right man wears a dark baseball cap with embroidered lettering and has facial hair. Obscure both faces with 2 vertical soft-edged gray censor rectangles centered over each face. Along the right side, create a vertical feature column with 4 black square icons, each separated by thin horizontal divider lines and paired with uppercase labels. The 4 items are: a starburst icon with the label "CREATIVE COLLISION", a connected-nodes icon with the label "AI-POWERED WORKFLOWS", a code brackets icon with the label "CODE IN MOTION", and a terminal prompt icon with the label "REAL-TIME DESIGN". Near the bottom, add a full-width footer separated by a thin horizontal black rule. Inside the footer, create 4 text blocks divided by slim vertical lines: block 1 says "BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD.", block 2 lists "MINIMAL PLAYGROUND & AGENCY 976" with a small red line beneath reading "LIVE ON THE WEB", block 3 lists "CYBERPUNK CAFE SURFERS (LATE SET)" and below it "4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE" and then "THE SOUTH SIDE DIY", block 4 lists ticket info as "TICKETS $10 ADV $12 DOS". On the far lower right edge, add vertical red text reading {argument name="location text" default="CHICAGO, IL"}. Use a clean neo-grotesk typeface similar to Helvetica or Akzidenz-Grotesk, heavy weight for the headline, condensed uppercase for supporting text, crisp alignment, subtle paper texture, and a high-contrast black-red-cream palette. The overall look should feel like a contemporary design-conference poster mixed with punk tech culture and brutalist editorial branding.
items.promptZh: 为实时人工智能和网页设计冲刺创建一张大胆的瑞士现代主义活动海报，纵向，具有温暖的灰白色纸张背景、纯黑色版式和鲜艳的红色强调块。构图是不对称的和编辑性的，具有强大的网格和宽敞的负空间。在左上角，放置一条小的红色大写文本行：{argument name="date text" default="LIVE APRIL 27–30"}，后面是一条向右延伸的细水平黑色线。在其下方，设置一个超大的堆叠标题，采用超粗体黑色无衬线字体，左对齐，内容为{argument name="headline text" default="The AI Web Design Sprint"}，以戏剧性的比例分成 4 行，这样文字就占据了海报的左半部分。在右上象限中，添加 1 个大的红色实心矩形作为图形块。在该红色块下方，放置一个紧凑的黑色大写副标题，分为 3 行：{argument name="tagline text" default="4 DAYS. REAL PROJECTS. SHIP TOGETHER."}。中下部分，包括两张裁剪后的男性胸部以上的灰度肖像照片，并排，纪实风格，与排版区域略有重叠；左边的男人留着深色的向后梳的头发和短胡子，右边的男人戴着深色的绣字棒球帽，留着胡须。使用以每个面为中心的 2 个垂直软边灰色审查器矩形来遮挡两个面。沿着右侧，创建一个垂直特征列，其中包含 4 个黑色方形图标，每个图标均由细水平分隔线分隔，并与大写标签配对。这 4 个项目是：带有“创意碰撞”标签的星爆图标、带有“AI-POWERED WORKFLOWS”标签的连接节点图标、带有“代码运行”标签的代码括号图标以及带有“实时设计”标签的终端提示图标。在底部附近，添加一个全角页脚，并用细水平黑色线分隔。在页脚内，创建 4 个由细垂直线分隔的文本块：第 1 块显示“快速构建。打破规则。大声分享。”，第 2 块列出“MINIMAL PLAYGROUND & AGENCY 976”，下方有一条小红线，上面写着“LIVE ON THE WEB”，第 3 块列出“CYBERPUNK CAFE SURFERS (LATE SET)”，下面列出“4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE”和然后“THE SOUTH SIDE DIY”，第 4 块将门票信息列为“门票 $10 ADV $12 DOS”。在最右下边缘，添加垂直红色文本：{argument name="location text" default="CHICAGO, IL"}。使用类似于 Helvetica 或 Akzidenz-Grotesk 的简洁 Neo-Grotesk 字体，标题采用粗体字，用于支撑文本的压缩大写字母，清晰的对齐方式，微妙的纸张纹理以及高对比度的黑红奶油色调色板。整体外观应该感觉像是一张当代设计会议海报，融合了朋克科技文化和野兽派编辑品牌。

items.title: Punk AI Sprint Flyer
items.titleZh: Create a raw, high-contrast punk rock gig poster collage for an event called {argument name="event title" default="THE AI WEB DESIGN SPRINT"}. The design should feel like a xeroxed underground flyer pasted on a city wall: rough torn paper edges, photocopy grain, ink smudges, distressed black-and-white textures, hot magenta paint splashes, DIY zine aesthetics, and chaotic layered paper scraps taped and pinned together. Use a vertical poster composition with a black background and a central oversized torn white rectangle set at a slight angle, filled with huge condensed black distressed lettering for the main title. At the very top, add a smaller black torn strip with handwritten brush lettering in neon magenta reading {argument name="top slogan" default="LIVE PUNK!"}. On the left side, place a hot pink torn paper block with hand-drawn black text listing the date {argument name="event dates" default="April 27-30"}, then smaller stacked lines reading "4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE", "DOORS 7PM", "SHOW 8PM", "$10 ADV", and "$12 DOS". On the right side, add an off-white torn note with magenta "WITH:" at the top and four supporting acts listed in black handwritten text: "Minimal Playground", "Agency 976", "Cyberpunk Cafe", and "Surfers (Late Set)". In the center-lower area, show exactly 2 black-and-white photocopied punk band members from the chest up, standing shoulder to shoulder, both wearing leather jackets with patches and pins; the left one has round glasses, the right one wears a baseball cap. Their faces should be generic and partially obscured by the collage styling so the poster focus remains typographic and graphic rather than portrait-specific. Add a hot pink spiky starburst on the mid-right containing a black circle with a simple white radial symbol. Near the bottom right, place a beige masking-tape-like paper scrap with bold handwritten black text reading "Build Fast. Break Rules. Share Loud.". Near the bottom left, add a black rectangular venue block with magenta hand lettering for {argument name="venue name" default="THE SOUTH SIDE DIY"} and smaller white address text "218 W. 31st Street" and "Chicago, IL", plus a small white skull icon nearby. Include exactly 2 silver safety pins, one near the upper left corner and one near the lower left area, and exactly 1 strip of dark duct tape on the left edge of the main title paper. Finish the bottom edge with a black-and-white checkerboard strip spanning the full width. Overall mood: rebellious, loud, youthful, anarchic, street-pasted punk flyer meets tech event promo, with intense contrast, gritty halftone noise, screen-print imperfections, and hand-made collage energy.
items.promptZh: 为名为 {argument name="event title" default="THE AI WEB DESIGN SPRINT"} 的活动创建原始、高对比度的朋克摇滚演出海报拼贴画。设计应该感觉像是一张粘贴在城墙上的复印地下传单：粗糙的撕破纸边、复印颗粒、墨水污迹、仿旧的黑白纹理、热洋红色油漆泼溅、DIY 杂志美学以及用胶带粘在一起并钉在一起的混乱的分层纸屑。使用垂直海报构图，黑色背景和中央超大的撕裂白色矩形，以小角度设置，主标题填充巨大的浓缩黑色仿旧字体。在最顶部，添加一条较小的黑色撕裂条，上面有霓虹灯洋红色的手写毛笔字样：{argument name="top slogan" default="LIVE PUNK!"}。在左侧放置一块亮粉色撕纸，上面有手绘黑色文本，列出日期 {argument name="event days" default="April 27-30"}，然后是较小的堆叠线，上面写着“4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE”、“DOORS 7PM”、“SHOW 8PM”、“$10 ADV”和“$12 DOS”。在右侧添加一张灰白色撕破纸条，顶部带有洋红色“WITH：”，并以黑色手写文字列出四位支持者：“Minimal Playground”、“Agency 976”、“Cyber​​punk Cafe”和“Surfers (Late Set)”。在中下区域，恰好展示了两名朋克乐队成员从胸部以上的黑白影印版，肩并肩站立，两人都穿着带有补丁和别针的皮夹克；左边戴着圆框眼镜，右边戴着棒球帽。他们的脸应该是通用的，并被拼贴风格部分遮挡，因此海报的焦点仍然是印刷和图形，而不是特定的肖像。在右中添加一个亮粉色尖刺星爆，其中包含一个黑色圆圈和一个简单的白色放射状符号。在右下角附近，放置一张米色遮蔽胶带状的纸片，上面写着粗体手写黑色文字，上面写着“快速构建。打破规则。大声分享。”。在左下角附近，添加一个带有洋红色手写字样的黑色矩形场地块 {argument name="venue name" default="THE SOUTH SIDE DIY"} 和较小的白色地址文本“218 W. 31st Street”和“Chicago, IL”，以及附近的一个白色小骷髅图标。包括 2 个银色安全别针，一个靠近左上角，一个靠近左下区域，以及主标题纸左边缘上的 1 条深色胶带。用横跨整个宽度的黑白棋盘条完成底部边缘。整体氛围：叛逆、大声、年轻、无政府主义、街头粘贴的朋克传单与科技活动宣传片的结合，具有强烈的对比、坚韧的半色调噪音、丝网印刷的缺陷和手工拼贴的能量。

items.title: Overdecorated Sophie Magic Poster
items.titleZh: A highly embellished full-body anime fantasy illustration of {argument name="character name" default="SOPHIE"}, a young elegant female alchemist-mage standing in the center of a vast celestial library laboratory. She has {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"} hair in a soft short bob with a side ponytail and a large crystalline flower hair ornament, though her face is obscured by a flat pale square censor block. She wears an ornate white and icy-blue dress with silver filigree, corset lacing, layered ruffles, translucent trailing panels, detached flowing sleeves, gemstone pendants, thigh garter ornaments, and white high-heeled ankle boots with metallic trims. Two glowing blue potion bottles hang at her hip. Her pose is graceful and confident: one hand raised with a floating faceted blue crystal hovering above her palm, the other holding an open magic book that projects transparent holographic pages and arcane interface diagrams in neon blue. The environment is a grand circular observatory-like library with towering bookshelves, alchemical instruments, astrolabes, hanging ornaments, glassware, candles, and luminous magical symbols. A huge backlit arched window behind her casts cool heavenly light. The floor beneath her is covered in glowing concentric magic circles and reflections, surrounded by crystalline blue flowers and sparkling particles. The composition is vertical, centered, and extremely polished, with dense decorative detail, ethereal lighting, layered translucency, shimmering highlights, and a palette dominated by white, silver, sapphire, and pale violet. Include large decorative title text on the left reading {argument name="title text" default="SOPHIE"}, smaller Japanese text beneath reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="ソフィー"}, a small "CV:" line below, a short block of tiny English flavor text on the lower left, and a luminous blue hologram panel on the right with the word {argument name="panel text" default="SOPHIC"}. Make it feel like a luxurious character key visual or promotional poster for a magical science heroine, ultra-detailed, glossy, radiant, and intentionally over-the-top.
items.promptZh: 一幅高度装饰的全身动漫奇幻插图，描绘的是一位年轻优雅的女炼金术士{argument name="character name" default="SOPHIE"}，她站在一座巨大的天体图书馆实验室的中心。她有一头{argument name="hair color" default="platinumblond"}头发，留着柔软的短波波头，扎着侧马尾辫，戴着大水晶花发饰，尽管她的脸被一个扁平的、苍白的方形审查块遮住了。她穿着华丽的白色和冰蓝色连衣裙，饰有银色细丝、紧身胸衣系带、分层荷叶边、半透明拖尾镶片、独立飘逸袖子、宝石吊坠、大腿吊袜带装饰，以及带有金属饰边的白色高跟踝靴。她的臀部挂着两个发光的蓝色药水瓶。她的姿势优雅而自信：一只手举起，手掌上方悬浮着一块漂浮的多面蓝色水晶，另一只手拿着一本打开的魔法书，上面投射出透明的全息页面和霓虹蓝色的神秘界面图。环境是一个宏伟的圆形天文台般的图书馆，里面有高耸的书架、炼金仪器、星盘、悬挂装饰品、玻璃器皿、蜡烛和发光的魔法符号。她身后一扇巨大的背光拱形窗户投射出凉爽的天堂般的光线。她脚下的地板上覆盖着发光的同心魔法阵和反射，周围环绕着水晶般的蓝色花朵和闪闪发光的颗粒。构图垂直、居中、极其抛光，具有密集的装饰细节、空灵的灯光、分层的半透明、闪烁的亮点，以及以白色、银色、蓝宝石和浅紫色为主的调色板。在左侧添加大的装饰性标题文本{argument name="title text" default="SOPHIE"}，在下方添加较小的日文文本{argument name="subtitle text" default="ソfuィー"}，下面有一个小“CV:”行，在左下角添加一小块英文风格的小文本，在右侧添加发光的蓝色全息图面板，其中包含单词{argument name="panel text" default="SOPHIC"}。让它感觉像是神奇科学女主角的豪华角色主视觉或宣传海报，超详细、有光泽、容光焕发，并且故意夸张。

items.titleZh: A highly detailed cinematic third-person wuxia MMORPG gameplay screenshot set in a bustling ancient Chinese water-town market street at dusk, viewed from behind the player character standing in the center foreground. The player character is a wandering swordsman in layered dark gray and blue hanfu-style robes with embroidered fabric, long black hair tied in a low ponytail, and a sheathed sword on his back, facing forward into a crowded street. The environment is a richly rendered Ming- or Song-inspired town with traditional wooden shopfronts, tiled roofs, hanging red lanterns, pink cherry blossom trees, damp reflective stone pavement, soft golden evening light, and a lived-in crowd of townsfolk in historical clothing. On the right foreground, exactly 3 elegant female courtesans in translucent pastel hanfu sit and stand outside a richly decorated teahouse or brothel draped with red silk curtains; one is playing a pipa, one is seated in pale green and cream robes, and one stands in flowing rose-pink robes. The largest shop sign above them features large gold Chinese calligraphy on a black plaque, and additional vertical shop banners with Chinese characters hang along the street. The composition should feel like a premium AAA fantasy Chinese RPG, with realistic character proportions, dense environmental storytelling, dramatic but natural lighting, atmospheric depth, and intricate costume materials. items.titleZh: A photorealistic vertical promotional portrait in a cozy modern library or bookstore interior, showing a young East Asian woman standing behind a wooden counter and presenting a large book toward the camera. She has long straight dark brown hair parted near the center, small delicate earrings, and a neat, friendly, professional appearance. She wears a white button-up shirt, a muted green striped necktie, and a beige apron tied at the waist with a stitched name patch reading “Librarian Ai-chan” and a small open-book icon. The book is the clear focal point: a glossy dark cover with dramatic orange title text reading “Pollo AI” twice, one large at the top and one glowing near the center over a cinematic landscape image, plus smaller Japanese subtitle and feature text and a circular P-style logo near the lower left. Place a transparent acrylic desk sign on the left side of the counter with Japanese text above and the large name “Ai-chan” below. On the right side of the counter, stack exactly 3 hardcover books horizontally, each with numbered spine labels and Japanese titles. In the softly blurred background, include a tall wooden bookshelf on the left with books, small potted plants, and a warm lamp; a framed wall poster on the upper right with Japanese writing; and a leafy indoor plant on the far right. Add a small white “Pollo.ai” watermark in the top-right corner. Use warm ambient lighting, shallow depth of field, soft beige and wood tones, realistic skin and fabric texture, clean commercial composition, and the polished look of a professional lifestyle advertisement for a book or AI-related publication. Keep the framing from mid-thigh to above the head in a portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.

items.titleZh: A polished Japanese animated film poster in a soft, luminous springtime anime style. The main scene shows 2 teenage schoolgirls walking hand in hand down a quiet residential street lined with blooming cherry blossom trees. They wear matching Japanese sailor school uniforms: white long-sleeve blouses with navy sailor collars, pale blue neckerchiefs, and dark navy pleated skirts, each carrying a navy school bag. The girl on the left has dark hair tied in a low side bun with loose strands and a small pink cherry blossom hairpin; she turns toward the other girl with a tender, slightly wistful expression. The girl on the right has long straight dark hair and looks back at her softly. Pink sakura petals drift through warm late-afternoon backlight, creating a romantic, emotional atmosphere with glowing rim light, gentle lens bloom, and painterly detail. Along the left edge, add a vertical collage of 7 inset memory scenes from the story: 1) two children together in a nostalgic childhood moment, 2) a close portrait of the long-haired girl, 3) the two characters standing apart in a tense or reflective moment, 4) an indoor conversation scene with 3 people, 5) a close profile of the bun-haired girl, 6) an intimate almost-kiss close-up of the two leads, 7) a rear view of the two girls walking together beneath cherry blossoms. At the top, include the Japanese tagline: 「変わってしまった朝、変わらなかった想い。」 Across the lower center, place the large glowing handwritten title {argument name="title text" default="Story of U"} in elegant pink neon script. Beneath it, add small Japanese subtitle text and a release line reading {argument name="release text" default="2027年春公開"}. At the very bottom, add dense small white Japanese credits in authentic movie-poster layout. Overall mood: bittersweet yuri coming-of-age drama, cinematic key visual, emotionally resonant, highly detailed, pastel pink and navy palette, vertical poster composition.

items.title: Back-to-Back Sirens in Sakura Dusk
items.titleZh: Two powerful fantasy women standing back-to-back in the center of a vast cherry blossom field at dusk, full-body heroic composition, seen from a slightly low angle, ultra-detailed cinematic anime-realism. The woman on the left has {argument name="left character hair color" default="vivid crimson red"} short layered hair, a curvy athletic build, and a fierce dominant presence; she wears a black and dark red strappy battle outfit with a cropped leather top, high-cut bottoms, garter-like thigh straps, flowing translucent red ribbons, and long glossy black armguards. The woman on the right has {argument name="right character hair color" default="golden blonde with soft pink ends"} wavy shoulder-length hair, an athletic curvy build, and extensive floral tattoo sleeves and body tattoos across her arm, shoulder, ribs, and thigh; she wears a black and purple strappy fantasy outfit with sheer purple fabric panels, chain accents, and black gloves. Their bare upper backs press together as they face opposite directions with calm, intimidating confidence. There are exactly 2 massive glowing energy swords planted upright in the ground behind and beside them: 1 on the left radiating molten red-orange fire and ember-like cracks, and 1 on the right radiating electric violet and cyan energy with lightning coursing through the blade. The scene is set in a breathtaking sakura landscape with dense pink cherry trees, countless petals swirling violently through the air, a dramatic sunset sky filled with magenta, purple, and orange clouds, distant lightning, and a glowing horizon over a Japanese-inspired cityscape with a pagoda visible on the right. Emphasize raw power, sensual elegance, high contrast rim lighting, wind-blown fabric and hair, luminous particle effects, rich red-versus-purple color contrast, epic fantasy atmosphere, hyper-detailed rendering, sharp focus on the two women, and painterly cinematic depth.

items.title: Demon AI Intern Office Poster
items.titleZh: Create a dramatic Chinese social-media poster in a warm amber office setting, featuring a stylish demon-themed female assistant character seated at a desk. The composition is a single vertical poster with dense graphic design, cinematic lighting, and a premium glossy illustration style mixing anime realism and commercial advertising. At the top, place a huge bold red Chinese headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="龙虾夏夏"}, with an elegant handwritten script overlay reading {argument name="signature text" default="Xia Xia"}. Under it, add a strong black Chinese slogan: {argument name="subtitle text" default="嘴欠，但能交付"}. The character is centered, upper body visible behind a desk, with messy vivid red hair in a loose bun and many flyaway strands, small dark red devil horns, pale skin, black layered clothing, a lanyard ID badge, long red metallic claw gloves, and a tired but dangerous office-worker aura. Her face is intentionally obscured by a square censor block in the center. She props her cheek with one clawed hand and holds a branded black takeaway coffee cup in the other hand. Add subtle lobster-inspired details in the outfit and props, including segmented glossy red shell-like forms behind and around her chair. The desk contains exactly 7 visible items: 1 open laptop with a red lobster logo and the words "XIA XIA", 1 closed dark book stack beneath the laptop, 1 open notebook with handwritten sketches and Chinese notes, 1 black fountain pen, 1 rectangular black desk nameplate with Chinese text, 1 takeaway coffee cup with matching lobster logo, and 1 hanging employee badge card. In the left background, show a computer or presentation screen displaying a Feishu-style document interface with the Chinese title "内容创作流程" and a simple 3-step flowchart labeled exactly "场景", "流程", "资产", plus the sentence "Agent 是放大器，不是方向盘。" Add a sticky note near that screen reading "扣瑞芋". In the upper left, include a yellow annotation box with the Chinese text "黄叔雇来的毒舌但能干的AI实习生" and a playful doodled face beside it. In the right background, pin up 3 office notes: 1 clipboard-style intern profile card titled "实习生档案" with multiple bullet lines of Chinese profile text and a handwritten sign-off, 1 checklist board titled "今日待办" with 5 checkbox items and a red star on the final line, and 1 yellow sticky note reading "老板别演". Make all Chinese typography feel intentionally designed, as if for a meme ad campaign and character branding poster. At the bottom, add a bold centered Chinese footer slogan reading {argument name="footer slogan" default="不演龙虾，我就是龙虾。"}. Use orange sunset backlight, warm shadows, glossy reflections on the claws, a cluttered but stylish startup office atmosphere, black and burnt-orange color grading, and a humorous yet competent "sharp-tongued AI intern" vibe. Include visible branding text "XIA XIA" on the cup and laptop, and make the whole image feel like a high-end character promo poster for an assistant persona used in workplace AI marketing.

items.title: Noir Woman With Red Halo Poster
items.titleZh: A minimalist fine-art poster portrait of a woman in clean side profile facing right, shown from about mid-torso up, with her face partially obscured by a soft rectangular blur over the front of the head. She has dark black hair styled in a low loose bun with gentle volume and wispy strands, and wears 1 dangling silver earring on the visible ear. Dress her in a structured black blazer or tailored coat with a deep neckline. The lower half of the figure dissolves into elongated dripping black ink trails, with many uneven vertical streaks extending downward like wet paint pulled by gravity, creating a dramatic melting silhouette. Place 1 large, perfectly round vivid red disc directly behind her head and upper shoulders, centered like a halo or rising sun. Use a strictly limited palette of black, red, and warm off-white. Set the background to a soft cream paper or canvas texture with subtle grain. Light the subject like a high-end noir editorial portrait with strong contrast, sculpted highlights on the ear, jaw, neck, and cheek contour, and deep shadow across the clothing. Keep the composition tall and centered with generous negative space, elegant poster-like balance, moody contemplative atmosphere, and crisp, refined photographic detail blended with painterly graphic design.
items.promptZh: 一幅极简主义美术海报肖像，画的是一名女性，侧面轮廓干净，面向右侧，从躯干中部向上展示，她的脸部分被头部前面的柔和矩形模糊所遮挡。她有一头深黑色的头发，扎成一个低松的发髻，发丝柔和，发丝纤细，可见的耳朵上戴着 1 个悬垂的银耳环。为她穿上有型的黑色西装外套或深领口定制外套。人物的下半部分溶解成细长的滴落的黑色墨水轨迹，许多不均匀的垂直条纹向下延伸，就像重力拉动的湿油漆一样，创造出戏剧性的融化轮廓。将 1 个大的、完美圆形的鲜红色圆盘直接放在她的头部和上肩后面，居中，就像光环或冉冉升起的太阳。使用严格限制的黑色、红色和暖灰白色调色板。将背景设置为柔软的奶油色纸或带有微妙纹理的画布纹理。像高端黑色社论肖像一样对拍摄对象进行照明，具有强烈的对比度，在耳朵、下巴、颈部和脸颊轮廓上雕刻高光，并在衣服上形成深阴影。保持构图高大且居中，留出大量的负空间，优雅的海报般的平衡，喜怒无常的沉思氛围，以及清晰、精致的摄影细节与绘画图形设计的融合。

items.title: Noir Man With Red Sun Poster
items.titleZh: Create a minimalist vertical art poster featuring a single man in clean side profile facing left, shown from about mid-thigh upward, wearing a tailored dark suit jacket, crisp white shirt, and a vintage 1940s-style black fedora with a ribbon band. His pose is upright, composed, and confident, evoking a classic noir protagonist. Render the figure in a refined monochrome photographic style with crisp editorial detail, rich tonal contrast, and dramatic Rembrandt-inspired lighting that sculpts the cheek, ear, jawline, hat brim, and shoulder with deep shadow. Place 1 bold perfectly round red disc directly behind the head and upper torso, centered like a halo or rising sun, creating a stark graphic focal point. The background should be a clean off-white or cream paper-textured surface with subtle grain and generous negative space around the subject. The lower half of the figure should dissolve into elongated black ink drips: count 12 distinct major dripping trails of varying thickness, hanging from the jacket hem and lower body, some long and straight, some tapering, with a few small splatters, as if the body is bleeding into the canvas. Keep the color palette strictly limited to black, red, and warm off-white. The overall mood should be moody, contemplative, elegant, slightly ominous, and modernist, like a high-end gallery poster blending film noir portraiture with surreal ink-paint abstraction.
items.promptZh: 创作一张极简主义垂直艺术海报，其中一名男子侧面轮廓简洁，面向左侧，从大腿中部向上显示，穿着定制的深色西装外套、挺括的白衬衫和 1940 年代风格的复古黑色软呢帽，配有丝带。他的姿势挺拔、沉稳、自信，让人想起经典的黑色主角。以精致的单色摄影风格渲染人物，具有清晰的编辑细节、丰富的色调对比和伦勃朗风格的戏剧性灯光，用深阴影塑造脸颊、耳朵、下巴、帽檐和肩膀。将 1 个粗体完美圆形红色圆盘直接放在头部和上躯干后面，像光环或升起的太阳一样居中，形成鲜明的图形焦点。背景应该是干净的灰白色或奶油色纸张纹理表面，在主题周围有微妙的纹理和宽敞的负空间。人物的下半部分应该溶解成细长的黑色墨滴：数12条不同粗细的明显主要滴迹，从夹克下摆和下半身垂下，有的长而直，有的逐渐变细，有一些小飞溅，仿佛身体正在渗入画布。将调色板严格限制为黑色、红色和暖灰白色。整体情绪应该是喜怒无常、沉思、优雅、略显不祥和现代主义，就像一张高端画廊海报，将黑色电影肖像与超现实水墨抽象融为一体。

items.title: Immersive Cultivation Novel Livestream Prompt
items.titleZh: Generate a 9:16 vertical smartphone screenshot of a realistic Douyin livestream. The theme is {argument name="livestream theme" default="three characters from 'A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality' selling magical treasures"}. Three people are in the frame, with their temperaments from left to right referencing Han Li, Zi Ling, and Xuan Gu. Do not show character names or use anime style; they should look like immortal cultivation streamers with a strong sense of reality. Clothing, makeup, and temperament should retain the Eastern immortal style while fitting realistic camera effects. The current item on display is {argument name="displayed item" default="'Thunderbolt Bamboo'"}, placed prominently in the foreground center. The item card should clearly display 'Thunderbolt Bamboo' and {argument name="item price" default="'9999 Spirit Stones'"}. The bamboo should have a rare treasure texture with clear details and a subtle, realistic lightning aura. The atmosphere should be lively with realistic UI, bullet comments, likes, and viewer counts. Bullet comments should feature relevant character nicknames like real fan interaction. The overall effect must look like a popular Chinese livestream screenshot—real, bustling, and having a mobile feel. No anime illustrations, movie posters, or game art. No English UI or exaggerated magic effects.
items.prompt: 生成一张 9:16 竖版手机截图风格的真实抖音直播间画面，主题是{argument name="直播主题" default="《凡人修仙传》三位人物直播卖法宝"}。三人同框，从左到右的人物气质分别参考韩立、紫灵、玄骨，但不要显示角色名字，也不要做成二次元立绘，要像真人感很强的修仙主播。服装、妆造和气质保留东方修仙风格，同时符合真实直播镜头效果。当前展示商品是{argument name="展示商品" default="“天雷竹”"}，放在画面中央偏前景重点展示，商品卡或直播信息区清楚显示“天雷竹”和{argument name="商品价格" default="“9999块灵石”"}。天雷竹要有珍稀灵宝质感，竹体细节清晰，带轻微真实的雷电气息，不要夸张特效。直播间氛围非常热闹，要有真实抖音直播 UI、弹幕、点赞、在线人数、直播标识和商品卡。弹幕里大量出现《凡人修仙传》相关人物昵称刷屏，像真实粉丝互动。整体效果必须像中国真实热门抖音带货直播截图，真实、热闹、有手机截图感。不要像动漫插画，不要像电影海报，不要像游戏宣传图，不要英文 UI，不要过强魔法爆炸特效。

items.titleZh: A luxury cosmetics advertisement poster featuring a single upright {argument name="product type" default="lipstick"} centered on a glossy black cube pedestal against a rich monochrome {argument name="background color" default="deep crimson red"} studio background. The product is a bold satin-finish {argument name="product shade" default="true red"} lipstick with the bullet fully extended, dramatic sculpted tip, and a two-tone tube: vivid red upper casing and matte black lower casing. On the front of the black base, vertical white brand text reads {argument name="brand name" default="BOBBI BROWN"}. Place elegant editorial copy on the left side in a refined high-fashion serif layout, split across multiple lines, reading {argument name="headline text" default="It’s not just a lipstick, it’s an attitude."}, with the final word styled in italic and a slightly brighter coral-red tone than the rest of the text.
