items.title: Cyberpunk 404 Witch Summoning
items.titleZh: A dramatic anime-style cyberpunk witch standing on a dark rooftop high above a dense futuristic city at night, viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The main subject is a petite young witch girl with pale skin, short icy blue bobbed hair, pointed elf-like ears, and glowing red eyes, wearing a sly confident smile. She raises a black wand overhead in her right hand, with a dangling orb charm at the tip glowing faintly purple and red. Her oversized crooked witch hat is black with purple lining and covered in stitched patches, warning labels, straps, and white graphics including a large “404” and a skull emblem. She wears a black and purple techwear outfit: oversized hooded jacket with many straps and tags, black crop top with “404” on the chest, layered belts, short bottoms, fishnet on one leg, black lace-up combat boots, chokers, and metallic accessories. Several hanging straps and tags visibly read words like “WITCH 404,” “404,” and glitch-themed markings. Beneath and beside her, a large glowing violet magic circle mixed with hacker interface aesthetics is projected on the rooftop floor, filled with occult rings, sigils, a central skull symbol, and scattered neon system text such as error-code fragments, creating a fusion of sorcery and digital corruption. Emerging from the circle is 1 large armored summoned figure: a black futuristic demon-knight or robotic familiar with jagged reflective armor, a narrow purple-lit visor, and a heavy weapon held in one hand, partially dissolving into purple energy shards and smoke. The background shows a sprawling rainy megacity of apartment towers and industrial rooftops, packed with windows, balconies, cables, signs, and haze. On a nearby building wall is a giant vertical graffiti-style sign with 3 readable elements: “404”, “Witch”, and “ERROR NOT FOUND”, plus a smaller “E404”. Additional purple neon glitch text and symbols are scattered across rooftops and in the air. Use a dark palette of black, indigo, and deep violet with sharp magenta-purple highlights, cinematic contrast, reflective wet surfaces, dense detail, and a high-end polished illustration style. The mood is occult, edgy, stylish, and dangerous, combining urban fantasy, hacker aesthetics, and magical summoning.
items.promptZh: 夜晚，一个戏剧性的动漫风格的赛博朋克女巫站在一座黑暗的屋顶上，高高地俯瞰着一座密集的未来城市，从稍微升高的角度观看。主角是一位身材娇小的年轻女巫，皮肤苍白，留着冰蓝色的短发，尖尖的耳朵，红红的眼睛，带着狡黠自信的微笑。她右手举起一根黑色魔杖，顶端悬挂着一个悬挂着的球体咒语，发出淡淡的紫色和红色光芒。她的超大号歪女巫帽是黑色的，带有紫色衬里，上面布满了缝制补丁、警告标签、带子和白色图形，包括一个大的“404”和一个骷髅徽章。她穿着一套黑色和紫色的科技服装：带有许多肩带和标签的超大连帽夹克、胸前带有“404”字样的黑色短上衣、分层腰带、短裤、一条腿上的渔网、黑色系带作战靴、颈链和金属配饰。一些吊带和标签上明显写有“WITCH 404”、“404”等字样，以及以故障为主题的标记。在她的下方和旁边，一个巨大的发光紫色魔法阵与黑客界面美学混合在一起投射在屋顶地板上，充满了神秘的戒指、印记、中央骷髅符号和分散的霓虹灯系统文本（如错误代码片段），创造了魔法和数字腐败的融合。从圆圈中出现的是一个巨大的装甲召唤人物：一个黑色的未来派恶魔骑士或机器人，熟悉锯齿状的反光盔甲，狭窄的紫色发光面罩，单手握着重型武器，部分溶解成紫色能量碎片和烟雾。背景展示了一座庞大的多雨大城市，里面有公寓楼和工业屋顶，到处都是窗户、阳台、电缆、标志和薄雾。附近的建筑墙上有一个巨大的垂直涂鸦式标牌，上面有 3 个可读元素：“404”、“女巫”和“错误未找到”，再加上一个较小的“E404”。额外的紫色霓虹灯故障文本和符号散布在屋顶和空中。使用黑色、靛蓝和深紫色的深色调色板，带有鲜明的洋紫色高光、电影对比度、反光湿表面、密集的细节和高端抛光插图风格。气氛神秘、前卫、时尚、危险，融合了都市奇幻、黑客美学和魔法召唤。

items.title: Weathered Custom Cub Concept Bike
items.titleZh: A highly detailed concept illustration of a customized vintage step-through motorcycle inspired by a Honda Super Cub, shown in a clean studio-like three-quarter left side view on a plain light gray background. The bike has a rugged post-apocalyptic street-build aesthetic with a black, white, and muted gray color scheme accented by small pink stickers and decals. Emphasize heavy weathering: chipped paint, scratches, oil stains, grime, rust flecks, ink splatter, worn edges, and layered sticker residue across the entire body. The front has 1 square headlight with an X-shaped light pattern and 2 smaller stacked auxiliary lights beneath it. Use spoked wheels, thick all-terrain tires, visible front suspension, exposed mechanical detail, chain drive, and a sturdy center stand touching the ground. The leg shield and side panels are covered in graphic decals, Japanese-style warning labels, numbers, symbols, and distressed typography, including a bold large kanji mark on the front fairing. Add 2 hard side cargo boxes on the rear, one larger box on the far side and 1 nearer black box with extra stickers, plus 1 hanging vertical tag charm attached near the rear case. Include 1 long black ribbed seat, rear rack framing, exposed wiring, metal brackets, bolts, and compact utility accessories that make it feel hand-modified and functional. Render it like an industrial design sketch mixed with polished anime mech concept art: precise linework, watercolor wash shadows, soft gray ground shadow, high-detail mechanical realism, slightly messy inked edges, and a collectible custom-bike illustration feel.
items.promptZh: 受本田 Super Cub 启发的定制老式步进摩托车的高度详细的概念插图，以纯浅灰色背景上干净的工作室式四分之三左侧视图显示。这款自行车具有粗犷的后世界末日街头建筑美学，采用黑色、白色和柔和的灰色配色方案，并配有粉红色小贴纸和贴花。强调严重风化：油漆剥落、划痕、油渍、污垢、锈斑、墨水飞溅、边缘磨损以及整个车身的分层贴纸残留。前部有 1 个带有 X 形光图案的方形头灯，其下方有 2 个较小的堆叠式辅助灯。使用辐条轮、厚实的全地形轮胎、可见的前悬架、暴露的机械细节、链条传动装置和接触地面的坚固中心支架。腿罩和侧板上覆盖着图形贴花、日式警告标签、数字、符号和仿旧版式，包括前整流罩上的粗体大汉字标记。在后部添加 2 个硬侧货箱，在远端添加 1 个较大的箱子，在较近的一侧添加 1 个带有额外贴纸的黑色箱子，再加上后箱附近附有 1 个悬挂式垂直标签饰物。包括 1 个黑色长肋状座椅、后架框架、外露接线、金属支架、螺栓和紧凑的实用配件，使其具有手工改装和实用的感觉。将其渲染为工业设计草图，与精美的动漫机甲概念艺术混合在一起：精确的线条、水彩水洗阴影、柔和的灰色地面阴影、高细节的机械现实主义、略显凌乱的墨迹边缘以及具有收藏价值的定制自行车插画感觉。

items.title: Anime Fantasy Travel Movie Poster
items.titleZh: A cinematic anime movie poster for a fictional film titled {argument name="headline text" default="EL VIAJE DE LA LUNA DE PLATA"}, in polished modern Japanese animation style with a natural, less over-detailed look. Center a teenage anime girl from mid-thigh up, facing forward, with a short silver bob haircut, pale skin, a black choker, small black geometric earrings, a white tank top, and a dark navy oversized zip hoodie with two yellow stripes running down the sleeves. She has a backpack strap over one shoulder and both hands tucked casually into the hoodie pockets. Her face is obscured by a flat rectangular censor block in a muted beige tone, covering the entire face area. Place her in a dramatic twilight coastal city setting that blends travel, nostalgia, and fantasy: on the left, a lit train platform with a commuter train approaching, its destination sign showing Japanese characters; behind it, a glowing city skyline with a ferris wheel. In the distance and lower left, layered mountains and a winding illuminated valley road. On the right, a cliffside coast at sunset with the sea reflecting warm light, a crescent moon in the sky, several flying seabirds, and a curving highway descending along the hillside. Also on the right, include a wooden signpost with exactly 3 directional signs labeled "NUEVOS CAMINOS", "VIEJOS RECUERDOS", and "SIN LÍMITES". At the top center, add the Spanish tagline {argument name="tagline text" default="CADA DESTINO CAMBIA SU HISTORIA"} in elegant serif capitals. On the upper left, create an awards column in gold typography with laurel wreaths and exactly 4 award blocks: one text block reading "GANADORA DE MÚLTIPLES PREMIOS" with 5 gold stars beneath it, then three laurel award sections reading "MEJOR PELÍCULA ANIMADA / FESTIVAL INTERNACIONAL DE ANIMACIÓN / 2024", "PREMIO DEL PÚBLICO / FESTIVAL INTERNACIONAL DE CINE / 2024", and "MEJOR BANDA SONORA ORIGINAL / ACADEMIA DE CINE ANIMADO / 2024". Place the film title large across the lower center in luminous ornate serif lettering with a magical glow and sweeping flourishes, layered partly over the character. Beneath it, add the Spanish quote {argument name="quote" default="A veces, para encontrarte... tienes que perderte en el mundo."}. Below that, add "UNA PELÍCULA DE ESTUDIO LUMINARIA" in small caps. Add large centered title typography near the bottom reading {argument name="headline text" default="VIAJES DE PRIMAVERA"}, with a refined serif font in pale ivory. items.titleZh:
Create a luxurious vintage-style travel poster for {argument name="country name" default="Germany"}, designed like a premium tourism campaign advertisement. Use a grand, symmetrical composition with elegant editorial typography and a refined gold border frame with tiny ornamental corner details. At the top center, place a small gold national emblem above the word “DISCOVER”, then a very large serif title reading {argument name="headline country" default="GERMANY"} in deep navy blue. Under it, add the slogan “LAND OF HISTORY. CULTURE. INSPIRATION.” in gold uppercase, followed by a smaller classic serif tagline reading “Timeless Traditions. Unforgettable Journeys.” with a tiny horizontal accent in the colors black, red, and gold.

Show a majestic panoramic montage of iconic German scenery at golden hour under a softly glowing blue sky with scattered clouds. On the left, feature a fairy-tale white hilltop castle resembling Neuschwanstein, perched above autumn trees. In the center distance, place dramatic alpine mountains. On the right, show a historic European riverside city with dense red-roofed houses, an arched stone bridge crossing the water, a domed cathedral, and a towering Gothic cathedral with twin spires. Add calm river reflections and a small white sightseeing boat at the lower right. The image should feel nostalgic, romantic, and aspirational, with warm sunlight, crisp architectural detail, and rich cinematic color grading.

Along the lower middle, include exactly 5 gold line-art cultural icons with labels beneath them, evenly spaced in a horizontal row: “ICONIC LANDMARKS”, “RICH HERITAGE”, “VIBRANT CULTURE”, “AUTHENTIC TRADITIONS”, and “BREATHTAKING LANDSCAPES”.

At the bottom, create a dark horizontal food showcase strip with the centered heading “SAVOR THE TASTE OF GERMANY” in gold. Inside the strip, include exactly 5 framed food panels, each labeled in white uppercase beneath the image: “BREZEL”, “BRATWURST”, “KARTOFFELSALAT”, “SCHWARZWÄLDER KIRSCHTORTE”, and “GERMAN BEER”. Show each item as an appetizing close-up: a glossy pretzel on a plate, grilled sausages with sauerkraut, creamy potato salad, a slice of Black Forest cake topped with cream and cherry, and a frothy beer mug. Keep the overall design polished, high-end, poster-like, and suitable for a luxury destination campaign.

为{argument name="country name" default="Germany"}制作一张豪华复古风格的旅行海报，其设计类似于优质旅游活动广告。使用宏伟、对称的构图、优雅的编辑排版和精致的金色边框，并带有微小的装饰角细节。在顶部中心，在“DISCOVER”一词上方放置一个小的金色国徽，然后放置一个非常大的衬线标题，其为深海军蓝色的{argument name="headlinecountry"default="GERMANY"}。在其下方添加口号“历史之地。文化。灵感。”金色大写字母，后面是较小的经典衬线标语：“永恒的传统。难忘的旅程。”带有黑色、红色和金色的微小水平装饰。

在柔和的蓝天和零散的云彩下，展示黄金时段德国标志性风景的壮丽全景蒙太奇。左边是一座童话般的白色山顶城堡，类似新天鹅堡，坐落在秋天的树木上方。中心距离是引人注目的高山山脉。右侧展示的是一座历史悠久的欧洲河畔城市，有密集的红顶房屋、横跨水面的拱形石桥、圆顶大教堂和高耸的双尖塔哥特式大教堂。在右下角添加平静的河流倒影和一艘白色的小观光船。图像应该给人怀旧、浪漫和渴望的感觉，有温暖的阳光、清晰的建筑细节和丰富的电影色彩分级。

沿着中下方，正好包含 5 个金色线条艺术文化图标，其下方带有标签，水平排列均匀分布：“标志性地标”、“丰富的遗产”、“活力文化”、“真实的传统”和“令人惊叹的景观”。

在底部，创建一个深色水平食品展示条，中间带有金色标题“品尝德国的味道”。条带内包含 5 个带框食品面板，每个面板在图像下方均以白色大写字母标记：“BREZEL”、“BRATWURST”、“KARTOFFELSALAT”、“SCHWARZWäLDER KIRSCHTORTE”和“GERMAN BEER”。将每件物品都以令人胃口大开的特写镜头展示：盘子里有光泽的椒盐卷饼、酸菜烤香肠、奶油土豆沙拉、一片淋有奶油和樱桃的黑森林蛋糕，以及一个泡沫啤酒杯。保持整体设计精致、高端、海报般，适合豪华目的地活动。

奢华的复古旅行海报风格插图，以{argument name="country name" default="FRANCE"}为目的地，{argument name="city name" default="PARIS"}，设计得像一则优雅的旅游广告。在黄金时段的日落时分，欣赏宏伟、浪漫的巴黎城市景观，以及桃红色、粉红色、薰衣草色和淡金色的柔和天空。让埃菲尔铁塔成为占据主导地位的中心地标，高大而精致，矗立在城市之上。包括另外 4 个巴黎标志性地标：左侧的卢浮宫金字塔、中心背景附近的凯旋门、埃菲尔铁塔右侧的巴黎圣母院以及最右上山坡上的圣心大教堂。在前景中，用鲜艳的紫色茂密盛开的{argument name="flower field" default="lavender"}填充场景，营造出通往城市的梦幻般的绘画前景。在埃菲尔铁塔下方添加一条河流和优雅的石桥，反射温暖的日落光。构图应该给人一种理想化、电影般的感觉，并且略带幻想，将多个地标结合成一个和谐的全景视图。

在左上角到中上区域覆盖精致的编辑排版：一个非常大的衬线标题，阅读{argument name =“headline text”default =“FRANCE”}，带有较小间距的衬线副标题阅读{argument name =“subheadline text”default =“PARIS”}。在副标题上方放置一个金色的百合花小装饰品；在它的下面，添加一个微小的水平法国三色口音。在主标题下，准确地包含两行促销文案：“永恒的美丽。无尽的灵感。”以及优雅的小写字母和斜体字体的“Where Every Moment Been a Memory”。在整个海报周围添加细细的装饰性金色边框，并带有精致的装饰角细节。

在底部，创建一个与图像融为一体的软奶油雾面板，将短语“法国生活艺术”置于一排 3 个食品和饮料的上方：1 个放在盘子上的黄油羊角面包、1 杯红酒和 1 个酒瓶，以及 1 个放在模子里的焦糖布丁，上面有浆果。将它们标记为“羊角面包”、“美酒”和“焦糖布丁”。在右侧添加 4 个小金线图标，其下方带有标签：“标志性地标”、“丰富的遗产”、“正宗美食”和“难忘的体验”。整体风格：超细致、精美的旅游海报，浪漫的欧洲旅游广告，绘画写实，温暖的发光氛围，优质的印刷设计，平衡的构图，高端的杂志审美。

items.title: Luxury Northern Europe Travel Poster
items.titleZh: Create an elegant luxury travel poster for {argument name="region name" default="NORTHERN EUROPE"}, designed like a premium tourism campaign brochure cover. Use a wide symmetrical layout with a thin gold decorative border and refined editorial typography. At the top center, place a small compass-star icon above the word DISCOVER, then a very large serif headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="NORTHERN EUROPE"} in deep navy blue. Below it, add a gold uppercase tagline: {argument name="tagline" default="BREATHTAKING NATURE. RICH CULTURE. TIMELESS EXPERIENCES."} and beneath that a smaller elegant italic line: {argument name="subheading" default="Four Countries. Countless Memories."}. The main image area is divided into 4 equal vertical scenic panels showing iconic destinations at golden hour with soft glowing skies and cinematic realism. Panel 1: Denmark, Copenhagen, a colorful harbor waterfront with historic buildings, boats, calm reflective water, and a domed landmark in the background; include a small Danish flag above the labels DENMARK and COPENHAGEN. Panel 2: Sweden, Stockholm, a waterfront old-town skyline with church spires and warm sunset light reflected in the water; include a small Swedish flag above the labels SWEDEN and STOCKHOLM. Panel 3: Finland, Helsinki, a small stone castle-like island fortress in blue water under a bright sky; include a small Finnish flag above the labels FINLAND and HELSINKI. Panel 4: Norway, dramatic fjords with steep jagged mountains, a waterfall, and a tiny red-roof coastal village at the water’s edge; include a small Norwegian flag above the labels NORWAY and FJORDS OF NORWAY. Beneath the 4 country panels, add a row of 4 gold line icons with captions, evenly spaced: mountain icon with ICONIC LANDSCAPES, Viking ship icon with RICH HERITAGE, moose icon with WILD NATURE, camera icon with UNFORGETTABLE JOURNEYS. Near the bottom center, place a gold divider and the title A TASTE OF THE NORTH. Under it, show exactly 5 food thumbnail panels in a horizontal strip, each on a plate or bowl with warm appetizing lighting and dark blue framing: 1) Smørrebrød — Denmark, open-faced sandwich topped with shrimp; 2) Köttbullar — Sweden, Swedish meatballs with cream sauce and lingonberries; 3) Gravad lax — Finland, sliced cured salmon in a bowl; 4) Fish soup — Norway, creamy fish soup with herbs and seafood; 5) Kanelbulle — Sweden, a glossy cinnamon bun on a plate. Use a polished high-end travel-ad aesthetic, photorealistic scenery, soft sunset color grading, navy and gold graphic design, balanced composition, crisp text placement, and a nostalgic upscale European tourism mood.
items.promptZh: 为{argument name="region name" default="NORTHERN EUROPE"}制作一张优雅的豪华旅行海报，其设计类似于优质旅游活动宣传册封面。使用宽对称布局，带有细金色装饰边框和精致的编辑排版。在顶部中心，在“DISCOVER”一词上方放置一个小罗盘星形图标，然后放置一个非常大的衬线标题，内容为深海军蓝色的{argument name="headline text" default="NORTHERN EUROPE"}。在其下方添加金色大写标语：{argument name="tagline" default="BREATHTAKING NATURE. RICH CULTURE. TIMELESS EXPERIENCES."}，在其下方添加一条较小的优雅斜体线：{argument name="subheading" default="Four Nations. Countless Memories."}。主图像区域分为 4 个相等的垂直风景面板，展示黄金时段的标志性目的地、柔和的发光天空和电影般的真实感。第一组：丹麦，哥本哈根，色彩缤纷的港口海滨，有历史建筑、船只、平静的水面倒影，背景是一个圆顶地标；在 DENMARK 和 COPENHAGEN 标签上方包含一面小丹麦国旗。第二组：瑞典斯德哥尔摩，海滨老城的天际线，教堂尖顶和温暖的夕阳光倒映在水中；在“瑞典”和“斯德哥尔摩”标签上方包含一面瑞典小国旗。展板三：芬兰赫尔辛基，明朗天空下蔚蓝海水中一座小石堡般的海岛堡垒；在 FINLAND 和 HELSINKI 标签上方添加一面小芬兰国旗。第四组：挪威，壮丽的峡湾，陡峭的锯齿状山脉，瀑布，以及水边的一个红顶沿海小村庄；在 NORWAY 和 FJORDS OF NORWAY 标签上方添加一面小挪威国旗。在 4 个国家/地区面板下方，添加一排 4 个带有标题的金线图标，间隔均匀：带有标志性景观的山峰图标、带有丰富遗产的维京船图标、带有野生自然的驼鹿图标、带有难忘旅程的相机图标。在底部中心附近，放置一个金色分隔板和标题“北方的味道”。在其下方，以水平条形显示 5 个食物缩略图面板，每个面板或碗上都有温暖的开胃灯光和深蓝色框架： 1) Smørrebrød — 丹麦，开面三明治，上面放有虾； 2）Köttbullar——瑞典，瑞典肉丸配奶油酱和越橘； 3) Gravad lax——芬兰，将腌制三文鱼切片放入碗中； 4）鱼汤——挪威，香草海鲜奶油鱼汤； 5) Kanelbulle——瑞典，盘子里放着光滑的肉桂面包。采用精致的高端旅游广告美学、逼真的风景、柔和的日落色彩分级、海军蓝和金色的图形设计、平衡的构图、清晰的文字放置以及怀旧的高档欧洲旅游氛围。

items.title: Luxury Austria Travel Poster
items.titleZh: A luxurious vintage-style travel poster for {argument name="country name" default="Austria"}, designed like a premium tourism advertisement. Use an elegant, symmetrical poster layout with thin gold decorative border lines and small ornamental corner details. At the top center, place a minimalist gold mountain emblem above the word “DISCOVER”, then a very large refined serif title reading {argument name="headline text" default="AUSTRIA"} in deep burgundy red. Beneath it, add a small uppercase tagline in gold: “TIMELESS BEAUTY. RICH HERITAGE. UNFORGETTABLE EXPERIENCES.” and below that an italic script line: “Where Tradition Meets Breathtaking Nature.” Place a small horizontal Austrian flag motif between the lines. The main image should be a breathtaking composite alpine lake scene at golden hour: on the left, a dramatic hilltop fortress resembling Salzburg Castle perched on a rocky cliff above the water; in the center distance, a calm reflective lake leading into a valley of towering snow-capped Alps; on the right, a picturesque Austrian lakeside village resembling Hallstatt with steep-roofed houses, a tall church spire, a hillside church, and clustered wooden buildings descending to the water. Warm sunlight from the left, crisp blue sky, glowing highlights on the mountains, rich reflections in the lake, romantic cinematic atmosphere, ultra-detailed, majestic and inviting. Along the lower middle, show exactly 5 gold icon-and-label tourism highlights spaced evenly: 1 castle icon with “ICONIC LANDMARKS”, 1 classical column icon with “RICH HERITAGE”, 1 music note icon with “VIBRANT CULTURE”, 1 heart icon with “WARM HOSPITALITY”, and 1 mountain icon with “BREATHTAKING LANDSCAPES”. At the bottom, create a horizontal food strip with exactly 5 framed culinary photos separated by thin dividers under the centered heading “SAVOR THE TASTE OF AUSTRIA”. The 5 dishes are: Wiener Schnitzel, Appelstrudel, Kaiserschmarrn, Sachertorte, and Melange. Each food image should be realistic, warmly lit, plated attractively, and labeled in uppercase serif text beneath the image. Overall style: high-end European travel campaign poster, polished editorial design, romantic nostalgia, refined typography, harmonious gold and burgundy accents, photorealistic scenery blended with luxury brochure aesthetics.
items.promptZh: {argument name="country name" default="Austria"} 的豪华复古风格旅行海报，设计类似于优质旅游广告。使用优雅、对称的海报布局，带有细金色装饰边框线和小装饰角细节。在顶部中心，在“DISCOVER”一词上方放置一个极简主义的金色山徽，然后是一个非常大的精致衬线标题，其内容为深酒红色的{argument name="headline text" default="AUSTRIA"}。在其下方，添加一个金色的大写小标语：“永恒的美丽。丰富的遗产。难忘的经历。”下面是斜体字：“传统与令人惊叹的自然相遇。”在线条之间放置一个小的水平奥地利国旗图案。主要图像应该是黄金时段令人惊叹的合成高山湖泊场景：左边是一座引人注目的山顶堡垒，类似萨尔茨堡城堡，栖息在水面之上的岩石悬崖上；左边是一座令人惊叹的山顶堡垒，类似萨尔茨堡城堡，坐落在水面之上的岩石悬崖上；中心远处是一个平静的倒影湖，通向高耸的白雪皑皑的阿尔卑斯山山谷；右边是风景如画的奥地利湖畔村庄，类似哈尔施塔特，有陡峭的屋顶房屋、高高的教堂尖顶、山坡上的教堂，以及一直延伸到水面的木质建筑。左边温暖的阳光，清新的蓝天，山峦的发光亮点，湖水的丰富倒影，浪漫的电影氛围，超详细，雄伟而诱人。沿着中下部，均匀地显示 5 个金色图标和标签旅游亮点：1 个带有“标志性地标”的城堡图标、1 个带有“丰富遗产”的古典圆柱图标、1 个带有“活力文化”的音符图标、1 个带有“热情好客”的心形图标和 1 个带有“令人惊叹的景观”的山峰图标。在底部，创建一个水平食物条，其中正好有 5 张镶框烹饪照片，并在中心标题“品尝奥地利的味道”下用薄隔板隔开。这 5 道菜是：维也纳炸肉排、Appelstrudel、Kaiserschmarrn、Sachertorte 和 Melange。每张食物图像都应该逼真、光线温暖、摆盘美观，并在图像下方用大写衬线文本标记。整体风格：高端欧洲旅游宣传海报，精致的编辑设计，浪漫的怀旧气息，精致的排版，和谐的金色和酒红色调，逼真的风景与奢华宣传册美学的融合。

items.titleZh: A close-up upper-body portrait of a cute Japanese idol-style girl in an ultra-kawaii pastel bedroom, centered in frame, with her face hidden by a large solid rectangular censor block in a muted mauve-brown color. She has dark brown medium-length wavy hair in twin tails, decorated with 2 oversized translucent pink bows, pearl strands, ribbon streamers, and 2 dangling star charms. Her outfit is an extravagant yume-kawaii idol dress in shimmering {argument name="main colors" default="pink and lavender"}, with glossy satin fabric, lace trim, frilly off-shoulder sleeves, sheer ruffles, beadwork, tiny gem details, and a large jeweled heart brooch at the center of the chest. Include a lace camisole neckline underneath, a sparkly collar with tiny pastel charms, a ribbon bow near one curl that she gently holds with one hand, and matching frilled wrist cuffs. The background is a dreamy, heavily decorated kawaii room filled with soft fairy lights, pastel curtains, ribbons, bows, plush textures, and glowing decor. On the left side, add a pink neon heart sign with a bow outline containing the Japanese text {argument name="neon sign text" default="夢は叶えるもの"}. Use a soft-focus lens, glittery highlights, pearlescent textures, warm pink-purple ambient lighting, bokeh sparkles, and a vertical social-media photo composition. items.title: Anime Crowd Camera POV Comparison
items.titleZh: A two-panel comparison graphic on a black background demonstrating a dramatic camera-angle change in an anime-style crowded street scene. Place a large white sentence centered across the top: "{argument name="headline text" default="Move the camera POV to be at ground level in the crowd."}". On the left side, add two large white labels aligned with the panels: "Source" beside the upper panel and "Output" beside the lower panel. Create exactly 2 stacked rectangular image panels centered on the canvas. In the top panel, show a high-angle overhead view of a densely packed historical street crowd in a hand-painted anime film style, with dozens of people pressed together around horse-drawn carts and wagon wheels; include bundled luggage, hats, muted earth-tone clothing, blue and tan garments, and a busy composition where figures overlap in every direction. In the bottom panel, recreate the same type of scene but shift the camera to a low, ground-level point of view inside the crowd, looking between bodies and beside a large wagon wheel on the right edge. The foreground should feel immersive and cramped, with several bent or crouched figures close to the camera, a person in a muted purple robe on the left foreground, a kneeling or hunched figure in tan near the center bottom, and a woman in a light blue dress or coat toward the right-middle turning through the crowd while holding a small child. Keep the environment as a chaotic old-world market or transit street with horses, carts, people in brimmed hats and simple period clothing, dusty ground, and warm subdued colors. Use soft cinematic anime lighting, painterly shading, and the visual feel of a classic Studio Ghibli crowd sequence. The overall image should read as a before-and-after camera experiment, with the upper panel as the original overhead composition and the lower panel as the transformed low-angle perspective.
items.promptZh: 黑色背景上的两面板比较图形，展示了动漫风格的拥挤街道场景中摄像机角度的戏剧性变化。在顶部居中放置一个大的白色句子：“{argument name=”headline text”default=”将相机 POV 移动到人群中的地面位置。”}”。在左侧，添加两个与面板对齐的大白色标签：上面板旁边的“源”和下面板旁边的“输出”。创建 2 个以画布为中心的堆叠矩形图像面板。在顶部面板中，以手绘动漫电影风格展示了密密麻麻的历史街道人群的高角度俯视图，数十人挤在马车和车轮周围；包括捆绑的行李、帽子、柔和的大地色服装、蓝色和棕褐色的服装，以及人物在各个方向重叠的繁忙构图。在底部面板中，重新创建相同类型的场景，但将摄像机转移到人群内部的低地面视角，观察尸体之间以及右侧边缘的一个大马车车轮旁边。前景应该让人感觉身临其境和局促，有几个靠近镜头的弯腰或蹲着的人物，左边前景有一个穿着柔和紫色长袍的人，靠近中央底部有一个跪着或驼背的棕褐色人物，中间偏右有一个穿着浅蓝色连衣裙或外套的女人抱着一个小孩在人群中转身。将环境保持为混乱的旧世界市场或交通街道，有马匹、马车、戴着檐帽、穿着简单古装的人们、尘土飞扬的地面和温暖柔和的色彩。使用柔和的电影动画灯光、绘画式阴影以及经典吉卜力工作室人群序列的视觉感觉。整个图像应该被解读为相机实验前后的对比，上面的面板是原始的俯视构图，下面的面板是转换后的低角度透视图。

items.title: Restaurant POV Change Comparison
items.titleZh: A side-by-side social media comparison graphic on a dark black background, showing a camera-angle transformation test for a busy restaurant interior. At the very top, large white sans-serif text reads: {argument name="headline text" default="Show me the POV from someone standing behind the bar looking out over this crowded restaurant. Change NOTHING in the scene other than the pov"}. Below that, centered on the page, are 2 vertically stacked rectangular photos with rounded corners. To the left of the top image, large white text reads "Source"; to the left of the bottom image, large white text reads "Output". The top image shows the original restaurant scene from the customer side facing the back bar: a warm, upscale, crowded restaurant at night with a massive illuminated wall of liquor bottles on shelves, wood ceiling beams, hanging globe pendant lights, bartenders and servers working, and many seated guests in the foreground and midground. The lower image shows the same restaurant with the same lighting, décor, crowd density, bottle wall, pendant lights, and overall atmosphere, but from a new viewpoint: the camera is now standing behind the bar looking outward across the crowded dining room. In the foreground of the lower image, include the bar counter surface with glassware, bottles, metal bar tools, and a glowing POS touchscreen at front left, reinforcing the behind-the-bar POV. Keep both photos photorealistic, warm amber lighting, lively evening ambiance, and maintain the sense that the lower image is the same scene with only the camera angle changed. Add subtle social-post styling with generous margins and clean layout, suitable for a tweet screenshot or AI image comparison post.
items.promptZh: 深黑色背景上的并排社交媒体比较图，显示了繁忙餐厅内部的相机角度转换测试。在最顶部，大的白色无衬线文本显示：{argument name="headline text" default="向我显示站在吧台后面的某人的视角，俯瞰这家拥挤的餐厅。除了视角之外，不要更改场景中的任何内容"}。下面，页面中央是 2 张垂直堆叠的圆角矩形照片。在顶部图像的左侧，大的白色文字写着“来源”；在底部图像的左侧，大的白色文字写着“输出”。顶部图片显示了面向后吧台的顾客一侧的原始餐厅场景：一家温暖、高档、夜间拥挤的餐厅，架子上有一面巨大的发光墙，上面摆满了酒瓶，木天花板横梁，悬挂着的地球吊灯，调酒师和服务员正在工作，还有许多坐在前景和中景的客人。下图显示了同一家餐厅，具有相同的灯光、装饰、人群密度、瓶壁、吊灯和整体氛围，但从一个新的角度来看：摄像机现在站在吧台后面，向外望去，穿过拥挤的餐厅。在下图的前景中，包括带有玻璃器皿、瓶子、金属酒吧工具的吧台表面，以及左前方发光的 POS 触摸屏，增强了吧台后的 POV。保持两张照片的真实感、温暖的琥珀色灯光、热闹的夜晚氛围，并保持下部图像是同一场景（仅改变相机角度）的感觉。添加微妙的社交帖子样式，具有宽大的边距和简洁的布局，适合推文屏幕截图或 AI 图像比较帖子。

items.title: Realistic Japanese Idol Close-Up
items.titleZh: A hyperrealistic close-up portrait of a young Japanese woman idol, framed vertically from the shoulders up, with her head slightly tilted and looking directly into the camera. She has {argument name="hair color" default="jet black"} straight medium-length hair with full blunt bangs that partially cover her forehead and lightly frame both sides of her face. Her skin is very smooth and pale with soft even lighting, large dark brown eyes with a gentle glossy catchlight, a small natural nose, and subtly glossy pink lips parted slightly to reveal uneven front teeth, with one upper tooth visibly irregular and overlapping, creating a charming imperfect smile. Her expression is calm, soft, and innocent. She wears a delicate light blue frilled lace top with sheer ruffle details visible at the shoulders. The background is softly blurred in cool pastel tones of lavender, blue, and pink, suggesting an indoor stage or event backdrop with bokeh-like highlights. Emphasize realistic facial texture, accurate asymmetrical teeth, beauty-idol photography styling, shallow depth of field, and a clean polished Japanese portrait aesthetic.
items.promptZh: 一位年轻日本女偶像的超写实特写肖像，从肩膀向上垂直取景，她的头稍微倾斜，直视镜头。她有一头{argument name="hair color" default="jet black"}中等长度的直发，齐刘海遮住了部分前额，轻轻地勾勒出脸的两侧。她的皮肤非常光滑苍白，光线柔和均匀，深棕色的大眼睛带有柔和的光泽，鼻子自然小，粉红色的嘴唇微微张开，露出参差不齐的门牙，其中一颗上牙明显不规则且重叠，形成迷人的不完美微笑。她的表情平静、温柔、天真。她穿着一件精致的浅蓝色褶边蕾丝上衣，肩部可见透明的荷叶边细节。背景以淡紫色、蓝色和粉色的冷色调柔和模糊，暗示室内舞台或活动背景具有散景般的亮点。强调真实的面部纹理、准确的不对称牙齿、美女偶像摄影造型、浅景深以及干净抛光的日本肖像美学。

items.title: Tokyo DisneySea Front-Row Battle UI
items.titleZh:
Create a hyper-detailed comedic Japanese arcade fighting game screenshot styled like a versus battle scene, using a real-world photo aesthetic with game UI overlaid on top. The scene shows an intense mock battle between two groups of theme-park fans competing for the front row at an outdoor show plaza in Tokyo DisneySea. Use a wide 16:9 composition. In the background, clearly show Mediterranean Harbor and Mount Prometheus under bright daytime skies, with the waterfront and DisneySea architecture visible. In the foreground, show exactly 10 young adult people in winter casual clothing, split into 2 opposing teams of 5, physically leaning, grabbing, reaching, and shoving in a tug-of-war-like scrum over position, with exaggerated competitive body language and frozen action as if in a fighting game. Faces should be anonymized with soft blurred blocks. Add floating character labels above each person with levels and names in Japanese. The overall tone is absurdly realistic, like a real candid photo transformed into a polished arcade game battle screen.

Add a full Japanese fighting-game HUD with glossy blue-versus-red interface styling. At the very top, place a center stage title bar reading "東京ディズニーシー　ミッキー広場　ショー最前列バトル" and a large timer in the middle reading "TIME 89". In the top left, add a blue team header "PLAYER1" and team name "最前列ガチ勢A". In the top right, add a red team header "RIVAL" and team name "ライバルグループB". On the left side, stack exactly 5 blue player status panels with portraits, level, Japanese class-like nicknames, HP, SP, and BURST meters. The 5 left-side labels are: "Lv.25 ガチ勢リーダー ユウキ", "Lv.24 筋肉マン タケシ", "Lv.23 眼鏡オタク シンジ", "Lv.23 開角心MAX ケント", "Lv.22 サポート要員 リョウ". On the right side, stack exactly 5 red rival status panels with the labels: "Lv.27 ライバルリーダー ダイキ", "Lv.26 パワフル代表 マサル", "Lv.24 戦略家 コウジ", "Lv.23 熱血漢 リク", "Lv.22 サポート女子 サキ". Each panel should include numeric HP and SP values and segmented BURST gauges, styled like a Japanese arcade RPG-fighter interface.

Place exactly 10 in-battle nameplates above the fighters in the center scene, color-coded blue for the left team and red for the right team. The 10 labels are: "Lv.24 タケシ", "Lv.25 ユウキ", "Lv.23 シンジ", "Lv.23 ケント", "Lv.22 リョウ", "Lv.27 ダイキ", "Lv.26 マサル", "Lv.23 リク", "Lv.22 サキ", "Lv.22 ミサキ".

At the lower left, add a skill menu titled "スキル" listing exactly 5 skills with SP costs: "ダッシュ突撃 SP 20", "肩押し強奪 SP 25", "荷物で場所確保 SP 15", "ロープくぐり SP 10", "本気の根性 SP 50". Beneath that, add a dark description box explaining the highlighted skill "本気の根性" with the Japanese text: "気合で相手を威圧し、どかす！ 一定時間、相手が怯みやすくなる！ （バーストゲージを大きく消費する） 効果時間：10秒".

At the bottom center, add an item menu titled "アイテム" with exactly 5 item slots showing icons and counts: a water bottle "x3", a folded purple towel "x2", a blue drawstring bag "x1", a gray backpack "x1", and a boxed meal "x2". At the lower right, add a quest panel titled "クエスト" with the mission text "ショー開始までに最前列を死守しろ！" and condition text "条件：ライバルグループを全員後ろに押し戻せ！" and countdown text "ショー開始まで：02:30". Beside it, add a mini-map titled "ミッキー広場MAP" showing red and blue dots for both teams in the plaza. Along the very bottom edge, include small controller prompts in Japanese for actions such as skill use, item use, grab/push, and dash.

Use dramatic, saturated lighting, crisp detail, realistic clothing folds, authentic plaza stone pavement, and a high-end Japanese game screenshot look. The image should feel like a ridiculous but believable crossover between a real Tokyo DisneySea crowd photo and a competitive arcade battle game interface.

items.title: Editorial Studio Portrait in Neutral Streetwear
items.titleZh: A high-end studio fashion portrait of a {argument name="subject gender" default="woman"} in her mid-30s to early 40s with a naturally fit build, shown in a half-body to upper-thigh framing, standing in a relaxed, confident pose with both hands tucked into her pants pockets. She has long, dark chestnut-brown wavy hair parted near the center, softly cascading over her shoulders, and wears 2 small gold hoop earrings on one visible ear, a delicate gold necklace, and a thin bracelet. Her outfit is modern minimal casual streetwear in soft neutral tones: a light beige zip-front jacket worn open, a fitted white cropped tank top, and matching light beige drawstring jogger pants. Shoot at eye level with an 85mm portrait lens at f/2.8, keeping the subject tack sharp with shallow depth of field. Use professional studio lighting with 1 softbox key light from the front-left, subtle fill to soften shadows, and 1 gentle warm rim light along the hair and shoulder for separation. The background is a clean studio backdrop with a smooth taupe-to-warm-gray neutral gradient and no distractions. The image should feel highly realistic and editorial, with natural skin tones, balanced color grading, ultra-high detail, crisp fabric texture, soft natural shadows, no noise, no motion blur, no cartoon styling, and no anatomical distortions.
items.promptZh: 一幅高端工作室时尚肖像，拍摄的是一位 30 多岁到 40 岁出头的{argument name="subject sex" default="woman"}，身材自然健美，采用半身到大腿上部的取景框架，以轻松、自信的姿势站立，双手插在裤子口袋里。她有一头深栗棕色的长发，中间分开，轻柔地披在肩上，一只可见的耳朵上戴着两个小金圈耳环，一条精致的金项链和一条细手镯。她的服装是现代简约休闲街头装，采用柔和的中性色调：一件敞开的浅米色前拉链夹克，一件合身的白色短款背心，以及配套的浅米色抽绳慢跑裤。使用 f/2.8 的 85 毫米人像镜头在视线水平位置拍摄，以浅景深保持拍摄对象的锐度。使用专业工作室照明，其中 1 个柔光箱主光来自左前方，微妙的填充可柔化阴影，1 个柔和温暖的边缘光沿着头发和肩膀进行分离。背景是一个干净的工作室背景，具有光滑的灰褐色到暖灰色的中性渐变，没有任何干扰。图像应该感觉高度真实和编辑，具有自然的肤色、平衡的色彩分级、超高细节、清晰的织物纹理、柔和的自然阴影、无噪点、无运动模糊、无卡通造型、无解剖扭曲。

items.titleZh: A moody 4-by-3 photo collage made of 12 candid smartphone-style snapshots of a young couple during summer nights in Tokyo, shot with a nostalgic film look, soft grain, muted colors, slight blur, low contrast, dim ambient street lighting, and intimate casual framing. The overall tone is romantic, youthful, private, and documentary-like, with a warm gray-brown palette and a slightly desaturated teal-orange night city atmosphere. The man has messy dark hair, a slim build, and wears a dark overshirt or lightweight jacket over a white T-shirt; the woman has long dark brown hair, a slim build, and wears a white sleeveless top with thin black shoulder straps from a bag. Middle row panel 5, a pavement shadow photo of two people, one making a peace sign; panel 6, the couple standing close on a sidewalk in an urban shopping street; panel 7, a sunset skyline over water with Tokyo Tower visible, no people; panel 8, a high-angle shot looking down on the woman and the man close together on stairs or a walkway. Bottom row panel 9, a tight intimate close-up of the couple touching faces or kissing; panel 10, the man adjusting or touching the woman's hair on a city street; panel 11, the couple riding together on a scooter or motorcycle, both wearing helmets, captured in motion blur; panel 12, the couple embracing against a pale blue sky, framed from the shoulders up. The overall mood is intimate, wistful, urban, and slightly melancholic, with a warm-and-cool mixed color palette and natural imperfect composition. Include 12 distinct photos: 1) a close nighttime portrait on a city street, one person in a scarf, face partially obscured, surrounded by glowing bokeh lights; 2) the couple sitting closely together on a train at night, leaning on each other, quiet and sleepy; 3) a rear three-quarter view of one person walking alone on a city street at night with traffic lights and storefront bokeh; 4) a rooftop or elevated outdoor portrait at dusk or early morning, one person turning back toward camera with windblown hair and a jacket; 5) a bright daytime suburban street snapshot with one person standing near a hedge, casual and slightly overexposed; 6) a very close, dimly lit selfie-like frame of the couple together indoors or at night, both faces soft and out of focus; 7) the couple seated side by side on a beach watching the sunset over the ocean, seen from behind; 8) the couple talking across a small table inside a cozy izakaya or retro restaurant with posters and warm tungsten lighting; 9) a cramped candid indoor or transit photo with one person slumped or resting, heavy motion blur and dark green tones; 10) the couple standing face to face in a narrow alley at night, surrounded by lantern light and vertical Japanese signs; 11) a quiet cropped detail shot of intertwined hands and draped clothing while sitting outdoors beside pavement; 12) a night portrait with one person against a background of tall city buildings and colorful defocused lights. Keep all 12 images borderless in a seamless grid, with slight variation in framing and exposure, as if taken over many dates and ordinary moments. items.title: Indonesian School Nutrition Landing Page
items.titleZh: Create a modern government program landing page UI mockup for Indonesia in a clean, professional web design style, desktop widescreen aspect ratio. The page uses a white background with bold red accents, soft rounded corners, subtle gray dividers, and a polished frontend-dribbble presentation look. At the very top, build a horizontal navigation bar with 6 visible elements: the Indonesian Garuda emblem and the text "PEMERINTAH REPUBLIK INDONESIA" on the left, then 4 centered menu items labeled "Program", "Dampak", "Menu", and "Pemantauan", and on the far right a large red rounded button labeled "Program MBG" with a small people icon. Below it, design a hero section split into two columns. On the left, show a small program label line with a red bowl icon, the text "MBG", a vertical divider, and "Makan Bergizi Gratis". Under that, place a large bold headline reading "{argument name="headline text" default="Makan Bergizi, Anak Indonesia Kuat"}" in dark navy, spanning 3 lines. Add a short paragraph in Indonesian below: "Program MBG mendukung gizi harian siswa SD dan SMP melalui menu seimbang, pemantauan sekolah, dan laporan dampak yang transparan." Then place 2 call-to-action buttons side by side: a solid red button labeled "Lihat Dampak" with a right arrow, and an outlined white button with red border labeled "Panduan Sekolah" with a right arrow. On the right side of the hero, place a rounded large photo-style image framed by a sweeping white curved divider and red corner background. The image shows an Indonesian elementary classroom with 5 visible schoolchildren in white uniforms with red ties, seated at desks, warm daylight from windows, shallow depth of field, documentary-photo realism. In the foreground, on a wooden desk, show a stainless steel compartment tray meal with exactly 5 food items: white rice, mixed vegetables, a piece of fried chicken, a banana, and watermelon cubes. Beside the tray, place 1 milk carton labeled "SUSU SEGAR". Under the hero, add a full-width red statistics band with 4 equally spaced metric cards separated by thin vertical dividers. Each card has a white circular icon and bold white text. The 4 metrics are: "245.000+" with label "Sekolah Terlayani", "8,7 Juta+" with label "Siswa Penerima Manfaat", "1,2 Miliar+" with label "Porsi Disalurkan", and "98,6%" with label "Kepuasan Siswa". [Basic Settings] Theme: {argument name="scene theme" default="Jujutsu battle / Dark Journey to the West / Cyber Hunter / Monster Hunting Team / Doomsday Survivor / Magic Academy Battle Group"} Work Name: [Work Name] Series Name / Brand Name: [Brand Name or Series Name] Subtitle: [Subtitle] Style Direction: {argument name="style" default="Dark fantasy, retro manga cover, hand-painted impasto, fantasy novel cover, game visual"} Main Tone: Dark green-black-gray / Deep blue neon / Dark brown-gold-red / Sand yellow-iron rust / Deep purple-gold Accent Color: Blood red energy, turquoise spell light, golden divine light, blue lightning Frame Ratio: 2:3 vertical / 3:4 vertical / 4:5 vertical / 9:16 vertical [Screen Structure] Use a vertical cover composition. There must be a huge visual figure as the spiritual core and atmosphere-dominating element. This person can be a profile, half-body, back, front stare, or huge silhouette, occupying the right, top, or main background area, with a calm, mysterious, and oppressive expression, not necessarily participating in the battle, but must govern the temperament of the whole picture. Arrange 3 to 6 action characters in the middle ground to form a combat faction ensemble. There should be clear division of labor and posture differences between characters, such as charging, holding a knife, casting spells, defense, summoning, jumping, alerting, long-range attack, etc. Avoid characters standing still; a strong rhythmic action and visual movement must be formed. Add enemy threats or worldview elements in the background, such as monsters, giants, villain shadows, mechanical legions, demons, ruins, forests, alien spaces, battlefield smoke, or city disasters. Background threats should not overshadow the main subject but wrap around characters like shadows to enhance the sense of crisis and narrative depth. Set 1 to 2 high-saturation energy hotspots, such as red flame fists, blue lightning, green cursed aura, purple magic, golden divine light, or white sword light. The energy effect should be concentrated on key characters or weapons, forming a visual focus, not uniformly lit across the screen. [Composition] The overall structure is "large spiritual core character + mid-ground action ensemble + background threat shadow + bottom or side blank title area". The image can use diagonal lines to organize characters, letting the ensemble rush from top-left to bottom-right or from bottom to center, forming a strong forward push. Retain a clear blank title area, suggested at the bottom-left, bottom, or side. Use off-white, gray-white, light paper color, or low-saturation background colors for the blank area to place the [Brand Name / Work Name / Subtitle]. The title typography should have a publication cover feel, using elegant serif fonts, retro title letters, manga cover titles, or high-end magazine-style layout. The text area must be clear and not completely blocked by characters and background. Do not make the edges a complete rectangle; use irregular brush edges, ink diffusion, torn paper style, or natural dissipation to let characters and background grow out of the paper, enhancing the hand-drawn cover feel and artistic quality. [Visual Style] The overall style should be a combination of hand-painted impasto and manga cover, with paper texture, brushstrokes, dark layers, and a retro publication temperament. Lighting is mainly low-key dark light with a darkened background, clear character silhouettes, and high-contrast focal points provided by local energy light. The image should not be excessively clean; it should retain hand-painted textures, paper grain, edge strokes, and dark mist. Use low-saturation dark tones mainly, supplemented by a small amount of high-saturation energy colors. The overall atmosphere should have a sense of pressure, mystery, combat, and worldview thickness. [Visual Goal] The final image should look like a mature fantasy novel cover, manga special cover, game character faction visual, or IP promo poster. It needs to possess: 1. A clear main visual character; 2. An ensemble with rhythmic movement; 3. Clear enemy threats or worldview background; 4. Strong but restrained energy effects; 5. A readable title text area; 6. An overall texture of a retro hand-drawn cover. Ensure the image is informative but not cluttered, with clear character levels and visual gravity, suitable for continuing to generate the same series with different themes.
items.prompt: 请根据【主题：{argument name="角色名" default="写人物名字"}】创作一张高完成度、高叙事张力、适合系列化发布的「暗潮群像封面 / Shadow Ensemble Cover」。这不是普通角色插画，也不是简单的战斗海报，而是一张具有小说封面感、漫画主视觉感、游戏宣传感和暗黑奇幻插画感的“群像式动作封面”。画面需要通过一个巨大的精神核心人物、多个中景动作角色、背景威胁元素、局部能量光效和留白标题区，共同构成一个完整的角色阵营与世界观封面。【基础设定】主题：{argument name="场景主题" default="咒术战斗 / 暗黑西游 / 赛博猎人 / 山海经猎妖队 / 末日幸存者 / 魔法学院战斗团"}作品名：[作品名]系列名 / 品牌名：[品牌名或系列名]副标题：[副标题]风格方向：{argument name="风格" default="暗黑奇幻、复古漫画封面、手绘厚涂、奇幻小说封面、游戏主视觉"}主色调：墨绿黑灰 / 深蓝霓虹 / 暗棕金红 / 沙黄铁锈 / 深紫金色点缀色：血红能量、青绿色法术光、金色神光、蓝色雷电画幅比例：2:3竖版 / 3:4竖版 / 4:5竖版 / 9:16竖版【画面结构】采用竖版封面构图。画面中必须有一个体量巨大的主视觉人物，作为整张图的精神核心和气质压场元素。这个人物可以是侧脸、半身像、背影、正面凝视或巨大轮廓，占据画面右侧、上方或背景主区域，表情冷静、神秘、有压迫感，不一定参与战斗，但必须统领整张图的气质。在中景安排3到6个动作角色，形成一个战斗阵营群像。角色之间需要有明确分工和姿态差异，例如冲锋、持刀、施法、防御、召唤、跳跃、警戒、远程攻击等。避免所有人物站桩，必须形成强烈的动作节奏和视觉动线。背景中加入敌方威胁或世界观元素，例如怪物、巨兽、反派阴影、机械军团、妖魔、废墟、森林、异空间、战场烟雾或城市灾难。背景威胁不应喧宾夺主，而应像阴影一样包裹角色，增强危机感和叙事深度。画面需要设置1到2个高饱和能量爆点，例如红色火焰拳、蓝色雷电、绿色诅咒气息、紫色魔法、金色神光或白色刀光。能量光效应集中在关键角色或关键武器上，形成视觉焦点，不要全画面平均发光。【构图方式】整体采用“大型精神核心人物 + 中景动作群像 + 背景威胁阴影 + 底部或侧边留白标题区”的结构。画面可以使用斜向动线组织角色，让角色群像从左上到右下、或从下方冲向中央，形成强烈推进感。保留一块明显的留白标题区，建议位于左下、底部或画面侧边。留白区域使用米白、灰白、浅纸色或低饱和背景色，用于放置【品牌名 / 作品名 / 副标题】。标题排版应具有出版物封面感，可以使用优雅衬线字体、复古标题字、漫画封面标题或高级杂志式排版。文字区要清晰，不要被角色和背景完全遮挡。插画边缘不要做成完整矩形铺满，可以使用不规则笔刷边缘、墨迹扩散、撕纸式留白或自然消散的方式，让角色和背景像从纸面中生长出来，增强手绘封面感和艺术质感。【视觉风格】整体风格应为手绘厚涂与漫画封面结合，具有纸张质感、笔触感、暗部层次和复古出版物气质。光影以低调暗光为主，背景压暗，人物轮廓清晰，局部能量光提供高对比焦点。画面不要过度干净，不要像普通AI光滑插画，应保留手绘纹理、纸张颗粒、边缘笔触和暗色雾气。色彩上采用低饱和暗调为主，辅以少量高饱和能量色。整体氛围应具有压迫感、神秘感、战斗感和世界观厚度。【画面目标】最终画面应像一张成熟的奇幻小说封面、漫画特别篇封面、游戏角色阵营主视觉或IP宣传海报。它需要同时具备：1. 清晰的主视觉人物；2. 有动作节奏的角色群像；3. 明确的敌方威胁或世界观背景；4. 强烈但克制的能量光效；5. 可阅读的标题文字区；6. 复古手绘封面的整体质感。请确保画面信息丰富但不混乱，角色层级清晰，视觉重心明确，阅读路径自然，适合后续替换主题继续生成同系列作品。

items.promptZh: 一幅引人注目的艺术肖像，描绘了一位魅力女性（附图），精确地捕捉到了她的面部表情，坐姿平静而有力。她盘腿坐在铺有装饰瓷砖的简约地板上，穿着带有简约印花的现代蓝色运动衫、宽松牛仔裤和黑色匡威运动鞋。她的表情平静而自信，带着温柔的微笑和轻松的眼神，微微凝视着漫射的光源。在她身后，矗立着一幅巨大的抽象壁画，画的是她自己的脸，用炭灰色、白色、金色和柔和的红色等大胆而富有表现力的笔触绘制。 ... 以超写实画质拍摄，使用 50 毫米人像镜头，浅景深、锐利的细节和优雅的色彩渐变，场景传达了创造力、内省和个人转变。负面：模糊、曝光过度、卡通化、扭曲的解剖结构、多余的肢体、画得不好的手、合并的脸、不切实际的颜色、水印、文本。 ar。 9:16

items.titleZh:
A polished square Japanese digital advertising banner for an AI e-commerce optimization tool, split into 2 main visual zones by a bold diagonal blue divider running from upper center to lower center-left. On the left third, show a realistic nighttime home-office scene with 1 tired young woman sitting at a desk, her face intentionally blurred, resting her head on one hand while looking at an open laptop. Warm desk-lamp lighting illuminates her and the desk, with a mug in the foreground, scattered papers, shelves and a wall clock softly out of focus in the dark background, creating a late-night overwork mood. On the right two-thirds, place a deep blue gradient promotional panel with subtle financial-growth graphics in the background: 1 ascending line chart with arrow and 4 vertical bar-chart columns in a lighter transparent blue near the top right. Fill this panel with bold oversized Japanese headline text in white with strong drop shadow, stacked across 4 lines: {argument name="headline text" default="深夜の
サムネ入れ替え、
もう自動化

items.title: Luxury Magazine Cover With Featured Book
items.titleZh: A photorealistic premium magazine cover in the style of an international design and business publication, shot as a sophisticated editorial still life. The cover features a dark, moody interior with shallow depth of field and warm ambient lighting. Center-right, standing upright on a glossy black marble table, is a cream-colored paperback book titled {argument name="book title" default="The Pathless Path"} by {argument name="author name" default="Paul Millerd"}. The book is angled slightly to the left so both the front cover and spine are visible. The cover illustration is minimalist navy-blue line art showing an office interior with an open door leading into a winding outdoor path, framed pictures on the wall, a water cooler, a desk with stacked papers, and a person slumped in an office chair. The author’s name appears near the lower left of the front cover, and the title also runs vertically on the spine. To the left of the book on the marble surface is a small stack of 4 books, softly out of focus, and in the lower-left foreground sits 1 dark coffee cup on a saucer. Behind them is a dim, elegant room with blurred shelving and a soft green plant shape in the background. The magazine masthead dominates the top: {argument name="magazine title" default="MONOCLE"} in very large white serif letters across the width, with small white issue text at top left reading {argument name="issue text" default="MAY 2024 • ISSUE 167"} and small white tagline text at top right reading “THE ENTREPRENEURS’ MAGAZINE”. Beneath the masthead is a thin rule and a category line in small gold serif text with 6 categories separated by dots: “AFFAIRS • BUSINESS • CULTURE • DESIGN • ENTERTAINING • FASHION”. On the left side, large white serif cover headline text reads “Rethinking Success”. Below it is a white serif subheadline about leaving the default path behind and building a life and work that matters, followed by a small gold page number. Further down the left column are 4 editorial teaser blocks, each with a gold circular icon and gold uppercase heading, white descriptive text, and a gold page number. The 4 headings are “ESCAPE THE DEFAULT”, “WORK WITH PURPOSE”, “A NEW STORY”, and a boxed teaser “DESIGN SPECIAL”. At the bottom right is a realistic barcode block with small pricing text above it and a small issue number beside it. The overall layout should feel like a real luxury magazine cover mockup: crisp typography, elegant serif fonts, black, white, cream, and gold palette, glossy reflections on the marble, cinematic shadows, subtle product reflection beneath the book, and high-end editorial photography styling.
items.promptZh: 逼真的高级杂志封面，采用国际设计和商业出版物的风格，以精致的社论静物形式拍摄。封面的特点是黑暗、喜怒无常的内部、浅景深和温暖的环境照明。中间偏右，直立在光滑的黑色大理石桌子上，是一本米色平装书，书名是{argument name="book title" default="The Pathless Path"}，作者是{argument name="author name" default="Paul Millerd"}。这本书稍微向左倾斜，因此封面和书脊都可见。封面插图是极简主义的海军蓝色线条艺术，展示了办公室内部，有一扇开着的门通向一条蜿蜒的户外小路，墙上挂着相框，有一个饮水机、一张堆满文件的桌子，以及一个瘫坐在办公椅上的人。作者姓名出现在封面左下角附近，标题也在书脊上垂直排列。大理石表面上的书的左侧是一小堆 4 本书，焦点模糊，左下前景的碟子上放着 1 个深色咖啡杯。他们身后是一间昏暗、优雅的房间，架子模糊，背景是柔和的绿色植物形状。杂志标头占据顶部：{argument name="magazine title" default="MONOCLE"}，宽度非常大的白色衬线字母，左上角有小的白色期刊文本，内容为{argument name="issue text" default="MAY 2024 • ISSUE 167"}，右上角有小的白色标语文本，内容为“THE ENTREPRENEURS’ MAGAZINE”。报头下方是一条细尺和一条金色小衬线文字的类别线，其中有 6 个类别，用点分隔：“事务•商业•文化•设计•娱乐•时尚”。左侧，大号白色衬线封面标题文字为“重新思考成功”。下面是一个白色衬线副标题，内容是关于抛弃默认路径并建立重要的生活和工作，后面是一个金色的小页码。左栏下方有 4 个编辑预告块，每个块都有一个金色圆形图标和金色大写标题、白色描述性文本和金色页码。四个标题分别是“摆脱默认”、“有目的工作”、“新故事”和盒装预告片“特别设计”。右下角是一个真实的条形码块，上面有小的定价文本，旁边有一个小的发行编号。整体布局应该感觉像一个真正的豪华杂志封面模型：清晰的排版、优雅的衬线字体、黑色、白色、奶油色和金色调色板、大理石上的光泽反射、电影阴影、书本下方微妙的产品反射以及高端编辑摄影风格。

items.title: Funny DIY Disaster Cat Comic
items.titleZh: Create a colorful humorous comic-style poster in Spanish, vertical format, with a retro cartoon look, thick black outlines, warm orange and yellow palette, halftone texture, and exaggerated expressive characters. The layout has 4 distinct panels: 1 large title panel across the top and 3 equal vertical panels along the bottom row. In the top panel, show a smug orange tabby cat handyman standing upright like a person in a cozy living room workshop, holding a screwdriver in one paw and the other paw on the hip, wearing a utility belt with visible tools. The cat has narrowed confident eyes and a sly grin. On the left side of this top panel, place a large jagged comic burst with the Spanish headline in bold distressed lettering: "3 PASOS PARA ARRUINAR ALGO FÁCIL", with "ARRUINAR" in red and the rest in black. Below it, add a taped paper strip that says "edición casera". In the background of the top panel, include a framed sign on the wall that reads "YO PUEDO SOLO" with a small paw print, a small potted plant, shelves, and dynamic radial lines behind the cat. In the bottom row, create 3 labeled step panels, each with a yellow header box and bold black text. Panel 1 header: "PASO 1". Show the same orange cat sitting calmly on the floor beside a standing lamp, eyes closed with overconfidence, casually holding a screwdriver. Add a speech bubble that says "Tranqui, esto lo arreglo en 2 minutos." Include a small open toolbox and a few screws on the floor. Panel 2 header: "PASO 2". Show the cat mid-repair, now alarmed with wide eyes, awkwardly unscrewing the wrong part of the lamp while pieces and screws fly through the air. Add a speech bubble that says "Ups..." and a sticky note near the bottom that says "tocar lo que no era". Include visual motion lines, scattered debris, and a toppled plant pot. Panel 3 header: "PASO 3". Show the aftermath: the lamp is broken and smoking with exposed wires and sparks, the room is messy with shattered parts everywhere, and the cat sits stunned holding the screwdriver. A brown dog stands to the right, looking disappointed, asking in a speech bubble "¿Qué hiciste?" The cat replies in another speech bubble "No sé... se complicó solo." Add a taped label at the bottom that says "resultado final". items.titleZh: A dreamy pastel anime illustration of a serene young woman in a moonlit spring garden beside a pond, rendered in delicate Japanese fantasy style with flat anime coloring, no shadows, ultra-clean linework, and no grainy texture. She is seated in three-quarter back view at the water’s edge, turning her face slightly toward the viewer with a calm, melancholic expression. She has very long straight {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair with soft bangs and floral ornaments woven into a blossom crown. She wears an elegant flowing kimono in pale blue and cream, richly patterned with stylized waves and white foxes, with layered fabric pooling around her. A large traditional paper parasol rests behind her on the right side, partly open, with dangling crystal-like ornaments. Surround her with dense blooming cherry blossom branches overhead and scattered petals in the foreground. The pond is filled with exactly 10 glowing lotus flowers floating on reflective water and exactly 4 visible koi fish swimming near the surface. In the distant left background, include a small multi-tier pagoda silhouette across the water. From the upper left, a soft rainbow beam of light descends diagonally onto the pond, creating iridescent reflections. Hang several faceted crystal ornaments from the branches so they sparkle in the light. Use a palette dominated by lavender, blush pink, pale blue, ivory, and soft gold. The atmosphere should feel ethereal, romantic, tranquil, and magical, with intricate decorative detail, luminous water reflections, and a polished vertical composition.

items.title: Elegant Chinese Calendar App UI
items.titleZh: A clean, elegant iPhone app UI mockup for a Chinese perpetual calendar and almanac app, shown as a full-screen mobile screenshot on a soft warm white background with subtle paper-like texture and refined East Asian editorial aesthetics. The interface uses a minimalist serif-and-sans mix, muted brown, gray, black, pale blue, green, and gold accents, with spacious layout and delicate dividers. Show the iOS status bar at the top with the time 8:45, cellular signal, Wi‑Fi icon, and a battery indicator reading 96. Below it, a header for {argument name="month" default="4月"} with secondary text “24日 | 每日万年历” and, on the right, a rounded rectangular date-picker button labeled “择日” with a calendar icon plus a separate plus symbol. The main section is a monthly calendar grid for {argument name="year" default="2026"}, with 7 weekday columns labeled Sunday through Saturday in Chinese: 周日, 周一, 周二, 周三, 周四, 周五, 周六. Render a 6-row month view with exactly 42 date cells including adjacent-month dates. The visible dates should be: first row 29, 30, 31, 1, 2, 3, 4; second row 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11; third row 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18; fourth row 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25; fifth row 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 1, 2; sixth row 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9. Each day cell includes a large Gregorian date and a smaller Chinese lunar date or note underneath. Include colored holiday and solar-term tags across specific cells, with exactly 10 highlighted labels visible: “休十七” on the 4th, “清明节” on the 5th, “休十九” on the 6th, “谷雨” on the 20th in green, “劳动节” on the next-month 1st, “休十六” on the next-month 2nd, “休十七” on the last-row 3rd, “青年节” on the last-row 4th, “休立夏” on the last-row 5th, and “天后诞” on the last-row 9th in orange. Add small lunar phase markers on a few days, including yellow crescent or dot icons around the 2nd, 10th, 17th, 24th, and next-month 2nd. Make the {argument name="selected date" default="24"} cell in the Friday column stand out with a rounded blue gradient tile and soft shadow, with smaller text “初八” inside. Beneath the calendar, show a detailed daily information panel separated by whitespace. The left side features a very large date title “4月24日”; the right side stacks “星期五 2026” and “农历三月初八”. Below that, include smaller gray metadata lines such as “第114天 · 第17周 金尊月” and a traditional sexagenary/date string like “丙午 · 马年 壬辰月 戊辰日”. At the far right of this metadata area, place a rounded outline pill button labeled “今日”. Underneath, present a large white rounded card with almanac guidance. The card contains two major sections with exactly 2 headings: a green “宜” section and a red “忌” section, separated by fine dotted dividers. In the “宜” section, include the directional fortune line “喜神 东南 福神 正北 财神 正北” and three activity items: “祭祀”, “修饰垣墙”, “余事勿取”. In the “忌” section, include the conflict line “冲煞 冲狗 煞南”. At the bottom, show a 5-item iOS-style tab bar with labels exactly “今日”, “MONTH”, “YEAR”, “EVENTS”, “MORE”; the first tab is active and includes the small sublabel “4月24日”. Overall style: premium app design concept, calm scholarly Chinese calendar aesthetic, high-fidelity mobile product shot, realistic yet idealized interface, perfectly aligned typography, subtle shadows, soft contrast, and polished startup-quality UI.

items.title: Retro Mince and Tatties Action Poster
items.titleZh: A bold retro propaganda-style poster illustration with a limited palette of red, black, and warm cream on a lightly aged paper texture. The composition features a dynamic anime-inspired action scene in the center: a martial artist in a white gi with a black belt carries a long-haired woman over one shoulder in a fireman's carry or wrestling throw pose. The fighter is shown from the knees up in a powerful wide stance, facing left, with the woman draped horizontally across the shoulders, her bare legs lifted and bent, her long dark hair flowing downward, and a black wide-brim cowboy hat still on her head. Render both figures in high-contrast inked line art with thick black shadows and sharp graphic contours, mixing manga character design with vintage screen-printed poster energy. Behind them, fill the background with aggressive geometric rays and wedges: 6 major red and black angular shapes radiating outward across the cream backdrop, creating a sense of impact and motion. In the top right corner, add 1 circular emblem containing a fierce gorilla or ape head icon with red accents. Across the lower third, place large bold condensed block typography integrated into the composition: the smaller line reads “SCOTTISH RECIPE:” and the huge main title reads “MINCE AND TATTIES”. Make the text red on cream and cream on black in layered diagonal banner panels, with the words occupying 3 text groupings total: “SCOTTISH RECIPE:”, “MINCE AND”, and “TATTIES”. Emphasize dramatic diagonal layout, posterized shadows, distressed print texture, and the feeling of a vintage Soviet constructivist or pulp exploitation food poster fused with martial arts manga aesthetics.

items.title: Pixel Game Asset Atlas Template
items.titleZh:
Please create a high-completion, high-information-density "Pixel World Asset Atlas" suitable for serialized release based on [Game Theme: {argument name="game theme" default="Demon Slayer/Tanjiro"}].

This is not a regular pixel illustration or a single game scene, but a "2D pixel game asset overview map" for game development, art setting, level design, and visual proposals. The visual should look like a complete game material board, systematically organizing core characters, enemies, items, terrain, scenes, mechanisms, Bosses, and decorative elements required for a [Game Type: {argument name="game type" default="Side-scrolling action"}] into a single clear, professional, and reusable game asset atlas.

[Basic Settings]
Theme Worldview: [Game Theme]
Game Type: [Game Type]
Era Background: [Era Background]
Protagonist Identity: [Protagonist Identity]
Enemy Types: [Enemy Types]
Main Scenes: [Main Scene Environment]
Overall Style: [Style Direction, e.g., {argument name="style" default="16-bit retro arcade pixel style"}]
Main Color: [Main Color]
Secondary Color: [Secondary Color]
Accent Color: [Accent Color]
Aspect Ratio: [Aspect Ratio, Landscape 4:3]
If not filled, automatically match according to the optimal plan for the game theme.

[Overall Visual Requirements]
The visual uses a large landscape canvas with a light or low-interference background, looking like a game development asset sheet or an instruction-style resource catalog. All elements should be 2D pixel art sprites with uniform pixel density, clear black/dark outlines, limited color scales, and retro game textures. Do not generate realistic photography, 3D rendering, painterly illustration, or movie poster styles. Focus on being "systematically complete, clearly categorized, resource-rich, and high in developability."

[Layout Structure]
The map uses a modular grid layout with fine lines dividing different resource areas. Each area needs a numbered title and short category labels, with a reading path from left to right, top to bottom. The layout should have the orderliness of an instruction manual or game dev document. Information density must be high but not chaotic; elements within each module should be equidistantly arranged.

[Modules to Include]
1. Player Character Module: Show complete action frames including standing, walking/running, jumping, etc. frames arranged horizontally like a sprite sheet.
2. Enemy Unit Module: Design multiple enemies including common, ranged, heavy, and elite units.
3. Weapons & Items Module: Show melee, ranged, projectiles, effects, and pickups.
4. Basic Terrain Tile Module: Show ground, walls, platforms, corners, and different material blocks.
5. Natural/External Scene Resource Module: Show trees, grass, rocks, and obstacles.
6. Building/Base/Camp Resource Module: Show doors, windows, walls, ladders, and camp facilities.
7. Special Terrain Module: Show bridges, water bodies, cliffs, and cave openings.
8. Indoor/Underground/Facility Resource Module: Show pipes, consoles, metal doors, and equipment.
9. Boss / Encounter Resource Module: Show large Bosses, special vehicles, and giant mechanisms.
10. General Decoration & Interaction Elements Module: Show ladders, ropes, signs, switches, and mechanisms.

[Visual Detail Requirements]
All resources must maintain consistent pixel size logic and worldview consistency. Clear scale relationships. Action frames must show continuity; terrain tiles must be tileable; items and mechanisms must have functional recognizability; Boss elements should feel oppressive.
items.prompt:
请根据【游戏主题：{argument name="游戏主题" default="鬼灭之刃/炭治郎"}】创作一张高完成度、高信息密度、适合系列化发布的「像素世界资产图鉴 / Pixel World Asset Atlas」。

这不是普通像素插画，也不是单张游戏场景图，而是一张面向游戏开发、美术设定、关卡设计和视觉提案的“2D像素游戏资产总览图”。画面需要像一张完整的游戏素材说明板，把一个【游戏类型：{argument name="游戏类型" default="横版动作"}】所需的核心角色、敌人、道具、地形、场景、机关、Boss和装饰元素系统化整理在同一张图中，形成清晰、专业、可复用的游戏资产图鉴。

【基础设定】
主题世界观：【游戏主题】
游戏类型：【游戏类型】
时代背景：【时代背景】
主角身份：【主角身份】
敌人类型：【敌人类型】
主要场景：【主要场景环境】
整体风格：【风格方向，例如{argument name="风格" default="16-bit复古街机像素风"}】
主色调：【主色调】
辅助色：【辅助色】
点缀色：【点缀色】
画幅比例：【画幅比例，横版4:3】
如没有填写，自动按照游戏主题最优方案进行匹配。

【整体画面要求】
画面采用横版大画布，浅色或低干扰背景，整体像一张游戏开发资产表、像素设定集展开页、说明书式资源目录。所有元素都应为统一像素密度的2D pixel art sprite，具有清晰黑色或深色描边、有限色阶、复古游戏质感。不要生成真实摄影风、3D渲染风、厚涂插画风或电影海报风。重点是“系统完整、分类清晰、资源丰富、可开发感强”。

【版式结构】
整张图采用模块化网格排版，用细线分割不同资源区域。每个区域需要有编号标题和简短分类标签，整体阅读路径为从左到右、从上到下。版式应具有说明书、游戏开发文档、素材图鉴、设定板的秩序感。信息密度要高，但不能混乱；每个模块内部的元素应等距排列，保持清晰可读。

【必须包含的模块】
1. 玩家角色模块：展示完整动作帧，包括站立、行走/奔跑、跳跃等。动作帧应横向排列，像游戏sprite sheet。
2. 敌人单位模块：设计多种敌人，包括普通、远程、重装、精英单位等。
3. 武器与道具模块：展示近战、远程、投掷物、特效、拾取物等。
4. 基础地形砖块模块：展示地面、墙体、平台、转角、不同材质地块。
5. 自然/外部场景资源模块：展示树木、草丛、石头、障碍物。
6. 建筑/基地/营地资源模块：展示门、窗、墙、梯子、营地设施。
7. 特殊地形模块：展示桥梁、水体、悬崖、洞口。
8. 室内/地下/设施资源模块：展示管道、控制台、金属门、设备。
9. Boss / 遭遇战资源模块：展示大型Boss、特殊载具、巨型机关。
10. 通用装饰与交互元素模块：展示梯子、绳索、指示牌、开关、机关。

【视觉细节要求】
所有资源需要保持统一的像素尺寸逻辑和世界观一致性。比例关系明确。动作帧需体现连续性；地形砖块可拼接；道具和机关有功能识别度；Boss元素需有压迫感。

items.title: Okinawa Summer Travel Banner
items.titleZh:
Create a polished Japanese travel agency summer banner ad for Okinawa in a bright, inviting commercial style. Use a wide horizontal layout with a vivid tropical beach scene as the full background: crystal-clear turquoise ocean, white sand shoreline, small green island in the mid distance, deep blue sky with large fluffy white clouds, and palm leaves hanging in from the upper right corner. On the right foreground, place 1 traditional Okinawan shisa lion-dog statue sitting on a stone wall, surrounded by red hibiscus flowers and lush tropical greenery. Near the water, include 1 small glass-bottom sightseeing boat floating close to shore. Add 2 small simple fish doodle icons over the sea.

Make the typography the hero element. Across the left-center to center, place very large Japanese calligraphic headline text reading {argument name="headline text" default="夏の沖縄"}, with a blue gradient and white glow or soft outline, highly legible and elegant. Above it, add a handwritten-style Japanese catchphrase in blue reading {argument name="catchphrase" default="青い海、青い空、心ほどける島時間。"} with a loose underline flourish. Under the main headline, add a smaller Japanese subheading reading {argument name="subheading" default="感動の景色と、あたたかいおもてなしに出会う旅へ。"}.

In the upper left, add a circular summer badge with a sunburst feel, soft cream background, tiny wave lines, a small hibiscus accent, and Japanese text reading "この夏は 沖縄で 最高の思い出を!". Decorate the headline area with 1 pink hibiscus flower on the left and subtle ocean-wave graphic strokes.

Along the lower middle, place 3 rounded white feature cards in a row, partially overlapping the beach scene. Count and depict all 3 cards clearly: the first card shows a sea turtle swimming underwater in a circular photo, with Japanese heading "美しい自然を満喫" and smaller body text about transparent waters and scenic spots; the second card shows a bowl of Okinawa soba in a circular photo, with heading "沖縄グルメを堪能" and smaller body text mentioning 沖縄そば and ゴーヤチャンプルー; the third card shows Shuri Castle in a circular photo, with heading "観光スポットも充実" and smaller body text mentioning 美ら海水族館 and 首里城. Add small coral, shell, hibiscus, and starfish decorations around these cards.

On the right lower-middle, overlap the beach with 1 tilted circular promotional sticker in pale blue and cream, with a small yellow tab on top. The yellow tab says "早めの予約がおトク!" and the main circle says "夏の沖縄ツアー 好評受付中!". Add a white plumeria flower accent near the sticker.

Create a full-width dark blue footer bar across the bottom. On the left side of the footer, place a white travel company logo icon and company name text {argument name="company name" default="〇〇旅行株式会社"}, with a smaller Japanese tagline below. Across the center of the footer, place exactly 3 circular line-icons with short Japanese captions: 1 calendar icon for tour plans, 1 support staff icon for travel assistance, and 1 suitcase icon for comfortable travel help. On the right side of the footer, add a boxed CTA area with Japanese text "詳しくはこちらから" and a mock search field containing {argument name="search text" default="〇〇旅行　沖縄"} plus a search icon. Overall design should feel premium, cheerful, summery, and highly marketable, like a professional Japanese web banner or travel campaign visual.

items.title: Anime Fashion Magazine Cover
items.titleZh: A stylized Japanese fashion magazine cover titled MODE TOKYO, designed like a glossy contemporary women's style publication. The composition is a high-angle, dynamic street-fashion anime illustration of 2 girls looking up toward the viewer from beside a brick wall with colorful graffiti and dramatic sunlight. The girl on the right has {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} hair in a lively messy ponytail with loose bangs, bright green eyes, a wide cheerful grin, and a sporty-feminine outfit: a light blue lace-trim camisole or slip-style top, short bottoms, chunky white sneakers, and a black choker. She is posed energetically, leaning forward with one knee bent, giving a confident summer-fashion editorial feel. The girl on the left has long vivid teal-green hair with straight heavy bangs, large blue eyes, and a calm, cool expression. She wears a casual layered street outfit in dark tones with a sleeveless top and sits lower in the frame, angled toward the right girl while gazing upward. Use bold cel-shaded anime rendering with crisp linework, glossy highlights in the hair and eyes, soft skin shading, and a polished commercial illustration finish. The background should combine sunlit urban texture, blurred mural colors in pink, purple, orange, and black, and deep shadows to create contrast. The overall palette mixes hot pink typography, summer sunlight, teal, blonde, and saturated street-art hues. Include dense magazine-cover typography in a premium editorial layout: a giant pink serif masthead reading {argument name="magazine title" default="MODE"} across the top with TOKYO vertically on the left; on the upper right a dark circular or rounded block containing {argument name="issue number" default="06"}, JUNE 2024, vol.218, and cover lines in Japanese; on the left side several smaller Japanese and English fashion blurbs including NEO BASIC STYLE and SPORTY × FEMININE; a pink circular badge on the right with Japanese text and Trend 7; a large hot-pink Japanese headline across the lower left and center reading 私らしく、もっと輝く季節。; elegant white handwritten script diagonally across the lower right reading Shine in my Style; small footer cover lines and hashtags in Japanese; and a small BEAUTY label at bottom right. Make it look exactly like a real high-end Japanese fashion magazine cover, vertical format, full bleed, vibrant, youthful, feminine, sporty, and trendy.

items.titleZh: A moody full-body fashion portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young woman"} standing in a narrow urban alley or tunnel covered in dense colorful graffiti, photographed at night with dramatic low-key lighting and flash-lit realism. She is leaning casually against the wall with 1 hand touching a large pair of over-ear black headphones and 1 hand tucked into the front pocket of an oversized {argument name="hoodie color" default="mustard yellow"} hoodie. The hoodie is long enough to read almost like a hoodie dress and has a simple black smiley-face graphic centered on the chest with white drawstrings. She wears a black backpack with 2 visible shoulder straps, white crew socks, and chunky black-and-white low-top sneakers. Her legs are bare, and her pose is relaxed with one knee slightly bent and one foot set forward. Her hair is shoulder-length, slightly messy, and {argument name="hair color" default="dark blonde"}. Compose the shot vertically from head to shoes, with the subject centered slightly left of frame. The background is a gritty painted wall dominated by turquoise blue, yellow, pink, and black spray paint, with drips, tags, and abstract cartoon-like graffiti shapes creating a raw street-art atmosphere. The floor is dark, worn, and reflective with paint splatters. Use high contrast, deep shadows, realistic skin and fabric texture, editorial streetwear photography style, underground urban vibe, sharp focus on clothing and body, subdued facial detail, and a cinematic dark nightlife mood.

items.title: Anime Graffiti Girl Transformation
items.titleZh: Using the provided reference image, transform the photo into a stylized anime street-art illustration while keeping the same subject, pose, outfit, headphones, backpack, and graffiti-wall setting. Replace the obscured real face with a clean original anime girl face, with a short blonde bob and side-swept bangs, and make the expression calm and slightly aloof. Keep the oversized yellow hoodie and black-and-white sneakers, but simplify the clothing into bold cel-shaded shapes with thick black ink outlines. Change the object in the raised hand from touching the headphones to holding a small blue spray-paint can near the face. Intensify the wall colors into vivid cyan, hot pink, and yellow graffiti splashes, and render the whole image in a dynamic manga/pop-art style with high contrast, sketchy linework, and a slightly low-angle full-body composition.

items.title: Japanese Roman Typeface Specimen Poster
items.titleZh:
Create a refined vintage-modern type specimen poster for a fictional typeface named {argument name="typeface name" default="KASEI"}, designed as an elegant fusion of Roman and Japanese typography. Use a tall portrait layout on warm ivory textured paper with thin gray divider lines, black letterforms, and muted vermilion accent text and seals. Center the composition around a large serif Latin wordmark "{argument name="typeface name" default="KASEI"}" above 2 oversized Japanese kanji, "華世", set in a matching high-contrast classical style. Above the title, place the small heading "INTRODUCING" with a tiny ornamental diamond. To the right of the title area, add a vertical Japanese tagline reading "古典の美、未来の書体。". Under the main kanji, add the subtitle "A ROMAN × JAPANESE TYPEFACE" and below it a Japanese line in vermilion: "ローマの精神、日本の美。". On the far left, create a narrow sidebar with the stacked English text "A TYPEFACE HARMONIZING ROME AND JAPAN", a small circular crest, the Japanese text "製作 — MMXXIV", and "CREATED IN KYOTO, JAPAN".

Build the lower two-thirds as a meticulous type specimen sheet with exact labeled sections. In a left column, include 2 sections: "WEIGHTS" with 5 items — Light, Regular, Medium, Semibold, Bold — and "POINT SIZES" with 9 items — 8pt, 10pt, 12pt, 14pt, 18pt, 24pt, 36pt, 48pt, 72pt. In the main area, include a section titled "ROMAN CHARACTERS" showing 4 specimen lines: uppercase alphabet A through Z, lowercase alphabet a through z, numerals 0 through 9, and a punctuation/symbol line with slashes, commas, semicolons, exclamation mark, question marks, apostrophes, quotation marks, em dash, parentheses, brackets, braces, ampersand, at sign, dollar sign, asterisk, dagger, and double dagger. Below that, include a section titled "JAPANESE CHARACTERS" with 4 lines: 19 kanji "日 月 山 川 花 鳥 風 林 火 水 土 金 木 道 心 時 空 光 夢 永", 23 hiragana "あ い う え お か き く け こ さ し す せ そ た ち つ て と な に ぬ ね の", 21 katakana "ア イ ウ エ オ カ キ ク ケ コ サ シ ス セ ソ ン タ チ ツ テ ト ナ ニ ヌ ネ ノ", and a symbols line including Japanese punctuation, corner brackets, wave dash, middle dot, parentheses, angle brackets, double angle brackets, black lenticular brackets, postal mark, reference marks, and iteration mark.

Along the next row, add 4 compact specimen panels: "LIGATURES" with 10 items — Æ, AE, AJ, Œ, KA, KE, KI, KO, KU, and "st ct fi fl ft fb"; "STYLISTIC ALTERNATES" with 12 items — A, A, A, R, R, K, K, a, a, g, g, y, y, J, J, Q, Q, t, t — arranged as a neat sampling grid; "SPACING STUDY" showing the word "KASEI" with wide tracking above the kanji string "華世永美"; and "NUMERAL STYLES" with 4 lines — lining figures 0123456789, oldstyle figures 0123456789, and small caps combinations "H 0123" and "H 0123". Add tiny red Japanese captions beneath some of these sample boxes.

At the bottom, create 3 feature panels. Left panel titled "WORDS" with 3 entries: "HARMONIA" with the red Japanese and English gloss "調和  HARMONY", "VERITAS" with "真実  TRUTH", and "FORTITUDO" with "勇気  COURAGE". Center panel with a large Japanese quote "時を越え、美は残る。" above the English statement "BEAUTY ENDURES\nBEYOND TIME." and a small signature line "— KASEI" in red. Right panel titled "DETAILS" with a large kanji "永" over faint construction circles and guide lines, plus 4 right-aligned Japanese annotation callouts connected by fine dotted leader lines.

Finish with a footer containing 4 blocks: a small crest and "KASEI TYPE FOUNDRY" with "WWW.KASEIFOUNDRY.JP"; a centered language support note "SUPPORTING 200+ LANGUAGES" and "LATIN / GREEK / CYRILLIC / JAPANESE / SYMBOLS"; a right-side statement "DESIGNED WITH RESPECT\nCRAFTED FOR THE FUTURE"; and a square vermilion seal bearing "華世". Overall style should feel like a premium Japanese foundry specimen sheet, balancing editorial Swiss-grid precision, classical book typography, subtle Japanese branding, generous margins, restrained luxury, and museum-poster elegance.

items.title: Futuristic STEM Classroom with Holograms
items.titleZh: A bright futuristic classroom or science museum learning lab filled with school-age children interacting with large mixed-reality holograms, cinematic ultra-detailed photorealism. The scene is a wide-angle interior during warm late-afternoon sunlight, with floor-to-ceiling glass windows, modern tables, bookshelves, digital displays, and a clean high-tech educational atmosphere. About 9 children and 1 adult teacher are spread across the room, actively exploring science exhibits with gestures and touch interactions. In the center, a glowing semi-transparent holographic human heart floats at chest height while 3 children gather around it, reaching toward it in curiosity. Suspended overhead is a large holographic solar system mobile with exactly 9 planets orbiting a bright sun, with luminous orbit trails and a magical scientific visualization style. On the left side, one child interacts with a tall vertical holographic DNA double helix. On the front-left table, there is a circular tabletop hologram of a miniature mountain-and-river ecosystem containing exactly 4 visible animals: an elephant, a deer, a llama or alpaca, and a bear. On the back-left table, there is a circular holographic architectural city model featuring a grand classical domed building and surrounding structures. On the right-front table, there is a large ball-and-stick molecular model made of glowing spheres and rods. In the mid-right and upper-right space, include additional floating science holograms: exactly 2 geometric polyhedra, exactly 2 molecule diagrams, exactly 2 spherical energy or data globes, and 1 hourglass-like abstract hologram. The children should be ethnically diverse, dressed casually, engaged, amazed, collaborative, and looking at different holographic subjects. Use soft volumetric sunlight, realistic reflections on glass and tabletops, subtle blue and gold glow from the holograms, shallow atmospheric haze, and a premium inspirational STEM-education advertisement aesthetic.
items.promptZh: 明亮的未来教室或科学博物馆学习实验室，里面挤满了学龄儿童，与大型混合现实全息图、电影般的超详细照片写实互动。场景是温暖的午后阳光下的广角室内，有落地玻璃窗、现代化的桌子、书架、数字显示器，以及干净的高科技教育氛围。大约 9 名儿童和 1 名成人老师分布在房间里，通过手势和触摸互动积极探索科学展品。在中心，一颗发光的半透明全息人体心脏漂浮在胸部高度，3 个孩子聚集在它周围，好奇地伸向它。头顶上悬挂着一个巨大的全息太阳系，正好有 9 颗行星围绕着明亮的太阳运行，具有发光的轨道轨迹和神奇的科学可视化风格。在左侧，一名儿童正在与一个高大的垂直全息 DNA 双螺旋相互作用。左前方的桌子上有一个圆形桌面全息图，显示了一个微型山河生态系统，其中恰好包含 4 种可见动物：大象、鹿、美洲驼或羊驼和熊。左后方的桌子上有一个圆形的全息建筑城市模型，具有宏伟的古典圆顶建筑和周围的结构。右前桌上有一个由发光球体和棒材制成的大型球棒分子模型。在右中和右上空间中，包括额外的浮动科学全息图：正好 2 个几何多面体、正好 2 个分子图、正好 2 个球形能量或数据地球仪以及 1 个沙漏状抽象全息图。孩子们应该是多元化的种族，穿着休闲，投入，惊讶，合作，并观看不同的全息主题。使用柔和的体积阳光、玻璃和桌面上的真实反射、全息图发出的微妙蓝色和金色光芒、浅层大气薄雾以及优质的鼓舞人心的 STEM 教育广告美学。
