items.title: Vintage Fantasy Postcard of Beacon Hollow
items.titleZh: Create a vintage fantasy travel postcard poster for {argument name="location name" default="BEACON HOLLOW"}, designed like a large-letter souvenir postcard from the 1950s–1960s. The composition is a single richly detailed horizontal scene with heavily weathered paper texture, rounded postcard corners, faded inks, creases, scratches, foxing, and worn edges. Across the top and center, huge dimensional block letters spell “BEACON HOLLOW” in classic retro postcard style, with warm cream outlines and red-brown extruded shadows; each letter contains miniature painted scenic vignettes of the destination, including alpine peaks, waterfalls, pine forests, a magical manor, glowing towers, and valley landscapes. In the upper left, hand-painted script text reads “GREETINGS FROM” in dark red. In the upper right, include a circular black postal cancellation stamp reading “BEACON HOLLOW / MAY 18 / 1967 / CREATIVE RETREAT,” overlapping a vintage postage stamp labeled “BEACON HOLLOW” and “CREATIVE RETREAT” with “7c,” depicting a moonlit mountain and a lighthouse-like beacon tower. Beneath the title, place a small curved ribbon banner reading {argument name="tagline" default="a magejosh destination"} with tiny compass-star ornaments. The main background should show a majestic golden-hour mountain valley with a winding river, distant snowy peaks, dense evergreen forests, and on the right a large timber-and-stone fantasy lodge perched on a cliff, warmly lit from within, with stairs descending the slope. Scatter subtle magical blue lights and faint arcane circular glyphs around the lodge and foreground for a worldbuilding-meets-magic atmosphere. In the lower left, place exactly 3 foreground desk objects: a dark ceramic mug with a compass emblem, an open sketchbook spread, and a fountain pen resting diagonally across the pages. The left page of the sketchbook is titled “Campaign Ideas” and lists 3 bullets: “The Forgotten Vale,” “Clockwork Pilgrims,” and “Echoes of the First Light,” with a small castle drawing below; the right page shows a tree illustration and the handwritten text “Beery world Hollow.” Across the lower center, add an old illustrated map spread out on the table, showing mountain icons and hand-drawn cartographic details. In the lower right, place exactly 5 more foreground elements: a closed leather journal embossed with a star compass and the phrase “Ideas Become Legends,” a cluster of 4 polyhedral dice, a rustic wooden signpost with 4 directional slats reading “STORY,” “GAME DESIGN,” “WORLD BUILDING,” and “AI FOR CREATORS,” a glowing glass lamp or tube device, and a nearby floating arcane target-like sigil. Add a pinned handwritten note left of center on aged paper reading, “Wish you were here — building worlds, chasing wonder, and turning ideas into adventures. — {argument name="signature name" default="magejosh"}” in blue cursive. Use painterly illustration with high detail, nostalgic Americana postcard design, fantasy concept art sensibility, warm sunset lighting, muted teal sky, sepia aging, and an inviting creative-retreat mood.
items.promptZh: 为 {argument name="location name" default="BEACON HOLLOW"} 创建一张复古奇幻旅行明信片海报，其设计类似于 20 世纪 50 年代至 1960 年代的大字纪念明信片。该构图是一个细节丰富的水平场景，具有严重风化的纸张纹理、圆形明信片角、褪色的墨水、折痕、划痕、狐臭和磨损的边缘。在顶部和中心，巨大的立体大写字母以经典复古明信片风格拼写“BEACON HOLLOW”，具有温暖的奶油色轮廓和红棕色挤压阴影；每封信都包含目的地的微型彩绘风景小插图，包括高山山峰、瀑布、松树林、神奇的庄园、发光的塔楼和山谷景观。左上角，手绘文字以深红色写着“GREETINGS FROM”。右上角有一枚圆形黑色邮政盖销邮票，上面写着“BEACON HOLLOW / MAY 18 / 1967 / CREATIVE RETREAT”，与贴有“BEACON HOLLOW”和“CREATIVE RETREAT”和“7c”的复古邮票重叠，描绘了一座月光下的山峰和一座灯塔般的灯塔塔。在标题下方，放置一个小的弧形丝带横幅，上面写着{argument name="tagline" default="a magejosh目的地"}，上面有微小的指南针星星装饰。主要背景应该展示雄伟的黄金时段山谷，蜿蜒的河流，遥远的雪峰，茂密的常绿森林，右侧是一座栖息在悬崖上的大型木材和石头奇幻小屋，内部光线温暖，楼梯沿着斜坡下降。在小屋和前景周围散布微妙的魔法蓝色灯光和微弱的神秘圆形符号，营造出世界建筑与魔法相遇的氛围。在左下角，放置 3 个前景桌面物体：一个带有指南针标志的深色陶瓷杯、一本打开的素描本以及斜放在书页上的一支钢笔。速写本的左页标题为“竞选创意”，列出了 3 个项目符号：“被遗忘的山谷”、“发条朝圣者”和“第一道曙光的回声”，下面画了一座小城堡；右页显示树插图和手写文字“Beery world Hollow”。在较低的中心，添加一张摊在桌子上的旧插图地图，显示山脉图标和手绘地图细节。在右下角，放置另外 5 个前景元素：一本压花有星星罗盘和“创意成为传奇”短语的闭合皮革日记本，一组 4 个多面体骰子，一个质朴的木制路标，上面有 4 个方向板条，上面写着“故事”、“游戏设计”、“世界建筑”和“人工智能创造者”，一个发光的玻璃灯或管装置，以及附近的一个漂浮的奥术类似目标的印记。在旧纸上的中间左侧添加一条固定的手写便条，上面写着“希望你在这里 - 建设世界，追逐奇迹，将想法变成冒险。 - {argument name =“signature name”default =“magejosh”}”蓝色草书。使用具有高细节的绘画插图、怀旧的美国明信片设计、幻想概念艺术感性、温暖的日落灯光、柔和的青色天空、棕褐色老化以及诱人的创意静修心情。

items.title: Pop-Punk Emo Kitten Portrait
items.titleZh: A photorealistic close-up portrait of a small tabby kitten styled like an early-2000s pop-punk rocker, sitting on a dark floor and facing the camera with a calm, slightly soulful expression. The kitten has large round eyes, soft striped fur, and long straight scene-kid hair in {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"} with a bold {argument name="streak color" default="pink"} streak draped over one side of the face, partially covering one eye. It wears 4 visible fashion elements: a black band-style shirt with a distressed white graphic, a black-and-pink diagonal striped necktie, a black studded bracelet on one front paw, and the dramatic long wig-like hairstyle. The background is a gritty bedroom or rehearsal-space wall covered with punk posters and distressed textures; on the left is a black poster with large white text reading {argument name="poster text" default="AVRIL LAVIGNE"} above a pink heart-and-crossbones symbol, and on the right is a blurred poster of a person in dark clothing with a striped tie. items.title: Cinematic Heist Mastermind at Whiteboard
items.titleZh: A cinematic, moody heist-planning scene in a dimly lit office at night, shot in a realistic thriller style. A single adult man stands with his back mostly to the camera, slightly turned in profile, writing on a huge whiteboard filled edge to edge with tactical notes, building sketches, floor plans, arrows, routes, and hand-drawn diagrams. He has wavy dark hair and wears a dark olive or charcoal casual jacket over dark trousers, giving the impression of a mastermind strategist. The whiteboard is the focal point and contains multiple readable planning areas: the top left title says "OPERATION NIGHTHAWK"; the left column has 3 sections labeled "OBJECTIVE," "TARGET," and "TIMELINE"; the upper right has 2 labeled diagram areas, "ENTRY PLAN" and "CAMERA NETWORK"; the lower middle-right has 4 labeled planning blocks, "TRANSIT," "EQUIPMENT," "HOTEL ROUTE," and "CONTINGENCIES." Include sketched building elevations, a rooftop access drawing, loading bay notes, room labels, arrows in black and red marker, and a small van sketch near the lower center. The room is warm and shadowy with amber practical lighting. On the left side of the frame, show a desk lamp glowing over a dark wooden desk with scattered papers, and a wall with 3 framed black-and-white photographs arranged vertically. Composition is a medium-wide over-the-shoulder shot, the man centered slightly left, the whiteboard dominating the background. High contrast, soft filmic grain, tense atmosphere, realistic textures, prestige TV crime-drama aesthetic similar to a brilliant planner preparing a robbery, but not depicting any specific copyrighted character. Add a white "Pollo.ai" watermark in the top-right corner.
items.promptZh: 夜间灯光昏暗的办公室里的电影般喜怒无常的抢劫计划场景，以现实惊悚风格拍摄。一名成年男子站着，背对着镜头，侧面稍微转动，在一块巨大的白板上写满了战术笔记、建筑草图、平面图、箭头、路线和手绘图表。他有一头卷曲的深色头发，穿着深橄榄色或木炭色的休闲夹克和深色裤子，给人一种策划战略家的印象。白板是焦点，包含多个可读的规划区域：左上角标题为“夜鹰行动”；左栏有 3 个部分，标记为“目标”、“目标”和“时间线”；右上角有2个标记的图表区域，“ENTRY PLAN”和“CAMERA NETWORK”；中右下角有 4 个标记的规划块：“交通”、“设备”、“酒店路线”和“意外情况”。包括建筑立面草图、屋顶通道图、装载区注释、房间标签、黑色和红色标记箭头以及靠近下部中心的小货车草图。房间温暖而阴暗，琥珀色的实用灯光。在画框的左侧，一盏台灯在一张散落纸张的深色木桌上发光，墙上挂着三张垂直排列的镶框黑白照片。构图是中广角的过肩镜头，人物居中稍偏左，白板占据背景。高对比度、柔和的电影颗粒、紧张的气氛、逼真的纹理、著名的电视犯罪剧美学，类似于准备抢劫的出色策划者，但没有描绘任何特定的受版权保护的角色。在右上角添加白色“Pollo.ai”水印。

items.title: Cinematic Red Heist Team in Bank
items.titleZh: A cinematic, gritty heist-team group portrait inspired by a Spanish crime thriller, showing exactly 5 robbers standing shoulder to shoulder in a grand historic bank interior. The scene is framed symmetrically in a low-angle medium full-body shot, with the tallest figure centered in front as the leader and 2 teammates on each side. All 5 wear identical deep red hooded jumpsuits zipped up the front, black straps and backpack harnesses, and their hoods up, creating a menacing anonymous look. The far-left and far-right robbers stand with arms crossed; the second-left and second-right robbers stand with arms relaxed at their sides; the center robber stands squarely facing camera with hands down and a dominant posture. Their faces are intentionally obscured and featureless, hidden in shadow and blur beneath the hoods. The setting is an opulent old bank hall with dark polished wood, brass safety deposit boxes lining both side walls, ornate columns, balcony railings, classical architectural details, and warm globe lamps. A bright golden overhead light pours down from the ceiling behind the group, creating dramatic backlighting, rim light on the red suits, long shadows, and a tense high-contrast atmosphere. Color palette: crimson red, black, dark brown, brass, and warm gold. Style: ultra-realistic cinematic photography, suspenseful crime-drama poster aesthetic, highly detailed fabric texture, moody lighting, symmetrical composition, shallow haze in the background, sharp focus on the team. Add a white {argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo.ai"} logo in the top-right corner.

items.title: Short-Form Attention Tax Poster
items.titleZh:
A bold editorial poster in a brutalist Swiss-modern infographic style on a light warm-gray background, portrait orientation, with a split composition: oversized typography dominating the left half and a blurred monochrome human face dominating the right half. The main headline is stacked in huge condensed sans-serif uppercase text reading {argument name="headline text" default="SHORT-FORM ATTENTION TAX"}, with “SHORT-FORM” in black and “ATTENTION TAX” in vivid red-orange. Along the far left margin place a small vertical year mark reading “-2024”. At the top left add tiny uppercase text “YOUR ATTENTION. THEIR ECONOMY.” and at the top right add tiny uppercase text “TIME IS LIMITED. ATTENTION ISN’T.” with small plus-sign registration marks near the corners. Beneath the headline on the left, add the subheading “A hidden cost extracted every time you scroll.”

Create 3 numbered information blocks stacked down the lower left side, each marked by a vertical red-orange bar and large black numerals: section 01 titled “WHAT IS IT?”, section 02 titled “WHY DOES IT EXIST?”, and section 03 titled “HOW IT AFFECTS BEHAVIOR”. Under section 01, include body text explaining that the Short-Form Attention Tax is the invisible price paid for consuming endless short-form content and that it is measured in seconds, minutes, and mental energy extracted by platforms designed to keep you scrolling. Under section 02, include body text explaining that platforms compete for attention because attention, data, and profit are linked, and that short-form content is optimized to be instantly rewarding, infinitely scrollable, and hard to stop. Under section 03, include exactly 6 bullet points in red-orange dash style: “Shortens attention span”, “Reduces deep focus”, “Increases impulsive behavior”, “Disrupts memory & learning”, “Drives comparison & anxiety”, and “Creates compulsive usage loops”, followed by a short concluding sentence about reshaping how you think, feel, and act.

In the center-left and lower-middle areas, add supporting editorial typography in mixed sizes: “Attention is the most valuable currency of the 21st century.” with the word “currency” in red-orange; a small stat block saying “THE AVERAGE PERSON SPENDS 90+ MINUTES DAILY ON SHORT-FORM VIDEO APPS.” with “90+ MINUTES” in red-orange; a giant stacked numeric statement reading “16 DAYS” in black with the surrounding text “THAT’S OVER” above and “A YEAR.” below; and a small closing line “TAX AVOIDANCE STARTS WITH AWARENESS.”

On the right half, show a close-up portrait of a human face in black and white, partially cropped, looking forward, with a serious neutral expression. Apply heavy horizontal motion blur, digital smear, scanline-like streaks, and glitch bars crossing the face, especially across the forehead, nose, and mouth. Overlay exactly 5 vertical social-media style interface icons near the center-right of the face: a white circle/profile dot, a red-orange heart, a white speech bubble, a white bookmark ribbon, and a white share arrow. Add a large translucent red-orange circle covering the lower-right part of the face. Include subtle HUD-like graphic elements: a faint circular reticle with a small red-orange triangular wedge near the upper right, a thin vertical measurement scale near the far right edge, a few white square markers, small black and white horizontal bars, and scattered tiny plus signs for layout texture.

At the bottom, place a barcode on the left with tiny coordinate-like text above it, then 3 footer callouts spaced across the width: “PROTECT YOUR ATTENTION. PROTECT YOUR LIFE.”, “BE MINDFUL. BE INTENTIONAL. BE FREE.”, and “RECLAIM FOCUS. RECLAIM TIME. RECLAIM YOU.” Use a restrained palette of black, off-white, and red-orange only. The overall look should feel like a high-end social critique poster, mixing typographic activism, data editorial design, and dystopian tech-noise portraiture, with crisp layout, strong negative space, and print-poster realism.

items.title: Doomscrolling Editorial Poster
items.titleZh: A stark black-and-white editorial anti-tech poster on an off-white background, designed like a modern brutalist magazine cover about digital addiction. The composition is vertical and highly typographic, with one central surreal image and multiple blocks of small text. At the top center, huge bold condensed sans-serif text reads DOOM on one line and SCROLLING below it, with the word SCROLLING stretched across the page and partially motion-blurred or smeared horizontally. In the upper left corner, a tiny text block reads “SCROLL. SWIPE. NOTHING CHANGES.” with a short horizontal line above it. In the upper right corner, small text reads “24 / 7 / 365” above “THE FEED NEVER ENDS” with a horizontal divider line below. On the left side under the title, add a definition paragraph in small editorial text: “the act of spending an excessive amount of time scrolling through negative or distressing content online, often leading to feelings of anxiety, helplessness, and fatigue.” Beneath that, include 2 short horizontal divider lines, then a large statistic reading “67%” followed by smaller text: “OF PEOPLE AGED 18–24 SAY THEY SCROLL MORE THAN THEY INTEND TO. — PEW RESEARCH, 2023”. Below that, another statement reads “MORE SCROLLING. LESS LIVING.” with a divider line beneath. The center of the poster features a glossy black smartphone standing vertically at the bottom center, seen front-on, with the bottom speaker holes and charging port visible. Emerging from the phone screen is a long impossible staircase receding upward into a narrow tunnel made of repeated translucent vertical panels, creating a claustrophobic corridor. Within the tunnel, a giant grayscale human eye appears in the upper half, partially obscured by haze, vertical slicing, and ghosted repetitions, as if trapped inside the feed. The central image should feel eerie, dreamlike, oppressive, and cinematic, with soft fog, high contrast, photocopy grain, subtle motion smear, and layered transparency. Along the right side of the central image, add a narrow vertical numbered index with exactly 24 visible entries: 001, 002, 003, 004, 005, 007, 008, 009, 010, 011, 012, 013, 014, 015, 017, 018, 019, 020, 021, 022, 024, 025, 026, and an ellipsis, plus a thin downward arrow underneath. In the right column, add a text block titled “DESIGNED TO KEEP YOU HOOKED.” followed by 4 short lines: “Infinite feeds. Unpredicted rewards. Endless comparison. It’s not a glitch— it’s the business model.” Below that place a simple eye/globe icon, then a black rectangular box containing the message: “AWARENESS IS THE FIRST STEP: PUT THE PHONE DOWN. LOOK UP. RECLAIM YOUR TIME.” On the lower left, place a massive cropped black word fragment reading END near the bottom edge, with another stacked statement beside it: “THE MORE YOU SCROLL, THE LESS YOU LIVE.” Add tiny vertical microtext near the left margin for editorial flavor. Across the bottom footer, place 4 icon/text groups: a globe icon, an eye icon, a small warning text block reading “WARNING: EXCESSIVE SCREEN TIME CAN IMPACT YOUR MENTAL HEALTH, SLEEP, AND PRODUCTIVITY.”, an expand-corners icon, a barcode, and a final statement on the far right reading “STAY PRESENT. LIVE IN REAL LIFE.” Use minimalist Swiss-grid alignment, generous negative space, sharp black typography, subtle distressed print texture, and a high-fashion poster aesthetic.
items.promptZh: 灰白色背景的鲜明黑白社论反科技海报，设计得像一本关于数字成瘾的现代野兽派杂志封面。该构图是垂直的，高度印刷，有一个中心超现实图像和多个小文本块。在顶部中心，巨大的粗体压缩无衬线文本在一行上写着“DOOM”，下面是“SCROLLING”，“SCROLLING”一词在整个页面上延伸，部分运动模糊或水平涂抹。左上角有一个小文本块，上面写着“滚动。滑动。没有任何变化。”其上方有一条短水平线。在右上角，小文字写着“24 / 7 / 365”，上面写着“THE FEED NEVER ENDS”，下面有一条水平分隔线。在标题下方的左侧，用小的编辑文字添加定义段落：“花费过多时间在网上滚动浏览负面或令人痛苦的内容的行为，通常会导致焦虑、无助和疲劳的感觉。”在其下方，包括两条短水平分隔线，然后是一个大的统计数据“67%”，后面是较小的文本：“18-24 岁的人们说他们滚动的内容比他们想要的要多。——皮尤研究中心，2023 年”。下面是另一条声明：“更多滚动。更少生活。”下面有一条分隔线。海报的中心是一部光滑的黑色智能手机，垂直放置在底部中心，从正面看，底部扬声器孔和充电端口可见。从电话屏幕中出现的是一条长长的、不可能的楼梯，向上退入一条由重复的半透明垂直面板组成的狭窄隧道，形成了一条幽闭恐怖的走廊。在隧道内，一只巨大的灰度人眼出现在上半部分，部分被雾霾、垂直切片和幻影重复遮挡，就好像被困在饲料中一样。中心图像应该感觉怪异、梦幻、压抑和电影化，具有柔和的雾气、高对比度、复印颗粒、微妙的运动涂抹和分层透明度。沿着中心图像的右侧，添加一个狭窄的垂直编号索引，其中包含 24 个可见条目：001、002、003、004、005、007、008、009、010、011、012、013、014、015、017、018、019、020、 021、022、024、025、026 和省略号，以及下方的细向下箭头。在右栏中，添加一个标题为“旨在让您着迷”的文本块。接下来是 4 句简短的台词：“无限的反馈。不可预测的奖励。无休止的比较。这不是一个小故障，而是商业模式。”在其下方放置一个简单的眼睛/地球图标，然后是一个黑色矩形框，其中包含以下消息：“意识是第一步：放下手机。向上看。收回你的时间。”在左下角，在底部边缘附近放置一个巨大的黑色文字片段，上面写着“END”，旁边还有另一个堆叠的语句：“你滚动得越多，你活得越少。”在左边距附近添加微小的垂直缩微文本，以增加编辑风格。在底部页脚上，放置 4 个图标/文本组：一个地球图标、一个眼睛图标、一个小警告文本块，上面写着“警告：过多的屏幕时间会影响您的心理健康、睡眠和生产力。”、一个展开角图标、一个条形码，以及最右侧的最终声明，上面写着“保持在场。活在现实生活中。”使用极简的瑞士网格对齐、宽大的负空间、锐利的黑色排版、微妙的仿旧印刷纹理和高级时尚海报美学。

items.title: Edible History Pop-Up Chocolate Book
items.titleZh: Create a square 1:1 macro photography image of an open antique history book on a clean white background, styled like an edible history pop-up book. The book is thick, vintage, leather-bound, and lying open flat at 180 degrees. Its pages are aged parchment with yellowed paper, worn edges, and visible paper texture. On the left page, show an abundant, slightly messy cocoa harvest spread partially covering the printed text: exactly 5 whole or split cacao pods in deep red-orange and brown tones, 1 wooden bowl filled with cacao nibs, a large scatter of loose cacao beans, broken cacao shells, small piles of nibs, and several glossy green leaves tucked among the ingredients. Everything should feel organic, overflowing, and tactile. On the right page, create a large 3D pop-up sculpture of assorted Swiss chocolate built entirely from chocolate and confectionery materials: exactly 8 visible chocolate bars or bar segments in mixed dark, milk, and white chocolate, arranged in a bouquet-like upright structure with 5 large leaf-shaped cacao or chocolate leaves behind them, curled pale chocolate shavings at the base, scattered cacao crumbs, and a wrapped paper base with a vintage label reading “CHOCOLAT SUISSE” and smaller text “Maison de Qualité”. Beside it, place a tiny 1:35 scale Victorian-era chocolatier gentleman in an apron, actively presenting and adjusting the chocolate display with both hands. Print on the right page in bold black serif text: “Vevey, 1875”. Below that, include a short faded cursive lore paragraph about cacao and Swiss chocolate culture. The paragraph should read: “From the cacao pod’s humble shell emerges a confection of elegance. In Swiss chocolate houses, cacao is refined into a treasured delicacy, shared in salons and homes alike, prized for comfort, celebration, and the craft of sweet invention.” Lighting is soft, warm museum lighting focused at the center of the open book. Mood is educational, whimsical, and richly textural. Emphasize photorealism, shallow depth of field, miniature world aesthetic, premium editorial styling, and extremely high material texture fidelity.
items.promptZh: 在干净的白色背景上创建一本打开的古董历史书的方形 1:1 微距摄影图像，其样式就像一本可食用的历史弹出书。这本书很厚，复古，皮革装订，180 度平放。它的页面是老化的羊皮纸，纸张泛黄，边缘磨损，纸张纹理清晰可见。在左页上，展示了丰富但略显凌乱的可可收获物，部分覆盖了印刷文字：正好 5 个深红橙色和棕色色调的完整或分裂的可可豆荚，1 个装满可可粒的木碗，一大片松散的可可豆，破碎的可可壳，小堆可可粒，以及夹在配料中的几片光滑的绿叶。一切都应该感觉有机、丰富、有触觉。在右侧页面上，创建一个完全由巧克力和糖果材料制成的各种瑞士巧克力的大型 3D 弹出式雕塑：正好 8 个可见的黑巧克力、牛奶巧克力和白巧克力混合的巧克力条或条块，排列成花束状的直立结构，后面有 5 个大叶形可可或巧克力叶，底部卷曲的淡巧克力刨花，散落的可可面包屑，以及带有复古标签的包装纸基，上面写着“CHOCOLAT” SUISSE”和较小的文字“Maison de Qualité”。在它旁边，放置了一位 1:35 比例的维多利亚时代巧克力绅士，围着围裙，积极地用双手展示和调整巧克力展示。在右侧页面上以粗体黑色衬线文本打印：“Vevey，1875”。下面是一段关于可可和瑞士巧克力文化的简短褪色草书传说段落。该段落应为：“从可可豆荚简陋的外壳中，诞生了一种优雅的甜点。在瑞士巧克力屋中，可可被提炼成一种珍贵的美味佳肴，在沙龙和家庭中共享，因其舒适、庆祝和甜蜜发明工艺而受到珍视。”灯光柔和、温暖，博物馆灯光集中在打开的书的中心。情绪具有教育意义、异想天开且结构丰富。强调真实感、浅景深、微型世界美学、优质的编辑风格和极高的材质纹理保真度。

items.title: Post-Apocalyptic Ruins at Dusk
items.titleZh: A moody post-apocalyptic cinematic landscape at dusk, painted in a dark sepia and amber palette, showing the ruins of an industrial or urban structure beneath a turbulent sky filled with dense, glowing clouds. In the left foreground, a large diagonal collapsed metal beam or crane arm rises from the bottom left toward the upper left, draped with torn fabric or shredded sheeting and tangled cables. A single long cable stretches diagonally downward across the frame toward the center. In the hazy midground, slightly right of center, stands a damaged domed tower or observatory-like building, partially obscured by dust, smoke, and drifting debris. The ground is filled with jagged rubble, broken structures, and silhouetted wreckage. Use dramatic backlighting from the cloud breaks near the horizon, soft volumetric haze, atmospheric perspective, painterly textures, and a ruined-world epic tone. The composition should feel vertical, solemn, desolate, and cinematic, with no people visible.
items.promptZh: 黄昏时的喜怒无常的后世界末日电影景观，以深棕褐色和琥珀色调色板绘制，展示了充满浓密发光云的动荡天空下的工业或城市结构废墟。在左侧前景中，一根巨大的对角倒塌金属梁或起重机臂从左下角向左上侧升起，上面覆盖着撕裂的织物或碎片和缠结的电缆。一根长电缆沿对角线向下穿过框架向中心延伸。在朦胧的中景，中心稍偏右的地方，矗立着一座受损的圆顶塔或天文台般的建筑，部分被灰尘、烟雾和漂浮的碎片遮盖。地面上布满了锯齿状的瓦砾、破碎的建筑和轮廓分明的残骸。使用来自地平线附近的云朵的戏剧性背光、柔和的体积雾霾、大气透视、绘画纹理和毁灭世界的史诗色调。构图应该给人一种垂直、庄严、荒凉、电影般的感觉，看不到任何人。

items.title: Apocalyptic Ruined City Street
items.titleZh: A dark, apocalyptic city street at night, viewed from ground level looking upward through a narrow canyon of ruined tall buildings on both sides. The architecture is heavily damaged and partially collapsed, with jagged silhouettes, broken facades, and blackened gothic-industrial details fading into shadow. A dense column of smoke and stormy cloud fills the center of the sky, backlit by a cold pale glow near the horizon, creating a dramatic high-contrast focal point. The overall palette is nearly monochrome deep navy, charcoal, black, and muted steel blue, with scattered tiny orange ember-like specks drifting through the air across the whole scene. The mood is bleak, ominous, and cinematic, like a post-disaster wasteland or bombed urban ruin. Painterly digital concept art, soft atmospheric haze, heavy texture, subtle film-grain feel, no people, no vehicles, no readable signs, wide composition, high detail in the ruined structures, strong vertical framing from the buildings, and a foreboding smoky sky dominating the upper half.
items.promptZh: 夜晚，一条黑暗的、世界末日般的城市街道，从地面向上望去，透过两边都是废墟高楼的狭窄峡谷。该建筑遭到严重损坏，部分倒塌，锯齿状的轮廓、破碎的外墙和黑色的哥特式工业细节逐渐消失在阴影中。浓密的烟柱和暴风云充满了天空的中心，在地平线附近的冷淡光芒的背光下，形成了一个引人注目的高对比度焦点。整体调色板几乎是单色的深海军蓝、木炭色、黑色和柔和的钢蓝色，散布着微小的橙色余烬状斑点在整个场景的空气中飘荡。气氛是凄凉的、不祥的、电影般的，就像灾后的荒地或被轰炸的城市废墟。绘画般的数字概念艺术，柔和的大气雾霾，厚重的纹理，微妙的胶片颗粒感，没有人，没有车辆，没有可读的标志，宽阔的构图，毁坏结构的高细节，建筑物的强烈垂直框架，以及占据上半部分的不祥的烟雾天空。

items.title: Cinematic Racing Legend Poster
items.titleZh: Create a dramatic vertical poster-style sports tribute for {argument name="athlete name" default="Lewis Hamilton"}, designed like a cinematic legacy montage with a dark, high-contrast, gold-and-black color grade, gritty smoke, sparks, stadium haze, and celebratory lighting. At the top, place a huge metallic distressed headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="LEWIS HAMILTON"}, with a bold gold subheadline beneath it reading “BEYOND SPEED. BEYOND LIMITS.” and a smaller white line below saying “A LEGEND IN MOTION.” The composition centers on a large, close-up hero portrait of the athlete in a modern black racing suit, shown from the chest up, facing slightly to the side with intense expression, detailed skin texture, braided hair, dramatic rim lighting, and visible sponsor-style logos across the suit. Build a collage around the central portrait using exactly 8 supporting elements: on the upper left, a childhood go-kart scene labeled “1995” with the caption “THE DREAM BEGINS”; below it, a single-seater junior formula car scene labeled “2003” with the caption “F1 IS CALLING”; below that, a victory celebration scene labeled “2008” with the caption “A STAR IS BORN” and a second line “FIRST WIN CANADIAN GP”; lower left, a racing portrait labeled “2013” with the caption “WORLD CHAMPION” and a second line “A NEW ERA”; center torso text block labeled “2014 – 2020” with the title “DOMINANCE” and three stat lines “7 WORLD TITLES”, “6 CONSTRUCTORS’ TITLES”, and “82 RACE WINS”; bottom center, a front-facing black Formula 1 car with number 44 emerging from shadows; upper right, a triumphant full-body figure raising a trophy overhead amid confetti; mid-right, a vertical achievements column titled “ACHIEVEMENTS” with exactly 5 laurel-wreathed stats reading “7× F1 WORLD CHAMPION”, “103 RACE WINS”, “104 POLE POSITIONS”, “197 PODIUM FINISHES”, and “7 BRITISH GP WINS”, followed by a final text callout “SIR” and the line “KNIGHTED FOR SERVICES TO MOTORSPORT”; lower right, a modern portrait of the athlete with hand over chest beside the caption “2021 & BEYOND” and the stacked text “STILL PUSHING. STILL INSPIRING. STILL WINNING.” Add 2 additional cars at the bottom edge: a red Formula 1 car on the lower left streaking diagonally with motion blur, and a smaller black Formula 1 car on the lower right. Place a centered quote near the bottom in white italic caps: {argument name="quote" default="I DON’T RACE TO BE SECOND. I RACE TO BE ONE OF A KIND."}, followed by a gold handwritten signature-style script reading {argument name="signature name" default="Lewis Hamilton"}. Finish with a footer slogan in spaced-out white capitals: “TALENT. DISCIPLINE. PASSION. PURPOSE.” and a final line beneath it: “LEWIS HAMILTON – MORE THAN A DRIVER. A MOVEMENT.” Use layered depth, sharp typography, premium magazine-poster layout, subtle British flag accents, realistic cars, photoreal faces, and an inspirational champion-documentary aesthetic.
items.promptZh: 为{argument name="athlete name" default="Lewis Hamilton"}创建一个引人注目的垂直海报风格的体育致敬，设计类似于电影传统蒙太奇，具有黑暗、高对比度、金黑颜色等级、砂砾烟雾、火花、体育场烟雾和庆祝灯光。在顶部放置一个巨大的金属仿旧标题，上面写着 {argument name="headline text" default="LEWIS HAMILTON"}，其下方有一个粗体的金色副标题，上面写着“BEYOND SPEED. BEYOND LIMITS”。下面有一条较小的白线，上面写着“A LEGEND IN MOTION”。构图以这位身穿现代黑色赛车服的运动员的大型特写英雄肖像为中心，从胸部向上展示，略微面向侧面，表情强烈，皮肤纹理细致，头发编成辫子，边缘灯光引人注目，整个套装上可见赞助商风格的标志。使用 8 个支撑元素围绕中央肖像构建拼贴画：左上角是童年卡丁车场景，标记为“1995”，标题为“梦想开始”；下面是一个单座青少年方程式赛车场景，标有“2003”，标题为“F1 IS CALLING”；下面是胜利庆祝场景，标有“2008”，标题为“一颗明星诞生”，第二行为“FIRST WIN CANADIAN GP”；左下角，一幅赛车肖像，标有“2013”​​，标题为“WORLD CHAMPION”，第二行为“A NEW ERA”；中心躯干文本块标记为“2014 – 2020”，标题为“DOMINANCE”和三个统计行“7 WORLD TITLES”、“6 CONSTRUCTORS’ TITLES”和“82 RACE WINS”；底部中央，一辆正面黑色一级方程式赛车，编号为 44，从阴影中显现出来；右上方，一个胜利的全身人物在五彩纸屑中高举奖杯；中右，垂直成就栏标题为“成就”，正好有 5 个桂冠统计数据，分别为“7× F1 世界冠军”、“103 场比赛获胜”、“104 杆位置”、“197 次登上领奖台”和“7 次英国大奖赛获胜”，后面是最后的文字标注“SIR”和“KNIGHTED FOR SERVICES TO”行赛车运动”；右下角是这位运动员的现代肖像，手放在胸前，旁边写着“2021 年及以后”标题和堆叠文字“仍在推动。仍在鼓舞人心。仍在获胜。”在底部边缘添加 2 辆额外的汽车：一辆红色一级方程式赛车在左下角以运动模糊对角线疾驰，一辆较小的黑色一级方程式赛车在右下角。在底部附近放置一个白色斜体大写居中的引号：{argument name="quote" default="I DON’T RACE TO BE SECOND. I RACE TO BE ONE OF A KIND."}，后面是金色手写签名式脚本，内容为 {argument name="signature name" default="Lewis Hamilton"}。最后以白色大写字母间隔的页脚口号结尾：“才华、纪律、激情、目的。”其下方还有最后一行：“刘易斯·汉密尔顿——不仅仅是一名车手。一场运动。”使用分层的深度、清晰的版式、优质的杂志海报布局、微妙的英国国旗口音、逼真的汽车、照片般真实的面孔以及鼓舞人心的冠军纪录片美学。

items.title: Editorial Woman in Wildflower Hills
items.titleZh: A soft, editorial-style outdoor fashion photograph of a woman standing in a wildflower meadow in the mountains during daylight, shown from behind with her body turned slightly three-quarters to the side and her head angled back toward the camera. She has shoulder-length to mid-back tousled {argument name="hair color" default="dark blonde"} hair, windblown and slightly messy. Her face is fully obscured by a flat rectangular blur block in a warm beige-brown tone. She wears a delicate, sheer white lace outfit consisting of 2 visible pieces: a long-sleeved semi-transparent floral lace top with ruffled cuffs and high-waisted white lace bottoms. The pose is relaxed and sensual, one arm hanging down and the other resting near her hip. Surround her with dense natural grasses and blooming wildflowers, including visible white daisies and small yellow flowers in the foreground and midground. Place her in front of rolling green and golden hills with dramatic chalky white cliff faces and erosion lines across the background. Use a wide open landscape, partly cloudy blue sky, warm natural sunlight, earthy tones, shallow depth of field, cinematic composition, realistic photography, high detail, soft contrast, and a dreamy bohemian countryside mood.
items.promptZh: 一张柔和的社论风格户外时尚照片，照片中一位女士在白天站在山上的野花草地上，从后面拍摄，她的身体稍微转向一侧四分之三，头向后仰向镜头。她有一头齐肩到中背的凌乱的{argument name="hair color" default="dark silver"}头发，被风吹得有点凌乱。她的脸被温暖的米棕色色调的扁平矩形模糊块完全遮挡。她穿着精致、透明的白色蕾丝套装，由两件可见的部分组成：长袖半透明花卉蕾丝上衣，带荷叶边袖口和高腰白色蕾丝下装。这个姿势放松而性感，一只手臂垂下，另一只手臂放在臀部附近。她周围是茂密的天然草和盛开的野花，包括前景和中景可见的白色雏菊和黄色小花。将她放置在连绵起伏的绿色和金色山丘前面，背景是戏剧性的白垩白色悬崖面和侵蚀线。使用开阔的风景、部分多云的蓝天、温暖的自然阳光、泥土色调、浅景深、电影构图、写实摄影、高细节、柔和的对比度和梦幻般的波西米亚乡村氛围。

items.title: Anime AI Studio Girls at Sunset
items.titleZh: A highly detailed anime-style illustration of a cozy creative studio at golden hour, showing 5 young women gathered around a cluttered wooden worktable, lit by warm sunset light through large windows, hanging pendant lamps, and string lights. The mood is stylish, intelligent, playful, and slightly chaotic, like a startup loft mixed with an artist workspace. In the left foreground, a tall woman with {argument name="hair color" default="long wavy auburn"} hair wears a white daisy flower crown and a sleeveless rust-red dress with a belt; she stands closest to camera and holds up a handwritten paper sign that reads exactly: {argument name="sign text" default="Claude is asking for your permission"}, with a small heart doodle. Behind and to the right of her stands a second woman with platinum-blonde twin ponytails, a black gothic mini dress, black thigh-high stockings, and large headphones around her neck; she poses confidently with one hand on her hip near an open laptop covered in stickers, prominently featuring a large X logo. In the center background stands a petite girl with very long straight black hair and a dark navy dress, reserved and quiet, positioned in front of a wide monitor displaying a glowing Gemini star logo on a dark screen. To the right of center, a glamorous woman with a short black bob and earrings leans over the desk in a fitted red floral cheongsam-style dress, looking toward the papers and laptops. On the far right, a fifth woman with messy light-brown hair in a loose bun wears an oversized open shirt over a cropped white T-shirt with the OpenAI knot logo and casual pants, leaning over the table with one hand braced on the surface and the other near a drawing tablet. The room should contain 2 laptops visible on the desk, 1 central monitor, 3 mugs, 2 sticky notes, 1 paper sign, 1 notebook page titled "Plans", and many scattered creative objects like pens, cables, books, papers, and cans. The first laptop is covered with stickers including a large X logo; the second laptop has an OpenAI logo. The desk includes a black mug with a moon-and-text design, a white mug that says "Good answer takes time.", a white cup with an orange sunburst logo, an energy-drink can, a clear plastic drink cup, a closed notebook, loose handwritten notes, and a tablet on the far right. One sticky note says "You got this" with a heart, and another says "One step at a time" with a tiny flower. The notebook page on the desk reads "Plans" and lists 3 items: "1. World peace", "2. More coffee", "3. Nap", with a small cat doodle. The environment should include bookshelves, framed prints, potted plants, warm wood textures, and wall decor with visible posters and signs, including "Anthropic", "Kindness intelligence", "DO GOOD BUILD COOL SHIT", and a neon-style sign that says "focus fuel". Use cinematic composition, rich amber and sepia tones, intricate linework, soft painterly shading, detailed fabrics and hair, subtle glow on screens, and a polished modern anime illustration aesthetic. No blur, no distortion, no extra people, and no duplicated objects.
items.promptZh: 一幅高度详细的动漫风格插图，展示了黄金时段舒适的创意工作室，展示了 5 名年轻女性聚集在杂乱的木制工作台周围，温暖的夕阳光透过大窗户、悬挂的吊灯和灯串照亮。这里的氛围时尚、聪明、俏皮，但又略显混乱，就像初创公司的阁楼与艺术家的工作空间混合在一起。左侧前景中，一位身材高挑、头发{argument name="hair color" default="long wavy auburn"}的女性，头戴白色雏菊花冠，身穿铁锈色无袖连衣裙，系着腰带；她站在离镜头最近的地方，举着一张手写的纸牌，上面写着：{argument name="sign text" default="Claude is requests your permission"}，上面有一个小小的心形涂鸦。在她的右后方站着第二位女士，她梳着白金金色的双马尾辫，穿着黑色哥特式迷你连衣裙，穿着黑色长筒袜，脖子上挂着大耳机；她自信地摆出一只手放在臀部的姿势，旁边是一台打开的笔记本电脑，笔记本电脑上贴满了贴纸，上面有一个巨大的 X 标志。背景中央站着一个身材娇小的女孩，她留着黑色长直发，穿着深色海军蓝连衣裙，矜持而安静，她站在宽大的显示器前，黑色的屏幕上显示着发光的双子星标志。在中间的右侧，一位留着黑色短波波头、戴着耳环的迷人女子穿着合身的红色花卉旗袍式连衣裙，靠在桌子上，看着文件和笔记本电脑。在最右边，第五位女士有着凌乱的浅棕色头发，扎着松散的发髻，穿着一件超大号的开放式衬衫，外面穿着一件带有 OpenAI 结标志的短款白色 T 恤，下身穿着休闲裤，她靠在桌子上，一只手撑在桌子上，另一只手靠近绘图板。房间内应包含桌上可见的 2 台笔记本电脑、1 个中央显示器、3 个杯子、2 个便签、1 个纸质标牌、1 个标题为“计划”的笔记本页，以及许多分散的创意物品，如钢笔、电缆、书籍、纸张和罐头。第一台笔记本电脑上贴满了贴纸，其中包括一个大 X 标志；第二台笔记本电脑有 OpenAI 徽标。桌子上有一个带有月亮和文字设计的黑色杯子，一个写着“好的答案需要时间”的白色杯子，一个带有橙色旭日标志的白色杯子，一个能量饮料罐，一个透明的塑料饮料杯，一个合上的笔记本，松散的手写笔记，以及最右边的一个平板电脑。一张便签上写着“你得到了这个”，上面写着一颗心，另一张便签上写着“一次一步”，上面写着一朵小花。桌子上的笔记本页面写着“计划”，列出了3项：“1.世界和平”、“2.更多咖啡”、“3.午睡”，上面有一个小猫涂鸦。环境应包括书架、镶框印刷品、盆栽植物、温暖的木质纹理以及带有可见海报和标志的墙壁装饰，包括“人性化”、“善良智慧”、“DO GOOD BUILD COOL SHIT”以及写着“焦点燃料”的霓虹灯式标志。使用电影构图、丰富的琥珀色和棕褐色色调、复杂的线条、柔和的绘画阴影、细致的织物和头发、屏幕上微妙的发光以及精致的现代动漫插图美学。没有模糊，没有扭曲，没有多余的人，也没有重复的物体。

items.title: Moonlit Woman and Tiger Reflection
items.titleZh: A dreamy cinematic fantasy night scene on a calm reflective sea under a deep indigo star-filled sky, with 1 large full moon in the upper left and the Milky Way stretching diagonally across the background. In the center, a slender woman with {argument name="hair color" default="black"} long straight hair walks barefoot across the shallow mirror-like water from left to right, shown in elegant full body profile. She wears a shimmering translucent silver evening gown with a fitted sparkling bodice, thin straps, a flowing gauzy skirt, and a high slit revealing one leg, the fabric trailing in the breeze. Around her right side, a curved arc of glowing magical particles forms 1 crescent-shaped trail made of luminous white roses, petals, and tiny lights, rising from the water near her reflection and curling upward beside her. Beneath her on the reflective surface appears a fantastical mirrored image: 1 glowing transparent white tiger lying on its side, rendered like liquid light and stardust, detailed with bright stripes and a softly radiant face. The water is glassy with subtle ripples and crisp reflections of the woman, moon, stars, and magical light. Low dark islands sit on the distant horizon. At the bottom center, add elegant luminous cursive text reading {argument name="quote" default="In me the tiger sniffs the rose"}. Ultra-detailed, ethereal, poetic, photoreal fantasy art, soft moonlight, cool blue palette, high contrast, gentle bloom, mystical atmosphere, widescreen composition.
items.promptZh: 梦幻般的电影奇幻夜景，在深蓝色的星空下，平静的反光大海上，左上方有一颗巨大的满月，银河系沿对角线延伸穿过背景。画面中央，一名留着长直发、身材苗条的女子，光着脚从左向右走过镜面般的浅水，展现出优雅的全身轮廓。她穿着一件闪闪发光的半透明银色晚礼服，配有合身的闪亮紧身胸衣、细肩带、飘逸的薄纱裙子，高开叉露出一条腿，布料在微风中飘扬。在她的右侧周围，一道由发光的魔法粒子组成的弧形形成了一条由发光的白玫瑰、花瓣和微小灯光组成的新月形轨迹，从她倒影附近的水中升起，并在她身边向上卷曲。在她下方的反光表面上出现了一个梦幻般的镜像：一只发光的透明白虎侧躺着，渲染得像液态光和星尘，细节上有明亮的条纹和柔和的容光焕发的脸。水面呈玻璃状，泛着微妙的波纹，清晰地反射出女人、月亮、星星和神奇的光芒。低矮的黑暗岛屿坐落在遥远的地平线上。在底部中心，添加优雅的发光草书文本：{argument name="quote" default="In me the Tiger sniffs the Rose"}。超细致、空灵、诗意、真实的奇幻艺术，柔和的月光，凉爽的蓝色调色板，高对比度，温柔的绽放，神秘的氛围，宽屏构图。

items.title: Pastel Blueberry Cake Anime Poster
items.titleZh: A dreamy pastel-purple Japanese movie poster illustration in a glossy shoujo anime style, packed with blueberry dessert chaos and soft sparkles. The scene shows 1 seated teenage girl with a short silver-lavender bob haircut, side bangs, a small lavender bow hair clip, and alternative cute fashion, sitting on the floor in a messy kitchen or baking workspace. Her face is intentionally covered by a centered square censor block in muted lavender-gray. She wears an oversized translucent lavender jacket with black ribbon details on the sleeves, a light purple graphic top, layered silver necklaces, a purple plaid skirt, slouchy white leg warmers decorated with lavender heart patches and black bows, and chunky lavender platform sneakers with ribbon accents. She holds 1 blueberry near her mouth with one hand and 1 metal mixing bowl smeared with vivid purple blueberry batter in the other. In front of her is 1 large golden pound cake split open dramatically, overflowing with dark glossy blueberries and purple filling, spilling across 1 cooling rack and the tabletop. Counted blueberries are scattered throughout the composition as floating and resting props, creating a whimsical suspended effect. The environment is cluttered with baking tools and notes: 1 spiral notebook page in the upper right labeled in English with a handwritten recipe for blueberry pound cake, 1 whisk in the lower right, 1 small pinned photo print in the lower left showing 2 anime girls, and 1 handwritten note card in the lower right with Japanese writing and a small bunny doodle. Use a monochrome palette of lilac, violet, periwinkle, cream, and deep blueberry purple, with luminous highlights, soft haze, translucent overlays, and romantic glitter. Add large expressive Japanese calligraphy text dominating the left half of the poster, reading vertically and diagonally like a dramatic light-novel or film advertisement, plus a ribbon banner near the cake with the date text “2026年7月メロードショー”, vertical copy on the right side, small production-credit text across the bottom, and a final tagline line at the very bottom. Make the composition feel like a cute disaster: beautiful but failed baking, sweet melancholy, fashionable messiness, and cinematic promotional poster energy.

items.title: Pastel Anime Blueberry Cake Movie Poster
items.titleZh: A dreamy pastel anime movie-poster illustration set in a narrow outdoor alley completely covered in dense floral mosaic wall art, rendered with glittering sparkles, soft haze, and romantic shoujo color grading in lavender, pink, periwinkle, and cream. In the foreground, show a cute teenage girl from a rear three-quarter view, her face mostly hidden, with short silvery-lavender bob hair and a large mauve bow hair accessory decorated with tiny flowers. She wears an oversized translucent lavender hoodie with embroidered floral appliqués on the sleeves, a layered pastel skirt, and carries a shiny lilac backpack covered with charms, ribbons, plush pom-poms, pins, and star details. She is holding a plate with a blueberry pound cake loaf that has been sliced open, and the center is dramatically overflowing with glossy dark-purple blueberry filling that pours out in thick syrupy streams down the cake and plate. Scatter whole blueberries around the cake and lower foreground. Make the scene whimsical, delicate, and slightly comedic despite the beautiful presentation. Design the image as a Japanese film poster with many decorative text overlays and laurels. Across the top, include 3 small award lines with laurel wreaths. Add a huge hand-lettered Japanese title in layered pink, white, and purple lettering with glow and sticker-like outlines reading: 「冷凍したブルーベリー使ってパウンドケーキ焼いたら中身溢れて失敗した件。」 Below it, add a smaller subtitle line: 「〜甘くて、ちょっぴり切ない青春のレシピ〜」. On the right side, place 1 vertical white quote box with Japanese text: 「うまくいかない日だって、人生のスパイスになるんだ。」 In the lower left, add 1 pinned pink note card that says “Sweet but clumsy.” and 1 torn recipe memo sheet with handwritten Japanese checklist items. Add a small speech bubble near the cake that says “Oops!”. Include a circular stamp-style seal near the lower right that reads “Blueberry disaster”. At the bottom, add film-credit style text in white, including “A FILM BY YUMEIRO PASTEL”, and a large release line in pink and white: “{argument name="release date" default="2024.6.30(SUN)"} ROADSHOW”. Under that, add the Japanese tagline: 「失敗は、最高の思い出になる。だから、また挑戦しよう。」 Frame the whole poster with lace, stickers, scraps of paper, and scrapbook-style decorations. Make it ultra-detailed, glossy, sentimental, kawaii, cinematic, and intentionally over-the-top like a fake coming-of-age movie poster about a baking failure.

items.title: Chinese Tomato Nutrition Poster
items.titleZh:
A clean premium food advertisement poster on a light gray-white studio background, featuring {argument name="fruit name" default="tomatoes"} as the hero subject. In the center, show exactly 7 tomato pieces arranged on a shallow round wooden plate: 5 whole ripe red tomatoes stacked in a natural pyramid, 1 halved tomato standing upright at the front center with glossy flesh and visible seeds, and 1 wedge slice placed at the lower right foreground. The tomatoes are fresh, vivid red, covered with realistic water droplets, with green stems attached to most whole fruits. Add a few green leaves and two small yellow tomato blossoms near the lower right edge for freshness accents. Use soft commercial lighting, gentle shadows, sharp focus, and highly realistic texture, in a polished supermarket-poster style.

Design the layout as a Chinese nutrition and freshness infographic poster. In the upper left, place a large two-line Chinese headline with strong typographic hierarchy: the first line in black reads {argument name="headline line 1" default="自然成熟"}, the second line in large warm red reads {argument name="headline line 2" default="营养美味"}. Below it, add a smaller gray Chinese slogan: {argument name="slogan text" default="每一口都是大自然的馈赠"}. Under the slogan, place exactly 3 simple red line icons in a horizontal row with short Chinese labels and gray sublabels beneath each: 1) a sun icon with text "充足日照" and subtext "自然成熟", 2) a sprout or leaf icon with text "科学种植" and subtext "健康美味", 3) a heart outline icon with text "新鲜采摘" and subtext "产地直供".

On the right side, create a thin curved red guide line framing the tomatoes, with exactly 4 circular nutrient callouts stacked vertically from top to bottom. Each callout is a red or red-orange gradient circle with a white symbol or letter inside, connected to the curve. Use these Chinese labels and explanatory text: 1) top callout with "C" and title "富含维生素C", description "有助于增强免疫力 促进胶原蛋白合成"; 2) second callout with a molecular icon and title "番茄红素", description "强效抗氧化剂 有助于抵御自由基"; 3) third callout with a leaf icon and title "膳食纤维", description "促进肠道蠕动 帮助消化"; 4) bottom callout with "K" and title "钾元素", description "有助于维持 心脏健康".

On the left lower side of the tomatoes, add exactly 2 red text feature callouts with fine red leader lines: the upper one titled "美味多汁" with smaller gray text "果肉饱满，汁水丰富 酸甜可口，回味无穷"; the lower one titled "新鲜采摘" with smaller gray text "人工精选，严格挑选 确保每一颗都新鲜优质".

Across the bottom, place a rounded rectangular nutrition table bar in white with light gray dividers. On the left end, add a solid red rounded label block containing the Chinese title {argument name="table title" default="营养成分表（每100g含量）"}. To its right, show exactly 6 nutrient columns with gray headings and darker values beneath: "能量" "20kcal"; "蛋白质" "0.9g"; "脂肪" "0.2g"; "碳水化合物" "4.2g"; "维生素C" "14mg"; "钾" "179mg". Center a tiny gray footnote below the table: "* 数据来源于《中国食物成分表》". Overall style: elegant Chinese fresh-produce marketing poster, balanced whitespace, red-accented infographic design, realistic product photography blended with clean vector UI elements.

items.title: Epic French Dystopian Book Cover
items.titleZh: A cinematic French dystopian science-fantasy book cover in vertical poster format, dark and epic, with a cold desaturated palette of charcoal blue, steel gray, ash white, and muted silver. In the foreground, show 1 solitary young traveler seen from behind, standing on a snow-dusted rocky cliff at lower left, small against the environment, wearing a weathered winter jacket, rugged pants, boots, and a large worn backpack, with messy light brown hair visible, posture still and contemplative as he looks out over a vast ruined city. In the middle distance, depict 1 immense circular or sprawling fortified city in a frozen valley, dense with countless dark gothic-industrial buildings and spires, surrounded by icy water channels and connected by several narrow bridges. Rising from the exact center of the city, place 1 colossal needle-like black tower that dominates the skyline, dramatically taller than everything else. Surround the city with jagged snow-covered mountain ranges on both sides and in the far distance. Above, create a stormy sky filled with heavy textured clouds, faint snowfall or drifting ice particles, and a pale backlit glow breaking through behind the central tower, giving a mythic apocalyptic atmosphere. Composition should emphasize scale, isolation, and awe, with the traveler occupying only a small portion of the image and the city and tower centered. Add distressed serif typography integrated as a cover design: at the very top in small uppercase French text, "DANS L’UNIVERS DE APRÈS L’EFFONDREMENT"; below it, a huge title in cracked weathered off-white serif capitals, "{argument name="title text" default="ELON"}", spanning nearly the full width; beneath the title place 1 small compass-star ornament centered with thin horizontal lines. At the bottom center, add the author name in refined serif capitals, "{argument name="author name" default="MARTINOLLI"}". Make the overall image look like premium dark fantasy / post-apocalyptic cover art, ultra-detailed, atmospheric perspective, realistic textures, dramatic lighting, moody, monumental, polished publishing design.
items.promptZh: 电影般的法国反乌托邦科学奇幻书籍封面，采用垂直海报格式，黑暗而史诗般，采用炭蓝色、钢灰色、灰白色和柔和银色的冷色不饱和调色板。前景中，一位孤独的年轻旅行者从后面看到，他站在左下角积雪覆盖的岩石悬崖上，在环境中显得很小，穿着一件饱经风霜的冬季夹克、粗糙的裤子、靴子和一个破旧的大背包，凌乱的浅棕色头发清晰可见，他的姿势静止而沉思，俯瞰着一座巨大的废墟城市。在中距离，描绘了一座位于冰冻山谷中的巨大圆形或蔓延的防御城市，密集地分布着无数黑暗的哥特式工业建筑和尖塔，周围环绕着冰冷的水道，并由几座狭窄的桥梁连接起来。一座巨大的针状黑色塔从城市的正中心升起，主宰着天际线，比其他一切都高得多。城市的周围和远处都是锯齿状的雪山。上方，创造出一个暴风雨般的天空，充满了厚重的纹理云、微弱的降雪或漂浮的冰粒，以及在中央塔后面突破的苍白背光光芒，营造出一种神话般的世界末日氛围。构图应强调规模、孤立和敬畏，旅行者只占据图像的一小部分，城市和塔楼居中。添加仿旧衬线字体作为封面设计：在最顶部用小写法文“DANS L’UNIVERS DE APRÈS L’EFFONDRMENT”；在它的下面，有一个巨大的标题，用破裂的、风化的灰白色衬线大写字母“{argument name =“title text”default =“ELON”}”，几乎覆盖了整个宽度；在标题下方放置 1 个小罗盘星形装饰物，以细水平线为中心。在底部中心，以精致的衬线大写字母添加作者姓名，“{argument name="author name" default="MARTINOLLI"}”。使整体图像看起来像高级黑暗幻想/后世界末日封面艺术，超详细，大气透视，逼真的纹理，戏剧性的灯光，喜怒无常，不朽，抛光的出版设计。

A colossal hovering platform-city dominates the upper right-middle area, dark metallic and heavily detailed, suspended above the skyline with smaller towers and structures attached beneath it. items.title: Cyberpunk City Highway HDRI
items.titleZh: Create a seamless-looking 360-degree equirectangular HDRI environment map of a futuristic urban expressway at night, viewed from the middle of a wide wet roadway beneath elevated highways in a dense modern city. Use a panoramic full-surround composition with strong fisheye-like equirectangular distortion at the top and bottom edges, designed for use as a Blender world background. The scene should feature 2 large curving elevated highway ramps, one on the left and one on the right, arching inward toward the center, with multiple supporting pillars and additional overpass layers receding into the distance. Surround the roadway with a skyline of illuminated high-rise office towers and apartment buildings, with cool blue and cyan windows and a few magenta and purple accent lights. Make the road surface glossy and rain-soaked, reflecting the city lights in long horizontal streaks of neon blue, violet, and pink. Add subtle light trails and luminous reflections across the pavement, creating a cyberpunk mood. The sky should be dark, cloudy, and atmospheric with a faint bright glow at the zenith and soft haze around distant buildings. Keep the overall palette dominated by deep indigo, electric blue, cyan, and purple. The image should feel cinematic, moody, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, high dynamic range, with realistic urban lighting and mirrored wet-surface reflections, suitable as an HDRI backdrop. Include slight panorama seam artifacts and stretched distortion near the poles so it feels like an AI-generated but usable environment map.
items.promptZh: 创建未来城市高速公路夜间的无缝 360 度等距矩形 HDRI 环境地图，从人口稠密的现代城市中高架高速公路下方宽阔潮湿的道路中间观看。使用全景全环绕构图，在顶部和底部边缘具有强烈的鱼眼状等距矩形畸变，专为用作 Blender 世界背景而设计。该场景应具有 2 个大型弯曲高架公路坡道，一左一右，向中心向内拱起，并有多个支撑柱和额外的立交桥层向远处退去。道路周围是明亮的高层办公楼和公寓楼的天际线，有凉爽的蓝色和青色窗户以及一些洋红色和紫色的重点灯光。使路面光滑且被雨水浸透，以霓虹蓝、紫罗兰色和粉色的长水平条纹反射城市灯光。在人行道上添加微妙的光迹和发光反射，营造赛博朋克氛围。天空应该是黑暗的、多云的、大气的，天顶有微弱的明亮光芒，远处的建筑物周围有柔和的薄雾。保持整体色调以深靛蓝、电蓝色、青色和紫色为主。图像应具有电影感、喜怒无常、超详细、逼真、高动态范围，具有逼真的城市照明和镜面湿表面反射，适合作为 HDRI 背景。包括轻微的全景接缝伪影和极点附近的拉伸变形，因此感觉就像人工智能生成但可用的环境地图。

items.title: Luxury Skincare Brand Key Visual (KV)
items.titleZh: Minimalist Eastern luxury advertising style, high-end skincare brand KV poster, brand name "BRAND", overall vibe is pure, restrained, combining technology with Eastern aesthetics. The center of the screen is a high-end essence product, glass bottle, transparent gradient texture (transparent top → cold cyan-green bottom), with liquid light at the bottom, paired with a champagne gold metal cap. The product is placed on a circular high-light base made of polished stone and metal. Details are exquisite and clear, serving as the absolute visual center. The product is surrounded by delicate golden energy halos and flowing light ribbons, forming a slight S-shaped movement, symbolizing repair and regeneration energy, with light diffusing outwards to strengthen "efficacy visualization". An Eastern woman is positioned in the background slightly to the right, looking back with a side profile, calm and elegant temperament, delicate natural features, cold white skin with a transparent glow (emphasizing skincare effects), low-saturation orange-pink makeup with faint golden highlights. Black long hair flows with the wind, hair strands integrated with golden light particles and weak light ribbons, overall clean and restrained without over-decoration, echoing the product's light effect. Wearing translucent silk clothing and a shawl, light and flowing, the material is transparent with fine gold-gilded textures and soft reflections, presenting a high-end texture. The lighting system is a clean warm-gold main light source (side-rear), the product is the focus, the person is auxiliary light, edge light is soft, volume light exists slightly, fine golden light particles float in the air, overall light is clear and not overexposed. Background is a minimalist light gradient (off-white + warm gold transition), large areas of negative space, the screen is clean without impurities, providing space for advertising layout. Cold-tone cyan-green water or mineral texture elements are added below (symbolizing pure technology and component sources), enhancing the brand's "pure technology feel". Strictly controlled color system: main colors are gold + off-white, accented with cold cyan-green and champagne gold, overall low-saturation high-end tones. Composition is stable center composition + slight S-curve, clear visual focus and hierarchy (Product > Light > Character). Overall style: high-end, pure, repair and regeneration, anti-aging technology, international big-brand skincare advertising quality (similar to La Mer / SK-II level). Ultra-fine, 8K texture, commercial photography-grade lighting, realistic material expression. Negative: product deformation, text errors, too much decoration, crowded screen, cheap gold, chaotic lighting, overexposure, low resolution.

整体风格：高端、纯净、修护再生、抗老科技感，国际大牌护肤广告质感（类似La Mer / SK-II级别）

items.title: Barcelona Transfer Poster for Saka
items.titleZh: Create a dramatic football transfer announcement poster for {argument name="player name" default="Bukayo Saka"} joining {argument name="club name" default="FC Barcelona"}. Use a vertical 4:5 sports-poster composition with a deep electric blue and crimson red color grade, high contrast lighting, cinematic shadows, subtle glow, and premium social-media graphic design styling. Center a large chest-up portrait of the player wearing the {argument name="jersey description" default="2024/25 FC Barcelona home shirt with Spotify sponsor"}, facing forward with a serious confident expression. Behind him, place a much larger low-opacity side portrait of the same player on the right side as a background layer, tinted dark blue. Add a huge faint FC Barcelona crest spanning the middle background, blended into the red-blue gradient. At the very top center, place 2 club identifiers: the FC Barcelona crest and above it a small vertical red-and-blue striped motif. On the upper left, include the text “MÉS QUE UN CLUB” in small gold uppercase letters. On the left lower-middle, create a bold typographic name stack with 2 lines: small gold uppercase first name “BUKAYO” above very large white condensed sans-serif “SAKA”. Below that, add 2 welcome lines in uppercase: “BENVINGUT” in white and “AL BARÇA” in red. Add a gold handwritten-style signature reading “B. Saka” with the number “7” beneath it. In the foreground near the lower center, place a full-body action pose of the same player running forward with arms stretched wide in celebration, wearing the same Barcelona kit, navy socks, light boots, and a white wrist wrap. At the bottom, show a stylized illuminated view of Spotify Camp Nou curving across the width of the poster in dark blue with red highlights, with small visible stadium text “SPOTIFY CAMP NOU”. In the bottom left corner, include 2 small lines of text: “FC BARCELONA” in gold and “2024/25” in red. Add a small gold sleeve detail on the right shoulder area. items.title: Museum-grade Crying Dragon Dome Mural
items.titleZh:
A {argument name="style" default="museum-grade, high-end mural"} inspired by the “Crying Dragon” of {argument name="location" default="Nikko Toshogu Shrine"}, painted on a circular dome ceiling. The composition is strictly centered, viewed from a worm’s-eye perspective, creating a powerful sense of sacred architectural depth.

A dragon of overwhelming presence emerges from the exact center of the dome, its head directed downward toward the viewer. Its body, claws, and surrounding clouds radiate outward in a swirling motion, forming a dynamic circular explosion from the center.

The entire scene is enveloped within the dome structure, with subtle architectural curvature and faint boundary cues that further emphasize the immersive sensation of looking up into an overhead space.

Lighting: a soft, sacred glow emanates from the center, gradually fading into darkness toward the edges. Mist, cloud voids, and delicate negative space create a breathable, atmospheric sense of depth.

items.prompt: A detailed retro fantasy pixel art scene of a massive medieval stone castle perched on a steep rocky hill, viewed from a slight low angle, with a winding dirt path leading up to the gate. The castle has many cylindrical towers and connecting walls, exactly 9 visible towers with red-orange conical roofs, several small red flags fluttering from the tallest spires, and weathered gray stone masonry. A huge red dragon is coiled around the tallest central tower, with its long body wrapped around the stone, claws gripping the battlements, horned head leaning forward near the top, and one large batlike wing spread open on the right side. Surround the hill with dense dark-green pine trees and rocky outcrops, with distant blue mountains on the horizon. Place the castle against a bright daytime sky in saturated blue with large fluffy white cumulus clouds. Render in classic 16-bit inspired pixel art with crisp sprite-like shapes, visible pixel texture, rich contrast, adventurous fantasy game cover composition, centered subject, and a square frame.

items.title: Gritty Córdoba Music Poster
items.titleZh: A dramatic vertical poster-style mixed-media portrait with a gritty urban editorial aesthetic, designed like a concert or personal brand poster. Center a middle-aged man from the waist up, wearing a black T-shirt, standing slightly turned and raising one arm upward with his index finger pointing toward the top of the frame. His face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blur block. Use a dark black and sepia color palette with distressed cream and gold accents, heavy grunge textures, ink splatters, scratched overlays, torn-paper brush marks, dust, and weathered print effects. Place a large muted gold circular halo behind his head and upper torso. In the background, create a collage of Córdoba city landmarks: a cathedral facade on the right side, a river with bridge and low skyline on the left side, all blended into the textured poster composition. Add oversized bold condensed serif typography at the top reading {argument name="headline text" default="EDU PEREYRA"}, with “EDU” in large distressed off-white letters and “PEREYRA” below in gold. Add 5 smaller text groups around the composition in uppercase handwritten or condensed styles: top left “MÚSICA PASIÓN VERDAD”, top right “DESDE ADENTRO HACIA AFUERA”, mid-right “LO QUE SE SIENTE NO NECESITA EXPLICARSE”, mid-left “AGRADECER SEGUIR CREAR”, and bottom center “TIERRA DE HISTORIA, CORAZÓN DE GENTE.” Across the lower foreground, add a huge expressive brush-script word {argument name="city name" default="cordoba"} in off-white, slightly diagonal, with a gold underline swoosh. Include 3 small symbolic graphic accents: a tiny crown icon near the upper right, a small starburst ornament near the bottom center, and a handwritten signature mark at the lower right. The shirt should include vintage printed lettering and emblem graphics. Lighting is moody and contrasty, with the subject cut out sharply against the layered collage. Overall feel: raw, passionate, musical, spiritual, local-pride poster, premium distressed print design, high visual impact, cinematic and artisanal.
items.promptZh: 戏剧性的垂直海报风格混合媒体肖像，具有坚韧的城市编辑美学，设计得像音乐会或个人品牌海报。中间是一名腰部以上的中年男子，身穿黑色T恤，略微转身站立，一只手臂向上举起，食指指向画面顶部。他的脸被一个矩形模糊块故意遮挡。使用深黑色和棕褐色调色板，搭配仿旧奶油色和金色点缀、浓重的垃圾纹理、墨水飞溅、划伤的覆盖层、撕碎的纸笔刷痕、灰尘和风化的印刷效果。在他的头部和上半身后面放置一个大的柔和的金色圆形光环。在背景中，创建科尔多瓦城市地标的拼贴画：右侧是大教堂立面，左侧是一条带有桥梁的河流和低矮的天际线，所有这些都融入了带纹理的海报构图中。在顶部添加超大粗体压缩衬线字体，阅读{argument name =“headline text”default =“EDU PEREYRA”}，其中“EDU”为大仿旧灰白色字母，下方为金色“PEREYRA”。以大写手写或压缩样式在构图周围添加 5 个较小的文本组：左上角“MÚSICA PASIÓN VERDAD”、右上角“DESDE ADENTRO HACIA AFUERA”、中右“LO QUE SE SIENTE NO NECESITA EXPLICARSE”、中左“AGRADECER SEGUIR CREAR”和底部中心“TIERRA DE HISTORIA, CORAZÓN DE”根特。”在较低的前景中，添加一个巨大的富有表现力的毛笔字{argument name="city name" default="cordoba"}，灰白色，略带对角线，带有金色下划线旋风。包括 3 个小的象征性图形装饰：右上角附近的小皇冠图标、底部中心附近的小星爆装饰以及右下角的手写签名标记。衬衫应包含复古印花字母和徽章图案。灯光喜怒无常，对比强烈，主体在分层拼贴画的映衬下被清晰地剪裁。整体感觉：原始、热情、音乐、精神、当地自豪感海报、优质仿旧印刷设计、高视觉冲击力、电影感和手工感。

items.title: Golden Wuxia Palace Poster
items.titleZh: A dramatic vintage Chinese martial-arts movie poster in a luxurious dark-gold and amber palette, styled like a classic historical epic. Center the composition on a young imperial man seated in front, wearing an ornate black-and-gold dragon robe and a Qing dynasty red-tasseled official hat, posed with one hand near his mouth in a sly, playful, confident manner. Surround him with exactly 8 beautiful court women in layered silk hanfu and gauzy robes, arranged tightly around him in a glamorous harem-like group portrait, with 4 women in the upper row and 4 women in the lower row. Each woman has an elegant updo with elaborate gold hairpins, floral ornaments, dangling earrings, and soft warm makeup; their expressions are alluring, gentle, or curious. Render the women in champagne, blush, peach, rose, and pale jade fabrics with translucent sleeves, embroidered bodices, and richly textured jewelry. Behind the group, place a large aged wooden plaque with carved golden Chinese calligraphy reading “鹿鼎记”, with a smaller line above it reading “金庸武侠经典”. Add vertical cast-name text in Chinese placed beside different figures: on the far left “苏荃”, below left “陈圆圆”, upper middle-left “阿珂”, upper middle-right “建宁公主”, far right upper “沐剑屏”, right middle “方怡”, lower right-middle “双儿”, and far lower right “曾柔”. Also add a vertical poetic slogan along the upper left margin in Chinese: “小人物，大智慧，游走江湖庙堂，玩转天下，抱得美人归”. At the bottom, blend in a secondary cinematic scene: an ancient palace gate and courtyard with soldiers and banners forming a grand processional crowd, with one lone figure centered in the foreground walking toward the viewer. Finish with a narrow line of Chinese tagline text across the bottom edge: “一部颠覆传统的英雄传奇 一段令人捧腹的江湖神话”. The whole image should feel opulent, theatrical, romantic, and slightly mischievous, with smoky sepia shadows, glowing rim light, rich texture, symmetrical poster composition, and polished high-end period-drama key art.

items.title: Cross-Strait Dialogue Editorial Illustration
items.titleZh: A minimalist editorial illustration about cross-strait relations and dialogue, in a muted flat-paper collage style with soft grain texture and rounded shapes. Show 2 human figures seated across a table in profile, facing each other: on the left a man in dark desaturated blue, resting his chin on one hand in a thoughtful pose; on the right a woman in warm brown, gesturing with one hand as if explaining. Both faces are intentionally anonymized with soft blurred rectangular blocks over the facial area. Centered between them is a dark blue balance scale, upright and symmetrical, symbolizing justice, negotiation, and equilibrium. Above the figures are 2 overlapping speech bubbles, one blue-gray on the left and one pale beige on the right, indicating conversation and contested viewpoints. At the bottom center, place 1 white silhouette of a human head in side profile containing a simple growing plant with stem and leaves, symbolizing peace, understanding, or constructive thinking. Use a cream background with 4 large translucent abstract circular forms around the composition, including a pale gray shape on the far left, a beige shape behind the upper center-right, a warm tan shape on the far right, and a darker blue-gray semicircular shape along the bottom foreground. Keep the composition balanced, calm, symbolic, and poster-like, with no text, no sharp outlines, no photorealism, and a subdued palette of dusty blue, slate, beige, cream, and brown.
items.promptZh: 关于两岸关系和对话的极简社论插图，采用柔和的平纸拼贴风格，具有柔软的纹理和圆形形状。展示两个人物侧面坐在桌子对面，彼此相对：左边是一个穿着深蓝色衣服的男人，一只手托着下巴，摆出若有所思的姿势；右边是一个穿着深蓝色衣服的男人，一只手托着下巴，摆出若有所思的姿势；右边是一个男人，一只手托着下巴，摆出若有所思的姿势。右边是一位穿着暖棕色衣服的女人，用一只手做着手势，好像在解释。两张脸都被有意地匿名化，在面部区域上使用了柔和模糊的矩形块。它们中间是一个深蓝色的天平秤，直立对称，象征着正义、谈判和平衡。人物上方有 2 个重叠的对话气泡，左侧一个蓝灰色，右侧一个浅米色，表示对话和有争议的观点。在底部中心，放置 1 个白色人头侧面轮廓，其中包含一棵简单的生长植物，有茎和叶，象征和平、理解或建设性思维。使用奶油色背景，在构图周围有 4 个大的半透明抽象圆形形状，包括最左侧的浅灰色形状、右上角中上方后面的米色形状、最右侧的暖棕褐色形状以及底部前景的深蓝灰色半圆形形状。保持构图平衡、平静、象征性和海报式，没有文字，没有尖锐的轮廓，没有照片写实主义，采用柔和的灰蓝色、石板色、米色、奶油色和棕色。

items.titleZh: A dreamy pastel pink Japanese mobile game advertisement poster in a vertical smartphone format, kawaii fantasy style, ultra-cute and glossy. The main subject is a fluffy white baby kitten with huge sparkling violet-blue eyes, soft blush on its cheeks, tiny pink nose, and a mischievous smile, lying on a pink cushion or blanket in the foreground while holding a baby bottle in its paws. The kitten is extremely fluffy and round, with soft glowing fur and a plush-toy feel, lit with warm magical highlights. The entire scene is filled with pink hearts, sparkles, lace details, soft bokeh, and candy-colored decorations, creating a soothing but playful atmosphere. In the background is a pastel pink bedroom or nursery interior with shelves holding exactly 3 stuffed animals: a pink rabbit, a mint-blue cat, and a lavender bear. Add translucent floating soap-bubble circles with white bone-shaped icons inside, small decorative charms, ribbons, and floral ornaments. On the left side, large bold vertical Japanese headline text in glossy bubble lettering reads 「脱出できない」 with smaller vertical text beside it reading 「かわいくて、」, all in bright pink with white glow and thick outline. Near the top inside a white lace-edged circular badge, include Japanese text reading 「もふもふ にゃんこと おへやから脱出？」 with a pink paw print icon beneath it. At the bottom, place a decorative game logo with large rounded Japanese text reading 「もふふミルクと にゃんこ」 and a ribbon banner below reading 「脱出ゲーム」, using pastel teal, cream, and pink colors with a shiny outlined style. Add a small rounded text plaque in the lower left that reads 「癒されるのに、意外とむずかしい…!?」 decorated with tiny flowers and a dangling baby bottle charm. Use a polished promotional key visual look for a cute indie app, highly detailed, soft airbrushed illustration, glossy typography, enchanting, comforting, and irresistibly adorable.

items.title: Japanese Visual Novel Promo Poster
items.titleZh:
Create a Japanese bishoujo game promotional poster in the style of a premium visual novel box cover and store page composite. The image is split into three vertical areas. The left two-thirds is a dramatic illustrated key visual at sunset: a dreamy spring sky filled with pink and violet clouds, glowing rim light, drifting petals, and a reflective wet road or riverside path. Show 4 anime girls in school uniforms, all with soft emotional expressions and highly detailed hair moving in the wind. The largest girl is centered upper-left, shown from the chest up in profile or three-quarter view, with long dark hair and a small flower hair ornament, looking wistful. A second girl stands at lower-left with very light silver hair and a ribbon accessory, turned slightly away. A third girl is at lower center, smaller, with mauve or reddish-brown hair and a bowed, melancholy pose. A fourth girl is at mid-right, blonde or light brown-haired, facing upward with a hopeful expression. At the very bottom center of the key art, show 2 tiny full-body silhouettes of a boy and girl holding hands in the glowing distance, reflected in the wet ground. Add a white feather near the upper-left and scattered cherry blossom petals throughout. Overlay elegant Japanese title typography in large white brush-like serif lettering near the bottom-left to center: 「{argument name="title text" default="さよならの向こう側で"}」, with a smaller subtitle line beneath it. Along the far left edge, place 3 vertical lines of small Japanese catchphrase text in white. In the bottom-left corner, add 2 stacked black product labels with white text like a PC game package badge, one reading Windows compatible and one reading all ages.

The center is a narrow dark indigo vertical band separating the art from the info panel. On this band, place the game title again vertically in large white Japanese characters, with a smaller vertical tagline beneath it. Keep this band clean and elegant, like the spine of a game box.

The right third is a soft cream-colored information panel with a gentle paper texture. At top-left of this panel, add a bold Japanese heading in brackets: 「【あらすじ】」 followed by several lines of Japanese synopsis text laid out like a visual novel description page. Below that, add a dotted or dashed divider line. Then add a second bracketed heading: 「【特徴】」 with 4 feature bullets, each preceded by a simple icon. The 4 features are: branching choices, full voice support, tearjerking emotional story, and many beautiful CGs. Use small dark blue-gray icons and text. Add another divider line, then a third bracketed heading: 「【プレイヤーへ】」 followed by 2 short lines of Japanese message text.

On the far right side of the cream panel, stack 4 rounded-rectangle screenshot thumbnails vertically, each with thin white borders. Thumbnail 1: the dark-haired heroine by a seaside railing at sunset. Thumbnail 2: a pale-haired heroine with windblown hair against a bright blue ocean. Thumbnail 3: a girl indoors by a sunlit classroom or café window, warm and contemplative. Thumbnail 4: a girl surrounded by cherry blossoms in soft pink light. At the bottom of the cream panel, place a wide rounded lavender feature bar containing 4 large icons with short Japanese labels beneath or beside them: an open book, a microphone, an image/photo symbol, and a branching path/share-like icon. The overall mood should be nostalgic, romantic, cinematic, and emotionally overwhelming, like a high-budget Japanese gal game advertisement from the 2000s to 2010s. Use polished anime illustration, luminous backlighting, rich pastel sunset colors, glossy reflections, detailed typography, and authentic visual novel promo design.

so here’s to thoughts, both big and small, to hopes, to fears, to me. i’ll keep on writing through it all, and set my spirit free."} The handwriting should look natural, slightly uneven, and convincingly human, with blue ballpoint pen texture. items.title: Moonlit Woman and Tiger Reflection
items.titleZh: A surreal yet photorealistic night scene on a vast calm reflective water surface under a deep star-filled sky. A bright full moon hangs on the upper left, with the Milky Way and faint green-blue aurora stretching across the background. In the real world, keep everything simple and realistic: a slim woman with shoulder-length dark hair walks barefoot from left to right across the water, wearing a {argument name="dress color" default="black"} elegant slit evening dress. Her posture is natural and poised, and her face is softly obscured or out of focus. The water surface is smooth and mirrorlike, with subtle ripples and realistic moonlight reflections. Place the symbolic magic mainly in the reflection: beneath her feet, instead of a normal reflection, a luminous ethereal white-blue line-art tiger appears inside the water, curled in motion and glowing like energy or moonlight. The tiger is sniffing or approaching a single glowing rose near the lower right area of the reflection. Around the rose, add exactly 6 small glowing butterfly-like light fragments rising upward in a gentle arc. Use cinematic lighting, high contrast, cool blue tones, dreamy atmosphere, ultra-detailed reflection effects, and a clean fine-art fantasy photography style. Add a delicate cursive caption centered near the bottom edge of the image that reads {argument name="caption text" default="In me the tiger sniff the rose."}. Rounded-corner framed composition, vertical social-media screenshot aesthetic, but the main artwork itself should be the focus.
items.promptZh: 在深邃的星空下，广阔平静的反光水面上呈现出超现实而又逼真的夜景。一轮明亮的满月悬挂在左上角，银河和淡淡的蓝绿色极光在背景上延伸。在现实世界中，一切都简单而现实：一位留着及肩黑发的苗条女士穿着{argument name="dress color" default="black"}优雅的开衩晚礼服，光着脚从左向右走过水面。她的姿势自然而镇定，她的脸被轻轻遮挡或失焦。水面光滑如镜，波纹细腻，月光倒影逼真。将象征性的魔力主要放在倒影中：在她的脚下，不是正常的倒影，而是一只发光的空灵白蓝色线条艺术老虎出现在水中，卷曲着运动，像能量或月光一样发光。老虎正在嗅探或接近倒影右下区域附近的一朵发光的玫瑰。在玫瑰周围，添加 6 个小发光的蝴蝶状光碎片，以柔和的弧线向上升起。采用电影般的灯光、高对比度、冷酷的蓝色调、梦幻的氛围、超细致的反射效果，干净的美术奇幻摄影风格。在图像底部边缘附近添加一个精致的草书标题，内容为 {argument name="caption text" default="In me the Tiger sniff the Rose."}。圆角框架构图，垂直社交媒体截图美学，但主要艺术品本身应该成为焦点。

items.titleZh: A photorealistic ultra-futuristic cityscape in the year {argument name="year" default="100000 AD"}, viewed from a high terrace with glossy reflective flooring and lush vegetation climbing the architecture at the left edge. In the foreground, exactly 3 figures stand with their backs turned, looking out over the city: 1 human in a long elegant cream-colored robe or cloak, 1 sleek silver humanoid android with exposed mechanical details, and 1 mysterious translucent glowing humanoid made of shimmering light, almost like an invisible person outlined by refracted energy. items.title: Hyper-realistic Surreal Poster Design Prompt
items.titleZh:
Genre: {argument name="genre" default="Hamburger"}
Brand Name: {argument name="brand name" default="Kashiko"}

Based on this image, generate a photorealistic poster image with a concept that completely deviates from common sense and does not exist anywhere else in the world.

Don't just make it an extension; leap with the idea to a level where it 'makes sense but the interpretation is insane.'

[Absolute Conditions]
- Photorealistic expression (reproduce textures, atmosphere, and even light particles like a real-life photo)
- All language must be in Japanese

[Exaggerated/Boosted Elements]
■ Font Design
- The characters themselves are objectified or phenomenological
- The font physically interacts with the theme

■ Text Placement
- Ignore normal layouts and place text within the space itself
- Layouts with abnormally strong gaze direction

■ Composition
- Unrealistic perspective, extreme wide angles, distortion, scale destruction
- Clear foreground, middle ground, and background layers with abnormally high information density
- A central element that catches the eye instantly + countless subtle oddities in the details

■ Lighting
- Movie-level cinematic lighting
- Intense backlighting, rim lights, neon, particle light, volume light
- Light itself has meaning (functioning as a guide or emphasis)

■ Catchphrase
- Short, intense Japanese text that makes sense but is hard to fully grasp
- Copy that is slightly off-situation but fits strangely well

[Additional Effects]
- A sense of discomfort where reality and unreality coexist simultaneously
- Parts of the image ignore the laws of physics
- Quality that functions as a professional-level advertisement

Ultimately, make it a poster that is 'understandable yet beyond comprehension' and warrants a second look. If the reference image is a character, apply actions such as wearing, using, or trying to eat the brand. Do not use any real brand logos, company names, or personal names; make it completely original. Verify that no real-world elements are included in the final finish. Suppress noise or balance disruptions caused by excessive detail, maintaining overall visual unity and a sophisticated impression.
items.prompt:
ジャンル：{argument name="ジャンル" default="ハンバーガー"}
ブランド名：{argument name="ブランド名" default="かし子"}

この画像をベースに、世界中のどこにも存在しない、発想が常識を完全に逸脱したフォトリアルなポスター画像を生成してください。

単なる延長ではなく、「意味は通じるが解釈が狂っている」レベルまで発想を飛躍させること。

【絶対条件】
・フォトリアル表現（実写のような質感、空気感、光の粒子まで再現）
・言語はすべて日本語

【誇張・ブーストする要素】
■フォントデザイン
・文字そのものが物体化・現象化している
・フォントがテーマと物理的に相互作用している

■文字の配置
・通常のレイアウトを無視し、空間そのものに配置
・視線誘導が異常に強い配置

■構図
・非現実的なパース、極端な広角、歪み、スケール破壊
・手前・中景・奥のレイヤーが明確で、情報密度が異常に高い
・一瞬で目を引く中心要素＋細部に無数の違和感

■ライティング
・映画レベルのシネマティック照明
・強烈な逆光、リムライト、ネオン、粒子光、ボリュームライト
・光自体が意味を持つ（導線や強調として機能）

■キャッチコピー
・短く、強烈で、意味が分かるのに理解が追いつかない日本語
・状況とズレているのに妙にハマるコピー

【追加演出】
・現実と非現実が同時に成立している違和感
・一部が物理法則を無視している
・広告として成立しているクオリティ（プロレベル）

最終的に「理解できるのに理解が追いつかない」「二度見する」ポスターにすること。
参考画像がキャラクターの場合、そのブランドを身につけている・使用している・食べようとしている、等の動作等を適用する。
実在のブランドロゴ・会社名・人名等は一切使用せず、完全オリジナルにする。最終仕上げ時に実在のものが含まれていないか確認すること。
過度な描き込みによるノイズやバランスの崩れを抑制し、画面全体の統一感と洗練された印象を維持する。

items.titleZh: A stylized faux-pixel-art landscape illustration of a single {argument name="bird species" default="black raven"} standing in profile in a golden wheat field, facing right. The image should look like retro pixel art at first glance when viewed zoomed out, but not be perfectly grid-aligned or true sprite-based pixel art; instead it should feel like painterly image-generation imitating pixel art, with soft inconsistencies in the block shapes and edges. Place the bird large in the foreground, slightly left of center, with glossy near-black feathers shaded in deep navy and indigo, a dark beak, and one small amber-brown eye visible. Surround it with tall yellow-gold grasses and exactly 9 visible small purple wildflower blossoms scattered in the foreground. In the midground, show a broad rural plain with patchy fields and a dark green tree line including a few tall narrow conifers on the right. In the distance, add a low mountain range in muted blue-violet tones. Above, create a bright {argument name="sky color" default="soft blue"} sky filled with large chunky cumulus clouds and a few smaller cloud bands, all rendered in limited-color dithered blocks. Use a warm late-afternoon palette with gold, blue, lavender, and dark charcoal, strong atmospheric depth, and a calm pastoral mood. Full-frame composition, landscape orientation, thin black border around the entire image, crisp blocky edges, retro game background aesthetic, highly detailed but simple, no text, no UI, no extra animals.

items.title: Zoomed Fake Pixel Art Grid Analysis
items.titleZh: A tightly zoomed-in comparison image demonstrating fake pixel-art rendering, showing a low-resolution-looking scene enlarged on screen with a thin bright blue square grid overlay across the entire frame. The composition is an abstract close crop of a pixel-art-style environment: sandy tan and ochre blocky forms on the left and center, a dark navy and black stepped diagonal mass on the right, muted olive-green and slate-blue shapes along the upper background, and a few lighter golden highlights. Every edge looks staircase-like and blocky at first glance, but the colors softly blur and blend within the apparent squares instead of aligning perfectly to the grid, creating the impression of pixel art that breaks down under inspection. Include a small white crosshair cursor near the upper left quadrant to suggest image analysis in an editor. The overall look should feel like a screenshot from a graphics program or social media demonstration about how AI can imitate retro game art aesthetics without producing true grid-perfect pixel art, with no text labels visible.

items.titleZh: A dramatic Japanese boxing match poster in a polished anime illustration style, vertical composition, split straight down the center into warm gold on the left and electric blue on the right. At the very top, huge metallic gold embossed lettering reads {argument name="headline text" default="JUNGLE PREMIUM Vol.7"}, with a bright glow and beveled 3D effect. Directly beneath it, centered white Japanese text reads "世界4団体フェザー級タイトルマッチ". Show 2 male featherweight boxers facing each other in fighting stance inside a boxing ring, both full body, highly muscular, lean, and sharply defined with glossy skin highlights. The left boxer is a blond anime-style young man with short tousled hair, wearing gold boxing gloves, black-and-gold trunks with a white-red accent on one leg, black boxing boots with gold laces, and a thick championship-style waistband patch reading "SEIJI".
