The right boxer is a black-haired anime-style young man with short spiky hair, wearing bright blue boxing gloves, dark navy-blue trunks, blue boxing boots, white socks, and a waistband patch reading "JUNICHI". He stands on the blue side with swirling blue energy, light trails, and glowing particles. Place a circular championship belt emblem in the center background between them, with ring ropes visible behind, and the words "WORLD CHAMPION" legible on the belt medallion. Add 2 large faded portrait overlays in the background, one behind each boxer: the left background portrait tinted gold and the right background portrait tinted blue. Along the far left side, place bold vertical Japanese calligraphy reading "黄金の閃光" in glowing white-gold. Along the far right side, place bold vertical Japanese calligraphy reading "蒼き鉄拳" in glowing white-blue. At the bottom, feature 2 very large Japanese name blocks: left in gold reading "松浦聖司", right in icy blue-white reading "藤原潤一", with a blazing gold "VS" between them. Beneath that, centered large white date text reads {argument name="event date" default="7月19日(日)"}. At the very bottom, centered gold serif text reads {argument name="venue name" default="SUN BIRTH STADIUM"}. The top half is labeled {argument name="top label" default="GPT-image-2"} in large bold white sans-serif text centered near the top, and the bottom half is labeled {argument name="bottom label" default="Nano Banana 2"} in the same style. Create a gritty, nostalgic, cinematic scene in a long, narrow shared hallway of a worn residential building from the late 20th century, with peeling paint, stained walls, faded propaganda posters and old newspapers on the walls, dark wooden doorways, hanging towels and laundry, a damp concrete floor, and daylight coming from a window at the far end. In the upper scene, show exactly 4 people: 1 adult standing at the left cooking over a small stove on a wooden table with visible steam, 1 adult man sitting deeper in the corridor beside an electric fan, 1 child crouching in the center playing near a basin on the wet floor, and 1 adult woman seated at a small table on the right writing or reading; include enamel mugs, metal pots, stools, buckets, thermos containers, and cluttered household items. items.title: Vintage Japanese Crime Film Poster
items.titleZh: A vintage late-1970s Japanese crime film poster in the style of a Nikkatsu theatrical one-sheet, vertically composed on aged beige paper with visible grain, faint stains, and slightly faded ink. The main image is a large, moody half-body portrait of {argument name="lead actor name" default="原田芳雄"} occupying the upper right and center, turned partly away from camera, with thick curly dark hair, a serious expression, and a wrinkled light gray suit jacket over an open-collar white shirt; his face is mostly in shadow. Behind him is a bleak industrial waterfront with cranes, low factory structures, and heavy gray smoke rising into a washed-out sky. Across the lower middle, place a huge hand-brushed red Japanese title reading {argument name="title text" default="影の街"}, painted diagonally and aggressively, partially overlapping the portrait and the lower scene. In the lower half, add a second scene: a rainy urban street at dusk or night with wet reflective pavement, a dark police car at left with a glowing red roof light, and 6 men in suits and trench coats walking forward, with 1 central detective figure in a beige trench coat and loosened tie leading the group. On the far right, include a vertical strip of 5 stacked inset cast portraits framed in thin borders, each a dark cinematic still with different characters. Add vertical Japanese typography: on the upper right, the actor credit “原田芳雄 主演”; on the upper left, a 2-line tagline column reading “その男、刑事。 正義より、真実を追う。”; and near the lower right of the main image, another vertical blurb reading “誰が敵で、誰が味方か。闇に消えた事件の中で、ただひとつの真実を掴むまで—”. At the bottom, include dense small Japanese credits spanning the width, plus a large release date on the lower right reading {argument name="release date" default="11.23"} with “日活ロードショー” beneath it and a small studio mark. Use muted charcoal, sepia, smoky blue-gray, and off-white tones, with the red title as the only vivid color. The overall feeling is hard-boiled, melancholic, gritty, and cinematic, like a lost 1970s Japanese detective movie poster.

Ultra-sharp focus, premium food advertisement style, hyper realistic, 8K.

items.titleZh: A warm, highly detailed anime-style illustration set in a cozy, cluttered indie workspace that feels like a book café mixed with a startup studio, lit by golden afternoon sunlight streaming through tall windows on the right and by 4 black industrial pendant lamps hanging from the ceiling, with string lights, overflowing bookshelves, plants, and handwritten motivational signs covering the background. Show 5 young women standing around a large wooden worktable, framed as a wide group portrait. The mood is whimsical, slightly satirical, and aspirational-but-chaotic. On the far left, place a tall woman with very long wavy {argument name="hair color" default="auburn"} hair wearing a crown of white daisies and a sleeveless rust-brown dress with a white sunburst emblem on the chest and a dark belt at the waist; she holds a small handwritten note toward the viewer that reads exactly {argument name="note text" default="Claude is asking for your permission"}. In front of her on a side table is a glass cup of tea, a book stack, and a tiny potted plant. Next to her, place a punky blonde woman with twin ponytails tied with black bows, large black headphones resting around her neck, and an off-shoulder black dress marked with a bold white X on the torso; she stands confidently beside an open sticker-covered laptop with another large X logo. In the center rear, place a mysterious slim girl with extremely long dark navy-black hair, pale skin, and a gothic dark dress, standing quietly in front of a desktop monitor showing a blue glowing star or sparkle on a dark screen. To the right of center, place an elegant woman in a fitted red cheongsam-inspired dress with floral embroidery and a side slit, leaning one hand on the wooden table near an open notebook filled with sketches or writing. On the far right, place a casually dressed brunette with messy hair in a bun, wearing a white T-shirt with a black knot-like AI logo under an open beige overshirt, standing behind an open silver laptop with the same logo. Scatter many cozy desk objects across the main table: 2 mugs, 1 open notebook, 1 pen, 1 small black figurine, 1 closed book stack, and laptops. Add readable handwritten wall notes and signs throughout the room: “FOCUS SHIPS DREAMS” on the upper left, “SHIPPING IS MY CARDIO” on the left wall, “turn caffeine into code” near the top center, “be kind to your future self” near the window, “The Art of Asking Nicely” on a book spine at lower left, “WORLD’S OKAYEST MODEL” on a black mug near center-left, “MOONSHOT DIARIES” on a book stack near lower right, “Good Prompts Only” on a mug at lower right, and a sticky note at the bottom right reading “AGI is already for ready us” with a small doodle. Use painterly linework, intricate textures, expressive fashion styling, warm brown and amber color grading, soft cinematic depth, and a polished social-media-viral illustration aesthetic.
items.promptZh: 温暖、高度详细的动漫风格插图，背景是一个舒适、杂乱的独立工作空间，感觉就像一家书吧咖啡馆和一家初创工作室混合在一起，金色的午后阳光透过右侧高大的窗户照射进来，天花板上悬挂着 4 盏黑色工业吊灯，灯串、满溢的书架、植物和覆盖背景的手写励志标语。展示 5 名年轻女性站在一个大型木制工作台周围，框架为一幅宽幅集体肖像。气氛异想天开，略带讽刺，充满抱负但混乱。最左边是一位高个子的女人，留着很长的波浪发，头戴白色雏菊王冠，穿着无袖铁锈棕色连衣裙，胸前有白色太阳纹徽章，腰间系着深色腰带；她向观看者拿着一张手写的小便条，上面写着{argument name="note text" default="Claude is requests your permission"}。她面前的边桌上放着一杯茶、一叠书和一盆小盆栽。在她旁边，放着一位朋克金发女郎，扎着双马尾辫，系着黑色蝴蝶结，脖子上挂着大号黑色耳机，身穿露肩黑色连衣裙，躯干上标有醒目的白色“X”；她自信地站在一台打开的笔记本电脑旁边，笔记本电脑上贴着贴纸，上面还有一个大 X 标志。在中央后方，一个神秘的苗条女孩，有着极长的深藏青色头发，苍白的皮肤，穿着哥特式的深色连衣裙，安静地站在桌面显示器前，在黑暗的屏幕上显示出蓝色发光的星星或闪闪发光。在中间的右侧，一位优雅的女士穿着一件合身的红色旗袍风格连衣裙，带有花卉刺绣和侧开衩，一只手靠在木桌上，靠近一本打开的笔记本，笔记本上写满了草图或文字。最右边是一位穿着休闲、头发凌乱的黑发女郎，头发凌乱，扎着发髻，穿着一件带有黑色结状 AI 标志的白色 T 恤，里面穿着一件开放的米色外套，站在一台带有相同标志的开放式银色笔记本电脑后面。主桌上散布着许多舒适的办公桌物品：2 个杯子、1 个打开的笔记本、1 支钢笔、1 个黑色小雕像、1 个闭合的书架和笔记本电脑。在整个房间里添加可读的手写墙注和标志：左上角的“FOCUS SHIPS DREAMS”，左墙上的“SHIPPING IS MY CARDIO”，靠近顶部中心的“将咖啡因变成代码”，靠近窗户的“善待未来的自己”，左下角书脊上的“The Art of Asking Nicely”，靠近中左的黑色杯子上的“WORLD’S OKAYEST MODEL”，“MOONSHOT”右下角附近的书架上写着“日记”，右下角的杯子上写着“只有好提示”，右下角有一张便利贴，上面写着“AGI 已经为我们做好了准备”，上面有一个小涂鸦。使用绘画般的线条、错综复杂的纹理、富有表现力的时尚造型、温暖的棕色和琥珀色分级、柔和的电影深度以及精致的社交媒体病毒插图美学。

items.titleZh: A high-impact anime promotional interview poster designed as a glossy two-page magazine spread for a futuristic live music event. The scene shows a packed nighttime concert arena filled with a crowd holding glowing light sticks in neon yellow, blue, and purple, with a huge illuminated stage in the background, laser beams, bokeh lights, haze, and a giant triangular play-icon screen reading "AI SUPERLIVE SUMMER 2026". In the center foreground are 2 anime-style female presenters seen from a dramatic side and back angle, both looking toward the stage. The left character is {argument name="left character name" default="ソラ"}, wearing a dark oversized hooded jacket with black and acid-lime accents, large lime-green headphones marked "06", and raising a bright yellow glow stick overhead; her face is partially obscured by a rectangular privacy block. The right character is {argument name="right character name" default="ナギ"}, with a short silver-white bob haircut and fair skin, wearing a pale oversized hooded coat, softly lit by stage lights, holding a white-blue glowing baton near her chest, with an emotional profile expression as she watches the show. Use cinematic rim lighting, richly saturated purple-blue concert colors, reflective fabric highlights, and detailed anime rendering with a polished editorial-advertising finish. Compose the layout like a Japanese special interview feature with dense text overlays, translucent dark panels, thin neon-yellow borders, and bold sans-serif typography. Include 8 distinct text blocks: 1 small header tag at top left reading "/ SPECIAL INTERVIEW /"; 1 large Japanese headline at upper left reading "この夏、AIと音楽の未来がステージで輝く！"; 1 event logo block at upper right reading "AI SUPERLIVE SUMMER 2026" and "2026.7.18 SAT @ FUTURE ARENA ODAIBA"; 3 question-and-answer panels stacked on the left with yellow-framed headers beginning with "Q."; 3 question-and-answer panels stacked on the right with yellow-framed headers beginning with "Q."; plus 2 character intro name boxes near the figures labeled "ソラ" and "ナギ". Add a bold closing Japanese tagline across the bottom left and center reading "AIと音楽が響き合う、新しい夏がはじまる。 一緒に、未来を体験しよう！". At the bottom right, include a footer block repeating the event name and date, plus a visible QR code and a small caption indicating the official website. The overall style should feel like a premium Japanese event flyer, interview article, and key visual combined, energetic, futuristic, emotional, and festival-like.

items.titleZh: A bold vintage propaganda-style poster with a limited red, black, and cream palette, printed on slightly textured aged paper. The composition shows 2 women in a dramatic action scene across the center: on the left, a woman with long wavy red hair in a white martial arts gi performs a very high side kick; on the right, a curvy woman in a black cowboy hat and a black lace bodysuit recoils and raises her arms defensively as the kick strikes her face. Use heavy black shadows, sharp angular shapes, screenprint-like ink coverage, and a graphic mid-century pulp poster aesthetic. Behind them, place a large diagonal red geometric banner spanning from upper left to lower right, plus 2 black speed lines on the left and 3 white speed lines on the right to emphasize motion. In the upper right corner, include a circular emblem with a stylized black-and-white screaming monkey or ape face inside a red disk. At the bottom, add oversized condensed block typography in an aggressive poster layout: the first line reads {argument name="headline text" default="SCOTTISH RECIPE:"} in red and black, and the second line reads {argument name="main title" default="MINCE AND TATTIES"} in very large red, white, and black letters over a black diagonal banner. items.titleZh: Japanese realistic romance movie poster style, inspired by 'We Made a Beautiful Bouquet', a pair of young Japanese couple in their twenties standing in a daily urban scene (street or intersection), maintaining a subtle and realistic distance from each other, no physical contact, like a moment of gradual estrangement in a relationship. The mood is quiet and restrained, with unuttered emotions and a sense of time passing. The composition is the main visual of a movie, characters located at the bottom or to one side, retaining a large area of white space to emphasize space and atmosphere. Light is natural (overcast or dusk), low-saturation gray-blue, beige, and warm gray tones, realistic photography texture. The image has fine film grain and a slight sense of daily life, not intentionally aesthetic, not over-decorated, like a frame from a real movie. A small amount of natural floral materials can be added at the edges or foreground as a metaphor (restrained, not excessive, not decorative). Add the title '花束みたいな恋をした' in the white space area, thin Mincho font, simple and sparse layout; add 'We Made a Beautiful Bouquet' in a smaller font size below. Overall requirements: Real Japanese movie poster texture, artistic, restrained, everyday life, emphasizing relationships over romantic symbols, avoiding sugary romance, avoiding flower piles, avoiding internet celebrity aesthetics, avoiding crowded compositions, avoiding the 'exquisite but hollow' AI feel. Negative prompt: AI feel, over-aesthetic, sea of flowers, romantic filters, excessive lighting effects, high saturation, neon lights, intimate couple embrace, posed feel, photobooth composition, internet celebrity style, illustration feel, 3D rendering, cluttered elements. Japanese minimalist artistic movie poster style, inspired by 'Love Letter', winter snow scene, a close-up of a young woman's face, face close to or semi-buried in the snow, tiny snowflakes falling naturally. The composition is a restrained close-up side profile or slightly tilted face, with the person occupying a large proportion of the screen but not overly sharp, edges slightly softened or slightly out of focus. Expression is calmness after sadness, with tears or tear marks in the eyes, emotions introverted and restrained, like having just cried and slowly returning to silence, eyes not looking at the camera, with a sense of memory and void. Light is winter natural scattered light or overcast soft light, cool white, light gray, pale blue tones, low saturation, low contrast, no strong shadows, no dramatic lighting effects. The snow and air form a clean background. The image texture is between real photography and film, with fine grain, slight mist, slightly white or slightly overexposed, like an old photo faded by time or a movie still. Skin not overly detailed, no skin smoothing, no sharpening, no retouching. Asymmetric composition, face can be partially cropped, minimalist background, retaining appropriate white space. Add the minimalist title 'Love Letter' or 'ラヴレター' in the white space area, thin Mincho or thin serif font, wide character spacing, sparse layout, color light gray; add 'Love Letter' in a tiny font size below. Overall requirements: Real Japanese artistic movie poster texture, quiet, subtle, restrained, like a memory covered by snow, avoiding photo studio feel, avoiding internet celebrity aesthetics, avoiding refined filters, avoiding lighting effects, avoiding high contrast and high saturation, avoiding sharp digital feel, avoiding theatrical emotions, avoiding 'pretty but hollow'. Negative prompt: AI feel, skin smoothing, sharpening, HDR, high contrast, high saturation, dreamy light effects, lens flare, filter feel, photo studio style, internet celebrity face, posing, looking directly at the camera, exaggerated emotions, 3D rendering, illustration style, complex background.
items.prompt: 日系现实主义爱情电影海报风格，灵感来自《花束般的恋爱》，一对二十岁左右的日本年轻情侣站在城市日常场景中（街头或路口），彼此之间保持微妙而真实的距离，没有肢体接触，像关系逐渐疏远的瞬间。情绪安静克制，带未说出口的情感与时间流逝感。构图为电影主视觉，人物位于画面下方或一侧，画面保留大面积留白，强调空间与空气感。光线为自然光（阴天或黄昏），低饱和灰蓝、米色与暖灰色调，真实摄影质感。画面带细腻胶片颗粒与轻微生活感，不刻意唯美，不过度修饰，像真实电影中的一帧。可在画面边缘或前景加入少量自然花材作为隐喻（克制、不过度、不装饰化）。在留白区域加入标题「花束みたいな恋をした」，细明朝体，排版简洁疏朗；下方小字号加入《花束般的恋爱》。整体要求：真实日本电影海报质感，文艺、克制、生活化，强调关系而不是浪漫符号，避免甜腻爱情表现，避免花朵堆砌，避免网红唯美，避免构图拥挤，避免“精致但空洞”的AI感。AI感，过度唯美，花海，浪漫滤镜，光效泛滥，高饱和，霓虹灯，情侣亲密拥抱，摆拍感，大头贴构图，网红风，插画感，3D渲染，元素堆砌。日系极简文艺电影海报风格，灵感来自《情书》，冬季雪地场景，一位年轻女子的脸部特写，面部贴近雪地或半埋在雪中，细小雪花自然落下。构图为克制的近距离侧脸或微偏角度面部，人物占画面较大比例但不过度清晰锐利，边缘轻微柔化或轻微失焦。表情为伤心之后的平静，眼中带泪或泪痕，情绪内敛、克制、像刚刚哭过又慢慢恢复安静，眼神不看镜头，带回忆与空白感。光线为冬日自然散射光或阴天柔光，冷白、浅灰、淡蓝色调，低饱和、低对比，无强阴影、无戏剧光效。雪地与空气形成干净背景。画面质感为真实摄影与胶片之间，带轻微颗粒、轻微雾感、略微泛白或轻微过曝，像一张被时间冲淡的旧照片或电影静帧。皮肤不过度细节，不磨皮、不锐化、不精修。构图不对称，可局部裁切面部，背景极简，保留适当留白。在留白区域加入极简标题「Love Letter」或「ラヴレター」，细明朝体或细衬线字体，字距拉开、排版疏朗，颜色为浅灰；下方极小字号加入《情书》。整体要求：真实日本文艺电影海报质感，安静、含蓄、克制，像一段被雪覆盖的记忆，避免写真感、避免网红审美、避免精致滤镜、避免光效、避免高对比高饱和、避免锐利数码感、避免情绪表演化、避免“好看但空洞”。AI感，磨皮，锐化，HDR，高对比，高饱和，梦幻光效，光斑，滤镜感，写真风，网红脸，摆拍，直视镜头，情绪夸张，3D渲染，插画风，复杂背景。

items.title: Anime VTuber Minecraft Stream Thumbnail
items.titleZh: A vibrant anime-style YouTube thumbnail for a livestream gaming broadcast, in a wide 16:9 composition, with a neon purple and pink streamer room. Center the scene on a cute catgirl VTuber sitting at a desk, shown from the waist up, leaning forward energetically with one hand on a computer mouse and the other hand reaching toward the viewer. She has {argument name="hair color" default="light orange-blonde"} bob-cut hair with soft bangs, fluffy brown-and-cream cat ears, and a visible cat tail. Her face is intentionally obscured by a solid rectangular censor block in the center. She wears a black-and-white maid-inspired outfit with a frilly white blouse, black dress bodice, puff sleeves, white ruffles, black ribbon bow, and a gold bell choker. Place a mechanical keyboard with bright RGB lighting on the desk, a glowing gaming mouse, and a streamer microphone on the far left with pink-purple LED lighting. Put 2 cat-themed desk items in the foreground: a plush cat face on the bottom left and a black cat-shaped mug on the bottom right. Behind her is a gaming chair with paw-print details. On the left side, add large bold Korean headline text in thick white block letters with black fill shadows and a glowing purple outline, stacked in 2 lines: {argument name="headline text" default="방송중 대참사"}. Below it, add a smaller yellow comic-style burst caption with black outline reading {argument name="sub text" default="> 크리퍼 실화냐"}. On the right side, show 1 large computer monitor angled inward, displaying a Minecraft-like scene with bright blue sky, green trees, water, and a large green Creeper popping out toward the viewer, outlined dramatically like a sticker cutout. Add starburst effects and neon accents around the monitor to heighten the chaos. Use exaggerated thumbnail aesthetics: ultra-saturated colors, sharp cel shading, thick outlines, glossy highlights, high contrast, dynamic perspective, and a clickworthy streamer-disaster mood.
items.promptZh: 用于游戏直播的充满活力的动漫风格 YouTube 缩略图，采用 16:9 宽幅构图，带有霓虹紫色和粉色流光室。场景以可爱的猫女 VTuber 为中心，她坐在办公桌前，腰部以上，身体前倾，一只手放在电脑鼠标上，另一只手伸向观众。她有一头{argument name="hair color" default="light Orange-blonde"}短发，有着柔软的刘海、蓬松的棕色和奶油色猫耳朵，还有一条明显的猫尾巴。她的脸被中央的实心矩形检查块故意遮挡。她穿着黑白女仆风格的服装，包括褶边白色衬衫、黑色连衣裙紧身胸衣、泡泡袖、白色荷叶边、黑色丝带蝴蝶结和金色铃铛项圈。在桌子上放置一个带有明亮 RGB 灯光的机械键盘，一个发光的游戏鼠标，以及最左侧带有粉紫色 LED 灯光的流媒体麦克风。在前景中放置 2 个以猫为主题的桌面物品：左下角的毛绒猫脸和右下角的黑色猫形马克杯。她身后是一把带有爪子图案细节的游戏椅。在左侧，添加大的粗体韩文标题文本，采用粗白色大写字母，带有黑色填充阴影和发光的紫色轮廓，堆叠在 2 行中：{argument name="headline text" default="방송중 대참사"}。在其下方添加一个较小的黄色漫画风格连拍标题，其黑色轮廓为 {argument name="sub text" default="> 크리퍼 실화냐"}。在右侧，展示了一台向内倾斜的大型计算机显示器，显示了类似 Minecraft 的场景，其中有明亮的蓝天、绿树、水和一个巨大的绿色爬行动物向观看者弹出，其轮廓戏剧性地像贴纸剪纸一样。在显示器周围添加星爆效果和霓虹灯效果，以加剧混乱。使用夸张的缩略图美感：超饱和的颜色、锐利的卡通阴影、粗轮廓、光泽高光、高对比度、动态透视以及值得点击的流光灾难情绪。

items.title: Futuristic Cyber Skincare Product Ad
items.titleZh: A futuristic luxury skincare product advertisement in a cool icy blue palette, shot as a high-end studio beauty campaign. Center a frosted white pump bottle labeled {argument name="brand name" default="SECURE-IP"} with minimalist navy text reading {argument name="product name" default="IP ADDRESS CLEANSER"}, plus smaller lines "for risk-free connections", "pour des connexions sans risque", and "75 ml / 2.5 fl. oz. - Data Stream Purifier" near the bottom. Place the bottle upright on a glossy wet reflective surface covered with realistic water droplets, with the translucent round cap lying off to the right behind the bottle. Surround the product with floating sharp-edged transparent glass shards and crystal fragments, suspended in midair like shattered ice. Several larger shards act as labeled callout panels: exactly 6 text shards reading "TEXTURE" on the left over a close-up of dewy skin, "SHIELD" in the upper right, "HYDRATION" on the right over a close-up of a blue eye and wet skin, "SECURITY SHIELD" in the lower left over a subtle hexagonal honeycomb pattern, "PROTECT" at bottom left, and "CLEANSE" at lower right. Integrate beauty-image fragments inside some of the shards: one shard shows cheek and lips with luminous skin texture, one shows a female eye with long lashes and water droplets on the skin, and one shows a scientific honeycomb barrier pattern. Add a tall soft rectangular frosted panel hovering behind the pump head in the upper center to create layered depth. Include two iridescent glass spheres on the wet surface, one at the lower left corner and one at the lower right corner. Use bright sparkling highlights, prismatic rainbow refractions, glowing rim light, floating mist, micro-particles, and a crisp 4K cosmetic advertising finish. The composition should feel premium, clean, protective, and cyber-skincare themed, blending hydration science with digital security metaphors.
items.promptZh: 未来派奢华护肤品广告，采用凉爽的冰蓝色调，以高端工作室美容广告形式拍摄。将一个磨砂白色泵瓶居中，标签为{argument name="brand name" default="SECURE-IP"}，上面写着极简海军蓝文字：{argument name="product name" default="IP ADDRESS CLEANSER"}，底部附近还加上较小的线条“无风险连接”、“pour des connexions sans risque”和“75 ml / 2.5 fl. oz. - Data Stream Purifier”。将瓶子直立放置在光滑的湿反射表面上，表面覆盖有逼真的水滴，半透明的圆盖位于瓶子后面的右侧。产品周围漂浮着锋利的透明玻璃碎片和水晶碎片，像碎冰一样悬浮在半空中。几个较大的碎片充当带标签的标注面板：正好有 6 个文本碎片，左侧为露水皮肤的特写，上面写着“纹理”，右上角为“护盾”，右侧为蓝眼睛和湿润皮肤的特写，右侧为“安全护盾”，左下角为微妙的六边形蜂窝图案，左下角为“保护”，右下为“清洁”。在一些碎片中融入了美图片段：一个碎片显示了带有发光皮肤纹理的脸颊和嘴唇，一个碎片显示了长睫毛和皮肤上水滴的女性眼睛，一个碎片显示了科学的蜂窝屏障图案。添加一个高大的柔软矩形磨砂面板，悬停在泵头后面的上部中心，以创建分层深度。在湿表面上放置两个虹彩玻璃球，一个位于左下角，一个位于右下角。使用明亮的闪闪发光的高光、棱镜彩虹折射、发光的边缘光、漂浮的薄雾、微粒和清晰的 4K 化妆品广告效果。该成分应该给人一种优质、干净、保护性和网络护肤主题的感觉，将水合科学与数字安全隐喻融为一体。

items.title: Futuristic Cyber Skincare Ad Poster
items.titleZh: A luxury futuristic skincare advertisement in a vertical 4K poster format, centered on a sleek matte-white spray bottle floating diagonally in the middle of the frame, slightly tilted to the right, with a soft cylindrical cap and fine condensation droplets across the upper body. The bottle label reads "{argument name="brand name" default="SECURE-IP"}" in clean navy sans-serif text, and below it: "{argument name="product name" default="IP ADDRESS CLEANSER"}" with smaller subtext "for risk-free connections" and "pour des connexions sans risque," plus tiny footer text "75 mL / 2.5 fl. oz. - Data Stream Purifier." Behind the bottle, enormous translucent serif typography fills most of the background, reading "{argument name="headline text" default="ULTRA-SECURE"}", split across two lines and partially obscured by the product. The environment is deep midnight blue with glowing translucent fabric-like liquid ribbons curling around the bottle from top left to bottom right and from the lower foreground upward, mixed with 2 prominent glassy tubular arcs and multiple floating crystal-like droplets or bubbles. Lighting is cold, cinematic, glossy, and high-end, with luminous icy blue highlights, soft bloom, refractive reflections, and a pristine premium beauty-campaign look. At the bottom center, elegant spaced-out small caps text reads "{argument name="tagline" default="ENCRYPTED BARRIER FORMULA"}". Beneath that is a row of 4 ingredient callouts separated evenly across the width: 1) "CERAMIDE IP-07" with two lines "Strengthens" and "Lipid Defence"; 2) "SQUALANE ENCAPSULES" with "Reinforces" and "Moisture Lock"; 3) "NIACINAMIDE 5%" with "Calms Visible" and "Stress Signals"; 4) "HYALURONIC STACK" with "Multi-Layer" and "Hydration Matrix". At the very bottom center, add a small shield icon and the words "DEFEND. PURIFY. PROTECT." The overall style should blend luxury skincare product photography with cyber-security branding, ultra-polished commercial lighting, shallow depth of field, premium editorial composition, and production-ready ad design.

Overlay large refined serif typography in cream across the middle-lower area: left text {argument name="left slogan" default="Depuis toujours."} and right text {argument name="right slogan" default="Pour toujours."}, with a glowing blue tooth icon centered between the two phrases on the mirror divide. Add a smaller centered serif tagline near the bottom in cream: {argument name="tagline text" default="Le meilleur de la tradition, la force de la science"}. Place 1 Colgate Sensation White toothpaste box in the bottom right corner, angled slightly toward camera, glossy and realistic. The overall composition should communicate the fusion of ancestral tradition and modern dental science, premium African fashion portraiture, symmetrical balance, editorial campaign design, and a sophisticated international cosmetics advertisement.

items.title: Tradition and Science Colgate Ad
items.titleZh: Create a polished square advertising image for Colgate Sensation White, split vertically into two equal halves with a glowing divider line in the center, showing a side-by-side contrast between tradition and modern science. On the left half, place an elderly African woman seated behind a pale marble tabletop in a warm, earthy interior with carved wooden wall panels and a clay pot in the background. She wears a richly patterned traditional rust-orange and gold wrap dress with layered bead necklaces and bracelets, and has short gray natural hair. She holds a natural chewing stick near her mouth in a calm, dignified pose. Curve the French headline text above her head in large warm golden-yellow letters: "Depuis toujours." On the right half, place a young African child seated behind the same tabletop in a sleek modern blue interior with soft glowing lights and vertical gold accents. The child wears a vivid traditional-modern outfit: a copper-brown tunic with bright blue patterned front panel and gold trim, with neat braided hair, and holds a Colgate toothbrush near the mouth. Curve the French headline text above the child in large bright blue letters: "Pour toujours." At the bottom center, spanning both halves and placed prominently on the marble table, show exactly 2 Colgate Sensation White toothpaste boxes stacked slightly offset, with one matching toothbrush resting on top. The packaging must be highly legible and realistic, featuring the red Colgate logo and blue-white Sensation White branding. Add a bold white French tagline centered along the bottom edge: "Le meilleur de la tradition, la force de la science". Use cinematic commercial lighting, premium product-photography realism, rich skin tones, balanced symmetry, and a visual story of heritage meeting innovation.

items.title: Emotional Hawaii Solo Travel Collage
items.titleZh:
A 12-frame collage of candid, emotional snapshots of a {argument name="subject" default="young Japanese woman"} traveling alone in {argument name="location" default="Hawaii"}, casually captured on a smartphone.
Each frame feels like a fleeting personal memory — imperfect, sun-drenched, intimate, and unposed.

The woman has a naturally curvy figure with a soft, feminine silhouette, subtly emphasizing her bust without exaggeration. Her presence feels real and unstyled, like a private photo album.

Scenes include: walking barefoot on the beach, seaside in strong sunlight, palm trees swaying, overexposed ocean reflections, small local cafés, a modest motel room, sunset coast, night markets, views from inside a moving car.

Shot with a smartphone aesthetic: slight motion blur, soft focus, blown-out highlights from tropical sunlight, lens flare, sun glare, high ISO noise at night, uneven framing, accidental cropping.

Composition feels random and spontaneous — subject sometimes off-center, partially cut off, mid-motion, or obscured by light leaks.

Lighting varies: harsh midday sun, warm golden hour glow, deep sunset tones, humid night street lighting.

Color grading: faded cinematic tones, slightly desaturated with warm highlights, nostalgic film-like look, subtle grain, lifted blacks.

Emotion: solitude, fleeting youth, bittersweet nostalgia, quiet introspection, like memories from a trip taken alone.

Layout: 12 images arranged in a loose, imperfect collage grid, slightly tilted and misaligned like a scrapbook.

No text, no watermark.

items.title: High-Contrast Monochrome Studio Portrait
items.titleZh: Create a 4:5 high-contrast, black-and-white studio portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="handsome man"} in the uploaded image. He is seated in a slumped, pensive posture on a {argument name="furniture" default="minimalist dark wooden chair"}. His right elbow rests on his knee, with his head leaning heavily into his palm, while his left hand loosely grips a white disposable coffee cup with a black plastic lid. He is wearing classic black Wayfarer-style sunglasses, hiding his eyes and adding to the stoic, moody atmosphere.Suit: An oversized, structured black blazer and matching wide-leg trousers. The fabric is a heavy, matte wool. Four small black buttons are visible on the sleeve cuff. Footwear: Crisp, bright white ribbed cotton socks creating a sharp visual break between the dark trousers and shoes. Shoes: Highly polished black leather Oxford shoes with thin laces and a slight sheen on the toe box. Background: A minimalist, sterile studio setting with a {argument name="background" default="light grey or off-white textured plaster wall"}. A soft, vertical shadow or curtain edge is visible on the far left. Lighting: Soft, diffused side-lighting that creates gentle gradients on the man's face and deep, dramatic folds in the oversized suit. The lighting emphasizes the high-contrast "black on white" aesthetic. Floor: A light, seamless studio floor that catches the soft shadows cast by the chair legs and the man's shoes. Color Grade: Pure monochrome (black and white) with a wide dynamic range—deep blacks and bright, clean whites. Film Quality: Sharp focus on the subject with a very subtle film grain, mimicking professional editorial fashion photography (reminiscent of 1990s minimalist campaigns).
items.promptZh: 在上传的图片中为{argument name="subject" default="handsome man"}创建一张 4:5 高对比度、黑白影棚肖像。他以一种颓然、沉思的姿势坐在一张{argument name="furniture" default="minimalist dark wood chair"}上。他的右肘放在膝盖上，头重重地靠在手掌上，左手松松地握着一个带有黑色塑料盖的白色一次性咖啡杯。他戴着经典的黑色 Wayfarer 风格太阳镜，遮住了眼睛，增添了坚忍、喜怒无常的氛围。 西装：超大、挺括的黑色西装外套和配套的阔腿裤。面料是厚重的哑光羊毛。袖口上可见四个黑色小纽扣。鞋类：清爽、明亮的白色罗纹棉袜在深色裤子和鞋子之间形成鲜明的视觉效果。鞋子：高度抛光的黑色皮革牛津鞋，配有细鞋带，鞋头略带光泽。背景：简约、无菌的工作室环境，带有{argument name="background" default="浅灰色或灰白色纹理石膏墙"}。最左边可以看到柔和的垂直阴影或窗帘边缘。灯光：柔和、漫射的侧光在男士脸上营造出柔和的渐变效果，并在超大西装上营造出深邃、戏剧性的褶皱。灯光强调高对比度的“白底黑字”美感。地板：明亮、无缝的工作室地板，可以捕捉到椅子腿和男人鞋子投下的柔和阴影。颜色等级：纯单色（黑色和白色），具有宽动态范围 - 深黑色和明亮、干净的白色。胶片质量：以非常微妙的胶片颗粒清晰地聚焦于主题，模仿专业的编辑时尚摄影（让人想起 20 世纪 90 年代的极简主义广告）。

items.title: Professional Brand Packaging System
items.titleZh:
Please create a high-aesthetic, high-completion "Brand Packaging System Display Image" for the brand {argument name="brand name" default="Brand Name"} in the category {argument name="category" default="Product Category"}. This is not a common e-commerce white background shot, nor a single product photo, but a brand proposal-style display showing a 'packaging family' with visual identity system logic and commercial photography texture. The image should reflect the 'unified implementation of a single brand across multiple packaging carriers,' presenting a complete packaging system for a mature consumer brand.

[Aspect Ratio Requirements] The overall composition must be a fixed 4:5 vertical poster. Horizontal compositions or scattered arrangements are prohibited. The layout should follow poster reading logic: breathing space at the top, the main visual focus of the packaging system in the center, and auxiliary packaging, labels, and products at the bottom. The weight should be concentrated and suitable for immediate release as a brand display poster.

[Core Requirements] Automatically match the most reasonable packaging combination based on the [Category] and build a unified visual system around the [Brand Name]. Choose a small but representative number of packaging forms to form a refined system. Prioritize hierarchy, brand unity, and display beauty over quantity. You can include: shopping bags, gift boxes, shipping boxes, long boxes, single item boxes, pouches, sleeves, sample bags, bottles, jars, tubes, spray bottles, pump bottles, labels, stickers, tags, cards, and the actual product itself.

[Category Adaptation] Adapt packaging forms to the [Category]: e.g., paper bags and food containers for Bakery; cups and sleeves for Coffee/Tea; jars and tubes for Beauty/Skincare; candles and cards for Fragrance/Lifestyle; drawer boxes and tags for Fashion/Collectibles. The result must feel category-appropriate and systematic.

[Quantity Control] Control the number of items; do not overcrowd. The scene should be "less is more." Suggest: 1-2 large items, 2-3 medium items, 2-4 small items/labels, and 1-3 actual products. Total visible elements should be between 6-10. Ensure enough white space and clear hierarchy.

[Visual System] All packaging must belong to the same brand system, using the [Brand Name] as the core element. Maintain consistent logo placement, font style, graphics, illustration/pattern systems, and material texture. The style can be minimalist, organic, modern, luxury, or youthful, but must be mature and high-quality.

[Color Mechanism] Avoid fixed combinations. Generate different schemes like Cream White/Caramel Brown, Mist Blue/Warm White, Olive Green/Linen Beige, Chocolate Brown/Ivory, etc. Avoid neon or cheap high-saturation colors. Maintain a sense of high-end restraint.

[Composition] Use a commercial studio setting with a 3/4 top-down or slight perspective view. Arrange in layers: large items in the background, core packaging in the mid-ground, and small items/products in the foreground. At least one product should interact with its packaging (e.g., half-out of a box). Create a balanced triangular or staggered composition.

[Visual Style] High-end commercial photography feel. Clean studio background (white, warm white, light grey). Emphasize material textures (paper folds, box structures, bottle silhouettes, print quality, embossing, matte/cotton/kraft textures). Modern and clean visual language.

[Lighting] Commercial grade lighting. Soft studio light or slight directional natural side light. Use clear but restrained shadows for depth. The light should be transparent and bright, never dark or messy.

[Final Effect] The final image should look like a mature brand's packaging proposal poster or visual landing page, emphasizing vertical poster feel, brand unity, systematic completeness, and commercial photography quality.
items.prompt:
请为品牌【{argument name="品牌名称" default="品牌名称"}】、类目为【{argument name="品牌类目" default="品牌类目"}】创作一张高审美、高完成度的「品牌包装系统展示图」。这不是普通电商白底图，也不是单一产品图，而是一张具有品牌提案感、视觉识别系统感和商业摄影质感的包装家族陈列效果图。画面需要体现“同一品牌在多个包装载体上的统一落地”，呈现一个成熟消费品牌的完整包装系统。

【画幅要求】整体必须为固定 4:5 的竖版海报构图，画面方向明确为纵向，禁止生成横版构图、宽幅桌面陈列或过于分散的横向展示。整体构图需符合海报阅读逻辑：上方保留呼吸感，中部为品牌包装系统的主要视觉焦点，下方安排辅助包装、标签和产品本体，整体重心集中，适合直接作为品牌展示海报发布。

【核心要求】根据【类目】自动匹配最合理、最自然的包装组合与产品形态，并围绕【品牌名字】建立统一的品牌视觉系统。画面中应选择少量但有代表性的包装形式，组成一组完整而精炼的品牌包装系统，不追求堆砌数量，而强调主次层级、品牌统一性与陈列美感。可根据类目合理选择以下包装类型中的一部分：手提袋 / 购物袋、纸盒 / 礼盒 / 外包装盒、长条盒 / 单品盒 / 套装盒、包装袋 / 封套 / 小样袋 / 软袋、杯子 / 瓶子 / 罐子 / 管状容器 / 喷雾瓶 / 泵头瓶、标签 / 贴纸 / 封签 / 吊牌 / 小卡片，以及与类目对应的真实产品本体。

【类目适配逻辑】包装形式与产品形态需要根据【类目】自动匹配，但不局限于单一方向。可参考以下适配逻辑自由发散：若类目为食品 / 烘焙 / 零食 / 饮品，则以纸袋、纸盒、包装袋、杯子、食品容器、贴纸、封签及真实产品本体为主；若类目为茶饮 / 咖啡 / 饮料，则以杯子、瓶子、罐装包装、提袋、杯套、封口贴、礼盒等为主；若类目为美妆 / 护肤 / 彩妆 / 香水，则以瓶、罐、管、盒、礼盒、手提袋、小样包装等为主；若类目为香氛 / 家居 / 生活方式，则以香薰瓶、蜡烛杯、包装盒、礼盒、提袋、吊卡、标签卡等为主；若类目为服饰 / 饰品 / 潮玩 / 文创，则以包装盒、抽屉盒、防尘袋、手提袋、贴纸、吊牌、配件包装等为主；若类目为数码配件 / 工具 / 小型消费品，则以硬盒、外包装盒、收纳袋、说明卡、贴纸、封套、标签等为主。整体必须体现“类目合理、品牌统一、包装成体系”的效果。

【数量与密度控制】请控制画面中的物件数量，不要过多堆砌，也不要把所有可能包装形式全部展示出来。整体应呈现“少而精、完整但不拥挤”的品牌包装系统效果。建议选择最具代表性的包装载体进行展示：大件包装 1～2 个，中型包装 2～3 个，小型包装或辅助物件 2～4 个，真实产品本体 1～3 个，总可见元素建议控制在 6～10 个之间。包装种类应体现层次变化与系统感，但不宜重复过多同类物件。画面需要有足够留白与呼吸感，确保每个包装都清晰可见、主次明确、摆放舒展，宁可少而精，也不要为了“完整”而过度塞满。

【品牌视觉系统要求】所有包装必须属于同一个品牌系统，统一使用【品牌名字】作为核心品牌识别元素。整体应具备一致的 logo / 标志呈现、字体风格、图形语言、插画语言或纹样系统、排版逻辑、配色体系、材质与印刷质感。品牌调性、色彩方向、图案元素、辅助图形和视觉氛围，请根据【类目】自动匹配并合理发散，不局限于任何固定风格。整体风格应统一、协调、具有品牌识别度，可以是简约高级、自然有机、时尚现代、轻奢精致、年轻清新、艺术感、潮流个性或经典优雅，但必须符合【类目】特征，并呈现成熟品牌的设计完成度。

【配色机制要求】整体配色不要固化为某一种固定组合，也不要连续多次出现高度相似的主色系统。每次生成时应根据【类目】与品牌气质，主动形成不同的主色方案与配色关系，采用“受控发散”的方式进行色彩演绎。色彩可以是低饱和自然色、现代中性色、轻复古色、明快清新色、轻奢深色系或艺术感综合色系，但必须保持高级、统一、克制、有品牌感。允许每次生成时呈现不同的视觉气质，例如奶油白与焦糖棕、雾灰蓝与暖白、橄榄绿与亚麻米、酒红与奶霜白、可可棕与象牙白、炭灰与麦秆金、雾粉灰与米白、海军蓝与暖灰等，仅作为参考方向而非固定模板。不要荧光色，不要廉价高饱和，不要杂乱失控的多色拼贴。

【画面构图与陈列要求】画面采用品牌包装家族陈列逻辑，而不是杂乱堆放。整体为商业摄影棚场景，使用 3/4 轻俯视角或略带透视的正面陈列角度，形成有层次、有秩序、有主次的包装展示画面。构图参考以下逻辑：后景摆放 1～2 个较大的包装作为视觉支撑，如手提袋、大礼盒、大外盒；中景安排品牌核心包装或主力单品包装，作为主要视觉焦点；前景摆放较小包装、辅助包装、标签、贴纸及真实产品本体；至少有一个真实产品与包装产生自然互动，如产品半露出、摆放在包装前方、与包装组合展示；整体形成平衡而有设计感的三角式或错落式构图。画面干净、有留白、不拥挤，内容丰富但克制，以有限而精准的包装组合体现完整的品牌包装生态。

【视觉风格要求】整体呈现高端商业摄影质感与品牌提案感，背景为干净的摄影棚环境，可为白色、暖白色、浅灰色，或根据品牌调性自动匹配的极简背景。画面应强调真实的包装材质表现、清晰的纸张折痕、盒型结构、瓶罐轮廓、标签细节、印刷质感、压纹 / 烫金 / 哑光 / 棉纸纹理 / 牛皮纸纹理等材质细节，以及统一而高级的配色搭配、精致现代干净的品牌视觉语言和强烈的“这是一整套品牌包装系统”的完整感。

【光影要求】采用真实商业摄影级光影，可为柔和棚拍光，也可带有轻微方向性的自然侧光。需要有清晰但克制的阴影，以增强立体感、空间感与高级感。整体光线通透、明亮、干净，不要阴暗，不要廉价感，不要杂乱背景。

【最终效果要求】最终画面应像一个成熟品牌的包装系统展示海报、包装家族提案图或品牌视觉落地效果图，而不是零散商品拼图。重点突出：固定 4:5 竖版海报感、品牌统一性、包装家族完整性、商业摄影感、设计提案感、类目适配性，以及高级审美与视觉完成度。

items.title: Japanese Video Production Poster
items.titleZh: Create a clean, premium Japanese corporate poster for a {argument name="company name" default="Arks"} video production company, in a minimalist editorial layout on an off-white background with lots of negative space. Portrait orientation, A4-like poster proportions. At the very top left, place an oversized bold black sans-serif logotype reading {argument name="company name" default="Arks"}, spanning nearly the full width of the page. In the upper right, add a small stacked brand mark in thin uppercase letters: "VIDEO" on one line, "PRODUCTION" on the next, "COMPANY" on the third, with a small burnt-orange geometric accent nearby. Below the logo, add a vertical burnt-orange bar on the left and a large elegant Japanese headline in black Mincho-style serif: {argument name="headline text" default="4つの領域で、映像を磨く。"}. items.title: Tennis Hydration Ad Poster
items.titleZh: Create a hyper-realistic sports advertising poster shot from an extreme wide-angle, low courtside perspective on a bright sunny day at an outdoor tennis court. In the extreme foreground, a male tennis player lunges dramatically toward the camera while thrusting a large matte cobalt-blue insulated water bottle toward the viewer, making the bottle the dominant object in the frame. The bottle is covered with visible condensation droplets and has a brushed metallic gold cap, with the white logo text {argument name="brand name" default="Aqua"} printed near the bottom. The athlete wears a clean white athletic t-shirt, bright blue tennis shorts, white wristbands, white socks, and white tennis shoes. His other arm stretches back holding a black tennis racket, with 1 bright yellow-green tennis ball visible near the racket on the right side of the image. The pose should feel dynamic and athletic, with one leg bent deeply and the other extended in a wide lunge across the blue hard court. Use strong midday sunlight, crisp shadows, vivid saturated blues, and a clear cloudless sky, with green trees and a dark fence line in the distant background. Compose it like a premium hydration brand campaign, with sharp focus on the bottle and athlete, dramatic foreshortening, commercial polish, and energetic motion. Add clean white ad typography integrated onto the court surface in the lower half: a smaller line reading {argument name="headline intro" default="Play Hard"}, a very large bold line reading {argument name="headline main" default="Hydrate Smart"}, and a smaller subheading reading {argument name="tagline" default="Hydration that keeps up with every move."}. Place the {argument name="brand name" default="Aqua"} logo again in white at the top right, and a small website URL in white at the bottom right reading {argument name="website" default="www.aqua.com"}.
items.promptZh: 在阳光明媚的日子，在室外网球场从超广角、低场边视角拍摄的超现实体育广告海报。在最远的前景中，一名男子网球运动员戏剧性地冲向镜头，同时将一个大的哑光钴蓝色绝缘水瓶推向观众，使瓶子成为画面中的主要物体。瓶子上覆盖着可见的冷凝水滴，并配有拉丝金属金色瓶盖，底部附近印有白色徽标文字{argument name="brand name" default="Aqua"}。运动员穿着干净的白色运动 T 恤、亮蓝色网球短裤、白色腕带、白色袜子和白色网球鞋。他的另一只手臂向后伸展，拿着一个黑色网球拍，在图像右侧的球拍附近可以看到一个明亮的黄绿色网球。这个姿势应该给人一种充满活力和运动感的感觉，一条腿深深弯曲，另一条腿在蓝色硬地球场上呈弓步伸展。使用强烈的正午阳光、清晰的阴影、生动饱和的蓝色和清澈无云的天空，远处的背景中有绿色的树木和深色的栅栏线。将其设计为优质水袋品牌广告活动，重点关注瓶子和运动员、戏剧性的透视、商业润色和充满活力的动作。在下半部分的球场表面上添加干净的白色广告排版：一条较小的行显示为{argument name="headline intro" default="Play Hard"}，一条非常大的粗行显示为{argument name="headline main" default="Hydrate Smart"}，还有一个较小的副标题显示为{argument name="tagline" default="Hydration that keep up with every move."}。再次将白色的 {argument name="brand name" default="Aqua"} 徽标放在右上角，并在右下角放置一个白色的小网站网址，内容为 {argument name="website" default="www.aqua.com"}。

items.title: Epic Shiva Tandava Fire Dance
items.titleZh: A monumental mythological fantasy painting of Lord Shiva performing the Tandava in the center of a fiery sacred arena, full-body, dynamic dancing pose with one leg raised and the other foot pressing down on a fallen figure beneath him. Shiva has ash-blue skin, a powerfully muscular physique, long wild flowing dark hair exploding outward in all directions, a high matted topknot, and a white crescent moon tucked into the hair. His expression is intense and divine. A cobra is coiled around his neck, and he wears multiple rudraksha bead necklaces, bracelets, and armlets, large circular earrings, and sacred ornaments. His clothing is a tiger-skin loincloth with dramatic red-orange cloth sashes whipping through the air. One raised hand holds a small damaru drum, one front hand is lifted in a blessing gesture with the Om symbol visible on the palm, and another hand conjures a bright flame above the open palm. Behind his head is a large glowing circular halo inscribed repeatedly with Sanskrit mantra text, creating a radiant mandala effect. The setting is an apocalyptic Himalayan temple landscape with dark storm clouds, smoke, embers, rocky mountains, waterfalls, and ancient stone shrines and temple towers on both the left and right sides. A trident wrapped with red cloth stands upright on the left side of the scene. Around Shiva is a circle of exactly 10 worshippers and ascetics, split across both sides, shown chanting, kneeling, raising arms, carrying torches, and playing drums in devotion. Beneath Shiva is exactly 1 fallen dark-skinned male figure lying on the stone ground. The ground is cracked and molten, with a blazing ring of lava and fire encircling the dance platform. Use dramatic cinematic lighting, glowing orange firelight against deep charcoal shadows, highly detailed anatomy, intricate jewelry and textures, swirling hair and fabric motion, devotional epic fantasy realism, painterly brushwork, symmetrical central composition, ultra-detailed, high contrast, vertical poster format.
items.promptZh: 这是一幅巨大的神话奇幻画作，画中湿婆神在炽热的神圣竞技场中央表演坦达瓦舞，全身充满活力的舞蹈姿势，一条腿抬起，另一只脚踩在他身下倒下的人身上。湿婆拥有灰蓝色的皮肤，肌肉发达的体格，长长的狂野飘逸的黑发向四面八方爆炸，高高的髻发髻，白色的新月塞在头发里。他的表情强烈而神圣。一条眼镜蛇盘绕在他的脖子上，他戴着多条金刚菩提珠项链、手镯和臂环、大圆形耳环和神圣的装饰品。他的衣服是虎皮缠腰布，橙色的布腰带在空中飘扬。一只举起的手拿着一个小达玛鲁鼓，一只前手举起祝福手势，手掌上可见嗡符号，另一只手在张开的手掌上方召唤出明亮的火焰。他的头后面有一个巨大的发光圆形光环，上面反复刻有梵文咒文，创造出光芒四射的曼陀罗效果。场景是一个世界末日般的喜马拉雅寺庙景观，左右两侧有乌云、烟雾、余烬、岩石山脉、瀑布以及古老的石头神龛和寺庙塔。场景左侧竖立着一根用红布包裹的三叉戟。湿婆周围有一圈恰好由 10 名崇拜者和苦行者组成的圆圈，分成两侧，虔诚地唱诵、跪下、举起双臂、举起火把、敲鼓。湿婆下面正好有一个倒在石头地上的黑皮肤男性雕像。地面龟裂并融化，一圈炽热的熔岩和火焰环绕着舞台。使用戏剧性的电影灯光、深木炭阴影下的橙色火光、高度详细的解剖结构、复杂的珠宝和纹理、旋转的头发和织物运动、虔诚的史诗幻想现实主义、绘画笔触、对称的中心构图、超详细、高对比度、垂直海报格式。

items.titleZh: A highly detailed historical maritime scene at water level, showing two large wooden sailing ships anchored close together on calm reflective water under a bright blue sky with soft scattered clouds. On the left, a massive ornate European galleon dominates the composition, viewed from the rear-left stern quarter, with richly carved baroque stern decorations in gold, red, blue, and cream, heraldic emblems, multiple stern windows, and a dark hull with warm reddish-brown planking. It has 4 visible masts including a bowsprit, dense black rigging, crow's nests, and many cream-white square sails partially unfurled and hanging loosely. On the right, a traditional Chinese junk faces slightly left, with 1 very large rust-brown battened sail raised, a curved wooden hull in brown, black, and white, carved stern details, and smaller masts and rigging. In the foreground center, include 1 small wooden rowboat with 1 standing boatman wearing light clothing and a brimmed hat, adding scale between the two ships. In the distant background, show faint silhouettes of additional sailing vessels near the horizon on the far left. Lighting is crisp daylight with warm highlights on the wood, subtle reflections in the rippling water, and a painterly yet photorealistic finish, ultra-detailed textures, cinematic composition, wide aspect ratio, no modern elements.

items.title: Surreal Wind, Sand and Stars Book World
items.titleZh: A poetic, cinematic macro illustration of the cover of {argument name="book title" default="Wind, Sand and Stars"} by {argument name="author name" default="Antoine de Saint-Exupéry"}, rendered as a surreal desert world emerging directly from the textured paper page. A large human hand holds a glossy black and gold fountain pen near the top right, the engraved gold nib touching the paper and releasing a dark stream of ink that becomes a winding path across a miniature Sahara landscape. The composition is vertical, warmly lit in amber and sepia tones, with dramatic side lighting, deep shadows, and ultra-detailed paper grain, skin texture, dust, and metallic reflections. On the upper left, the printed title text appears in elegant serif typography, with the author name below it and a short italic quote in smaller script beneath. The page transforms into a detailed map-like desert tableau with exactly 16 tiny human figures scattered across the scene: 1 lone standing figure balanced beside the pen nib, 3 figures near a small campfire, 2 central robed men in conversation, 3 figures gathered beside the biplane, 1 solitary figure walking near the lower middle, 2 riders on camels at the lower left, 3 standing figures near the truck at the lower right, and 1 tiny seated figure near the wreckage at the lower left. Include exactly 1 vintage biplane parked on the right with visible markings, exactly 1 old expedition truck at the bottom right, exactly 1 windsock near the center-right, exactly 1 desert oasis town with palm trees on the right, exactly 1 ruined sandcastle-like mound on the left, exactly 1 dark tent encampment on the left-center, exactly 1 wrecked engine or fuselage fragment in the lower left corner, and exactly 1 compass rose printed at the bottom left. The ink trail should branch through dunes and cracked earth like a route on an old map, connecting landmarks labeled with place names including {argument name="map label one" default="Tamanrasset"}, {argument name="map label two" default="Agadir"}, and {argument name="map label three" default="Dakar"}. Blend antique cartography, literary symbolism, and miniature diorama realism, evoking exploration, memory, loneliness, and the romance of early aviation.

items.title: Isometric Coastal Base Under Naval Attack
items.titleZh: An isometric real-time-strategy game battle scene viewed from a high oblique angle, showing a fortified coastal military outpost under naval attack in a desert oasis environment. The base sits in the lower left and center foreground, enclosed by pale concrete walls with defensive corner towers and several cylindrical turret emplacements. Inside the compound are 5 major structures: a large central metallic command or factory building with a curved roof and landing-pad markings, 1 long segmented industrial generator on the left, 1 smaller smokestack power structure near the bottom center, and 2 green cylindrical reactor or storage buildings on the right. Show dirt tracks, scattered crates, utility details, and a paved gray yard inside the walls. A large orange fireball explosion is erupting inside the base near the right-center interior, with smoke and debris. Another smaller explosion is happening outside the walls at the upper left on a dirt road near 2 red ground vehicles or launchers, with black smoke rising. The shoreline curves around shallow blue-green water with sandy banks, rocky cliffs, and many palm trees, creating a tropical desert cove. In the water on the right side, depict 5 gray modern warships in formation, angled diagonally, each leaving white wakes as they move. Count 8 missiles total with bright flaming trails arcing from the ships toward the land and base defenses; one missile is striking the nearest ship-side target area with a bright blue-white impact flash over the waterline, while others arc toward the compound and shore. Include tiny infantry figures near the beach and walls, some fallen, to suggest an active assault. The style should look like a polished high-detail strategy game screenshot, with realistic military sci-fi architecture, cinematic lighting, sharp textures, dynamic explosions, and readable spatial depth.

items.title: Cyberpunk Manga Page of a Giant Robot Cat
items.titleZh: A highly detailed black-and-white manga page showing a gigantic mechanical cat walking through a dense nighttime Japanese city street. The page has 4 panels total: 1 wide top panel spanning the full width, 2 smaller stacked panels on the bottom left, and 1 tall large panel on the bottom right. In the top panel, a colossal robotic cat dominates a narrow neon-lit alley lined with tall buildings, tangled power lines, vertical shop signs, and tiny pedestrians staring upward in shock. The cat has realistic feline proportions but is built from exposed armor plates, rivets, pistons, cables, gears, segmented metal limbs, and intricate machine internals, with a tag hanging from its neck that reads "猫神". The wet street reflects city lights. Add multiple Japanese signs in the environment including "古書 2F", "万事屋 B1", and "酒処". Include a large manga speech bubble in Japanese in the upper right of the top panel reading "うわっ？でっけえ!!". In the upper bottom-left panel, show a close-up of a long-haired woman seen from behind and slightly to the side, looking toward the creature, with a vertical Japanese speech bubble reading "…何でこんな街にこんなものが…". In the lower bottom-left panel, show a group of startled onlookers from the front, including a young man in the foreground and other shocked pedestrians behind him, with a vertical Japanese speech bubble reading "神様の使いか!?". In the tall bottom-right panel, show a dramatic low-angle close-up of the mechanical cat towering between buildings under a bright moon, emphasizing its chest machinery, massive forelegs, whiskers, and regal face, with the neck tag "猫神" clearly visible. items.prompt: 一份专业的动漫院线分镜头（16：9），标题为《{argument name="标题" default="天空之击"}》，副标题为“{argument name="副标题" default="战士与圣石"}”。干净的浅米色背景，圆角矩形面板排列成三列网格，共 9 个场景。每个场景面板显示：橙色“场景 XX”标签、时间码、场景标题，然后是两个并排的画面，分别标有“开始帧”→“结束帧”，通过白色箭头连接，下面有注释（镜头/对白/特效/动作）。艺术风格：清晰的卡通渲染 {argument name="画风" default="新海诚的×工作室机智，×进击的巨人"}——柔和的画风光线、立体云朵、温暖的金色阳光、电影般的广角镜头、动态动作姿势、浓郁的天蓝和翡翠绿调，搭配黄铜和铜色点缀。需要描绘的场景：1. 广角景——一艘雄伟的蒸汽朋克飞艇，黄铜螺旋桨和飘扬的帆，在高空穿透积云海洋（慢速无人机推入）2.低角度特写一名女战士的靴子和交叉的双腿悬挂在飞艇木制栏杆上，风中头发飘动（静电→微微向上倾斜） 3.鸟瞰视角俯瞰栏杆下方：广阔的翡翠山谷，蜿蜒的河流和远处一个茅草屋顶的小中世纪村庄（眩晕变焦）4.飞艇桥内部——海盗船长戴着三角帽和长大衣，举着一块比蛋稍大、发着蓝光的圣石，脸上有耀眼的青色光（中→石头放大）5.甲板上的船员发现入侵者——一名满脸胡渣的海盗举起一把黄铜中世纪左轮手枪对准她，其他人震惊地转身（两枪→跟着瞄准）6.子弹飞行中极近距离，旋转穿过空中，伴随着运动模糊和烟雾轨迹，朝栏杆方向飞去（子弹时间追踪镜头）7.栏杆——空的。 她被放置的地方什么都没有，子弹穿过空气（快速剪辑，杂音）8。女战士在空中优雅地做月面翻身，背景是明亮的天空，头发和斗篷在动作中拖曳（慢动作，宽→近）9。着陆镜头——她悄无声息地在射手身后降落，低蹲着，手放在剑柄上，海盗转身半空震惊僵住（低角度→对峙） 底部部分包括：“关键角色”一行，有 4 个角色肖像（女战士、海盗船长、射手海盗、一名船员）;一个“音调与方向”盒子（动态动作、风和云粒子，吉卜力风格的奇观与武士的强烈情感）;“音乐与特效计划”时间线（环境风→紧张弦乐→子弹→→沉默）;以及“技术规格”盒装（30 秒，16：9 1920×1080,24 帧，全彩，mp4 H.264）。布局：简洁的信息图，细边框，粉彩色格，每帧内高度细致的动漫关键视觉，专业制作文档美学。

Middle row has 3 panels: middle-left aligned with 正东 in large vertical side text, a green-framed panel for number 8 and text 八白左辅星, plus 吉星: 财运、置业、积蓄, illustrated with a bonsai-like money tree and gold ingots; middle-center labeled 中宫 in a blue capsule tag overlapping the top edge of the center square, a blue-framed panel for number 1 and text 一白贪狼星, plus 吉星: 人缘、感情、智慧, illustrated with a crystal ball on a wooden stand; middle-right aligned with 正西 in large vertical side text, a green-framed panel for number 3 and text 三碧禄存星, plus 凶星: 是非、口舌、争执, illustrated with bamboo and a small stacked rock fountain. Bottom row has 3 panels: bottom-left labeled 东北 with a green-framed panel for number 4 and text 四绿文曲星, plus 吉星: 学业、文昌、考试, illustrated with an open book, brush pen, and ink stone with bamboo leaves behind; bottom-center labeled 正北 with a gold-framed panel for number 6 and text 六白武曲星, plus 吉星: 权力、贵人、偏财, illustrated with a golden guardian lion statue on a pedestal holding a ball; bottom-right labeled 西北 with a gray-framed panel for number 2 and text 二黑巨门星, plus 凶星: 病痛、伤害、阻滞, illustrated with a stone pagoda and a small incense burner. Use exactly 6 outer direction labels around the grid: 东南, 正南, 西南 above the top row, and 东北, 正北, 西北 below the bottom row, each inside rounded capsules matching the panel colors. Add exactly 2 large vertical side direction labels outside the grid: 正东 on the left side and 正西 on the right side. At the bottom center, add a pill-shaped legend with 2 segments: a red segment reading 吉星: 1、4、6、8、9 and a dark gray segment reading 凶星: 2、3、5、7. Include faint pale cloud motifs behind some objects for traditional atmosphere. Style is crisp vector-infographic with soft watercolor-like object rendering, high readability, balanced spacing, and an elegant Chinese metaphysical chart aesthetic.

items.title: Luxury Publishing Branding Editorial Spread
items.titleZh: Create a luxurious Japanese magazine-style PR editorial spread for a publishing and branding service, designed as a two-page brochure layout. The left half is a dark, cinematic portrait scene in a sophisticated office lounge: a seated Japanese businessman in a navy bespoke suit, white shirt, dark tie, white pocket square, and wristwatch sits in a leather chair with one hand near his chin, posed thoughtfully beside a glossy wooden table. His face is intentionally obscured with a soft rectangular blur. The lighting is moody and warm, with reflections from tall windows and a premium executive atmosphere. On this dark left page, place large elegant serif headline text in English reading {argument name="headline text" default="PUBLISHING BRANDING"}, stacked in two lines near the upper left in muted gold. Below it, add multiple lines of Japanese copy in white, including a larger subheadline and several short body paragraphs arranged vertically. Near the lower left, include a bordered dark box containing exactly 4 checklist items, each preceded by a check mark, with Japanese text. Put a small page number "02" in the bottom-left corner. The right half is a clean white editorial information page with refined minimalist typography and generous spacing. At the top, place a large Japanese headline in black, aligned upper center-right, with two short Japanese body text blocks beneath it; on the upper far right include a small photo of exactly 4 stacked hardcover books and a glass vase near a bright window with greenery. Across the middle, add a centered section title in Japanese for five benefits, followed by exactly 5 numbered columns labeled 1 through 5, each with a short Japanese heading and several lines of smaller explanatory Japanese text. Beneath that, add another centered Japanese section title for workflow, followed by exactly 4 step blocks laid out horizontally: STEP 01 with a speech bubble icon, STEP 02 with a pencil icon, STEP 03 with an open book icon, STEP 04 with a megaphone icon. Each step includes the English word STEP plus a two-digit number, a short Japanese subtitle, and a few lines of smaller Japanese description, with small chevrons between steps. Along the bottom of the right page, place exactly 3 rectangular photos side by side: a city-view office meeting table scene, a close-up of a hand writing with a pen, and a stack of books near an open book. Under these images, add a prominent Japanese closing statement in a serif style on the lower left, and a smaller Japanese paragraph on the lower right. Put page number "03" in the bottom-right corner. items.promptZh: 为出版和品牌服务创建豪华的日本杂志风格的公关编辑跨页，设计为两页小册子布局。左半部分是一个在精致的办公室休息室里的黑暗的电影肖像场景：一位坐着的日本商人穿着海军定制西装、白衬衫、深色领带、白色口袋巾和手表，坐在皮椅上，一只手靠近下巴，在一张光滑的木桌旁边若有所思地摆着姿势。他的脸被故意用柔和的矩形模糊遮挡。灯光柔和而温暖，高大的窗户反射着光线，营造出高级的行政氛围。在这个深色的左侧页面上，放置大型优雅的衬线英文标题文本：{argument name="headline text" default="PUBLISHING BRANDING"}，在左上方附近以柔和的金色堆叠成两行。在其下方，添加多行白色日文文案，包括一个较大的副标题和几个垂直排列的短正文段落。在左下角附近，有一个带边框的黑框，其中正好包含 4 个清单项目，每个项目前面都有一个复选标记，并带有日语文本。在左下角放置一个小页码“02”。右半部分是一个干净的白色编辑信息页面，具有精致的简约排版和宽敞的间距。在顶部，放置一个黑色的日文大标题，右上方对齐，下面有两个简短的日文正文文本块；最右上方有一张小照片，上面有四本堆放的精装书和一个玻璃花瓶，靠近一扇绿树成荫的明亮窗户。在中间，添加一个居中的日语部分标题，以表示五个好处，然后是 5 个编号的列，标记为 1 到 5，每个列都有一个简短的日语标题和几行较小的解释性日语文本。在其下方，为工作流程添加另一个居中的日语部分标题，然后是水平布局的 4 个步骤块：带有语音气泡图标的步骤 01、带有铅笔图标的步骤 02、带有打开的书本图标的步骤 03、带有扩音器图标的步骤 04。每个步骤都包含英文单词 STEP 加上一个两位数的数字、一个简短的日语字幕和几行较小的日语描述，步骤之间有小 V 形符号。沿着右页底部，并排放置 3 张长方形照片：城市景观办公室会议桌场景、用笔写字的手部特写以及一本打开的书旁边的一摞书。在这些图像下，在左下角添加一个突出的日语衬线风格结束语，并在右下角添加一个较小的日语段落。将页码“03”放在右下角。使用深海军蓝、黑色、暖棕色、象牙色和柔和的金色等高级调色板，在编辑奢华、企业信任和高端出版美学之间取得平衡。整体构图应该感觉像真正的杂志广告或咨询手册，精美、逼真、优雅且可信。

items.title: Luxury Hair Dryer Beauty Ad
items.titleZh: Create a premium minimalist beauty advertisement on a clean light gray studio background. Show a glamorous female model from chest up on the left side, with {argument name="hair color" default="deep brunette"} hair blown dramatically to the left in a smooth, glossy wave, emphasizing shine and movement. She wears an elegant white halter dress with a twisted neckline. Her face is de-emphasized and not the focal point. On the right side, place a sleek modern cylindrical hair dryer in a metallic silver finish with a rose-gold circular rim around a black hollow center, shown upright with visible handle buttons, lower air vent perforations, and attached cord. Use luxury commercial product-photography lighting, soft shadows, ultra-clean retouching, and high-end cosmetic ad styling. Add bold modern sans-serif headline text in the upper right: {argument name="headline text" default="Effortless shine."} on the first line and {argument name="subheadline text" default="Everyday perfection."} below it in a lighter weight. In the lower left, include exactly 4 vertically stacked feature callouts with thin outlined circular icons and small sans-serif text: 1) sparkle icon with title "Fast drying." and body "Powerful digital motor for quick, efficient results." 2) thermometer icon with title "Heat intelligent." and body "Measures air temperature 40 times per second." 3) wavy heat lines icon with title "Designed for hair health." and body "Helps protect natural shine and smoothness." 4) muted speaker icon with title "Engineered for balance." and body "Lightweight, quiet, and comfortable to use." In the bottom right corner, add the luxury brand logo text {argument name="brand name" default="LUXÉO"} with small uppercase "PROFESSIONAL" beneath it. Vertical poster layout, polished mobile ad aesthetic, aspirational beauty-tech branding, realistic hair texture, realistic skin, crisp typography, and premium editorial composition.

items.titleZh: Create a high-end luxury perfume advertisement in a vertical smartphone-friendly editorial layout. Show a close-up, cropped portrait of an elegant woman from the back-left side, with only the lower half of her face and shoulder area visible, her head turned slightly away so her ear, jawline, neck, and shoulder are prominent while the upper face is mostly out of frame. Her hair is styled in a soft, voluminous brunette updo with loose, polished strands. She wears a silky ivory spaghetti-strap slip dress. Her skin is luminous with warm, diffused highlights. In one hand she delicately holds a rectangular glass perfume bottle near her neck and collarbone, fingers graceful and refined. The bottle contains pale golden liquid, has a faceted transparent cap, and a cream square label that reads {argument name="brand name" default="LUMIÈRE"} with smaller text below reading "EAU DE PARFUM". items.promptZh: 以适合智能手机的垂直编辑布局创建高端奢华香水广告。从左后侧拍摄一位优雅女性的特写剪裁肖像，仅能看到她的下半张脸和肩膀区域，她的头稍微偏向一边，因此她的耳朵、下巴、脖子和肩膀很突出，而上脸大部分都在画面之外。她的头发呈柔软、丰盈的深色盘发造型，发丝松散、抛光。她穿着一件丝质象牙色细肩带吊带裙。她的皮肤散发着温暖、漫射的光泽，焕发光彩。她一手精致地握住靠近脖子和锁骨的长方形玻璃香水瓶，手指优雅而精致。瓶子里装有浅金色液体，有一个刻面透明瓶盖，还有一个奶油色方形标签，上面写着{argument name="brand name" default="LUMIÈRE"}，下面较小的文字写着“EAU DE PARFUM”。使用极简主义美术美容活动美学，采用柔和的米色、香槟色、象牙色和腮红色调、明亮的自然工作室灯光、柔和的阴影、浅景深、清晰的玻璃反射和干净的灰白色背景。在右侧留出足够的负空间用于广告文案。在右侧添加优雅的衬线标题文本，采用柔和的灰褐色，分为 3 行，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="A香味，在沉默中徘徊。"}。包括微妙的高级时尚杂志感觉、超现实的皮肤纹理、奢侈品摄影和精美的商业美容修饰。

items.title: Constructivist GPT Image 2.0 Poster
items.titleZh: A vintage political-propaganda-style poster collage on aged beige paper with a worn, slightly stained texture and torn-paper edges throughout. The composition is a bold vertical poster with a strong constructivist and Soviet-inspired graphic design, using only black, red, blue, yellow, and off-white. At the very top, centered in bold black sans-serif text, place the headline {argument name="headline text" default="Image generation with a point of view"}. In the center, reserve a large vertical rectangular area as the dominant focal block, slightly taller than wide, filled with a plain muted beige-to-taupe gradient like a blank poster insert. Around it, build a torn-paper photomontage from 4 visible collage zones: on the left, a red paper field with a black-and-white cutout of a person in a dark coat seen from behind or in profile, next to fragments of French poster text; at the top behind the central rectangle, a partial black-and-white face or head fragment peeking out; on the right, a blue paper field with a black-and-white Paris-like street scene including 1 tall ornate lamppost, old buildings, 1 car, and 1 walking man; at the bottom center, a yellow torn-paper field with a cropped black-and-white figure holding a newspaper, wearing a striped shirt. Add a vertical strip of black rectangular blocks near the upper right edge of the central rectangle, like cut graphic bars. At the bottom, place the main title in huge heavy condensed typography: {argument name="brand text" default="GPT Image"}, with "GPT" in black and "Image" in bright red. Beneath and to the right, add an enormous {argument name="version text" default="2.0"} in vivid blue. Below the left title area, add a rough horizontal black brushstroke underline. items.title: OpenAI Merch Poster Grid
items.titleZh: A clean, minimalist promotional poster on an off-white background in a modern tech-brand style. At the top left, a very large bold sans-serif headline in deep cobalt blue reads {argument name="headline text" default="Thinking Mode Searches"} split across two lines. Beneath it, a smaller gray explanatory sentence says that with thinking mode, the model can automatically browse the internet and find relevant contents for reference. At the top right, place a small blue OpenAI knot logo. Below the intro text, add a thin horizontal blue divider line ending with a tiny sparkle icon on the right. Under that, include a prompt line in small text with the word “Prompt:” in blue followed by the sentence {argument name="prompt text" default="Make a poster about OpenAI merch available on the official website right now."}. The main body is a centered 3-by-2 product grid with 8 total merchandise items shown as clean catalog cutouts with soft shadows inside rounded pale cards. Top row has 3 larger products: 1) a white long-sleeve striped rugby-style jersey with black collar and cuffs, small blue patches, and blue chest text “Research & Deployment Co.”, labeled “10 Year Jersey”; 2) a dark brown pullover hoodie with front pocket, small centered chest text “Research Deployment Co.” and sleeve print, labeled “Diagram Hoodie”; 3) a black T-shirt viewed from the back with a metallic knot graphic and pale pink text “Research & Deployment Co.”, labeled “Chrome Blossom Tee”. Bottom row has 5 smaller products: 4) a blue folding chair keychain shaped like a chair, labeled “Blue Chair Keychain”; 5) a black baseball cap with white flame graphics and “GPT-5” on the front, labeled “GPT-5 Flame Cap”; 6) a white notebook with a bold blue lower band and minimal OpenAI branding, labeled “OpenAI Notebook”; 7) a glossy black mug with “OpenAI” in white, labeled “OpenAI Office Mug”; 8) a dark green baseball cap with small white text “Thinking deeply”, labeled “Thinking Deeply Cap”. Keep all item labels centered below each product in small blue sans-serif text. Along the bottom footer, place “Research & Deployment Co.” on the left, the OpenAI knot logo plus wordmark centered, and “Designed with care.” on the right. Use a balanced editorial layout, lots of whitespace, premium product-ad poster aesthetics, subtle shadows, crisp studio lighting, and a restrained palette of off-white, blue, black, brown, and green.

items.title: Vintage Miami Art Date Comic Page
items.titleZh: A vintage American comic-book page in a faded 1950s romance-adventure style, printed on slightly yellowed paper with visible halftone texture, inked panel borders, and soft weathered colors. The page contains exactly 5 panels arranged in a classic comic layout: 1 wide top panel, 2 middle panels side by side, and 2 bottom panels side by side. In the top panel, show a sunny coastal boulevard in {argument name="city" default="Miami"}, with turquoise water on the left, a sailboat offshore, pastel Art Deco buildings in the distance, tall palm trees, and a pink classic convertible driving along the waterfront. A stylish couple sits in the car, and large dramatic comic title lettering reads “ART IN MIAMI!” with a small caption box at the top saying “MIAMI, SATURDAY AFTERNOON…”. Add two speech balloons: “READY TO SEE SOME ART?” and “ALWAYS!”. In the second panel, an interior car view from behind the couple as they drive down Ocean Drive, showing colorful pastel buildings and palms ahead; the man has dark hair and a blue shirt, the woman wears sunglasses, a pink dress, and a lavender headscarf. Include a caption box reading “WE DROVE DOWN OCEAN DRIVE…” and speech balloons saying “LOOK AT THOSE COLORS…” and “MIAMI FEELS LIKE A PAINTING!”. In the third panel, show the couple approaching the entrance of a modern museum with the visible wall text “MIAMI ART MUSEUM”, glass doors, and people inside; add a caption box reading “THE EXHIBIT WAS AT A MODERN MUSEUM…” and a speech balloon saying “LET’S GO!”. In the fourth panel, place the couple inside a gallery viewing large abstract paintings in bright pastel blocks and shapes, with a small sculpture on a pedestal nearby; add a caption box reading “INSIDE, THE ART SURROUNDED US.” and speech balloons saying “I LOVE HOW BRIGHT AND BOLD IT IS.” and “IT FEELS LIKE MIAMI… VIBRANT AND FREE!”. In the fifth panel, show the couple outside again by the water with the skyline, palm trees, and a sailboat in the background, standing close together in the sun; add a caption box reading “WE STEPPED OUT INTO THE SUN…” and a small closing narration box at the bottom right saying “A BEAUTIFUL DAY.” Include speech balloons saying “THAT WAS PERFECT.” and “ART, SUN, AND MIAMI… CAN’T BEAT IT!”. Use hand-lettered uppercase comic text, black outlines, slightly imperfect vintage printing registration, muted pinks, aquas, sandy beige, and seafoam green, with a nostalgic warm romantic mood.
items.promptZh: 复古的美国漫画书页面，采用褪色的 20 世纪 50 年代浪漫冒险风格，印刷在略带泛黄的纸张上，具有可见的半色调纹理、墨迹面板边框和柔和的风化颜色。该页面包含以经典漫画布局排列的 5 个面板：1 个宽顶部面板、2 个并排的中间面板和 2 个并排的底部面板。在顶部面板中，显示了 {argument name="city" default="Miami"} 的一条阳光明媚的沿海大道，左侧是碧绿的海水、一艘离岸的帆船、远处柔和的装饰艺术建筑、高大的棕榈树和一辆沿着海滨行驶的粉色经典敞篷车。一对时尚情侣坐在车里，巨大的戏剧性漫画标题写着“艺术在迈阿密！”顶部有一个小标题框，上面写着“迈阿密，周六下午……”。添加两个语音气球：“准备好观看一些艺术作品了吗？”和“永远！”。在第二幅图中，当这对夫妇沿着海洋大道行驶时，从后面看到了汽车内部的景色，前方呈现出色彩缤纷的柔和建筑和棕榈树；男人有深色头发和蓝色衬衫，女人戴着墨镜、粉色连衣裙和淡紫色头巾。包括一个标题框，上面写着“我们沿着海洋大道行驶……”和语音气球，上面写着“看看那些颜色……”和“迈阿密感觉就像一幅画！”。在第三个面板中，展示了这对夫妇走近一家现代博物馆的入口，墙上有可见的文字“迈阿密艺术博物馆”、玻璃门和里面的人；添加一个标题框，上面写着“展览在现代博物馆……”和一个语音气球，上面写着“走吧！”。在第四个面板中，将这对夫妇放在画廊内，欣赏明亮柔和的块状和形状的大型抽象画，附近的基座上有一个小雕塑；添加一个标题框，上面写着“里面，艺术围绕着我们”。和语音气球上写着“我喜欢它的明亮和大胆。”和“感觉就像迈阿密......充满活力且自由！”。在第五幅图中，再次展示了这对夫妇在外面的水边，背景是天际线、棕榈树和一艘帆船，在阳光下并肩站立；添加一个标题框，上面写着“我们走进阳光……”，并在右下角添加一个小的结束旁白框，上面写着“美好的一天”。包括语音气球，上面写着“太完美了”。以及“艺术、阳光和迈阿密……无与伦比！”。采用手写大写漫画文字、黑色轮廓、略显不完美的复古印花套准、柔和的粉色、水绿色、沙米色和海泡绿，带着怀旧温暖浪漫的情调。

items.title: Candy Lunar New Year Shrine
items.titleZh: An ultra-dense maximalist fantasy illustration in a perfectly symmetrical front-facing composition, depicting a candy-themed Lunar New Year shrine scene exploding with color and detail. At the exact center, a kawaii doll-like girl deity sits cross-legged in a meditative lotus pose on a mound of sweets, framed by a huge radiant mandala halo shaped like layered lotus petals and ornamental festival patterns in gold, pink, orange, teal, and neon rainbow hues. She has a glossy bob haircut with blunt bangs in dark brown with purple sheen, a porcelain face with red lips, and her eyes are covered by a dramatic striped visor or blindfold made of yellow-and-black caution-tape-like ribbons. Her hair is decorated with oversized candy beads and lollipops, and her outfit is an extravagant sculptural dress made of frosting, sprinkles, bows, hearts, candy charms, pastel mascot faces, and dripping confection textures. Her hands rest open on her knees, palms up, in a serene ceremonial pose. Surrounding her is a packed altar-city of miniature pagodas, lantern towers, dragons, dolls, sweets, toys, and lucky symbols, all arranged in mirrored abundance. Include 4 large circular framed dessert mascots in the corners: top left a smiling pink frosted cupcake, top right a smiling pink macaron with a bow, bottom left a smiling gingerbread cookie, bottom right a smiling pink sprinkled donut. Include 6 prominent red-and-gold round festival signs across the upper half with Chinese characters such as fortune, prosperity, joy, and luck. Add 2 ornate dragon figures flanking the center, 2 decorated elephants in the mid-lower left and right, and 2 gold ingot bowls near them. Scatter many small doll girls in traditional festive dress throughout the background like collectible figurines. The entire foreground should be buried under countless colorful gumballs, candies, tiny teddy bears, smiley-face sweets, lollipops, beads, and toy-like creatures, with no empty space anywhere. Style: hyper-detailed, glossy 3D digital art, candycore, pop surrealism, toy diorama, festival altar, Chinese New Year iconography, saturated reds, pinks, oranges, and golds, sparkling highlights, crisp focus, intricate textures, celebratory and divine atmosphere.
items.promptZh: 一幅超密集的极简奇幻插画，采用完美对称的正面构图，描绘了一个以糖果为主题的农历新年神社场景，色彩和细节爆炸。在正中心，一个可爱的娃娃般的女孩神盘腿坐在一堆糖果上，以冥想的莲花姿势，周围是一个巨大的辐射曼陀罗光环，形状像分层的莲花花瓣和金色、粉色、橙色、青色和霓虹彩虹色调的装饰性节日图案。她留着光亮的波波头，留着带有紫色光泽的深棕色钝刘海，陶瓷脸和红唇，眼睛被引人注目的条纹遮阳帽或黄黑警示带状丝带制成的眼罩遮住。她的头发装饰着超大的糖果珠和棒棒糖，她的服装是一件奢华的雕塑连衣裙，由糖霜、糖粉、蝴蝶结、心形、糖果吊饰、柔和的吉祥物脸和滴水的糖果纹理制成。她的双手张开放在膝盖上，掌心向上，摆出一种平静的仪式姿势。她周围是一座祭坛城市，里面有微型宝塔、灯笼塔、龙、玩偶、糖果、玩具和幸运符号，所有这些都以镜面的方式排列着。在角落里包括 4 个大圆形框架甜点吉祥物：左上是微笑的粉红色磨砂纸杯蛋糕，右上是带蝴蝶结的微笑粉红色马卡龙，左下是微笑的姜饼饼干，右下是微笑的粉红色甜甜圈。上半部分有 6 个醒目的红金圆形节日标志，上面写着“福”、“兴”、“喜”、“吉祥”等汉字。在中心两侧添加2个华丽的龙像，在中下左和右下添加2个装饰大象，并在它们附近添加2个金元宝碗。在背景中散布许多穿着传统节日服装的小娃娃女孩，就像收藏雕像一样。整个前景应该被无数色彩缤纷的口香糖、糖果、小泰迪熊、笑脸糖果、棒棒糖、珠子和玩具一样的生物所掩埋，没有任何空白。风格：超详细、光滑的 3D 数字艺术、candycore、流行超现实主义、玩具立体模型、节日祭坛、中国新年图像、饱和的红色、粉色、橙色和金色、闪闪发光的亮点、清晰的焦点、复杂的纹理、庆祝和神圣的氛围。

items.title: Split Style Artistic Portrait
items.titleZh:
The painting contains only one face: that of an {argument name="subject" default="elegant young female model"} with {argument name="expression" default="little grin"}. The line that runs from her hair parting to seamlessly split her face in half is designed to look like violently torn paper. The painting is perfectly, completely and forcibly divided into two parts by one flowing lines that resemble tears in the paper:
—Left side: {argument name="left style" default="Futuristic elegant pop art style"} with strategic cutie smile subtly.
—Right side: Hyper realistic beautiful natural style with smiling subtly.
—Right side: Her beautiful natural upper-body is drowned by totally beautiful marine-blue geometric halftone circles. style.

The background is futuristic dreamy. The entire screen is effectively bright and maintains natural vividness. The high resolution, fine details, and soft blur are reminiscent of an electron microscope.

items.title: Commercial Ad Storyboard Layout
items.titleZh:
Create a cinematic commercial storyboard sheet.

LAYOUT:
- Fixed 6-panel grid (2x3), evenly spaced
- Clean white or neutral background
- Each panel clearly separated, no UI, no clutter

GLOBAL STYLE:
- Cinematic realism, high-end commercial look
- Soft controlled lighting, consistent across all panels
- No character or environment drift

STORY ARC (strict order):
1. Setup
2. Tension
3. Product reveal
4. Product interaction
5. Transformation (impact)
6. Clean closing shot

SCENE CONCEPT:
{argument name="story concept" default="A woman lives in a quiet apartment with a tense, unpredictable tiger. The tiger behaves like a domestic cat but carries constant danger. When she serves the product (cat food), the tiger visibly relaxes and transforms into a calm domestic house cat."}

PANEL REQUIREMENTS (for EACH panel include):
- Cinematic frame (clear composition, subject readable)
- Shot / Action (focused on character + product when applicable)
- Camera (shot type, angle, movement)

PRODUCT RULES:
- Product must be sharp, readable, and well-lit in panels 3, 4, 6
- No distortion, no redesign
- Packaging must remain consistent

VISUAL PRIORITIES:
- Strong contrast between tension (tiger) and relief (cat)
- Clear readability in every frame
- No abstract or surreal distortion, grounded realism

TEXT:
- Minimal, small, professional labels only (panel number + short shot note)
- No extra graphics
items.promptZh:
创建电影商业故事板表。

布局：
- 固定 6 面板网格 (2x3)，间隔均匀
- 干净的白色或中性背景
- 每个面板清晰分离，无 UI，无杂乱

全球风格：
- 电影现实主义，高端商业外观
- 柔和控制的灯光，所有面板一致
- 无角色或环境漂移

故事弧（严格顺序）：
1.设置
2.紧张
3.产品展示
4.产品交互
5.转型（影响）
6.干净的结束镜头

场景概念：
{参数名称=“故事概念”默认=“一个女人住在一个安静的公寓里，旁边有一只紧张、不可预测的老虎。老虎的行为就像一只家猫，但始终面临危险。当她提供产品（猫粮）时，老虎明显放松并变成一只平静的家猫。”}

面板要求（每个面板包括）：
- 电影框架（清晰的构图、主题）可读）
- 镜头/动作（适用时重点关注角色 + 产品）
- 摄像机（镜头类型、角度、运动）

产品规则：
- 产品必须清晰、可读且在面板 3、4、6 中光线充足
- 无变形，无需重新设计
- 包装必须保持一致

视觉优先级：
- 紧张（老虎）和浮雕（猫）之间的强烈对比
- 每个区域都具有清晰的可读性框架
- 没有抽象或超现实的扭曲，接地气的现实主义

文本：
- 仅最小、小、专业的标签（面板编号+短镜头注释）
- 没有额外的图形

items.title: Antique Celestial Goddess Mural
items.titleZh: A richly detailed vertical mural in the style of an aged East Asian religious wall painting on weathered silk or plaster, with visible cracks, abrasions, faded pigment, and distressed gold leaf. At the center, a celestial bodhisattva-like goddess floats gracefully above a large pink lotus pedestal, framed by a huge circular golden halo filling the upper middle of the composition. She wears an elaborate jeweled headdress, layered necklaces, armlets, and flowing robes in muted cinnabar red, cream, teal, and soft green, with long ribbon-like scarves swirling around her body in elegant arcs. Her right arm is raised, delicately holding a pink lotus flower, while her left hand extends outward in a gentle offering gesture. Surrounding her are exactly 3 smaller attendant maidens: one at lower left standing on clouds and playing a pipa, one at lower center kneeling or floating while presenting a tray of lotus blossoms, and one at lower right standing lightly on clouds with both hands raised in reverence. The background is a deep lapis-blue celestial sky filled with stylized cream and jade clouds, faint flying birds, lotus blooms, and 2 ornate temple pavilions in the upper left and upper right corners. Add hanging ornamental motifs near the mid-left and mid-right edges, and enclose the whole image in a decorative floral border. The overall mood is sacred, elegant, and antique, with intricate linework, delicate textile patterns, muted earthy tones, and a dominant blue-and-gold palette, resembling a treasured museum fresco or devotional hanging scroll.

items.title: Seaside Cafe Event Poster
items.titleZh:
Create a lively Chinese event poster with a warm, trendy coffee-shop aesthetic, photographed from inside a seaside cafe looking out through large floor-to-ceiling windows at palm trees, a bright blue sky, outdoor seating, and a Ferris wheel in the distance. The composition should feel like a candid lifestyle scene combined with energetic graphic design. In the foreground, place a dark wooden table with 1 open laptop centered near the bottom, 1 takeaway coffee cup with a black lid on the right side of the table, 1 black bag on the left, and 1 short stack of books near the left edge. Use a sunlit, slightly golden afternoon atmosphere with reflections on the glass and a relaxed vacation vibe.

Overlay bold poster graphics in a collage style using torn paper, brushstroke paint, stickers, and taped note-paper elements. The main headline on the upper left should be huge, hand-painted Chinese calligraphy in dark brown and orange, reading “疯狂星期四”, with a small yellow tag near it that reads “第11期”, and an even smaller top-left badge reading “活动预告” with a tiny megaphone icon. Beneath the main headline, add a green brushstroke banner with the text “下周四，不见不散！”, and below that a smaller line in parentheses: “（五一长假前最后一期）”.

Add 2 torn notebook-paper cards: 1 in the upper right and 1 in the lower left. The upper-right note should contain a short invitation paragraph in Chinese, neatly typeset in black and orange text, reading: “让我们海边小聚，远眺摩天轮，吹吹海风，和 App & AI Builder 们一起聊聊产品、远程生活与创作。” and include a small orange heart doodle in the bottom-right corner of that note. The lower-left note should list 3 info blocks with icons and orange section headers: “时间”, “地点”, and “说明”. Under “时间”, write “2026年04月23日 (星期四)” and “12:00 ~ 18:00”. Under “地点”, write “南山区·前海石公园·福叁咖啡”. Under “说明”, write “无需报名，随时来吧！”.

Across the middle-right area, place a large playful white script-style slogan with a dark outline, angled slightly upward, reading “喝咖啡、随意交流 海边散步，主打一个 Chill~”. Add 1 illustrated coffee cup sticker next to this slogan on the right. Use energetic orange paint splashes and sketch doodles around the headline and notes to make the poster feel youthful and spontaneous.

At the bottom, place a wide off-white torn-paper footer strip containing 3 feature blocks laid out horizontally. Block 1: a snowflake-like icon with the text “舒适环境” and smaller text “空调 + 宽敞桌椅”. Block 2: a Wi‑Fi icon with the text “电网无忧” and smaller text “WiFi + 插座”. Block 3: larger orange handwritten text “期待与你 海边相遇！” with a blue underline flourish and a tiny heart doodle. The overall design should mix real photography and graphic poster elements, with strong contrast, brush lettering, scrapbook textures, cafe lifestyle realism, and a fashionable AI-generated social-media event-poster look.
