items.title: Inventor Portrait Memory Map
items.titleZh: A stylized half-body portrait of {argument name="subject" default="a brilliant young woman inventor"} in a dark, moody studio, rendered as a warm amber-and-copper digital painting with semi-realistic detail and subtle sketch-like linework. She faces forward in a relaxed upright pose, cropped from about mid-torso upward, with long dark brown hair swept loosely over one shoulder, a few flyaway strands rim-lit by orange backlight, and thin clear-framed eyeglasses partly visible. Dress her in a glossy mustard-yellow bomber jacket over a deep burgundy turtleneck sweater. The lighting is dramatic and cinematic: a glowing spherical lattice lamp sits behind her on the left, casting a golden halo and warm edge light around her hair and jacket, while the rest of the background fades into charcoal brown shadow. Behind her, integrate the feeling of a visual memory map or inventor's mind palace: faint technical sketches, geometric construction lines, and handwritten scientific notes drawn directly onto the background like illuminated chalk. Include exactly 2 large wireframe forms on the right side: 1 tilted basket-like lattice ellipsoid near the upper right and 1 faint rectangular diagram with axis-like guide lines near the lower right. Include exactly 1 glowing lattice sphere lamp on the lower left. Add small handwritten text in the upper right that reads “TPMS” with three bullet-like lines underneath: “gyroid”, “diamond”, and “primitive”, and a small formula note reading “E = hv” near the right-center. The overall mood should feel intelligent, elegant, flattering, and slightly futuristic, like a portrait merged with a conceptual memory interface. Use a rich palette of burnt orange, gold, auburn, brown-black, and wine red, with high contrast, luminous highlights, and a polished editorial-art finish.
items.promptZh: 在黑暗、喜怒无常的工作室中拍摄的{argument name="subject" default="一位才华横溢的年轻女发明家"}的风格化半身肖像，渲染为一幅温暖的琥珀色和古铜色数字绘画，具有半写实的细节和微妙的素描般的线条。她面朝前方，摆出一种放松的直立姿势，从躯干中部向上剪短，长长的深棕色头发松散地披在肩上，几缕飘逸的发丝在橙色背光的边缘照亮，薄框透明眼镜若隐若现。为她穿上亮泽的芥末黄色飞行员夹克，搭配深酒红色高领毛衣。灯光充满戏剧性和电影感：一盏发光的球形格子灯位于她身后的左侧，在她的头发和夹克周围投射出金色的光环和温暖的边缘光，而背景的其余部分则淡入炭棕色阴影。在她身后，融入了视觉记忆图或发明家思维宫殿的感觉：淡淡的技术草图、几何构造线以及像发光粉笔一样直接绘制在背景上的手写科学笔记。右侧正好包括 2 个大型线框形式：1 个位于右上方附近的倾斜篮状格子椭圆体和 1 个位于右下方附近带有轴状引导线的微弱矩形图。在左下角正好包括 1 个发光的晶格球体灯。在右上角添加小手写文字，上面写着“TPMS”，下面有三条子弹状的线条：“gyroid”、“diamond”和“primitive”，并在右中心附近添加一个小公式注释，写着“E = hv”。整体氛围应该给人一种聪明、优雅、讨人喜欢、略带未来感的感觉，就像一幅肖像与概念记忆界面的融合。使用丰富的焦橙色、金色、赤褐色、棕黑色和酒红色调色板，具有高对比度、明亮的高光和抛光的编辑艺术效果。

items.title: Anime Mecha Pilot Poster
items.titleZh: Create a dramatic anime sci-fi poster of {argument name="character name" default="Puru Two"}, inspired by a cyber-newtype pilot from a mecha war setting. The composition is a vertically oriented character key visual with one central full-body female figure in a sleek red and black pilot bodysuit, shown standing confidently in a slightly low-angle pose. She has short layered orange hair with long side bangs, pale skin, and a serious, emotionally distant expression. Her suit is glossy crimson with black side panels, a high collar, fitted seams, a front zipper line, dark gloves, a utility belt, and military insignia on the shoulders and chest. The background is a dark, space-like abstract field with black, crimson, magenta, and scattered star-like textures, splattered energy effects, and a gritty futuristic propaganda-poster mood. Surround the central figure with 3 inset panels: a top-right close-up of her eyes and upper face reflected through a transparent cockpit or HUD glass with red interface lights and small technical readouts, a mid-right soft pale portrait of a ghostly young girl in a loose white gown against a luminous misty white-gray background, and a bottom-right close-up of 1 gloved hand gripping a mechanical control lever with illuminated cockpit instrumentation. Add dense graphic design elements and typography throughout the left and right edges, combining elegant serif English text, Japanese vertical title text, compact technical labels, and mecha specification blocks. Include visible text such as the large title "PURU TWO", "NEO ZEON", "CYBER-NEWTYPE", "MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM ZZ", "PSYCHO GUNDAM MK-II", percentage/status readouts like "99.8%", and other small control-panel annotations. Use a high-detail painted anime illustration style, cinematic red lighting, glossy fabric highlights, sharp linework, subtle screen reflections, layered UI overlays, and a premium poster layout reminiscent of a luxury sci-fi character dossier.

RECOMMENCER.” Finish with a full-width deep red footer band containing the logo centered and subtle Moroccan geometric patterns. items.title: Minimalist Film Noir Poster
items.titleZh:
Subject & Composition:

Central Figure: A {argument name="subject profile" default="sharp profile view of a man wearing a classic 1940s fedora and a formal suit"}.

Melting Effect: The lower half of the man's torso should dissolve or "drip" into long, vertical black ink streaks and splatters, creating a surreal, liquid-bleed effect against the background.

Graphic Element: A large, {argument name="background shape" default="solid vibrant red circle"} is positioned directly behind the man's head and shoulders, creating a "halo" or "rising sun" motif that anchors the composition.

Style & Color Palette:

Color Scheme: A strict {argument name="color scheme" default="minimalist palette of True Red, Deep Black, and Off-White/Cream"}.

Photography Style: High-contrast, black and white film noir photography for the subject. The texture should look like a high-resolution fashion editorial with a shallow depth of field.

Background: A clean, slightly textured off-white paper or canvas background to give it a premium, physical poster feel.

Technical Details:

Lighting: Strong "Rembrandt" lighting to define the facial contours, emphasizing the bridge of the nose and the jawline with deep shadows.

Atmosphere: Somber, intellectual, and high-stakes. The design should feel modern yet period-accurate to the mid-20th century.

Framing: Vertical poster orientation (A-frame), with significant negative space on the left and right to emphasize the central vertical axis.

Aspect ratio is 9:16
items.promptZh:
主题和构图：

中心人物：{参数名称=“主题简介”默认=一个穿着 1940 年代经典软呢帽和正式西装的男人的清晰侧面视图”}。

融化效果：男人躯干的下半部分应该溶解或“滴”成长而垂直的黑色墨水条纹和飞溅，在背景下产生超现实的液体渗色效果。

图形元素：一个大的{argument name="background shape" default="solid fresh red Circle"}直接位于男人的头部和肩膀后面，创建一个锚定构图的“光环”或“冉冉升起的太阳”图案。

风格和调色板：

配色方案：严格的{argument name="配色方案"default="纯红色、深黑色和灰白色/奶油色的极简调色板"}。

摄影风格：以高对比度、黑白电影为主题的黑色摄影。纹理应看起来像景深较浅的高分辨率时尚社论。

背景：干净、略带纹理的灰白色纸或画布背景，给人一种优质的物理海报感觉。

技术细节：

灯光：强烈的“伦勃朗”灯光定义面部轮廓，强调鼻梁和下巴轮廓，并带有深色阴影。

气氛：忧郁、知性、高风险。设计应该给人现代感，但又符合 20 世纪中叶的时代风格。

框架：垂直海报方向（A 形框架），左侧和右侧有明显的负空间，以强调中心垂直轴。

宽高比为 9:16

items.titleZh: A centered studio portrait of a fluffy {argument name="cat breed" default="ragdoll kitten"} sitting upright and facing directly toward the camera on a seamless pure white background. items.title: Team Drawing Japan Illustration
items.titleZh: A clean editorial-style illustration on a light gray-white background showing exactly 11 young people gathered around a huge sheet of paper on the floor, collaboratively drawing a detailed Japan travel scene. The composition is viewed from slightly above, centered on the artwork, with the people forming a loose ring around it. Use a simple hand-drawn cartoon style with thin black outlines, soft muted colors, minimal shading, and a friendly modern magazine aesthetic. The central drawing on the paper includes 8 distinct scenic elements: snow-capped Mount Fuji in the middle background, a red sun to the upper right of the mountain, a few white clouds, pink cherry blossoms on a dark branch at upper left, a red multi-tier pagoda on the right, a tall city skyline with a tower near the center-right, a blue lake with a small boat, and a sleek white bullet train curving across the lower right. Add trees and bushes throughout, plus a small arched bridge near the lower middle. The 11 people are casually dressed in varied outfits and are all holding markers or crayons while leaning, kneeling, or lying around the paper. Include 6 people across the top edge, 3 along the left side, and 2 along the lower-right side. Their clothing should vary: hoodies, jackets, a knit beanie, a plaid shirt, a patterned sweater, a blue T-shirt, a black T-shirt, and one person in a red cardigan over dark clothes. One person on the right should wear glasses and a red cardigan, another at the bottom right should have curly dark hair, round glasses, a black T-shirt, and be lying on his stomach while drawing. Scatter a few loose crayons in blue and dark colors near the bottom edge of the paper. Keep the mood collaborative, creative, and playful, with the large illustrated poster as the clear focal point.
items.promptZh: 浅灰白色背景上干净的编辑风格插图，正好显示 11 个年轻人聚集在地板上的一张巨大的纸周围，共同绘制了详细的日本旅行场景。构图是从稍上方观看的，以艺术品为中心，人们在其周围形成一个松散的圆圈。使用简单的手绘卡通风格，具有细长的黑色轮廓、柔和的柔和色彩、最小的阴影以及友好的现代杂志美学。纸上的中心图包括8个不同的风景元素：中间背景是白雪皑皑的富士山，山的右上方是红色的太阳，几朵白云，左上方深色树枝上的粉红色樱花，右边是一座红色的多层宝塔，中右附近有一座塔的高大城市天际线，一个有小船的蓝色湖泊，以及右下方蜿蜒的白色子弹头列车。在整个区域添加树木和灌木丛，并在中下部附近添加一座小拱桥。这11个人穿着随意，穿着各异的服装，都拿着记号笔或蜡笔，或倚着、跪着、或趴在纸上。顶部边缘有 6 个人，左侧有 3 个人，右下边缘有 2 个人。他们的服装应该有所不同：连帽衫、夹克、针织帽、格子衬衫、图案毛衣、蓝色 T 恤、黑色 T 恤，以及一个人在深色衣服外穿红色开衫。右边的一个人应该戴着眼镜，穿着红色羊毛衫，右下角的另一个人应该有深色卷发，戴着圆眼镜，穿着黑色T恤，并在画画时趴着。在纸张底部边缘附近撒一些蓝色和深色的松散蜡笔。以大型插图海报作为清晰的焦点，保持协作、创意和有趣的氛围。

items.titleZh: A flashy Japanese romantic comedy movie poster in a cute-but-dramatic pop anime mascot style, designed like a theatrical film teaser. Center the composition on a full-body cartoon bunny girl mascot named {argument name="character name" default="パン子"}, with a large white face, black body and one black ear, one bright red ear, thick black outline, half-lidded glamorous eyes with long lashes, pink blush circles on her cheeks, a tiny red nose, a small tongue peeking out, and a pink bow with white polka dots on top of her head. She wears a sleeveless pink dress with white polka dots and a black scarf-like neck detail, posing with one hand near her cheek in a confident, slightly flirty stance. The background is a dreamy sunset waterfront city skyline with golden reflections on the water, pastel pink-orange-blue sky, sparkles, soft bokeh, and a ferris wheel on the left. Place 2 male silhouette figures in the midground, one on the left standing casually and one on the right in a suit-like pose, suggesting potential love interests. Add lush tropical flowers and leaves around the borders, especially pink hibiscus blossoms in the corners, plus floating hearts and glitter effects throughout. Use a bold, layered Japanese poster layout packed with decorative typography and stickers. At the top, handwritten-style Japanese text reads: 「笑って、泣いて、恋をして。アラサーの私、まだまだ諦めない！」 with pink emphasis and doodled heart lines. On the upper left, include a bright pink scalloped badge that says 「2026年 夏公開」. Along the right side, place vertical Japanese text: 「私の幸せ、探しにいきます。」. Near the lower left, add a pink ribbon label reading 「劇場版！」. Across the bottom center, create the large main title in bold decorative Japanese lettering: 「アラサー パン子の 婚活奮闘記」 with pink and dark navy text, white outlines, and a cute heart accent. Beneath it, add a pink slogan banner with yellow-highlighted text: 「恋に迷って、人生はもっとキラキラする♥」. Include small faux credits at the bottom in Japanese film-poster style. Around the lower area, place 4 small polaroid-style inset snapshots of the bunny character: 2 on the lower left and 2 on the lower right, each showing different cute situations such as a close-up pose, sitting at a cafe table, wearing sunglasses, or posing outdoors. Add a small notebook page labeled "Today's Mission" with checklist hearts in the lower left, and a plastic iced drink cup with straw plus sunglasses in the lower right. Overall feeling: feminine, comedic, inspirational, sparkly, over-the-top, and nostalgic, like a parody of a live-action romance film poster starring a mascot heroine. Use vivid pinks, peach sunset tones, sky blue, white, and navy, with glossy highlights and a polished promotional-poster finish.

items.title: Gothic Anime Witch Library Ensemble
items.titleZh: A lavish dark fantasy anime illustration of 11 elegant young women gathered in a grand gothic library at night, composed like an elite magical academy coven portrait. The room is filled wall-to-wall with towering wooden bookshelves, rolling ladders, crimson velvet banners with occult gold sigils, carved paneling, candlelight, a warm table lamp on the far left, red upholstered armchairs and sofas, stacked antique books, potion bottles, crystal orbs, brass instruments, and a tall arched window showing a deep violet night sky. The overall palette is black, crimson, gold, and purple, with dramatic low-key lighting, rich shadows, glossy highlights, and a luxurious, sinister atmosphere. All 11 characters wear coordinated occult-school uniforms: black tailored jackets with gold embroidery and crest details, white shirts, red ties or ribbons, layered belts and chains, short skirts or fitted bottoms, black thigh-high stockings, and black capes lined in dark red. Place 3 seated prominently in the middle on ornate red chairs and sofa, 3 in the back row standing among the shelves, 3 in the front row on the floor or leaning close to the table, and 2 reclining at the far left and far right edges. Vary their hair colors and styles across the group, including {argument name="hair color" default="blonde"}, silver, black, red, blue, brown, and purple; use long wavy hair, twin tails, straight long hair, side ponytail, and loose layered cuts. Give each woman a calm, confident, slightly dangerous expression, as if they are genius witches or aristocratic students. Count and include 6 clearly visible magical effects or props being actively handled: 1 red flame floating above a raised hand in the back center, 1 glowing purple orb held by a standing girl near the upper right center, 1 swirling purple magic circle over an open book at the lower left, 1 faint purple arcane flame near the lap of the seated silver-haired girl on the right-center, 1 dark violet smoky aura around the far-right reclined girl, and 1 glowing purple crystal lamp or alchemical vessel on the central coffee table. Also include 4 additional glass vessels in the foreground and side tables: 1 crystal ball at the bottom left, 1 tall red potion bottle at the bottom right, and 2 smaller laboratory bottles beside it. Add multiple open and closed grimoires across laps, tables, and the floor, with at least 8 visible books in total. items.title: Dreamy Kimono Woman by a Koi Pond
items.titleZh: A dreamy, romantic East Asian garden illustration at blue-hour twilight, painted in a highly detailed anime-inspired fantasy style with soft glow and slightly abstract, heart-stirring atmosphere. In the right foreground, a graceful young woman in an elaborate traditional kimono sits demurely on worn stone steps beside a koi pond, holding a large wagasa paper umbrella above her shoulder. Her face is softly obscured and not sharply defined, keeping the mood poetic rather than portrait-realistic. Her hair is styled in a formal updo adorned with many pink cherry blossoms, dangling ornaments, and delicate hairpins. items.title: Swiss Travel Guide Relief Map Poster
items.titleZh: Create a highly detailed vintage-inspired illustrated travel poster and infographic for {argument name="country name" default="Switzerland"}, shown as a sculpted 3D relief map centered on a clean light gray background. At the top, place a huge bold black sans-serif title reading {argument name="headline text" default="SWITZERLAND"}, with smaller uppercase text below reading TRAVEL GUIDE, flanked by thin horizontal divider lines and a tiny red shield emblem with a white cross. The centerpiece is a raised topographic map of Switzerland rendered like a miniature diorama, with rocky borders, green valleys, snowy alpine peaks, blue lakes, winding white roads, and a few rail lines. Mark exactly 12 destinations on the map with black dot markers and bold black capsule labels with white uppercase text: BASEL, ZÜRICH, ST. GALLEN, LUCERNE, BERN, INTERLAKEN, CHUR, ST. MORITZ, LUGANO, ZERMATT, GENEVA, and LAUSANNE. Integrate miniature landmark buildings and scenery directly onto the map, including churches, old town towers, waterfront structures, castles, and mountain villages, plus two small red trains moving through the landscape. Add surrounding travel ephemera arranged around the map: 1 worn brown vintage suitcase with travel stickers and a red Swiss-cross badge in the upper left, 1 antique brass compass rose on the left, 1 postage stamp in the upper right reading TRAVEL TO SWITZERLAND with mountain art and postal cancellation marks, 1 realistic Swiss flag on a pole in the top right corner, 1 tilted polaroid photo in the lower left with snowy mountains and the caption {argument name="photo caption" default="Swiss Alps"}, and 4 faceted heart-shaped crystal charms total, with 2 clear/silver hearts and 2 red hearts placed around the composition. On the right side, add a vertical sightseeing list with icon illustrations and thin separators, containing exactly 12 city entries with headings and short attraction lines: ZÜRICH — Bahnhofstrasse; Old Town (Altstadt); Lake Zurich. LUCERNE — Chapel Bridge; Lion Monument; Lake Lucerne. INTERLAKEN — Jungfraujoch; Harder Kulm; Lake Brienz & Thun. ZERMATT — Matterhorn; Gornergrat Railway; Skiing & Hiking. GENEVA — Jet d'Eau; United Nations; Lake Geneva. LAUSANNE — Olympic Museum; Lausanne Cathedral; Lake Geneva. BERN — Federal Palace; Zytglogge Clock Tower; Bear Park. ST. MORITZ — St. Moritz Lake; Skiing; Luxury Shopping. LUGANO — Lake Lugano; Monte Brè; Swiss-Italian Culture. ST. GALLEN — Abbey Library; St. Gallen Cathedral; Textile Museum. CHUR — Old Town; Bishop's Palace; Rhine Valley. BASEL — Kunstmuseum; Basel Minster; Rhine River. The environment is dense and atmospheric: weathered stone buildings rise on both sides, the street is packed with spectators, and a grand baroque cathedral dome and towers stand in the sunlit background. Use intense warm amber and copper lighting, deep shadows, high contrast, dust and spark particles, gritty texture, dramatic motion blur, shallow depth of field, and an epic blockbuster tone. The composition should feel like a hybrid of underground battle, street duel, and anime-inspired live-action adaptation, with kinetic energy, tension, and hyper-detailed realism.

items.title: Cute Chinese Tokenization Infographic
items.titleZh: A cute hand-drawn scrapbook-style horizontal educational infographic in Chinese on a warm beige paper background with rounded borders, pastel doodles, tape stickers, tiny stars, and a classroom-notebook aesthetic. The top center has a large headline in playful handwritten Chinese: "什么是分词？" with the second half in coral pink and the rest in dark brown. On the upper left, a chibi Shiba Inu teacher character stands facing forward, wearing a pale yellow shirt and blue necktie, holding a pointer stick upward, with a speech bubble that says "今天来学习分词(Tokenization)!". On the upper right, a cute blue square token mascot labeled "TOKEN" sits smiling, with blush cheeks, tiny legs and arms, and a magnifying glass; next to it is a speech bubble saying "我是 Token！被切得越合理，模型越聪明！". Near the right edge, add a small hanging notepad card reading "知识点 收藏夹" with a heart icon. items.title: Chinese Cooking Cognition Infographic
items.titleZh: A vintage hand-drawn Chinese infographic on textured off-white paper with torn deckled edges, printed in a limited two-ink palette of deep purple and bright cyan accents, with halftone shading and poster-like comic line art. The composition compares intuitive manual cooking versus tool-assisted cooking and externalized cognition. On the left, a large adult cook in an apron is dramatically stir-frying in a wok with flames, flying ingredients, smoke swirls, and energetic motion lines; the cook’s face is obscured by a rectangular blur block. Above the head is a glowing brain-like thought bubble containing 3 small icons: a seasoning bottle, a flame, and a timer/clock, with rays radiating outward. At the lower left, a broken chain hangs beside large bold Chinese text reading “全凭手感”. Below the cook, a smaller confused person mixing in a bowl looks worried, surrounded by exactly 4 question marks. In the center, multiple thick arrows point from the cook’s intuition toward a structured cooking workflow. At upper center is large Chinese text “照着做”. Beneath it, a hand holds a smartphone recipe screen showing visible Chinese text including “5克盐” and “中火3分钟”, with a finger tapping the screen. Around the phone are measured cooking tools and ingredients: 2 measuring spoons, 1 measuring cup, 1 digital scale, and 6 small bowls arranged neatly, plus a pot on a stove with steam rising and a finished plated dish nearby. Near the plated dish is Chinese text “七八分” and a 5-star rating row with exactly 4 filled stars and 1 empty star. On the right, show a concept map of externalized cognition around a simple smiling stick-figure cook standing behind a table of food. The node network is connected with cyan lines and includes exactly 6 tool/info nodes: a smart oven at the top, 2 seasoning packets labeled “调料包” and “榨酱包”, 1 clipboard labeled “精准配方”, 1 blender, 1 rice cooker, and 1 recipe note sheet. Centered in this network is large Chinese text “认知外化”. The table in front of the figure holds exactly 5 dishes/bowls/plates of prepared food. Along the bottom is a simplified cognition equation: a large brain icon, then an arrow to a smaller brain icon, then a cluster of external tools/documents including a phone screen, a microwave-like appliance, and 3 paper/manual items, then an equals sign, then a muscular human silhouette with gears inside the torso and an upward arrow near the shoulder. Beneath or beside this equation is bold Chinese text “脑 + 外部工具 = 更强能力”, with the first “脑” also shown separately under the left brain icon. Use expressive sketched arrows, doodle lightning bolts, comic emphasis marks, and a balanced left-to-right flow that visually communicates the transition from pure instinct to repeatable systems and augmented ability.

items.title: Dreamy Nemophila Date Portrait
items.titleZh: A dreamy vertical spring portrait photo of a young woman standing in profile in a vast field of tiny blue nemophila flowers under a bright blue sky with soft white clouds. She wears a fitted ribbed knit dress in {argument name="dress color" default="pale sky blue"} with elbow-length sleeves, and her long straight brown hair is blowing dramatically to the right in the wind. Frame her from about mid-thigh upward, slightly off-center to the right, with the flower field filling the background and a small rope fence with wooden posts visible along the lower right edge beside a gravel path. Use soft natural morning sunlight, airy high-key exposure, gentle pastel tones, shallow depth of field, subtle lens bloom, and a romantic social-media snapshot aesthetic. Add a few large out-of-focus white flower petals drifting across the foreground. Overlay handwritten white Japanese text directly on the image: at the upper left, "{argument name="greeting text" default="おはよう"}" with a small doodled cloud beside it; below that, the date "{argument name="date text" default="2026.04.22"}"; across the lower middle-right, "{argument name="main note text" default="嫁と ネモフィラデート✌︎"}"; and beneath it, "{argument name="sub note text" default="に使っていいよっ♡"}". Keep the handwriting casual, playful, and slightly uneven like a marker pen on a photo.

items.title: Flat-Color Elf Girl on Frilly Bed
items.titleZh: A soft flat-color anime illustration of a cute elf girl lounging sideways on a frilly bed in a pastel bedroom, with the composition weighted to the left and a large area of empty cream-colored negative space on the right. She has long slightly tousled {argument name="hair color" default="bright orange"} hair, large vivid {argument name="eye color" default="blue"} eyes, pale skin, and one clearly visible pointed elf ear decorated with a red flower hair clip. Her expression is gentle, shy, and relaxed, with a faint blush, as she rests her cheek against her hands and curls her body slightly on the bed. She wears a romantic off-shoulder {argument name="dress color" default="sage green"} dress with abundant white lace trim, floral embroidery, and 4 small red ribbon bows visible on the dress, paired with black bloomers with 1 red bow visible and white ankle socks with a tiny pink bow detail. The bed has a white ruffled pillow, pink cushions including a round frilled cushion, and a beige bunny plush toy with a pink ribbon sitting near her legs. In the background, show a small bedside table with 1 potted plant, 1 framed photo, and 1 lamp with a fabric shade, plus wall decor consisting of 1 hanging floral ornament and 2 small framed pictures. Scatter a few tiny pastel hearts and flower motifs across the empty right side. Use a delicate clean lineart style, muted pastel palette, very light beige background, flat coloring with minimal shading, airy and sweet shoujo mood, cozy bedroom aesthetic, high detail in frills and fabric, landscape format.

items.title: Surreal Futurist Japanese Collage Poster
items.titleZh: A dense surreal collage poster blending retro Japanese street culture, dystopian futurism, environmental collapse, and cosmic dream imagery in one vertically stacked composition. The image should feel like layered mixed-media street art made from torn posters, ink illustration, manga textures, watercolor washes, newspaper print, spray paint, and graphic design fragments. The overall palette combines deep midnight blues, black, cream paper tones, neon magenta, crimson red, cherry blossom pink, and industrial gray. In the upper left, show a large red sun behind Mount Fuji with cherry blossom branches crossing the corner, and a small airplane in the sky. Along the left side and lower left, depict a crowded Tokyo-like city street packed with pedestrians, glowing signs, dense buildings, and a tall cylindrical building with a smiley face near the top and a vertical sign reading AI IS WATCHING YOU. Include stylized Japanese-style signage on nearby buildings. Add a giant wave motif and a pagoda integrated into the urban scene. In the upper center, place a dark industrial skyline with multiple smokestacks releasing massive black clouds, transitioning into a giant astronaut floating forward with one hand reaching out. In the upper right, transform the sky into outer space with stars, a swirling purple-and-blue nebula, and a black hole. Beneath that, create a futuristic eco-city of sleek skyscrapers mixed with lush trees, cliffs, and cascading waterfalls. Add a glowing neon sign on the far right that reads DREAMING IS FREE. Near the astronaut, place a torn poster with the text THE FUTURE IS UNWRITTEN in large type and below it But we are the authors in smaller type. Across the center, layer floral elements including cherry blossoms and large roses around a partially obscured central human portrait to give the sense of fragmented identity. In the lower center, show a person from behind wearing a dark hooded jacket with graffiti-style text reading QUESTION EVERYTHING. Around them, include additional cutout portrait fragments, a Mondrian-inspired geometric block of red, blue, yellow, white, and black rectangles, a classical marble bust fragment, a white dove in flight, a small protest sign that reads EQUALITY ≠ EQUITY, and a seated figure looking toward the futuristic landscape. In the lower left corner, include part of a noir-style person in a dark hat and coat, and in the lower right, part of a manga-style female face in profile. Scatter graffiti, torn edges, ink splatters, layered paper textures, and poster remnants throughout. The composition should be extremely busy, cinematic, and thought-provoking, balancing hope and anxiety, tradition and technology, nature and urban overload, in the style of a high-detail contemporary collage mural.
items.promptZh: 一张密集的超现实拼贴海报，将复古日本街头文化、反乌托邦未来主义、环境崩溃和宇宙梦想意象融合在一个垂直堆叠的构图中。图像应该感觉像是由撕破的海报、墨水插图、漫画纹理、水彩水洗、报纸印刷、喷漆和平面设计片段制成的分层混合媒体街头艺术。整体色调结合了深夜蓝色、黑色、奶油纸色调、霓虹洋红色、深红色、樱花粉色和工业灰色。左上角，富士山背后有一轮巨大的红日，樱花树枝穿过拐角，天空中还有一架小飞机。沿着左侧和左下角，描绘了一条拥挤的类似东京的城市街道，挤满了行人、发光的标志、密集的建筑物，以及一座高大的圆柱形建筑，顶部附近有一张笑脸，还有一个垂直的标志，上面写着“AI正在看着你”。在附近的建筑物上添加风格化的日式标牌。添加一个巨大的波浪图案和一座融入城市场景的宝塔。在上部中心，放置一个黑暗的工业天际线，多个烟囱释放出巨大的黑云，转变为一个巨大的宇航员向前漂浮，一只手伸出。在右上角，将天空变成带有星星、旋转的紫蓝色星云和黑洞的外太空。在其之下，创建一个未来生态城市，其中有时尚的摩天大楼、茂密的树木、悬崖和瀑布。在最右侧添加一个发光的霓虹灯标志，上面写着“梦想是免费的”。在宇航员附近，放置一张撕破的海报，上面用大字体写着“未来未写”，在其下方用小字体写着“但我们是作者”。在整个中心，在部分模糊的中央人物肖像周围分层放置樱花和大玫瑰等花卉元素，给人一种支离破碎的身份感。在中下部，显示一个人从后面穿着深色连帽夹克，上面写着涂鸦风格的文字“质疑一切”。在它们周围，包括额外的剪纸肖像片段、蒙德里安风格的红、蓝、黄、白和黑色矩形几何块、古典大理石半身像片段、飞行中的白鸽、写着“平等≠平等”的小抗议标志，以及一个面向未来风景的坐着的人物。在左下角，包括一个戴着深色帽子和外套的黑色风格人物的一部分，在右下角，包括一个漫画风格女性脸部的侧面轮廓。到处都是散落的涂鸦、撕裂的边缘、墨水飞溅、分层的纸张纹理和海报残留物。构图应该非常忙碌、电影化、发人深省，以高细节当代拼贴壁画的风格平衡希望与焦虑、传统与技术、自然与城市超载。

In the upper left, show a large red sun behind Mount Fuji with cherry blossom branches crossing the corner, and a small airplane in the sky. Along the left side and lower left, depict a crowded Tokyo-like city street packed with pedestrians, glowing signs, dense buildings, and a tall cylindrical building with a smiley face near the top and a vertical sign reading AI IS WATCHING YOU. Include stylized Japanese-style signage on nearby buildings. Add a giant wave motif and a pagoda integrated into the urban scene. In the upper center, place a dark industrial skyline with multiple smokestacks releasing massive black clouds, transitioning into a giant astronaut floating forward with one hand reaching out. In the upper right, transform the sky into outer space with stars, a swirling purple-and-blue nebula, and a black hole. Beneath that, create a futuristic eco-city of sleek skyscrapers mixed with lush trees, cliffs, and cascading waterfalls. Add a glowing neon sign on the far right that reads DREAMING IS FREE. Near the astronaut, place a torn poster with the text THE FUTURE IS UNWRITTEN in large type and below it But we are the authors in smaller type. Across the center, layer floral elements including cherry blossoms and large roses around a partially obscured central human portrait to give the sense of fragmented identity. In the lower center, show a person from behind wearing a dark hooded jacket with graffiti-style text reading QUESTION EVERYTHING. Around them, include additional cutout portrait fragments, a Mondrian-inspired geometric block of red, blue, yellow, white, and black rectangles, a classical marble bust fragment, a white dove in flight, a small protest sign that reads EQUALITY ≠ EQUITY, and a seated figure looking toward the futuristic landscape. In the lower left corner, include part of a noir-style person in a dark hat and coat, and in the lower right, part of a manga-style female face in profile. Scatter graffiti, torn edges, ink splatters, layered paper textures, and poster remnants throughout. The composition should be extremely busy, cinematic, and thought-provoking, balancing hope and anxiety, tradition and technology, nature and urban overload, in the style of a high-detail contemporary collage mural.

items.titleZh:
Create a premium Japanese plastic model kit product-poster layout on a clean white studio background with subtle gray gradients and a glossy floor reflection. The main subject is a highly detailed anime mecha schoolgirl figure posed dynamically in the center-left, in a wide combat stance, holding a katana horizontally across the frame with one robotic hand gripping the hilt and the other making a peace sign near her face. The character has a blurred face area, short dark navy-blue hair in a tousled bob with small side strands, and gold horn-like mechanical hair ornaments. Her outfit is a fusion of a Japanese high school sailor uniform and hard-surface sci-fi armor: white armored torso with mechanical panel lines, a red sailor neckerchief, a pleated navy skirt, bulky white armored thighs and shins, red and blue accent parts, gold circular joint details, a dark blue waist ribbon or back cloth, and red mechanical backpack-like attachments at the hips and lower back. The katana has a dark blade and a blue-and-gold wrapped handle. Render the figure like a professionally photographed collectible model or action plastic kit, with sharp material definition, realistic molded plastic surfaces, slight satin sheen, and commercial product-shot lighting.

Design the page as a figure advertisement/spec sheet with exactly 1 large hero image and 5 smaller detail panels stacked vertically on the right. The 5 right-side panels must show: 1) close-up of the head and hair ornaments, 2) upper-body torso detail with sailor scarf and chest armor, 3) weapon and articulated hand close-up with the sword near the face, 4) waist attachment and skirt/hip armor detail, 5) leg detail close-up showing joints and armor construction. Include thin blue divider accents around the right-side panel area.

At the top left, place a large Japanese title in bold serif-like characters reading "女子甲生", with the middle character in dark red and the others in dark navy. Beneath it, add a smaller Japanese subtitle line: "— メカ × 少女 × 青春 —". On the upper right, place a sleek logo and brand name reading "{argument name="brand name" default="TENNEN"}" with small Japanese text beneath it. Add a vertical Japanese slogan block on the left side of the hero figure reading "鋼に咲く、乙女の意志。" with the middle phrase in red. Add Japanese captions beneath each of the 5 right-side detail panels: "表情造形", "上半身ディテール", "武装・可動手", "腰部アタッチメント", "脚部ディテール". In the lower left, include a boxed scale label reading "{argument name="scale label" default="1/12 SCALE"}" and nearby English product text reading "FULL ACTION PLASTIC MODEL KIT". Add two small bullet lines in Japanese beneath that: "◆ 塗装済み髪パーツ付属" and "◆ マーキングデカール付属". Across the bottom, add a dark navy footer band with the brand logo and "{argument name="footer brand" default="TENNEN"}" centered, plus small Japanese text below.

Use a polished modern hobby-brand aesthetic, Japanese mecha-girl collectible packaging design, minimal white negative space, crisp typography, balanced editorial layout, and realistic studio-photo rendering of a non-existent original figure. Color palette: white, navy blue, dark blue, red, gray, black, and metallic gold. Aspect ratio 3:4.

items.title: Samurai Mecha Girl Figure Poster
items.titleZh:
Create a premium Japanese figure advertisement poster on a clean off-white background with subtle pale gray brushstroke textures and tiny scattered gold flecks. The layout should look like a luxury hobby product introduction page for an original anime/mecha statue. The main centerpiece is a highly detailed 1/7 scale-style figure of {argument name="character name" default="Samurai Mecha Girl"}, a slim teenage anime girl in a dramatic crouching attack pose, turned three-quarters to the viewer, with one knee bent under her body and the other mechanical leg planted forward. She raises a katana overhead with both hands as if about to strike. Her face is intentionally obscured by a soft square blur block. She has long brown hair with loose strands flying outward, a white headband with a small mechanical side ornament, and a navy Japanese sailor school uniform with a cropped long-sleeve top, red neckerchief, short pleated skirt, and exposed midriff. Her arms and legs are mostly robotic: metallic silver-gray mechanical arms with articulated fingers and visible joints, bulky armored mech thighs and calves with realistic pistons, seams, weathering, and small orange caution markings. The sword is a polished katana with a white-and-black wrapped handle and a metallic guard. Render the statue as a realistic painted collectible figure with studio lighting, glossy and matte material contrast, precise shadows, and showroom-grade product photography.

Design the page like a commercial figure brochure with exactly 5 numbered detail callout sections. On the left side, stack 4 rectangular close-up panels vertically, each with a number and Japanese label plus short descriptive body text in Japanese: panel 1 shows a close-up of the face and hair, labeled "01 表情"; panel 2 shows the upper torso and uniform, labeled "02 上半身"; panel 3 shows the raised mechanical arms and sword grip, labeled "03 メカアーム&ソード"; panel 4 shows the mechanical legs, labeled "04 メカレッグ". At the bottom right, add a wider rectangular panel labeled "05 武装・ディテール" showing exactly 2 katana close-up views arranged horizontally, one above the other. Keep all panel images bordered lightly and integrated into the poster layout.

At the upper left, place a large expressive brush-calligraphy title reading {argument name="main title" default="Samurai Mecha Girl"}, with an ink-brush circle motif behind the first word. At the upper right, add a gold minimalist logo and the brand name {argument name="brand name" default="TENNEN"}, with small Japanese tagline text beneath it. Along the right side, place a vertical Japanese promotional slogan in elegant dark text. In the lower left area, include small product specification text in Japanese with exactly these lines of product info styling: scale, product name, sculptor credit, paint credit, brand, and a release date line. Use {argument name="release date" default="2025年12月"} in the schedule area. Along the bottom, add a dark horizontal footer bar with the gold brand logo on the left, the brand name repeated, a short Japanese brand statement in small text across the center, and tiny legal/disclaimer text at the far right. Overall style: high-end Japanese figure marketing sheet, refined editorial composition, realistic collectible statue photography, elegant white-and-gold packaging aesthetic, anime girl fused with hard-surface mecha design, polished and premium.

items.titleZh: A hyper-detailed ultra-high-resolution vertical illustration of a surreal Japanese futuristic megacity at night, viewed from a very high, steep downward angle through a cramped canyon of buildings, as if standing on a dark hillside alley or rooftop overlook. Keep the composition 9:16 and dramatic, with a deep plunging perspective into an immense glowing urban basin packed with tightly layered low rooftops, narrow streets, elevated walkways, and towering skyscrapers fading into the distance. Frame the scene with dense foreground architecture on both sides: on the upper left, a large glowing red paper lantern sign with bold black Japanese characters hanging from an old wooden eave; on the right, a tall building facade with many lit windows and several vertical neon signs; across the image, tangled overhead utility wires and poles cut through the view. The city below should feel overcrowded yet mesmerizing, blending retro Showa-era alleyway aesthetics with cyberpunk futurism. Use a rich, graphic painterly style with strong black inky linework, bold cel-shaded shapes, and luminous neon accents, preserving a Midjourney-like cinematic beauty while adding much finer environmental detail. Dominant colors are blazing orange and amber window light, saturated crimson and scarlet signage, deep violet night sky, hot magenta highlights, and electric cyan accents. Populate the lower city with countless tiny readable micro-scenes implied through silhouettes and lit windows: festival processions in the streets, nightlife crowds, exhausted salary workers, hidden gang figures in side alleys, dancers in entertainment lanes, students studying in apartment windows, arguing couples, gamers at glowing screens, and many other small human stories embedded throughout the architecture. Emphasize the contrast between urban splendor and emotional isolation, overcrowded boredom and decadent beauty, with a satirical undertone about meaningless modern life. The image must remain aesthetically harmonious despite the density, with crisp small details visible everywhere, glowing signage in Japanese, layered depth, atmospheric haze, and a surreal, slightly oppressive but beautiful mood.
items.promptZh: 一幅超详细的超高分辨率垂直插图，展示了一座超现实的日本未来主义大城市的夜晚，从一个非常高、陡峭的向下角度穿过狭窄的建筑物峡谷观看，仿佛站在黑暗的山坡小巷或屋顶俯瞰上。保持构图 9 分 16 秒的戏剧性，以深入的视角观察巨大的发光城市盆地，那里挤满了层层叠叠的低矮屋顶、狭窄的街道、高架人行道和逐渐消失在远方的高耸的摩天大楼。两侧都是密集的前景建筑，构成了场景：左上角，一个巨大的发光红色纸灯笼标志，上面悬挂着一个古老的木屋檐，上面挂着粗体的黑色日文字符；在左上方，一个巨大的红色纸灯笼标志，上面悬挂着一个古老的木屋檐；右边是一座高大的建筑立面，有许多明亮的窗户和几个垂直的霓虹灯标志；在整个图像中，纠结的头顶公用电线和电线杆穿过视野。下面的城市应该会让人感到拥挤而又迷人，将复古昭和时代的小巷美学与赛博朋克未来主义融为一体。使用丰富的图形绘画风格，具有强烈的黑色墨色线条、大胆的卡通阴影形状和发光的霓虹灯口音，保留中途之旅般的电影美感，同时添加更精细的环境细节。主要颜色是炽热的橙色和琥珀色的窗光、饱和的深红色和猩红色的标牌、深紫色的夜空、热洋红色的亮点和电青色的色调。通过剪影和亮着的窗户暗示着无数微小的可读的微观场景，充斥着下城：街道上的节日游行、夜生活人群、疲惫不堪的工薪阶层、小巷中隐藏的帮派人物、娱乐巷中的舞者、公寓窗户里学习的学生、争吵的情侣、发光屏幕前的游戏玩家，以及嵌入整个建筑的许多其他人类小故事。强调都市的辉煌与情感的孤立、拥挤的无聊与颓废的美丽之间的对比，带有对毫无意义的现代生活的讽刺意味。尽管密度很大，但图像必须在美学上保持和谐，清晰的小细节随处可见，日语中发光的标牌，分层的深度，大气的薄雾，以及超现实的、略显压抑但美丽的情绪。

items.title: Retro Constructivist Fight Poster
items.titleZh: A gritty retro propaganda-style poster illustration with a limited palette of black, deep red, and aged beige paper texture, designed like a bold vintage screen-printed action poster. Show 2 stylized women in a dramatic diagonal composition, frozen mid-fight. On the left, a woman dressed like a nurse in a short white uniform and angular nurse cap lunges forward with one knee raised and one arm bent, her body sharply foreshortened. On the right, a woman in a fitted black dress and wide-brim black hat leans backward in a defensive pose, one arm raised above her head and the other near her torso, long dark hair flowing behind her. Render both figures with hard-edged geometric shapes, exaggerated limbs, sharp shadows, and high-contrast noir facial planes. Use aggressive red diagonal rays sweeping across the background, with black architectural bars and abstract constructivist shapes framing the scene. Add distressed paper grain, ink wear, and slight misregistration for a worn print effect. Place a small blurred monkey head emblem in the upper-right corner. Include large blocky poster text in the lower left across 3 lines reading “SCOTTISH RECIPE:” then “MINCE AND” then “TATTIES”, with the first 2 lines in beige and the final 2 lines in strong red, using a heavy squared sans-serif display font. Add a red cross-like graphic element in the lower-right corner. The overall mood is violent, satirical, cinematic, and strikingly graphic, like a Soviet constructivist pulp film poster advertising {argument name="dish name" default="Scottish Recipe: Mince and Tatties"}.
items.promptZh: 坚韧的复古宣传风格海报插图，采用有限的黑色、深红色和旧米色纸张纹理调色板，设计就像大胆的复古丝网印刷动作海报。以戏剧性的对角线构图展示 2 位风格化的女性，她们在战斗中僵住了。左边，一名穿着白色短制服、戴着棱角分明的护士帽、打扮得像护士的女人向前猛冲，单膝抬起，单臂弯曲，身体急剧缩短。右边，一名穿着合身黑色连衣裙、戴着宽边黑色帽子的女人向后倾斜，摆出防御姿势，一只手臂举过头顶，另一只手臂靠近躯干，长长的黑发在她身后飘逸。用棱角分明的几何形状、夸张的四肢、锐利的阴影和高对比度的黑色面部平面渲染两个人物。使用强烈的红色对角光线扫过背景，并用黑色建筑条和抽象的建构主义形状构成场景。添加仿旧纸纹、墨水磨损和轻微套准不良，以获得磨损的打印效果。在右上角放置一个模糊的小猴头标志。在左下角包含大块的海报文字，共 3 行，分别为“苏格兰食谱：”、“肉末和”、“纹身”，前 2 行为米色，最后 2 行为浓红色，使用粗方形无衬线显示字体。在右下角添加一个类似红色十字的图形元素。整体情绪是暴力的、讽刺的、电影般的和引人注目的图形，就像苏联建构主义低俗电影海报广告{argument name="dish name" default="苏格兰食谱：肉馅和馍馍"}。

items.title: Japanese Character Relationship Chart Poster
items.titleZh: Using REFERENCE_0 as the cast reference, transform the simple lineup into an ornate Japanese light-novel character relationship chart poster. Keep the same 10 named characters and reuse their existing portrait art as the base visuals, but redesign the layout into a polished infographic on a soft cream and pale-blue fantasy background with decorative borders, sparkles, roses, and a small European-style hotel building vignette in the upper left. Add a large Japanese title at the top, 「支配人はかりそめの顔」, with the subtitle 「キャラクター紹介＆相関図」, and place a dark badge in the upper right that says 「ネタバレ配慮版」. Put the heroine 一条 紬希 in the center as the main focus in a framed character card labeled 「主人公」, and place 秦野 啓司 in a large framed card on the right as the key counterpart. Arrange the remaining 8 characters around them in individual profile cards: 加賀坂 その葉, 川原 澪, 樫村, 紬希の母, ハルカ, 杏子, 美果, 桜子. Connect the characters with multiple colored arrows and relationship labels to visualize the network; include exactly 14 visible relationship labels: 「親友」, 「理解者」, 「本音を見抜く」, 「憧れ」, 「相談」, 「画策」, 「仲直り中」, 「直感的理解」, 「メンター」, 「実務支援」, 「保護者的存在」, 「後輩　ムードメーカー」, 「後輩　グループを支える」, 「後輩　明るさ・希望」. Also add the 8 central horizontal relationship callouts between 一条 紬希 and 秦野 啓司: 「偽溶み→公認」, 「ライバル」, 「秘密を共有」, 「対等な相棒」, 「気になる存在」, plus a pink central badge reading 「反発から信頼へ」, and 3 lower callouts: 「信頼」, 「協力を後押し」, 「二人の空気に気づく」. Include a gold-ribbon group label above the three lower girls that says 「ASTRALの仲間たち」. Add a bottom section with exactly 10 smaller summary cards, one for each character again, lined up across the width. On the far right, add 2 boxed sidebar sections titled 「作品のキーワード」 and 「関係の見どころ」; the first should contain 4 bullet items with icons, and the second should contain 4 bullet items with icons. Fill every card with dense Japanese profile text and role tags in a clean editorial style, as if for a promotional relationship guide included with a novel. Make the overall design elegant, readable, romantic-mystery themed, and magazine-quality.

items.title: Hidden Engraved Rice Grain
items.titleZh: A photorealistic close-up tabletop scene showing a large mound of uncooked long-grain white rice poured onto a warm brown wooden surface, filling almost the entire frame. The camera is slightly elevated and angled toward the pile so the rice forms a broad dome centered in the image, with thousands of individual grains sharply visible and softly lit by warm indoor lighting. Hide a tiny easter egg in the rice: exactly 1 unusual rice grain near the lower-left area is rotated horizontally and has the text "{argument name="engraved text" default="GPT Image 2"}" neatly engraved on its surface in small legible letters. Add a circular magnified callout in the bottom-left corner with a bright red outline, zooming in on that single engraved grain among surrounding rice grains so the text becomes readable. Also add exactly 1 small picture-in-picture inset in the bottom-right corner showing a casual indoor livestream or interview setting with 4 seated people around a round wooden table and an open laptop, warm ambient lighting, and faces slightly indistinct; the inset should feel like a secondary contextual thumbnail, much smaller than the main rice image. Prioritize realistic texture, convincing macro detail, natural shadows, subtle ivory color variation in the rice, and clear but believable engraved text on the highlighted grain.
items.promptZh: 逼真的特写桌面场景显示一大堆未煮过的长粒白米倒在温暖的棕色木质表面上，几乎填满了整个画面。相机稍微抬高并与稻堆成一定角度，因此稻米在图像中央形成一个宽阔的圆顶，数千颗单独的稻谷清晰可见，并在温暖的室内灯光下柔和地照亮。在米中隐藏一个小复活节彩蛋：左下区域附近正好有一颗不寻常的米粒水平旋转，并在其表面以清晰的小字母整齐地刻有文字“{argument name=”engraved text”default=”GPT Image 2”}”。在左下角添加一个带有亮红色轮廓的圆形放大标注，放大周围米粒中的单个雕刻颗粒，以便文本变得可读。另外，在右下角添加 1 个小画中画插图，显示休闲的室内直播或采访环境，4 个人围坐在圆木桌和一台打开的笔记本电脑周围，环境光线温暖，面孔略显模糊；插图应该感觉像是辅助上下文缩略图，比主稻米图像小得多。优先考虑逼真的纹理、令人信服的宏观细节、自然的阴影、大米中微妙的象牙色变化，以及突出显示的谷物上清晰但可信的雕刻文字。

She wears a round yellow sunhat with a blue ribbon tied at the back, an oversized light blue smock-like dress with a white collar, a visible name tag pinned to her chest reading {argument name="name tag text" default="兀華"}, and a mustard-yellow crossbody satchel. The mood should feel innocent, nostalgic, fresh, and slightly magical, like a children’s book illustration mixed with high-end anime key art.

items.title: Split-Screen Time Travel Scene
items.titleZh: A horizontal split-screen cinematic shot of {argument name="scene" default="Times Square, New York"}, seamlessly blending two different eras: {argument name="first era" default="1920s"} on the left and {argument name="second era" default="present day"} on the right (default: about 100 years ago vs. present day). On the left side: show era-appropriate architecture, interior or environment design, materials, vehicles, and props that clearly belong to that historical period. People wear authentic clothing from the era, including hairstyles, accessories, and typical items in their hands. The overall mood feels nostalgic and historically accurate. On the right side: show the same scene in the modern era, with updated architecture or renovated structures, contemporary materials (glass, steel, LED screens, modern furniture), modern vehicles or equipment, and current technology. People wear contemporary fashion that matches today’s style in this setting. In the center: the two eras merge and overlap organically, without a hard dividing line. Elements from both eras visually interact: people from different times look at each other, walk through each other’s space, or seem surprised by the other era’s technology and objects. Architecture and environment smoothly morph from old to new. Make sure the scene is not just a simple left/right comparison but a dynamic time-travel interaction. Photorealistic, 8k resolution, cinematic lighting, wide angle, highly detailed textures, rich sense of time-travel storytelling. Aspect Ratio: 4:3

Elements from both eras visually interact: people from different times look at each other, walk through each other’s space, or seem surprised by the other era’s technology and objects. Architecture and environment smoothly morph from old to new. Make sure the scene is not just a simple left/right comparison but a dynamic time-travel interaction. Photorealistic, 8k resolution, cinematic lighting, wide angle, highly detailed textures, rich sense of time-travel storytelling. Aspect Ratio: 4:3

items.promptZh: 一张正面照片，一艘巨大的白色游轮位于伊斯坦布尔水面上的画面中央，从远处穿过狭窄的港口航道看到，游轮缓慢地驶向镜头。蝴蝶结上有一个大胆的风格化嘴唇图案，涂有红色和黑色，营造出俏皮的病毒式Instagram滤镜感。船的后方和周围是密集的海滨城市景观，其中有低矮的建筑、码头，以及矗立在天际线右侧的两座细长的清真寺尖塔。构图对称且具有电影感，船在垂直中心占据主导地位，前景是深色的海水，上方是巨大的、戏剧性的天空。天空的上三分之一处布满了厚重的暴风雨云，但下半部分的天空却泛着淡黄绿色的薄雾，给图像带来了一种复古、梦幻、略带怪异的气氛。正好包括分散在天空中的 4 只小鸟。应用怀旧的模拟胶片外观，其中包括褪色、颗粒、灰尘斑点、柔和模糊、浅晕影、柔和的对比度以及略显风化的 90 年代旅游快照美感。在左下角添加橙色摄像机样式的日期戳，内容为 {argument name="date stamp" default="02 25 '94"}。垂直 3:4 取景，居中构图，逼真的摄影，喜怒无常的旅行明信片色调，城市和船舶的细节因雾霾而略微柔和。
items.prompt: A front-facing photograph of a massive white cruise ship centered in the frame on the water in Istanbul, seen from a low distance across a narrow harbor channel, with the ship moving slowly toward the camera. The bow has a bold stylized lips graphic painted in red and black, creating a playful viral Instagram-filter feel. Behind and around the ship is a dense waterfront cityscape with low buildings, docks, and exactly 2 slender mosque minarets rising on the right side of the skyline. The composition is symmetrical and cinematic, with the ship dominating the vertical center, dark water in the foreground, and a huge dramatic sky above. The sky is filled with heavy storm clouds across the upper third, but the lower sky glows in pale yellow-green haze, giving the image a vintage, dreamy, slightly eerie atmosphere. Include exactly 4 small birds scattered in the sky. Apply a nostalgic analog film look with faded colors, grain, dust specks, soft blur, light vignette, muted contrast, and a slightly weathered 1990s tourist snapshot aesthetic. Add an orange camcorder-style date stamp in the lower left corner reading {argument name="date stamp" default="02 25 '94"}. Vertical 3:4 framing, centered composition, realistic photography, moody travel postcard tone, city and ship details slightly softened by haze.

items.title: Japanese Aqua Fashion Magazine Cover
items.titleZh: A polished Japanese fashion magazine cover illustration in elegant contemporary editorial style, vertical full-page composition. The cover title is a huge teal serif masthead reading "AURA" across the top. In the upper right, include 4 stacked issue details: "6", "June 2025", "No.126", and a small boxed label "アウラ", followed by the price line "特別定価 ¥980". The background is a bright pale blue sky with soft white clouds. Center the portrait of an androgynous, ethereal young model, shown from chest up, wearing a crisp white tailored jacket with subtle gold piping, a white shirt, a vivid aqua-teal vest or tie layer, and a gemstone-like star brooch at the collar. The character has very long, layered, windswept hair in {argument name="hair color" default="icy white with pale aqua tint"}, with glossy strands flowing across the shoulders, and fair luminous skin. The face is largely obscured by a centered rectangular censor block in muted gray-blue to pale pink gradient, covering the eyes, nose, and upper cheeks; the visible lower face shows a soft mouth and refined chin. One hand is raised near the lips in a thoughtful fashion-portrait pose. Use delicate anime-inspired linework, airy lighting, translucent highlights, and luxury beauty-editorial rendering. Add 3 left-column cover blurbs in Japanese with teal headlines and smaller black body text: first, "透明感をまとう 初夏のスキンケア" with 2 smaller lines beneath; second, "好印象をつくる 爽やかカラー術" with 2 smaller lines beneath; third, "プロが教える 美しい髪の条件" with 2 smaller lines beneath. Add a teal circular badge on the right with 4 lines of white text: "Special Interview", "風と光と、", "自分らしさと。", and "ソラが語る 日常と美学". Near the lower center, place a small italic English line "Cover & Special Feature" above the large Japanese main headline "ソラ、という名の透明感。" with the first word in teal and the rest in black. Under that, add 2 lines of smaller Japanese subheadline text. Along the bottom edge, create 3 feature teasers with pale italic English category labels and Japanese copy beneath: left label "Fashion", center label "Beauty", right label "Trend", each with 2 short Japanese lines. Overall mood: serene, luxurious, airy, refreshing early-summer beauty fashion cover with cohesive aqua-and-white color design.

items.title: Dark Fantasy Stage Poster
items.titleZh: A dramatic vertical Japanese stage-play poster in luxurious dark fantasy anime style, featuring a single androgynous young actor in a half-body portrait against a nighttime city skyline with glowing high-rise windows and soft bokeh lights. The character has long straight hair in deep black with vivid teal-turquoise inner glow and streaks, glossy highlights, and strands flowing across the shoulders. They wear an elegant black high-collared costume with subtle brocade texture, a fitted dark coat, black leather gloves, and a jewel-like diamond-shaped turquoise pendant at the throat set in ornate gold. One gloved hand is raised near the collar in a poised theatrical gesture. The mood is mysterious, romantic, and slightly gothic, with cinematic rim lighting from behind, strong contrast, gold sparkles, and luminous accents in the hair and costume. Use a refined magazine-quality key visual composition with decorative gold filigree corners and a premium theatrical poster layout. Leave space for Japanese typography integrated into the design: at upper right, small text "夜空に輝く、唯一の星。", then "主演俳優" and the actor name "{argument name="character name" default="夜乃 宙"}" with small romanization "SORA YORUNO" beneath; along the left side, a vertical quote reading "この役に、すべてを捧げる。闇さえ、愛に変えてみせよう。"; near center-lower, small text "幻想ロマン・ステージ" above the large glowing gold title "{argument name="title text" default="夜の檻に囚われた光"}" with a small subtitle beneath "—それでも、君を愛した。"; include a dark teal rose motif and thorny circular ornament near the title. At the bottom left, add the date block "2025 6.20 FRI - 6.29 SUN" and venue "天穹シアター". At the bottom right, add a bordered ticket box with "チケット一般発売 5.10 SAT 10:00~". Center bottom credits in Japanese: "原作・脚本 霧月 澪", "演出 七海 翼", "音楽 深月 奏". Along the very bottom, add the tagline "—光か、闇か——。愛が、運命を選ぶ。—". Color palette: midnight blue, black, teal, cyan glow, and antique gold. Emphasize polished poster typography, layered depth, elegant fantasy drama branding, and a consistent face and atmosphere suitable for a theatrical promotional campaign.

items.title: Mirassol FC Signing Announcement Poster
items.titleZh: Create a dramatic Brazilian football club signing announcement poster in a vertical 2:3 layout, with a gritty high-contrast sports-marketing aesthetic in yellow, dark green, black, and gold. The main subject is a muscular tattooed male footballer wearing a bright yellow Mirassol FC home jersey, shown as a large centered half-body portrait from chest up, facing forward with a serious intimidating expression. He has a shaved head, visible neck and arm tattoos, and a broad athletic build. The jersey has dark green trim on the collar and sleeves, the Mirassol crest with two stars on the chest, the ATHLETA logo on the opposite chest, a large green sponsor wordmark reading “Poty” across the torso, shoulder brand marks, and a circular sleeve sponsor patch. Behind him, place a dramatic waving Mirassol flag in dark green and yellow on the upper right with a large club crest and two stars, glowing stadium lights, smoky golden particles, and a night stadium crowd background. On the left side, stack large bold condensed text in Portuguese: “BEM-VINDO AO” above an oversized yellow “MIRASOL”, then the player name split across 2 lines as “ALEX” and “POATAN” in huge white letters, with a handwritten yellow signature-style “Poatan” beneath. Below that, add a 4-line motivational block in uppercase white text with the final line highlighted in yellow: “DE CAMPEÃO / NO OCTÓGONO / PARA GUERREIRO / EM CAMPO. / A LUTA CONTINUA.” On the right side, add a vertical info panel with 3 icon-and-word traits, each in yellow with matching symbols: target icon with “FOCO”, fist icon with “DISCIPLINA”, and helmet icon with “GARRA”, then below them a bold yellow callout: “AGORA É PELO LEÃO!”. Include 2 smaller secondary player images at the bottom: 1 on the lower left, a cropped front three-quarter pose kissing the club badge on the jersey; and 1 on the lower center-right, a back view with both arms raised and index fingers pointing upward. On the back-view jersey, show the sponsor text “DS TECNOLOGIA AUTOMOTIVA” across the upper back, the name “POATAN”, and the number “10” in large green numerals. Add a black-and-gold bottom strip containing 4 values separated evenly with icons: lion head and “MENTALIDADE DE CAMPEÃO”, shield and “FORÇA E HONRA”, star and “HUMILDADE E TRABALHO”, soccer ball and “PAIXÃO PELO JOGO”. Beneath that, place a yellow banner with the slogan “NOVO DESAFIO. MESMA MISSÃO.” and at the very bottom a handwritten white phrase “FÉ, FOCO E FAMÍLIA!” followed by the hashtag “#POATANÉLEÃO”. Use cinematic rim lighting, intense contrast, metallic golden glow, textured smoke, and premium club-announcement poster design.
items.promptZh: 以 2:3 垂直布局制作引人注目的巴西足球俱乐部签约公告海报，并采用黄色、深绿色、黑色和金色呈现坚韧的高对比度体育营销美感。主要拍摄对象是一名肌肉发达、纹身的男足球运动员，身穿亮黄色米拉索尔足球俱乐部主场球衣，以胸部以上居中的大型半身肖像呈现，面朝前方，表情严肃而令人生畏。他剃着光头，颈部和手臂上有明显的纹身，身材魁梧，体格健壮。球衣衣领和袖子上有深绿色镶边，胸前有两颗星星的米拉索尔队徽，对面胸前有 ATHLETA 标志，躯干上有一个大的绿色赞助商字标，上面写着“Poty”，肩部品牌标记和圆形袖子赞助商贴片。在他身后，右上角放置了一面引人注目的深绿色和黄色的米拉索尔旗帜，上面有一个巨大的俱乐部徽章和两颗星星，发光的体育场灯光，烟熏金色颗粒，以及夜间体育场人群背景。在左侧，用葡萄牙语堆叠大的粗体压缩文字：“BEM-VINDO AO”在超大的黄色“MIRASOL”上方，然后球员姓名分成两行，用巨大的白色字母表示“ALEX”和“POATAN”，下面是手写的黄色签名式“Poatan”。在其下方，添加一个 4 行大写白色文本激励块，最后一行以黄色突出显示：“DE CAMPEñO / NO OCTÓGONO / PARA GUERREIRO / EM CAMPO。/ A LUTA CONTINUA。”在右侧，添加一个垂直信息面板，其中包含 3 个图标和文字特征，每个特征都是黄色的，并带有匹配的符号：目标图标为“FOCO”，拳头图标为“DISCIPLINA”，头盔图标为“GARRA”，然后在它们下方有一个粗体的黄色标注：“AGORA É PELO LEãO！”。底部包括 2 个较小的次要球员图像：1 个在左下角，裁剪前的四分之三姿势亲吻球衣上的俱乐部徽章； 1 位于中右下方，是双臂举起、食指朝上的后视图。球衣后背上印有赞助商文字“DS TECNOLOGIA AUTOMOTIVA”、名字“POATAN”以及绿色大数字“10”。添加黑色和金色底部条，包含 4 个值，并用图标均匀分隔：狮子头和“MENTALIDADE DE CAMPEãO”、盾牌和“FORÇA E HONRA”、星星和“HUMILDADE E TRABALHO”、足球和“PAIXãO PELO JOGO”。在其下方，放置一面黄色横幅，上面写着“NOVO DESAFIO。MESMA MISSIO”。最底部有一个手写的白色短语“FÉ，FOCO E FAMÍLIA！”接下来是主题标签“#POATANÉLEËO”。使用电影边缘照明、强烈的对比度、金属金色光芒、纹理烟雾和高级俱乐部公告海报设计。

items.title: Epic FC Barcelona Heritage Poster
items.titleZh: Create a dramatic vertical football tribute poster in a dark cinematic mixed-media style, combining fine-art portraiture, sports branding, textured grunge painting, and premium editorial typography. The central subject is a waist-up portrait of {argument name="historical figure" default="Rabindranath Tagore"} reimagined as an FC Barcelona icon, facing slightly to the right, with long wavy silver-gray hair, a long flowing beard, aged features, and a calm legendary presence. Dress him in a classic FC Barcelona home jersey with deep red and navy vertical stripes, visible Nike swoosh on the left side, and the FCB crest on the chest. Use moody rim lighting and painterly highlights around the hair and shoulders so the figure feels monumental and almost divine. Set the background as an abstract brush-texture composition in Barcelona colors, dark indigo, crimson, burgundy, and muted gold, with 3 major graphic elements behind the portrait: a large faded FC Barcelona crest near the top center, a vertical block of handwritten Bengali manuscript text on the left side, and a large gold handwritten signature-style script running vertically on the right. At the top left, place 5 lines of elegant serif text: the first line reads "RABINDRANATH", the second much larger line reads "TAGORE", the third line reads "1861-1941", the fourth line is the quote "Where the mind is without fear and the head is held high...", and the fifth line is a cursive signature reading "Rabindranath Tagore". In the middle-lower area, add 5 centered text lines in a refined poster layout: "MORE THAN A POET.", then a large gold handwritten line reading "A timeless spirit.", then "A {argument name="club nickname" default="CULER"} FOREVER.", then a thin horizontal red-and-blue accent line, and then a small centered FCB crest beneath it. At the bottom, show a wide view of Camp Nou at dusk with glowing stadium lights and a dramatic sunset horizon, packed stands, and a giant crowd mosaic reading exactly {argument name="stadium slogan" default="MES QUE UN CLUB"}. In the foreground place 1 football centered on the wet reflective pitch with the Barcelona crest visible on the ball. The entire image should feel like a luxury fan-made heritage poster, ultra-detailed, painterly, emotional, reverential, high contrast, textured, epic, and suitable for a premium social media football graphic or wall poster. Use a tall 2:3 poster composition with layered depth, subtle sparks, paint streaks, and gold accents. Optionally replace the visible club identity with {argument name="football club" default="FC Barcelona"} while preserving the same elite tribute-poster aesthetic.
items.promptZh: 以黑暗电影混合媒体风格创作引人注目的垂直足球致敬海报，结合美术肖像、体育品牌、纹理垃圾绘画和高级编辑排版。中心主题是一幅{argument name="historicalfigure"default="Rabindranath Tagore"}的腰部肖像，被重新想象为巴塞罗那足球俱乐部的标志，脸稍稍偏右，银灰色长发，飘逸的长胡子，苍老的面容，以及平静的传奇气质。为他穿上经典的巴塞罗那足球俱乐部主场球衣，球衣带有深红色和海军蓝垂直条纹，左侧可见耐克标志，胸前有 FCB 徽章。在头发和肩膀周围使用喜怒无常的边缘照明和绘画高光，让人物感觉不朽，几乎神圣。将背景设置为巴塞罗那颜色、深靛蓝、深红色、酒红色和柔和金色的抽象画笔纹理构图，肖像后面有 3 个主要图形元素：靠近顶部中心的大型褪色巴塞罗那足球俱乐部徽章，左侧垂直的手写孟加拉手写文本块，以及右侧垂直运行的大型金色手写签名风格脚本。在左上角，放置 5 行优雅的衬线文本：第一行写着“RABINDRANATH”，第二行写着“TAGORE”，第三行写着“1861-1941”，第四行是引言“心无恐惧，昂首挺胸……”，第五行是草书签名，写着“Rabindranath Tagore”。在中下区域，在精致的海报布局中添加 5 条居中文本行：“MORE THAN A POET.”，然后是一条金色手写大行，上面写着“A timelessspirit.”，然后是“A {argument name="clubnickname"default="CULER"}FOREVER.”，然后是一条细的水平红蓝强调线，然后是下方居中的小 FCB 徽章。在底部，展示了黄昏时诺坎普的广阔视野，体育场灯光闪烁，日落地平线令人惊叹，看台上挤满了人，巨大的人群马赛克上写着{argument name="stadium slogan" default="MES QUE UN CLUB"}。在前景中，1 个足球以潮湿的反光球场为中心，球上可见巴塞罗那队徽。整个图像应该感觉像一张由粉丝制作的豪华传统海报，超详细、绘画性、情感、虔诚、高对比度、纹理、史诗，并且适合优质社交媒体足球图形或墙壁海报。使用高 2:3 的海报构图，具有分层深度、微妙的火花、油漆条纹和金色点缀。您可以选择将可见的俱乐部标识替换为 {argument name="footballclub"default="FCBarcelona"}，同时保留相同的精英致敬海报美感。

items.title: Satirical Expensive Supplements Cartoon
items.titleZh: A clean, square editorial cartoon in flat vector style with soft shading and bold outlines, on a light gray background. The scene is a satirical medical office consultation about overpriced supplements that do not work. At the top left, a huge three-line Spanish headline in bold sans-serif reads: “Suplementos” in dark teal, “costosos” in orange, and “que no funcionan” in dark teal, with a small orange sparkle accent and an orange underline swoosh beneath the headline. At the top right, add a social handle and website in dark teal: “@elnutridice” and “elnutridice.com”. Along the far left edge, place a vertical orange credit line that reads “Imagen creada en: ia.elnutridice.com”. In the foreground, show a wooden desk covered with large stacks of green cash, with many loose bills flying through the air around the characters. On the right, a smug male doctor in a white lab coat over teal scrubs sits behind the desk, holding a thick stack of money in one hand and gesturing casually with the other. His face is deliberately blurred or censored with a rectangular blur block. On his coat, a badge or patch reads “SALUD Y COMISIONES”. In front of him on the desk is a dark teal nameplate with a dollar symbol and the Spanish text “TU SALUD, MI NEGOCIO”. Behind him on the wall, include a framed certificate that reads “CERTIFICADO DE COMISIONES”, plus a small shelf with 3 visible items: 2 teal binders and 1 small potted plant. On the left, a female patient with long dark brown hair and a teal long-sleeve shirt sits facing the doctor, one hand raised in frustration. Her face is also blurred or censored with a rectangular blur block. Add a speech bubble above her saying: “Doc, ese suplemento carísimo que me mandó no me sirvió para nada.” Add a speech bubble above the doctor saying: “A mí sí me sirvió.” On the lower left corner of the desk, place a supplement bottle labeled “SUPLEMENTO PREMIUM” with an orange price mark “$$$$”. Next to it, place a clipboard with a prescription sheet showing a large “Rx” and the text “SUPLEMENTO PREMIUM”. Also include 2 small potted plants total in the image: 1 on the floor or lower left beside the desk and 1 on the rear shelf. Use a humorous, critical, social-media infographic tone, balanced composition, crisp typography, high readability, and polished modern vector illustration aesthetics.

items.title: Photorealistic Fast Food Storefront
items.titleZh: A photorealistic daytime street-corner exterior of a modern {argument name="restaurant brand" default="BURGER KING"} fast-food restaurant, viewed from a front-left angle under a bright blue sky with scattered white clouds. The building has a beige stucco facade with a bold red trim band along the roofline, a large round brand logo near the upper left of the front wall, and oversized red channel letters spelling {argument name="main sign text" default="BURGER KING"} across the top. On the right side of the facade, show one tall vertical menu billboard with 6 visible product panels and prices: Whopper $6.99, Impossible Whopper $7.49, Chicken Fries $3.49, Onion Rings $2.49, a 2 for $6 Mix or Match panel, and a $3 Your Way Meal panel with fries and drink. Include a black drive-thru canopy on the left side with the text {argument name="drive thru sign" default="DRIVE THRU"}, and 2 cars in the lane, one dark SUV closer to camera and one silver sedan ahead. items.title: Flash Mirror Selfie in Retro Bathroom
items.titleZh: A candid flash mirror selfie in a small retro bathroom, shot vertically with a realistic early-2000s disposable-camera aesthetic. A young woman with her face obscured by a soft rectangular blur stands in front of a slightly dirty mirror, holding a smartphone with a bright direct flash that creates a strong starburst flare at the center-right of the image. She has dark brown hair with lighter blonde highlights, styled in a messy claw-clip updo with loose strands around the face, and wears small hoop earrings plus 2 layered silver necklaces. Her outfit is a fitted white baby tee with faded pink collegiate-style text reading "NANTUCKET" in reverse from the mirror, and loose heather gray sweatpants with white socks; one knee is raised casually on the sink counter, giving the pose a relaxed, intimate snapshot feel. The phone case is covered with cute stickers and a round grip featuring a pink cartoon bear or bunny motif. The bathroom has pale pink wall tiles on the lower half, off-white upper walls, a sink counter cluttered with 7 visible toiletry and beauty items total: 4 bottles on the left side of the sink, 1 black hairbrush on the sink edge, and 2 perfume or cosmetic bottles along the bottom ledge of the mirror. A beige towel hangs in the background, and the mirror frame is metal with visible smudges and dust specks catching the flash. Include the subject’s shadow cast dramatically on the left wall and mirror, soft ambient greenish indoor light mixed with harsh flash, subtle film grain, natural skin texture, slight lens distortion, and an authentic unpolished lifestyle-photo mood.

items.title: Cinematic Shiba Squat Hero Poster
items.titleZh: Create a hyper-detailed cinematic parody movie poster featuring an anthropomorphic Shiba Inu as an extreme bodybuilding powerlifting hero, centered in a full frontal deep squat while holding a massively overloaded barbell across his shoulders. The dog has a realistic Shiba Inu head with a calm, confident expression, warm orange-and-cream fur, upright ears, and direct eye contact. The body is exaggeratedly muscular and humanlike, with huge deltoids, chest, arms, abs, quads, and calves, rendered with glossy dramatic highlights and dense texture in the fur and skin. He wears only tight black lifting shorts and a dark lifting belt. The squat stance is low and powerful, knees bent wide, feet planted on a wet reflective rooftop or industrial platform at night. Put a modern city skyline in the background with illuminated skyscrapers, bluish haze, smoke, and two bright stadium floodlights in the upper left and upper right creating strong rim light and a heroic sports-arena mood. The composition should be perfectly centered and symmetrical, with the barbell extending horizontally across the frame and stacked with many large black weight plates on both sides. Use a high-contrast teal, amber, black, and gold color palette with intense cinematic grading, sharp focus on the character, and atmospheric glow around the lights. Add stylized poster typography: at the very top, a gold all-caps tagline reading {argument name="top tagline" default="NO PAIN. MUCH GAIN. SUCH LEGEND."}. Add 2 blocks of small white Japanese copy, 1 on the left of the character and 1 on the right, each set in 2 lines. At the bottom, place a gigantic cracked stone-textured gold title in all caps reading {argument name="movie title" default="SQUAT HERO"}. Beneath it, add a red all-caps subtitle reading {argument name="subtitle" default="LEG DAY IS DESTINY."}. Add a small red stamp-like Japanese label near the lower right of the title. Include dense tiny mock film-poster credits in white across the lower center, a ratings box in the lower left, 3 tiny studio or audio logos in the lower right, and a centered release line near the bottom reading {argument name="release text" default="COMING SOON TO A GYM NEAR YOU"}. Make it look like a polished blockbuster action-comedy sports film poster with absurdly epic intensity, photoreal rendering, dramatic shadows, volumetric smoke, reflective ground, and premium theatrical poster design.

items.title: Latin American Tech Festival Poster
items.titleZh: Create a highly detailed, colorful isometric festival poster illustration of a bustling Latin American technology fair in an open urban plaza, packed with dozens of people networking, coding, presenting, eating, recording media, and attending talks. The overall style should feel like a premium editorial cityscape poster: vibrant, dense, optimistic, playful, and full of readable signage, with crisp linework, painterly textures, warm sunlight, and a celebratory startup-community atmosphere. The main headline on the large stage at upper left reads {argument name="headline text" default="LATAM TECH FEST"}, with a subheading in Spanish reading "Aprender para transformar". On the stage, show a live conference with blue lighting, a presenter, and a seated audience; include 4 vertical icon panels on the stage area labeled "Educación", "Tecnología", "Innovación", and "Futuro", plus 3 glowing topic icons on the back wall labeled "Código", "Comunidad", and "Impacto". Build the plaza as a dense multi-zone event map with exactly 24 clearly labeled signs or booths distributed across the scene: "Keep Coding Keep Growing", "YO APRENDÍ EN LÍNEA", "Remote Work Zone", "ENGLISH UPGRADE YOUR FUTURE", "STARTUPS BUILD THE FUTURE", "DESIGN THINKING", "HACKATHON 24 HORAS DE IDEAS", "Café con código", "AREPAS CON TODO", "Hechas con código y ♥", "Inspiración", "Networking", "Aprendizaje", "Café", "Baños", "SOMOS LATINOAMÉRICA", "AI LAB", "DATA PEOPLE", "DEVS QUE IMPACTAN", "MARKETING GROWTH & COMMUNITY", "PRODUCT BUILD WHAT MATTERS", "FINTECH EL FUTURO DEL DINERO", "FOUNDER MODE", and "DEMO DAY LAUNCH · SCALE". In the center of the plaza, place a circular fountain with a large green geometric logo sculpture as the visual anchor. Surround it with tables, laptops, whiteboards, crowds, planters, and benches. Include a colorful hillside neighborhood in the background with mountains, palm trees, power lines, and exactly 2 red cable cars crossing the sky; also add exactly 1 small drone flying overhead. On the upper right building, place a large brand sign reading {argument name="brand name" default="Platzi"} and a green billboard that says "NUNCA PARES DE APRENDER". Populate the lower and middle foreground with many micro-scenes: a podcast booth labeled "PODCAST ON AIR", a neon "LIVE STREAM" corner, a startup workspace with people using laptops, a hackathon judging table, a founder pitch area, a fintech board with charts, and a coffee stand with espresso equipment and menu boards. Add 6 animal or mascot details across the scene: 1 orange cat lounging near the left worktables, 1 capybara at the lower left, 1 multicolor llama piñata in the lower center-left, 1 yellow rubber duck near the center-bottom, 1 small green robot near the bottom center-right, and 1 tiny turtle near the bottom beside a coin. Also place exactly 4 vehicle elements: 2 green scooters at the lower left, 1 decorated taco truck at the lower right with the sign "TACOS AL PASTOR", and 1 wheelchair user moving through the crowd. Include extra props that reinforce tech culture: whiteboards with sticky notes, a board titled "Traction" with an upward graph and bullet points "Users", "Revenue", "Retention", "Love", a board titled "CAP TABLE" with percentage rows, a Bitcoin-style coin on the ground, microphones, cameras, cables, monitors, smartphones, and branded green merchandise. Clothing should be modern casual startup attire with hoodies, jackets, backpacks, jeans, sneakers, and conference badges, featuring a diverse mix of ages and Latin American identities. Use rich greens, teals, oranges, purples, and warm neutrals, with lush plants and vines integrated into architecture. Make every corner busy and discoverable, like a Where's-Waldo-style tech ecosystem celebration, but keep the composition readable and inviting.

items.title: Juventus Cinematic Player Poster
items.titleZh: Create a dramatic luxury sports poster for {argument name="player name" default="Bernardo Silva"} as a Juventus football star, in a dark cinematic black-and-gold editorial style. Vertical composition, high contrast, moody stadium atmosphere, premium poster design with layered photomontage. The background is a massive waving Juventus flag filling the upper half of the image, black fabric with broad white stripes and a large metallic gold Juventus "J" crest on the right side, topped by exactly 3 gold stars. In front of the flag, place an oversized close-up half-body portrait of the player wearing a classic Juventus home kit, facing slightly left, with wet textured hair, visible neck tattoos, dramatic rim lighting, and the face partially obscured by shadow for a mysterious heroic look. In the foreground, place a full-body action pose of the same player running forward with a soccer ball at his feet on a floodlit pitch, centered near the bottom, wearing the black-and-white striped Juventus jersey with white shorts, white socks, black boots, gold number 20 on the shorts, gold Adidas details, and the Jeep sponsor logo clearly visible. The stadium should wrap across the lower half with bright white floodlights, dark packed stands, light fog, and subtle smoke near the ground. Use elegant magazine-poster typography integrated into the composition: top left small gold text "JUVENTUS" and "FOUNDED 1897", with exactly 3 gold stars beneath; along the upper left a vertical list of 4 words in white caps: "CLASS", "VISION", "INTELLIGENCE", "WORK RATE"; beneath that a gold handwritten signature and the year split across two lines as "20" and "26"; center-left large serif player name text with the first name smaller and the last name huge, reading "BERNARDO" and "SILVA" in white; below that smaller gold text "JUVENTUS"; lower right exactly 3 gold stars above 3 stacked white words: "TRADITION", "PASSION", "GLORY"; bottom center exactly 3 gold stars above the phrase "THE OLD LADY" and smaller text "SINCE 1897". Color palette limited to black, white, charcoal, and metallic gold. Add subtle rain haze, fabric texture, vignette, glowing highlights on the crest and text, and a polished Champions League poster aesthetic.
items.promptZh: 为尤文图斯足球明星 {argument name="player name" default="Bernardo Silva"} 创建一张引人注目的豪华体育海报，采用黑暗电影般的黑金编辑风格。垂直构图，高对比度，喜怒无常的体育场氛围，优质海报设计与分层蒙太奇。背景是一面巨大的飘扬的尤文图斯旗帜，占据了图像的上半部分，黑色织物上有宽阔的白色条纹，右侧有一个巨大的金属金色尤文图斯“J”徽章，顶部正好有 3 颗金色星星。在旗帜前面放置一幅超大的球员半身特写肖像，身穿经典的尤文图斯主场球衣，面朝左侧，头发湿漉漉的，有纹理，颈部纹身清晰可见，边缘灯光引人注目，脸部部分被阴影遮住，营造出神秘的英雄形象。在前景中，展示了同一名球员的全身动作姿势，他脚下有一个足球，在泛光灯照明的球场上向前奔跑，中心位置靠近底部，他穿着黑白条纹尤文图斯球衣，白色短裤、白色袜子、黑色靴子，短裤上有金色的数字 20，金色的阿迪达斯细节和吉普车赞助商标志清晰可见。体育场的下半部应该被明亮的白色泛光灯、黑暗的看台、浅雾和地面附近的微妙烟雾所包围。使用优雅的杂志海报排版融入构图：左上角小金色文字“JUVENTUS”和“FOUNDED 1897”，下面正好有 3 个金色星星；左上角有 4 个白色大写字母的垂直列表：“CLASS”、“VISION”、“INTELLIGENCE”、“WORK RATE”；下面有一个金色手写签名，年份分为两行：“20”和“26”；中左大衬线球员姓名文本，名字较小，姓氏较大，白色为“BERNARDO”和“SILVA”；下面是较小的金色文字“JUVENTUS”；右下角正好有 3 个金色星星，上面有 3 个堆叠的白色单词：“TRADITION”、“PASSION”、“GLORY”；底部中心正好有 3 颗金星，位于短语“THE OLD LADY”和较小的文字“SINCE 1897”上方。调色板仅限于黑色、白色、木炭色和金属金色。添加微妙的雨雾、织物纹理、小插图、徽章和文字上的发光亮点以及抛光的冠军联赛海报美感。

items.title: Classical Chinese Poem Scroll Landscape
items.titleZh: A classical Chinese ink-wash painting on warm aged rice paper, combining landscape art and calligraphy in a clean two-part composition. On the left half, leave broad negative space filled with bold black brush-calligraphy showing the poem title {argument name="poem title" default="早发白帝城"}, the poet name {argument name="poet name" default="李白"}, and four large vertical lines of poem text in expressive handwritten script: {argument name="poem text" default="朝辞白帝彩云间，千里江陵一日还。两岸猿声啼不住，轻舟已过万重山。"}. On the right half, paint a serene river gorge at sunrise in the style of a traditional shan shui scroll: a soft orange sun low above misty layered mountains, tall steep cliffs on both sides, faint haze in the distance, and calm reflective water glowing with pale gold light. In the foreground at lower right, place a small wooden river boat with a simple covered cabin and a vertical mast. A solitary ancient Chinese scholar in flowing white hanfu stands on the deck facing the landscape from behind, hair tied in a traditional topknot, long robe and sash slightly trailing in the breeze, creating a contemplative mood. Add a tiny temple pavilion perched high on the top of the right cliff. Use delicate ink outlines, subtle sepia and gray washes, textured paper grain, elegant empty space, and refined literati-painting aesthetics. The overall image should feel poetic, quiet, balanced, and museum-quality, with especially beautiful legible calligraphy integrated into the artwork.
