items.title: Surreal Desert with Twin Celestial Spheres
items.titleZh: A surreal sci-fi desert landscape at twilight or night, with a vast sandy plain covered in low drifting haze and surrounded by dark jagged rock formations. In the foreground, a rugged rocky ledge frames the lower left corner, with a steep cliff wall on the left and a smaller craggy outcrop on the right, while a distant mountain range sits low on the horizon. Above the horizon, centered in the sky, place 2 enormous overlapping celestial spheres: the rear sphere is a luminous blue-to-cyan gradient circle, and the front sphere is a slightly lower, partially eclipsing teal-green glowing sphere with a soft atmospheric fade on its lower half. The sky is deep black with very faint stars, creating a minimalist cosmic atmosphere. Use cinematic lighting with warm amber-brown tones across the desert and cool neon blues in the planets, soft mist, high contrast, ultra-clean digital rendering, sharp terrain detail, and a calm, otherworldly mood.
items.promptZh: 黄昏或夜晚的超现实科幻沙漠景观，广阔的沙质平原覆盖着低沉的薄雾，周围环绕着黑色的锯齿状岩层。在前景中，左下角有一个崎岖的岩石壁架，左边是陡峭的悬崖墙，右边是一个较小的崎岖的露头，而远处的山脉坐落在地平线上。在地平线上方，以天空为中心，放置两个巨大的重叠天球：后球体是一个发光的蓝到青色渐变圆，前球体是一个稍低、部分遮盖青绿色发光球体，其下半部分有柔和的大气褪色。天空是深黑色的，星星非常微弱，营造出一种极简的宇宙氛围。使用电影灯光，沙漠中呈现温暖的琥珀棕色色调，行星中呈现凉爽的霓虹蓝色调，柔和的薄雾，高对比度，超干净的数字渲染，清晰的地形细节，以及平静、超凡脱俗的情绪。

items.title: Food Lifecycle Infographic Prompt
items.titleZh:
An educational infographic themed "Life of {argument name="food name" default="Garlic"}."

The image must feature "a single complete food item" (such as a potato / a bunch of bananas / a head of garlic), using horizontal slicing to show the changes of the same food at different time stages, rather than a collage of multiple different items.

The main food body maintains structural continuity and consistent shape, presenting different levels of maturity in different slice areas (like time being sliced open).

The image is in vertical 3:4 ratio, with the main subject centered and horizontally expanded, evenly divided into 4-6 segments:

From left to right: Immature → Mature → Overripe → Spoiled

Each segment reflects real changes:

Color changes (green → yellow → black, etc.)
Texture changes (plump → softened → shriveled → decayed)
Feature changes (sprouting, weeping, mold, etc.)

Each stage is accompanied by text descriptions:

Stage name
Appearance characteristics
Internal changes (sugar/starch/moisture changes)
Consumption suggestions (recommended/suitable for cooking/inedible)

Design style:

Minimalist light background (beige)
Highly realistic photography style
Clear dividing lines (sense of time slicing)
Chinese educational layout, Little Red Book style
Appropriate use of icons like ⚠️✔️

Title at the top: "Life of {argument name="food name" default="Garlic"}"

Key requirement: It must be presented as "slices of the same food item changing over time," not a collage of independent individuals.
items.prompt:
以“{argument name="食物名称" default="大蒜"}的一生”为主题的科普信息图。

画面中必须是“一个完整的单体食物”（如一个土豆 / 一把香蕉 / 一头大蒜），
通过横向切片的方式，表现同一个食物在不同时间阶段的变化，而不是多个不同食物拼接。

食物主体保持结构连续、形状一致，只是在不同切片区域呈现不同成熟度（像时间被切开）。

画面为竖版3:4比例，主体居中横向展开，被均匀分割为4-6段：

从左到右：未成熟 → 成熟 → 过熟 → 变质

每一段体现真实变化：

颜色变化（青→黄→黑等）
质地变化（饱满→软化→皱缩→腐坏）
特征变化（发芽、出水、霉变等）

每个阶段配文字说明：

阶段名称
外观特点
内部变化（糖分/淀粉/水分变化）
食用建议（推荐/适合烹饪/不可食用）

设计风格：

极简浅色背景（米色）
高真实感摄影风格
清晰分割线（时间切片感）
中文科普排版，小红书风格
适当使用⚠️✔️等标识

画面顶部标题：“{argument name="食物名称" default="大蒜"}的一生”

关键要求：必须表现为“同一个食物随时间变化的切片”，而不是多个独立个体拼接

items.title: Minimal SaaS Poster with Pink Mascot
items.titleZh: A bold minimalist brand poster on a matte black background with a soft grainy print texture, designed like a startup landing-page hero graphic. In the top left, place a simple cream-colored logo icon followed by the brand name {argument name="brand name" default="Biscuit"} in a refined serif wordmark. Below it, create a large left-aligned typographic block occupying roughly the left half of the composition. The main headline reads: {argument name="headline text" default="Built for solopreneurs."} in oversized elegant cream serif type with strong contrast and generous line spacing. Directly beneath it, add a second headline line in vivid hot pink italic serif reading {argument name="tagline text" default="Backed by simplicity."}. Below that, add a smaller white sans-serif body copy block, left aligned, reading {argument name="body text" default="Everything you need to launch, run, and grow—all in one place."}. Near the bottom left, place the URL {argument name="website text" default="biscuit.so"} in bold hot pink sans-serif. On the right half, feature a cute abstract mascot: a rounded irregular cloud-like pink blob character with scalloped edges, 2 large cream-and-black circular eyes, 1 small curved smiling mouth, and 2 tiny rounded hands resting on top of a large curved pink foreground shape that rises from the bottom edge like a hill or product surface. Add a dense field of hot pink spray-like speckles and particles in the upper-right quadrant fading toward the center, giving a playful cosmic ink-splatter effect. Use a limited palette of black, cream, white, and saturated pink; high contrast editorial typography; lots of negative space; a clean, modern, approachable, founder-friendly SaaS branding aesthetic; centered-right character placement; portrait poster composition.

items.title: Minimal Anti-Itch Cream Poster
items.titleZh: A clean minimalist vertical product poster on a soft pale gray background with a subtle green tint, designed like a modern Chinese skincare or medicine advertisement. Show a {argument name="character type" default="Charlie Chaplin lookalike"} from the chest up on the left side, wearing a black bowler hat, black suit jacket, white shirt, dark tie, and gray vest, posed formally and holding a bright green plastic jar of {argument name="product name" default="anti-itch cream"} with a white lid in both hands at center-left. One hand supports the jar from below while the other points toward it, creating a clear product presentation pose. The face should have a gentle pleasant expression, but keep the composition focused more on wardrobe, hands, and product than facial detail. On the upper right, place a green brand logo and Chinese brand text. Below it, add large elegant green Chinese headline text reading “舒缓 止痒膏” and smaller English subtitle text “ANTI-ITCH CREAM”. To the right of the jar, include a circular botanical graphic with {argument name="herb" default="mint leaves"}, plus exactly 2 green checklist claims in Chinese beneath it. At the bottom, add a curved white panel spanning the width of the poster containing exactly 3 evenly spaced green line icons with Chinese captions: a leaf icon for cooling itch relief, a water droplet icon for moisturizing dry itch, and a shield icon for gentle protection. The product jar label should be yellow-green with Chinese text and small herb illustrations, matching the green branding. Overall style: sparse, neat, commercial poster, lots of negative space, premium pharmacy-ad aesthetic, soft studio lighting, realistic photography mixed with clean graphic layout, green-and-white color palette.

items.title: Minimal Anti-Itch Cream Poster
items.titleZh: A minimalist clean poster on a warm light beige studio background with a subtle wall-to-table horizon line, lots of negative space, and soft diffused lighting. Center-right stands a full-body vintage silent-film comedian resembling {argument name="character type" default="Charlie Chaplin"}, wearing a black bowler hat, dark worn suit, vest, white shirt, tie, oversized trousers, and old leather shoes, holding a thin curved cane in one hand and smiling gently. His other arm is extended in a presentation gesture toward a large green jar of {argument name="product name" default="anti-itch cream"} placed in the foreground at center. The jar has a white screw cap, translucent green body, and a bright yellow-green label with Chinese medicine-style packaging details, including small Chinese characters and the English text {argument name="label text" default="ANTI-ITCH CREAM"}. A realistic human hand rises from below to support the jar from underneath, making the product the visual focal point. Add fresh green mint leaves around the base of the jar and near the character’s feet for a natural herbal cue. Composition should feel like a modern advertising poster: product large and centered, character slightly behind and to the right, clean cutout look, soft shadows, crisp edges, muted neutral palette with the green jar as the main color accent. No headline, no extra layout elements, no clutter, no border. Include a tiny four-point sparkle icon in the lower right corner. Aspect ratio vertical poster, polished commercial photomontage style.

items.title: Dog in Leather Cangaceiro Hat at a Bar
items.titleZh: A cinematic low-angle photo of a medium-sized tan dog sitting proudly on a patterned tile floor inside a rustic old bar, wearing an oversized brown leather cangaceiro-style hat decorated with multiple metal star emblems and stitched details. The dog is centered in the frame, looking slightly upward with a calm, noble, almost heroic expression. Behind the dog is a long dark wooden bar counter on the right and a wall densely lined with many glass liquor bottles and hanging glasses, creating a cluttered authentic tavern atmosphere. On the left side, show a small wooden table, 2 wooden chairs, a dark doorway, worn walls, exposed beams, and 2 visible bare hanging light bulbs. Use warm amber indoor lighting, rich brown and golden tones, realistic textures, shallow depth of field, documentary-style realism, sharp focus on the dog, softly blurred background, wide cinematic composition, and a humorous but dignified mood. The image should feel like a Brazilian countryside bar portrait of a dog dressed like a regional folk hero.
items.promptZh: 一张电影般的低角度照片，一只中型棕褐色狗自豪地坐在一家质朴的老酒吧内的图案瓷砖地板上，戴着一顶超大的棕色坎加塞罗风格皮革帽子，帽子上装饰着多个金属星星标志和缝制细节。狗位于画面中央，目光微微向上，表情平静、高贵、近乎英雄。狗的身后是右边一个长长的深色木制吧台，墙上密密麻麻地排列着许多玻璃酒瓶和挂着的酒杯，营造出一种杂乱的地道酒馆氛围。左侧有一张小木桌、两把木椅、黑暗的门口、破旧的墙壁、裸露的横梁和两个可见的裸露悬挂灯泡。采用温暖的琥珀色室内灯光，浓郁的棕色和金色色调，逼真的纹理，浅景深，纪录片式的现实主义，对狗的清晰聚焦，柔和的模糊背景，宽阔的电影构图，以及幽默而庄严的情绪。该图像应该感觉像巴西乡村酒吧的肖像，一只狗打扮得像当地的民间英雄。

items.title: Hand-drawn Infographic Card Prompt
items.titleZh: Create a hand-drawn style infographic card with a 9:16 vertical ratio. The card has a clear theme, the background is beige or off-white with paper texture, and the overall design reflects a simple and friendly hand-drawn aesthetic. At the top of the card, a large red and black contrasting brush cursive font highlights the title to attract the visual focus. The text content is all in Chinese cursive, and the overall layout is divided into 2 to 4 clear sections, each expressing core points with short and refined Chinese phrases. The font maintains the smooth rhythm of cursive script, which is both clear and readable and full of artistic atmosphere. Simple and interesting hand-drawn illustrations or icons, such as characters or symbolic signs, are dotted on the card to enhance visual appeal and trigger readers' thinking and resonance. Pay attention to visual balance in the overall layout, reserve enough blank space to ensure the image is concise and clear, easy to read and understand. The theme is: "{argument name="theme" default="Building an IP is long-term compound interest; stick to setting up your stall every day and keep doing it, there will definitely be results because 99% can't persist."} "

items.title: Cinematic Running Shoe Ad Poster
items.titleZh: Create a cinematic sports advertising poster featuring a giant close-up running shoe in motion splashing through shallow water on a wet city street at sunset. The composition is a low-angle, ultra-dynamic action shot with 1 primary shoe dominating the right half of the frame and 1 secondary blurred shoe visible behind it, implying a runner mid-stride. The hero sneaker is a white and gray knit performance shoe with a black side swoosh-style logo, gray laces, small red lace-loop accents, a thick translucent cushioned sole, and a bright orange-red outsole glow along the bottom edge. Show the shoe covered in realistic water droplets and sharp texture detail, with explosive splash particles frozen around the sole. The runner wears dark athletic leggings, visible only from the lower legs down. Place a dramatic urban skyline in the distant background on the right, softly blurred, under stormy dark clouds breaking into warm golden sunlight near the horizon. Use intense contrast between cool blue-gray shadows and fiery orange highlights, with glossy reflections on the rain-soaked pavement. On the left side, add 3 text elements arranged vertically: a huge bold distressed white uppercase headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="JUST DO IT."}, beneath it 1 white swoosh-style brand mark, and below that a smaller uppercase orange motivational line reading {argument name="tagline text" default="YOU CAN'T STOP WHAT'S ALREADY INSIDE YOU."}. Include visible branding on the tongue label with {argument name="brand name" default="NIKE"}. Make it look like a premium high-impact commercial poster for {argument name="product type" default="running shoes"}, with hyperreal detail, dramatic lighting, shallow depth of field, motion energy, crisp typography, ad-photography polish, and a widescreen 16:9 layout.

items.titleZh:
{argument name="subject name" default="[PERSON NAME]"}. 
Act as a high-end sports graphic designer creating a conceptual tribute poster. The style is a complex "dual exposure photo-grid composite" with mixed-media textures.
CENTRAL STRUCTURE (THE VESSEL):
The central focus is a large-scale, high-contrast black and white portrait silhouette of {argument name="subject name" default="[PERSON NAME]"}. This main portrait acts as the container.
THE GRID FILL & TEXTURES (MIXED MEDIA):
The interior of the silhouette is populated by a dense "photo mosaic grid" of action shots from the person's career.
CRITICAL TEXTURE INSTRUCTION: Do not just paste flat photos. Apply artistic textures to various grid cells to create a tactile, collage feel. Use effects like:
Halftone Dots: Comic-book style raster patterns on some cells.
Fabric/Embroidery: Subtle thread or canvas textures suggesting a jersey or patch.
Film Grain: Heavy noise on specific high-contrast action shots.
COLOR STRATEGY:
The base is Monochrome B&W. Use selective color overlays (relevant to the team/flag) ONLY on specific grid cells to create a rhythm.
TYPOGRAPHY & BRANDING (STRICT MICRO-SCALING):
Top Left (The Name): Write "{argument name="subject name" default="[PERSON NAME]"}" strictly using the font {argument name="font family" default="Inter Semibold"}.
Kerning: Tight negative kerning (-4%).
Size: SMALL and discreet. It must occupy MAXIMUM 20% of the canvas width. Do NOT make it large or loud.
Top Right (The Symbol): Place the primary logo (Team/Brand/Flag).
Size: VERY SMALL. It must occupy MAXIMUM 10% of the canvas width.
COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND:
Background: Off-white or light grey with a visible high-quality paper or concrete texture. It should not be flat digital white.
Alignment: Center the figure perfectly. Maintain wide negative space around the object.
items.promptZh:
{参数名称=“主题名称”默认=“[人名]”}。 
担任高端体育平面设计师，创作概念致敬海报。该风格是一种复杂的“双曝光照片网格合成”，具有混合媒体纹理。
中央结构（船舶）：
中心焦点是{argument name="subject name" default="[PERSON NAME]"}的大尺寸、高对比度黑白肖像剪影。这幅主肖像充当了容器的作用。
网格填充和纹理（混合媒体）：
剪影的内部充满了密集的“照片马赛克网格”，其中包含该人职业生涯中的动作镜头。
关键纹理说明：不要只粘贴平面照片。将艺术纹理应用于各种网格单元，以创造触觉、拼贴的感觉。使用如下效果：
半色调点：某些单元格上的漫画书风格的光栅图案。
面料/刺绣：微妙的线或帆布纹理暗示着球衣或补丁。
胶片颗粒：特定高对比度动作镜头上出现严重噪点。
色彩策略：
底座是单色黑白。仅在特定网格单元上使用选择性颜色叠加（与团队/旗帜相关）来创建节奏。
版式和品牌（严格的微观缩放）：
左上角（名称）：严格使用字体 {argument name="font family" default="Inter Semibold"} 书写“{argument name="subject name" default="[PERSON NAME]"}”。
字距调整：严格的负字距调整 (-4%)。
尺寸：小而谨慎。它必须最多占据画布宽度的 20%。不要让它太大或太大声。
右上角（符号）：放置主要徽标（团队/品牌/旗帜）。
尺寸：非常小。它必须最多占据画布宽度的 10%。
组成和背景：
背景：灰白色或浅灰色，具有可见的优质纸张或混凝土纹理。它不应该是纯数字白色。
对齐：将图形完美居中。在物体周围保持宽阔的负空间。

上方有醒目的大标题“{argument name="主标题" default="马自达 创驰蓝天 最详细拆解介绍"}”，配合马自达品牌科技感元素。画面四周排布大量中文说明模块与参数卡片，包含“基本参数、性能数据、动力系统、底盘悬挂系统、制动系统、车身结构与安全、空气动力学设计、内饰与科技配置、版本对比、总结”等栏目，整体采用信息图布局，条理清晰，排版紧凑但高级。
中间主体车辆采用真实摄影级渲染，车漆为魂动红颜色，车轮、刹车盘、卡钳、悬挂连杆、发动机、变速箱、碳纤维部件、座舱细节都极度真实。左侧与右侧用细线引导标注部件名称，底部有底盘与内饰局部放大图。整体风格像汽车工程拆解海报、工业设计图、科普宣传长图，画面信息密度高，层次分明，画质超清，8K，超精细，锐利，专业，震撼，电影级灯光，真实金属反光，UI 排版美观，中文字体清晰，现代科技风。

items.title: Anime Heroine Promo Poster
items.titleZh:
A polished anime-style vertical key visual poster for a futuristic fantasy action series. Center the composition on a full-body young heroine in a confident three-quarter back pose, looking over her shoulder, with her face partially obscured by angle and hair. She has long flowing silver-white hair blowing dramatically in the wind, pale skin, and cool violet accents. Her outfit is a sleek black, white, and purple combat uniform: black cropped jacket with white hood and cape-like layered back panels, fitted bodice, short pleated skirt, utility belt and straps, black gloves, thigh strap on one leg, and subtle star-emblem details. In her right hand she holds a large angular sci-fi sword with glowing purple energy lines. The background is a bright blue daytime sky with soft clouds, several white birds, and an elegant white city of tall cathedral-like spires and bridges, creating a grand utopian futuristic kingdom atmosphere. Use strong wind effects in the hair, ribbons, coat tails, and fabric. Add smooth linework and smooth coloring, clean anime rendering, high-detail cel shading, crisp lighting, glossy highlights, and a premium game-promo illustration finish.

Design it as a complete Japanese promotional poster layout. On the upper left, place a large bold vertical headline in Japanese reading "未来を、自分の手で。" with the middle phrase in purple and the rest in black, over a pale decorative emblem. Beneath it, add a short Japanese blurb in smaller text. On the right side, place a tall dark vertical sidebar with white Japanese text reading "信じてる。だから、私が道を切り開く。". On the lower left, include 3 tilted rectangular inset images stacked diagonally: 1 close-up portrait of the heroine's face, 1 action shot of her fighting with the glowing sword, and 1 wide cityscape view. Below those in a dark character info panel, show the character name "ルシア" with the romanized name "Lucia" and a small emblem, followed by 7 profile lines in Japanese: "CV：悠木 碧", "年齢：17歳", "所属：黎明騎士団（不屈の翼）", "武器：双刃剣（レプリカント）", "誕生日：4月12日", "身長：165cm", "好きなもの：静かな場所、星空", and a final dislike line. At the bottom center, place the large series logo text "黎明のリベリオン" with the English subtitle "REIMEI NO REBELLION" beneath it, and below that the release line "2025年、始動。". Color palette: white, black, deep indigo, electric violet, and sky blue. Overall mood: heroic, elegant, aspirational, premium anime game or light novel promotional poster.

items.title: Pastel Anime Fantasy Poster with Heroine
items.titleZh: A vertical Japanese anime fantasy game or light-novel promotional poster in a soft pastel lavender, white, and gold palette, featuring a single heroic teenage girl as the main subject in a grand celestial city. She stands in a dynamic three-quarter full-body pose, slightly turned left, holding an ornate staff in her left hand, with her right arm extended behind her as if caught in wind. Her face is obscured by a flat pale square censor block centered over the head, but the visible design suggests a delicate anime heroine with very long flowing silver-lilac hair, side bangs, loose strands, and star-shaped hair ornaments with dark indigo ribbon bows. She wears an elaborate magical-girl style dress: off-shoulder white bodice with navy and violet trim, gold star motifs, layered asymmetrical skirt in white, periwinkle, violet, and deep indigo, a very large dark blue waist bow with a gold star jewel, detached flowing sleeves, gold chains with tiny star charms draped at the hip, white thigh-high stockings, and a blue star-shaped garter ornament on one thigh. Her staff is tall and elegant, dark shaft with gold frame elements and a suspended faceted blue crystal near the top, decorated with bows and star accents. The background is an airy fantasy skyline of white towers, cathedral-like spires, clouds, feathers, and drifting pink petals, with bright ethereal backlighting and a dreamy heroic atmosphere. Compose it like a polished key visual poster with abundant Japanese typography integrated into the artwork. At the upper left, place the Japanese tagline text "願いが、未来を照らす。" with two smaller lines below it. At the upper right, place a star-like emblem, the large character name "ルミナ", the subtitle "— Lumina —", and a smaller CV credit line. On the right side, add 3 vertically stacked feature callouts, each with a small icon and a bold Japanese heading followed by 2 short lines of smaller text. On the left side, add 1 vertical Japanese copy block running downward beside the character. At the lower right, include 3 small portrait inset panels of the same girl, stacked diagonally: 1 calm front-facing expression, 1 side-profile serious expression, and 1 smiling eyes-closed expression. At the lower left, place the large Japanese title "星紡ぐレガシア" with the English subtitle "— LEGACIA: Weave the Stars —" beneath it. At the bottom right, add the date text "2025. 夏" and one short Japanese tagline line below. At the very bottom edge, include 2 small social or website info blocks on the left and a tiny copyright line on the right. Render in high-end modern anime promotional illustration style, luminous pastel fantasy atmosphere, elegant composition, smooth linework and coloring, soft cel shading, delicate fabric movement, glossy highlights, intricate costume details, clean typography layout, and refined commercial poster finish.

items.title: Dark Comedy Insect Spray Ad
items.titleZh: A darkly comedic, cinematic product advertisement staged in a messy modern living room at night. In the background, a person in a full {argument name="superhero costume" default="Spider-Man-inspired red and blue suit"} lies face-down and motionless on a wooden floor, one arm stretched toward the camera, posed like a defeated superhero after a battle. The room is dim and moody with a gray couch in soft focus, pillows and blankets tossed around, and scattered white popcorn across the floor. In the left foreground, show 1 open pizza box cropped into frame. In the right foreground, place 1 large upright can of {argument name="product name" default="Raid"} insect spray as the hero object, sharply focused, oversized in perspective, with a black cap and a purple label facing camera. Make the product feel dominant, clean, and commercial, with dramatic rim lighting and glossy reflections. Add 2 lines of bold white uppercase ad copy: at the top, very large condensed sans-serif text reading {argument name="headline text" default="NOT EVEN A SUPERHERO SURVIVES."}; at the bottom center, smaller bold text reading {argument name="tagline text" default="Raid. Kills bugs dead."}. Include 2 visible insect illustrations on the can label, and keep the overall tone like a high-end shock-value commercial campaign: realistic photography, shallow depth of field, strong contrast, gritty floor texture, subdued gray-blue interior lighting, and a composition that makes the spray can the clear focal point while the fallen hero tells the joke in the background.
items.promptZh: 夜间在凌乱的现代客厅中上演的黑色喜剧电影产品广告。背景中，一个穿着全套{argument name="superhero dress" default="蜘蛛侠风格的红蓝套装"}的人脸朝下一动不动地躺在木地板上，一只手臂伸向镜头，摆出一副战斗后战败的超级英雄的姿势。房间昏暗而喜怒无常，灰色的沙发焦点柔和，枕头和毯子扔得到处都是，白色的爆米花散落在地板上。在左侧前景中，显示了 1 个打开的披萨盒，并被裁剪到框架中。在右侧前景中，放置 1 个直立的大罐 {argument name="product name" default="Raid"} 昆虫喷雾剂作为英雄对象，焦点清晰，视角超大，带有黑色帽子和面向相机的紫色标签。通过戏剧性的边缘照明和光泽反射，让产品给人一种主导、干净和商业的感觉。添加 2 行粗体白色大写广告文案：在顶部，非常大的压缩无衬线文本，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="NOT EVEN A SUPERHERO SURVIVES."}；在底部中心，较小的粗体文本显示为{argument name="tagline text" default="Raid. Kills bugs dead."}。在罐头标签上添加 2 个可见的昆虫插图，并保持像高端震撼价值商业广告一样的整体基调：逼真的摄影、浅景深、强烈的对比度、砂砾地板纹理、柔和的灰蓝色内部照明，以及使喷雾罐成为清晰焦点的构图，而倒下的英雄在背景中讲述笑话。

items.title: Darkly Comic Bug Spray Ad
items.titleZh: Create a gritty, darkly comedic advertising image for a bug spray product in a realistic cinematic photo style. The scene is a messy sunlit living room with a wooden floor, soft warm afternoon light coming from tall windows on the left, shallow depth of field, and a low camera angle near floor level. In the foreground on the right, place a sharply focused aerosol can of {argument name="product brand" default="Raid"} bug spray standing upright, large in frame, label facing camera. The can is red and black with bold yellow branding, and the visible label reads "Raid", "ANT & ROACH", and "KILLS BUGS DEAD". In the midground and stretching toward the left side of the room, show 1 exhausted fallen superhero in a red-and-blue spider-themed suit, lying face-down and sprawled across the floor as if defeated, one gloved hand reaching toward the camera. Scatter exactly 6 visible dead bugs across the floor around the can and superhero. The room should include 4 background furniture elements: a sofa on the far left, a small side table, a wooden cabinet at the back, and a second storage unit on the right, all slightly out of focus. Add a bold oversized distressed white uppercase headline across the top that reads {argument name="headline text" default="NOT EVEN A SUPERHERO SURVIVES."} and a smaller bold white tagline centered at the bottom that reads {argument name="tagline text" default="Raid. Kills bugs dead."}. Emphasize strong product focus, ironic shock-value humor, realistic textures, dramatic shadows, commercial ad composition, and polished premium campaign photography for e-commerce or social media marketing.

Kills bugs dead."}。强调强烈的产品焦点、讽刺性的震撼幽默、逼真的纹理、戏剧性的阴影、商业广告构图以及用于电子商务或社交媒体营销的精美优质活动摄影。

items.title: Vintage Knight Helmet Etching
items.titleZh: A centered black-and-white vintage ink illustration of a medieval knight’s helmet and upper neck guard, shown as a bust on a plain light gray background with lots of negative space. The helmet is angled slightly to the left in three-quarter view, with a rounded domed top, a narrow horizontal visor slit, and a faceplate featuring 6 vertical ventilation slits. Include a riveted gorget with visible metal studs and a draped cloth or cape falling over the right shoulder. Render it in an engraved woodcut or etching style with bold black outlines, dense stippling, scratchy crosshatching, and high contrast shading, like an old heraldic emblem or antique book illustration. Clean isolated composition, no text, no border, no additional objects.
items.promptZh: 中世纪骑士头盔和上颈护甲的中心黑白复古墨水插图，在纯浅灰色背景上显示为半身像，有大量负空间。头盔在四分之三视图中略微向左倾斜，具有圆形圆顶顶部、狭窄的水平面甲缝隙和具有 6 个垂直通风缝隙的面板。包括一个带有可见金属钉的铆接护颈和一件垂在右肩上的布或斗篷。以雕刻的木刻或蚀刻风格渲染它，带有粗体的黑色轮廓、密集的点画、粗糙的交叉影线和高对比度阴影，就像古老的纹章徽章或古董书籍插图。干净的独立构图，没有文本，没有边框，没有附加对象。

items.title: Hooded Rogue with Blurred Face
items.titleZh: A minimalist monochrome fantasy portrait on a flat light gray background, centered with lots of empty negative space around the subject. Show a bust-length hooded rogue or medieval assassin facing slightly to the right, rendered as a high-contrast black ink illustration with dense stippling, scratchy engraving-like texture, and dramatic white highlights on the folds of the cloth. The figure wears a deep cowl and heavy hood that completely obscure the head and most of the face, plus a layered scarf wrapped around the neck and a single worn metal shoulder pauldron on the right side with visible rivets, scratches, and a leather strap crossing the chest. Replace the visible face area with a single vertical soft-edged blurred rectangle in gray-black tones, creating an intentional censored or glitched void where the face should be. Keep the composition simple: 1 character, 1 shoulder pauldron, 1 blurred rectangular face block, no additional props, no scenery, no text. Style it like a dark fantasy woodcut or vintage pen-and-ink print, isolated emblem-like portrait, stark black on pale gray.
items.promptZh: 平坦的浅灰色背景上的极简主义单色奇幻肖像，以主题周围的大量空白负空间为中心。展示一个半身长的带兜帽的盗贼或中世纪刺客，脸稍微向右，渲染为高对比度黑色墨水插图，具有密集的点画、粗糙的雕刻般的纹理，以及布料褶皱上引人注目的白色高光。该人物戴着深罩和厚重的兜帽，完全遮住了头部和大部分脸部，脖子上缠着一条多层围巾，右侧有一个磨损的金属肩甲，肩甲上有明显的铆钉、划痕，一条皮带交叉在胸前。用灰黑色调的单个垂直软边模糊矩形替换可见的面部区域，在面部应有的位置故意创建一个经过审查或出现故障的空白。保持构图简单：1个人物，1个肩甲，1个模糊的长方形脸块，没有额外的道具，没有风景，没有文字。它的风格就像黑暗奇幻木刻或复古钢笔印刷、孤立的徽章式肖像、浅灰色上的纯黑色。

items.titleZh: Create a clean, square split-screen commercial image for athleisure clothing with polished ad photography and realistic typography. At the top across the full width, place a large bold all-caps white headline in a heavy sans-serif font: {argument name="headline text" default="BOUGHT FOR THE GYM. USED FOR THE COUCH."} The layout is divided vertically into 2 equal panels. In the left panel, show a neatly arranged flat lay of 5 apparel items on a smooth light gray studio background with soft directional lighting and subtle shadows: 1 black hoodie with drawstrings and a small white swoosh-style chest logo, 1 pair of black athletic shorts with a small white logo near the hem, 1 pair of white crew socks with black swoosh-style logos, and 1 pair of black running shoes with white midsoles and white swoosh-style side logos. The clothing should look premium, minimal, and carefully styled like an e-commerce campaign. In the right panel, show a young man wearing the same black hoodie, black shorts, white crew socks, and black running shoes, slouched lazily on a dark charcoal fabric couch in a dim cozy living room, holding a smartphone and looking relaxed and unmotivated. In front of him on a dark coffee table are 6 visible lounge items: 1 open pizza box with a pizza, 1 red soda can, 1 large red bag of nacho cheese tortilla chips, 1 TV remote, 1 blue bowl of chips, and 1 pink-frosted sprinkled donut partly visible at the bottom edge. Add a draped gray blanket on the couch and keep the mood humorous and relatable. At the bottom center, overlay a smaller white caption in a clean sans-serif font: {argument name="tagline text" default="Still worth it."} High-end product advertising aesthetic, crisp text rendering, brand-aware lifestyle marketing, realistic materials, balanced composition, subtle contrast between aspirational fitness purchase and actual couch use.

items.title: Cockatiel Owner Seed Spill Comic
items.titleZh: A single-panel Japanese comic-style illustration on a light wooden floor, drawn in a soft, detailed, slightly vintage manga-anime style with clean ink outlines and muted warm colors. In the center, a young woman kneels on the floor in a gray cockatiel kigurumi pajama suit with a white belly panel and small gray wings, while wearing an oversized yellow cockatiel hood shaped like a bird’s head with crest, round black eyes, orange cheek patches, and a beak above her forehead. She holds both sides of the hood in shock, her posture frozen and guilty, with a large rectangular censor block covering the center of her face. Across the floor in front of her is a huge mess of spilled birdseed: mixed grains, pellets, shells, and seeds scattered widely in a dense irregular pile. On the left lies 1 overturned white seed cup spilling its contents, and in the lower left corner 1 vacuum cleaner floor head points toward the mess, with part of the hose visible at the lower right edge. On the right stands 1 real cockatiel, small and curious, with a yellow face, orange cheeks, pale body, gray wings, and a raised crest, looking toward the kneeling woman; next to the bird is 1 small speech bubble containing a question mark. The background is simple indoor flooring with dramatic dark vertical stress lines filling the upper half to heighten panic. Add 4 Japanese text elements integrated like manga lettering: a huge sound effect 「ガーン」 at the upper left, 1 vertical thought bubble on the left reading 「やっちゃった…」, 1 large vertical spiky speech bubble on the upper right reading 「これ…掃除機かけるの…？無理ゲーすぎる…！」, and 1 beige caption box at the bottom right reading 「オカメ飼い、あるある。」. The mood is comedic embarrassment and domestic disaster, as if illustrating a relatable bird-owner mistake.

items.title: Bold KFC Food Ad Poster
items.titleZh: A bold square fast-food advertisement poster in a clean studio setup, designed like a premium KFC campaign. The composition is perfectly centered with a white background panel in the middle and solid bright red vertical side panels on both the left and right. At the very top, place 3 short red vertical stripes spaced evenly across the upper margin, referencing the KFC brand motif. Under them, add a large stacked headline in heavy bold sans-serif uppercase text: “THIS IS NOT A FILTER.” in black, followed directly below by “IT’S JUST KFC.” in bright red. In the center foreground, show a young man with short dark curly hair wearing a dark red crew-neck shirt, leaning forward behind a large bucket of fried chicken as if smelling the food; only his hair, ears, shoulders, and upper torso are visible, and his face is obscured by a rectangular blur block. The bucket is oversized and centered on a white tabletop, filled with 6 visible pieces of golden crispy fried chicken with textured crunchy breading, with light steam rising from the chicken. The bucket is white with red side panels and a black KFC-style logo on the front, with the face area obscured by a metallic gray blur block. On the left side of the table, place 1 red-and-white striped fries carton filled with golden French fries, with a few extra fries scattered on the tabletop in front; the carton also has the KFC-style logo with its face area obscured. On the right side, place 1 tall transparent glass of dark cola packed with ice, condensation visible on the outside, branded with the KFC-style logo with the face area obscured. In front of the drink, place 1 small white dipping bowl filled with glossy red ketchup. At the bottom center, add the tagline in bold black sans-serif: “Crispy. Juicy. Irresistible.” and beneath it a small cursive signature-style line reading “Col. Harland Sanders.” with a small rectangular red accent below. Use highly polished commercial food photography lighting, vivid red-white-black brand colors, sharp focus on the food, realistic textures, symmetrical layout, premium poster ad styling, and a clean modern social-media-ready square format.
items.promptZh: 干净的工作室环境中醒目的方形快餐广告海报，设计类似于优质肯德基广告活动。该构图完美居中，中间有白色背景面板，左侧和右侧都有纯亮红色垂直侧面板。在最顶部，放置 3 条短的红色垂直条纹，这些条纹均匀地分布在上边缘，参考肯德基品牌图案。在它们下面，添加一个大的堆叠标题，采用粗体无衬线大写文本：“这不是过滤器。”黑色，正下方是“IT'S JUST KFC”。呈鲜红色。前景中央，一个身穿深红色圆领衬衫、留着深色短卷发的年轻人，在一大桶炸鸡后面倾身向前，仿佛闻到了食物的味道；只有他的头发、耳朵、肩膀和上半身可见，他的脸被一个矩形模糊块遮挡。水桶超大，以白色桌面为中心，里面装满了6块肉眼可见的金黄酥脆的炸鸡，外面裹着有质感的脆脆面包屑，鸡身上冒着淡淡的蒸汽。桶是白色的，带有红色侧板，正面有黑色肯德基风格的标志，面部区域被金属灰色模糊块遮挡。桌子左边放1个红白条纹薯条盒，里面装满了金色的薯条，前面的桌面上还撒了一些薯条；纸盒上还有肯德基风格的标志，但正面区域被遮盖了。在右侧，放置 1 个高高透明的黑可乐，里面装满了冰块，外部可见凝结物，上面印有肯德基风格的标志，但脸部区域被遮住了。在饮料前面，放置 1 个装满亮红色番茄酱的白色小碗。在底部中心，添加粗体黑色无衬线标语：“香脆。多汁。不可抗拒。”其下方有一行草书签名风格的小字，上面写着“哈兰·桑德斯上校”。下面有一个小矩形红色口音。使用高度抛光的商业食品摄影照明、​​生动的红白黑品牌颜色、对食品的清晰聚焦、逼真的纹理、对称的布局、优质的海报广告造型以及干净的现代社交媒体就绪的方形格式。

A young man is seen from behind, wearing a light gray hoodie, black athletic shorts, white crew socks, and white sneakers, stretching upward to grab a Pepsi bottle from the very top shelf. He is standing precariously on a vertical stack of exactly 4 red Coca-Cola cans arranged one on top of another on the floor, making the visual joke that getting Pepsi is literally worth the extra steps. The vending machine is fully stocked and brightly lit with cool white interior lighting: the top shelf contains multiple Pepsi bottles, the middle shelves contain assorted clear, green, yellow, and amber bottled drinks, and the lower shelf displays rows of red Coca-Cola cans. items.title: Anime Office Lady Beer Toast at Night
items.titleZh: A polished anime-style night illustration in a tall 1:2 vertical composition. A young Japanese office lady stands on a riverside promenade at night, facing the viewer, offering a large glass beer mug forward in a cheerful toast. She wears a fitted dark navy business suit with a pencil skirt, white dress shirt, red necktie, and a company ID badge on a lanyard. She has long straight dark brown to black hair with soft bangs, a slim figure, and a friendly after-work mood. Her right arm is extended toward the camera holding the frosty beer mug filled with golden lager and a foamy head, making the mug appear large in the foreground because of perspective. Her left arm hangs naturally by her side. Add a single white manga-style speech balloon to her upper right with vertical Japanese text reading 「今日もお疲れさまでした！」. Set the scene on a paved waterfront walkway with metal railings, 3 visible warm lantern lights along the path, a river or canal behind her, and a modern city skyline with many illuminated windows in the background. Above, a clear deep blue star-filled night sky dominates most of the image, with the Milky Way forming a bright diagonal band from lower center behind the character toward the upper right. Use cinematic lighting with cool moonlit blues contrasted by warm lantern glows, crisp linework, subtle glossy shading on the suit, detailed star field, and a calm, celebratory end-of-work atmosphere.

items.title: LEGO Plaza de España at Sunset
items.titleZh: A highly detailed photorealistic LEGO interpretation of {argument name="landmark" default="Plaza de España, Seville"}, shown as a grand golden-hour architectural scene from canal level. The image is vertical and cinematic, with the viewer looking straight down a narrow curved canal toward an ornate Spanish Renaissance Revival palace facade built entirely from LEGO bricks. The warm terracotta building fills the upper half of the frame, with multiple towers, arched colonnades, balconies, decorative cornices, and intricate brick-built ornamentation. A small Spanish flag flies from the central tower. In the foreground, a LEGO rowboat with 2 minifigures is seen from behind, drifting along the canal; one has reddish-brown hair and the other light brown hair, both rowing with long brown oars. In the mid-distance, there is a second small rowboat with 2 minifigures under or near an elegant arched bridge. Count 2 boats total and 4 rowing passengers total. Along the right-side promenade, count 4 visible standing minifigures placed at intervals beside the tiled railing. The canal is lined with detailed blue, white, and yellow ceramic-style LEGO mosaic balustrades and brick parapets, with black vintage street lamps; count 7 visible lamp posts total. On the left edge, include 2 rounded pink flowering shrubs in planters. The bridge crossing the canal has ornate blue-and-white LEGO tile patterns and a graceful single arch. The water should look realistic yet made from small glossy LEGO-like tiles, with dark teal reflections of the building and sky. Lighting is soft sunset light with a glowing amber sky, scattered clouds, long highlights, and rich warm shadows. Emphasize realism, fine texture, playful scale illusion, and the convincing blend of real architectural grandeur with unmistakable LEGO construction.
items.promptZh: 对{argument name="landmark" default="Plaza de España, Seville"}的高度详细、逼真的乐高诠释，展示了运河层面宏伟的黄金时段建筑场景。该图像是垂直的、电影般的，观众可以沿着狭窄的弯曲运河直视完全由乐高积木建造的华丽的西班牙文艺复兴时期宫殿正面。温暖的赤土建筑占据了框架的上半部分，有多个塔楼、拱形柱廊、阳台、装饰性飞檐和复杂的砖砌装饰。中央塔楼上飘扬着一面西班牙小国旗。在前景中，从后面可以看到一艘带有 2 个小人仔的乐高划艇，沿着运河漂流；一个是红棕色的头发，另一个是浅棕色的头发，两人都用棕色的长桨划船。在中距离，有第二艘小划艇，上面有 2 个小人仔，位于一座优雅的拱桥下方或附近。数一数共有 2 艘船和 4 名划船乘客。沿着右侧长廊，数出 4 个可见的站立小人仔，间隔放置在瓷砖栏杆旁边。运河两旁是精致的蓝色、白色和黄色陶瓷风格的乐高马赛克栏杆和砖砌栏杆，还有黑色复古路灯；数一数共有 7 个可见灯柱。在左边缘，在花盆中放置 2 颗圆形粉红色开花灌木。横跨运河的桥梁拥有华丽的蓝白色乐高瓷砖图案和优雅的单拱门。水看起来应该很逼真，但由类似乐高积木的光滑小瓷砖制成，并反射出建筑物和天空的深青色。灯光是柔和的日落光，带有发光的琥珀色天空、分散的云彩、长长的高光和丰富的温暖阴影。强调真实性、精细纹理、有趣的比例错觉，以及真实建筑宏伟与明确无误的乐高结构的令人信服的融合。

items.title: LEGO Alhambra Courtyard at Sunset
items.titleZh: A highly detailed photorealistic LEGO diorama of {argument name="landmark" default="the Alhambra in Granada"}, shown as an ornate Moorish courtyard at golden-hour sunset. The scene is built entirely from LEGO bricks and minifigure parts, with warm amber light, cinematic depth, and rich texture. Center the composition on a long narrow reflective water channel leading toward 1 small round fountain in the middle distance and a grand horseshoe arch beyond it. Surround the courtyard with intricate tan stone-like LEGO walls, carved-looking geometric relief patterns, slender columns, tiled archways, and terracotta rooflines made from densely layered reddish-brown pieces. In the background, include 2 main towers and several additional palace structures rising behind the courtyard, plus 6 tall dark green cypress trees silhouetted against a glowing orange sky. Add blue, green, and white mosaic-style tile details around the central arch and lower walls. Populate the courtyard with exactly 9 LEGO tourists and visitors: 1 traveler in a tan hat and light outfit, 1 visitor in a blue jacket beside them, 1 person with a green backpack at the left foreground, 1 photographer holding a camera in the left foreground, 1 kneeling visitor examining the garden at the right edge of the water channel, 2 standing visitors chatting in the right midground, and 2 seated visitors on a tiled bench in the right foreground. Frame the water channel with low manicured hedges and small pink flowers. Use a low eye-level perspective from the start of the reflecting pool, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on the central courtyard, glossy water reflections, realistic LEGO stud texture, and a mood that feels majestic, playful, and museum-quality.

items.titleZh: Photorealistic candid interior car photo in a locked 4:5 vertical composition, shot from the front-right at eye level with a wide 24mm smartphone-style lens, showing a young adult woman with {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} shoulder-length hair lounging in the front passenger seat of a modern luxury car with bright white leather interior. Her body is reclined diagonally into the seat in a compact comfort pose with both knees drawn tightly up toward her chest, creating strong wide-angle foreshortening on the legs; her torso angles slightly left while her face turns toward the camera. One arm is bent behind her head and the other hand lightly touches the top edge of her corset. She wears 4 visible clothing items: a fitted floral corset top in {argument name="corset color" default="cream with dusty mauve embroidery"}, white shorts, white ribbed crew socks scrunched at the ankles, and thin corset shoulder straps. Her expression is relaxed and intimate, with natural makeup and soft skin texture. The car interior includes 5 clearly visible elements: the white passenger seat, the white driver seat edge in the foreground right, the side window, the panoramic glass roof, and the dark door panel trim. Outside the rain-speckled windows is a quiet suburban neighborhood with 4 visible environmental cues: wet street pavement, green lawns, leafy trees, and blurred houses under overcast daylight. Lighting is soft diffuse gray daylight coming through the side window and glass roof, with gentle ambient shadows, subtle HDR smartphone clarity, mild exterior highlight overexposure, realistic skin tones, crisp white leather reflections, and distinct raindrops on the roof glass. Keep the scene tasteful, fashion-editorial, and highly realistic, as if captured on an iPhone 14 Pro or Sony Alpha wide-angle photo inside a parked car on a rainy day.

items.titleZh: A realistic nighttime street photo shot as a mirror selfie through a large roadside convex traffic mirror, vertical 3:4 composition, with the entire circular mirror filling the frame and no black empty border outside the reflected scene. Use a strong fisheye lens and a slightly exaggerated dome-mirror effect so the road, scaffolding, poles, buildings, and lane markings bend heavily toward the edges. At the bottom center of the reflection, show a young person from about waist up taking the photo, wearing a {argument name="jacket style" default="black leather jacket"}, with short dark hair, small silver hoop earrings, and 2 visible silver rings, holding a {argument name="phone model" default="white iPhone 15 Pro Max"} up to cover most of the face. The subject stands casually with one hand in a pocket, centered in the mirror. The street is wet and glossy, reflecting intense red light. Include 1 moving dark car crossing the curved road from left to right with subtle motion blur and bright red taillight streaks. Surround the road with dense construction scaffolding and striped barriers; show exactly 2 red-and-yellow diagonal road barriers along the right and upper-right curve and additional striped safety panels around the left side. The mood is cinematic, urban, candid, and realistic, with a gritty night-street atmosphere in an East Asian city.

items.titleZh: A dense isometric steampunk-cyberpunk city illustration at dusk, designed like a whimsical indie tech district called {argument name="city name" default="INDIE MIND CITY"}. The scene is a single sprawling urban plaza packed with narrow brick buildings, rooftop antennas, cables, pipes, neon signs, market stalls, tiny pedestrians, and playful programmer humor. In the center background, a plaza labeled “PLAZA DEL PROMPT” surrounds a sculptural fountain with pale blue water, with benches and people gathered around it. To the left background, a tall building with a giant sign reading “BARRIO CÓDIGO ABIERTO” is covered in balconies, windows, hanging laundry, air conditioners, plants, and street activity. To the right background, another block bears a large sign “CALLEJÓN DE LOS AGENTES,” with stacked storefront signs including “Codex Barbería cortes exactos,” “Gemini Lavandería,” “Claude’s Coffee,” and “Dr. Llama.” Further right, a heavy industrial factory zone with smokestacks, cranes, ducts, crates, and catwalks displays 3 large signs: “ZONA INDUSTRIAL,” “FÁBRICA DE TOKENS,” and “LLM.” A cloud of floating letters and symbols rises above the chimneys like generated text smoke. In the foreground center, a tall clocktower-like corner building has a vertical neon sign reading “INDIE MIND,” a large round clock on the facade, warm lit windows, and a small stone animal sculpture at its base. To the right foreground, a lively market district glows with string lights and a bright neon sign “MERCADO NOCTURNO,” with 3 visible stall signs: “Memoria usada barata,” “Embeddings frescos del día,” and “Se cambian vectores.” Nearby are 3 more joke signs: “HARD HAT: prompt injection zone,” “HACKATHON: entra y sal con un bug,” and a food stand labeled “STACK OVERFLOW NOODLES.” To the left foreground, an older mixed-use building is filled with signs and visual jokes, including a huge rooftop billboard with 2 cats on top and the title {argument name="main billboard text" default="INDIE MIND CITY"}, plus a small version label “v1.0.0.” On that same block, include these visible signs: “FORGE & CAFE,” “git push cafe +$2,” “Tienda de MERGE CONFLICTS abierto 24/7,” “Se reparan linters,” “NO rm -rf aquí,” “Ralph was here,” “npm install vv,” “sudo make me sandwich,” “WORKTREE,” “SE VENDE GPU USADA,” “MUSEO DEL MERGE CONFLICT,” “NOTARÍA DE COMMITS FIRMADOS,” “PSICÓLOGO PARA SENIOR DEVS 50m 80,” “GATO PERDIDO responde a localhost,” and a poster board reading “HOY: charla sobre agentic coding entrada libre” and “REUNIÓN DE AA^AI REUNIDOS DE LOS AGI.” Near the center-left plaza, add a sandwich-board style sign labeled “PROMPTS USADOS” with 3 lines beneath it, and small plaza signs that read “HELLO WORLD,” “Tailscale,” “OpenRouter,” and “Deepseek.” The streets are cobblestone and crowded with exact small story details: 1 yellow tram labeled “LÍNEA MAIN,” 1 small blue car, 1 bicycle cart, 1 delivery scooter, outdoor café tables, chess players, pedestrians, crates, potted plants, striped awnings, laundry lines, glowing windows, rooftop cats, and a white llama standing near the agent alley. items.title: Censored Studio Portrait
items.titleZh: A centered studio portrait photo of a single adult man from upper chest to top of head, facing straight toward the camera against a smooth deep navy-blue backdrop. He has a very closely shaved buzz cut, visible ears on both sides, medium tan skin, and short dark facial hair concentrated along the chin and jawline with a faint mustache. Dress him in a plain off-white or cream crewneck sweatshirt with no logo. Use soft professional studio lighting with gentle highlights on the scalp, ears, neck, and sweatshirt, realistic skin texture, shallow depth of field, and a clean photographic look. Compose it symmetrically with the head near the top of frame and broad shoulders filling the lower half, in a vertical portrait orientation. Overlay 1 large opaque rectangular censor block centered over the face, covering from forehead to below the nose area and spanning most of the facial width; make the block a flat muted brown tone with slightly soft edges so the facial features are completely hidden.
items.promptZh: 一张居中的工作室肖像照片，照片中一名成年男子从上胸部到头顶，在光滑的深海军蓝色背景下直面镜头。他留着剃得非常整齐的寸头，两侧耳朵清晰可见，皮肤呈中等棕褐色，面部短毛集中在下巴和下巴线上，还有淡淡的小胡子。给他穿上一件没有徽标的纯灰白色或奶油色圆领运动衫。使用柔和的专业工作室灯光，在头皮、耳朵、颈部和运动衫上提供柔和的高光、逼真的皮肤纹理、浅景深和干净的摄影外观。构图对称，头部靠近画面顶部，宽阔的肩膀填充下半部分，呈垂直纵向。覆盖 1 个大型不透明矩形检查块，以面部为中心，覆盖从前额到鼻子下方的区域，并跨越大部分面部宽度；将块设为平坦、柔和的棕色调，边缘稍软，以便完全隐藏面部特征。

Dress him in a plain off-white or cream crewneck sweatshirt with no logo. Use soft professional studio lighting with gentle highlights on the scalp, ears, neck, and sweatshirt, realistic skin texture, shallow depth of field, and a clean photographic look. Compose it symmetrically with the head near the top of frame and broad shoulders filling the lower half, in a vertical portrait orientation. Overlay 1 large opaque rectangular censor block centered over the face, covering from forehead to below the nose area and spanning most of the facial width; make the block a flat muted brown tone with slightly soft edges so the facial features are completely hidden.

items.title: Surreal Floating Head With Censor Block
items.titleZh: A surreal studio portrait of a floating human head seen straight-on, centered in the frame against a vivid saturated blue sky with soft fluffy white clouds. The face is entirely obscured by a large smooth rectangular censor block in the center, covering from forehead to chin and most of the cheeks, with a subtle gradient of warm tan to muted blue-gray. Only the outer features remain visible: a close-cropped buzz cut with tight dark speckled hair texture on top, 2 visible ears, and the lower rounded chin and jaw. The head wears colorful eyeglass temples wrapping around the sides only, with no visible front lenses because the center is blocked; the left temple is pale cream with a tiny red-and-gold decorative mark, and the right temple is bright red-orange. Add 2 small rounded nubs peeking above the censor block near the top edge, one yellow on the left and one off-white on the right, creating a quirky toy-like feel. Render it as a hyperreal yet slightly uncanny 3D illustration, smooth skin, soft daylight, minimal composition, shallow depth of field, clean whimsical pop-surreal aesthetic.
items.promptZh: 一幅超现实的工作室肖像，正面看到一个漂浮的人头，以画面为中心，映衬着生动饱和的蓝天和柔软蓬松的白云。脸部完全被中央的一个大而光滑的矩形检查块遮盖，覆盖从前额到下巴和大部分脸颊，具有暖棕褐色到柔和蓝灰色的微妙渐变。只有外部特征仍然可见：剪短的齐肩短发，顶部有紧密的深色斑点毛发纹理，两只可见的耳朵，以及圆形的下巴和下巴。头部戴着彩色眼镜腿，仅环绕两侧，由于中心被遮挡，看不到前面的镜片；左侧太阳穴呈淡奶油色，带有微小的红金色装饰标记，右侧太阳穴呈鲜红橙色。在顶部边缘附近的检查块上方添加 2 个小圆形小块，左侧一个黄色，右侧一个灰白色，营造出一种古怪的玩具般的感觉。将其渲染为超真实但略显不可思议的 3D 插图、光滑的皮肤、柔和的日光、极简的构图、浅景深、干净的异想天开的流行超现实美学。

items.title: Retro Fast-Food Brand Board
items.titleZh: Using REFERENCE_0 as the hero food photo, transform it into a polished one-page restaurant branding board for a fried chicken and waffle-fries concept named {argument name="brand name" default="Can Dende"}. Keep the yellow-table food photography as the visual anchor, but redesign the output as a clean square brand guideline sheet on a warm off-white background with a cheerful, retro, hand-drawn fast-casual identity. Add a large logo area in the upper left with bold vintage red lettering, a small illustrated fried-food mascot above it, and the tagline “FRIED CHICKEN & RUFFLES”. Build the page as a structured multi-panel layout with 9 sections: 1) logo/hero area, 2) brand story text block, 3) top-right hero photo crop from the reference, 4) color palette showing exactly 5 swatches with hex labels, 5) typography section with a large display sample of the brand name plus 3 text styles labeled header, subhead, and body, 6) patterns and textures section with exactly 4 playful assets: a yellow wavy stripe pattern, a red checker pattern, a handwritten phrase, and a small doodle heart, 7) iconography section with exactly 5 simple icons: chicken, bottle, fries, smiley face, and heart, 8) photography style section with a 2x2 grid of exactly 4 food-photo crops derived from the reference and matching close-up shots, plus a short bullet list of photography guidelines, and 9) brand applications section with exactly 5 mockups labeled signage, takeout packaging, menu design, social media, and staff apparel. Include a circular badge near the hero photo that says {argument name="badge text" default="CRISPY GOOD MOOD"}. Use the palette {argument name="primary palette" default="yellow, tomato red, deep navy, leaf green, soft pink"}. Add a bottom banner with 2 sections titled “VOICE & VIBE” and a short brand summary paragraph. Overall feel: modern branding presentation, vibrant, appetizing, playful, sunny, editorial, highly legible, premium-but-fun.

items.titleZh: Using the provided reference image as the brand inspiration, transform the fried chicken burger and waffle fries meal into a polished one-page logo guidelines board for a restaurant brand named {argument name="brand name" default="Can Dende"}. Create a cheerful, modern fast-casual identity derived from the food in the reference: turn the crispy fried topping into a playful mascot/icon above the wordmark, and build a bold custom logo in a warm palette inspired by the photo. Design the output as a clean editorial brand sheet on an off-white background with navy and red typography, yellow scalloped borders at the top and bottom, and small sparkle doodles. Include these exact sections and counts: 1 main header reading "LOGO GUIDELINES" with the brand name beneath it; 1 "PRIMARY LOGO" section with the main logo and an "ABOUT THE LOGO" text block; 1 "LOGO VARIANTS" section with 3 variants labeled "FULL COLOR", "SINGLE COLOR", and "REVERSED"; 1 "COLOR VARIATIONS" section with 4 tiles labeled "YELLOW BACKGROUND", "NAVY BACKGROUND", "PINK BACKGROUND", and "NAVY ON CREAM"; 1 "MINIMUM SIZE" section showing the logo with a width guide and the text "1.25 in / 120 px MINIMUM WIDTH"; 1 "CLEAR SPACE" section with a spacing diagram based on the height of the letter C; 1 "INCORRECT USAGE" section with 4 wrong examples labeled "Don't change the colors", "Don't stretch or distort", "Don't rotate the logo", and "Don't add effects or shadows"; 1 "USAGE NOTES" section with 4 bullet points; and a handwritten-style closing tagline at bottom right that says {argument name="tagline text" default="It's a vibe. It's a smile. It's yours."}. Keep the composition crisp, print-ready, highly legible, and presentation-quality, like a real branding deliverable for a restaurant.

items.title: Chinese Calligraphy Poem Scroll
items.titleZh: A traditional Chinese calligraphy painting on aged tan xuan paper, landscape orientation, styled like an antique literati hanging scroll reproduction. The main composition is a large block of bold black semi-cursive to cursive brush calligraphy arranged in 10 vertical columns, read right to left, featuring the poem title at the top of the rightmost main column as {argument name="poem title" default="雨霖铃"}. The calligraphy should feel elegant, fluid, and expressive, with varied ink density, dry-brush texture, thick and thin stroke transitions, and natural hand-written spacing rather than perfect typesetting. Use the visible poem text as written in the image, including its inaccuracies, with the right-side main columns beginning: “寒蝉凄切，对长亭晚，骤雨初歇。都门帐饮无绪，留恋处，兰舟催发，执手相看泪眼，竟无语凝噎。念去去，千里烟波，暮霭沉沉楚天阔。多情自古，雷情自古伤离别，更那堪冷冷宵，酒醒倦兼芊？杨柳岸，晓风残月。此去经年良宰，经年，应是良辰好景。便纵有千种风情，更与何人说？” Place a narrower signature column on the far left with 1 vertical inscription reading {argument name="signature text" default="柳永《雨霖铃·寒蝉凄切》"}. Add 4 red seals total: 1 oval collector-style seal near the upper right margin and 3 square seals stacked vertically near the lower left inscription area. Include a faint monochrome ink-wash landscape in the lower right corner with 1 drooping willow tree and 1 small pavilion by the water, partially faded into the paper. The paper should have warm brown aging, subtle stains, mottling, foxing, worn edges, and a museum-photograph feel. Overall mood is refined, poetic, historical, and scholarly, like a Song-dynasty-inspired calligraphy artwork photographed flat in soft even light.

items.title: Sunlit Desk with White Cat and Laptop
items.titleZh: A cozy sunlit home office scene photographed in a realistic lifestyle style. A white short-haired cat with pale green eyes sits upright on a warm wooden desk near the center-left, facing the camera with a calm attentive expression, its tail curled around its front paws. To the left of the cat is 1 leafy potted houseplant in a textured beige pot and 1 ceramic mug filled with dark coffee. In front of the cat lies 1 open spiral notebook with handwritten notes and 1 silver pen resting diagonally across the pages. On the right side of the desk is 1 open laptop angled slightly toward the viewer, showing a vivid wallpaper of a turquoise lake and dramatic snow-capped mountain peaks under a blue sky. A dark, cinematic anime group portrait inspired by The Last Supper, set in a long stone banquet hall at night. Show exactly 11 seated or leaning female characters arranged shoulder to shoulder behind a long table covered with a white tablecloth, viewed straight on in a wide symmetrical composition. In the exact center is a blonde knightly woman in ornate blue-and-silver armor and a royal-blue dress, posed as the visual focal point with both armored arms extended along the table. In front of her sits a glowing golden chalice radiating warm light upward onto the faces and hands of the group. Behind them, three tall arched windows reveal a twilight landscape with a huge tree silhouetted against a dusky sky. The ceiling has dark wooden beams, and the side walls are lined with large shadowy framed paintings.

The 11 characters should feel like a crossover ensemble of iconic anime-style women with varied silhouettes, hairstyles, and fashion. From left to right: 1) a woman in a glossy red skintight futuristic suit, leaning forward with one hand on the table; 2) a dark-haired woman in muted military-style clothing close beside her; 3) a pale gothic girl in a black dress with long sleeves, hands lifted with delicate fingers; 4) a short blonde woman in a loose white T-shirt, casual and modern; 5) a tall red-haired woman in a white shirt standing slightly behind the others; 6) the central blonde armored knight in blue; 7) a black-haired woman in a black dress with gold accessories and a headpiece, raising one finger; 8) a glamorous woman in a red embroidered dress with long black hair; 9) a dark-haired woman in a low-cut black outfit leaning inward; 10) a teal twin-tailed virtual-idol-like girl in a sleeveless outfit; 11) a green-haired girl in a pale patterned dress seated with crossed legs at the far right, holding a wine glass. Keep all faces attractive anime faces, mature young-adult women, elegant rather than caricatured.

On the table, include exactly 11 place settings, 8 visible wine glasses with red wine, several loaves of bread and scattered rolls, plates, silverware, crumbs, and a few metallic goblets or cups. The warm chalice light should illuminate the center while the rest of the room falls into moody shadow. Use painterly realism, high-detail anime illustration, dramatic chiaroscuro, subdued brown and blue ambience with red accents, solemn yet slightly decadent atmosphere, ultra-wide panoramic framing, masterpiece quality.
items.promptZh:
一幅黑暗的、电影般的动漫群像，灵感来自《最后的晚餐》，背景设定在夜晚的长石宴会厅中。准确地展示了 11 个坐着或倾斜的女性角色，肩并肩地排列在铺着白色桌布的长桌后面，以宽大的对称构图直接观看。正中央是一位身穿华丽的蓝银盔甲和宝蓝色连衣裙的金发骑士女子，双臂铠甲沿着桌子延伸，成为视觉焦点。她面前放着一个发光的金色圣杯，将温暖的光芒向上照射到人们的脸上和手上。在他们身后，三扇高大的拱形窗户展现出暮色中的风景，一棵巨大的树在昏暗的天空下映出轮廓。天花板有深色木梁，侧壁上排列着大型阴影框画。

这 11 个角色应该感觉像是标志性动漫风格女性的跨界组合，具有不同的轮廓、发型和时尚。从左到右：1）一位身穿光亮红色紧身未来派套装的女士，身体前倾，一只手放在桌子上； 2）她身边有一位身穿柔和军装的黑发女子； 3）苍白的哥特式女孩，穿着长袖黑色连衣裙，纤细的手指举起双手； 4）金发短发女人，穿着宽松的白色T恤，休闲又摩登； 5) 一位身穿白衬衫、身材高大、红发的女士，稍稍落后于其他人； 6）中央的金发蓝色铠甲骑士； 7）一位身穿黑色连衣裙、戴着金色配饰和头饰的黑发女子，举起一根手指； 8）身着红色绣花长裙、留着黑色长发的迷人女子； 9) 一位身穿低胸黑色服装、身体向内倾斜的黑发女子； 10）一个穿着无袖服装的青色双马尾虚拟偶像女孩； 11) 最右边盘腿坐着一个穿着浅色图案连衣裙的绿发女孩，手里拿着一个酒杯。保持所有面孔有吸引力的动漫面孔，成熟的年轻成年女性，优雅而不是漫画。

桌子上正好有 11 个餐具、8 个可见的红酒杯、几条面包和散落的面包卷、盘子、银器、面包屑和一些金属高脚杯或杯子。温暖的圣杯灯应该照亮中心，而房间的其余部分则陷入喜怒无常的阴影中。采用绘画写实主义，高细节的动漫插画，戏剧性的明暗对比，柔和的棕色和蓝色氛围加上红色的点缀，庄重而略显颓废的气氛，超宽的全景取景，杰作品质。

items.title: Epic Shonen Crossover Poster
items.titleZh: A hyper-detailed cinematic anime crossover poster featuring 4 legendary shonen-inspired heroes charging forward in a single epic battle composition under a dramatic apocalyptic sky. The scene is wide, symmetrical, and explosively energetic, with a glowing break in the storm clouds at the top center sending intense golden sun rays downward across the characters. From left to right: a blond ninja-inspired teenage hero in an orange-and-black outfit with a forehead protector, crouched in an attack stance and forming a glowing spinning energy orb in one hand, surrounded by orange chakra flames and several floating black spheres behind him; a muscular black-haired martial artist in an orange gi at left-center, twisting mid-strike while charging a bright blue energy sphere in his hand, wrapped in crackling blue aura and electric arcs; a lean pirate-inspired young man at right-center wearing a straw hat, sleeveless red vest, blue shorts, and sandals, lunging forward with a fierce grin, one arm extended, with white steam-like energy curling around his body; a dark-haired swordsman at far right in a flowing black-and-red checkered haori, drawing or swinging a katana with a sweeping arc of fiery red-orange energy around him. The background is a chaotic fantasy battlefield of shattered rock, sparks, lightning, embers, molten light, and swirling elemental effects, with orange fire dominating the left and right edges, cool blue energy concentrated around the martial artist, and white vapor around the pirate hero. items.title: UFC-Style Women's Fight Poster
items.titleZh: A dramatic UFC fight-poster style sports promotion for {argument name="event title" default="UFC 305"}, designed as a high-contrast vertical matchup graphic with two female MMA fighters facing inward in orthodox guard poses. The left fighter is a fit blonde woman with shoulder-length messy beach-wave hair, tan skin, a black sports bra, black UFC gloves, and black fight shorts, shown from upper thigh to head, turned slightly right. The right fighter is a fit dark-haired woman with long straight black hair, tan skin, a black sports bra, black UFC gloves, and black fight shorts, shown from upper thigh to head, turned slightly left, with a large detailed black-and-gray tattoo sleeve on her right arm and script tattoo text on the inner upper arm. Both fighters are sweaty, intensely lit, and centered close together with fists raised near chest height. Use a split background: fiery orange sparks and smoke on the left, icy blue-white sparks and haze on the right, with a dark black center seam. At the top center, place a black rectangular logo box with gold trim containing the gold text {argument name="event logo text" default="UFC 305"}. Beneath it, in stacked condensed white uppercase type, add the tagline: "TWO ICONS. ONE OCTAGON." Along the far left edge, place the surname "SWEENEY" vertically in large distressed gold letters; along the far right edge, place the surname "FOXX" vertically in large distressed silver-gray letters. In the center, overlay huge distressed white condensed sans-serif typography with the matchup names stacked exactly as {argument name="left fighter name" default="SYDNEY SWEENEY"} above a small gold "VS" and {argument name="right fighter name" default="MEGAN FOXX"}. Below that, add a small gold subtitle reading "BANTAMWEIGHT BOUT". At the bottom center, show a small realistic UFC octagon cage seen from a slightly elevated front angle, embedded into the poster. In front of the cage, place a black date card with gold trim containing stacked gold text: "JUNE 14", "SATURDAY", "10PM ET / 7PM PT". Below the card, add white text "LIVE ON" and the ESPN+ logo. Bottom left, add small gold and white ticket text reading "TICKETS ON SALE APRIL 25" with the Ticketmaster logo beneath. Bottom right, add the Rogers Arena logo and white text "ROGERS ARENA" with gold text "VANCOUVER, BC" below. Use a glossy premium combat-sports poster finish, cinematic rim lighting, gritty texture overlays, metallic typography, and intense face-off composition.
items.promptZh: 针对 {argument name="event title" default="UFC 305"} 的引人注目的 UFC 格斗海报风格体育宣传，设计为高对比度垂直对决图形，其中两名女性 MMA 选手面朝内，摆出正统的后卫姿势。左边的拳击手是一位身材健美的金发女性，留着齐肩凌乱的海滩波浪发，棕褐色的皮肤，黑色运动胸罩，黑色 UFC 手套，穿着黑色拳击短裤，从大腿上部到头部，稍微向右转。右边的战士是一位身材匀称的黑发女性，黑色长直发，棕褐色皮肤，黑色运动胸罩，黑色UFC手套，黑色战斗短裤，从大腿上部到头部，稍微向左转，右臂上有一个大而细致的黑灰色纹身袖，上臂内侧有文字纹身文字。两名拳手都大汗淋漓，光线强烈，并紧靠在一起，拳头举到接近胸部的高度。使用分割背景：左边是火热的橙色火花和烟雾，右边是冰冷的蓝白色火花和薄雾，中间有深黑色接缝。在顶部中心，放置一个带有金色镶边的黑色矩形徽标框，其中包含金色文本 {argument name="event logo text" default="UFC 305"}。在其下方，以堆叠的浓缩白色大写字体添加标语：“两个图标。一个八角形。”沿着最左边缘，垂直放置姓氏“SWEENEY”，以大号仿旧金色字母书写；沿着最右边缘，用大号仿旧银灰色字母垂直放置姓氏“FOXX”。在中心，覆盖巨大的仿旧白色压缩无衬线字体，其中对战名称完全按照 {argument name="leftfighter name" default="SYDNEY SWEENEY"} 堆叠在小金色“VS”和 {argument name="rightfighter name" default="MEGAN FOXX"} 上方。在其下方添加一个金色小标题，上面写着“BANTAMWEIGHT BOUT”。在底部中心，展示了一个小型的现实 UFC 八角形笼子，从稍微升高的前角看到，嵌入到海报中。在笼子前面放置一张带有金色镶边的黑色日期卡，其中包含堆叠的金色文字：“6 月 14 日”、“星期六”、“东部时间晚上 10 点/太平洋时间晚上 7 点”。在卡片下方添加白色文字“LIVE ON”和 ESPN+ 徽标。左下角添加金色和白色的小票文字，上面写着“TICKETS ON SALE APRIL 25”，下方带有 Ticketmaster 徽标。右下角添加罗杰斯竞技场徽标和白色文字“ROGERS ARENA”，下方添加金色文字“VANCOUVER, BC”。使用光滑的优质格斗运动海报表面、电影边缘照明、坚韧的纹理覆盖、金属版式和激烈的对峙构图。

items.titleZh: A candid, unprocessed indoor photograph taken with an early 2000s consumer digital camera or cheap film camera. The image features a {argument name="family description" default="cheerful Chinese family of three"} in their {argument name="living room description" default="modest Beijing apartment living room"} circa {argument name="year" default="2003"}. A mother, father, and young daughter (around 6) are captured in a cluttered, genuine setting. The mother is looking up, surprised and smiling, while the father is trying to fix an old VCR player, and the daughter is playing with a colorful toy car on the patterned rug. The shot is clearly spontaneous, taken with poor, natural window light from the right. The composition is off-center, slightly blurry and grainy with muted, washed-out colors and a yellowish tint. In the background, there's a bulky beige TV showing static, a wall calendar from 2003, cluttered shelves with VHS tapes, framed family pictures, a cloth sofa, and maybe a small plant. The perspective is from eye level but feels handheld and shaky. The focus is soft, and the depth of field is shallow, emphasizing the natural moment. Shot with an old Nikon Coolpix or Canon PowerShot, visible digital noise and a time-stamp in a corner. The shot captures a slice of mundane, everyday life, with the daughter's messy hair and toys scattered, creating an authentic, memory-like feel.

items.title: Futuristic City With Sparkling Artifacts
items.titleZh: A bright daytime futuristic city street viewed from pedestrian level, looking upward through a canyon of tall sleek skyscrapers with blue-tinted glass facades, rounded balconies, layered terraces, and elegant sci-fi architecture. The scene shows a bustling urban promenade with about 12 visible pedestrians in the foreground and midground, casually dressed and walking away from the viewer, including one central figure in a gray jacket. At the upper left, include 1 small hovering flying vehicle or drone-like air taxi. The buildings are highly reflective and polished, with integrated greenery: trees along the walkway and planted terrace edges. The sky is clear blue with soft sunlight, giving the image a clean optimistic utopian mood. Across the entire image, add a conspicuous artifact layer of dense multicolored sparkling dots and specks, like a noisy pixel grid or glittering digital contamination scattered uniformly over the architecture, people, sky, and street. Use a painterly semi-realistic style with soft focus, luminous highlights, vertical composition, and cinematic depth.

items.title: Rainforest Clearing with Speckle Artifacts
items.titleZh: An ultra-detailed wide-angle rainforest clearing photographed from a very low ground-level perspective, with the camera almost at the edge of a shallow muddy puddle. Dense tropical jungle vegetation forms a circular wall around the clearing, with tangled vines, broad wet leaves, shrubs, and tree trunks heavily covered in greenery. The foreground is slick with brown water, leaf litter, and reflective puddles, including a fallen branch stretching diagonally across the lower right area and a rounded mossy rock on the lower left. The center opens into a patch of low green plants, while the background rises into thick jungle canopy. Bright midday sunlight breaks through the treetops in the upper right, creating strong rays, haze, glowing highlights, and high contrast against a partly cloudy blue-and-white sky visible through the canopy. Use a dramatic fisheye or ultra-wide lens effect with subtle barrel distortion, immersive environmental scale, rich saturated greens, wet textures, realistic natural lighting, crisp foliage detail, and a photorealistic documentary nature-photography look. Include a faint, unnatural grid-like speckle noise artifact pattern across the image, especially visible in darker foliage and muddy ground, as if from an image-generation quality bug.
items.promptZh: 从非常低的地面视角拍摄的超详细广角雨林空地，相机几乎位于浅泥水坑的边缘。茂密的热带丛林植被在空地周围形成了一道圆形的墙，藤蔓错综复杂，宽阔的湿叶、灌木和树干都被绿色植物覆盖。前景光滑，有棕色的水、落叶和反光的水坑，包括一根斜伸穿过右下区域的倒下的树枝和左下角一块长满青苔的圆形岩石。中心是一片低矮的绿色植物，而背景则是茂密的丛林树冠。中午明亮的阳光穿过右上角的树梢，产生强烈的光线、薄雾、发光的高光，并与透过树冠可见的部分多云的蓝白色天空形成鲜明对比。使用戏剧性的鱼眼或超广角镜头效果，具有微妙的桶形畸变、身临其境的环境规模、丰富的饱和绿色、潮湿的纹理、逼真的自然光、清晰的树叶细节以及逼真的纪实自然摄影外观。在图像中包含微弱的、不自然的网格状散斑噪声伪影图案，尤其是在较暗的树叶和泥泞的地面上，就好像来自图像生成质量错误一样。

items.titleZh: A moody cinematic dystopian winter scene at dusk, viewed from a sheltered riverside foreground toward a dark modern city skyline glowing with hundreds of tiny warm window lights. In the left foreground, a stylish woman with dark curly hair sits in three-quarter view, her face intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur, holding a lit cigarette near her lips. She wears a sheer black lace high-neck dress with intricate floral embroidery, dangling earrings, and a glamorous noir aesthetic. The ground around her is wet, icy, and littered with trash, with glossy black garbage bags piled on the right foreground and scattered debris across the frozen shoreline. Across the icy water in the midground sits a huge weathered metal bowl or basin filled with snow, prominently marked with the text {argument name="headline text" default="USA"}. Three tiny human figures stand near it for scale. Bare tree branches frame the upper left. The overall palette is cold blue-gray with amber pinpricks of city light, and the whole image should have a gritty, painterly-photoreal look with a distinct artificial image artifact pattern: a visible grid of tiny glowing specks and dot noise scattered across the entire scene, especially in dark areas, as if from a flawed generative model output.

items.title: 360 AI Art Gallery Panorama
items.titleZh: An ultra-wide 360-degree equirectangular panoramic view of a futuristic contemporary art gallery exhibition about artificial intelligence, designed for immersive VR viewing. The scene is inside a vast dark-ceilinged museum hall with exposed rigging, many small spotlights, polished reflective concrete floors, and curved white exhibition walls wrapping continuously across the panorama. The environment is filled with {argument name="visitor count" default="about 25"} adult visitors in smart casual and business attire, standing in small conversational groups and scattered around the room, with subtle face blur or indistinct facial detail. At the exact center of the panorama is a circular installation platform containing a tall translucent holographic human figure made of white glowing particles and vertical strands of light, suspended beneath a large circular ceiling ring. On the left side, show a white robotic arm sculpture on a round pedestal in front of a giant wall artwork depicting a luminous side-profile human head composed of particles and constellation-like dots. Across the walls, include 6 visible AI-themed artworks total: 1 giant particle head mural, 3 framed cosmic nebula or galaxy images, 1 large monochrome abstract painting, and 1 tall colorful starfield-like digital piece in the far right background. On the right foreground, place a large transparent cube installation containing a swirling spiral galaxy projection in blue, violet, and white. Also include 2 small white service robots near the center-right area of the floor. Lighting is cinematic and cool-toned, with blue, purple, and white glows from the installations contrasting against the dark ceiling and neutral gallery architecture. The mood is sleek, high-end, intellectual, and techno-cultural, like an AI biennale or premium digital art fair. Render photorealistically with crisp architectural detail, realistic reflections, natural human scale, and full seamless 360 panorama distortion appropriate for an equirectangular image.

items.title: Summer McCafé Mountain Road Ad
items.titleZh: Create a premium vertical fast-food lifestyle advertisement in a polished commercial photography style, designed like a summer campaign poster for McDonald's and McCafé. Show a glamorous young woman with softly blurred, unidentifiable facial features sitting confidently on the hood of a sleek red sports car parked on a winding mountain road at golden hour. She has long wavy auburn hair glowing in warm sunset backlight, wears a dark green satin bomber jacket with gold detailing, a white camisole, high-waisted burgundy pants, and black ankle boots with heels. Her pose is relaxed and stylish, one leg bent and one extended forward, while she holds out a clear plastic cup of iced coffee with a straw and visible McDonald's golden arches branding toward the camera. Scatter red roses across the car hood around her, and place 1 McDonald's paper takeout bag on the right side of the hood. Use a dramatic canyon or hillside background with warm sunlight, soft haze, cinematic depth of field, and a luxurious aspirational road-trip mood. Include floating red flower petals in the air. Compose the layout as a high-end ad with the model centered slightly right and large promotional typography on the left. Add exactly 3 large headline lines in the upper left: "SIP.", "SAVOR.", and "{argument name="headline text" default="SUMMER."}" with the first 2 in bold white and the third in bold golden yellow. Below that, add the subheadline: "Refresh your drive with McCafé." with "McCafé" highlighted in yellow. Add exactly 3 circular feature icons stacked vertically on the left with short captions: "PREMIUM McCAFÉ ICED COFFEE", "WORLD FAMOUS FRIES", and "QUALITY YOU CAN TASTE". Place the McDonald's golden arches logo with the text "i'm lovin' it" in the top right. Add a small lower-left tagline reading "Good days start here." with "start here." in yellow. Create a bold yellow bottom banner spanning the width, divided into 3 content areas: left area reads "SUMMER SAVINGS" and "ENJOY EXCLUSIVE OFFERS"; center area includes a McDonald's app icon and the text "DOWNLOAD THE APP FOR DEALS NEAR YOU"; right area reads "FOLLOW US @MCDONALDS" with social icons. Use brand-accurate red and yellow accents, glossy product styling, realistic lighting, sharp editorial retouching, shallow depth of field, luxury commercial ad composition, and mobile-first poster proportions.

She has dark brown to nearly black hair parted in the center and tied back into a low ponytail, with a few soft loose strands near the ears, and small delicate earrings. Her face is intentionally obscured and featureless, with no visible eyes, nose, or mouth detail. She wears a fitted ribbed zip-front crop top in {argument name="top color" default="deep chocolate brown"}, with a collar, three-quarter sleeves, and the zipper partially open to create a deep neckline, paired with high-waisted straight-leg pants in a matching {argument name="pants color" default="brown"}. Her body is angled slightly toward the camera with relaxed shoulders, hands resting together between her knees, conveying a calm casual studio pose. The background is a soft off-white draped fabric curtain with gentle folds, lit by diffused natural window light for a clean, minimalist studio look. Emphasize realistic skin texture, soft shadows, neutral warm tones, shallow depth of field, and polished high-end fashion photography styling.

items.title: Photographed MIDI Piano Score Sheet
items.titleZh: A top-down realistic photograph of a single white sheet of printer paper placed on a light wood desk, showing a computer-generated music score. The page is centered horizontally with slight perspective and soft natural indoor lighting, minimal shadows, and a clean document-print look. At the top center, print the title "{argument name="file name" default="kura.mid"} - {argument name="track name" default="CH05 Piano"}" in a plain sans-serif font. Below it is a piano staff system rendered in standard black music notation with a treble clef and 4/4 time signature, designed to look like an automatically converted MIDI excerpt rather than carefully engraved sheet music. On the far left of the first system, include the instrument label "CH05 Piano". Show exactly 5 horizontal systems of notation on the page, beginning with measure numbers 18, 21, 25, 29, and 33 at the left edges of the systems. Near the first system, include a tempo marking with a quarter-note symbol equals 120. Fill the staves with dense, slightly awkward but plausible black notes, accidentals, stems, slurs, and rests, with many sharp signs and repeated short-note figures in the upper register, visually resembling piano transcription from MIDI. The first 3 systems should be long and nearly full width; the 4th system should also be long; the 5th system should be short, occupying only the left portion of the page. Keep the notation legible but somewhat mechanically spaced. Use a clean white page with wide margins and no handwritten marks, no colored elements, no extra graphics, just the printed score sheet photographed on a desk.

She has a fierce focused expression, luminous green eyes, small glossy black-and-magenta horn-like head implants, and long flowing hair whipping outward in all directions. Her body is encased in a high-detail reflective chrome-and-magenta cybernetic exosuit with translucent chest plating, segmented armored shoulders, mechanical gauntlets, exposed joint details, armored thighs, and blade-like lower leg armor. Behind her are 2 large radiant energy wings made of pink crystalline electricity and particle streaks, exploding outward symmetrically.
