items.title: Anime Girl Under Umbrella in Rain
items.titleZh: A luminous anime-style close-up portrait of a teenage schoolgirl standing outdoors in the rain, framed from the chest up, holding a transparent vinyl umbrella. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark navy black"} hair tied in a low side ponytail with soft loose strands and straight bangs, delicate round glasses, large glossy violet-blue eyes, and a calm, slightly awed expression as she looks upward toward leaves and raindrops. She wears a wet white short-sleeved school blouse and a dark blue plaid ribbon bow at the collar. The scene is filled with convincing water and light: rain falling in fine streaks, droplets clinging to the umbrella ribs, beads of water on her hair and shirt, and large crystal-clear drops hanging from broad green leaves in the upper right foreground. In the lower right and foreground, include blooming white garden flowers with dark glossy foliage covered in rain. Use a cool blue and silver palette with soft lavender highlights, backlit by diffused daylight after or during a shower, creating intense transparency, reflections, refraction, sparkling bokeh, and shimmering wet surfaces. The background should be an out-of-focus urban garden or residential walkway with fences and buildings blurred by rain, while the girl remains sharply rendered. Emphasize cinematic composition, layered foreground leaves, hyper-detailed raindrops, realistic translucent umbrella material, subtle rim light on wet hair, and an overall mood of quiet wonder and serene summer rain.

The scene shows a modern mixed-use city block on a clear sunny day, with a contemporary cafe or restaurant on the right featuring tall glass windows, dark frames, a stone facade, and a warm wood soffit extending over the terrace. items.titleZh: A high-fashion luxury editorial advertisement in a vertical format, featuring a mysterious female model from mid-torso up, centered and slightly turned to the side, wearing an oversized dark olive leather jacket with a high collar and prominent buckle strap detail near the neck. Her face is obscured by a soft rectangular blur, while her dark wavy shoulder-length hair remains visible and voluminous. She carries a slouchy black leather shoulder bag with a gold chain strap and a small gold logo near the bottom corner. Place the large serif brand name {argument name="brand text" default="LOEWE"} across the center in elegant white uppercase letters, overlaying the figure. Build the entire composition as a tactile collage made of torn and layered fabric and leather swatches: exactly 8 visible material fragments surrounding and partially overlapping the subject, including beige linen at the top left, olive stitched leather panels on the left, soft beige fabric at the lower left edge, dark brown embossed leather with a monogram motif at the upper right, rocky coastline photography at the right and lower right, a textured taupe stitched textile across the lower center, a dark denim-like fragment at the lower left, and a deep brown leather panel at the bottom right. In the background, reveal a dramatic coastal landscape with rocks, ocean waves, and a moody cloudy sky lit like late afternoon or sunset. Use rich earthy tones, muted olive, dark brown, taupe, black, and warm highlights. The overall look should feel premium, cinematic, moody, artisanal, and minimalist, like a luxury fashion campaign combining leather craftsmanship, collage art direction, and editorial photography.

items.titleZh: A luxury fashion editorial advertisement poster in a vertical smartphone format, centered on a female model from chest-up wearing a structured olive green leather coat with a sharp pointed collar and a single visible round brown button at the neck. Her dark wet-look hair is slicked back and slightly messy, her head tilted upward with an elegant elongated neck, and her face mostly obscured by framing and shadow to create a mysterious high-fashion mood. Across the center, place the brand name {argument name="brand name" default="LOEWE"} in very large white high-contrast serif capital letters, spanning nearly the full width of the image. Build the composition as a collage framed by 5 torn material swatches: 1 embossed olive suede piece in the top left with a luxury monogram pressed into it, 1 coarse taupe-beige canvas fabric piece in the top right attached to a warm tan leather strip with visible white stitching, 1 pale textured fabric scrap with frayed edges in the bottom left, 1 dark brown glossy leather piece in the bottom right with a subtle embossed monogram, and 1 narrow vertical weathered beige panel along the left edge. Inside that left panel, include thin dark desert plant stems with small seed heads. In the background behind the model, use a dramatic golden-brown sunset sky with soft clouds and a faint rocky desert landscape near the lower right, creating a warm earthy palette. Lighting should be cinematic, moody, and directional, with rich shadows, tactile material detail, premium fashion-magazine styling, and an elegant artisan-luxury aesthetic. Use a color palette of olive green, camel, tan, beige, chocolate brown, and sunset gold. The overall feeling is sophisticated, handcrafted, minimal, and expensive, like a heritage luxury leather-goods campaign.

items.title: Summer Coffee Ice Cream Collab Poster
items.titleZh: A bright, cheerful summer co-branded beverage poster in a clean Chinese commercial advertising style, showing a collaboration between {argument name="brand one" default="蜜雪冰城"} and {argument name="brand two" default="STARBUCKS"}. Vertical poster layout with a soft blue sky background, sunlit greenery, and an outdoor cafe atmosphere. At the top, place both brand logos side by side with a large bold Chinese headline in playful hand-drawn display lettering: {argument name="headline text" default="雪王遇见星朋友"}. Beneath it, add a green ribbon banner with Chinese subheadline text: {argument name="subheadline text" default="米雪冰城 × 星巴克 联名开启"}, and a smaller line reading "甜蜜加倍·快乐翻倍". Include 2 circular stamp-style graphics: one on the left reading "联名限定", and one on the upper right like a postmark with Chinese text around a small drink icon. In the center foreground on a wooden outdoor table, display 2 iced drinks: on the left, a tall clear cup of vivid green matcha slush topped with a tall swirl of vanilla soft serve and green matcha drizzle, with visible ice texture and a cute snowman mascot logo on the cup; on the right, a tall clear Starbucks-style iced latte with milk and green matcha swirls at the bottom, topped with whipped cream and dark cookie crumbs, with the green siren logo on the cup. In front of the drinks, place 1 cute white snowman mascot figurine with a tiny crown, round body, rosy cheeks, red cape, and a happy wink, sitting and holding a small takeaway coffee cup. Add 2 vertical product name tags beside the drinks: left tag "雪顶抹茶星冰乐", right tag "抹茶雪王奥利奥". On the right midground, place 1 small black chalkboard sign on a wooden easel reading "ICE CREAM & COFFEE" with chalk drawings of an ice cream cone and a takeaway cup. In the lower left, create a torn-paper price block showing a combo offer with large red numbers "¥19.9", green supporting text, and a small green badge reading "立省 ¥6". In the lower center-right, add a "联名周边" area displaying exactly 4 merchandise items: 1 cup sleeve, 1 character keychain or acrylic charm, 1 round badge, and 1 small sticker or token, all using the snowman mascot and coffee collaboration theme. Use warm sunlight, glossy drink photography, shallow depth of field, soft bokeh trees, high contrast product retouching, crisp packaging details, and an upbeat youthful retail-promo aesthetic. Include scattered doodle hearts and playful decorative accents around the typography. Keep all visible text in Chinese except the Starbucks wordmark and the chalkboard text.

items.title: Anime Samurai Game Ad Poster
items.titleZh: Create a high-impact vertical mobile game advertisement poster in glossy anime action style, with a dramatic cyber-samurai fantasy aesthetic and dense, premium gacha-RPG promotional composition. The main scene shows 2 young adult male fighters in modern black business suits crouching aggressively in the foreground, each drawing a katana toward the viewer. Both have styled blond hair, sharp handsome features, white dress shirts, blue neckties, and intense action poses, with foreshortened hands and swords dominating the lower foreground. One sword has a blue ribbon tied near the hilt. Behind them, centered and towering, place 1 massive armored mecha samurai with ornate gold horns, layered metallic blue-black armor, glowing blue eyes, and a sheathed sword across its back, framed like a guardian deity. Use a vivid neon city and energy-burst backdrop in electric blue, violet, magenta, and gold, with light streaks, sparks, petals, slash effects, and ink-brush explosion textures. Add 1 vertical black brushstroke banner on the upper right with bold white Japanese text reading 「この刃で、未来を斬り拓け。」. Across the middle-lower area, place 1 huge gold Japanese calligraphy headline with thick brush texture and black shadow reading 「切り捨て御免」, spanning nearly the full width. In the lower left, embed 1 framed gameplay screenshot panel with a gold border, showing a night battle in front of a red Japanese temple courtyard, 1 playable swordsman in combat, multiple enemies, floating damage numbers including 5324, 5329, and 6132, a left-side virtual joystick, 5 character portraits total arranged vertically and along the bottom, 3 circular skill buttons on the right, and a top HUD showing a timer around 01:28 and WAVE 3/3. In the lower right, place 1 large black-and-white QR code inside a white square frame. Beneath and beside it, add bold Japanese text in white with blue outline reading 「今すぐダウンロード」. At the very bottom, include 2 official-style store badges: App Store on the left and Google Play on the right. Overall look: ultra-detailed, polished key art, dynamic perspective, metallic highlights, sharp cel-shaded anime rendering, premium mobile game marketing poster, intense action energy, cinematic lighting, and layered UI-heavy promotional layout.

items.title: Anime Swordsman in Suit
items.titleZh: A dynamic anime-style illustration of a sharply dressed young man in a dramatic foreshortened action pose, viewed from above as if he is lunging upward toward the camera while drawing a rapier straight at the viewer. He has {argument name="hair color" default="golden blond"} hair, neatly styled with a center part and soft swept-back volume, and fair skin. His face is mostly hidden by the camera angle and shadow, creating a mysterious, stylish look. He wears a tailored dark navy business suit with a subtle sheen, a light blue dress shirt, a vivid blue necktie, and polished black dress shoes. One hand dominates the foreground in extreme perspective, gripping the ornate rapier hilt; the other hand pulls the blade free, emphasizing motion and tension. The composition is bold and graphic, with the character diagonally crossing the frame over 1 large inverted triangle backdrop filled with pale aqua and turquoise geometric fan-like patterns, outlined with a thin warm beige border, set against a clean light gray background. items.titleZh: A high-end luxury fashion advertising poster in vertical 9:16 format, featuring a tall elegant female model with her face intentionally obscured, standing in a dramatic three-quarter pose against a stormy cinematic sky at golden sunset. She has windswept auburn hair pulled back loosely with flying strands, and wears a two-tone belted trench coat split in rich burnt orange and deep black, layered over a cream ribbed turtleneck sweater, with one hand in the coat pocket. The trench has a structured collar, double-breasted buttons, and a slim black leather belt with a polished gold circular buckle. items.title: Futuristic Tech Beauty Product Poster
items.titleZh: Luxury futuristic cosmetic product advertisement poster on a deep midnight-blue background, centered composition, featuring a glowing white spray bottle standing upright on a three-tier transparent crystal pedestal with water droplets and glossy reflections. The bottle is tall, cylindrical, minimalist, and softly backlit with a radiant halo, with visible condensation beads across the surface and an exposed pump top. Behind it, a symmetrical luminous lotus made of exactly 10 translucent petals fans out like a digital aura, each petal shimmering with iridescent blue-violet highlights, delicate circuit-like filaments, and tiny sparkling light nodes, blending botanical elegance with data-network aesthetics. The pedestal looks like stacked glass or ice blocks, wet and reflective, sitting on a slick sparkling surface with scattered blue light particles. At the top, elegant serif typography in large glowing white letters reads {argument name="headline text" default="THE PURITY PROTOCOL"}, with a thin horizontal divider line and a small star-like flare at the center beneath it. Below that, smaller spaced sans-serif text reads {argument name="subheadline text" default="DATA STREAM PURIFIER // 75ML"}. On the bottle, the main brand name reads {argument name="brand name" default="SECURE-IP"}, and the product name reads {argument name="product label" default="IP ADDRESS CLEANSER"}, followed by smaller copy: "for risk-free connections" and "pour des connexions sans risque", and at the bottom "75 mL / 2.5 fl. oz. - Data Stream Purifier". In the upper left, small brand text reads "IP 9OXYGEN TECHNOLOGY." A large bold uppercase headline dominates the left-center: "{argument name="headline text" default="BREATHE SECURE. GLOW FREE."}" with a smaller subheading below reading "for risk-free connections." Along the bottom is a row of 4 minimalist icon-and-text feature blocks, evenly spaced: 1) shield icon with the heading "CLEANSE YOUR IP" and short supporting copy, 2) wifi icon with the heading "SECURE CONNECTIONS" and short supporting copy, 3) leaf icon with the heading "BREATHE FREELY" and short supporting copy, 4) share/network icon with the heading "GLOW CONFIDENTLY" and short supporting copy. items.promptZh: 未来派奢华护肤风格广告海报，采用淡冰蓝色单色调色板，设计得像一场高端科技美容活动。该构图是垂直且通风的，具有柔和的发光光线、朦胧的渐变、半透明的粒子效果和干净的编辑布局。左侧，一位身着飘逸白色无袖连衣裙的年轻女子从肩部向上侧视，头向后仰，仿佛在呼吸新鲜空气，深色的头发随风飘逸。她的脸被一个普通的方形检查块遮住了。精细的发光网络线和闪闪发光的点从她的颈部和胸部向右流动，暗示着数字清洁和连接。在右侧，一个高大的哑光白色喷雾瓶直立漂浮，标有“SECURE-IP”和“IP ADDRESS CLEANSER”，下面有较小的产品副本和微妙的高级化妆品表面。在瓶子的后面和周围，分枝的半透明茎像生物技术珊瑚或神经纤维一样升起，每根茎的末端都是透明的发光气泡；几个气泡包含微弱的技术文本，例如“数据包”，而附近的微型标签标识包括“氧气流”、“数据包”、“安全路由”、“风险过滤器”、“私人清洁”和“纯粹连接”等功能。在左上角，小品牌文字写着“IP 9OXYGEN TECHNOLOGY”。一个大的粗体大写标题占据了左中心：“{argument name =“headline text”default =“BREATHE SECURE”。 GLOW FREE。"}"，下面有一个较小的副标题，内容为“无风险连接”。底部是一排 4 个简约的图标和文本功能块，均匀分布：1) 盾牌图​​标，标题为“清理您的 IP”和简短的支持副本；2) wifi 图标，标题为“安全连接”和简短的支持副本；3) 叶子图标，标题为“自由呼吸”和简短的支持副本；4) 共享/网络图标，标题为“自信地发光”和简短的支持副本。在右下角，添加一段关于持续连接和数字清理的营销文案，以口号“呼吸。连接。发光”结尾。在左下角，包括一个圆形 IP 徽标和品牌线“SECURE-IP”，以及一个小副标题，例如“OXYGEN FOR YOUR DIGITAL LIFE”。整体风格：超现实的产品广告、优质的社论海报、干净的无衬线字体、柔和的花朵、半透明的玻璃球、优雅的科幻健康品牌、超详细、抛光、杂志品质的布局。

items.titleZh: A cinematic, ultra-realistic golden-hour equestrian portrait of a {argument name="horse color" default="dark bay"} horse and a {argument name="rider gender" default="young man"} standing closely together in a quiet outdoor paddock at sunset. The horse is tall and elegant, shown from the chest up in three-quarter view, with a glossy coat, long dark mane, alert upright ears, and a black leather bridle and reins; part of an English saddle is visible on the left side of the frame. The rider wears a fitted {argument name="rider outfit" default="black long-sleeve riding shirt and black riding pants"}, standing on the right side of the horse, leaning in with one hand gently cupping the horse’s cheek and muzzle in a tender, intimate pose. Compose the image as a close portrait with the horse dominating the left half and the rider on the right, their faces nearly touching, emphasizing emotional connection and trust. Set the scene in a fenced field with softly blurred wooden rails, distant rolling hills, and a glowing orange sky with the sun low on the horizon. Use warm backlighting, rich amber highlights, realistic skin and fur texture, shallow depth of field, premium advertisement-style photography, natural shadows, high contrast, and a polished luxury editorial look. The overall mood should be affectionate, serene, and sophisticated, like a high-end lifestyle ad for equestrian fashion or horse care.
items.promptZh: 一幅电影般的超现实黄金时段马术肖像，一匹{argument name="horse color" default="dark bay"}马和一匹{argument name="rider sex" default="young man"}在日落时分紧密地站在安静的户外围场上。这匹马高大而优雅，从胸部向上看四分之三的视角，有光泽的皮毛，长长的深色鬃毛，警觉的直立耳朵，黑色皮革缰绳和缰绳；在框架的左侧可以看到英国马鞍的一部分。骑手穿着合身的{argument name="rideroutlet"default="black long-sleeve 马术衬衫和黑色马术裤"}，站在马的右侧，身体前倾，一只手轻轻托住马的脸颊和马口，摆出温柔亲密的姿势。将图像构图为特写肖像，马占据左半部分，骑手占据右半部分，他们的脸几乎接触，强调情感联系和信任。场景设置在一片有栅栏的田野里，木栏杆模糊不清，远处连绵起伏的山丘，还有橙色的天空，太阳低垂在地平线上。使用温暖的背光、丰富的琥珀色高光、逼真的皮肤和毛皮纹理、浅景深、优质的广告风格摄影、自然阴影、高对比度和精美的豪华编辑外观。整体基调应该是深情的、宁静的、精致的，就像马术时尚或马匹护理的高端生活方式广告一样。

The scene features {argument name="character name" default="Akari"}, a cheerful teenage magical-idol girl with very long voluminous {argument name="hair color" default="pastel pink"} twin-tail hair, bright green eyes, fair skin, and a playful expressive face. She wears an ornate frilly stage costume in layered pink, lavender, and white with gold trim, ribbons, heart motifs, lace cuffs, a choker bow, star earrings, and floral heart hair accessories. The background is a dreamy glitter-filled pink haze with bokeh, sparkles, and soft glow effects. Design it as a fake phone lock screen with a large white lock icon near the top center, cellular status icons in the upper right, and the date in Japanese reading 5月22日 木曜日 above a large glowing time display reading {argument name="time display" default="22:22"}. Include 5 visible character depictions of the same girl: 1 large central half-body figure winking and holding one finger to her lips in a teasing pose, 1 upper-left bust portrait laughing with eyes closed, 1 upper-right full or three-quarter body pose joyfully raising a small wand or key-like object, 1 lower-left smaller figure partly obscured by a blurred pink rectangle over the face while reaching outward, and 1 lower-right crouching figure with another blurred pink rectangle over the face while interacting with a large physical lock. Add handwritten Japanese sound-effect style text around the figures, including playful exclamations and notes. Show 2 message notification banners styled like iPhone alerts, both from メッセージ and お兄ちゃん with the text 今どこ〜？, one tilted on the left and one upright on the right. Across the lower middle, place a rounded translucent slider bar with Japanese text スライドでロック解除 and a lock icon. Make the unlocking concept literal by attaching an oversized brass padlock and latch mechanism to the slider, with the lower-right character appearing to unlock it using a key; add nearby handwritten Japanese text suggesting lock removal and a metallic click sound. In the lower left, include 2 circular utility icons, a flashlight and a trash can, plus a comic-style speech bubble reading ポイッ！. Add a camera icon in a dark circular button at the lower right and a thin white home indicator at the very bottom. Render everything with polished glossy anime illustration quality, soft lighting, dense sparkles, layered transparency, and a cute mischievous mood, as if an idol character has taken over and physically prevented the phone from being unlocked.

Effortless优雅。为推动您前进的每一个时刻而设计。"}。添加正好 3 个圆形线图标，标签垂直排列：优质皮革，永恒的设计，经久耐用。在左下角，将品牌名称置于优雅的衬线大写字母中：{argument name="brand name" default="LUMIÈRE"}，下面是较小的大写标语：{argument name="tagline" default="BAGS THAT DEFINE YOU."}。添加一个带有边框的号召性用语按钮，上面写着“购买该系列”，并带有一个向右的小箭头。整体风格：高档、有抱负、精美的电子商务活动、逼真的时尚广告、奢华而现代、干净的版式、平衡的负空间、杂志品质的构图。
items.prompt: Luxury fashion advertisement, vertical editorial product ad shot at golden hour on a high-rise balcony overlooking a modern city skyline at sunset. A stylish woman stands in a confident three-quarter pose, framed from mid-thigh up, with her face obscured by a simple rectangular block matching warm brown-orange tones. She has long, softly wavy brunette hair lit by warm backlight from the setting sun. She wears a black tailored blazer over a fitted white scoop-neck ribbed top and high-waisted light beige trousers, with one hand in her pocket and the other holding a structured taupe leather handbag with a top handle, flap closure, polished gold clasp hardware, and a hanging leather tag. The bag is the visual hero and should look premium, elegant, and sharply detailed. Use cinematic warm lighting, soft rim light on the hair, subtle luxury color grading, shallow depth of field, and blurred skyscrapers in the background. Compose the layout like a premium brand campaign with large text and icons on the left side. At top left, place a refined serif monogram logo: {argument name="brand monogram" default="L"}. Below it, large white serif headline text stacked in uppercase: {argument name="headline text" default="CARRY CONFIDENCE. EVERYDAY."}. Beneath that, add a short white serif body copy in 4 lines: {argument name="body text" default="Timeless design. Effortless elegance. Made for every moment that moves you forward."}. Add exactly 3 circular line icons with labels arranged vertically: premium leather, timeless design, made to last. At the bottom left, place the brand name in large elegant serif capitals: {argument name="brand name" default="LUMIÈRE"}, with smaller uppercase tagline below: {argument name="tagline" default="BAGS THAT DEFINE YOU."}. Add a bordered call-to-action button reading “SHOP THE COLLECTION” with a small right arrow. Overall style: upscale, aspirational, polished e-commerce campaign, photorealistic fashion ad, luxurious but modern, clean typography, balanced negative space, magazine-quality composition.

items.title: Sunlit Suit Portrait With Red Rose
items.titleZh: A moody minimalist portrait of a young man in a formal black suit, white dress shirt, and black tie, standing against a plain light beige wall in warm late-afternoon sunlight. He is shown from the chest up, slightly angled, with his face mostly obscured by shadow and framing, emphasizing the jawline, neck, ear, and tousled short black hair. In one hand he delicately holds exactly 1 long-stemmed red rose with 1 bloom and a few small green leaves, positioned beside his chest. Strong directional golden light from the left casts a crisp shadow of both the man and the rose onto the wall, creating a cinematic romantic atmosphere. Clean editorial photography, soft natural skin tones, high contrast between the dark suit and sunlit wall, shallow luxury fashion aesthetic, centered composition, realistic photo style.

items.titleZh:
A cute pastel anime promotional poster in a dreamy idol-fanclub style, landscape orientation, featuring a single horse-girl character from the waist up on the right side of the composition. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark chestnut brown"} long fluffy hair with side-swept bangs covering one eye, one large visible sparkling purple-pink eye, fair skin, soft blush, and upright horse ears with a large cream bow tied between them. Her expression is gentle, shy, and welcoming, with a small smile and a slight head tilt toward the viewer. She wears a thick red scarf with white horizontal stripes, a cream cable-knit sweater, and a navy sailor-style inner collar with a small red ribbon at the chest. The overall color palette is warm pink, cream, beige, and cocoa brown with soft winter lighting.

Design the image as a Japanese fan-content announcement graphic with layered sticker-like typography, fluffy outlines, hearts, sparkles, and snowflake motifs. The background should be a softly blurred cozy winter café or warmly lit indoor scene with glowing bokeh and pale decorative textures. Add exactly 5 major text areas: a pink ribbon banner at the top with the Japanese text "ライスと一緒に"; a very large central-left headline in rounded pop lettering reading "ほのぼの 育成" with "ほのぼの" in pink and white and "育成" in bold brown with white stitched edging; a small dark ribbon under it reading "しよっ♪"; a circular brown badge on the right reading "初見さん歓迎"; and a logo-like label at bottom right reading "ライスシャワーちゃんねる" with a small horseshoe icon. Add exactly 1 memo pad in the bottom-left corner with 3 checklist lines, each with a pink checkmark: "ストーリー", "チャンミ", and "まったり雑談". Include small decorative pink hearts around the character, tiny accent lines near her head, white snowflakes, lace-like trim, paper-cut corner decorations, and a soft scrapbook aesthetic. Make the whole piece look like an adorable fictional stream or channel thumbnail welcoming new viewers, highly polished, clean anime line art, soft shading, glossy eyes, and charming commercial poster composition.

items.title: Chinese Cursive Calligraphy Scroll
items.titleZh: A traditional Chinese ink calligraphy artwork on aged beige xuan paper, presented as a clean flat scan or photograph of a single hanging scroll page with no frame. The composition is entirely vertical Chinese cursive script, bold expressive grass-script brushwork in deep black ink with dynamic stroke variation, flying-white texture, dry-brush breaks, and elegant rhythm. Write the full poem {argument name="poem text" default="怒发冲冠，凭栏处、潇潇雨歇。抬望眼，仰天长啸，壮怀激烈。三十功名尘与土，八千里路云和月。莫等闲，白了少年头，空悲切。\n靖康耻，犹未雪；臣子恨，何时灭！驾长车，踏破贺兰山缺。壮志饥餐胡虏肉，笑谈渴饮匈奴血。待从头，收拾旧山河，朝天阙。"} in large vertical columns arranged right to left, about 8 main poem columns across the page, each column flowing freely with slight variations in spacing and tilt. Leave a wide left margin containing a smaller vertical inscription with 3 narrow columns: the title and attribution reading {argument name="inscription text" default="岳飞 满江红 甲辰書月 某元"}, written in a more restrained but still cursive hand. Add exactly 3 small red seal stamps: 2 stacked square seals in the lower-left margin beneath the inscription, and 1 small oval seal near the upper-right edge beside the first main column. The paper should have subtle warm tan mottling, soft fibers, faint age marks, and natural uneven tone. Overall mood is heroic, scholarly, and museum-quality, with authentic Song-inspired Chinese calligraphy aesthetics, minimal background, high detail, and faithful brush texture.

Write the full poem {argument name="poem text" default="怒发冲冠，凭栏处、潇潇雨歇。抬望眼，仰天长啸，壮怀激烈。三十功名尘与土，八千里路云和月。莫等闲，白了少年头，空悲切。\n靖康耻，犹未雪；臣子恨，何时灭！驾长车，踏破贺兰山缺。壮志饥餐胡虏肉，笑谈渴饮匈奴血。待从头，收拾旧山河，朝天阙。"} in large vertical columns arranged right to left, about 8 main poem columns across the page, each column flowing freely with slight variations in spacing and tilt. Leave a wide left margin containing a smaller vertical inscription with 3 narrow columns: the title and attribution reading {argument name="inscription text" default="岳飞 满江红 甲辰書月 某元"}, written in a more restrained but still cursive hand. Add exactly 3 small red seal stamps: 2 stacked square seals in the lower-left margin beneath the inscription, and 1 small oval seal near the upper-right edge beside the first main column. The paper should have subtle warm tan mottling, soft fibers, faint age marks, and natural uneven tone. Overall mood is heroic, scholarly, and museum-quality, with authentic Song-inspired Chinese calligraphy aesthetics, minimal background, high detail, and faithful brush texture.

items.title: Sci-Fi Mech Blueprint Hangar
items.titleZh: A cinematic ultra-detailed sci-fi mech hangar interior at night, shown in a wide-angle view from slightly above a massive horizontal holographic planning table. The glowing blue tabletop dominates the foreground and center, displaying an intricate engineering blueprint for a humanoid combat robot labeled {argument name="mech name" default="ARGONAUT"}. The blueprint includes exactly 3 large full-body orthographic mech drawings across the table, one front view, one side view, and one rear view, plus many smaller component diagrams for hands, joints, feet, armor segments, and circular mechanical parts, dense technical callouts, graphs, measurement lines, and blocks of Japanese annotation text mixed with alphanumeric labels. Around the table are exactly 5 engineers in light gray industrial jumpsuits studying the design, leaning over the edges and holding rugged tablets; their faces are intentionally indistinct and partially obscured. In the deep background, exactly 1 towering real humanoid mech stands upright in a maintenance gantry, suspended or docked in a cavernous factory bay filled with catwalks, scaffolding, pipes, heavy cables hanging from the ceiling, illuminated control panels, glass partitions, and a few tiny distant workers for scale. Use a cold steel-and-cyan color palette, dramatic volumetric lighting, reflective metallic surfaces, subtle mist, high contrast shadows, and a serious military-industrial mood. The environment should feel dense, realistic, and operational, like a secret advanced robotics facility. Emphasize scale, technical complexity, and the contrast between the flat luminous blueprint and the massive constructed mech behind it. Render in photorealistic concept-art style with crisp linework on the holographic display, cinematic depth, and extreme detail.

items.title: Hand-drawn Travel Journal Illustration
items.titleZh:
Please draw a brightly colored, vertical (9:16) hand-drawn style "{argument name="city name" default="Beijing"} Travel Journal Illustration." The style should look as if it were created with crayons by a curious child. Use a soft and warm light-colored background (such as light yellow), paired with bright tones like red, blue, and green, to create a cozy, child-like, and travel-inspired atmosphere.

I. Main Image: Journal-style Travel Route

Draw a "winding travel route" in the center of the illustration, connecting multiple locations with arrows and dashed lines. Recommended attractions will be automatically generated based on a {argument name="number of days" default="1"}-day itinerary:

Example format (automatically replaced with {argument name="city name" default="Beijing"} related content):

- "Stop 1: {Attraction 1 recommendation + short fun description}"
- "Stop 2: {Attraction 2 recommendation + short fun description}"
- "Stop 3: {Attraction 3 recommendation + short fun description}"
- ...
- "Final Stop: {Local signature food/souvenir + warm closing statement}"

> The number of travel stops is automatically generated based on the number of days. If no days are input, a 1-day/highlights route will be generated by default.

II. Fun Surrounding Elements (Automatically replaced based on the city)

Add plenty of child-like elements around the route, such as:

- Cute travel characters: "A child holding local snacks," "An adventurous kid wearing a backpack," etc.
- Child-like Q-version hand-drawings of local landmarks: such as "{landmark 1}," "{landmark 2}," "{landmark 3}."
- Fun signboards: "Watch out for getting lost!", "Mind the crowds!", "Good food ahead!" (Adjusted according to city context).
- Sticker-style slogans: "{argument name="city name" default="Beijing"} Travel Memories Unlocked!", "{argument name="city name" default="Beijing"} Food Adventure!", "Where to next?"
- Cute small icons of local delicacies: such as "{food 1}," "{food 2}," "{food 3}."
- Exclamations (maintaining a child-like tone): "{argument name="city name" default="Beijing"} is so much fun!", "I want to go again!"

III. Overall Style Requirements

- Hand-drawn crayon style / children's travel log style
- Bright colors, full but warm composition
- Emphasis on the joy and exploration of travel
- All text uses cute handwritten fonts
- Make the entire image look like a travel journal page full of child-like wonder.
items.prompt:
请绘制一张色彩鲜艳、竖版（9:16）手绘风格的《{argument name="城市名" default="北京"}旅行手账插画》，画风仿佛由一位充满好奇心的孩子用蜡笔创作，整体使用柔和温暖的浅色背景（如浅黄色），搭配红色、蓝色、绿色等明亮色调，营造温馨、童趣、满满旅行气息的氛围。

一、主画面：手账式旅行路线

在插画中央绘制一条“蜿蜒曲折的旅行路线”，路线用箭头 + 虚线连接多个地点，由 {argument name="天数" default="1"} 日行程自动生成推荐景点：

示例格式（自动替换为{argument name="城市名" default="北京"}相关）：

- “第 1 站：{景点 1 推荐 + 简短趣味描述}”
- “第 2 站：{景点 2 推荐 + 简短趣味描述}”
- “第 3 站：{景点 3 推荐 + 简短趣味描述}”
- …
- “最终站：{当地招牌美食/纪念品 + 温馨结束语}”

> 旅程站点数量随天数自动生成：
> 若用户未输入天数，则按默认 1 日 / 精华线路生成。

---

二、周围趣味元素（全部根据城市自动替换）

在路线周围加入大量充满童趣的小元素，例如：

- 可爱的旅行角色：
  “拿着当地特色小吃的小朋友”、
  “背着旅行包的冒险小孩”等。

- 当地标志性建筑的童趣 Q 版手绘：
  如 “{城市地标1}”、“{城市地标2}”、“{城市地标3}”。

- 有趣的提示牌：
  “小心迷路！”、“注意人流！”、“前方好吃的！”（可根据城市语境调整）。

- 贴纸式小标语：
  “{argument name="城市名" default="北京"}旅行记忆已解锁！”
  “{argument name="城市名" default="北京"}美食大冒险！”
  “下一站去哪儿？”

- 当地美食的可爱小图标：
  如 “{城市美食1}”、“{城市美食2}”、“{城市美食3}”。

- 感叹句（保持童真风）：
  “原来{argument name="城市名" default="北京"}这么好玩！”
  “我要再来一次！”

---

三、整体风格要求

- 手绘蜡笔风 / 儿童旅行日志风格
- 色彩鲜艳、构图饱满但温暖
- 强调旅行的欢乐与探索感
- 所有文字采用可爱的手写字体
- 让整个画面像一本童趣满满的旅行手账页面

items.title: Countryball Strait of Hormuz Standoff
items.titleZh: A detailed satirical countryball meme illustration of the {argument name="waterway name" default="Strait of Hormuz"} as a very narrow sea passage between two steep rocky cliffs, painted in a polished digital cartoon style with dramatic shading and textured stone. In the center foreground, exactly 2 countryballs block each other in the tight channel so that only one can pass. On the left is a USA countryball with angry narrowed eyes, painted with the American flag, wearing a dark navy baseball cap labeled "USA" in large white letters. On the right is an Iran countryball with angry narrowed eyes, painted with the Iranian flag and emblem, wearing a green-and-white headband tied on the side; the headband contains Korean text that reads "저항은 우리의 권리". Above each ball is exactly 1 white speech bubble with thick black outline, for a total of 2 speech bubbles, and both say {argument name="speech text" default="길!"} in large bold Korean lettering, as if neither side will yield. Show the two balls facing each other nose-to-nose in a standoff in the bottleneck. On the left cliff, include exactly 1 wooden sign reading in Korean and English: "호르무즈 해협" and "Strait of Hormuz". On the right cliff, include exactly 1 warning sign with Persian text at the top and a red warning triangle below, indicating that only one person can pass. In the left bottom corner, place exactly 1 black oil barrel labeled "OIL" with dark spilled oil pooling around it. In the right bottom corner, place exactly 1 black naval mine with Persian writing on it, attached to a chain. In the background beyond the narrow passage, show open sea with exactly 3 distant ships, including at least 1 larger tanker and faint dark smoke rising into the sky. Use a tense but humorous geopolitical meme tone, centered composition, eye-level view, soft daylight, slightly muted realistic colors, crisp outlines, and high readability for all text.

items.titleZh: A humorous political meme illustration in a simple countryball cartoon style, showing the current situation at the {argument name="location label" default="호르무즈 해협"} as a narrow chokepoint. Use a wide landscape composition with bright flat colors, thick black outlines, and a clean hand-drawn infographic-like look. In the foreground, place 2 countryballs standing shoulder to shoulder on an extremely narrow sandy land bridge with rocks along both sides, making it obvious that only one can pass at a time. On the left is a {argument name="left country" default="United States"} countryball painted with the American flag, wearing black sunglasses and a brown cowboy hat, facing the other ball with a stubborn attitude. On the right is an {argument name="right country" default="Iran"} countryball painted with the Iranian flag, wearing a dark turban-like hat, with angry slanted eyes, also refusing to move. Add 2 large white speech bubbles, one beside each countryball, and put the same bold Korean word in both bubbles: {argument name="speech bubble text" default="길"}. In the midground and background, show a busy blue sea crowded with 9 ships total: 2 gray US warships on the far left, 1 Chinese submarine with a red Chinese flag, 4 oil tankers lined up in the center-left and center carrying different national flags, and 2 gray military ships near the narrow passage with small American flags. At the top right, include a large Iranian flag overlay along the coastline. Draw beige landmasses around the waterway to resemble a simplified map view of the Strait of Hormuz. items.title: Blockbuster Anime Sky Fantasy Poster
items.titleZh: A breathtaking Japanese anime movie poster in the style of a blockbuster theatrical key visual, ultra-detailed and emotionally grand, with a delicate luminous sky reminiscent of prestige modern anime cinema. The scene shows 2 characters from behind on a flower-covered cliff overlooking a glowing coastal fantasy city at sunset and twilight: a teenage boy in a dark school uniform with a loosened tie and windblown short dark hair stands on the left, and a teenage girl in a long flowing pale dress with very long silver-white hair stands on the right. Both face the horizon in awe. Above them, an enormous celestial sky fills most of the composition, painted with vivid deep blue, indigo, violet, magenta, and gold clouds, a brilliant comet-like meteor streak slashing diagonally from upper center toward the horizon, scattered stars, sparkling particles, and a glowing circular magic-like ring constellation in the upper right sky. The sea and city below shimmer with reflected light, with slender fantasy skyscrapers and towers rising from the coastline and a radiant sunlit gap at the center horizon. Foreground flowers are saturated blue and purple with glowing highlights, and white-pink petals drift through the air. Use dramatic rim light, cinematic backlighting, lens-glow sparkle effects, highly polished anime rendering, crisp linework, atmospheric depth, and a vertical poster composition. Include Japanese poster typography integrated into the design: giant embossed gold headline text across the top reading {argument name="top headline text" default="興行収入100億円突破"}, a gold subheadline block at upper left reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="大ヒット上映中"}, a vertical white tagline on the upper right reading {argument name="tagline text" default="あの日、君と見上げた空が、世界を変える。"}, and a very large glowing white-lavender Japanese film title at the bottom center reading {argument name="movie title" default="星屑の約束"}. Beneath the title, add small elegant romanized subtitle text reading {argument name="romanized subtitle" default="Hoshikuzu no Yakusoku"}, plus dense small production credits, cast lines, website text, release-copy lines, and cinema format logos along the bottom edge in authentic Japanese movie-poster layout. Add 2 gold laurel emblems flanking the top headline, one on the left and one on the right. Make it feel like a fictional anime film that earned 10 billion yen at the box office, sweeping, romantic, bittersweet, magical, and destined to make audiences cry.

items.title: Steampunk Ship Cabin Interior
items.titleZh: A highly detailed cinematic interior of a cramped Victorian steampunk ship cabin engine room, viewed from standing eye level in a narrow corridor. The scene is packed wall-to-wall with aged polished brass pipes, copper tubes, riveted metal tanks, valves, gauges, and dark varnished wooden cabinets. On the left foreground, a steep wooden staircase with curved banister enters the frame diagonally. Along both sides of the corridor are heavy antique drawers and machinery consoles covered with small metal instruments, teapots, kettles, and mechanical fittings. At the back center is a small square-paned porthole window with 6 visible panes, showing a pale overcast exterior and a faint distant industrial skyline. Beneath the window is a narrow shelf unit with 3 open levels and a small drawer. On the right wall near the window hangs 1 round analog clock. The walls are painted teal-green metal with peeling paint and weathered patina. The floor is dark wood with a narrow worn patterned rug runner. Lighting is warm and moody, primarily from 1 glowing amber industrial wall lamp near the upper left of center, mixed with soft cold daylight from the porthole. Emphasize rich material texture, tarnished brass, oxidized copper, chipped paint, dust, age, and a lived-in mechanical atmosphere. Symmetrical depth, dense environmental storytelling, ultra-detailed, realistic, cinematic composition, shallow contrast but sharp focus throughout, no people.
items.promptZh: 在狭窄的走廊里，从与视线齐平的位置观察，可以看到狭窄的维多利亚蒸汽朋克船舱发动机室的高度细节化的电影内部。场景中到处都是陈旧的抛光黄铜管、铜管、铆接的金属罐、阀门、仪表和深色清漆的木柜。在左边的前景，一个带有弯曲栏杆的陡峭的木楼梯斜向进入框架。走廊两侧是沉重的古董抽屉和机械控制台，上面布满了小型金属仪器、茶壶、水壶和机械配件。后面中央是一扇小方玻璃舷窗，有 6 块可见玻璃，显示出苍白阴暗的外观和隐约遥远的工业天际线。窗户下方是一个狭窄的架子单元，有 3 个开放层和一个小抽屉。靠近窗户的右墙上挂着 1 个圆形模拟时钟。墙壁被漆成青绿色的金属，油漆剥落，铜锈已风化。地板是深色木地板，上面有一条窄窄的、有磨损图案的地毯。灯光温暖而喜怒无常，主要来自中心左上方附近的一盏发光的琥珀色工业壁灯，与舷窗发出的柔和的冷日光混合在一起。强调丰富的材料质感、失去光泽的黄铜、氧化的铜、剥落的油漆、灰尘、年代和生活中的机械氛围。对称的深度、密集的环境故事讲述、超详细、现实的电影构图、浅对比度但贯穿始终的清晰焦点，没有人物。

Center front: a young man in a wide straw hat, oversized red graphic T-shirt, blue shorts, and a black crossbody waist bag, holding a mint-blue ice cream cone. Front left: a green-haired young man in a black oversized graphic shirt with green lettering and layered necklaces, eating ice cream. Front right: a small chibi-like reindeer mascot character wearing a large pink hat with a white X, black and pink streetwear jacket, and holding a blue-and-pink ice cream cone. Right midground: a long-nosed smiling young man in a cap and casual streetwear, loudly laughing with an ice cream cone; behind him a tall skeleton man with a large black afro, crown-like hat, purple hoodie, sunglasses, and an ice cream cone. Left midground: an orange-haired young woman in a cropped white tank top and jeans holding ice cream; behind center-left a blond young man in a blue shirt with a relaxed pose and ice cream; center-right a dark-haired young woman in a purple outfit with sunglasses on her head holding ice cream. The mood is cheerful, summery, fashionable, and adventurous. Add large brush-script title text across the top reading {argument name="headline text" default="ONE PIECE"} in huge white paint strokes, with a yellow handwritten subtitle reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="Straw Hat Crew"}. On the upper left, stack poster text blocks reading exactly: "STRAW HAT CREW", "2024", "WE GO! TOGETHER! NEW WORLD!". On the right side, add a vertical street sign reading "New World". Include a pink hanging sign reading "ICE CREAM" with a skull emblem. Add pirate-skull hat emblems in the corners and on storefront signage. At the lower left, place white handwritten script reading "Enjoy! Ice Cream" with a small smiley, and beneath it smaller bold text reading "一起去吃冰淇淋吧！". At the lower left edge add small text: "I'M GONNA BE KING OF THE PIRATES!". At the lower right add "ONE PIECE 2024", a barcode, and tiny caption text "STRAW HAT CREW SUMMER ICE CREAM". Use glossy anime illustration rendering, bold cel shading, crisp line art, rich fabric folds, detailed accessories, vibrant summer lighting, cinematic contrast, poster-grade typography, and a polished commercial key art finish. items.titleZh: A cinematic vertical poster inspired by The Little Prince, set on a rainy city street at blue hour in modern Shanghai. In the center foreground, a small child in Little Prince styling stands in side profile facing right, with messy curly golden-blond hair, a long flowing mustard-gold scarf blowing dramatically to the left, and a muted sage-green ankle-length coat tied at the waist. The child holds 1 single red rose upright in both hands. The face is simplified and softly obscured, with no detailed facial features. The wet pavement reflects neon lights, traffic, and the evening sky. In the background, the Oriental Pearl Tower rises softly out of the dusk with glowing pinkish lights, surrounded by blurred city buildings, storefronts, pedestrians, and car headlights, creating a dreamy bokeh urban atmosphere. On the upper right, include 1 street sign mounted on a traffic pole reading {argument name="street sign text" default="星球大道\nPLANET AVE."}. Also on the pole, include 1 red pedestrian traffic light showing a standing human figure. On the left side, place large handwritten brush-style Chinese quote text in warm pale yellow: {argument name="main quote" default="重要的东西，\n用眼睛是看不见的。"}, with a smaller signature line beneath reading {argument name="author text" default="—— 小王子"}. Scatter a few tiny hand-drawn star doodles and 1 small planet doodle around the text. Near the lower left, add 3 lines of small warm-yellow Chinese dedication text above a stylized script title reading {argument name="title text" default="Le Petit Prince"}. On the right side near the pole, tape 1 small paper note with handwritten Chinese text about not seeing truly important things with the eyes, plus a simple doodle. Add 1 vertical storefront sign on the left reading "咖啡". The composition should feel poetic, nostalgic, gentle, and premium, like an art-house movie poster or literary inspirational street poster. Color palette: twilight blue sky, amber street glow, soft gold typography, muted green clothing, vivid red rose. Shallow depth of field, glossy rain reflections, soft cinematic lighting, highly detailed illustration with realistic urban atmosphere and storybook character design.

items.titleZh: A dynamic manga-style action illustration of a single androgynous young woman shot from a dramatic low angle, as if the viewer is beneath her while she drops or steps forward through an explosive burst of ink and debris. She has a short platinum-blonde bob haircut with long side-swept bangs partly covering one side of her face, pale skin, and a cool, rebellious streetwear aesthetic. Her face is obscured by a simple light-gray rectangular censor block. She wears 5 main clothing items: an oversized black hooded jacket with bright cyan geometric markings on the sleeve and inner lining, a fitted white tank top, loose black cargo-style pants with straps and zipper details, a black belt with a hanging cyan tag, and chunky white-and-black sneakers with small cyan accents. Add extra accessory details including dangling straps, buckles, and street-tech trims. Her pose is relaxed but dominant, one knee raised toward the viewer, torso leaning back slightly, one hand tucked into a pocket, jacket flaring outward in motion. The composition should feel aggressive and kinetic, with a monochrome palette of black, white, and gray, punctuated by vivid electric cyan paint slashes. Fill the background with explosive abstract brushwork, ink splatter, speed lines, torn black shards, and chaotic manga energy radiating outward from behind her. High contrast, gritty texture, rough inked linework, painterly splashes, urban dystopian anime key visual, extremely detailed fabric folds, stylish editorial framing, wide cinematic composition.
items.promptZh: 动态漫画风格的动作插图，描绘了一位雌雄同体的年轻女子，从戏剧性的低角度拍摄，仿佛观众就在她下方，而她在墨水和碎片的爆炸性爆发中跌落或前进。她留着白金金色的鲍勃短发，长长的侧扫刘海遮住了脸的一侧，皮肤苍白，有着酷炫、叛逆的街头服饰审美。她的脸被一个简单的浅灰色矩形检查块遮挡。她穿着 5 件主要服装：一件超大号黑色连帽夹克，袖子和内衬上有亮青色几何标记；合身白色背心；带有肩带和拉链细节的宽松黑色工装裤；一条带有悬挂青色标签的黑色腰带；以及带有小青色装饰的厚实黑白运动鞋。添加额外的配饰细节，包括悬挂带、带扣和街头科技装饰。她的姿势放松但占主导地位，一只膝盖向观众抬起，躯干稍微向后倾斜，一只手插在口袋里，夹克向外张开。构图应该给人一种侵略性和动感的感觉，采用黑、白、灰的单色调色板，并点缀着生动的电青色油漆斜线。背景充满爆炸性的抽象笔触、墨水飞溅、速度线、撕裂的黑色碎片，以及从她身后向外辐射的混乱漫画能量。高对比度、粗糙的纹理、粗糙的墨迹线条、绘画般的泼溅、城市反乌托邦动漫的主视觉、极其细致的织物褶皱、时尚的编辑框架、宽广的电影构图。

items.title: Minimal SaaS Ad With Invoice Mockup
items.titleZh: Create a minimalist static SaaS ad on a warm off-white background with elegant editorial typography and clean, high-fidelity text rendering. At the top, place a large black serif headline in two lines reading: "{argument name="headline text" default="Your dev team shouldn’t be your analytics team."}" The words “dev team” should appear in italic serif while the rest remains bold high-contrast serif, with generous spacing and a luxury magazine-style layout. Centered below, show a slightly tilted white paper invoice sheet with a soft drop shadow and a subtle vertical fold crease down the middle, as if photographed from above. The invoice uses black monospaced typewriter-style text and reads exactly: “INVOICE — DEV HOURS, OCTOBER” as the header, then 5 line items with hours and prices aligned in columns: “A/B test setup on pricing page   8 hrs   $1,200”, “GTM tag install (3 events)   4 hrs   $600”, “Funnel tracking debug   6 hrs   $900”, “Meta pixel mapping   3 hrs   $450”, and “Attribution reporting build   12 hrs   $1,800”. Under the 5 items, add a dashed divider line, then a bold monospaced “TOTAL” on the lower left and the total price “$4,950” on the lower right. Draw a hand-drawn yellow line striking through the total price. Add 4 doodle-style annotation elements around the invoice: on the left, handwritten yellow text saying “every month??” with a yellow arrow pointing right toward the paper; on the upper right of the paper, a yellow starburst scribble; below the total, a green curved arrow pointing up toward the crossed-out price; and on the lower right, a green hand-drawn circle containing the handwritten words “zero devs,” connected to the green arrow. At the bottom center of the ad, add a smaller black sans-serif body copy in 2 lines reading: “{argument name="body text" default="Marketers ship tests and track revenue themselves.\nNo tickets. No tag manager. One script."}" Keep the composition airy, premium, and conversion-focused, blending modern startup ad design with tactile paper realism and playful marker annotations.

At the top, place a large stacked serif headline in off-white reading: "Your analytics stack" on the first line, "shouldn’t cost more" on the second line in bright magenta italic serif, and "than your rent." on the third line in off-white serif. items.titleZh: Create a clean minimalist static ad on an off-white light gray studio background with a centered editorial layout. At the top, place a large luxury-fashion-style serif headline in black reading {argument name="headline text" default="Stop gambling with your ad spend."}, with the word "gambling" set in italic serif for emphasis. In the middle, show a vintage metal slot-machine window viewed straight on, slightly weathered and realistic, with 3 vertical reels inside a rectangular steel housing and a lever with a black knob on the right side. The 3 reels must display, from left to right, "$", "$", and "?". Make the rightmost reel background pale pink while the first 2 reels are aged white. Add a hand-drawn neon-pink annotation style over the image: 1 arrow-and-note on the left pointing to the first reel reading {argument name="left annotation" default="your attribution"}, 1 starburst scribble above the pink question-mark reel, 1 arrow from the question-mark reel to a circled note on the right reading {argument name="right annotation" default="actual revenue"}, and 1 large curved arrow in the lower left pointing toward the body copy area. Below the slot machine, center a short sans-serif paragraph in black reading {argument name="body text" default="See which campaigns drive revenue, not just clicks. Connect Meta, Google, and Stripe in 60 seconds."}. At the bottom center, place a simple black analytics-style bar logo icon followed by the bold sans-serif brand name {argument name="brand name" default="Humblytics"}. Use strong text fidelity, polished product-ad composition, soft studio shadows, restrained palette of black, steel gray, off-white, and hot pink, and a modern direct-response ad aesthetic.

items.title: Blurred Deer in Green Forest
items.titleZh: A painterly wildlife photograph with strong intentional motion blur, showing 1 deer-like animal in a lush green forest clearing. The animal stands slightly left of center in side profile facing left, with a pale tan to cream body, slender legs, and a soft indistinct head and ears, partially emerging from a dark shadowy opening in dense foliage. The entire image is heavily smeared with diagonal and vertical camera motion, creating an impressionistic, dreamlike effect rather than sharp detail. Surround the subject with saturated summer greenery: deep emerald bushes in the background, darker forest shadows near the upper left, and bright vivid grass across the foreground. Use natural outdoor daylight, rich green tones, soft contrast, and an abstract photographic style that feels like a fleeting glimpse of wildlife captured while moving. No people, no text, no buildings, no extra animals.
items.promptZh: 一张带有强烈有意运动模糊的绘画野生动物照片，展示了郁郁葱葱的绿色森林空地上的一只类似鹿的动物。该动物的侧面轮廓面向左侧，站立位置稍偏左，身体呈浅棕褐色至奶油色，腿细长，头部和耳朵柔软模糊，部分从茂密树叶中的深色阴影开口中露出。整个图像严重涂抹了对角线和垂直的相机运动，创造了一种印象派、梦幻般的效果，而不是清晰的细节。用饱和的夏季绿色植物围绕主题：背景是深翠的灌木丛，左上方附近较暗的森林阴影，前景是明亮生动的草丛。使用自然的户外日光、丰富的绿色色调、柔和的对比度和抽象的摄影风格，感觉就像在移动时捕捉到的野生动物的一瞥。没有人，没有文字，没有建筑物，没有多余的动物。
items.prompt: A painterly wildlife photograph with strong intentional motion blur, showing 1 deer-like animal in a lush green forest clearing. The animal stands slightly left of center in side profile facing left, with a pale tan to cream body, slender legs, and a soft indistinct head and ears, partially emerging from a dark shadowy opening in dense foliage. The entire image is heavily smeared with diagonal and vertical camera motion, creating an impressionistic, dreamlike effect rather than sharp detail. Surround the subject with saturated summer greenery: deep emerald bushes in the background, darker forest shadows near the upper left, and bright vivid grass across the foreground. Use natural outdoor daylight, rich green tones, soft contrast, and an abstract photographic style that feels like a fleeting glimpse of wildlife captured while moving. No people, no text, no buildings, no extra animals.

items.title: Anime Maid Thriller Movie Poster
items.titleZh: A dramatic anime theatrical movie poster in a tall vertical composition, centered on 2 young women in classic black-and-white maid uniforms standing back-to-back and facing opposite directions. The left maid has a short silver bob haircut with straight bangs and a white maid headband; the right maid has a short vivid pink bob haircut with straight bangs and a matching white maid headband. Both wear fitted black dresses with puff sleeves, white aprons with ruffled trim, white collars and cuffs, and black ribbon accents at the neck. Their poses are confident and tense, with one hand lowered at their sides, suggesting mystery and rivalry. Place them large in the foreground, filling most of the poster height. Behind them, create a split-color night sky: deep electric blue on the left and saturated magenta-pink on the right, blending at the center. In the upper left, show a bright full moon and a small helicopter with a searchlight. Along the horizon and lower sides, include a glowing city skyline, blue-lit on the left and pink-lit on the right. In the center background, place a gothic mansion or castle with pointed towers at the end of a path, illuminated with warm lights. In front of the mansion, show 2 smaller full-body figures of the same maids from behind, walking toward the building side by side. Add 4 supporting characters around the lower edges: 1 dark-haired man in a suit at bottom left, 1 older stern man in a suit at lower right-center, 1 young woman with long dark hair at bottom right, and the 2 small maid figures in the center distance, for a total of 6 visible human figures in the poster. Scatter bright pink flower petals across the image as if blown by the wind. Use intense cinematic lighting, glossy anime rendering, high contrast, sharp linework, glowing rim light, and a suspenseful psychological thriller mood. Include vertical Japanese tagline text on both sides, a large stylized title at the bottom center reading {argument name="title text" default="Re:maid"}, smaller Japanese subtitle text beneath it, and release text at the lower left reading {argument name="release date text" default="7.25 [FRI] ROADSHOW"}. Add a final Japanese tagline line along the bottom. Overall style: premium anime key visual, mystery thriller, neon blue and hot pink dual-color palette, polished poster typography, highly detailed background, dynamic petals, and theatrical film-poster finish.
items.promptZh: 戏剧性的动漫剧场电影海报，采用高大的垂直构图，以两名身穿经典黑白女仆制服的年轻女性为中心，背靠背面向相反方向站立。左边的女仆留着齐刘海的银色波波头短发，戴着白色的女仆发带；右边的女仆留着鲜艳的粉色短发，直刘海，搭配白色女仆头带。两人都穿着合身的泡泡袖黑色连衣裙、带褶边饰边的白色围裙、白色衣领和袖口，颈部饰有黑色丝带。他们的姿势自信而紧张，一只手垂在身体两侧，暗示着神秘和竞争。将它们放在前景较大的位置，占据海报的大部分高度。在它们后面，创建一个分色的夜空：左边是深电蓝色，右边是饱和的洋红色，在中心混合。左上角显示一轮明亮的满月和一架带有探照灯的小型直升机。沿着地平线和下侧，包括发光的城市天际线，左侧呈蓝色，右侧呈粉红色。在中心背景中，在路径的尽头放置一座带有尖塔的哥特式豪宅或城堡，用温暖的灯光照亮。宅邸前，有两个较小的同一女仆的全身像，并肩向宅邸走去。在下边缘添加4个配角：左下角1个黑发西装男，右下角1个严肃的西装男，右下角1个黑长发年轻女子，中间距离2个小女仆，海报上总共有6个可见人物。将亮粉色的花瓣撒在图像上，就像被风吹过一样。使用强烈的电影灯光、光泽的动漫渲染、高对比度、清晰的线条、发光的边缘光和悬疑的心理惊悚情绪。两侧均包含垂直的日文标语文本，底部中心有一个大的风格化标题，内容为 {argument name="title text" default="Re:maid"}，下方较小的日文副标题文本，左下角的发布文本为 {argument name="release date text" default="7.25 [FRI] ROADSHOW"}。沿底部添加最终的日语标语行。整体风格：优质动漫主视觉、悬疑惊悚片、霓虹蓝和艳粉色双色调、精美的海报排版、高度细致的背景、动态花瓣和戏剧电影海报效果。

items.title: Dark Wuxia Game Poster
items.titleZh: A dramatic vertical cinematic poster for the dark wuxia action game {argument name="game title" default="Phantom Blade Zero"}, painted in an ultra-detailed gritty concept-art style with realistic textures, moody volumetric fog, and high contrast lighting. The scene shows 1 lone swordsman standing in the lower center foreground, viewed mostly from behind in a three-quarter pose, wearing a wide straw hat and layered black robes shredded into long wind-whipped strips, with pale loose hair streaming out beneath the hat. He holds 1 drawn sword low in his right hand, the blade catching cold silver light. The environment is a ruined ancient Chinese city of towering wooden pagodas and fortress-like buildings rising into steep cliffs, with collapsing architecture, hanging chains, smoke, drifting ash, and rubble. A bright full moon glows near the top center behind dense storm clouds, backlighting the skyline and the warrior. The color palette is almost monochrome charcoal, black, steel gray, and moonlit white, punctuated by sharp crimson slashes and blood-like streaks cutting diagonally across the composition. At the very top, place 4 huge Chinese calligraphy characters in explosive white brushstroke ink reading {argument name="main Chinese title" default="影之刃零"}, spanning nearly the full width. Directly beneath, centered, add the small elegant serif English subtitle {argument name="subtitle text" default="PHANTOM BLADE ZERO"}. At the bottom center, add 1 line of Chinese tagline text reading {argument name="tagline text" default="刀光即命运 影尽方归零"}, with the final character in red, plus 1 smaller line of Chinese promotional text beneath it. Add subtle ornamental divider lines and a tiny red seal-like emblem at the bottom. Composition should feel like an official AAA key art poster: epic, ominous, martial, supernatural, and intensely atmospheric, with dynamic wind, debris, embers, torn fabric, and ink-splatter energy.

items.title: Blindfolded Sorcerer Victory Pose
items.titleZh: A high-impact shonen manga anime illustration of a powerful white-haired sorcerer in a dramatic low-angle full-body pose, laughing with his head thrown back and mouth wide open, wearing a sleek black high-collar uniform and a black blindfold over his eyes. His left hand is thrust toward the viewer making a two-finger peace sign, with strong foreshortening that makes the hand large in the foreground, while his right arm hangs lower at his side. Surround him with explosive {argument name="energy color" default="electric blue"} supernatural energy, violent brushstroke-like aura trails, flying debris, sparks, and swirling curved streaks cutting across the frame. The background should be a dark, abstract, chaotic energy burst with glowing blue shards and motion lines, creating a sense of overwhelming power. Use bold cel-shaded anime rendering with painterly highlights, sharp linework, intense contrast, and glossy fabric folds on the black outfit. On the right side, add 1 large jagged white manga speech bubble with thick black outline containing the text {argument name="speech bubble text" default="LUDDITES ALWAYS LOSE!"} in huge distressed black uppercase letters. Vertical composition, dynamic action poster framing, confident triumphant attitude, modern dark fantasy anime aesthetic.

items.title: Tim Cook MMO Raid Boss Screen
items.titleZh: Create a cinematic fantasy MMO raid boss loading-screen-style illustration with a full custom game UI overlay. The scene is set at dusk in front of the glass cube Apple Store, with the glowing white Apple logo centered on the building facade. In the middle of the plaza stands a giant raid boss version of {argument name="boss name" default="Tim Cook"}, labeled as "The Architect," wearing a fitted black turtleneck, dark pants, and sneakers, holding a glowing smartphone in one hand and posing calmly with the other hand open. His face is intentionally blurred or anonymized. The overall tone is epic, satirical, and high-production, like a World of Warcraft raid encounter screen mixed with corporate tech parody. Around him, exactly 20 fantasy raiders in a semicircle battle formation face inward toward the boss, with varied races and silhouettes including armored warriors, rogues, mages, shamans, hunters, and orc-like and human-like characters. Several are casting bright spells in orange fire, blue lightning, green energy, and purple void magic. Include exactly 3 small robotic adds near the boss, each labeled "Supplier Add," with squat industrial bodies and Apple logos on their fronts. Also include 2 active encounter mechanic bubbles: one blue spherical shield labeled "Margin Shield" on the right side of the boss, and one purple circular dome labeled "Closed System" farther right with a humanoid enemy trapped inside. Build the image as a complete raid UI composition. Top left: a large expansion-style title reading "SIEGE OF THE INFINITE LOOP" with subtitle "20-MAN HORDE RAID." Far left: a vertical "RAID FRAMES" panel listing exactly 20 player names in numbered rows from 1 to 20 with colored health bars. Top center: a boss portrait frame with the boss name {argument name="boss name" default="Tim Cook"}, subtitle "The Architect," and a red health bar at 100%. Top right: a large encounter guide panel titled "ENCOUNTER: {argument name="boss name" default="TIM COOK"} – \"THE ARCHITECT\"" containing exactly 3 phases. Phase 1 title: "SUPPLY CHAIN DOMINANCE (100% – 70%)" with 3 abilities: "Logistics Surge – Summons waves of Supplier Adds.", "Margin Shield – Reduces incoming damage by 40% for 10 sec.", and "Quarterly Pressure – Stacking debuff, explodes if not dispelled." Phase 2 title: "ECOSYSTEM LOCK-IN (70% – 30%)" with 3 abilities: "Closed System – Isolates 3 players, puzzle to return.", "Subscription Drain – Raid-wide damage over time.", and "Device Sync – Stack in correct formations to avoid spikes." Phase 3 title: "ONE MORE THING (30% – 0%)" with 3 abilities: "Surprise Launch – Massive AoE burst every 20 sec.", "Reality Distortion Field – Reverses controls briefly.", and "Enrage: Market Collapse – Boss enrages at 3:00." Bottom right: a "POTENTIAL LOOT" panel listing exactly 4 items with rarity-colored text: "Executive Cloak of Efficiency (Epic)", "Keynote Blade (Epic)", "Ecosystem Ring (Epic)", and "Investor's Favor (Bonus – Hard Mode)." Below that, add a small red-black badge reading "HARD MODE" and the line "Activate \"Investor Call\" during the fight to" with the remaining text cut off or obscured. Bottom left: a "CHAT" box with 4 lines, including taunting boss dialogue and a player response, such as "{argument name="boss quote" default="Tim Cook yells: Innovation. Discipline. Excellence. That is how we win."}", "Tim Cook yells: Our ecosystem is unbreakable.", "Tim Cook yells: One more thing...", and "Lok'tarbrok: Lok'tar ogar!" Along the bottom center: a fantasy action bar with exactly 12 ability icons in ornate slots, some numbered, some showing cooldown text including "2m" and "1m". Use dramatic volumetric lighting, glossy reflections on the wet plaza, realistic environment rendering, highly detailed fantasy characters, exaggerated spell effects, dark vignette, sharp UI typography, and polished AAA game key art composition.

items.titleZh: Create a premium minimalist keynote-style presentation cover slide in an Apple-inspired industrial design aesthetic. Use a wide 16:9 layout with a deep matte black upper background and a pale concrete-gray lower platform occupying the bottom quarter of the frame. Place a large photorealistic floating rectangular slab in the right-center foreground, resembling a thin black glass device or polished obsidian platform with mirror-like reflections, chamfered chrome-metal edges, and precise industrial finishing. The slab should hover above the light surface and cast a soft elongated shadow directly beneath it. Add a tall vertical gray metallic wall or pillar on the far right edge to frame the composition. Use extremely sparse, high-end art direction, lots of negative space, cinematic studio lighting, subtle gradients, and crisp contrast between black and silver materials. On the left side, set clean white sans-serif typography with a clear hierarchy: a tiny top caption reading "{argument name="system label" default="Apple-inspired presentation system"}", a very large bold headline reading "{argument name="headline text" default="Clarity At Scale"}", and a medium subtitle reading "{argument name="subtitle text" default="The strongest slides behave like products."}". items.title: Thoughtful Systems Presentation Cover
items.titleZh: Create a refined editorial presentation cover slide in a warm, Claude-inspired design system. Use a landscape 16:9 composition with a parchment-paper background, subtle paper grain, soft shadows, and layered torn-paper collage elements. The overall palette should be warm ivory, cream, sand, charcoal, muted black, and terracotta accent. On the left half, place a small top label reading "{argument name="system label" default="Claude-inspired presentation system"}" with a small terracotta dot and a thin horizontal divider line. Below it, set an oversized elegant high-contrast serif headline in black that reads "{argument name="main headline" default="Thoughtful Systems"}", split across two lines and dominating the left side. Under the headline, add a smaller serif subheadline in terracotta reading "{argument name="subheadline" default="Warmth can still feel precise."}". Beneath that, create a vertical list of exactly 4 design principles, each on its own row with thin divider lines and a small icon at left: 1) a rectangular parchment-sheet icon with the text "Parchment canvas", 2) a serif capital T icon with the text "Serif-led hierarchy", 3) a filled terracotta circle icon with the text "Terracotta for signal", 4) a chain-link icon with the text "Organic diagrams over cold chrome". Add a tiny footer caption at bottom left reading "CLAUDE-INSPIRED PRESENTATION SYSTEM" in spaced small caps. On the right half, build a layered collage of exactly 3 paper cards: first, a tall off-white art card with a fine border containing the heading "A more considered approach", a short body paragraph about complex problems yielding to clarity, a minimal landscape line drawing with a terracotta sun, and a vertical terracotta botanical branch overlapping the card; second, a dark charcoal rectangular card partially behind it with the lowercase title "thinking process" and an exact 5-step numbered list: "01 Observe", "02 Interpret", "03 Connect", "04 Synthesize", "05 Act with care", plus a delicate circular orbital diagram in dotted lines and terracotta highlight; third, a torn off-white note card in front near the bottom with a hand-drawn overlapping-circles diagram where one crescent-shaped intersection area is shaded in terracotta, alongside a handwritten quote reading "{argument name="quote" default="Clarity emerges when systems are designed with intention."}". Include one extra light beige paper strip tucked beneath the lower cards. Emphasize tactile realism, elegant negative space, print-editorial sophistication, soft natural lighting, and a calm, thoughtful luxury-tech mood.
items.promptZh: 在受克劳德启发的温暖设计系统中创建精致的编辑演示文稿封面幻灯片。使用具有羊皮纸背景、微妙的纸纹、柔和的阴影和分层的撕纸拼贴元素的风景 16:9 构图。整体色调应该是温暖的象牙色、奶油色、沙色、木炭色、柔和的黑色和赤土色。在左半部分，放置一个小顶部标签，上面写着“{argument name =“system label”default =“Claude-inspiredpresentation system”}”，带有一个小陶土点和一条细水平分隔线。在其下方，设置一个超大的、优雅的、高对比度的黑色衬线标题，上面写着“{argument name="main header" default="Thoughtful Systems"}”，分成两行并占据左侧。在标题下，添加一个较小的赤土色衬线副标题，内容为“{argument name="subheadline" default="Warmth can still Feel Precision."}”。在其下方，创建一个包含 4 个设计原则的垂直列表，每个设计原则在其自己的行上，带有细分隔线，并在左侧有一个小图标：1）一个矩形羊皮纸图标，上面写着“羊皮纸画布”，2）一个衬线大写 T 图标，上面写着“衬线主导的层次结构”，3）一个填充的赤土圆形图标，上面写着“赤土信号”，4）一个链式图标，上面写着“冷的有机图”铬”。在左下角添加一个小页脚标题，用间隔小写大写字母写着“CLAUDE-INSPIRED PRESENTATION SYSTEM”。在右半部分，用 3 张纸卡制作分层拼贴画：首先，一张高大的灰白色艺术卡，带有细边框，其中包含标题“更经过深思熟虑的方法”，一段关于复杂问题的简短正文段落，清晰可见，带有赤土太阳的最小风景线图，以及与卡重叠的垂直赤土植物分支；第二，一张深色木炭矩形卡片，部分在其后面，上面写着小写标题“思考过程”和一个精确的 5 步编号列表：“01 观察”、“02 解释”、“03 连接”、“04 综合”、“05 小心行事”，以及精致的虚线圆形轨道图和赤土色突出显示；第三，前面靠近底部的一张撕破的灰白色便条卡，上面有一张手绘的重叠圆圈图，其中一个新月形交叉区域用赤土色遮蔽，旁边有一条手写引文，上面写着“{argument name =“quote”default =“当系统有意设计时，清晰度就会出现。”}”。在下面的卡片下方添加一条额外的浅米色纸条。强调触觉真实感、优雅的负空间、精致的印刷编辑、柔和的自然光线以及平静、深思熟虑的奢华科技氛围。

items.title: Surreal Woman at a Weathered Window
items.titleZh: A moody surreal painting of a woman leaning forward through an old window frame, shown from behind and cropped tightly so the composition centers on her wildly windblown {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown with copper highlights"} hair streaming left across the image in long tangled strands. Her bare shoulders and upper back are mostly hidden by her hair, and both hands rest on a worn wooden windowsill at the bottom center, with 2 visible fingers on each side gripping the ledge. The face is completely obscured by hair and angle. Behind her is a weathered multi-pane window with 6 rectangular panes in a 3-by-2 grid, painted in cold gray-blue tones with grime, scratches, drips, and distressed edges. Use an expressive mixed-media style combining charcoal, ink, dry brush, scratched lines, and textured oil paint on rough canvas, with sketchy white and black linework layered over muted industrial colors. items.title: Japanese Fantasy Winged Pig Film Poster
items.titleZh: A dramatic Japanese fantasy movie poster in a painterly, ultra-detailed cinematic illustration style. The poster is vertically composed like a theatrical key visual, with a warm gold title at the bottom and multiple emotional vignettes layered into one unified scene. The central character is a small fluffy pig-like creature with soft pale cream fur, oversized pink inner ears, a tiny snout, a curled tail, and large feathered angel wings glowing with golden light. It stands upright on a rooftop or elevated wooden platform overlooking a vast Tokyo cityscape at sunset, holding a whiskey glass in one hoof with the other hoof on its hip, posed like a weary but resilient middle-aged salaryman. In the distance are the Tokyo skyline, water, bridges, floating lanterns, and Tokyo Tower glowing orange-red under a radiant sky filled with clouds lit in gold, peach, violet, and deep blue. Around the center are 4 supporting vignette scenes: 1) top left, the winged pig sits alone at a narrow bar counter in a nostalgic lantern-lit Japanese alley at night, looking exhausted and melancholy, with a bottle and a glass nearby; 2) top center, the winged pig sits drinking with 2 human adults in an izakaya-like nightlife setting, warm lights surrounding them; 3) upper right, the winged pig walks away down railway tracks toward a brilliant ocean sunset, carrying a small suitcase, seen from behind; 4) left middle, the winged pig walks alone through a rain-slick neon-lit city street at night, seen from behind, surrounded by glowing signs and reflections. The whole image should feel bittersweet, magical, lonely, and hopeful, like a prestige animated film poster about adulthood, solitude, and emotional survival. items.title: Find Kyle in a Seoul Market
items.titleZh: A richly detailed vertical editorial travel illustration of a bustling Seoul market alley rendered in polished hand-drawn realism with warm cinematic lighting, dense urban storytelling, and highly legible signage. The scene is packed with a large crowd of pedestrians, shoppers, diners, street-food customers, musicians, and commuters in a narrow neighborhood market street, viewed from a slightly elevated eye level so the full alley feels layered and alive. At the top left, a large illustrated poster reads “WHERE IS {argument name="character name" default="KYLE"}?” with the subtitle “Can you find Kyle in Seoul?” in bold playful English typography, styled like a search-and-find book cover. The environment should clearly be Seoul, with a visible Namsan tower in the distant skyline, tangled overhead power lines, rooftop seating, stacked low-rise buildings, shop signs in Korean, and a subway entrance sign on the right showing line numbers 4, 2, 4, 4 and the bilingual text “서울역 방면 / To Seoul Station.” Include exactly 15 major visible signs or text panels: 1) the “WHERE IS {argument name="character name" default="KYLE"}?” poster, 2) “할머니 손칼국수”, 3) a hanging vertical sign “낙원상가 2F”, 4) a small blue street sign, 5) a vertical sign “이름 떡볶이”, 6) the large market arch sign “황진다운시장 영”, 7) a vertical orange sign “커피”, 8) a wall mural map with “남산 가는길”, 9) the subway sign with “출입구 4” and “서울역 방면 / To Seoul Station”, 10) the produce sign “경성 야채”, 11) the lower produce sign “신선한 채소”, 12) a handwritten busker sign, 13) the street-food cart sign “호떡·어묵·붕어빵”, 14) the menu board “오늘의 추천 김밥 떡볶이 순대 튀김”, and 15) the delivery box text “빠른 배달”. Populate the alley with exactly 8 vendor or activity zones: 1) a noodle restaurant at left under a red-and-white awning with seated diners, 2) a vegetable stall with stacked produce crates, 3) a busking duo with guitar and percussion, 4) a central street-food cart selling hotteok, fish cake, and bungeoppang, 5) a standing crowd eating snacks and holding cups, 6) a small magic performance table in the lower center with cards and cups, 7) a painter at an easel near the lower left, and 8) a scooter delivery cluster at the lower right. Add exactly 6 notable background accents: 1) rooftop diners on the upper right terrace, 2) a cat lounging on a roof ledge upper left, 3) colorful market umbrellas in the middle distance, 4) stairways and narrow side passages, 5) dense balconies and windows full of plants and people, and 6) the distant tower and skyline. The crowd should feel extremely varied in age and clothing, mostly casual contemporary Korean street fashion in jackets, hoodies, backpacks, skirts, slacks, and sneakers, with a few office workers and students. Hide a single subtly distinct person meant to be the findable target, {argument name="target outfit" default="a young man in a blue hoodie with yellow lettering"}, integrated naturally among the central crowd rather than spotlighted. Use a vibrant but grounded palette of brick red, teal, forest green, cream, mustard, asphalt gray, and sky blue. Emphasize intricate linework, readable Korean text, observational city details, lively human gestures, and the playful feel of a premium “Where’s Waldo?” style Seoul search poster. Aspect ratio 2:3.

items.title: Vitamin C Skincare Ad
items.titleZh: Create a clean luxury skincare product advertisement in a square 1:1 layout with a warm beige studio background and strong natural sunlight casting soft palm-leaf shadows across the wall. Place 1 amber glass dropper bottle on the left-center, standing upright on a round cream stone pedestal. The bottle has a glossy gold collar and a matte white rubber dropper top. Add a white rectangular label with elegant minimal typography: brand name "{argument name="brand name" default="NATURELLE SKINCARE"}" at the top, a large orange product name "{argument name="product name" default="VITAMIN C"}", then black text reading "BRIGHTENING SERUM" and smaller subtext "With Hyaluronic Acid & Niacinamide". Surround the pedestal with 3 visible glossy green tropical leaves, arranged from the left edge and behind the bottle for a fresh botanical look. On the right side, place a large bold black serif headline in 3 stacked lines reading "{argument name="headline text" default="Glow Naturally. Every Day."}". Beneath it, add a smaller clean sans-serif benefits line reading "{argument name="benefits text" default="Brightens | Hydrates | Protects"}". Below that, include 3 circular black outline ingredient or values icons in a horizontal row, each with a simple leaf-style symbol inside; add tiny caption text beneath them with the same slightly imperfect ad-like wording seen in the original, including "Barban Free", "Dermicologyg", and "Creuty-free". At the lower right, place a glossy rounded green call-to-action button with white bold text "{argument name="button text" default="Shop Now"}". Add 1 sliced orange on the far right edge, partially cropped, with vivid juicy texture to reinforce the vitamin C theme. Include a small white "Pollo.ai" watermark in the top-right corner. Style the whole image as a polished commercial product mockup, photorealistic, high-end beauty branding, soft warm highlights, subtle shadows, balanced composition, sharp label detail, premium ecommerce social ad aesthetic.

items.title: Fashion Height Comparison of Four Women
items.titleZh: A clean fashion comparison studio photo of 4 adult East Asian women standing side by side against a plain light gray seamless background, full body visible from head to shoes, photographed straight-on with soft diffused lighting and a polished commercial look. Above each woman, centered over her head in black serif text, place height labels reading exactly: 145cm, 155cm, 165cm, 175cm. Emphasize realistic proportional differences in height while keeping all four women slim, elegant, and similarly styled, with long dark brown to black softly wavy hair and neutral expressions. Their faces are obscured by smooth rectangular blur blocks. The women stand very close together in a friendly pose, with subtle arm contact and one woman lightly resting an arm around another. Use a coordinated beige, cream, taupe, and soft blush wardrobe palette with smart casual feminine outfits and matching ivory loafers. Woman 1 under the 145cm label wears a short-sleeve cream ribbed knit top tucked into high-waisted light beige shorts with a fabric belt, plus a small quilted shoulder bag with a chain strap. Woman 2 under the 155cm label wears a white long-sleeve blouse with a bow tie at the collar and a taupe mini skirt with a slight flared hem, carrying a small light beige crossbody handbag. Woman 3 under the 165cm label wears a sleeveless blush-beige ribbed knit top and a simple ivory mini skirt. Woman 4 under the 175cm label wears a draped white V-neck blouse with sleeves rolled to the forearms, high-waisted taupe belted shorts, and a medium taupe shoulder bag. All 4 women wear cream or ivory horsebit loafers. Composition is vertical, centered, minimal, stylish, realistic, like a fashion catalog image comparing female heights.
items.promptZh: 一张干净的时尚比较工作室照片，4 名成年东亚女性并排站在浅灰色无缝背景下，全身从头部到鞋子都可见，采用柔和的漫射灯光和抛光的商业外观直接拍摄。在每位女性上方，以黑色衬线文字居中放置身高标签，其读数准确：145 厘米、155 厘米、165 厘米、175 厘米。强调现实的身高比例差异，同时保持所有四位女性的苗条、优雅和相似的风格，留着深棕色到黑色的柔软波浪形长发和中性的表情。他们的脸被光滑的矩形模糊块遮挡。两位女士以友好的姿势站得很近，手臂有微妙的接触，其中一位女士轻轻地用手臂搂着另一位女士。使用协调的米色、奶油色、灰褐色和柔和的腮红衣柜调色板搭配时尚休闲女性服装和相配的象牙色乐福鞋。 145cm标签下的女性1穿着短袖奶油色罗纹针织上衣，塞进高腰浅米色短裤中，配有织物腰带，再加上带有链条带的小号绗缝单肩包。 155cm标签下的女性2身穿白色长袖衬衫，领口系有领结，下身搭配灰褐色微喇叭形迷你裙，拎浅米色小斜挎包。 165cm标签下的女人3穿着无袖腮红米色罗纹针织上衣和简约的象牙色迷你裙。 175cm 标签下的女性 4 身穿垂坠白色 V 领衬衫，袖子卷至前臂，搭配高腰灰褐色束带短裤，背中号灰褐色单肩包。所有 4 名女性均穿着奶油色或象牙色马衔扣乐福鞋。构图是垂直的、居中的、简约的、时尚的、现实的，就像比较女性身高的时装目录图像。
