items.title: Korean Sports Drink Celebrity Ad Poster
items.titleZh: A bold Korean beverage advertisement poster in a glossy commercial photography style, featuring {argument name="spokesperson" default="Donald Trump lookalike"} in a dark navy business suit, white dress shirt, and vivid blue tie, standing front-facing against a saturated bright-blue sky with a few soft white clouds and a faint modern city skyline including a tall skyscraper resembling the Empire State Building on the right. He is holding a cold plastic bottle of {argument name="product name" default="POCARI SWEAT"} dramatically toward the camera in his left hand, with extreme foreshortening so the bottle appears large in the foreground and the person is slightly behind it. The bottle is clear with condensation, a white cap, visible water inside, and a deep blue label reading “POCARI SWEAT” in large white letters with smaller text above saying “ION SUPPLY DRINK.” Add energetic frozen water splashes and droplets around the bottle, hand, and lower foreground to emphasize freshness and hydration. Place the brand logo in the upper left corner: “POCARI SWEAT” in white with the curved underline mark. Across the top, add huge distressed white Korean headline text, slightly angled and filling most of the upper half: {argument name="headline text" default="갈증 해소? 이걸로 끝! 포카리스웨트!"}. In the lower right over the suit, add a bold italic quotation in white and blue Korean text: {argument name="quote" default="WINNING은 수분 싸움! 포카리스웨트로 리프레시!"}. In the bottom left, include exactly 3 circular benefit icons stacked vertically with short Korean labels: a water drop icon with “수분 보충”, a lightning bolt icon with “전해질 보충”, and a running figure icon with “빠른 흡수”. Use a high-contrast, patriotic blue-and-white color palette, dramatic ad lighting, sharp focus on the bottle and hand, slightly softer focus on the face and background, and an overall energetic premium campaign-poster look.
items.promptZh: 一张大胆的韩国饮料广告海报，采用光面商业摄影风格，{argument name="spokesperson" default="Donald Trump Lookalike"}穿着深海军蓝西装、白色正装衬衫和鲜艳的蓝色领带，正面站立在饱和的亮蓝色天空下，飘着几朵柔和的白云，还有淡淡的现代城市天际线，包括右侧一座类似帝国大厦的高耸摩天大楼。他左手拿着一个冰冷的塑料瓶{argument name="product name" default="POCARI SWEAT"}，戏剧性地对着镜头，并进行了极大的透视，因此瓶子在前景中显得很大，而人则稍微在后面。瓶子是透明的，有冷凝水，白色的盖子，里面有水，深蓝色的标签上写着“POCARI SWEAT”，上面写着大号白色字母，上面写着较小的文字“ION SUPPLY DRINK”。在瓶子、手和下部前景周围添加充满活力的冰冻水花和水滴，以强调新鲜度和水合作用。将品牌标志置于左上角：白色“POCARI SWEAT”，带有弧形下划线标记。在顶部，添加巨大的仿旧白色韩文标题文本，稍微倾斜并填充上半部分的大部分：{argument name="headline text" default="갈증 해소? oodle걸로 끝! 포카리스웨트!"}。在西装的右下角，添加白色和蓝色韩文文本的粗体斜体引文：{argument name="quote" default="WINNING은 수분 싸움! 포카리스웨트로 리프레시!"}。在左下角，包含 3 个垂直堆叠的圆形福利图标，并带有简短的韩国标签：带有“수분 보충”的水滴图标、带有“전해질 보충”的闪电图标和带有“빠른 흡수”的奔跑人物图标。使用高对比度、爱国主义的蓝白调色板、戏剧性的广告照明、对瓶子和手的清晰聚焦、对脸部和背景的聚焦稍微柔和，以及整体充满活力的优质竞选海报外观。

items.title: Korean Rice Drink Parody Ad Poster
items.titleZh:
Create a bold Korean-style beverage advertisement poster with a warm golden splash background and dramatic commercial lighting. Show a {argument name="celebrity spokesperson" default="Donald Trump-like older male politician"} from the chest up, wearing a navy suit, white dress shirt, bright red tie, and a small American flag lapel pin, facing camera with a confident sales-pitch expression. His face is obscured by a flat rectangular censor block in a skin-toned color. In his left hand, extended close to the camera in forced perspective, he holds a yellow aluminum can of Korean rice punch drink labeled prominently in Korean, with red top and bottom bands and the main product text "비락 식혜" and "Since 1993" on the can. The can also includes smaller Korean copy, an image of sweet rice drink near the bottom, and the volume text "238 ml (120 kcal)". His right hand gives a thumbs-up.

Use an energetic retro-commercial composition, with splashing sweet rice beverage and droplets behind him, glowing golden highlights, and a slightly low-angle heroic framing. At the top, include 3 distinct headline text groups: a small handwritten-style black slogan on the upper left reading "전통의 맛, 한국의 DRINK!", a huge central headline in distressed bold Korean type reading "걸죽는 땐?" in dark brown-black and "비락 식혜!" in vivid red, and a brand logo on the upper right reading "비락" with small red text "Since 1993" beneath it. Add 2 callout badges: on the left, a yellow circular seal with a tiny crown icon and the text "대한민국 국민음료 No.1"; on the right, a white speech bubble with handwritten Korean text "한국이 만든 맛있는 전통!" and red English text "I LOVE IT!".

At the bottom foreground, place 2 food elements: a brass bowl filled with sweet rice drink and floating rice grains on the left, and a wooden bowl piled with white rice on the right. Across the lower middle, add 2 lines of large brush-style promotional text, the first in white reading "달콤하게! 시원하게!" and the second in mixed white and yellow reading "속까지 시~원하게!" with an energetic yellow underline stroke. Along the very bottom, include 3 circular feature icons with captions in Korean: "국내산 쌀 엄선된 재료", "시원하게 갈증해소", and "부드러운 단맛 속 편한 식혜". In the lower right corner, add tiny disclaimer text "연출된 이미지입니다". Make the overall look glossy, exaggerated, funny, and convincing like a viral parody print ad.
items.promptZh:
以温暖的金色飞溅背景和戏剧性的商业灯光打造大胆的韩式饮料广告海报。展示一位{argument name="celebrityspoken" default="唐纳德·特朗普式的老年男性政客"}从胸部以上的角度，穿着海军蓝西装、白色正装衬衫、鲜红色领带，别着美国国旗小翻领别针，面对镜头，露出自信的推销表情。他的脸被肤色的扁平矩形检查块遮挡。他的左手以强制视角靠近镜头，手里拿着一个黄色铝罐，装着韩国大米宾治饮料，上面有韩语醒目标签，顶部和底部有红色条带，罐上有主要产品文字“비락 식혜”和“Since 1993”。该罐还包括较小的韩文副本、底部附近的甜米饮料图像以及体积文字“238 毫升（120 kcal）”。他的右手竖起了大拇指。

采用充满活力的复古商业构图，身后是飞溅的甜米饮料和水滴，泛着金色的亮点，略低角度的英雄取景。在顶部，包括 3 个不同的标题文本组：左上方有一个小的手写式黑色标语，上面写着“전통의 맛，한국의 DRINK！”，一个巨大的中央标题，以粗体韩文字体写着“걸죽는 땐？”深棕黑色和“비락 식혜!”鲜艳的红色，右上角有一个品牌标志，上面写着“비락”，下面有红色小文字“Since 1993”。添加 2 个标注徽章：左侧是一个黄色圆形印章，带有小皇冠图标和文字“대한민국 국민음료 No.1”；右侧是一个白色的气泡，上面有手写的韩文文字“한국 Been 만든 맛있는 전통!”和红色英文文字“我喜欢它！”。

底部前景放置2个食物元素：左边是装满甜米饮料和漂浮米粒的黄铜碗，右边是堆满白米的木碗。在中下方，添加两行大毛笔式促销文字，第一行是白色的“달콤하게！시원하게！”第二个是白色和黄色混合的，写着“속까지 시~원하게！”带有充满活力的黄色下划线。沿着最底部，包括 3 个带有韩语标题的圆形功能图标：“국내산 쌀 엄선된 재료”、“시원하게 갈증해소”和“부드러운 단맛 속 편한” 식혜”。在右下角，添加微小的免责声明文本“연출된 Been 지입니다”。让整体看起来有光泽、夸张、有趣且令人信服，就像病毒式模仿平面广告一样。

The composition is a sunlit Mediterranean coastal cityscape viewed from a curving seaside road in the foreground, painted in a richly textured retro poster style with warm cream stone architecture, saturated turquoise-blue sea, and a bright azure sky with soft white clouds. On the left, a hillside of tightly packed historic limestone buildings rises above the waterfront, including colorful enclosed wooden balconies, a large domed church with a reddish terracotta roof, and a slender church spire. In the foreground on the road, place a classic mid-century white sedan seen from the rear three-quarter angle, driving along the curve, with a dark license plate reading {argument name="license plate text" default="MTA 1964"}. A low stone seawall runs along the right edge of the road beside the harbor. In the bay, include exactly 4 boats: 2 colorful Maltese luzzu fishing boats in the near and mid water, plus 2 smaller distant boats farther back. Add exactly 4 white seagulls gliding across the sky above the water. Frame the scene with lush flowering bougainvillea branches in vivid magenta-pink arching across the upper right and lower right corners, and leafy tree branches along the upper left edge; include a spiky agave plant in the lower left foreground. The distant shoreline across the bay should show a pale sunlit city stretching along the horizon. Use a nostalgic 1950s–1960s tourism poster aesthetic, painterly brushwork, crisp composition, romantic travel mood, and elegant typography with the main title in large cream serif capitals and the subtitle in smaller dark sans-serif capitals.
items.promptZh: {argument name="destination name" default="MALTA"} 的复古旅行海报插图，副标题 {argument name="tagline" default="MEDITERRANEAN PARADISE"} 位于顶部附近的中心位置。构图是从前景弯曲的海滨道路上看到的阳光明媚的地中海沿海城市景观，以质感丰富的复古海报风格绘制，温暖的奶油色石头建筑，饱和的绿松石蓝色大海，以及明亮的蔚蓝天空和柔软的白云。左边，一座山坡上矗立着一座座历史悠久的石灰岩建筑，矗立在海滨之上，其中包括色彩缤纷的封闭式木制阳台、一座带有微红色赤土屋顶的大型圆顶教堂，以及一座细长的教堂尖顶。在道路前景中，放置一辆从后四分之三角看去的经典中世纪白色轿车，沿着曲线行驶，深色车牌上写着 {argument name="licenseplate text" default="MTA 1964"}。港口旁边道路的右边缘有一座低矮的石头海堤。海湾中正好有 4 艘船：2 艘色彩缤纷的马耳他 luzzu 渔船位于近水区和中水区，再加上 2 艘较小的远处船，位于较远的后方。添加正好 4 只白色海鸥，它们在水面上的天空中滑翔。用茂盛的开花九重葛树枝和生动的洋红色拱形横跨右上角和右下角，以及沿着左上边缘的绿叶树枝来构筑场景；在左下前景中包括一株带刺的龙舌兰植物。海湾对面的遥远海岸线应该显示出一座阳光明媚的苍白城市沿着地平线延伸。使用怀旧的 20 世纪 50 年代至 60 年代的旅游海报美学、绘画性的笔触、清晰的构图、浪漫的旅行心情和优雅的排版，主标题采用大号奶油色衬线大写字母，副标题采用较小的深色无衬线大写字母。

items.title: Packaging Design Proposal Board Prompt
items.titleZh:
Please generate a "hand-drawn packaging proposal board style" product introduction poster for {argument name="product name" default="milk powder"}.

If I provide a product image, please use it as the main reference, retaining the core visual characteristics, packaging form, colors, materials, brand identity, and overall temperament of the product. Prioritize the main color tone and color relationships from the product image for the design.
If I do not provide a product image, please automatically generate a product appearance and packaging design that fits the positioning of {argument name="product name" default="milk powder"}, and automatically match natural and reasonable main, auxiliary, and background colors based on the product attributes, category characteristics, and temperament.

Overall poster style requirements:
This is not a standard e-commerce detail page or a simple studio-shot poster, but a creative proposal board that integrates "product finished image + packaging design sketches + brand concept development process." The overall presentation is a high-aesthetic, high-completion brand design display image, as if a designer is presenting a packaging concept proposal.

Visual requirements:
- Vertical composition
- Use a unified background with a brand feel; the background color should be naturally determined by the product itself and not fixed to any one color.
- Color schemes should coordinate with product attributes: if there is a reference image, prioritize inheriting its main and brand colors; if not, automatically generate a reasonable color scheme based on the product name.
- Place the most complete and eye-catching product main visual in the center, with realistic textures, 3D lighting, and commercial finish effects.
- Surround the product with multiple auxiliary visual elements: packaging sketches from different angles, structural sketches, local form explorations, hand-held display drafts, packaging unfolding ideas, and brand lettering layout experiments.
- Add natural and casual black or dark hand-drawn line art, arrows, circles, symbols, and handwritten Chinese annotations to give the image a strong sense of "design process" and "creative proposal."
- The finished product image should be relatively refined and realistic, while the sketch parts should be relatively casual and dynamic, creating a contrast between the "finished product + design sketches."
- The layout should look relaxed and free, but overall it must have order, rhythm, and a visual center, reflecting a high-end graphic design feel.
- Small graphics, symbols, or interesting elements related to the product can be added appropriately to enhance brand memory points.
- The final effect should have a sense of branding, creativity, process, and visual impact.

Color principles:
- Do not fix a yellow background.
- Automatically select the main color tone based on product type, material, use, consumer experience, and brand temperament.
- The background color, product color, text color, and sketch line art color should coordinate with each other.
- High-saturation monochromatic backgrounds or soft, unified color schemes can be used, as long as the overall image has a brand feel and visual impact.
- Colors should naturally serve the product rather than overshadow it.

Style keywords:
Packaging design proposal board, brand concept development, hand-drawn sketches, design process feel, moodboard, creative review draft, product finished rendering, visual experimentation, commercial design poster.

Special notes:
- If there is a reference product image, prioritize following it and do not deviate from the product itself.
- If there is no reference image, automatically generate reasonable product appearance, packaging, and color schemes based on the product name, maintaining overall style consistency.
- The focus of the image is "product introduction + creative design process display."
- Do not make it look like a common e-commerce detail page, a promotional poster, or overly neat and stiff; do not lack sketches and handwritten annotations; avoid a cheap feel or an immature cartoon style.
items.prompt:
请为【{argument name="产品名称" default="奶粉"}】生成一张“手绘包装提案板风格”的产品介绍海报。 

如果我提供了产品图片，请以该图片为主要参考，保留产品的核心外观特征、包装形态、颜色、材质、品牌识别和整体气质，并优先沿用产品图中的主色调与配色关系进行设计。
如果我没有提供产品图片，请根据【{argument name="产品名称" default="奶粉"}】自动生成符合该产品定位的产品外观与包装设计，并根据产品属性、品类特征和气质，自动搭配自然合理的主色、辅助色和背景色。

海报整体风格要求：
这不是普通电商详情页，也不是单纯棚拍海报，而是一张融合“产品成品图 + 包装设计草图 + 品牌概念开发过程”的创意提案板。整体呈现为高审美、高完成度的品牌设计展示图，像设计师正在展示一个包装概念方案。

画面要求：
- 竖版构图
- 使用统一且有品牌感的主色调背景，背景颜色根据产品本身自然决定，不固定为某一种颜色
- 配色应与产品属性协调：如果有参考图，优先继承参考图的主色和品牌色；如果没有参考图，则根据产品名称自动生成合理的色彩方案
- 画面中央放置一个最完整、最吸睛的产品主视觉，具有真实质感、立体光影和商业成品效果
- 产品周围加入多个辅助视觉元素：不同角度的包装草图、结构草图、局部造型探索、手持展示小稿、包装展开思路、品牌字样排版试验
- 加入自然随性的黑色或深色手绘线稿、箭头、圈画、符号、手写中文批注，让画面具有强烈“设计过程感”和“创意提案感”
- 成品图要相对精致真实，草图部分要相对随性灵动，形成“完成品 + 设计草图”的对比
- 版式看起来松弛自由，但整体要有秩序、有节奏、有视觉中心，体现高级平面设计感
- 可以适度加入与产品相关的小图形、小符号或趣味元素，增强品牌记忆点
- 最终效果应具有品牌感、创意感、过程感和视觉冲击力

配色原则：
- 不要固定黄色背景
- 要根据产品类型、材质、用途、消费感受和品牌气质自动选择主色调
- 背景色、产品色、文字色、草图线稿色应彼此协调
- 可以使用高饱和单色背景，也可以使用柔和统一色系背景，只要整体有品牌感和视觉冲击力
- 色彩应自然服务于产品，而不是喧宾夺主

风格关键词：
包装设计提案板、品牌概念开发、手绘草图、设计过程感、moodboard、创意评审稿、产品成品渲染、视觉实验、商业设计海报

请特别注意：
- 如果有参考产品图，优先遵循参考图，不要偏离产品本身
- 如果没有参考图，则根据产品名称自动生成合理的产品外观、包装和配色方案，并保持整体风格统一
- 画面重点是“产品介绍 + 创意设计过程展示”
- 不要做成普通电商详情页，不要做成促销海报，不要过度整齐呆板，不要缺少草图和手写批注，不要廉价感，不要低幼卡通感

items.title: Chinese VPS Comparison Cover
items.titleZh: Create a clean modern Chinese tech blog cover in a wide 16:9 layout with a soft light-gray background, rounded-corner canvas, and minimalist dashboard aesthetic. On the left, place a small rounded category pill near the top with a yellow dot icon and the text “VPS 实测 · 购买参考”. Below it, set a very large bold dark navy Chinese headline in two stacked lines: “DMIT涨价之后” and “我把搬瓦工”. Under the headline, add a short yellow underline accent and then a medium-gray subheading reading “先看重点再下单”. The typography should feel premium, editorial, and highly legible, with strong contrast and generous spacing. On the right, show a floating desktop-app style server monitoring panel with a white card body, subtle shadow, rounded corners, and a pale beige browser top bar with three small circular window buttons. The panel header should read “BandwagonHost – CN2 GIA”, with a smaller line underneath “洛杉矶 · CN2 GIA” and a green status label “运行中”, plus on the top-right a small clock icon and the text “运行时长 27 天”. Inside the panel, include exactly 5 metric cards across the top row labeled “CPU” showing “12%”, “内存” showing “28%”, “硬盘” showing “18%”, “带宽” showing “1.2 Mbps”, and “延迟（本地）” showing “156 ms”, each with a small teal icon and a thin teal progress bar. Below, place a large line chart card on the left titled “稳定性（近 7 天）” with a top-right annotation “可用性 99.92%”, a teal fluctuating line, a vertical scale from 97% to 100%, and date labels from “05-13” through “05-19”. To the right of the chart, add a specs card titled “配置摘要” listing exactly 5 rows: “CPU 2 vCPU”, “内存 2 GB”, “硬盘 40 GB SSD”, “流量 1 TB/月”, and “系统 CentOS 7.9 64bit”. In the lower-left area overlapping between the text block and the dashboard, add a smaller white recommendation card with rounded corners and shadow. Its title line should include a yellow bookmark icon and read “购买参考 · 重点看这几项”. Inside, list exactly 4 rows: “线路质量  CN2 GIA”, “稳定性  ★★★★☆”, “性价比  中上”, and “适用场景  建站 / 中转 / 轻应用”. Add soft decorative elements in the background: a pale mint abstract rounded shape in the bottom-left corner, a faint dotted mint pattern above it, and a light dotted curved connector line arcing from the left text area toward the top of the dashboard, with a small yellow dot on the curve. Place a small rounded yellow name tag in the bottom-right corner of the canvas with the text “小墨同学”. Use a restrained palette of dark navy, teal, yellow, white, and light gray, with crisp vector-style rendering, subtle shadows, spacious composition, and a polished AI-generated editorial cover look for a VPS comparison article.

items.title: Luxury Bag Meets Discount Chaos Poster
items.titleZh: A vertical 9:16 luxury-fashion parody advertising poster with a single centered handbag as the hero product, designed as a brutal collision between ultra-premium maison branding and chaotic Chinese e-commerce discount graphics. The top half should feel like an elegant Hermes-style campaign: a warm beige and taupe atelier interior with soft morning window light, shallow depth of field, refined wall paneling, a wooden worktable, and visible artisan tools including exactly 6 workshop elements around the bag: a brush cup with several brushes on the left, a small ceramic vase on the far left, a leather awl or burnishing tool on the table front left, a knife-like leather tool on the table front left edge, an adjustable desk lamp on the right, and a spool of thread on the right. At the top center place a gold luxury logo with a horse-and-carriage icon above the word HERMÈS and PARIS beneath it, followed by one giant serif headline reading BIRKIN in gold. In the center, show one large structured crocodile-embossed Birkin-style handbag in {argument name="bag color" default="warm greige taupe"}, front-facing, highly detailed leather texture, polished gold hardware, upright handles, sitting on the tabletop, photographed like a premium product shot. Across the right-middle of the bag, add one torn-paper rip effect revealing aggressive discount advertising underneath; around the tear add exactly 5 digital glitch accents in neon magenta, green, cyan, black, and white. On the torn area place exactly 3 visible Chinese promo stickers layered diagonally: a small red sticker reading 福利价, a large red sticker reading 百亿补贴, and a black sticker with bright outline reading 亿补贴. The bottom third of the poster should erupt into a loud comic-book and livestream-sale visual explosion with torn-paper separation from the luxury upper half. Use saturated red, yellow, white, black, and cyan with sharp starburst shapes, speed lines, heavy outlines, and flying gold coins. Include exactly 7 bottom promotional text blocks: 1 large central red banner reading 百亿补贴, 1 red rounded rectangle below it with the Pinduoduo logo and the text 拼多多, 2 side banners partially cropped with 拼多多, 2 additional yellow-red 百亿补贴 bursts at the lower left and lower center, and 1 handwritten black calligraphy slogan at the lower right reading 砍一刀. Add one extra handwritten black phrase at the lower left reading 只需9.9元!. The overall composition must feel like an elite fashion campaign violently invaded by cheap viral bargain marketing, with cinematic lighting, strong visual hierarchy, realistic product rendering, premium typography above, explosive discount chaos below, and intentional aesthetic contrast between sophistication and low-cost internet commerce. Make it look like a high-end brand collaboration key visual poster for {argument name="collaboration brand text" default="拼多多 × 爱马仕"} promoting {argument name="promo text" default="百亿补贴铂金包"}.

items.title: Luxury x E-commerce Split Poster
items.titleZh: Create a vertical 9:16 luxury-campaign poster for a fictional crossover product, a disruptive co-branded handbag advertisement between {argument name="brand one" default="HERMÈS PARIS"} and {argument name="brand two" default="拼多多"}. The composition is a violently split, collage-style fashion key visual with a torn-paper seam running vertically down the center, dividing two clashing aesthetics: on the left, refined premium luxury branding in warm Hermes orange, cream paper, and elegant editorial minimalism; on the right, aggressive Chinese e-commerce promotion energy in black and metallic red foil, with loud sale graphics, confetti, ripped stickers, and explosive discount typography. At the top center, place both brands prominently with a large collaboration headline in Chinese, the left logo area styled like a classic luxury house with serif typography and horse-and-carriage emblem, the right logo area in bold red Chinese branding. Below that, add the main headline text in huge Chinese characters: {argument name="headline text" default="颠覆性联名款"}, and a boxed subheadline: {argument name="subheadline text" default="百亿补贴铂金包"}. The centerpiece is one Birkin-style luxury handbag shown front-facing and large, perfectly centered but visually split in half along the torn seam: the left half is orange pebbled leather with gold hardware, the right half is crinkled metallic silver leather with silver hardware, both halves seamlessly merged into one surreal bag. The bag should include 5 clearly visible accessory/product elements around or on it: 1 orange clochette hanging on the left, 1 metallic silver hanging strap with lock on the right, 1 central turn-lock closure with padlock, 1 orange Hermes-style gift box with dark ribbon at lower left, and 1 beige dust bag with small logo near the bottom left. Behind the bag on the left is a painterly orange brushstroke on textured cream paper; behind the bag on the right is a crushed reflective red metallic wrapper surface with spark-like highlights and falling confetti. On the right half, add 8 aggressive promotional text bursts and stickers layered diagonally like an online shopping festival poster: 1 giant white Chinese slogan "百亿补贴 全网最低", 2 "限时秒杀!!", 3 a torn price sticker reading "补贴价 ¥999?!", 4 "万件疯抢", 5 "百亿补贴 官方直补", 6 "直降到底", 7 a large bottom torn banner repeating "补贴价 ¥999?!", and 8 small text "建议零售价 ¥1000000+". On the left margin, add a slim vertical editorial text column with 4 grouped text blocks in a luxury layout: 1 "限量发售 / 全球瞩目 / 2024 LIMITED EDITION", 2 "HERMÈS PARIS MADE IN FRANCE", 3 "CRAFTED FOR ELEGANCE", and 4 "DESIGNED TO DEFY THE ORDINARY". At the bottom, create a black app-like information bar with 3 feature blocks from left to right: 1 a red brand icon with "拼多多" and a search-bar style pill containing "百亿补贴铂金包", 2 a lightning icon with the text "百亿补贴 官方补贴 所以低价", and 3 a shield icon with the text "正品保障 假一赔十 3期免息". Add a thin final slogan line across the very bottom in small Chinese text. Use hyper-detailed commercial product photography, premium graphic design, sharp lighting, embossed textures, foil reflections, paper tears, and strong depth. The overall mood must feel like a world-class art director forced a heritage luxury campaign and a chaotic discount-shopping poster to collide in one image, producing extreme visual tension, irony, and high-impact contrast.

items.title: One Piece Manga Coloring Cover Page
items.titleZh: A clean manga-coloring test page styled like an official One Piece chapter cover on a light gray background. At the very top, place the large black-and-white ONE PIECE logo with the skull wearing a yellow straw hat with a red band, integrated rope elements, and the silhouette inside the lettering. Centered beneath it, add the subtitle text {argument name="chapter title" default="Chapter 1177: FURIOUS"} in bold black serif italics. Below that, create one large rectangular full-color illustration framed by a thin black border. The scene shows Nico Robin, a young woman with long straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair and pale skin, seated in a garden with her knees drawn up, planting flowers. Her face is obscured by a soft rectangular blur censor block. She wears a loose white short-sleeve shirt and black-and-white horizontal striped thigh-high socks, giving a casual, slightly playful look. Around her are 3 small One Piece characters helping or watching: on the left, Tony Tony Chopper in a straw hat and blue overalls holding a small shovel near freshly dug soil; in the right foreground, another small chibi-like Chopper figure wearing a blue cap with round yellow ear covers labeled “MOGO” and pink shorts, turned partly away; near the center-left foreground, a tiny helper with goggles and a hat standing by the flower bed. The garden is whimsical and storybook-like: a huge old tree with a thick twisting trunk fills the left side, a white picket fence runs behind the flower beds, and a crooked cozy cottage with blue scalloped roof tiles, dormer windows, flower boxes, and a round wooden door stands on the right. The sky is bright blue with a few puffy white clouds. In the flower bed, show exactly 3 distinct flower clusters being planted: 1 pink cluster in Robin’s hands, 1 white cluster to the right, and 1 orange cluster farther right, with several dug holes in the brown soil and chopped tree stumps in the foreground. Add a caption strip overlapping the bottom of the illustration with uppercase serif text: {argument name="caption text" default="READER REQUEST: \"ROBIN PLANTING FLOWERS IN A BED DUG UP BY MOLES\" BY MRS. FUJI"}. Beneath the image, center the credit line {argument name="author text" default="By EIICHIRO ODA"} in bold black type, and below it a smaller line reading {argument name="credit line" default="Translation: STEPHEN PAUL • Lettering: VANESSA SATONE"}. Use crisp inked manga linework with vibrant hand-colored fills, slightly textured shading, and an authentic colored manga cover-page aesthetic.
items.promptZh: 干净的漫画着色测试页，风格类似于浅灰色背景上的官方海贼王章节封面。在最顶部，放置了巨大的黑白海贼王标志，头戴黄色草帽，红色带子，集成绳索元素，以及刻字内的剪影。在其下方居中，添加粗体黑色衬线斜体的副标题文本 {argument name="chapter title" default="Chapter 1177: FURIOUS"}。在其下方，创建一个由细黑色边框框住的大型矩形全彩插图。场景中，尼科·罗宾 (Nico Robin) 是一位留着长直发、肤色苍白的年轻女子，她坐在花园里，盘膝而坐，正在种花。她的脸被一个柔软的矩形模糊检查块遮挡。她身穿宽松的白色短袖衬衫，搭配黑白横条纹过膝袜，休闲又略带俏皮。她周围有 3 个海贼王小角色在帮忙或观看：左边是托尼·托尼·乔巴，戴着草帽，穿着蓝色工作服，手里拿着一把小铲子，靠近新挖的土壤；右边是托尼·托尼·乔巴，戴着草帽，穿着蓝色工作服，手里拿着一把小铲子，靠近新挖的土壤。在右侧前景中，另一个赤壁般的乔巴小人物，头戴蓝色帽子，黄色圆形耳罩上标有“MOGO”，穿着粉红色短裤，半转身；在中左前景附近，一个戴着护目镜和帽子的小帮手站在花坛旁边。花园异想天开，像故事书一样：左侧有一棵巨大的老树，树干粗壮，扭曲，花坛后面有白色的尖桩篱笆，右侧是一座弯曲舒适的小屋，有蓝色扇形瓦、老虎窗、花箱和圆形木门。天空是明亮的蓝色，飘着几朵蓬松的白云。在花坛中，准确地展示了种植的 3 个不同的花簇：罗宾手中的 1 个粉红色簇，右侧的 1 个白色簇，以及更右侧的 1 个橙色簇，棕色土壤中挖了几个洞，前景是砍伐的树桩。添加与插图底部重叠的大写衬线文本标题条：{argument name="caption text" default="READER REQUEST: \"ROBIN PLANTING FLOWERS IN A BED DUG UP BY MOLES\" BY MRS. FUJI"}。在图片下方，以粗体黑色字体居中注明出处{argument name="author text" default="By EIICHIRO ODA"}，其下方有一条较小的线，内容为{argument name="credit line" default="Translation: STEPHEN PAUL • 文字：VANESSA SATONE"}。使用清晰的墨迹漫画线条和充满活力的手工着色填充、略带纹理的阴影以及真实的彩色漫画封面美感。

items.title: Colored Manga Romance Comedy Page
items.titleZh: A cleanly colored manga page in a modern romantic-comedy style, presented as a 6-panel comic layout with crisp black panel borders on a white page. The scene takes place outdoors on a bright day with blue sky, soft clouds, leafy green trees, paved walkway, and queue posts with chain barriers. The main subject is a teenage anime girl with a short blond bob haircut, loose windblown strands, large golden-brown eyes, light blush, and a serious slightly embarrassed expression. She wears a floppy dog-ear hat with cream fur and a small blue polka-dot cap detail, a blue school-style cardigan or blazer over a white shirt, and a red patterned necktie, while holding a pink swirled soft-serve ice cream cone. A teenage boy in a dark blue sweater and white collared shirt appears in 3 panels, his face obscured by a soft rectangular blur, also wearing a matching floppy dog-ear hat. The page should have exactly 6 panels: 2 small panels across the top row, 1 large central close-up panel spanning the width, and 3 panels along the bottom row. Top-left panel: the boy faces forward with the girl turning sharply toward him, her hair and hat flaring from motion, outdoor background with a signboard, and hand-drawn manga sound effects in black. Top-right panel: a small chibi-style version of the girl stands near the chain barrier, looking smug and flustered while holding the ice cream, with a speech bubble that says "THAT'S A LOOK OF ACCOMPLISHMENT." and small floating sound-effect text near her head. Center panel: a dramatic close-up portrait of the girl against open sky, hair blowing across her face, one strand crossing her mouth, dog ears visible, staring forward with a calm, stunned look; include a vertical speech bubble on the right with Japanese text and a small English sound effect reading "PLOP". Bottom-left panel: the boy, face blurred, speaking with a speech bubble that says "I'VE BEEN THINKING THIS FOR A WHILE, BUT..." Bottom-middle panel: the girl in side view lifting a hand toward her mouth while holding the pink ice cream in the other hand, with a speech bubble saying "THANKS." Bottom-right panel: the boy reaches toward the girl's mouth or cheek with his hand as if wiping off cream, with a speech bubble that says "YOU GOT SOME CREAM OVER HERE." Keep all visible comic text and sound effects integrated into the art, including "WAH!", "FWSH", and the English dialogue. Use polished manga coloring over inked line art: soft cel shading, slightly textured watercolor-like fills, warm skin tones, glossy eyes, fine crosshatching accents, and expressive linework. Emphasize romantic tension, wind movement, and the contrast between comedic chibi reaction and tender close-up drama.
items.promptZh: 现代浪漫喜剧风格的色彩干净的漫画页面，以 6 面板漫画布局呈现，白色页面上有清晰的黑色面板边框。场景发生在晴朗的户外，蓝天、软云、绿树成荫、铺好的人行道和带有铁链屏障的排队柱。主角是一位十几岁的动漫女孩，留着金色短发，被风吹散的发丝，金棕色的大眼睛，淡淡的腮红，表情严肃而略显尴尬。她戴着一顶带有奶油色毛皮和蓝色小圆点细节的松软狗耳帽，白色衬衫外面套着蓝色学校风格的羊毛衫或西装外套，打着红色图案的领带，手里拿着一个粉色漩涡状的软冰淇淋筒。一个身穿深蓝色毛衣和白领衬衫的十几岁男孩出现在 3 个画面中，他的脸被柔和的矩形模糊遮挡，还戴着一顶相配的松软狗耳帽。该页面应恰好有 6 个面板：顶行有 2 个小面板，横跨整个宽度的 1 个大型中央特写面板，以及底行有 3 个面板。左上面板：男孩面朝前方，女孩猛地转向他，她的头发和帽子因动作而飘扬，户外背景上有一块招牌，还有手绘的黑色漫画音效。右上面板：一个赤壁风格的小女孩站在铁链屏障附近，手里拿着冰淇淋，看上去得意又慌乱，还有一个对话气泡，上面写着“这是一种成就”。以及她头部附近浮动的小音效文字。中心面板：一幅戏剧性的特写肖像，画中的女孩在开阔的天空下，头发飘过她的脸，一根头发穿过她的嘴，狗耳朵清晰可见，凝视着前方，表情平静而震惊；右侧包括一个带有日语文本的垂直对话气泡和一个小的英文音效“PLOP”。左下图：男孩，脸部模糊，说话时有一个对话气泡，上面写着“我已经想这个有一段时间了，但是……”中下图：侧视图中的女孩将一只手伸向嘴边，另一只手拿着粉红色的冰淇淋，对话气泡上写着“谢谢”。右下图：男孩把手伸向女孩的嘴或脸颊，就像擦奶油一样，并带有一个对话气泡，上面写着“你这里有一些奶油”。将所有可见的漫画文本和声音效果融入艺术中，包括“WAH！”、“FWSH”和英语对话。在墨水线条艺术上使用抛光的漫画着色：柔和的卡通阴影、略带纹理的水彩般的填充、温暖的肤色、有光泽的眼睛、精细的交叉影线口音和富有表现力的线条。强调浪漫的张力、风的动作，以及喜剧赤壁反应和温柔的特写戏剧之间的对比。

Bottom-left panel: the boy, face blurred, speaking with a speech bubble that says "I'VE BEEN THINKING THIS FOR A WHILE, BUT..." Bottom-middle panel: the girl in side view lifting a hand toward her mouth while holding the pink ice cream in the other hand, with a speech bubble saying "THANKS." Bottom-right panel: the boy reaches toward the girl's mouth or cheek with his hand as if wiping off cream, with a speech bubble that says "YOU GOT SOME CREAM OVER HERE." Keep all visible comic text and sound effects integrated into the art, including "WAH!", "FWSH", and the English dialogue. Use polished manga coloring over inked line art: soft cel shading, slightly textured watercolor-like fills, warm skin tones, glossy eyes, fine crosshatching accents, and expressive linework. Emphasize romantic tension, wind movement, and the contrast between comedic chibi reaction and tender close-up drama.

items.title: Colorized Soccer Manga Page
items.titleZh: A full-color manga page in the style of a dramatic sports manga, showing an intense soccer match inside a huge domed stadium packed with a blue-and-white crowd. Use sharp ink lines, dense crosshatching, screentone texture, dynamic speed lines, and vivid anime coloring as if a black-and-white manga page has been professionally colorized. The composition is a single page with 3 panels: 1 large main panel covering most of the page, plus 2 narrow diagonal inset panels stacked along the left side. In the main panel, show a steeply tilted wide-angle view of the penalty area and goal from an elevated sideline perspective, with the green grass stretched by perspective and filled with directional hatching. Count 6 visible players in the main panel: 4 blue-uniform players and 2 white-uniform players, plus 1 goalkeeper in yellow at the goal. The most prominent player is seen from behind in the lower center-right wearing a blue jersey with “HUGO” and the number 9, running toward the play with one arm extended. Near him on the lower right edge, show another player in a white jersey labeled “ISAGI” with the number 11, also running forward. In the midground, show 4 more field players contesting the ball: 3 in blue and 1 in white, with one white-uniform player diving or lunging horizontally from the right toward the center. The goal stands near the top center-left, with the yellow goalkeeper bracing in front of the net. Add 3 speech bubbles in the main panel, large white manga balloons with hand-lettered uppercase English text: “BUT I WANT TO WIN THE WORLD CUP...”, “...AS THE SECOND-BEST AND AS A MID-FIELDER.”, and “...THE WORLD RECORD FOR MOST TIMES WINNING THE WORLD CUP...”. In the left-side inset area, create 2 diagonal panels. The upper inset panel shows a close-up of a dark-haired character in blue, partly obscured by a soft rectangular blur over the center of the face and torso area, with a small speech bubble that says, “YOICHI ISAGI, DID YOU KNOW...”. The lower inset panel shows a close-up of a reddish-haired character with a wide blue eye, sweat on the face, and a pale blue background, looking surprised or stunned. Maintain bold black panel borders, dramatic foreshortening, and a high-energy tournament atmosphere. Use a blue, green, white, and yellow palette with strong contrast and authentic manga-page coloring aesthetics.

items.title: Japanese Jungle Theme Park Parody Poster
items.titleZh: A hyper-detailed vertical Japanese theme park advertisement poster set in a lush tropical jungle under a vivid blue sky with scattered clouds and strong golden sunlight flaring from the upper right. The style is cinematic, photorealistic, dramatic, and slightly absurdist, like a premium satirical travel ad. At the top, huge three-dimensional stone-textured gold Japanese headline text reads {argument name="headline text" default="ジャンキリア沖縄"}, with a smaller white Japanese tagline underneath that reads "— やんばるの大自然に包まれた、超本格ジャングル・テーマパーク —". In the center foreground, a giant modern smartphone stands upright, slightly tilted, dominating the composition like a monument. Its screen shows a lottery waiting-ticket interface with a safari silhouette header and large bold Japanese text "整理券抽選中", a dotted loading circle, smaller text "結果発表まで30分", and a tiny note "※この画面を閉じずにお待ちください". The phone status bar shows 10:00. To the left midground, a roaring Tyrannosaurus rex emerges from dense jungle foliage behind a huge aged concrete sign with oversized red Japanese text "待ち時間 180分". To the right midground, an ornate extravagant gold entrance gate to a premium area rises above the trees, with a black signboard reading "プレミアムパス入口" and a red-carpeted queue lane beyond it. A long crowded line of park visitors stretches from the foreground deep into the background along rope barriers; the visitors wear summer vacation clothing, hats, towels, backpacks, handheld fans, water bottles, and parasols, showing exhaustion, heat, and anticipation. In the lower left foreground, 3 stacked rustic wooden signboards are visible: the top board says "駐車場 2,000円" with a parking icon, the middle board says "アプリ必須 ダウンロードしてね!" with a smartphone icon, and the bottom board says "当選者だけが冒険へ" with a dinosaur silhouette. Along the right side, large vertical white brush-style Japanese copy reads {argument name="side slogan" default="待つこと、それが冒険だ。"}. Near the lower right are 3 circular gold icon callouts with short Japanese promotional lines: 1 dinosaur icon with "抽選に選ばれし者だけが、恐竜に会える。", 1 smartphone battery icon with "スマホの充電が尽きる前に、夢は始まる。", and 1 VIP icon with "プレミアムな近道も、ご用意しました。". At the very bottom center, include a small black strip with white Japanese disclaimer text: "このポスターは架空のパロディ広告です". The jungle should be dense and glossy with large tropical leaves framing the foreground, warm rim lighting, high contrast, and a polished blockbuster-poster composition. Keep all Japanese typography crisp, clean, and perfectly legible.

items.title: Tang Dynasty Aesthetic CG Illustration
items.titleZh:
{argument name="style" default="Chinese style CG illustration"}, Tang Dynasty aesthetics, {argument name="character description" default="exquisite ancient woman"}, half-body close-up shot, focus on face and upper body, high-end portrait composition, cinematic camera language and spatial perspective.

Character Setting:
East Asian classical beauty, cold white transparent skin, fine and real skin texture, soft shimmer; exquisite and three-dimensional facial features but natural and not exaggerated, narrow phoenix eyes, slightly tilted eye corners, affectionate and shy eyes, slightly tipsy and hazy, long eyelashes casting subtle shadows; lip color like rouge, slightly parted lips, soft and emotional tension, presenting 'subtle Oriental beauty'.

Styling Design:
Pink-toned gorgeous Tang-style clothing, softly fitting the body curves, rich layers but not over-stacked; moderate low-neck design emphasizing collarbone and neck-shoulder lines, natural visual guidance; exquisite phoenix crown (metal, pearls, gems, tassels), realistic material reflection, moving slightly with action.

Dynamics and Pose:
Slightly side-turned or lightly rotating posture, neck extension, shoulder lines stretched, hands forming soft guide lines, enhancing picture rhythm and feminine soft tension.

Lighting System:
Cinematic lighting. Key light: warm gold front-side light focusing on face and skin highlights. Fill light: cold ambient light shaping volume and space. Rim light outlining hair and neck silhouette. Highlights controlled without overexposure, shadows retaining details, soft transition of facial light and shadow.

Art Style:
Ultra-realistic CG portrait merged with Oriental freehand charm, slight hazy aesthetics.

Atmosphere and Texture:
Dreamy, subtle, high-end atmosphere of Oriental aesthetics; blurred background to weaken environment and strengthen character; slight film grain + soft focus glow to enhance emotion and texture.

Color System:
Main colors: rouge pink, gold. Auxiliary colors: cold blue-gray. Overall low saturation and high quality, avoiding gaudiness.

Lens parameters:
85mm portrait lens, f1.4–f2, shallow depth of field, cinematic framing.

Quality:
ultra detailed, 8K–16K, extreme detail, high resolution, cinematic lighting.

Aspect Ratio:
{argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16"}

items.title: Vintage Beijing Travel Scrapbook Poster
items.titleZh:
Create a charming hand-drawn vintage travel scrapbook poster about {argument name="city name" default="北京"}, designed as a Chinese-language illustrated tourist guide page on warm aged paper lying on a wooden tabletop. The composition is a single vertical poster with a slightly worn notebook-page look, soft stains, folded corners, tape marks, stamp-like ink smudges, and a casual collage aesthetic. At the top center, place large bold black Chinese calligraphy for {argument name="city name" default="北京"}, with the English word {argument name="english city name" default="Beijing"} underneath in loose blue brush script. Near the title, add a small red seal stamp and a short Chinese text block on the upper right describing the geographic location of the city in dark blue handwritten-style Chinese characters.

Below the title, include 4 taped polaroid-style travel photos arranged in a slightly uneven row, each with a handwritten English caption on the white border. Photo 1: the Forbidden City at sunset with golden reflections and warm orange light, captioned about warm golden tones. Photo 2: the Great Wall winding across green mountains under a bright sky, captioned about Great Wall of China landscape and green mountains. Photo 3: Beihai Park lake with willow branches, boats, and a white stupa in the background, captioned about a serene lake view. Photo 4: a traditional hutong alley with gray brick walls and hanging red lanterns, captioned about red lanterns and a charming narrow street. Use different decorative tape patterns above the photos.

Arrange the lower two-thirds like an illustrated infographic with colorful doodles and handwritten Chinese headings in red and blue. Include 5 main content sections: a geographic description block at the top right; a “best travel season” section on the left with Chinese text recommending spring and autumn, decorated with a leaf doodle and a small sun icon; a “main attractions and features” section on the left-middle listing exactly 3 items in Chinese with bullet points: Forbidden City, Badaling Great Wall, and Shichahai & hutongs, accompanied by line-art sketches of a palace pavilion, the Great Wall, hutong houses, and a small tricycle; a “must-eat foods” section on the lower left listing exactly 3 foods in Chinese with bullet points: Peking duck, zhajiangmian, and douzhi, alongside cute food illustrations of a roast duck platter, a bowl of noodles with chopsticks, and a surprised face doodle; and a “tips” section near the lower middle with exactly 2 advice lines in Chinese, each with a small icon, one about wearing comfortable shoes because attractions are large, and one about booking tickets in advance because holidays are crowded.

Add a small outline map of China near the center-right with Beijing marked by a red star and a curved arrow pointing to it. Place a traditional stone guardian lion illustration on the right side with a comic-style handwritten Chinese callout bubble saying it is super imposing. Add a highlighted recommendation box with a scalloped red outline containing exactly 2 recommended places in Chinese: Temple of Heaven Park with a note about praying for good harvests, and Nanluoguxiang; decorate this box with 2 architectural illustrations, one of the Temple of Heaven and one of a traditional gate building. At the very bottom, include a bold handwritten Chinese quote line in dark blue with red emphasis marks, plus 3 doodles beside it: a retro camera, the Bird’s Nest stadium with a small red heart, and the CCTV Headquarters building.

Overall style: cozy travel journal infographic, hand-drawn pen-and-watercolor look, slightly naive sketch style, scrapbook collage, cream paper texture, muted red and navy blue palette with soft greens and warm browns, playful but informative layout, highly legible mixed typography, clean composition, nostalgic tourism poster feel.

items.title: Astronaut Beside Living Earth
items.titleZh: A cinematic surreal space scene showing 1 astronaut floating in open space beside Earth, with the planet dominating the left side of the frame and the astronaut on the right, drifting backward with bent legs and one arm reaching toward the planet. The astronaut wears a realistic white EVA-style spacesuit with a dark reflective visor, a backpack unit, and a shoulder patch in red, yellow, and green. Earth is shown from the Atlantic side with North and South America clearly visible, lit by a cool blue rim glow against a deep black star field with sparse tiny stars. Across the continents and faintly across the oceans, organic branching root-like or neural vein structures spread over the surface, especially dense across North America and extending into South America, creating a dark biomechanical or living-planet effect. Use dramatic low-key lighting, strong contrast, moody shadows, photorealistic textures, ultra-detailed cinematic realism, a quiet ominous atmosphere, and a wide composition with large negative space.

items.title: Dust-Drawn Symbol on Car Hood
items.titleZh: A photorealistic close-up of the hood of a dark blue or black car parked outdoors, covered in a thick layer of beige-brown dust and pollen. In the center of the hood, a large clean emblem-like shape has been finger-drawn through the dust, revealing the glossy paint underneath. The symbol is a circular logo with 8 segmented bars around a raised circular center: 1 wide curved segment across the top, 3 horizontal bar segments on the left side, 3 horizontal bar segments on the right side, and 1 wide angled segment across the bottom. A realistic adult human hand with dirty fingernails rests on the lower right area of the hood, as if it has just finished drawing the symbol. Show streaks, smudges, and finger-trace texture in the dust around the edges of the design. Include part of the windshield and 1 windshield wiper at the top left, with soft reflections of trees in the glass and paint. Background is a slightly blurred parking lot with sunlit pavement, curb, and 3 tree trunks. Warm late-afternoon natural lighting, shallow depth of field, high-detail automotive surface reflections, candid documentary-style composition, vertical smartphone photo framing.

The top left shows a modern overlay logo reading Pollo AI and GPT Image 2. Centered across the top is a large engraved metal site title, {argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"}, with a smaller plaque subtitle reading {argument name="tagline text" default="THE FUTURE IN MOTION"}. A navigation bar directly beneath contains 6 visible items: a home icon button, TRENDING, INNOVATIONS, DOCUMENTARIES, ENTERTAINMENT, and a search box on the right with placeholder text similar to Search ElectroVid.... On the upper right corner of the frame there is 1 round analog clock gauge. On the left sidebar, a framed section titled Popular Channels contains exactly 3 channel cards stacked vertically, each with a circular emblem, subscriber count, and a SUBSCRIBE button: The Patent Office with 27.4K subscribers, The Royal Society with 18.7K subscribers, and General Electric with 35.1K subscribers. The main content area features 1 large central video player with a sepia historical scene of two men in suits debating in front of a chalkboard marked AC vs. DC with lightning-like chalk effects; one man points while the other gestures with open hands, and a glowing light bulb plus early electrical apparatus sit on the table between them. Add a realistic video player UI with a play button, timeline with partial red progress, volume icon, elapsed and total time reading 08:47 / 22:31, settings icon, theater icon, and fullscreen icon. Beneath the player, show the featured video title as {argument name="featured video title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"}, with channel metadata below: The Electrical Age, 142K views, 3 days ago, plus a small circular profile portrait and a brass LIKE button showing 5.8K. Below that, a section header reading LATEST VIDEOS contains exactly 3 thumbnail cards in one row: 1) My New Incandescent Bulb, showing a man holding a lit bulb, duration 10:12, channel Thomas Edison, 89K views, 5 days ago; 2) The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower, showing a Tesla tower under electrical arcs, duration 15:36, channel Nikola Tesla, 120K views, 1 week ago; 3) The Automobile Revolution, showing an early vintage car with a driver on a city street, duration 12:08, channel Henry Ford, 110K views, 1 week ago. Centered below the thumbnails is a brass button reading VIEW ALL VIDEOS. At the bottom center, add a footer plaque reading © 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. All rights reserved. Decorate the outer border with additional pipes, cogs, mechanical joints, embossed corners, and 1 more circular pressure gauge near the bottom right. Use symmetrical, highly polished antique UI design, cinematic warm lighting, realistic texture, impeccable serif typography, dense ornamental craftsmanship, and a believable fusion of modern streaming layout with 19th-century industrial aesthetics.

At the top left, place a modern white logo reading "Pollo" with a small pink-red rounded badge containing "AI", and directly below it the text "GPT Image 2" in white, overlaid on the vintage interface. Center the header with a large embossed brass title reading "{argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"}" on a dark metal plaque, and a smaller engraved tagline underneath reading "{argument name="tagline" default="THE FUTURE IN MOTION"}". Add a horizontal navigation bar with exactly 5 items: a home icon, "TRENDING", "INNOVATIONS", "DOCUMENTARIES", and "ENTERTAINMENT", plus a search field on the right containing the placeholder text "Search ElectroVid..." and a square search button. In the upper right corner, include a round analog gauge or clock built into the frame.

Use a three-column vintage web layout. In the left sidebar, create a panel titled "POPULAR CHANNELS" containing exactly 3 circular channel emblems stacked vertically, each with a name, subscriber count, and a "SUBSCRIBE" button: 1) "THE PATENT OFFICE" with "27.4K SUBSCRIBERS", 2) "THE ROYAL SOCIETY" with "18.7K SUBSCRIBERS", 3) "GENERAL ELECTRIC" with "35.1K SUBSCRIBERS". The emblems should look heraldic and industrial, with aged metallic borders.

In the main content area, feature a large video player showing a dramatic sepia debate scene between two late-19th-century inventors in suits, facing each other across a table with electrical apparatus, a glowing bulb, and lightning on a chalkboard behind them reading "AC vs. DC". The left figure points accusingly; the right figure gestures back. Keep both faces obscured by soft rectangular blur blocks. Add a video control bar with a play button, progress bar, volume icon, timecode "08:47 / 22:31", settings icon, and fullscreen icon. Beneath the player, place the large serif video title "{argument name="main video title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"}". Below that, show the channel row with a small circular avatar, the channel name "The Electrical Age", and metadata "142K views • 3 days ago". On the right side of this row, add a brass button reading "LIKE 5.8K".

Below the featured video, add a section header "LATEST VIDEOS" and exactly 3 video cards in one row. Card 1: a sepia thumbnail of a man holding up a glowing light bulb, face obscured by a blur block, duration label "10:12", title "My New Incandescent Bulb", creator "Thomas Edison", and metadata "89K views • 5 days ago". Card 2: a sepia thumbnail of a Wardenclyffe-style tower crackling with electricity, duration "15:36", title "The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower", creator "Nikola Tesla", and metadata "120K views • 1 week ago". Card 3: a sepia thumbnail of an early automobile on a city street, duration "12:08", title "The Automobile Revolution", creator "Henry Ford", and metadata "110K views • 1 week ago". Under the cards, center a brass button reading "VIEW ALL VIDEOS".

At the bottom, add a metal footer plaque with the text "© 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. All rights reserved." Surround the whole composition with decorative mechanical borders, exposed pipes, pressure gauges, cogs, corner ornaments, and warm amber lighting. The overall style should blend a YouTube-like video platform layout with a luxurious Victorian steampunk machine aesthetic, using dark brass, copper, blackened steel, parchment beige, and sepia photography, with crisp readable typography and a polished cinematic UI mockup look.

使用三列复古网页布局。在左侧边栏中，创建一个标题为“流行频道”的面板，其中包含 3 个垂直堆叠的圆形频道标志，每个标志都有名称、订阅者数量和“订阅”按钮：1)“专利局”和“27.4K 订阅者”，2)“THE ROYAL SOCIETY”和“18.7K 订阅者”，3)“一般” ELECTRIC”，拥有“35,100 名订阅者”。标志应具有纹章和工业风格，并带有陈旧的金属边框。

在主要内容区域中，有一个大型视频播放器，展示了两位 19 世纪末身着西装的发明家之间戏剧性的深褐色辩论场景，他们隔着桌子面对面，桌上摆着电器、发光的灯泡，身后黑板上写着“交流电与直流电”的闪电。左图指责地指出；右图示意回来。让两张脸都被软矩形模糊块遮挡。添加视频控制栏，其中包含播放按钮、进度条、音量图标、时间码“08:47 / 22:31”、设置图标和全屏图标。在播放器下方，放置大衬线视频标题“{argument name="main video title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"}”。在其下方，显示带有小圆形头像的频道行、频道名称“电气时代”和元数据“142K 观看次数• 3 天前”。在此行的右侧，添加一个黄铜按钮，上面写着“LIKE 5.8K”。

在特色视频下方，添加一个部分标题“最新视频”，并在一行中添加 3 个视频卡。卡 1：一个男人举着发光灯泡的深褐色缩略图，脸部被模糊块遮挡，持续时间标签“10:12”，标题“我的新白炽灯泡”，创建者“托马斯·爱迪生”，元数据“89K 次浏览• 5 天前”。卡 2：Wardenclyffe 风格塔的深褐色缩略图，电力噼啪作响，持续时间“15:36”，标题“Wardenclyffe 塔的奇迹”，创建者“Nikola Tesla”，元数据“12 万次浏览• 1 周前”。卡 3：城市街道上一辆早期汽车的深褐色缩略图，持续时间“12:08”，标题“汽车革命”，创建者“亨利·福特”，元数据“11 万次浏览• 1 周前”。在卡片下方，中间有一个黄铜按钮，上面写着“查看所有视频”。

在底部添加一个金属页脚牌，上面写有“© 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. 保留所有权利。”用装饰性机械边框、外露管道、压力表、齿轮、角落装饰品和温暖的琥珀色灯光包围整个构图。整体风格应将类似 YouTube 的视频平台布局与奢华的维多利亚蒸汽朋克机器美学融为一体，使用深色黄铜、红铜、黑钢、羊皮纸米色和棕褐色摄影，具有清晰易读的排版和精美的电影 UI 模型外观。

items.titleZh:
Generate a full color Chinese-text manga about this {argument name="character" default="OpenAI researcher, Chen Boyuan"} (first picture), who works on improving the text rendering capability of ChatGPT Image 2 model for the upcoming release. (in the background there is boba tea and a banana taped to the wall with a single slice of duct tape). The model can render insanely small Chinese text when he tried generating some detailed and beautiful multilingual infographics handdrawn-style poster about his hometown, {argument name="location" default="Wuxi"} on his computer screen. His hard work pays off and the team was impressed by the absurdly good quality of multilingual text performance of his model, seeing all the languages it can write. When he takes a break with one hand holding his phone, he received a translated text message from Sam Altman on his phone (avatar attached as second picture), asking him to take a look at the rendered multilingual text in an image he just generated to congrat the team, since Sam only knows English. However, make it funny by let Boyuan outrage (typical manga style) at the end by seeing Sam's generated image contains a "稳稳地接住你" phrase at the central location in an otherwise perfectly rendered image that's used to congrat the team, because this sentence has been memed as an unnatural but funny Chinese sentence GPT likes to use on Chinese internet. Boyuan should rage "God! It learned to 'catch' again!" (with teammates as tiny heads on the side, sweating and saying in Chinese "we are working hard to fix it!"). At the very bottom of the manga, add a tiny line of footnote (very tiny)in Chinese that "note: the entire manga, including this footnote and picture in picture, are all generated with gpt image 2 at once without editing or multiple steps."

Additional Instructions: Use vertical 1440x2560 image layout, with first row about this researcher working hard, second row about his result on {argument name="location" default="Wuxi"} with multiple languages, third row shows the team excitement, fourth row split into left and right where left shows he takes a break and the phone received a message, right panel shows Sam's text message, and fifth row shows Sam's picture and Chen Boyuan's reaction. No narration except for the first row. Avoid Chinese map. All characters should be in manga style. The banana background should only appear in the first panel and the tape should be a single slice of tape, not a cross tape. The banana and tape decoration should be small as a insignificant easter egg for people to find. OpenAI logo shall only appear on Chen Boyuan's cloth, not elsewhere. No mugs in the scene since we already have the boba. Sam should only appear in the text message panel. The entire manga should be appear as a professional photo of a physical page in a manga book. In the lower right most corner of the poster there is a small "Ultra-small Chinese is also clearly readable:" with a paragraph of much smaller Chinese that begins with "(This is an ultra-small font size test) Wuxi is the author's hometown, so I made this poster, and the Chinese is finally fixed. Haven't been home for many years, really want to eat hairy crabs!" (ultra small).

items.titleZh: Create a full-page steampunk video platform homepage mockup in a dark antique bronze, brass, and sepia palette, styled like a Victorian industrial version of YouTube. The interface should be vertically oriented like a poster or website screenshot, richly decorated with gears, pipes, engraved metal borders, filigree, gauges, screws, and glowing Edison bulbs. At the top left, place a modern overlay logo reading "Pollo AI" with smaller text "GPT Image 2" beneath it. Center the main site title in large ornate serif lettering: "{argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"}", with a smaller engraved tagline below: "{argument name="tagline" default="THE FUTURE IN MOTION"}". Add a horizontal navigation bar under the title with exactly 6 items: a home icon button, "TRENDING", "INNOVATIONS", "DOCUMENTARIES", "ENTERTAINMENT", and a search box on the right showing the placeholder "Search ElectroVid..." and a search icon. On the left sidebar, add a section titled "POPULAR CHANNELS" containing exactly 3 vertically stacked channel cards with circular emblems and subscribe buttons: 1) "THE PATENT OFFICE" with "27.4K SUBSCRIBERS", 2) "THE ROYAL SOCIETY" with "18.7K SUBSCRIBERS", 3) "GENERAL ELECTRIC" with "35.1K SUBSCRIBERS". Each card should have an ornate vintage badge logo and a rectangular button labeled "SUBSCRIBE". In the main content area, place one large featured video player with a sepia still image of two late-19th-century inventors in suits arguing in front of a chalkboard marked "AC vs. DC" with lightning motifs; one man points while the other gestures back, and a light bulb plus early electrical apparatus sit on the table between them. Intentionally obscure both faces with soft rectangular blur blocks. Add a video progress bar, playback controls, and timestamp "08:47 / 22:31". Beneath the player, show the video title "{argument name="featured title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"}". Below that, include a channel row with a circular avatar, the channel name "The Electrical Age", metadata "142K views • 3 days ago", and on the right a like button reading "LIKE" with count "5.8K". Under this, add a section header "LATEST VIDEOS" and exactly 3 video thumbnails in one row. Thumbnail 1: a sepia portrait of Thomas Edison holding a glowing bulb, face obscured with a blur block, duration "10:12", title "My New Incandescent Bulb", creator "Thomas Edison", metadata "89K views • 5 days ago". Thumbnail 2: a dramatic sepia image of the Wardenclyffe Tower under lightning, duration "15:36", title "The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower", creator "Nikola Tesla", metadata "120K views • 1 week ago". Thumbnail 3: a sepia photo of an early automobile with Henry Ford seated in it, duration "12:08", title "The Automobile Revolution", creator "Henry Ford", metadata "110K views • 1 week ago". Below the thumbnails, add a centered metal button labeled "VIEW ALL VIDEOS". At the bottom footer, include the text "© 1893 {argument name="company name" default="ElectroVid, Ltd."}" on one line and "All rights reserved." on the next. Add decorative pressure gauges in the upper right and lower right corners, plus exposed pipes and a large gear in the lower left. Make the whole design highly detailed, symmetrical, tactile, and cinematic, with engraved textures, aged paper panels, brass highlights, soft warm bulb glow, and crisp, legible typography integrated into the antique UI.
items.promptZh: 使用深色古铜色、黄铜色和棕褐色调色板创建全页蒸汽朋克视频平台主页模型，其风格类似于维多利亚工业版的 YouTube。界面应该像海报或网站屏幕截图一样垂直定向，并用齿轮、管道、雕刻金属边框、金银细工、仪表、螺丝和发光的爱迪生灯泡进行丰富的装饰。在左上角，放置一个现代的覆盖标志，上面写着“Pollo AI”，其下方有较小的文字“GPT Image 2”。将主网站标题置于大型华丽衬线字体的中心：“{argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"}”，下方刻有较小的标语：“{argument name="tagline" default="THE FUTURE IN MOTION"}”。在标题下添加一个水平导航栏，其中包含 6 个项目：主页图标按钮、“趋势”、“创新”、“文档”、“娱乐”，以及右侧显示占位符“搜索 ElectroVid...”和搜索图标的搜索框。在左侧边栏上，添加标题为“流行频道”的部分，其中包含 3 个带有圆形标志和订阅按钮的垂直堆叠频道卡：1)“专利局”和“27.4K 订阅者”，2)“THE ROYAL SOCIETY”和“18.7K 订阅者”，3)“GENERAL ELECTRIC”和“35.1K”订阅者”。每张卡片都应该有一个华丽的复古徽章标志和一个标有“订阅”的矩形按钮。在主要内容区域中，放置一个大型特色视频播放器，上面有两个 19 世纪末发明家穿着西装的深褐色静态图像，他们在标有“AC vs. DC”（带有闪电图案）的黑板前争论；一个人指指点点，另一个人也做出回应，他们之间的桌子上放着一个灯泡和早期的电器。故意用软矩形模糊块遮挡两张脸。添加视频进度条、播放控件和时间戳“08:47 / 22:31”。在播放器下方显示视频标题“{argument name="featured title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"}”。在其下方，包含带有圆形头像的频道行、频道名称“The Electrical Age”、元数据“142K 观看次数• 3 天前”，以及右侧的“LIKE”按钮，计数为“5.8K”。在此之下，添加一个节标题“最新视频”，并在一行中添加 3 个视频缩略图。缩略图 1：托马斯·爱迪生手持发光灯泡的深褐色肖像，脸部被模糊块遮挡，持续时间“10:12”，标题“我的新白炽灯泡”，创建者“托马斯·爱迪生”，元数据“89K 次浏览• 5 天前”。缩略图 2：闪电下的 Wardenclyffe 塔的戏剧性棕褐色图像，持续时间“15:36”，标题“Wardenclyffe 塔的奇迹”，创建者“Nikola Tesla”，元数据“12 万次浏览• 1 周前”。缩略图 3：一张早期汽车的深褐色照片，其中坐着亨利·福特，持续时间“12:08”，标题“汽车革命”，创建者“亨利·福特”，元数据“11 万次浏览• 1 周前”。在缩略图下方，添加一个标有“查看所有视频”的居中金属按钮。在底部页脚中，在一行中添加文本“© 1893 {argument name="company name" default="ElectroVid, Ltd."}”和“保留所有权利”。就下一个。在右上角和右下角添加装饰性压力表，在左下角添加裸露的管道和大齿轮。使整个设计高度细致、对称、触感和电影感，将雕刻纹理、老化纸面板、黄铜亮点、柔和温暖的灯泡发光以及清晰易读的排版集成到古董用户界面中。

items.title: Visual Polyglot Magazine Collage
items.titleZh: I am creating a magazine page with the theme of "visual polyglot". The title in the center of the image should be "{argument name="title" default="Create Everything at Once"}". Create a piece of art celebrating visual creations, not limited to beautiful photographs but also across the full breadth of human visual culture and natural visual elements. There should be curated collage representing the diverse distribution: scientific diagrams, the periodic table, the solar system, medieval manuscript pages, botanical illustrations, anatomical drawings, old maps, climate charts, engineering schematics, transit signage, multilingual text, comic panels, UI screenshots, a camera photo, a butterfly specimen, pie charts, architectural blueprints, and façade drawings. The text frames the model as fluent across languages, notation systems, interfaces, cultural forms, and visual conventions—able to move from utility to beauty, from document understanding to artistic generation. Also feature artistic elements like pixel art, styles, history, sculpture, nature, photography, paintings, and all art forms. These are just examples, I need you to actively think about other elements / styles that may fit in a good design that's not limited to these concepts. The overall effect is that of a premium research announcement or museum-style manifesto: elegant, ambitious, and designed to argue that image intelligence should be trained on the whole visual world, not just polished aesthetics. Use an unstructured, creative and artistic layout, such as but not limited to fan out, avoid grid-like layouts. Portrait 4:5 aspect ratio. Don't add any content text beside the "Create Everything at Once" title. Text as part of the art is okay. Avoid a beige tint of the overall style, since we want vibrant elements to be vibrant.
items.promptZh: 我正在创建一个主题为“视觉多语言”的杂志页面。图像中心的标题应为“{argument name="title" default="Create Everything at Once"}”。创作一件庆祝视觉创作的艺术作品，不仅限于美丽的照片，还涵盖人类视觉文化和自然视觉元素的全部内容。应该有代表不同分布的精选拼贴画：科学图表、元素周期表、太阳系、中世纪手稿页、植物插图、解剖图、旧地图、气候图、工程示意图、交通标牌、多语言文本、漫画面板、用户界面屏幕截图、相机照片、蝴蝶标本、饼图、建筑蓝图和立面图。文本将模型构建为跨语言、符号系统、界面、文化形式和视觉惯例的流畅性——能够从实用转向美观，从文档理解转向艺术生成。还具有像素艺术、风格、历史、雕塑、自然、摄影、绘画和所有艺术形式等艺术元素。这些只是示例，我需要您积极思考可能适合良好设计的其他元素/样式，而不仅限于这些概念。整体效果就像一份高级研究公告或博物馆风格的宣言：优雅、雄心勃勃，旨在论证图像智能应该在整个视觉世界上进行训练，而不仅仅是精美的美学。使用非结构化、创造性和艺术性的布局，例如但不限于扇出，避免网格状布局。纵向 4:5 宽高比。不要在“一次创建所有内容”标题旁边添加任何内容文本。文字作为艺术的一部分是可以的。避免整体风格采用米色，因为我们希望充满活力的元素充满活力。

items.title: Monochrome Tennis Streetwear Moodboard
items.titleZh: A clean editorial fashion concept board on a pale powder-blue background with a minimalist green monochrome palette, combining 4 full-body lifestyle photos of the same youth streetwear tennis-inspired character arranged in a horizontal layout. On the far left, a tall vertical photo panel partially overlaps the background, showing a standing model in an oversized light gray-blue Nike windbreaker, mint green shorts, white crew socks, and white sneakers, holding a white tennis racket at their side and a small mint towel or accessory in the other hand. The character’s head is replaced by a large white doodle coffee-cup face icon with a smiling expression and ruler-like tick marks across the top rim. To the right are 3 rounded-rectangle photo panels, evenly spaced. In panel 1, the model sits in a folding chair reading a magazine and holding a green mug, with a dark Nike duffel bag on the floor and a few scattered cups nearby; the white doodle cup head has 2 steam squiggles rising above it. items.title: Minimalist AI Fashion Comparison Board
items.titleZh: A minimalist fashion moodboard on a pale sage green background, laid out as a wide horizontal comparison sheet with four portrait panels of young male models wearing oversized white sports T-shirts. Use a soft editorial studio look with cool periwinkle-blue backdrops inside the portrait frames, subtle film grain, muted contrast, and a highly consistent color palette of sage green, cyan trim, off-white, deep shadow, and blue-lavender. On the far left, include 1 large cropped reference portrait that is partially cut off by the canvas edge, showing the left side of a dark-skinned male model’s shaved or closely buzzed head, ear, jawline, neck, and shoulder in profile, wearing a white shirt with a bright aqua ribbed collar; place 2 overlapping semi-opaque rectangular blocks over the face area, creating a graphic censorship/collage effect. To the right, place 3 rounded-corner portrait cards in a row, evenly spaced, each featuring a different young male model from the chest up against the same blue studio background: card 1 shows a light- to medium-skinned man with short slicked-back dark hair, facing slightly left, wearing a white athletic shirt with aqua collar trim and a small Nike swoosh on the lower right chest; card 2 shows a light-skinned man with medium dark hair swept back, turned three-quarters left, wearing a white Nike shirt with a black swoosh centered on the chest; card 3 shows a dark-skinned man with a short fade haircut, turned three-quarters right, wearing a white Adidas shirt with a cyan Adidas logo centered on the chest and a small hoop or cross earring. Add 3 face-obscuring gradient rectangles, one over each smaller portrait face, in dark green fading to gray-green, aligned vertically like graphic overlays. Include 2 thin horizontal divider lines across the full composition, one near the top and one near the lower third, in a slightly lighter sage tone. At the bottom, add small uppercase monospaced editorial text: near the lower center-left write "MJ REFERENCE" and near the lower right write "KREA  //  GPT 2". The overall image should feel like a premium AI-fashion comparison board, graphic design presentation, or concept consistency sheet, with clean spacing, flat background, and polished art-direction.
items.promptZh: 淡鼠尾草绿色背景上的简约时尚情绪板，布局为宽水平比较表，其中有四个穿着超大白色运动 T 恤的年轻男模特的肖像面板。使用柔和的编辑工作室外观，肖像框架内有凉爽的长春花蓝色背景，微妙的胶片颗粒，柔和的对比度，以及高度一致的鼠尾草绿、青色镶边、灰白色、深阴影和蓝紫色调色板。最左边包括一张被画布边缘部分切掉的大型裁剪参考肖像，展示了深色皮肤男模特的左侧剃光或剃光的头部、耳朵、下巴、颈部和肩膀的轮廓，穿着一件带有明亮水绿色罗纹领的白色衬衫；将 2 个重叠的半透明矩形块放置在面部区域上，创建图形审查/拼贴效果。在右侧，将 3 张圆角肖像卡排成一排，间隔均匀，每张都有一个不同的年轻男性模特，从胸部到胸部，在相同的蓝色工作室背景下：卡 1 展示了一个浅色到中等肤色的男性，留着向后梳的深色短发，面朝左，穿着一件带有水领饰边的白色运动衬衫，右下胸口有一个小 Nike 旋风；卡 2 展示了一名浅肤色男子，中等深色头发向后梳，左转四分之三，身穿白色耐克衬衫，胸前有一个黑色旋风图案；图 3 显示的是一名深色皮肤的男子，留着褪色短发，右转四分之三，身穿白色阿迪达斯衬衫，胸口中央有青色阿迪达斯标志，戴着小圈形或十字耳环。添加 3 个面部模糊渐变矩形，每个较小的人像面部各有一个，颜色为深绿色渐变为灰绿色，垂直对齐，就像图形叠加一样。在整个构图中包括 2 条细水平分隔线，一条靠近顶部，一条靠近下三分之一，颜色略淡的鼠尾草色调。在底部，添加小的大写等宽编辑文本：靠近下中左写“MJ REFERENCE”，靠近右下写“KREA // GPT 2”。整体图像应该感觉像一个优质的人工智能时尚比较板、图形设计演示或概念一致性表，具有干净的间距、平坦的背景和精美的艺术指导。

items.title: Japanese Eco-Community Promo Poster
items.titleZh: A polished Japanese promotional poster for a community and sustainability project called {argument name="project name" default="セカイムラ"}, designed like a premium eco-lifestyle campaign flyer. Vertical layout, clean and elegant, with a soft cream paper background and a luminous, aspirational mood. The top half is dominated by a giant translucent globe centered in the composition, glowing with warm sunrise light from the upper right. Inside the globe is a breathtaking aerial landscape of a green mountain valley opening to a calm blue bay or lake, with tiny villages and fields below, cinematic and utopian. Over the globe, place a smaller Japanese slogan line reading {argument name="tagline text" default="世界は1つの村になる。"} and beneath it the large main title in bold dark navy Japanese calligraphic lettering: {argument name="main title text" default="セカイムラ"}. Around the globe, create a collage of exactly 8 candid lifestyle photos fading into the edges: 1) top left, two people in conversation outdoors under trees; 2) upper left-mid, several people working together in a rice paddy; 3) left middle, a circle gathering inside a rustic wooden structure at night; 4) lower left, two portrait-style figures in nature; 5) top right, a group sharing a meal at a long table in warm indoor light; 6) right middle, a person tending plants or crops; 7) right lower-mid, a line of people holding hands on a ridge at sunset; 8) lower right, a close portrait of a person eating or holding food. The photographic style should feel human, communal, slightly idealized, with soft depth of field, natural skin tones, golden-hour highlights, and smooth ad-poster compositing. The bottom half contains 3 evenly spaced feature cards on a light cream background, separated by subtle vertical dividers. Card 1 on the left has the heading "セカイムラ 新月会" in dark blue, a circular photo of a nighttime campfire circle, and a short block of Japanese descriptive text below. Card 2 in the center has the heading "セカイムラ 満月会" in warm gold, a circular photo of an indoor evening gathering under string lights, decorative radiating sunburst lines around the circle, and a short block of Japanese descriptive text below. Card 3 on the right has the heading "セカイムラ 米部が今の一押し" in green, small rice plant illustrations near the title, a circular photo of a wooden bowl of white rice, and a short block of Japanese descriptive text below. Under these cards, add a centered Japanese statement line in dark blue: {argument name="footer slogan" default="人・自然・文化がつながり、循環する未来を一緒につくる。"}. Beneath that, place 4 small icon-and-text items in a horizontal row, each with a simple thin-line icon and two-line Japanese label: 1) people icon with "つながる 仲間と出会える"; 2) house icon with "まなぶ 暮らしを学べる"; 3) sprout icon with "つくる 未来を共につくる"; 4) globe icon with "ひろがる 世界にひろげる". At the very bottom center, include a circular logo mark followed by the project name in Japanese, and underneath a website URL: {argument name="website URL" default="www.sekaimura.com"}. Add a small QR code at the bottom right with tiny Japanese text indicating details are on the website. Use a refined palette of deep navy, forest green, gold, cream, and sky blue. Overall style: high-end Japanese nonprofit poster, eco-community branding, inspirational, harmonious, photoreal collage with subtle graphic design elements, balanced typography, soft glows, and magazine-quality print finish.

items.title: Steampunk ElectroVid Video Platform UI
items.titleZh:
A highly detailed full-screen steampunk video-streaming website interface in a dark bronze, brass, and sepia color palette, designed like an antique Victorian industrial dashboard. The page is framed by ornate metal borders, rivets, pipes, gears, pressure gauges, and glowing Edison bulbs, with rich engraved textures and warm low-key lighting. At the top left, a modern white and red brand mark reads "Pollo AI" with smaller white text "GPT Image 2" beneath it, overlaid on the interface. Centered across the top is a large embossed brass title plaque reading "ElectroVid" with a smaller engraved tagline below, "THE FUTURE IN MOTION". A horizontal navigation bar sits under the title with exactly 6 items: a home icon button, "TRENDING", "INNOVATIONS", "DOCUMENTARIES", "ENTERTAINMENT", and a search field showing placeholder text "Search ElectroVid..." followed by a search icon. On the upper right, include 1 round vintage gauge dial built into the metal frame.

The main content area is split into 2 columns. The left sidebar is a framed panel titled "POPULAR CHANNELS" containing exactly 3 stacked channel cards, each with a circular emblem, a channel name, subscriber count, and a brass subscribe button labeled "SUBSCRIBE". Card 1: emblem with an eagle seal, channel name "THE PATENT OFFICE", subscriber text "27.4K SUBSCRIBERS". Card 2: emblem with a royal crest, channel name "THE ROYAL SOCIETY", subscriber text "18.7K SUBSCRIBERS". Card 3: blue circular GE-style logo, channel name "GENERAL ELECTRIC", subscriber text "35.1K SUBSCRIBERS".

The large central featured video panel has an ornate metal frame and shows a sepia historical scene of two famous inventors in suits debating in front of a chalkboard marked "AC vs. DC" with lightning illustrations. Their faces are obscured by 2 soft rectangular blur blocks, one over each face. Add an old-film, archival-photo look. Along the bottom of the video frame, show a player control bar with exactly 7 visible UI elements: play icon, volume icon, red progress bar, timestamp "08:47 / 22:31", settings gear, small rectangle screen icon, and fullscreen icon. Beneath the video, show the title "The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate". Below that, display channel metadata with a small circular avatar, channel name "The Electrical Age", and stats text "142K views • 3 days ago". On the right side of this metadata row, place a brass like button labeled "LIKE" with count "5.8K".

Below, add a section header "LATEST VIDEOS" above exactly 3 thumbnail cards in one row. Card 1: title "My New Incandescent Bulb", thumbnail of a man holding a glowing bulb with his face obscured by 1 blur block, duration label "10:12", creator "Thomas Edison", stats "89K views • 5 days ago". Card 2: title "The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower", thumbnail of a dramatic Tesla tower under lightning, duration "15:36", creator "Nikola Tesla", stats "120K views • 1 week ago". Card 3: title "The Automobile Revolution", thumbnail of an early automobile with driver in a city street, duration "12:08", creator "Henry Ford", stats "110K views • 1 week ago". Under the thumbnails, add a centered brass button reading "VIEW ALL VIDEOS".

At the bottom center, include a footer plaque with the text "© 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. All rights reserved.". Add additional decorative machinery in the corners and edges, including exposed pipes, cogs, filigree, and 1 more round gauge near the bottom right. The whole composition should feel like a believable antique YouTube homepage reimagined as a Victorian steampunk invention, with crisp readable typography, symmetrical layout, parchment panels, embossed brass UI components, and cinematic sepia contrast.
items.promptZh:
一个非常详细的全屏蒸汽朋克视频流网站界面，采用深青铜色、黄铜色和棕褐色调色板，设计得像古董维多利亚时代的工业仪表板。该页面由华丽的金属边框、铆钉、管道、齿轮、压力表和发光的爱迪生灯泡构成，具有丰富的雕刻纹理和温暖低调的灯光。在左上角，现代的白色和红色品牌标记写着“Pollo AI”，其下方有较小的白色文字“GPT Image 2”，覆盖在界面上。顶部中央是一个巨大的浮雕黄铜标题牌，上面写着“ElectroVid”，下面刻着一个较小的标语“THE FUTURE IN MOTION”。标题下方有一个水平导航栏，其中包含 6 个项目：主页图标按钮、“趋势”、“创新”、“文档”、“娱乐”，以及一个显示占位符文本“搜索 ElectroVid...”的搜索字段，后跟一个搜索图标。在右上角，包括 1 个内置于金属框架中的圆形复古仪表盘。

主要内容区域分为两栏。左侧边栏是一个标题为“流行频道”的框架面板，其中包含 3 个堆叠的频道卡，每个频道卡都有一个圆形标志、频道名称、订阅者数量和标有“订阅”的黄铜订阅按钮。卡 1：带有鹰印章的徽章，频道名称“THE PATENT OFFICE”，订阅者文本“27.4K SUBSCRIBERS”。卡 2：带有皇家徽章的徽章，频道名称“THE ROYAL SOCIETY”，订阅者文本“18.7K SUBSCRIBERS”。卡 3：蓝色圆形 GE 风格徽标，频道名称“GENERAL ELECTRIC”，订阅者文本“35.1K SUBSCRIBERS”。

中央的大型视频面板有一个华丽的金属框架，展示了两位穿着西装的著名发明家在一块标有“AC vs. DC”和闪电插图的黑板前辩论的深褐色历史场景。他们的脸被 2 个柔软的矩形模糊块遮挡，每张脸上各有一个。添加老电影、档案照片的外观。沿着视频帧的底部，显示一个播放器控制栏，其中包含 7 个可见的 UI 元素：播放图标、音量图标、红色进度条、时间戳“08:47 / 22:31”、设置齿轮、小矩形屏幕图标和全屏图标。视频下方显示标题“AC 与 DC 的真相：最后的辩论”。在其下方，显示带有小圆形头像的频道元数据、频道名称“电气时代”和统计文本“142K 观看次数• 3 天前”。在此元数据行的右侧，放置一个类似黄铜的按钮，标记为“LIKE”，计数为“5.8K”。

下面，在一行中的 3 个缩略图卡上方添加一个节标题“最新视频”。卡 1：标题“我的新白炽灯泡”，一个男人拿着发光灯泡的缩略图，他的脸被 1 个模糊块遮挡，持续时间标签“10:12”，创建者“托马斯·爱迪生”，统计数据“89K 次浏览• 5 天前”。卡 2：标题“Wardenclyffe 塔的奇观”，闪电下戏剧性的特斯拉塔的缩略图，持续时间“15:36”，创建者“Nikola Tesla”，统计数据“1 周前 12 万次浏览”。卡 3：标题“汽车革命”，城市街道上有司机的早期汽车的缩略图，持续时间“12:08”，创建者“亨利·福特”，统计数据“1 周前 11 万次浏览”。在缩略图下方，添加一个居中的黄铜按钮，上面写着“查看所有视频”。

在底部中心，包括一个页脚牌，上面写着“© 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. 保留所有权利。”。在角落和边缘添加额外的装饰机械，包括裸露的管道、齿轮、金银丝和右下角附近的 1 个圆形仪表。整个构图应该感觉像是一个可信的古董 YouTube 主页，被重新想象为维多利亚时代的蒸汽朋克发明，具有清晰易读的排版、对称布局、羊皮纸面板、浮雕黄铜 UI 组件和电影棕褐色对比。

items.titleZh:
A cinematic high resolution action portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young man riding a modern motocross dirt bike"} across {argument name="setting" default="rough rocky terrain during golden hour sunset"}. He is leaning aggressively forward while turning, showing focus and intensity on his face. He has messy windswept dark hair, light stubble, sharp jawline, athletic build, wearing a fitted black compression t shirt, dark cargo pants, black motocross gloves with orange details, and black racing boots with orange accents.

Strong sunlight creates dramatic rim lighting around the rider and bike, with rich shadows and warm highlights.
Foreground has textured gravel, dirt, scattered stones, motion debris, sharp ground detail. Shot from a low angle for a heroic powerful perspective. Shallow depth of field keeps the rider sharp while background remains creamy and cinematic.

这辆自行车是一款时尚的哑光黑色和灰色越野越野车，配有精致的悬架、坚固的多节轮胎、可见的发动机零件、逼真的泥浆飞溅、旋转的车轮以及后轮胎飞扬的灰尘。捕捉骑手的动态能量和速度。

前景有纹理的砾石、泥土、散落的石头、运动碎片、尖锐的地面细节。从低角度拍摄，呈现出英雄般的强大视角。浅景深使骑手保持敏锐，而背景则保持奶油色和电影感。

items.title: Hand-drawn Infographic Card Prompt
items.titleZh:
Create a hand-drawn style infographic card with a 9:16 vertical aspect ratio. The card has a clear theme and the background is beige or off-white with a paper texture. The overall design reflects a simple and friendly hand-drawn aesthetic.

The top of the card features a large brush cursive font in alternating red and black with sharp contrast to highlight the title and attract visual focus. The text content is all in Chinese cursive, and the overall layout is divided into 2 to 4 clear sections, each using short, concise Chinese phrases to express core points. The font maintains the smooth rhythm of cursive, being both legible and artistic.

The card is dotted with simple, fun hand-drawn illustrations or icons, such as characters or symbolic signs, to enhance visual appeal and trigger thought and resonance in the reader. The overall layout pays attention to visual balance, reserving enough white space to ensure the image is concise, clear, and easy to read and understand.

The theme is: "{argument name="theme content" default="Building an IP is long-term compound interest. Keep setting up your stall every day, keep doing it, and there will definitely be results, because 99% of people can't stick to it."}"
items.prompt:
创作一张手绘风格的信息图卡片，比例为9:16竖版。卡片主题鲜明，背景为带有纸质肌理的米色或米白色，整体设计体现质朴、亲切的手绘美感。

卡片上方以红黑相间、对比鲜明的大号毛笔草书字体突出标题，吸引视觉焦点。文字内容均采用中文草书，整体布局分为2至4个清晰的小节，每节以简短、精炼的中文短语表达核心要点。字体保持草书流畅的韵律感，既清晰可读又富有艺术气息。

卡片中点缀简单、有趣的手绘插画或图标，例如人物或象征符号，以增强视觉吸引力，引发读者思考与共鸣。整体布局注意视觉平衡，预留足够的空白空间，确保画面简洁明了，易于阅读和理解。

主题是：“{argument name="主题内容" default="做IP是长期复利，坚持每日出摊，持续做，肯定会有结果，因为99%都坚持不住的。"}”
