items.title: Game Asset - Anime Classroom Visual Novel CG
items.titleZh: Game Asset - Anime Classroom Visual Novel CG
items.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished anime visual-novel CG screenshot of a bright high school classroom scene, in the highly detailed glossy style associated with modern GPT Image 2 anime illustrations.

Canvas: 16:9 widescreen game screenshot, approximately 1200×675, cinematic composition with a visual novel dialogue UI overlay along the bottom. Warm spring daylight, soft bloom, crisp linework, detailed painterly shading.

Layout: Foreground left shows the back and side profile of 1 teenage boy seated at a desk, facing the heroine; he has messy short black hair and wears a dark navy hoodie. Midground right is 1 teenage girl seated at the opposite desk, smiling and raising her right hand in a friendly wave. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long black hair"} tied in a high side ponytail with loose strands, blue eyes, round glasses, and a gentle cheerful expression. She wears {argument name="outfit" default="a cream-white cable-knit turtleneck sweater"}. The camera angle is over the boy’s shoulder, making the girl the focal point.

Classroom details: Include exactly 2 main characters: 1 boy seen from behind and 1 girl facing the viewer. Include exactly 6 visible student desks with wooden tops and metal frames: 1 boy’s foreground desk, 1 girl’s desk, 2 empty desks behind her, 1 partial desk at far right, and 1 partial desk near the window. Include 3 large window panels on the left/back wall showing blue sky, distant buildings, and blooming pink cherry blossoms outside. Add soft drifting cherry blossom petals and sunbeams across the room. Include 1 green chalkboard on the back right wall with handwritten welcome text {argument name="chalkboard text" default="電気工事科 1年1組 ようこそ！"} plus small sakura doodles, and 1 bulletin board with pinned papers beside it.

Desk props: On the central desk include exactly 3 study items: 1 open notebook with Ohm’s law notes showing a triangle labeled V, I, R and the formula “V = I × R”; 1 pen lying diagonally near the notebook; and 1 thick textbook with colorful tabs titled {argument name="textbook title" default="電気理論の基礎"} with smaller Japanese subtitle text about electrical circuits and calculations.

Visual novel UI: Add a dark translucent navy dialogue box spanning the bottom 18% of the image. It has 1 small blue name tag on the left reading {argument name="speaker name" default="奈緒"}, 1 line of Japanese dialogue in white text, a small downward triangle at the right end of the dialogue, and a row of tiny game controls along the bottom right such as BACK, AUTO, SKIP, SAVE, LOAD, CONFIG, LOG, MENU. Add a small stylized site/logo mark in the bottom left, similar to a game screenshot watermark.

Style constraints: Clean anime faces, luminous eyes, fine hair strands, realistic classroom perspective, soft rim lighting, high-detail fabric texture on the sweater, warm nostalgic mood, no extra characters, no cropped face for the girl, no photorealism, no 3D render look.

items.title: Game Asset - Cyber Angel Character Sheet
items.titleZh: Game Asset - Cyber Angel Character Sheet
items.promptZh:
目标：为官方 AAA 科幻游戏角色圣经创建超详细的 16:9 未来派动漫角色设计表，其中包括 {argument name="character name" default="CYBER ANGEL"} 和副标题 {argument name="subtitle" default="Pink Protocol"}。

画布：宽水平 16:9 白色编辑字符表画布、干净的高级 UI 演示、薄浅灰色分隔线、洋红色和黑色网络界面标题、大量负空间、清晰的高分辨率线条。

布局：将工作表分为三个主要区域。左第三：角色的大型全身英雄插图，自信地站立，稍微转向观众，一只手做出和平手势。中/右：技术模型表和设计参考面板。最右边：垂直详细信息列。

角色详细信息：可爱的未来派动漫女孩，身材苗条，长长的飘逸{argument name="hair color" default="white-blonde"}头发带有柔和的粉红色调，明亮的青蓝色眼睛，猫耳网络耳机，小天线装饰品，粉红色的心形图案，光滑的科幻配件，以及俏皮的偶像机甲美学。套装是一套粉色、白色和黑色的网络天使街头服饰战斗服：心形胸甲、短款上衣、带有粉色饰边的超大蓬松白色袖子、短百褶裙、实用腰带、大腿带、吊袜带、不对称长筒袜（包括一件渔网袜和一件白色高科技紧身裤）、厚底厚底战斗靴、小兔子吊饰细节、电缆、链条和小型机械附件。添加一个大型粉红色背包式网络单元，带有圆形心核和悬垂的电缆，末端有兔子饰物。

左侧英雄区域：将标题文本放在左上角，以粗体深色字体显示 {argument name="character name" default="CYBER ANGEL"}，并在下面显示一条较小的行“// PINK PROTOCOL”。在角色附近添加一个带有 X 眼的带翅膀的兔子脸的简单粉色涂鸦标志。在她的肩膀附近包括一个漂浮的圆形粉红色机器人宠物，它有小翅膀、兔子般的耳朵、黑色圆形数字脸和有光泽的亮点。

中心模型表：添加带标签的标题“模型表”。准确显示同一角色的 3 个较小的全身转身姿势，均匀间隔并用粉红色标签标记：“前”、“侧”和“后”。正面朝前，侧面朝左，背面是长发和大号圆形心形背包。

右侧详细信息列：添加标签标题“DETAILS”。包括 5 个堆叠的特写面板：1) 头部和网络猫耳耳机，2) 胸甲和心脏顶部，3) 背包心脏核心装置和侧面模块，4) 大腿带/吊袜带和小腿技术细节，5) 厚实的粉白色厚底靴。

底部参考区域：添加一个标记为“武器和宠物”的部分，其中包含 2 个物品：粉白色的未来派链式武器或带有魅力的机械手杖，以及圆形粉红色有翅膀的机器人宠物。添加一个标记为“调色板”的部分，其中包含 6 个方形样本：亮粉色、柔和的彩虹渐变、近白色、浅粉色、深炭色和浅青色。

视觉风格：超详细的抛光动漫概念艺术、精致干净的墨线、柔和的卡通阴影、微妙的柔和渐变、光滑的塑料和金属亮点、网络卡哇伊科幻设计语言、专业的游戏艺术参考表、带有洋红色 UI 口音的白色背景。

限制：保留所有英文标签，保留 3 个转身姿势、5 个细节面板、2 个武器和宠物物品以及 6 个色样的精确计数。没有多余的字符，没有水印，没有凌乱的背景，没有写实的摄影。
items.prompt:
Goal: Create an ultra-detailed 16:9 futuristic anime character design sheet for an official AAA sci-fi game character bible, featuring {argument name="character name" default="CYBER ANGEL"} with the subtitle {argument name="subtitle" default="Pink Protocol"}.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 white editorial character-sheet canvas, clean premium UI presentation, thin pale gray dividers, magenta and black cyber-interface headers, lots of negative space, crisp high-resolution linework.

Layout: Split the sheet into three main zones. Left third: a large full-body hero illustration of the character, standing confidently, slightly turned toward the viewer, one hand making a peace sign. Center/right: technical model sheet and design reference panels. Far right: vertical details column.

Character details: Cute futuristic anime girl, slim build, long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="white-blonde"} hair with soft pink accents, bright cyan-blue eyes, cat-ear cyber headphones, small antenna ornaments, pink heart motifs, glossy sci-fi accessories, and a playful idol-mecha aesthetic. Outfit is a pink, white, and black cyber angel streetwear battle suit: heart-shaped chest armor, cropped top, oversized puffy white sleeves with pink trim, short pleated skirt, utility belt, thigh straps, garters, asymmetrical stockings including one fishnet stocking and one white tech legging, chunky platform combat boots, tiny bunny charm details, cables, chains, and small mechanical attachments. Add a large pink backpack-like cyber unit with a circular heart core and dangling cable ending in a bunny charm.

Left hero area: Place the title text at the top left reading {argument name="character name" default="CYBER ANGEL"} in bold dark lettering, with a smaller line beneath reading “// PINK PROTOCOL”. Add a simple pink doodle emblem of a winged bunny face with X eyes near the character. Include a floating round pink robot pet near her shoulder, with tiny wings, rabbit-like ears, a black circular digital face, and glossy highlights.

Center model sheet: Add a labeled header “MODEL SHEET”. Show exactly 3 smaller full-body turnaround poses of the same character, evenly spaced and labeled with pink tabs: “FRONT”, “SIDE”, and “BACK”. The front view faces forward, the side view faces left in profile, and the back view shows long hair and the large circular heart-core backpack.

Right details column: Add a labeled header “DETAILS”. Include exactly 5 stacked close-up panels: 1) head and cyber cat-ear headphones, 2) chest armor and heart top, 3) backpack heart-core device and side modules, 4) thigh strap/garter and lower-leg tech detail, 5) chunky pink-white platform boot.

Bottom reference area: Add a section labeled “WEAPON & PET” containing exactly 2 items: a pink-white futuristic chained weapon or mechanical staff with charms, and the round pink winged robot pet. Add a section labeled “COLOR PALETTE” with exactly 6 square swatches: hot pink, pastel rainbow gradient, near-white, pale pink, dark charcoal, and light cyan.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed polished anime concept art, delicate clean ink lines, soft cel shading, subtle pastel gradients, glossy plastic and metallic highlights, cyber-kawaii sci-fi design language, professional game art reference sheet, white background with magenta UI accents.

Constraints: Keep all labels in English, preserve the exact count of 3 turnaround poses, 5 detail panels, 2 weapon-and-pet items, and 6 color swatches. No extra characters, no watermark, no messy background, no realistic photography.

items.title: Game Asset - Pastel Anime Joker Playing Card
items.titleZh: Game Asset - Pastel Anime Joker Playing Card
items.promptZh:
目标：制作一张华丽的动漫风格小丑扑克牌，以可爱的魔法偶像女孩为主题，以柔和的嘉年华幻想为主题，适合作为收藏的定制王牌。

画布：垂直纸牌格式，带圆角、全出血插图、柔软的象牙色纸牌边缘和极其细致的镀金边框。使用以粉色、淡蓝色、奶油色、薰衣草色和金色为主的柔和色调，并带有闪亮的虹彩亮点。

布局：中心一名全身动漫女孩，摆出动态的姿势，仿佛漂浮或向前跳跃。她对观众灿烂地微笑，举起的左手拿着一张小扑克牌，右手向外伸出。在两侧添加垂直文本：{argument name="cardrank text" default="JOKER"}：一个沿左边缘直立，一个沿右边缘倒置。恰好放置 3 个皇冠徽章：左上角有一个圆形皇冠徽章，右下角有一个圆形皇冠徽章，底部中央有一个较大的皇冠徽章。卡片周围饰有分层的金丝、涡卷、细绿松石和粉红色的强调线、小宝石和装饰性角饰。

主题详细信息：该角色是{argument name="character name" default="an Original Pastel Joker Girl"}，一位年轻的动漫偶像，留着蓬松的波波头短发，{argument name="hair color" default="棉花糖粉色在发尖处逐渐变成淡蓝色"}，一双闪闪发光的蓝粉色大眼睛，红润的脸颊和开朗的笑容。她穿着一件柔软的小丑风格迷你连衣裙，颜色为{argument name="outfitcolors"default="pink,white,babyblue,andgold"}：露肩荷叶边上衣、荷叶边泡泡袖、丝带肩带、珍珠和珠宝配饰、花饰、一条镶有宝石的小项圈、带蕾丝的分层短裙、半透明荷叶边和小蝴蝶结细节。添加一顶带有悬挂金铃的倾斜小小丑帽或软帽，再加上花朵发夹和蓝色发夹。

姿势和服装数量：包括 1 个女孩、1 张凸起的扑克牌、1 个小丑帽、1 个项圈、2 个腕带、2 条可见的腿和 2 条不匹配的长筒袜：左边的长筒袜是粉红色和白色的水平条纹，右边的长筒袜是淡蓝白相间的钻石丑角图案。添加华丽的鞋子或脚踝装饰，配有丝带、鲜花和小金铃铛。

背景：梦幻般的奇幻游乐园内部，配有柔和的散景灯、半透明丝带、柔和的丑角钻石图案、漂浮的闪光以及微弱的旋转木马或马戏团帐篷形状。正好包括 2 条大卷曲丝带，一条蓝色丝带从左侧流出，一根粉红色丝带从右侧流出。保持背景明亮且忙碌，但对比度低于角色。

视觉风格：高度抛光的日本动漫插图，精致的线条，水彩般的柔和渐变，闪闪发光的宝石亮点，蕾丝和珍珠细节，魔法少女美学，华丽的洛可可扑克牌设计，柔和的绽放灯光，非常高的细节，对称的卡片框架，无照片写实主义。

限制：保留干净的扑克牌构图，没有多余的字符，没有现代徽标，没有水印，没有逼真的手，没有黑暗的恐怖气氛，并且除了重复的{argument name =“cardrank text”default =“JOKER”}之外没有其他可读文本。
items.prompt:
Goal: Create an ornate anime-style joker playing card featuring a cute magical idol girl in a pastel carnival fantasy theme, suitable as a collectible custom trump card.

Canvas: Vertical playing-card format with rounded corners, full-bleed illustration, soft ivory card edges, and an extremely detailed gilded border. Use a pastel palette dominated by pink, baby blue, cream, lavender, and gold, with sparkling iridescent highlights.

Layout: Center one full-body anime girl posed dynamically as if floating or leaping forward. She smiles brightly at the viewer, holding one small playing card in her raised left hand while her right hand reaches outward. Add vertical text reading {argument name="card rank text" default="JOKER"} on both sides: one upright along the left edge and one upside-down along the right edge. Place exactly 3 crown emblems: one circular crown medallion at the top-left corner, one circular crown medallion at the bottom-right corner, and one larger crown crest centered at the bottom. Surround the card with layered gold filigree, scrollwork, thin turquoise and pink accent lines, tiny gems, and decorative corner flourishes.

Subject details: The character is {argument name="character name" default="an original pastel joker girl"}, a youthful anime idol with a short fluffy bob haircut in {argument name="hair color" default="cotton-candy pink fading into pale blue at the tips"}, big sparkling blue-pink eyes, rosy cheeks, and an open cheerful smile. She wears a soft jester-inspired mini dress in {argument name="outfit colors" default="pink, white, baby blue, and gold"}: off-shoulder ruffled bodice, frilly puff sleeves, ribbon straps, pearl and jewel accents, floral ornaments, a tiny choker with a gem, layered short skirt with lace, translucent ruffles, and small bow details. Add a small tilted pastel jester hat or bonnet with dangling gold bells, plus flower hair clips and blue hairpins.

Pose and costume count: Include exactly 1 girl, 1 raised playing card, 1 jester hat, 1 choker, 2 wrist cuffs, 2 visible legs, and 2 mismatched thigh-high stockings: the left stocking is pink-and-white horizontal striped, and the right stocking is pale blue-and-white diamond harlequin patterned. Add ornate shoes or ankle decorations with ribbons, flowers, and small gold bells.

Background: A dreamy fantasy amusement-park interior with soft bokeh lights, translucent ribbons, pastel harlequin diamond patterns, floating sparkles, and faint carousel or circus-tent shapes. Include exactly 2 large curling ribbons, one blue ribbon flowing from the left side and one pink ribbon flowing from the right side. Keep the background luminous and busy but lower contrast than the character.

Visual style: Highly polished Japanese anime illustration, delicate linework, watercolor-like pastel gradients, glittering jewel highlights, lace and pearl details, magical-girl aesthetic, ornate rococo playing-card design, soft bloom lighting, very high detail, symmetrical card framing, no photorealism.

Constraints: Preserve a clean playing-card composition with no extra characters, no modern logo, no watermark, no realistic hands, no dark horror mood, and no additional readable text beyond the repeated {argument name="card rank text" default="JOKER"}.

items.title: Profile / Avatar - Sunlit Cafe Winking Portrait
items.titleZh: Profile / Avatar - Sunlit Cafe Winking Portrait
items.promptZh:
主题：
一只眼睛在绿色的窗户旁眨眼

主题：
一张胸部特写肖像，照片中一位年轻女子穿着{argument name="clothing" default="white lace-trimmed dress"}，单手托着脸颊，在{argument name="background" default="绿树环绕的明亮咖啡馆"}的木桌上闭着一只眼睛微笑。人物脸部和上半身从中心向左放大，右下角有柠檬饮料，前景有淡粉色装置，窗外有树木。

人物/表情：
一张小而圆的椭圆形脸微微向右倾斜，下巴微微内收。屏幕左侧那只深棕色的大眼睛向前看，而右侧的眼睛眨眼间就完全闭上了。细长的棕色眉毛，挺拔的小鼻子，友善的微笑，淡粉色的嘴唇紧闭，嘴角向上翘起。白皙的皮肤搭配淡粉色的脸颊。长长的深棕色头发垂至胸部，在中央附近分开，沿着脸颊形成细细的刘海和发丝，松散的头发长长地垂在双肩上，尤其是在右侧胸部前面。

服装/姿势：
暖白色无袖长裙。细肩带和深 V 领饰有配套的小蕾丝，细褶皱从胸部下方蔓延，薄面料上有精致的垂直皱纹。脖子上有一条超细金链，上面有一个透明的小吊坠，右手腕上有一条{argument name="accessory" default="淡金手镯"}。坐姿前倾，朝向桌子，用手掌和右手弯曲的手指支撑右脸。左臂向前伸出，在左下角处切断。

背景/灯光：
前景是一张明亮的木纹圆桌。右下角是透明饮料，里面有柠檬片和冰块、黑色吸管和圆形藤制杯垫。下部中央是淡粉色外壳中的三镜头设备。背景由黑色窗框、大玻璃、茂密的绿叶、白色藤椅、木柱和右后方的露台组成。柔和的午后光线从左上方的窗外射入，均匀地照亮了脸部、头发、肩膀和桌子，在脸颊和手臂下投射出薄薄的阴影。

构图/相机：
3:4 宽高比。相机处于几乎水平的视线高度，略高于坐着的拍摄对象的眼睛，从头顶到胸部底部和桌子边缘拍摄胸部特写。人物尺寸较大，约为屏幕高度的四分之三，脸部位于上半部分的中央，支撑脸颊的手位于右侧中央，胸部位于左下角。饮料在右边缘被部分切断，而设备在底边缘被部分切断。清晰的焦点集中在睁开的眼睛和嘴唇上，背景树叶柔和地模糊。

质地/风格：
以白色、浅木色、鲜绿色和浅黄色为基调的高清逼真照片。自然地描绘出细腻的皮肤、光泽的嘴唇、稀疏的头发、蕾丝和薄织物、冰和柠檬、木纹以及窗外树叶的散景。

负面：
不要改变眨眼的表情和支撑脸颊的手；不要移除柠檬饮料和浅粉色装置。
items.prompt:
Theme:

items.promptZh: 面部身份：使用附加的面部身份作为唯一的面部参考。四张照片必须一致匹配相同的面部特征、肤色、年龄和整体身份。身体：一名{argument name="age" default="20岁出头"}的成年女性。使用所附的身体参考作为唯一的身体比例参考，保持真实的解剖结构、自然的曲线和皮肤纹理。主题：唐代娱乐四大场景：曲江赛花、长安酒馆、乐坊舞后、马球赛后。主题：生成四张独立的垂直2:3彩色逼真照片，无拼贴。四人必须保持相同的角色，但改变发型、服装、表情和摄影语言，以符合{argument name="era" default="盛唐（高唐）"}的美学。第一个镜头“花隙中的胜利”：透过牡丹和彩色窗帘的特写镜头。她头扎半挽唐髻，头戴不对称发夹，一身杏白、石绿、牡丹红等现代审美的唐式乳裙。听到声音，她转向一位朋友，眉毛微微扬起，脸上浮现出微笑。使用100-135mm长焦观察，前景遮挡，低对比度彩色负片纹理。第二个镜头《长安酒馆第七回合》：人物坐在胡酒馆的矮桌旁，放下金杯后大笑。她盘着乌蛮髻，身穿孔雀蓝锦缎，着朱红色短袖上衣，下着深红色裙子。使用 35 毫米纪实视角，桌子边缘、罐子和客人的背影自然进入前景。温暖的光线遮盖了五官。第三个镜头“舞后的多彩呼吸”：最后一支舞结束后，角色停在丝绸窗帘前喘口气。高唐舞髻，松散。深红色和孔雀绿色的舞蹈服，带有不透明层。她看着帘外，双唇微启，疲惫、满足、惊讶并存。 50mm后台特写，柔和雾彩负片。第四个镜头“马球线后折返”：女骑手下马后走向休息区，听到一声召唤，中途折返。双螺旋马髻，身穿暗红色内层，石蓝色窄袖长袍，脚踩皮靴。一只手从底部边缘握住马球槌。 135mm长焦距，1/40s彩色慢快门平移。照明：自然宽光照明或带罩的室内灯。纹理：真实彩色摄影，带有毛孔、绒毛和胶片颗粒。签名：右下角的小手写签名'{argument name="signature" default="Zhong"}'。负面提示：拼贴、连拍、身份漂移、现代马尾辫、廉价服装、机器人表情、重复背景人物、复杂手势、多余肢体、光斑、塑料皮肤、黑白、现代场景、乱码文字。
items.prompt: Facial Identity: Use the attached facial identity as the sole facial reference. The four photos must consistently match the same facial features, skin tone, age, and overall identity. Body: An adult female in her {argument name="age" default="early 20s"}. Use the attached body reference as the sole body proportion reference, maintaining realistic anatomy, natural curves, and skin texture. Theme: Four scenes of Tang Dynasty entertainment: Qujiang flower competition, Chang'an tavern, post-dance at a music studio, and after a polo match. Subject: Generate four independent vertical 2:3 color realistic photos, no collages. All four must maintain the same character, but change hairstyles, costumes, expressions, and photographic language consistent with the aesthetics of the {argument name="era" default="Sheng Tang (High Tang)"}. First shot 'Victory Revealed in the Flower Gaps': Close-up shot through peonies and colorful curtains. She wears a semi-turned Tang bun, asymmetrical hairpins, and a modern aesthetic Tang-style Ruqun in apricot white, stone green, and peony red. She turns toward a friend at the sound, eyebrows slightly raised, a smile just appearing. Use 100-135mm telephoto observation, foreground obstruction, and low-contrast color negative texture. Second shot 'Seventh Round at the Chang'an Tavern': The character sits by a low table in a Hu tavern, laughing after putting down a gilded cup. Her hair is in a Wu Man bun, wearing peacock blue brocade, a vermilion short-sleeved top, and a deep crimson skirt. Use a 35mm documentary perspective, with table edges, jars, and guest backs naturally entering the foreground. Warm light covers the features. Third shot 'Colorful Breath After the Dance': After the final dance, the character stops by a silk curtain to catch her breath. High Tang dance bun with a loose strand. Dark red and peacock green dance clothes with opaque layers. She looks out the curtain, lips parted, fatigue, satisfaction, and surprise coexisting. 50mm backstage close-up, soft mist color negative. Fourth shot 'Turning Back After the Polo Line': A female rider walks toward the rest area after dismounting, turning back mid-stride at a call. Double-spiral riding bun, wearing dark red inner layer, stone blue narrow-sleeved robe, and leather boots. One hand grips the polo mallet coming from the bottom edge. 135mm long focal length, 1/40s color slow shutter panning. Lighting: Natural wide lighting or hooded indoor lamps. Texture: Real color photography with pores, fuzz, and film grain. Signature: Small handwritten signature '{argument name="signature" default="Zhong"}' in the bottom right. Negative prompt: Collage, multi-shot, identity drift, modern ponytail, cheap costumes, robotic expressions, duplicate background figures, complex gestures, extra limbs, light spots, plastic skin, black and white, modern scenes, garbled text.

items.promptZh:
主题：
双腿伸展在草地上

主题：
一位年轻女子的全身肖像，她穿着{argument name="clothing" default="grey sports top and Shorts"}，坐在{argument name="location" default="sunny park"}的瑜伽垫上，双腿高高张开，双手握住脚趾。人物从中央到下放得很大，一只腿向前中央笔直延伸，一只腿向左斜张开，双臂、草地和树木。

人物/表情：
一张瓜子脸转向屏幕左侧，下巴微微扬起，深棕色的眼睛望着左上角的远方。又黑又细的眉毛，挺直的小鼻子，浅玫瑰色的嘴唇紧闭着，露出温柔的微笑。白皙的皮肤搭配淡粉色的脸颊。深棕色的长发在头顶附近扎成高高的马尾辫，薄薄的刘海和波浪状的发丝绕在脸上，长发垂在右侧的背上。

服装/姿势：
浅蓝灰色的运动上衣和同色系的短裤。上衣有细肩带，浅V领，长度短至下胸围，有细密的垂直罗纹。短裤具有宽腰和宽松下摆。白色长及脚踝的袜子。右手腕上戴着一个半透明的浅绿色手镯，左手腕上戴着一个细细的银色手镯。坐在灰色垫子上，双腿伸直至膝盖，呈大V字形。右腿几乎垂直地向中央前景延伸，右手握住这些脚趾。左腿向左上方对角打开，左臂伸直握住左脚趾。

背景/灯光：
前景是灰色的长方形瑜伽垫和短绿草。中景是一片明亮的草地，从右到上有一棵绿叶茂密的大树，左后方是小树和远处的人物。左上角是明亮的白色天空。柔和的早晨直射光从左上角照射到脸部、肩膀和双腿，在身体右侧和垫子上投射出微弱但清晰的阴影。阳光透过树叶洒下斑驳的细光。

构图/相机：
5:7 宽高比。相机的水平视线水平略低于坐着的拍摄对象的腰部，拍摄从两个脚趾到垫子底部边缘的全身镜头。该人物被抓得很大，几乎占据了整个屏幕的高度，脸部位于右上方，中央腿是一条从下边缘到上边缘附近的粗垂直线，另一条腿和左臂向左上方展开。中央腿被显示为一个强大的前景元素，腰部和垫子位于底部三分之一。脸部和身体的焦点清晰，距离轻微模糊。

质地/风格：
基于嫩草绿色、浅蓝灰色、白色和自然肤色的高清真实感照片。真实地描绘了皮肤纹理、运动面料的细肋、白袜子、草叶、垫子的细微凹凸以及早晨斑驳的阳光。

负面：
不要改变双腿张开的{argument name="pose" default="yoga"}姿势；不要断开手和脚趾之间的接触。
items.prompt:
Theme:
Both legs extended on the grass

Subject:
A full-body portrait of a young woman wearing {argument name="clothing" default="grey sports top and shorts"} sitting on a yoga mat in a {argument name="location" default="sunny park"}, with her legs spread high and her hands holding her toes. The figure is placed large from the center to the bottom, showing one leg extending straight toward the front center, one leg opening diagonally to the left, both arms, grass, and trees.

Person/Expression:
A small oval face turned to the left of the screen, chin raised slightly, looking into the far distance at the top left with dark brown eyes. Thin dark eyebrows, a small straight nose, and a gentle smile with pale rose lips closed. Fair skin with pale pink cheeks. Long dark brown hair tied in a high ponytail near the crown, with thin bangs and wavy strands around the face, and long ends hanging down her back on the right.

Clothing/Pose:
Light blue-grey sports top and shorts of the same color. The top has thin shoulder straps, a shallow V-neck, a short length down to the under-bust, and fine vertical ribs. The shorts have a wide waist and loose hems. White ankle-length socks. A translucent light green bangle on the right wrist, and a thin silver bracelet on the left wrist. Sitting down on a grey mat, raising both legs straight to the knees in a large V-shape. The right leg is extended almost vertically toward the center foreground, with the right hand holding those toes. The left leg is opened diagonally to the top left, with the left arm extended holding the left toes.

Background/Light:
A grey rectangular yoga mat and short green grass in the foreground. The midground is a bright grassy field, with a large tree with dense green leaves from the right to the top, and small trees and distant figures in the back left. The top left is a bright white sky. Soft morning direct light from the top left illuminates the face, shoulders, and both legs, casting faint but clear shadows on the right side of the body and mat. Fine dappled sunlight through the tree leaves.

Composition/Camera:
5:7 aspect ratio. The camera is at a horizontal eye-level slightly lower than the seated subject's waist, a full-body shot capturing from both toes to the bottom edge of the mat. The figure is captured large, occupying almost the entire screen height, with the face in the upper right, the central leg as a thick vertical line from the bottom edge to near the top edge, and the other leg and left arm spreading to the top left. The central leg is shown large as a strong foreground element, with the waist and mat in the bottom third. Sharp focus on the face and body, with the distance lightly blurred.

Texture/Style:
A high-definition photorealistic photo based on young grass green, light blue-grey, white, and natural skin tones. Realistically depicts skin texture, fine ribs in the sports fabric, white socks, blades of grass, fine unevenness of the mat, and morning dappled sunlight.

Negative:
Do not change the {argument name="pose" default="yoga"} posture with legs spread high; do not break the contact between hands and toes.

items.prompt:
Goal: Create a 16:9 cinematic historical PowerPoint cover slide about the {argument name="historical event" default="Wenxi Fire in Changsha, 1938"}, using a heavy archival collage aesthetic that feels solemn, painful, and reflective.

Canvas: Wide presentation slide, 1200×675 or 16:9. Use an aged beige paper background with faint grid lines, scratches, stains, fold marks, dust, and worn print texture. The overall palette is sepia, charcoal black, brick red, smoky gray, and deep teal.

Layout: Design one dense poster-like slide with exactly 5 main visual zones: 1) a narrow vertical brick-red strip on the far left with faint city imagery and vertical Chinese text, 2) a huge central title occupying the left and middle of the slide, 3) a burning ruined city panorama across the lower half and right center, 4) a torn-paper map collage in the upper-right corner, and 5) a dark teal torn-paper information block in the lower-right corner.

Text content: At the top-left, set small bilingual/location text: “长沙  CHANGSHA”, then “1938”, then “WENXI FIRE”, separated by thin horizontal rules. The main title must be enormous Chinese typography reading “文夕大火”, with “文夕” in distressed black and “大火” in distressed dark red. Under the title, place a beige label strip reading “1938年长沙的伤害、余痛与重生”. Below it, add a smaller subtitle: “一场由战时决策失控引发的城市灾难”. Under that, add a small black rectangular tag reading “课件视觉图组”. In the upper-right, add a bold “1938” with a small red label “WENXI FIRE”, plus a vertical framed Chinese stamp-like label reading “长沙文夕大火”. In the lower-right, add a large page indicator “01 / 10”. Include one short vertical handwritten-style Chinese note over the teal panel, subtle and atmospheric.

Subject details: The city scene should show old Changsha streets in ruins, dark silhouettes of people walking, damaged traditional and early modern buildings, telephone poles, rubble piles, and a large building burning with orange flames and thick black smoke rising into the sky. Add torn collage edges where the city photo meets the paper background. Include exactly 1 prominent fire plume, exactly 1 large smoke column, exactly 1 rubble pile in the lower-left foreground, exactly 1 torn map fragment in the upper-right, and exactly 1 teal torn-paper block in the lower-right.

Visual style: Heavy historical aesthetics, archival documentary poster, Chinese modernist editorial design, distressed letterpress typography, old newspaper collage, torn paper, grainy halftone, scratches, muted contrast, somber memorial mood. Use bold geometric Chinese title characters with rough ink erosion and printed wear. Keep the composition dramatic but readable.

Constraints: Do not make it look modern, glossy, or clean. Avoid extra decorative icons, people portraits, watermarks, or random English filler text. Preserve the exact slide/page feeling and the solemn historical tone.

items.titleZh: Infographic / Edu Visual - Portrait Lighting Study Grid
items.promptZh:
3x3 照片网格在 {argument name="background color" default="dark grey"} 背景上呈现为单个图像。九个网格单元中的每一个都包含上传图像中同一主题的不同肖像，在所有面板上保持完美的角色一致性、服装和姿势。在每个单独的肖像下方，清晰地显示一个带有数字和名称的干净的无衬线文本标签。
网格布局和照明设置为：
- 顶行，从左到右：
环形照明（迷人的 3/4 光，从鼻子到脸颊有一个小环形阴影）
强光正面闪光灯（直接正面，强光手电筒，正面阴影较深）
分体照明（仅在脸部的一侧提供戏剧性的光线，使另一侧完全黑暗）
- 中间行，从左到右：
蝴蝶光（经典对称光，正面照射，稍高，鼻子下有小阴影）
Gobo Pattern（百叶窗）'（光线通过百叶窗投射，在脸部和衣服上产生线性阴影，阴影也可以出现在背景上）
底光（上光）”（光线来自下方，产生反向阴影和喜怒无常的外观）
- 底行，从左到右：
黄金时刻/暖光”（从侧面沐浴在柔和、金色、温暖的光线中）
戏剧性聚光灯（坚硬、狭窄的圆形光束，具有深明暗效果和碎黑色）
“中性开尔文边缘光”（强烈的背光，没有正面填充，在头发和肩膀周围形成明显的发光轮廓，使脸部处于黑暗中，在黑色背景下）。
所有面板的视角和功能都保持相同，只有指定的照明发生变化以匹配标签。
items.prompt:
A 3x3 photo grid presented as a single image on a {argument name="background color" default="dark grey"} background. Each of the nine grid cells contains a different portrait of the same subject from the uploaded image, maintaining the perfect character consistency, outfit and pose across all panels. Below each individual portrait, a clean sans-serif text label with a number and name is clearly displayed.
The grid layout and lighting setups are:
- Top row, left to right:
Loop Lighting (Flattering 3/4 light with a small loop of shadow from the nose onto the cheek)
Hardlight Frontal Flash (direct front facing, harsh flashlight with deep frontal shadows)
Split Lighting (dramatic light on only one side of the face, leaving the other side completely dark)
- Middle row, left to right:
Butterfly Lighting  (classic symmetrical light from the front, slightly high, with a small shadow under the nose)
Gobo Pattern (Venetian Blind)' (light projected through Venetian blinds, creating linear shadows across the face and clothes, the shadow can also be scene on the background)
Under-Lighting (Uplight)' (light coming from below, creating reverse shadows and a moody look)
- Bottom row, left to right:
Golden Hour / Warm Light' (bathed in soft, golden, warm light from a side angle)
Dramatic Spotlight  (hard, narrow circular beam of light, with a deep chiascuro effect and crushed blacks)
Neutral Kelvin Rim Light' (intense backlighting with no front fill, creating a distinct glowing outline around the hair and shoulders, leaving the face in darkness, against a black background).
The perspective and features remain identical in all panels, with only the specified lighting changing to match the label.

items.prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic 16:9 PowerPoint cover slide for a children’s AI art course, blending premium Chinese aesthetics, futuristic AI education, and warm imaginative storytelling.

Canvas: Wide presentation slide, 1366×768 or 16:9 ratio. Dark black-to-burgundy background with a strong vertical glowing portal slightly right of center. Use a luxury black, deep red, ivory, and gold palette with soft haze, dust particles, and luminous light trails.

Layout: Left side is the typography area; right side is the fantasy visual scene. Place a large two-line Chinese title on the left: first line “小孩AI绘图”, second line “培训版”, with elegant Song/Ming-style serif Chinese typography, ivory on top and warm gold accents below. Under the title, add one subtitle line: “让孩子用AI打开想象力 · 创造力 · 未来视觉表达”. Below that, add a small caption: “儿童AI创意绘画课程介绍”. In the top-left corner, include a tiny vertical four-line motto reading “想象力 / 表达力 / 未来力 / 创造力” with a small red seal-like square beneath it.

Subject details: On the right, show one small child silhouette standing at the base of the glowing portal, facing away from the viewer and reaching one hand toward floating visual panels. The child should look about 5–7 years old, short, with a rounded head silhouette and simple clothing, rendered as a warm backlit figure. Around the child, include exactly 5 floating art panels: 2 small dark red abstract landscape panels near the upper right, 2 pale Chinese ink landscape panels stacked near the middle-right, and 1 small translucent rectangular panel near the portal. Add exactly 4 main geometric accents: 1 large translucent red moon/circle behind the portal, 1 thin outlined circle in the upper right, 1 small outlined square near it, and 1 beige sphere near the lower left. Add a red ribbon-like orbit around the child and golden wave particles sweeping from lower left toward the portal.

Visual style: High-end course-presentation cover, cinematic lighting, subtle Chinese ink landscape silhouettes along the bottom left, faint bamboo silhouette on the far right, layered transparent rectangles, thin technical lines, warm golden vertical beam, glossy floor reflection, dramatic contrast, refined editorial composition, premium education brand aesthetic.

Customizable text: Main title should read {argument name="main title" default="小孩AI绘图\n培训版"}. Subtitle should read {argument name="subtitle" default="让孩子用AI打开想象力 · 创造力 · 未来视觉表达"}. Small course label should read {argument name="course label" default="儿童AI创意绘画课程介绍"}. Motto should read {argument name="vertical motto" default="想象力\n表达力\n未来力\n创造力"}. Overall theme should remain {argument name="course theme" default="children’s AI creative drawing course"}.

Constraints: Keep the composition uncluttered and presentation-ready. Do not add extra people, extra title text, logos, watermarks, or UI elements. Preserve the luxurious black-red-gold palette and the exact counts of 1 child, 5 floating art panels, and 4 main geometric accents.

items.titleZh: YouTube Thumbnail - Pop Idol Typography Cover Art
items.promptZh:
生成高端流行偶像排版封面海报。

主题：{argument name="主题" default="音乐封面/偶像视觉/流行社论/活动概念"}
Direction: {argument name="style Direction" default="动感红色排版封面/红底聚焦人像封面/动感偶像舞台海报/耳机流行编辑封面"}
主标题：{argument name="主标题" default="[填写主标题]"}
副标题：[填写短副标题]
版本小文字：[填写期号/版本/次要信息]
主题：[成人青年女偶像/成人青年男偶像/波普艺术家/各国表演者]
国家设置：[中国/韩国/日本/泰国/法国/美国/巴西/阿根廷/英国等]
氛围：[大胆/时尚/情感/动感/青春/图形/社论]
颜色系统：[红/白/黑/深红/柔白]

整体效果应类似于高端流行音乐视觉封面或时尚杂志海报。

使用超大字体作为视觉结构的一部分，而不仅仅是简单的标题。

通过以下方式允许主题和文本之间进行显着交互：遮挡、交织、裁剪、透视、空间分层、部分模糊和前景/背景关系。

布局应该干净且有影响力，仅保留少量辅助文本。

选择以下四个方向之一：

1.动态红色字体封面
使用白色或灰白色背景和超大粗体红色文本。以充满活力的姿势呈现成年年轻女性或男性偶像，与文字强烈互动。

2.红色背景聚焦肖像封面
使用浓郁的红色背景和偶像的特写或半身肖像。包括优雅的白色衬线文本，在眼睛上方有一个微妙的焦点框；梦幻般的氛围和清澈的眼睛。

3.动态偶像舞台海报
使用强烈的表演姿势和夸张的视角（例如，腿、靴子或手臂靠近镜头）。大文本被正文部分切割，营造出舞台视觉或音乐会海报的感觉。

4. 耳机流行社论封面
在特写或半身镜头中展示戴着耳机的偶像。结合与主体轮廓互动的高垂直文本，搭配 1-2 个小标签文本框，打造时尚、不拥挤的外观。

避免：廉价的模板感觉、过多的小文本、杂乱的构图、弱字体、假冒品牌徽标、变形的肢体、不正确的手指、塑料皮肤或堆积的贴纸元素。

要求：大胆、干净、现代、以设计为导向。仅生成一张高质量的独立海报。
items.prompt:
Generate a high-end pop idol typography cover poster.

Theme: {argument name="theme" default="music cover / idol visual / pop editorial / campaign concept"}
Direction: {argument name="style direction" default="Dynamic red typography cover / Red-background focused portrait cover / Dynamic idol stage poster / Headphone pop editorial cover"}
Main Title: {argument name="main title" default="[Fill in main title]"}
Subtitle: [Fill in short subtitle]
Edition Small Text: [Fill in issue number / edition / minor info]
Subject: [Adult young female idol / Adult young male idol / Pop artist / Performer from different countries]
Country Setting: [China / Korea / Japan / Thailand / France / USA / Brazil / Argentina / UK, etc.]
Atmosphere: [bold / stylish / emotional / kinetic / youthful / graphic / editorial]
Color System: [Red / White / Black / Crimson / Soft White]

The overall effect should resemble a high-end pop music visual cover or a fashion magazine poster.

Use oversized typography as part of the visual structure, not just a simple title.

Allow significant interaction between the subject and the text through: occlusion, interweaving, cropping, perspective, spatial layering, partial blurring, and foreground/background relationships.

Layout should be clean and impactful, retaining only a small amount of auxiliary text.

Choose one of the following four directions:

1. Dynamic Red Typography Cover
Use a white or off-white background with oversized bold red text. Feature an adult young female or male idol in a dynamic pose, interacting strongly with the text.

2. Red Background Focused Portrait Cover
Use a rich red background with a close-up or half-body portrait of an idol. Include elegant white serif text with a subtle focus box over the eyes; a dreamy atmosphere with clear eyes.

3. Dynamic Idol Stage Poster
Use strong performance poses and exaggerated perspective (e.g., legs, boots, or arms closer to the lens). Large text is partially cut by the body, creating a stage visual or concert poster feel.

4. Headphone Pop Editorial Cover
Feature an idol wearing headphones in a close-up or half-body shot. Incorporate tall vertical text interacting with the subject's silhouette, paired with 1-2 small label text boxes for a stylish, non-crowded look.

Avoid: Cheap template feel, excessive small text, cluttered composition, weak fonts, fake brand logos, deformed limbs, incorrect fingers, plastic skin, or piled-up sticker elements.

Requirements: Bold, clean, modern, and design-oriented. Generate only one high-quality standalone poster.

创建一个电影般的 5 面板故事板，其中展示了现代冰箱内的一个身材娇小的年轻女子。她有一头{argument name="hair color" default="深棕色波浪长发"}，皮肤白皙，笑容灿烂，穿着{argument name="top" default="白色针织长袖短款毛衣"}搭配{argument name="bottom" default="白色抽绳短裤"}。她在整个场景中都是赤脚的。

第 1 幅：小个子女人高兴地站在冰箱门架上，旁边有一排白色的大鸡蛋。冰箱里摆满了五颜六色的汽水罐、果汁盒、新鲜水果、蔬菜、美味的巧克力蛋糕和闪闪发光的冰块。明亮、干净的 LED 照明营造出清新的优质氛围。

面板2：她不小心踩到了一个巨大的鸡蛋，导致它裂开。浓郁的金黄色蛋黄戏剧性地洒落在透明的玻璃架上。她惊讶地举起双臂，同时熟练地保持平衡。

第三幅：她小心翼翼地跳过堆叠的果汁盒，避开流动的蛋黄。捕捉具有真实运动模糊、电影般运动和强烈能量感的动态动作姿势。

第 4 幅：她安全地降落在冰箱内，高兴地微笑着举起双手庆祝。现代冰箱内部一尘不染，采用冷白色 LED 照明，周围摆放着整齐排列的食品。

图5：完成挑战后，她高兴地蹲在最底层的架子上，大笑起来。冰箱的墙壁干净而简约，创造了一个简单的背景，将焦点集中在微小的人物上。

超写实、照片级写实、电影般的故事讲述、微型人体错觉、优质商业品质摄影、高度细致的冰箱内部、逼真的食物质感、HDR、柔冷的 LED 灯光、自然肤色、8K 分辨率、锐焦、动态构图、浅景深、35 毫米镜头、超细致的写实主义。

items.title: Comic / Storyboard - Cinematic Coffee Journey Storyboard
items.titleZh: Comic / Storyboard - Cinematic Coffee Journey Storyboard
items.promptZh:
目标：创建一个优质的电影咖啡商业故事板作为单个静态图像，展示从咖啡种子到成品拿铁的完整旅程。使用深色简约工作室外观，纯黑色背景、引人注目的低调灯光、浅景深、微距摄影真实感、丰富的棕色咖啡色调、光泽高光和优雅的白色标题。

画布：16:9 宽屏情节提要板，正好分为 10 个垂直面板，排列在 2 行 5 列的网格中。在面板之间使用薄的深灰色分隔板。每个面板都应该感觉像一个高端商业静态框架，具有黑色负空间和由狭窄的柔和聚光灯照亮的主题。

布局：顶行包含面板 1-5，靠近下三分之一处有居中的白色标题文本，但没有可见的数字。底行包含面板 6-10，每个面板的左上角带有白色的小计时标签，靠近底部的居中白色标题文本。保持所有排版干净、现代、无衬线、白色且不引人注目。

故事板面板，正好 10 个：
1. 一颗看起来像是烤过的咖啡种子，部分嵌入深色土壤中，从侧面照亮，说明文字：“咖啡种子与土壤相遇。”
2. 一颗咖啡种子裂开，一条弯曲的绿色芽从黑暗的土壤中向上长出，说明文字：“第一颗芽破土而出。”
3. 一棵咖啡幼苗，长着两片新鲜的绿叶，土壤中可见细细的浅色根，说明文字：“新生命在黑暗中生长。”
4. 较高的绿色咖啡豆芽，两侧是两半棕色的种子，说明文字：“种子变形，自然塑造。”
5. 黑暗中，一颗光滑的绿色咖啡樱桃挂在一根细细的树枝上，下面有一个小水滴，说明文字：“樱桃在沉默中成熟。”
6. 左下面板，左上标签为“6 5.0 - 6.0s”；展示了一颗成熟的红色咖啡樱桃裂开，露出里面一颗浅色的咖啡豆，从深色的土壤中生长出来，说明文字：“咖啡豆诞生了，浓郁而完整。”
7. 左上角标签“7 6.0 - 7.0s”；显示单个烘焙咖啡豆漂浮或隔离在黑色的背景下，非常接近的宏观细节，标题：“从大自然的工作到收获。”
8. 左上角标签“8 7.0 - 8.0s”；展示精细研磨的咖啡从研磨机落入手握的手柄中，标题：“研磨至完美。”
9. 左上角标签“9 8.0 - 9.0s”；显示浓缩咖啡的提取过程，两股细流从手柄中倒入下面的深色杯子中，标题：“精确提取。”
10. 左上角标签“10 9.0 - 10.0s”；展示了一名咖啡师将金属水罐中的热牛奶倒入一杯浓缩咖啡中，形成干净的拿铁艺术，说明文字：“精心打造，完美和谐。”

文本自定义：使用 {argument name="brand Mood" default="premium Cinematic Coffee Commercial"} 样式。主要的标题语气应该是诗意的和简约的。 （可选）将最终标题替换为 {argument name="final Caption" default="Crafted into a Perfect Harmony."}，同时保留相同的位置。

视觉限制：仅保留 10 个面板，每行恰好 5 个面板，并且仅在面板 6 到 10 上保留编号的计时标签。请勿添加徽标、水印、额外的图标、额外的面板、装饰性边框或不相关的文本。保持真实的咖啡质感、暗土颗粒、深邃的黑色、温暖的高光以及奢华的商业氛围。

Goal: Create a polished cinematic storyboard sheet for a short animated fantasy scene about {argument name="character name" default="a tiny dragon"} discovering an unexpected magical ability.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 storyboard board, eight panels arranged in a clean 4-by-2 grid. Each panel has a vivid image area on top and a black caption strip beneath it. Use thin black dividers between panels. Overall look: high-end 3D animated family-film style, warm forest lighting, shallow depth of field, expressive character acting, glowing particles, lush flowers, moss, butterflies, and soft golden sunbeams.

Main subject details: The main character is a cute small orange baby dragon with a cream belly, big green eyes, tiny horns, small bat wings, rounded snout, soft scales, and childlike proportions. The story takes place in an enchanted woodland clearing full of flowers, mossy stones, firefly-like sparkles, and friendly animals. The dragon is trying to breathe fire, but instead creates {argument name="magical breath effect" default="rainbow flame"}.

Layout and exact panel count: Use exactly 8 storyboard panels, numbered 1 through 8, with these visible captions and actions:

Panel 1 caption: “1. (0–2s) Establishing Shot” with subcaption “A tiny dragon stands alone, looking determined.” Image: wide establishing shot of the dragon standing on a forest path in a glowing magical clearing, butterflies and flowers around it.

Panel 2 caption: “2. (2–4s) Determination” with subcaption “The dragon puffs its cheeks, takes a huge breath, and spreads its wings.” Image: medium close-up of the dragon squeezing its eyes shut, cheeks inflated, wings open, preparing dramatically.

Panel 3 caption: “3. (4–6s) Failure” with subcaption “It exhales with all its strength… but only a tiny puff of smoke comes out.” Image: close-up of one winking eye and puckered mouth releasing a small gray smoke cloud.

Panel 4 caption: “4. (6–8s) Embarrassment” with subcaption “The dragon feels shy while a bird tilts its head, watching curiously.” Image: the dragon scratches its head sheepishly while a cute blue bird perches on a branch nearby.

Panel 5 caption: “5. (8–10s) The Sneeze” with subcaption “The smoke tickles its nose. It builds up… and prepares for the biggest sneeze ever!” Image: extreme close-up of the dragon’s face, wide eyes, smoky swirl around its nostril, about to sneeze.

Panel 6 caption: “6. (10–12s) Magical Surprise” with subcaption “It sneezes! Instead of fire, a HUGE burst of rainbow flames explodes out!” Image: side view of the dragon sneezing a massive sparkling rainbow blast, bright saturated colors, glittering embers.

Panel 7 caption: “7. (12–14s) Wonder” with subcaption “Animals stare in amazement as the rainbow flames light up the whole forest.” Image: wider shot with the dragon in the center, surrounded by exactly 5 visible woodland animals watching in awe: a rabbit, a squirrel, a deer-like fawn, a hedgehog, and a small bird. Rainbow fire arcs above them through the trees.

Panel 8 caption: “8. (14–15s) Happy Ending” with subcaption “The dragon laughs with joy as a tiny rainbow flame dances above its nose. Everyone celebrates!” Image: joyful close-up of the dragon laughing open-mouthed, eyes sparkling, tiny rainbow flame curling above its nose, cheering forest animals blurred behind.

Visual style: Cinematic 3D animation, cute Pixar-like character appeal, detailed scales and soft skin texture, warm orange-and-gold lighting, magical rainbow glow, volumetric sun rays, bokeh, expressive faces, high production value, family-friendly tone.

Text constraints: Keep all captions in English exactly as written. Use clean white sans-serif text centered on each black caption strip. Maintain legibility. Do not add extra panels, logos, watermarks, UI elements, or unrelated text.

items.promptZh:
# 参考和目的
- 附上一张用户拥有的{argument name="reference" default="全身女性参考图片"}。
- 仅将参考图像应用于{argument name="subject" default="Princess"}，而不应用于将军。
- 创建一张1:1的方形人物表，适合分享和视频制作参考。
- 平衡视觉吸引力与识别人员、服装和武器的实用性。
- 没有故事板；没有对城堡或王座等背景的描述。

# 参考主题的继承
从参考图像继承公主的面部特征、眼睛、脸型、鼻子/嘴巴、发型、颜色、刘海、分型、长度、年龄、皮肤、身高、比例和体型。在所有视图中保持同一性，而不会过度美化或老化。不要从参考中继承服装、配色方案或背景。

# 表达式
- 相当于剧场动画的细腻线条，高品质的卡通渲染，以及金属、布料和宝石的精致纹理。
- 精致的表面处理相当于官方画册。
- 避免 3D、现实或廉价的电视动画风格。

# 固定角色设计
## 公主

items.promptZh: 一个{argument name="subject" default="27岁的男子，有着聪明、瘦削的体格、柔软的棕色头发和害羞、天真的表情"}的电影般的、高度详细的场景。他穿着简单的公司上班装，反映出朝九晚五单调的办公室生活。晚高峰期间，他静静地站在{argument name="location" default="拥挤的城市公交车站"}，周围有数十名通勤者，他们看上去冷漠而冷漠。整个世界都是黑白的，强调了他日常生活的平淡和重复。乌云密布，雨突然倾盆而下。当周围的人都争先恐后地撑起雨伞、寻求庇护时，他只是低下目光，默默地接受着雨。这时，一个{argument name="stranger" default="25岁的女性，皮肤白皙，外表优雅，笑容温暖真诚"}走到了他的身边。她轻轻地撑起伞，将两人遮住。当他抬起头，他们的目光相遇时，他们交换了一个安静而真诚的微笑。当他们目光相遇的那一刻，黑白世界开始转变为鲜艳的色彩。雨滴发出柔和的光芒，城市的灯光变得温暖而生动，周围的每一个细节都变得栩栩如生。人群仍然在背景中，模糊而微不足道，而两人站在伞下，分享着一种沉默的、神奇的联系。这个场景充满情感、浪漫且充满希望，象征着一个善意的举动如何为某人的生活带来色彩。
items.prompt: A cinematic, highly detailed scene of a {argument name="subject" default="27-year-old man with a smart, lean physique, soft brown hair, and a shy, innocent expression"}. He is dressed in simple corporate office attire, reflecting the routine of a monotonous 9-to-5 office life. He stands quietly at a {argument name="location" default="crowded city bus stop"} during the evening rush hour, surrounded by dozens of commuters who seem distant and emotionless. The entire world is shown in black and white, emphasizing the dullness and repetition of his daily life. Dark clouds gather overhead, and rain suddenly begins to pour. While everyone around him rushes to open umbrellas or seek shelter, he simply lowers his gaze, accepting the rain in silence. At that moment, a {argument name="stranger" default="25-year-old woman with fair skin, an elegant appearance, and a warm, genuine smile"} steps beside him. She gently extends her umbrella to cover both of them. As he looks up and their eyes meet, they exchange a quiet, heartfelt smile. The instant their eyes meet, the black-and-white world begins transforming into vibrant color. The rain glows softly, the city lights become warm and vivid, and every detail around them comes to life. The crowd remains in the background, blurred and insignificant, while the two stand beneath the umbrella, sharing a silent, magical connection. The scene is emotional, romantic, and hopeful, symbolizing how a single act of kindness can bring color into someone’s life.

items.title: Product Marketing - Glamorous Fashion Magazine Cover
items.titleZh: Product Marketing - Glamorous Fashion Magazine Cover
items.promptZh:
目标：创建一个迷人的垂直时尚杂志封面，以年轻女性为中心封面模特，风格像高端美容和生活方式社论。

画布：高肖像杂志封面，2:3 宽高比，全出血摄影封面，优质光面印刷外观。黑暗温暖的散景背景，柔和的金色灯光，浅景深，电影般的夜间照明。

对象详细信息：一名年轻的东亚女性，{argument name="hair style" default="深棕色头发，松散的盘发，搭配纤细的刘海和修饰脸型的发丝"}，自然明亮的妆容，光泽的嘴唇，精致的吊式耳环，以及泰然自若的过肩姿势。她带着平静自信的表情直视观众。她的肩膀和上背部清晰可见。她穿着一件闪闪发光的粉红色薄纱高级定制连衣裙，无肩带紧身胸衣，闪闪发光的质地，透明的分层荷叶边和精致的手镯。皮肤应该看起来精致且具有编辑性但又真实。

杂志标识和版式：最顶部的大报头以巨大优雅的高对比度衬线字母阅读{argument name =“magazine title”default =“EMA'S”}，淡粉色，几乎覆盖整个宽度。左侧刊头下方有小写的大写文字：“时尚 | 美容 | 生活方式”。右上角是小写的问题文本：{argument name="issue text" default="AUGUST 2025\nISSUE 48"}。使用精致的时尚杂志排版组合：高衬线标题、斜体衬线重音、干净的无衬线正文副本和大型手写脚本功能线。

布局和文本内容：包括 8 个封面文本组和 1 个条形码块：
1. 顶部刊头：“EMA'S”。
2. 小品类线：“时尚|美容|生活方式”。
3. 发行信息：“2025年8月”和“ISSUE 48”。
4. 左上特征：标题“NEW\nSEASON\nGLOW”，正文“毫不费力的美丽\n看起来会带你度过\n每一个时刻。”和一条短而细的分隔线。
5. 左中特征：斜体标题“Mind.\nBody.\nBalance”。正文为“健康仪式\n让你更平静、\n更强大。”和一条短而细的分隔线。
6. 右上特征：斜体标题“Be\nYou”，正文“Confidence\nis the best\naccessory”。和一条短而细的分隔线。
7. 右中圆形徽章：浅粉色轮廓的细圆圈，包含“独家\n采访”和较小的文字“鼓舞人心\n对话。\n真实故事。”
8. 右下方特征：标题“时尚\n预测”，正文“主要趋势、\n新鲜主打、\n永恒风格”。和一条短而细的分隔线。
9. 底部主封面线：巨大的白色手写脚本，上面写着{argument name="main cover line" default="Made to Shine"}，与下半身着装区域重叠，下面有小的大写标语：{argument name="tagline" default="EMBRACE YOUR STORY. OWN YOUR POWER."}
10. 左下条形码块：带有黑条的白色小条形码矩形，上面有微小的价格文本，例如“$6.99 US $8.99 CAN”，以及小的数字详细信息。

视觉风格：逼真的时尚编辑封面，温暖的对比，头发和肩膀上柔和的边缘光，优雅的粉白色版式，奢华的美容杂志美学，干净的专业间距。保持模特居中稍偏右，脸部位于中上，报头位于头后/上方，大脚本标题位于底部。

限制：没有额外的徽标或水印。使所有文本清晰易读。保留列出的文本组的准确数量和位置。不要在指定的封面行之外添加其他标题。
items.prompt:
Goal: Create a glamorous vertical fashion magazine cover featuring a young woman as the central cover model, styled like a high-end beauty and lifestyle editorial.

Canvas: Tall portrait magazine cover, 2:3 aspect ratio, full-bleed photographic cover, premium glossy print look. Dark warm bokeh background with soft golden lights, shallow depth of field, cinematic evening lighting.

Subject details: A young East Asian woman with {argument name="hair style" default="dark brown hair in a loose updo with wispy bangs and face-framing strands"}, natural luminous makeup, glossy lips, delicate drop earrings, and a poised over-the-shoulder pose. She looks directly at the viewer with a calm confident expression. Her shoulders and upper back are visible. She wears a sparkling blush-pink tulle couture dress with a strapless bodice, glitter texture, sheer layered ruffles, and a delicate bracelet. Skin should look polished and editorial but realistic.

Magazine identity and typography: Large masthead at the very top reading {argument name="magazine title" default="EMA'S"} in huge elegant high-contrast serif letters, pale pink color, spanning nearly the full width. Beneath the masthead on the left, small uppercase text: “FASHION | BEAUTY | LIFESTYLE”. On the upper right, small uppercase issue text: {argument name="issue text" default="AUGUST 2025\nISSUE 48"}. Use a refined fashion magazine typography mix: tall serif headlines, italic serif accents, clean sans-serif body copy, and a large handwritten script feature line.

Layout and text content: Include exactly 8 cover text groups plus 1 barcode block:
1. Top masthead: “EMA'S”.
2. Small category line: “FASHION | BEAUTY | LIFESTYLE”.
3. Issue information: “AUGUST 2025” and “ISSUE 48”.
4. Left upper feature: headline “NEW\nSEASON\nGLOW” with body copy “Effortless beauty\nlooks to carry\nyou through\nevery moment.” and a short thin divider line.
5. Left middle feature: italic headline “Mind.\nBody.\nBalance.” with body copy “Wellness rituals\nfor a calmer,\nstronger you.” and a short thin divider line.
6. Right upper feature: italic headline “Be\nYou” with body copy “Confidence\nis the best\naccessory.” and a short thin divider line.
7. Right middle circular badge: thin pale-pink outlined circle containing “EXCLUSIVE\nINTERVIEW” and smaller text “Inspiring\nconversations.\nReal stories.”
8. Right lower feature: headline “FASHION\nFORECAST” with body copy “Key trends,\nfresh staples,\ntimeless style.” and a short thin divider line.
9. Bottom main cover line: huge white handwritten script reading {argument name="main cover line" default="Made to Shine"}, overlapping the lower dress area, with small uppercase tagline underneath: {argument name="tagline" default="EMBRACE YOUR STORY. OWN YOUR POWER."}
10. Bottom-left barcode block: small white barcode rectangle with black bars, tiny price text above such as “$6.99 US   $8.99 CAN”, and small numeric details.

Visual style: Photorealistic fashion editorial cover, warm contrast, soft rim light on hair and shoulders, elegant pink-and-white typography, luxury beauty magazine aesthetic, clean professional spacing. Keep the model centered slightly right, face in the upper-middle, masthead behind/above her head, and the large script title across the bottom.

Constraints: No extra logos or watermarks. Make all text crisp and legible. Preserve the exact count and placement of the listed text groups. Do not add additional headlines beyond the specified cover lines.

items.promptZh:
创建超逼真的电影豪华冬季旅行肖像照片 (9:16)。

场景：一夜新降雪后，一座美丽的手工小木屋坐落在白雪覆盖的高山森林深处。软雪覆盖了屋顶、木栅栏、松树和周围的景观。温暖的金色光芒透过小屋的窗户照射进来，而轻柔的烟雾从石烟囱自然升腾到寒冷的冬日天空中。

在宽敞的木质门廊上，一位时尚的女性旅行者坐在一张裹着厚厚的奶油色针织毯的质朴摇椅上放松身心。她穿着舒适的超大绞花针织毛衣、羊毛袜和柔软的冬季家居服，双手捧着一杯热气腾腾的热巧克力。她的表情很平静，看着安静的雪景。

她周围是一个风格精美的 hygge 环境：一张木制咖啡桌，上面有自制的饼干、肉桂卷、棉花糖、松果、闪烁的灯笼、发光的蜡烛、新鲜的常绿树枝、一台老式胶片相机、一本皮革日记和一摞经典书籍。柔软的羊皮地毯、针织枕头和编织毛毯增添了温暖和质感。

门廊之外，高耸的白雪覆盖的松树环绕着小屋，雄伟的雪山在第一缕阳光的照耀下闪闪发光。温柔的雪花在空中飘舞，而未曾触及的脚印则消失在新鲜的粉末中。这里的气氛让人感觉平静、神奇、完全与世隔绝。

豪华山间小屋的美学灵感源自安缦度假村和四季酒店、斯堪的纳维亚hygge风格、电影般的金色日出灯光、体积太阳光线、柔和的降雪、逼真的烟囱烟雾、温暖的窗光、超细致的木质纹理、HDR、8K、国家地理品质、Vogue Living编辑摄影、浅景深、自然肤色、温暖的电影色彩分级、宁静的氛围、杰作构图、滚动停止的冬季逃生、无文字、无水印，没有人群，没有车辆，没有干扰。
items.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic cinematic luxury winter travel photograph in portrait (9:16).

Scene: A beautiful handcrafted log cabin sits deep within a snow-covered alpine forest after a fresh overnight snowfall. Soft snow blankets the rooftop, wooden fences, pine trees, and surrounding landscape. Warm golden light glows through the cabin windows while gentle smoke rises naturally from the stone chimney into the crisp winter sky.

On the spacious wooden porch, a stylish female traveler relaxes in a rustic rocking chair wrapped in a chunky cream knit blanket. She wears a cozy oversized cable-knit sweater, wool socks, and soft winter loungewear while holding a steaming mug of rich hot chocolate with both hands. Her expression is peaceful as she watches the quiet snowy landscape.

Around her is a beautifully styled hygge setting: a wooden coffee table with homemade cookies, cinnamon rolls, marshmallows, pinecones, flickering lanterns, glowing candles, fresh evergreen branches, a vintage film camera, a leather journal, and a stack of classic books. A soft sheepskin rug, knitted pillows, and woven blankets add warmth and texture.

Beyond the porch, towering snow-covered pine trees surround the cabin, with majestic snow-capped mountains glowing under the first rays of sunrise. Gentle snowflakes drift through the air while untouched footprints disappear into the fresh powder. The atmosphere feels calm, magical, and completely secluded.

Luxury mountain lodge aesthetic inspired by Aman Resorts and Four Seasons, Scandinavian hygge style, cinematic golden sunrise lighting, volumetric sun rays, soft snowfall, realistic chimney smoke, warm window glow, ultra-detailed wood textures, HDR, 8K, National Geographic quality, Vogue Living editorial photography, shallow depth of field, natural skin tones, warm cinematic color grading, peaceful atmosphere, masterpiece composition, scroll-stopping winter escape, no text, no watermark, no crowds, no vehicles, no distractions.

items.promptZh:
使用上传的参考图片为“{argument name="product name" default="PRODUCT NAME"}”创建醒目、色彩缤纷的 1:1 社交媒体广告系列网格，或生成高级、超现实版本的 {argument name="product name" default="PRODUCT NAME"}。根据产品类型或上传的参考自动调整所有颜色、成分、纹理、道具、装饰元素和整体视觉氛围。设计一个现代流行艺术灵感的促销拼贴画，具有多个创意方形部分。

画布尺寸：
1:1 方形格式 — 1080 × 1080 像素，针对 Instagram 帖子和时尚社交媒体品牌进行了优化。

设定及背景：
使用充满活力的流行艺术背景，其中包括充满活力的色块、抽象波浪图案、迷宫线、复古曲线、涂鸦轮廓、霓虹灯口音、俏皮的几何形状和现代孟菲斯风格的设计元素。将构图分为四个创意网格部分，每个部分都有独特的背景风格和动态的视觉节奏。

照明：
明亮的商业工作室照明具有光泽的高光、鲜艳的色彩反射、柔和逼真的阴影、优质的纹理增强和有趣的现代广告氛围。

风格：
现代波普艺术广告美学、Z世代品牌风格、时尚的Instagram营销视觉效果、色彩缤纷的街头风格图形、简约而充满活力的布局、大胆的现代排版、优质的商业海报设计和超现实的产品渲染。

版式风格：
使用超大的粗体排版和有趣的布局放置。
将简洁的现代字体与手写重音文本混合。
保持版式充满活力、年轻且视觉上充满活力。

颜色方向：

items.promptZh: 创建一个垂直的、超现实的夏季奇幻饮料广告场景：一个高大的透明玻璃杯的极端特写，里面装满了闪闪发光的翠绿苏打水、碎冰、气泡、冷凝水滴和光滑的石灰状亮点，坐在明亮的沙滩上。饮料中升起一个微型冰冷的北极世界：一头半透明的蓝色冰鲸从苏打水中戏剧性地冲出，它的头和身体向上呈弧形，水花和水滴冻结在半空中，身体上有细小的发光冰脊。旁边，浮在水面上的一个圆形的白色冰雪堆上，正好放置着四只北极小动物：三只企鹅直立成一排，一只白色北极熊站在它们的右边。这些动物应该看起来像精致的霜冻冰雕，具有微妙的现实细节。背景：碧绿的海洋，模糊的海滩游客，遥远的低山，生动无云的蓝天，右边有柔软的白云，左上方强烈的夏日阳光和镜头光晕。使用明亮清爽的色彩、闪闪发光的高光、浅景深、微距摄影视角、热带炎热与冰冷之间的高对比度、电影般的真实感、无文字、无徽标、无水印。将饮料自定义为 {argument name="drink color" default="emerald green"}，将主要冰冷生物自定义为 {argument name="ice Bio" default="breaching blue shark"}，将北极动物群自定义为 {argument name="animal group" default="三只企鹅和一只北极熊"}，将设置自定义为 {argument name="beach setting" default="sunnytropical beach"}，将灯光氛围自定义为 {argument name="lighting Mood"默认=“带有镜头光晕的灿烂正午阳光”}。
items.prompt: Create a vertical, hyperrealistic summer fantasy beverage advertisement scene: an extreme close-up of a tall transparent glass filled with sparkling emerald-green soda, crushed ice, bubbles, condensation droplets, and glossy lime-like highlights, sitting on a bright sandy beach. From the drink rises a miniature icy arctic world: one translucent blue ice whale breaching dramatically from the soda with its head and body arcing upward, water splashes and droplets frozen midair, and fine glowing ice ridges along its body. The animals should look like delicate frosty ice sculptures with subtle realistic detail. Use bright refreshing colors, sparkling highlights, shallow depth of field, macro photography perspective, high contrast between tropical heat and icy coolness, cinematic realism, no text, no logo, no watermark. Customize the drink as {argument name="drink color" default="emerald green"}, the main icy creature as {argument name="ice creature" default="breaching blue whale"}, the arctic animal group as {argument name="animal group" default="three penguins and one polar bear"}, the setting as {argument name="beach setting" default="sunny tropical beach"}, and the lighting mood as {argument name="lighting mood" default="brilliant midday sun with lens flare"}.

items.promptZh: 使用上传的模特照片作为准确的个性参考。 1:1 保持外观：脸部、五官、比例、皮肤、头发和整体外观。不要改变性格。皮肤必须最大限度地自然和有活力：真实的毛孔、自然的纹理、柔和的自然光泽、没有整形修饰、没有美化、没有过度平滑。使用上传的产品照片作为准确的产品参考。 1:1 保留产品：形状、尺寸、比例、包装、盖子、标签、徽标、文本、材料、颜色、涂层、反射和所有设计细节。产品必须看起来非常自然和逼真，就像手中的真实物体一样，而不是计算机生成的，没有扭曲，也没有重新解释。以{argument name="campaign style" default="modern奢华化妆品campaign"}风格拍摄的特写美女。照片参考中的模特将上传照片中的产品放在一只眼睛附近，稍微遮住它，并做出{argument name="facial expression" default="俏皮的面部表情，柔软的嘴唇，亲吻脸风格"}。目光直视相机。头发顺利地向后梳。戴在耳朵上 — {argument name="accessories" default="金环耳环"}。背景——干净简约的白色，没有多余的物体。工作室灯光柔和，干净的美感灯光，皮肤和产品上有精致的亮点。妆容自然清新：容光焕发的皮肤，微微闪亮的嘴唇，整齐的眉毛，柔和强调的眼睛，没有浓妆。整体审美——新鲜的护肤/美容社论，有光泽，昂贵，现代，但同时自然和现实。框架焦点 — 模特的脸部、自然皮肤和产品。避免：改变脸部、塑料皮肤、大量修饰、CGI 产品外观、难以辨认的徽标、额外的物体、不良的手部解剖结构、卡通化。

items.promptZh: 在 4:3 的水平画布上创建逼真的奢华护肤品静物画。准确展示 3 个站在透明亚克力块上的未贴标签的化妆品容器：左侧 1 个圆肩形状的高哑光乳白色乳液瓶和半透明白色翻盖，1 个透明淡蓝色圆柱形瓶子，装满透明液体，中间有缎面银色瓶盖，右侧 1 个淡薰衣草粉色泵瓶，带有白色泵分配器。将它们紧密地排列在一起，稍微向右居中，中间的蓝色瓶子比白色瓶子稍短，泵瓶比蓝色瓶子稍高。亚克力底座应为矩形、有光泽、透明，并沿正面和顶面覆盖有可见的水滴。使用凉爽的雾气水疗氛围：磨砂玻璃背景，带有垂直凝结条纹，许多微小的水滴，柔和的蓝灰色和白色渐变照明，以及在底座周围漂浮的低淡紫色雾气。照明应该是高调的、漫射的、透过湿玻璃的背光、柔和的反射和柔和的光晕。没有可读的标签，没有品牌，没有人，没有文字，没有额外的产品。强调清洁保湿、清新、露水凝结和优质化妆品广告摄影。
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic luxury skincare product still life on a 4:3 horizontal canvas. Show exactly 3 unlabeled cosmetic containers standing on a clear acrylic block: 1 tall matte milky-white lotion bottle with a rounded-shoulder shape and translucent white flip cap on the left, 1 transparent pale-blue cylindrical bottle filled with clear liquid and a satin silver cap in the center, and 1 pale lavender-pink pump bottle with a white pump dispenser on the right. Arrange them tightly grouped, centered slightly to the right, with the center blue bottle a little shorter than the white bottle and the pump bottle slightly taller than the blue bottle. The acrylic pedestal should be rectangular, glossy, transparent, and covered with visible water droplets along the front face and top surface. Use a cool misty spa atmosphere: frosted glass background with vertical condensation streaks, many tiny water droplets, soft blue-gray and white gradient lighting, and low lavender-tinted fog drifting around the base. Lighting should be high-key, diffused, backlit through the wet glass, with soft reflections and gentle bloom. No readable labels, no branding, no people, no text, no extra products. Emphasize clean hydration, freshness, dewy condensation, and premium cosmetic advertising photography.

items.prompt: Create a realistic vertical smartphone mirror selfie of an adult fantasy elf cosplayer sitting on a soft white sheet on a gray carpet in a minimal beige room. The subject is {argument name="character name" default="an elf princess cosplayer"}, wearing a delicate white draped fantasy outfit with gold chain details, thin arm jewelry, gold leg bands, and pale blue flower accessories. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long silver-gray"} hair styled in twin ponytails, pointed elf ears, and a blue-and-white floral crown. items.promptZh:
主题：反射群青的眼睛

主要拍摄对象：仲夏大海背景下，一位 20 多岁女性手放在 {argument name="sunglasses color" default="blue round sexys"} 上的逼真垂直美女肖像。随风飘扬的短发、充满活力的{argument name="dress color" default="royal blue"}缎面连衣裙、蓝色配饰、波光粼粼的海面是核心元素。

性格/表情：脸几乎向前，下巴微微上扬，平静地看着镜头。小鹅蛋脸，光滑的下巴和珊瑚粉色的嘴唇。精致自然的日式妆容。明亮的灰米色{argument name="hairstyle" default="短鲍勃发"}，浅刘海在微风中飘扬。透过蓝色镜片隐约可见眼睛。

服装/姿势：闪亮的宝蓝色缎面连衣裙，配有细肩带和裹身式 V 领，配有柔软的垂坠感。她举起右手，用拇指和食指触摸太阳镜的外框。镶有小蓝色宝石的金耳环和一条细项链。

背景/灯光：背景是充满活力的蓝色大海，地平线上有模糊的岛屿阴影。白色海鸥在浅景深中飞翔。夏日强烈的阳光从左上方照射下来，在头发和皮肤上形成亮点。水面上波光粼粼的倒影。

构图/摄影机：垂直 3:4。从头部到胸部的半身特写镜头。主体占据中心。相机位置稍低。大海和海鸥严重模糊。

纹理/风格：高清逼真时尚摄影。自然的肌肤纹理，纤细的发丝，透明的蓝色镜片，光滑的缎面光泽。夏季自然光明亮清澈。

负面：不要将圆形蓝色镜片改为黑色或方形；保持手与太阳镜接触；不要把头发改成长发。
items.prompt:
Subject: Eyes Reflecting Ultramarine

Main Subject: A realistic vertical beauty portrait of a woman in her 20s with her hand on {argument name="sunglasses color" default="blue round sunglasses"} against a midsummer sea background. Wind-blown short hair, a vibrant {argument name="dress color" default="royal blue"} satin dress, blue accessories, and the shimmering sea surface are the core elements.

Character/Expression: Faces almost forward with the chin slightly up, looking calmly at the camera. Small oval face with a smooth chin and coral pink lips. Fine natural Japanese-style makeup. Bright ash-beige {argument name="hairstyle" default="short bob hair"} with light bangs blowing in the breeze. Eyes are slightly visible through the blue lenses.

Clothing/Pose: Shiny royal blue satin dress with thin straps and a wrap-style V-neck with soft drapes. Her right hand is raised, touching the outer frame of the sunglasses with her thumb and forefinger. Gold earrings with small blue stones and a thin necklace.

Background/Light: Vibrant blue sea in the background with blurry island shadows on the horizon. White seagulls flying above in shallow depth of field. Strong summer sun from top left creates highlights on hair and skin. Shimmering reflections on the water.

Composition/Camera: Vertical 3:4. Close-up bust shot from head to chest. Subject occupies the center. Camera at a slightly low position. Sea and seagulls are heavily blurred.

Texture/Style: High-definition photorealistic fashion photography. Natural skin texture, fine hair strands, transparent blue lenses, and smooth satin sheen. Bright and clear summer natural light.

Negative: Do not change round blue lenses to black or square; keep hand-to-sunglasses contact; do not change hair to long hair.

items.title: Profile / Avatar - Train Travel Portrait 9:16 Cinematic Prompt
items.titleZh: Profile / Avatar - Train Travel Portrait 9:16 Cinematic Prompt
items.promptZh:
垂直 9:16，在白天火车靠窗座位上拍摄的逼真旅行肖像。一位虚构的日本成年女性，年龄似乎是 {argument name="age group" default="24-30 岁"}。从头顶到胸部以下拍摄的半身特写。使人稍微偏向中心左侧，身体比正面更偏右。脸朝向右上角的窗户，而不是看着相机。将右手食指根部轻轻放在下巴右侧下方，拇指放在下巴下方，其他手指自然弯曲。 {argument name="expression" default="谦虚的微笑，露出牙齿，微微露出牙齿"}，仿佛想象着窗外的目的地。
长长的深棕色头发几乎是黑色的。左边的侧分，修饰脸型的头发顺着脸颊，没有塞到耳后，发尾在胸部向内卷曲。深棕色眼睛，带有垂直窗户聚光灯，细棕色眼线，浅珊瑚米色妆容，自然玫瑰色嘴唇。明亮的自然光下的肌肤，保留毛孔、细毛和嘴唇的纹理。
服装由{argument name="outfit" default="浅灰色薄罗纹背心搭配象牙色薄开衫"}组成。开衫打开，露出小圆形配套纽扣和自然的织物褶皱。曝光优雅又日常。背景显示了火车窗框的一部分和蓝色座椅，而外面的景色是淡蓝色、白色和米色的流动模糊的城市景观。右前方柔和的窗光，左前方微弱的温暖室内反射。
85 毫米等效值，f/2.0，与坐着的人的视线高度相同。精确对焦近眼、睫毛、指尖；背景和远处的头发被平滑地模糊。没有文字、路线名称、标志、广告、可读标志、多余的手指、刺伤下巴的手指、扭曲的窗户、不对称的眼睛、过度的皮肤平滑、强烈的 HDR 或 CG 感觉。

Close-up half-body shot from the top of the head to below the chest. Position the person slightly to the left of the center, with the body facing more to the right than the front. Lightly place the base of the right index finger under the right side of the chin, thumb under the chin, and other fingers naturally curved. A {argument name="expression" default="modest smile of anticipation with teeth slightly visible"}, as if imagining the destination outside the window.
Long dark brown hair nearly black. Side part on the left, face-framing hair following the cheeks without being tucked behind ears, and ends curled inward at the chest. Dark brown eyes with vertical window catchlights, thin brown eyeliner, light coral beige makeup, and natural rose lips. Skin in bright natural light, retaining textures of pores, fine hairs, and lips.
Costume consists of a {argument name="outfit" default="light gray thin ribbed tank top under an ivory thin cardigan"}. The cardigan is open, showing small round matching buttons and natural fabric folds. Exposure is elegant and everyday. The background shows part of the train window frame and blue seats, while the outside view is a flowing blur of cityscapes in pale blue, white, and beige. Soft window light from the front right, weak warm interior reflections on the left.
85mm equivalent, f/2.0, eye-level height with the seated person. Precise focus on the near eye, eyelashes, and fingertips; background and far hair are smoothly blurred. No text, route names, logos, ads, readable signs, extra fingers, fingers stabbing the chin, distorted windows, asymmetrical eyes, excessive skin smoothing, strong HDR, or CG feel.

items.promptZh: 创建高度逼真的休闲智能手机自拍照，看起来就像在日本城市户外拍摄的真实 Instagram Story 生活方式快照。拍摄对象是一位性格开朗的年轻女性，{argument name="character name" default="unnamed"}，留着{argument name="hair color" default="金色短发，配上柔和的刘海"}，妆容温暖自然，皮肤白皙透亮，戴着小耳环，直视手机摄像头时，脸上挂着温柔的闭嘴微笑。她高举手机，角度稍大，手臂伸向左下前景，营造出自然的自拍扭曲和亲密坦诚的感觉。她穿着一件纯白色圆领 T 恤，塞进浅蓝色高腰牛仔短裤中，戴着一条细银项链、一块白色手表或手镯，肩上挎着一个米色帆布手提包。她的另一只手拿着两件可见的物品：一杯冰咖啡，装在一个带有圆顶盖和黑色吸管的透明塑料杯中，以及一个白色塑料购物袋。将场景设置在人行横道附近阳光明媚的人行道上，有城市店面、绿树成荫的行道树、带有温暖室内灯光的咖啡馆露台、瓷砖路面、触觉铺路，以及右侧可见的一辆停放的自行车。背景中包括一些远处的行人，柔和地模糊。使用午后黄金时段的阳光、自然阴影、逼真的皮肤纹理、微妙的镜头畸变、智能手机 HDR 外观、浅但不过分人工的景深以及坦率的日常时尚照片氛围。整体氛围应该是{argument name="overall momo" default="自然、友好、时尚、不做作"}。没有文字叠加，没有水印，没有选美姿势，没有工作室灯光，没有幻想元素。
items.prompt: Create a highly realistic casual smartphone selfie that looks like an authentic Instagram Story lifestyle snap taken outdoors in a Japanese city. The subject is a cheerful young woman, {argument name="character name" default="unnamed"}, with {argument name="hair color" default="short blonde hair with soft face-framing bangs"}, warm natural makeup, clear glowing skin, small hoop earrings, and a gentle closed-mouth smile while looking directly into the phone camera. She is holding the phone high and slightly wide-angle, arm extended toward the lower-left foreground, creating a natural selfie distortion and an intimate candid feel. She wears a plain white crew-neck T-shirt tucked into light blue high-waisted denim shorts, a thin silver necklace, a white watch or bracelet, and carries a beige canvas tote bag over one shoulder. In her other hand she holds exactly 2 visible items: an iced coffee in a clear plastic cup with a domed lid and black straw, and a white plastic shopping bag. Set the scene on a sunny sidewalk near a crosswalk, with urban storefronts, leafy street trees, a cafe terrace with warm interior lights, tiled pavement, tactile paving, and exactly 1 parked bicycle visible on the right side. Include a few distant pedestrians in the background, softly blurred. Use late-afternoon golden-hour sunlight, natural shadows, realistic skin texture, subtle lens distortion, smartphone HDR look, shallow but not overly artificial depth of field, and a candid everyday fashion-photo mood. The overall atmosphere should be {argument name="overall mood" default="natural, friendly, stylish, and unposed"}. No text overlays, no watermark, no beauty-pageant posing, no studio lighting, no fantasy elements.

items.promptZh:
主题：转入紫光

主要主体：再现面部特征，翻肩，镜头目光接触，右手放在脖子上，超细黑色带子，棕色头发，左边{argument name="left light color" default="blue-violet light"}，右边{argument name="right light color" default="pink light"}。一幅 20 多岁女性垂直方向的逼真美女肖像，在黑暗的工作室中从肩膀到头顶非常接近地拍摄，具有纯色{argument name="background color" default="purple background"}。该人背朝右侧，将脸转向左肩对着镜头。前景中的大圆形左肩。

性格/表情：椭圆形脸，光滑的下巴，小鼻子，玫瑰米色的嘴唇。头大约转动了40度，深褐色的眼睛直视着镜头。表情安静，嘴唇微微张开。皮肤呈明亮的中性象牙色，鼻子、颧骨和肩膀上有亮点。头发是中棕色的，有薄刘海。

服装/姿势：黑色缎面或哑光弹力吊带背心，配有单条超细肩带。该人扭转上半身，使左肩靠近镜头。她的右手摸到了脖子的右侧。 

背景/灯光：背景从淡紫色过渡到中紫色再到深红紫色。主光从右前方射出，呈柔和的粉红色至红紫色。辅助光是从左前方射出的冷青蓝色到蓝紫色。头发上有洋红色的边缘光。

构图/摄影机：垂直 3:4 紧密特写。相机处于视线水平。中长焦镜头视角。严格关注前景的眼睛、鼻子和嘴唇。

纹理/风格：高分辨率真实感工作室美容摄影。细致的毛孔、发丝和平滑的光线渐变。眼睛里的聚光灯小而自然。

负面：不改双灯光或紫色背景；避免多余的手指/四肢；没有文字、徽标或水印。
items.prompt:
Subject: Turning in Purple Light

Main Subject: Reproduce facial features, turning over the shoulder, camera eye contact, right hand on neck, ultra-thin black strap, brown hair, {argument name="left light color" default="blue-violet light"} on the left and {argument name="right light color" default="pink light"} on the right. A photorealistic beauty portrait in vertical orientation of a woman in her 20s captured extremely close from shoulders to crown in a dark studio with a solid {argument name="background color" default="purple background"}. The person has her back to the right and turns her face over her left shoulder to the camera. Large rounded left shoulder in foreground.

Character/Expression: Oval face, smooth chin, small nose, and rose-beige lips. Head turned roughly 40 degrees, looking straight at the lens with dark brown eyes. Quiet expression with lips slightly parted. Skin is bright neutral ivory with highlights on nose, cheekbones, and shoulder. Hair is medium brown with thin bangs.

Clothing/Pose: Black satin or matte stretch camisole with a single ultra-thin strap. The person twists her upper body, bringing the left shoulder close to the camera. Her right hand touches the right side of her neck. 

Background/Light: Background transitions from lavender to medium purple to dark reddish-purple. Main light is soft pink to reddish-purple from the front right. Auxiliary light is cool cyan-blue to blue-violet from the front left. Magenta rim light on the hair.

Composition/Camera: Vertical 3:4 tight close-up. Camera at eye level. Mid-telephoto lens perspective. Focus strictly on the foreground eye, nose, and lips.

Texture/Style: High-resolution photorealistic studio beauty photography. Detailed pores, hair strands, and smooth light gradients. Catchlights in eyes are small and natural.

Negative: Do not change dual lighting or purple background; avoid extra fingers/limbs; no text, logos, or watermarks.

items.promptZh:
主题：斑驳阳光下的长凳

主要拍摄对象：一张明亮的肖像，照片中一位 20 多岁的女性坐在{argument name="background" default="lush green park"}的深色木凳上，从头到交叉的膝盖垂直拍摄。主体占据了中心框架的大部分。她面朝前方，头稍微向左倾斜，双手撑在长椅上。她的右腿交叉在左腿上，形成一种柔软的坐姿。

性格/表情：小椭圆形脸、浅象牙色皮肤、棕色眼睛和玫瑰色脸颊。平静的微笑看着镜头。她的浅棕色头发造型为{argument name="hairstyle" default="低辫子髻"}，带有细刘海。金色的背光照射在她的头发上，圆形的阳光照射在她的皮肤上。

服装/姿势：白色{argument name="dress type" default="wrap-style mini dress"}，深V领，腰部系丝带。她外面套了一件从肩上垂下来的透明白色雪纺长开衫。细节丰富的泡泡袖，袖口饰有褶边。她的双手自然地放在长椅上。

背景/灯光：前景是一张带有可见纹理的深棕色木凳。右边有一个象牙色的方形包。背景是一个公园，有深绿色的草坪和大树。来自左上角的强烈温暖的自然光在树叶上形成斑驳的阳光。背景树有圆形散景。

构图/相机：垂直 2:3 比例，从胸部高度看膝盖向上的肖像。脸位于上方中央。人像镜头的浅景深。

纹理/风格：高分辨率逼真的户外时尚照片。象牙色、暖肤色、深棕色和活力绿色是主要颜色。肩膀和膝盖上有亮点。详细的织物纹理和木凳纹理。

缺点：避免面部或微笑变形、多余的手指、四肢合并、不自然的阴影、徽标或水印。
items.prompt:
Subject: Bench in Dappled Sunlight

Main Subject: A bright portrait of a woman in her 20s sitting on a dark wooden bench in a {argument name="background" default="lush green park"}, captured vertically from head to crossed knees. The subject takes up much of the center frame. She faces forward with her head slightly tilted to her left, supporting herself with her hands on the bench seat. Her right leg is crossed over the left, creating a soft sitting posture.

Character/Expression: Small oval face, light ivory skin, brown eyes, and rose-colored cheeks. A calm smile looking at the camera. Her light brown hair is styled in a {argument name="hairstyle" default="low braided updo"} with thin bangs. Golden backlighting on her hair and round sun dapples on her skin.

Clothing/Pose: A white {argument name="dress type" default="wrap-style mini dress"} with a deep V-neck and a ribbon tie at the waist. She wears a sheer white chiffon long cardigan over it, falling off the shoulders. Detailed puff sleeves with frilled cuffs. Her hands rest naturally on the bench seat.

Background/Light: Foreground features a dark brown wooden bench with visible grain. An ivory square bag sits on the right. Background is a park with deep green lawn and large trees. Strong warm natural light from the top-left-back creates sun dapples through the leaves. Background trees have circular bokeh.

Composition/Camera: Vertical 2:3 ratio, knee-up portrait from chest height. Face in the upper center. Shallow depth of field with a portrait lens.

Texture/Style: High-resolution realistic outdoor fashion photo. Ivory, warm skin tones, dark brown, and vibrant green are the main colors. Highlights on shoulders and knees. Detailed fabric textures and wooden bench grain.

Negative: Avoid distortion of face or smile, extra fingers, merging of limbs, unnatural shadows, logos, or watermarks.

items.promptZh: 为一位{argument name="character description" default="二十几岁的年轻东亚女性"}创作一幅柔和、自然的生活方式肖像，她在舒适的复古卧室里度过了一个慵懒的周末早晨。她站在门口或衣柜角落的中央，面对镜头，表情平静，略带俏皮的睡意，眼神清澈，妆容精致，皮肤纹理逼真。她的{argument name="hair style" default="长长的黑发松散地扎成低马尾辫，细细的发丝垂落在脸上"}应该看起来休闲且略显凌乱。她穿着一件宽松的纯白色短袖 V 领 T 恤和{argument name="pants" default="蓝黑格子宽松睡裤"}。她的手臂举过头顶，水平地抱着一个奶油色的大枕头，就像一个柔软的垫子放在她的头顶上。使用来自左侧的温暖漫射晨光，透明的白色窗帘占据画面的左边缘，营造出朦胧、柔和的光芒。房间小而温馨，配有深色木质装饰、灰白色墙壁，背景中悬挂着衣服，包括深色条纹毛衣、钩编背心和牛仔面料，以及靠近地板的深色手提箱或储物箱。添加精致的白色手绘涂鸦覆盖照片：正好 13 个可见的涂鸦元素，由手写文字 {argument name="doodle text" default="morning Chaos"}、文字附近和右上角的四颗小星星、两颗小心、一颗小兔子般的涂鸦、一弯新月、左边的一条虚线弯曲轨迹、右边的一条虚线弯曲轨迹和两个小闪光标记组成。将图像设计为亲密的偷拍胶片照片，具有柔焦、柔和的纹理、柔和的温暖、垂直 4:5 构图、无刺眼的对比度、无迷人的修饰、没有多余的人物、没有水印，并且除了涂鸦短语之外没有其他可读文本。
items.prompt: Create a soft, naturalistic lifestyle portrait of a {argument name="character description" default="young East Asian woman in her twenties"} spending a lazy weekend morning in a cozy vintage bedroom. She stands centered in a doorway or closet nook, facing the camera with a calm, slightly playful sleepy expression, clear eyes, subtle makeup, and realistic skin texture. Her {argument name="hair style" default="long black hair loosely tied in a low ponytail with wispy strands falling around her face"} should look casual and slightly messy. She wears a loose plain white short-sleeve V-neck T-shirt and {argument name="pants" default="blue-black gingham plaid loose pajama pants"}. Her arms are raised above her head, holding a large cream-colored pillow horizontally like a soft cushion resting over the top of her head. Use warm diffused morning light from the left, with a sheer white curtain occupying the left edge of the frame and creating a hazy, gentle glow. The room is small and homey with dark wooden trim, off-white walls, hanging clothes in the background including a dark striped sweater, a crocheted vest, and denim fabric, plus a dark suitcase or storage box near the floor. Add delicate white hand-drawn doodles overlaying the photo: exactly 13 visible doodle elements consisting of the handwritten words {argument name="doodle text" default="morning chaos"}, four small stars near the text and upper right, two tiny hearts, one small bunny-like scribble, one crescent moon, one dashed curved trail on the left, one dashed curved trail on the right, and two small sparkle marks. Style the image as an intimate candid film photograph with soft focus, mild grain, pastel warmth, vertical 4:5 composition, no harsh contrast, no glamour retouching, no extra people, no watermark, and no additional readable text beyond the doodle phrase.

items.promptZh: 9点16分垂直方向，东方仿古刺绣作坊艺术妆容肖像，采用巨型圆形绣框作为前景取景装置进行高精度写实摄影。 {argument name="subject" default="一位明显成年的年轻东方女性，视觉年龄约为 25-28 岁"} 站在一个大刺绣框架后面，透过刺绣的花卉图案可以看到她的脸和上半身。彩色丝线从边缘向中心延伸，绣花针放在指尖附近，捕捉创作的瞬间。一手握着细长的金针，一手轻抚着飘落的丝线，身体微微前倾，目光直视画面，专注而柔和，将贵妇的泰然自若与女性创造者的静谧力量融为一体。角色有着成熟、自然的东方古典骨骼结构，柔和的鹅蛋脸，清澈的杏眼中带着静谧的光芒，嘴唇饱满。妆容以瓷白为基底，保留真实的肌肤纹理。眼影有桃粉色和梅子玫瑰色，带有金色闪光。唇部涂有桃红色玫瑰玻璃釉。黑发盘成繁茂的古典发髻，配以金针、白玉簪和珍珠。服装使用{argument name="服装颜色" default="珍珠白、柔莲紫、浅金色"}。工作室里摆满了木线轴和金属针，巨大的框架构成了绣制牡丹和蝴蝶的自然风景框。柔和的暖白光从天窗落下，彩色的丝线将色彩反射到她的脸上。侧光凸显了她的锁骨和腰部，而深色的车间背景则增强了她皮肤和衣服的亮度。
items.prompt: 9:16 vertical orientation, artistic makeup portrait in an Oriental antique embroidery workshop, high-precision realistic photography using a giant circular embroidery frame as the foreground framing device. {argument name="subject" default="A clearly adult young Oriental female, visually aged about 25–28 years"} stands behind a large embroidery frame, her face and upper body visible through the floral patterns being embroidered. Colored silk threads extend from the edges toward the center, with an embroidery needle resting near her fingertips, capturing a moment in creation. One hand holds a slender gold needle, the other gently touches the falling threads, body leaning slightly forward, gaze looking straight through the frame into the camera—focused and soft, combining the poise of a noblewoman with the quiet power of a female creator. The character has a mature, natural Oriental classical bone structure, soft oval face, clear almond eyes with quiet light, and full lips. The makeup features a porcelain white base, preserving real skin texture. Eyeshadow is in peach pink and plum rose, with gold shimmer. Lips are finished with peach-red rose glass glaze. Black hair is styled in a lush classical bun with gold needles, white jade hairpins, and pearls. The clothing uses {argument name="clothing colors" default="pearl white, soft lotus purple, and light gold"}. The workshop is filled with wooden spools and metal needles, with a giant frame creating a natural scenic frame of embroidered peonies and butterflies. Soft warm white light falls from a skylight, with colored threads reflecting hues onto her face. Side lighting highlights her collarbone and waist, while the dark workshop background enhances the brightness of her skin and clothing.

items.title: Social Media Post - Sun-Drenched Resort Fashion Portrait
items.titleZh: Social Media Post - Sun-Drenched Resort Fashion Portrait
items.promptZh:
主题：
{argument name="theme" default="中午在蔚蓝的海水旁放松身心"}

主要主题：
一幅垂直的度假村肖像，一位女士穿着{argument name="clothing" default="white Swimwear"}懒洋洋地躺在黑色木甲板上，甲板上伸出高度透明的蓝色大海，沐浴在阳光下。一条腿悬垂在水面上，而她坐着，另一只膝盖抬起。

人物/表情：
一个20多岁的女人。她的脸斜着向上，眼睛上戴着大大的棕色太阳镜。嘴唇微微张开，表情平静。自然、有光泽的皮肤，浅珊瑚色的嘴唇和微妙的健康光泽。她的头发是{argument name="hair style" default="有光泽的黑色长发"}，垂至胸前，在微风中散开在身后。

服装/姿势：
象牙白色比基尼上衣，配有细肩带、荷叶边和中央丝带领带。搭配带有精美褶边的配套短裤，一件薄薄的白色条纹罩衫宽松地披在肩上。她将上半身向后倾斜，用一只手支撑在甲板上。一条膝盖高高弯曲，另一条腿伸长，脚放在靠近水面的地方。两只脚踝上都戴着精致的银色脚链。

背景/灯光：
画面的大部分被清澈的海面占据，从绿松石色过渡到深蓝色。透过水面可以看到浅浅的海床和细小的波纹，夏季强烈的阳光在海面上反射出白色的光芒。甲板上她旁边有一顶蕾丝边草帽和一块柔软的芥末米色布料。来自高处的明亮自然光会产生轮廓分明的柔和阴影。

构图/相机：

Canvas: Portrait 2:3 layout, off-white paper background, rounded corners, thin double green ornamental border with small leaf flourishes in the corners. Use soft watercolor-style food illustrations, friendly rounded Japanese fonts, dark brown main title text, green section ribbons, orange accents, dotted divider lines, and subtle sparkles.

Top header: Large centered headline text: {argument name="recipe title" default="4種野菜のスタミナガーリック炒め"}. Directly underneath, orange subtitle: {argument name="subtitle" default="（バター不使用版）"}. Add a small Japanese tagline below: "シャキッ！ほくっ！にんにく香る、食べごたえ抜群のスタミナおかず♪". Place a large illustrated cabbage on the upper left, a small garlic bulb icon near the upper right, and a black frying pan on the upper right filled with stir-fried cabbage, green bell pepper, potato slices, and garlic.

Main layout: Use five distinct content blocks arranged like a recipe card: 1 ingredients box at upper left, 1 preparation box at upper right, 1 cooking steps box at middle left, 1 technique tips box at middle right, and 1 serving memo box across the bottom.

Ingredients block: Green ribbon header "材料（2人分）". List exactly 10 ingredients with dotted leader lines and amounts: 1) キャベツ — 1/4玉（約250g）, 2) じゃがいも — 2個（約300g）, 3) ピーマン — 2個, 4) にんにく — 2かけ, 5) サラダ油 — 大さじ1, 6) ごま油 — 小さじ1, 7) しょうゆ — 大さじ1, 8) 鶏ガラスープの素 — 小さじ1, 9) 塩 — 少々, 10) こしょう — 少々. Include three small illustrations at the bottom of this box: green bell peppers, potatoes with one cut open, and garlic cloves.

Preparation block: Green ribbon header "下準備" with explanatory text: "じゃがいもはあらかじめ火を通しておくと、炒め時間が短くなり、味がしみ込みやすくなります。" Include exactly 2 preparation methods in rounded subcards. First green subcard titled "レンジで加熱する場合" with microwave icon and exactly 3 numbered steps: 1) じゃがいもは皮をむき、1.5cm幅の半月切りにする。 2) 耐熱容器に入れ、ふんわりとラップをかける。 3) 600Wで約5〜6分加熱する。 Add note: "※竹串がスッと通るくらいが目安です。" Second orange subcard titled "ゆでる場合" with pot icon and exactly 3 numbered steps: 1) じゃがいもは皮をむき、1.5cm幅の半月切りにする。 2) 鍋に水とじゃがいもを入れ、沸騰したら中火で3〜4分ゆでる。 3) ザルに上げて水気を切る。 Add note: "※固めに火を通すのがポイント！".

Cooking steps block: Orange ribbon header "作り方". Show exactly 7 numbered orange circles with Japanese step text: 1) キャベツはざく切り、ピーマンは縦にひと口大の細切りにする。にんにくは薄切りにする。 2) フライパンにサラダ油を中火で熱し、にんにくを炒める。香りが立ってきたら、じゃがいもを加えて焼き目がつくまで炒める。 3) ピーマンを加えてさっと炒める。 4) キャベツを加え、強めの中火でシャキッとするまで炒める。 5) 鶏ガラスープの素を加えて全体を炒め合わせる。 6) しょうゆを鍋肌から回し入れ、さっと絡める。ごま油を回しかけて香りをプラス。 7) 塩・こしょうで味をととのえ、全体をさっと混ぜて完成！ Add a tiny pan illustration near the lower right of this block with vegetables flying and a handwritten note "強火でサッと炒めてシャキッ！".

Technique tips block: Yellow-orange header "スタミナを盛る裏技" with sparkles. Include exactly 3 tip rows, each with an orange check icon and a small illustration on the right: 1) "にんにくは「香りを立てる」！" with garlic bulb, 2) "じゃがいもは「焼き目」をつける！" with potatoes, 3) "仕上げのごま油でコクUP！" with a sesame oil bottle labeled "ごま油". Use short explanatory Japanese text beneath each tip.

Bottom serving memo block: Green ribbon header "いただき方のメモ". Include the text "熱々のうちにどうぞ！ごはんが進む味つけで、スタミナ満点♪" and exactly 3 green check bullet points: 1) 白ごはんとの相性抜群！ 2) お弁当のおかずにも◎ 3) 冷めてもおいしいので、作り置きにもおすすめです。 Add three food illustrations along the bottom: a bowl of white rice, a plated serving of the vegetable garlic stir-fry, and a speech bubble saying "にんにくの香りと野菜の甘みで、やみつきになるおいしさです♪" with a small heart.

Visual constraints: Keep all Japanese text crisp and readable, maintain a balanced magazine-recipe layout, use no photographs, no watermark, no extra sections, and no additional ingredients or steps.
